jobs.description:
**The Job**
-----------

**The Department of Public Health (DPH)** is recruiting for a **Department Systems Engineer** to serve as an internal technical consultant on all related departmental systems. Duties include assessing organizational needs and computing resources; monitoring and managing server and network infrastructure in a data center environment; assessing and evaluating configurations to optimize systems; developing system security standards; researching and procuring hardware/software; managing hardware/software maintenance and licensing renewals; serving as project manager for technology projects; and creating and maintaining technical documentation.

  

A current vacancy exists with the**Department of Public Health**. The resulting list may be used for future vacancies throughout the County.

*For a more comprehensive listing of job duties for this classification, view the* Department Systems Engineer *job description.*

  

**EXCELLENT BENEFITS**

To review job-specific benefits, refer to: **Summary of Benefits** and the **Memoranda of Understanding (MOU)**

**Pre-Employment Process:**Incumbent must successfully complete a background investigation (fingerprinting and work history/education check) in addition to a job-related physical exam, including a drug test.

  

**Availability:** Incumbents may occasionally work evening and weekend hours. Some overtime, on-call, or call back work may be required.

  

**Sponsorship:** Please note San Bernardino County is not able to consider candidates who will require visa sponsorship at the time of application or in the future. Candidates must be able to present their legal right to work in the United States.

* Windows System Administration to include maintaining and troubleshooting Windows Active Directory, Windows Server 2016 and later.
* Database Administration on MS SQL Server 2016 and later.
* Administration of Network Infrastructure, such as switches, routers, and IDS Modules.
* Administration of Enterprise Storage and Backup Solutions
* Administration of a Virtual Machine (VM) Environment
* Administration of a Cloud/Hybrid-Cloud Environment

**- AND -**

  

**REQUIRED EDUCATION:**Thirty (30) semester (45 quarter) units of completed post high-school coursework in computer science, business/public administration, or closely related field. *A list of coursework is required unless applicant possesses a bachelor's degree in a qualifying field.*

  

*Education Substitution:* An additional one (1) year of qualifying experience within last six (6) years may substitute 15 semester (23 quarter) units of the education requirement, for up to 30 semester (45 quarter) units.
  
  
*Note:* *Qualifying degrees or coursework must be completed at a college or university accredited by any accrediting association recognized by the United States Department of Education. jobs.description:

**Description**
---------------

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Aeronautics Systems is seeking a **Principal Systems Engineer** to support fielded airborne ISR systems and associated data center, network, and communication infrastructures at Beale AFB, CA. This role is a key technical interface between operations, field users, engineering Integrated Product Teams (IPTs), and customer representatives. The selected engineer will apply systems thinking to sustain and improve mission systems, resolve complex field issues, and drive configuration changes from concept through implementation in support of 24/7 operations.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the on-site systems engineering liaison between operations, engineering IPTs, and customer stakeholders to resolve field issues, escalations, and installations.
* Sustain and provide real-time support for mission systems, including operating systems (Windows, Linux, VMware ESXi), data center hardware (compute, storage, network), and ground communication/network infrastructure (routers, switches, firewalls, SATCOM/RF).
* Perform system-level troubleshooting and root cause analysis across avionics, data center, network, and communication subsystems in field and control room environments.
* Plan, configure, integrate, and test hardware/software changes in lab and operational environments; ensure interoperability across compute, storage, and network.
* Lead intake, technical review, and execution of configuration and change requests, including preparation of Configuration Change Board (CCB) packages with risk assessments and implementation guidance.
* Coordinate and track cross-functional action items and change requests; maintain status and performance metrics for field modifications and fixes.
* Develop and execute test plans, integration procedures, and verification/validation activities for new or modified payloads, instrumentation, and network configurations.
* Provide technical briefings and written status updates to customers, program leadership, and internal stakeholders.
* Support mission operations, including shift work, weekends, holidays, and occasional overtime.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s of Science Degree in a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics) discipline and 5 years of related systems engineering or related engineering experience; OR a Master’s degree in a STEM discipline and 3 years of related systems engineering or related engineering experience
* Experience with system integration, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis across hardware, software, and network boundaries.
* Familiarity with modern operating systems and networking concepts (e.g., Windows and/or Linux administration, TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, ACLs, VPNs).
* Experience reading and interpreting electrical and/or mechanical drawings, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation.
* Experience working cross-functionally with engineering teams and technicians to implement system changes and resolve issues under schedule pressure.
* Active USG Top Secret SCI clearance (with a background investigation within the past 5 years or enrolled into Continuous Evaluation).
* Ability to obtain and maintain initial Special Access Program (SAP) access via a Program Access Request (PAR). This SAP/PAR must be obtained prior to commencement of employment and must be obtained within a reasonable amount of time as determined by the company to meet its business needs.
* Ability to work non-standard hours (shift work, nights, weekends, holidays) and support occasional travel (up to ~25%).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including clear technical documentation and briefings.
* Experience supporting airborne ISR platforms and associated ground systems in field or test environments.
* Experience configuring and troubleshooting network equipment (e.g., Cisco or equivalent switches/routers, firewalls such as Cisco ASA/Firepower or Palo Alto) and virtualized environments (VMware ESXi or similar).
* Familiarity with network management and security protocols (e.g., SNMP, SSH, syslog, RADIUS/TACACS).
* Experience with Agile practices and/or tools (e.g., JIRA) for managing engineering actions.
* Proficiency in one or more programming/scripting languages (e.g., C, C++, Python, Bash)
* Prior military, flight test, or depot-level field engineering support experience.
* DoD 8140 IAT Level II (or higher) compliant certification (e.g., Security+ CE, CCNA Security, CCNP, CISSP) strongly preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer-Air Transport Engineering
jobs.description:
**Job Description**  
BAE Systems is hiring for a Product Focal Lead. At BAE Systems, we deliver a full range of products and services for air, land and naval forces, as well as advanced electronics, security, information technology solutions and customer support services. If you are an individual that enjoys a cohesive team environment and is interested in a variety of challenges across a variety of products, then we are interested in hearing from you! The Product Focal Lead (PFL) is responsible for managing production and field issues related to commercial avionics products. The PFL reports to the Integrated Product Team Leader (IPTL) and manages component obsolescence, FPGA changes, failure analyses, reliability investigations and factory yield related to a specific product area within the Controls and Avionics Solution business. In this capacity, the PFL is responsible for communicating and managing issues with the customer (aircraft OEM) (10% of effort), BAE Systems operations team (10% of effort), and internally within the program team (10% of effort); lead the engineering team to investigate and resolve product issues, including leading the Engineering 7-Step investigation process (40% of effort), and perform direct engineering analysis of product issues (30% of effort).  
  
  
  
**Required Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* Bachelor's Degree and 4 years work experience or equivalent experience.
* Knowledge of factory test methods, including ATP and ESS.
* Familiarity with product and component failure analysis methods, including use of engineering 7-Step method, fault tree analysis, design of experiment, etc.
* Familiar with internal parts list and BOM structure, product design and release processes, including change management (Windchill, etc.).
* Experience with product test and test equipment operations.
* Familiarity with design tools (PTC Creo, Spice, etc.).
* Ability to review component data sheets and perform component selection, selection of alternate parts, component date codes, etc.
* Experience writing technical communications (coordination memos, briefs, etc.).
* Familiarity with product qualification per DO-160.
* Familiarity with hardware design and certification per DO-254.
  

  
  
**Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* Experience with development and operation of commercial aircraft avionics products for aircraft preferred.
* Experience in customer communications and messaging.
* Experience working in and/or leading a cross-functional team.
  

  
  
**Pay Information**
  
Full-Time Salary Range: $79370 - $134929
  
  
Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.
  
  
Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.  
  
  
  
**About BAE Systems, Inc.**
  
BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.
  
  
Our culture is performance-driven and values-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters.
  
  
This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

jobs.title: IoT engineer II - ST, Seattle, WA
jobs.description:
**Role summary**

The IoT Engineer II designs, develops, tests, deploys, and supports software that connects retail devices and edge systems to secure, scalable cloud services. This engineer works across device integrations, telemetry and messaging, backend APIs, operational tooling, and web experiences used by engineering and support teams. The role independently delivers well-defined features, contributes to solution design, and improves the reliability and supportability of connected-device platforms.

**What you will do**

* Develop and maintain IoT applications and services using Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript, including unit, integration, and automated test coverage.
* Build software that runs on Linux-based edge devices and communicates with sensors, controllers, peripherals, gateways, and connected retail equipment.
* Develop Python-based APIs and microservices for device onboarding, configuration, telemetry ingestion, command and control, and operational workflows.
* Implement event-driven integrations using MQTT, Kafka, or comparable messaging technologies, with appropriate retry, ordering, durability, and failure-handling patterns.
* Create React-based dashboards and administrative tools that improve fleet visibility, device health monitoring, diagnostics, and support workflows.
* Deploy and operate containerized services using Kubernetes and public cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS.
* Apply secure engineering practices, including authentication, authorization, certificate or token management, secrets handling, dependency management, and protection of device-to-cloud communications.
* Build observability through structured logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, and actionable alerts; participate in incident response, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
* Contribute to requirements analysis, technical design, prototypes, code reviews, release readiness, documentation, and continuous improvement of engineering standards.
* Partner with product, store operations, cybersecurity, networking, data engineering, support, and vendor teams to deliver reliable connected solutions.

**Basic qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* At least 2 years of professional experience in application development, software engineering, platform engineering, IoT, edge computing, or a related role.
* Professional experience developing production software with Python and at least one of C, C++, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
* Experience with RESTful APIs, automated testing, source control, pull requests, code review, and CI/CD practices.
* Experience deploying or supporting applications in Azure, AWS, or another public cloud environment.
* Working knowledge of Linux, networking fundamentals, and troubleshooting across application, device, and infrastructure layers.
* Experience working in an Agile engineering team and using tools such as GitHub, Jira, and Confluence.
* Ability to communicate technical decisions clearly and collaborate across engineering and business functions.

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience with connected-device platforms, device telemetry, fleet management, provisioning, remote configuration, or lifecycle management.
* Experience with MQTT, Kafka, AMQP, or other event-driven and device-messaging technologies.
* Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, infrastructure-as-code, and cloud-native operational practices.
* Experience building React applications, support dashboards, or administrative interfaces.
* Experience with relational databases such as MySQL and practical SQL development.
* Familiarity with observability tools such as Datadog, Grafana, Splunk, Prometheus, or Azure Monitor.
* Experience supporting retail technology, operational technology, connected appliances, sensors, digital displays, or other distributed hardware environments.
* Knowledge of secure device identity, certificate-based authentication, secrets rotation, vulnerability management, and software supply-chain controls.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Oncology Applications
jobs.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

Position: Software Engineer, Oncology Applications

Reporting to: Director, Software Engineering

Location: Remote

About The Job

At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees around the world work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We’re looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.

Position Summary

Oncology at Lilly depends on software that connects people, data, systems, and workflows across research and business operations. The Software Engineer, Oncology Applications designs, builds, integrates, and sustains applications that improve access to information, reduce manual work, and help teams operate more efficiently.

The position sits within the software engineering group and serves the Oncology organization broadly. The engineer will partner with discovery and translational teams, scientific platforms, informatics, research operations, and Tech@Lilly. Work may include scientific data applications, workflow and process tools, dashboards and reporting, system integrations, automation, and AI-enabled interfaces. The portfolio will evolve with Oncology priorities and technologies.

The role requires sound engineering practices, thoughtful use of AI-assisted development, and a focus on secure, tested, maintainable systems.

Key Responsibilities

Design, build, deploy, and sustain full-stack applications, data services, workflow tools, and automation for scientific and operational users.

Partner with scientists, engineers, informatics teams, and business stakeholders to identify needs, clarify requirements, and define practical deliverables.

Improve efficiency by simplifying processes, reducing manual handoffs and duplicative data entry, and connecting fragmented data and systems.

Build and maintain APIs, data models, and access layers across scientific, operational, enterprise, and vendor data sources.

Integrate applications with laboratory systems, data pipelines, analysis environments, and enterprise platforms.

Apply appropriate standards for data quality, provenance, versioning, security, and access control.

Develop AI-enabled capabilities where they provide clear value, such as information retrieval, natural-language data access, extraction, annotation, and summarization.

Use AI-assisted development tools while maintaining established standards for code review, testing, security, and ownership.

Evaluate technology options and recommend whether needs are best addressed through custom development, configuration, integration, reuse, purchase, process change, or retirement.

Contribute to shared engineering practices, including version control, peer review, automated testing, CI/CD, containerization, observability, and dependency management.

Deploy and operate applications on Lilly cloud infrastructure in partnership with Tech@Lilly and Information Security.

Own application reliability, user support, documentation, maintenance, and lifecycle planning.

Mentor junior engineers, co-ops, and scientist-developers as appropriate.

Required Qualifications

BS or MS in computer science, software engineering, or a related discipline, with 4 or more years of professional software engineering experience. An equivalent combination of education and demonstrated experience will be considered

Additional Preferred Qualifications

Strong programming experience with Python or another modern server-side language; Python experience is preferred.

Experience developing web applications or APIs using modern server-side frameworks (preferred frameworks for experience: Django, Flask, Ruby on Rails)

Front-end development experience with JavaScript or TypeScript and a modern component framework.

Experience with relational database design, SQL, APIs, and system integration.

Experience with cloud deployment, preferably AWS, as well as containerization and CI/CD pipelines.

Fluency with Git-based collaborative development, code review, automated testing, and production support.

Experience with AI-assisted development tools and working familiarity with LLM APIs or related application patterns.

Ability to work directly with scientific and operational stakeholders and communicate technical options clearly to non-engineers.

Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage concurrent projects, and adapt to changing priorities.

Experience developing scientific, operational, or data-intensive business applications.

Prior work in pharma, biotech, healthcare, research, or another regulated environment.

Experience with biological data, laboratory systems, scientific instruments, or research data pipelines.

Experience with workflow automation, enterprise integration, reporting, or interactive data visualization.

Experience developing AI-enabled or agentic applications over internal data sources.

Familiarity with data governance, sensitive-data handling, or controlled-access systems.

Work Environment and Physical Demands

This position is primarily computational and office-based, with regular in-person collaboration with laboratory, informatics, technology, and operations teams. Travel requirements are less than 5%. The physical demands described are representative of those required to perform the essential functions of this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities.

Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.

Lilly is proud to be an EEO Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

Our employee resource groups (ERGs) offer strong support networks for their members and are open to all employees. Our current groups include: Africa, Middle East, Central Asia (AMECA), Black Employees at Lilly (BE@Lilly), Chinese Culture Network (CCN), EnAble, Evolve, Lilly Indian Network (LIN), Organization of Latinx at Lilly (OLA), Pride (LGBTQ+ Allies), Veterans Leadership Network (VLN) and Women’s Initiative for Leading at Lilly (WILL).

Actual compensation will depend on a candidate’s education, experience, skills, and geographic location. The anticipated wage for this position is

$126,000 - $224,400

Full-time equivalent employees also will be eligible for a company bonus (depending, in part, on company and individual performance). In addition, Lilly offers a comprehensive benefit program to eligible employees, including eligibility to participate in a company-sponsored 401(k); pension; vacation benefits; eligibility for medical, dental, vision and prescription drug benefits; flexible benefits (e.g., healthcare and/or dependent day care flexible spending accounts); life insurance and death benefits; certain time off and leave of absence benefits; and well-being benefits (e.g., employee assistance program, fitness benefits, and employee clubs and activities).Lilly reserves the right to amend, modify, or terminate its compensation and benefit programs in its sole discretion and Lilly’s compensation practices and guidelines will apply regarding the details of any promotion or transfer of Lilly employees.

### **About Us**

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world's largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. jobs.title: Embedded Systems Engineer, Robotics
jobs.description:
**ABOUT DEXMATE**

Dexmate is building the foundation for physical AI — combining a new generation of robots with a universal Physical AI OS, making robots as easy to build and deploy as software. Today, robotics is fragmented, slow, and closed: most builders are forced to reinvent the same stack again and again, and most ideas never make it past the prototype stage. We exist to change that. Our mission is to democratize robotics by lowering the barrier to entry, delivering a plug-and-play platform for developers, researchers, and enterprises, and cultivating an open ecosystem that accelerates the evolution of physical AI.

If you want to help shape the next layer of human capability — and believe the future of robotics should be built together, not in isolation — we'd love to build it with you.

**THE ROLE**

We're looking for an Embedded Systems Engineer to own the boundary where our robot's electronics meet its software. You will bring up and debug new PCBs, write the firmware and drivers that make every sensor, camera, actuator, and compute module talk to each other, and make sure data moves reliably across CAN/CAN FD, EtherCAT, GMSL, I2C, SPI, and Ethernet.

This is a hands-on, cross-layer role. One day you're probing a board with a scope to find why a bus is dropping frames; the next you're writing a Linux driver for a camera serializer or tuning an EtherCAT network for deterministic timing. You'll work closely with electrical, firmware, controls, and robotics software engineers, and you'll often be the person who figures out whether a problem lives in hardware, firmware, or software.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Bringing up, validating, and debugging new PCBs: reading schematics and layouts, measuring signals, and isolating hardware vs. software faults
* Developing firmware for MCUs (bare-metal and RTOS) and drivers for embedded Linux platforms (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson / Orin)
* Writing and maintaining device drivers and communication stacks for CAN/CAN FD, EtherCAT, I2C, SPI, UART, and Ethernet
* Integrating camera and sensor pipelines over GMSL (serializer/deserializer configuration, device trees, V4L2 drivers, timing and synchronization)
* Bringing up and tuning EtherCAT and CAN networks across actuators, sensors, and power systems for deterministic, real-time performance
* Debugging signal-integrity, power, timing, and bus-level issues with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and protocol analyzers
* Contributing firmware and software input during schematic and PCB design reviews to make boards easier to bring up, test, and debug
* Building diagnostics, test fixtures, and automated hardware-in-the-loop tests for boards and subsystems
* Supporting manufacturing, end-of-line testing, and field troubleshooting as robots move from prototype to deployment
* Documenting interfaces, bring-up procedures, and debugging playbooks for the wider team

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* 3+ years of professional experience in embedded systems in robotics, automotive, industrial automation, or complex consumer electronics
* Strong C and C++ skills for firmware and driver development; working knowledge of Python for tooling and test automation
* Hands-on board bring-up experience, including reading schematics, PCB layouts, datasheets, and timing diagrams
* Driver-level experience with several of: CAN/CAN FD, EtherCAT, I2C, SPI, UART, Ethernet
* Experience with MCU firmware (ARM Cortex-M, STM32, TI C2000, or similar) on bare-metal or RTOS platforms
* Comfort with embedded debugging and lab tools: JTAG/SWD debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and protocol analyzers
* Systematic debugging skills across the hardware, firmware, and software boundary
* Strong communication skills and comfort working directly with electrical, mechanical, controls, and software engineers

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with GMSL or other high-speed camera links (e.g., MAX9295/MAX9296, FPD-Link), MIPI CSI-2, and V4L2
* Embedded Linux kernel and device-driver development, device trees, and BSP bring-up (NVIDIA Jetson / Orin a plus)
* Experience integrating EtherCAT master or slave stacks (SOEM, IgH, or equivalent)
* Familiarity with PCB design tools (Altium, KiCad) and the ability to propose schematic-level fixes
* Knowledge of signal integrity, power integrity, and EMC fundamentals
* Experience with motor-control, BMS, or power-electronics systems
* Experience with ROS 2 or other robotics middleware
* Prior experience working in a vertically integrated robotics or hardware startup
* Hands-on use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex to accelerate implementation, debugging, testing, and documentation

Compensation Range: $100K - $300K

jobs.description:
### **About Us**

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world's largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine's Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World's Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we're not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we're looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you're the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you'll fit right in.

### **Available Locations: Austin, TX | New York, NY | San Francisco, CA | Seattle, WA | London, UK**

### **About the Role**

Cloudflare's Developer Platform powers stateful, data-intensive applications across our network. We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to work across the database stack, from query planning and execution to transaction processing and durable storage.

You'll make decisions that shape the consistency, durability, and latency guarantees that customer applications rely on.

Correctness under concurrency and failure is central to the role. You'll define and implement how queries read and modify data, how concurrent transactions become visible, and how durable state is recovered. You'll validate these systems using deterministic simulation, workload testing, and evidence from production.

### **Responsibilities**

* Improve query planning and execution, including index selection, row reads and writes, and performance as data volumes and access patterns change.
* Build transaction and storage paths that make writes durable and reads consistent. Define when changes become visible, how commits survive failure, and how recovery restores a correct view of the data.
* Design deterministic simulations that make rare event orderings and failures reproducible.
* Plan stateful upgrades that cannot be reversed by rolling back software. Carry them through staged rollout, failover, and recovery without putting existing data at risk.
* Participate in the service's on-call rotation and incident response.
* Own major changes from design through production. Coordinate implementation across teams when a change spans multiple parts of the service, and help trace failures across those parts.
* Mentor other engineers through design reviews, debugging, and incident analysis involving concurrency, durability, and recovery.

### **Desirable Skills, Knowledge & Experience**

* You have owned a database, storage engine, transaction system, or similarly correctness-sensitive stateful system from architecture through production. You can make architecture and implementation decisions when requirements or system boundaries are incomplete.
* You understand how query execution, indexing, transaction processing, and durable state shape what developers and operators observe.
* You understand how concurrency control, isolation, replication, and snapshots shape consistency, durability, and recovery. You can apply those concepts when operations arrive out of order, components fail independently, or the network partitions.
* You write and debug concurrent production software in Rust, Go, C++, or another systems language. You can trace failures across process, network, and durable-state boundaries.
* You have operated stateful systems through rollouts, scaling events, incidents, and recovery. You know the difference between transient unavailability and incomplete or incorrect recovery, and when a system is safe to return to service.
* You have led investigations where failures crossed systems owned by several teams.

### **Bonus Points**

* You've worked on the internals of PostgreSQL, MySQL, Amazon Aurora, or another relational database and can trace a SQL operation from planning through commit.
* Your work on transaction processing or concurrency control has included defining snapshot visibility and recovery behavior.
* You've profiled database workloads and traced performance bottlenecks from query execution through durable storage.
* You've used deterministic simulation or another systematic method to uncover distributed-systems bugs that conventional tests missed.

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

* For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $194,000 - $266,000
* For New York City, New Jersey, Washington, Washington DC, and California (excluding Bay Area) based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000

jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager, AI Kernels & Performance Optimization — MTIA Software
jobs.description:
Meta designs and deploys its own AI systems. MTIA — the Meta Training and Inference Accelerator — is Meta's family of in-house AI accelerator ASICs, running recommendation and ranking workloads in production across Meta's data centers today and expanding into generative AI inference and training as successive silicon generations land.The MTIA Software team is part of the AI & Compute Foundation (ACF) organization within Meta Infrastructure. We build the entire stack a chip vendor would normally supply — compiler and LLVM toolchain, runtime, kernel authoring frameworks and libraries, developer tooling, and deep PyTorch integration — co-designing it with the silicon teams generation over generation.Within that stack, the AI Kernels and Performance Optimization team (KORE) owns the layer where silicon architecture meets arithmetic. Our mission is roofline-level performance and programmability at scale: we design and implement high-performance compute and communication kernels (GEMM, attention variants, normalization, collectives, elementwise and reduction fusions, sparse and quantized paths) against novel architectural features including matrix engines, on-chip reduction fabrics, and software-managed memory hierarchies. We ship kernel libraries with broad PyTorch operator coverage, build C++ and Python kernel authoring frameworks and DSL surfaces, and write production kernels against new architectures long before first silicon — turning hardware proposals into measured roofline evidence while the design can still change.We are seeking a Software Engineering Manager to lead a team of kernel and performance engineers doing this work. You will own the performance of workloads that serve billions of people, drive technical strategy for kernel development and optimization, and build a team that can deliver roofline-level performance on MTIA accelerators. Your team will profile and root-cause performance across the full stack — instruction scheduling, memory hierarchy and DMA behavior, on-chip interconnect, multi-device collectives — and drive fixes to the right layer, whether that is the kernel, compiler, runtime, or hardware. You will partner closely with silicon architecture teams on hardware/software co-design, quantifying the value of proposed features with real kernels and advocating for the changes the software stack needs. This is a hands-on technical leadership role where you will contribute directly to architectural decisions while enabling your team to move with speed and clarity.  
  
  

### **Software Engineering Manager, AI Kernels & Performance Optimization — MTIA Software Responsibilities:**

* Lead and manage a team of systems engineers delivering on multiple concurrent projects across ambiguous, high-impact areas of Meta's platform infrastructure
* Drive roadmap creation and technical strategy for systems-level software, ensuring alignment with broader product and engineering goals
* Contribute directly to technical work including architecture reviews, design documents, and hands-on coding to maintain credibility and unblock the team
* Identify and resolve systemic issues affecting team velocity, including on-call load, technical debt, and gaps in tooling or automation
* Partner with product, design, and data science to ensure engineers contribute across disciplines and deliver outcomes that move business metrics forward
* Set clear goals and expectations for individual engineers, provide timely and actionable feedback, and proactively address performance gaps
* Manage staged rollouts and feature delivery using feature flagging and A/B testing frameworks, ensuring high engineering quality and system reliability
* Recruit, onboard, and develop engineers, building a team structure that minimizes single points of failure and scales with organizational needs
* Communicate team goals, technical decisions, and progress clearly to cross-functional partners and leadership, including written design proposals and postmortems
* Participate in org-wide engineering contributions, sharing effective workflows, tooling practices, and systems engineering patterns across the broader organization

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 4+ years of experience in software engineering with a focus on systems-level software, platform infrastructure, or distributed systems
* 2+ years of experience managing or leading engineering teams, including setting technical direction and supporting engineer growth
* Experience driving technical roadmaps and executing against them with measurable outcomes in ambiguous or high-complexity environments
* Experience identifying and resolving engineering efficiency issues such as on-call burden, technical debt, or gaps in automation
* Experience collaborating across product, design, and data functions to deliver software that achieves business and user impact

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Track record of hands-on technical contribution as a manager, including authoring design documents, reviewing system architectures, or writing production code
* Experience with hardware/software co-design cycles: collaborating with silicon architects, validating architectural features with real kernels, and influencing hardware roadmaps based on software performance analysis
* Experience working on customized AI accelerators (TPU, AI ASICs, or similar non-GPU architectures) with direct involvement in kernel development and roofline enablement
* Familiarity with transformer and attention kernel design: FlashAttention-class algorithms, KV-cache management, paged and chunked attention, MoE routing and expert dispatch
* Experience with distributed execution and collective communication (NCCL/RCCL-class primitives, tensor and expert parallelism, overlapping communication with compute)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience managing or leading

jobs.title: Senior Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. The Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) team are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all the robotics and material handling equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!  
  
About the Role:  
As a Senior Automation Engineer, you will play a crucial role in maximizing equipment reliability and operational performance in our fulfillment centers by providing proactive controls automation and technical support. Your expertise will be essential in troubleshooting complex control systems, analyzing performance metrics, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. You'll mentor junior engineers and lead cross-functional teams to optimize material handling equipment (MHE) systems, implement innovative projects, and develop system design improvements to enhance site throughput. You'll work with state-of-the-art technology, including conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print and apply systems, and SCADA devices and programs. Through your technical leadership and design optimization efforts, you'll directly contribute to ensuring our customers receive their orders with Amazon's signature speed and accuracy while building team capabilities and driving operational excellence.  
  
What Do We Offer?  
Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there’s more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  

* You will apply Subject Matter Expertise (SME) on troubleshooting and dive deeps for engineering issues, supporting automation engineers to investigate the root cause and planning actions to eliminate/mitigate the downtime of critical assets
* You will collaborate with building Operations, Operations Engineering teams, FC Start-up Team, AFT Software teams, ACES team, and Safety to support MHE systems optimization and project implementation
* You will understand, maintain and troubleshoot material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers and industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems
* You will monitor MHE metrics and partner with maintenance/operations to address system performance issues and provide analysis across all operations
* You will provide escalation support to automation engineers, during and after business hours, troubleshooting locally and remotely, to ensure that all hardware or controls software within the building is repaired on time
* You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent, or 4+ years of PLC programming or automation engineering experience
* Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
* 4+ years of process or production environment related PLC-controlled automation and issue diagnosis experience
* 4+ years of robotics work cells and control systems experience
* 4+ years of Siemens, Allen-Bradley or Codesys Ladder Logic and structure programming experience
* 4+ years of electrical theory, robotics, controls components, and automated equipment experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent
* Master's degree, or Six Sigma Black Belt certification
* Experience leading controls in manufacturing or complex industrial environments
* Experience identifying, maintaining, troubleshooting, and modifying Motor Controls including motor starters, Variable Frequency Drives, DC drives, and standard electrical components
* Experience interpreting and modifying mechanical and electrical drawings

jobs.title: Manufacturing Automation Engineer – Cobots
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**The Role**

The Manufacturing Automation Engineer – Cobots leads the development, deployment, optimization, and sustainment of manufacturing automation solutions across GPS manufacturing sites. This role combines deep manufacturing engineering expertise with end-to-end project leadership.

  

You will identify processes suitable for automation, evaluate the right solution—including collaborative robots (cobots), traditional industrial robots, vision systems, controls, and other automation technologies—and lead turnkey projects from concept through launch and sustainment. You will partner with plant teams, manufacturing engineering, controls and automation teams, suppliers, and business stakeholders to deliver solutions that improve safety, quality, ergonomics, throughput, labor efficiency, equipment utilization, and cost performance.

  

This role supports projects across multiple plant locations. Travel is expected to vary by project phase and may reach 50% or more, including overnight travel and extended time at manufacturing plants during equipment build, installation, commissioning, and launch. Travel may exceed 50% during critical launch periods.

  

**What You’ll Do**

* Visit manufacturing plants and assess current processes, production requirements, and operational constraints.
* Identify and prioritize automation opportunities that improve safety, ergonomics, quality, cycle time, labor efficiency, uptime, and cost.
* Conduct feasibility studies and determine the appropriate solution, including cobots, traditional industrial robots, vision systems, controls, tooling, sensors, and related technologies.
* Lead turnkey automation projects from concept and planning through design, equipment build, installation, commissioning, validation, launch, sustainment, and closeout.
* Develop project scopes, Statements of Requirements (SORs), technical specifications, project plans, timing, deliverables, and risk and issue-management plans.
* Obtain and evaluate OEM and supplier quotes; lead supplier and integrator selection in partnership with stakeholders.
* Secure project funding through applicable governance and approval processes.
* Coordinate design reviews and equipment development with plant manufacturing engineering, CME, controls and automation teams, safety and ergonomics stakeholders, suppliers, and OEMs.
* Ensure equipment and process designs meet manufacturing, quality, safety, ergonomic, capability, repeatability, and specification requirements.
* Coordinate equipment delivery, installation, production downtime windows, commissioning, startup, and launch support.
* Troubleshoot technical and process issues, perform root cause analysis, develop recovery plans, remove obstacles, and drive corrective actions through completion.
* Track project timing, open issues, risks, dependencies, and deliverables; communicate status and escalate barriers when needed.
* Validate equipment capability, repeatability, quality, safety, and process performance before transition to plant ownership.
* Develop standard work, process documentation, technical specifications, troubleshooting guides, training materials, and lessons learned.
* Train and support plant engineers, maintenance personnel, operators, and other stakeholders on system requirements and standardized methods.
* Review process data and performance metrics to identify gaps and drive continuous improvement.
* Complete project deliverables, deauthorization, and closeout activities.
Benchmark and evaluate emerging technologies, tools, and methods that can improve manufacturing performance.  

  

**Your Skills and Abilities**

* Strong manufacturing technical depth and hands-on experience solving production and process problems.
* Ability to evaluate manufacturing processes and translate production needs into practical automation solutions and executable project plans.
* Demonstrated ability to lead projects from feasibility and concept through implementation, launch, validation, sustainment, and closeout.
* Strong project execution, organization, prioritization, and follow-through skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, dependencies, risks, and competing business needs in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* Ability to influence without direct authority and gain alignment across plant teams, manufacturing engineering, controls, quality, maintenance, safety, ergonomics, leadership, suppliers, and OEMs.
* Strong communication, collaboration, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills.

jobs.description:
Meta Reality Labs is seeking a principal-level AI Systems Engineer to define the hardware architecture strategy for next-generation AI-accelerated computing systems powering virtual and augmented reality products. In this role, you will shape the long-term silicon and systems roadmap for on-device AI inference and training workloads across wearables, headsets, and spatial computing platforms. A core focus of this role is driving the architecture of advanced imaging systems and camera pipelines that enable real-time perception, scene understanding, and mixed reality experiences. You will drive architectural decisions that span custom silicon, memory subsystems, interconnects, image signal processors (ISPs), camera subsystems, and software-hardware co-design, ensuring Meta's AI hardware remains at the forefront of performance, efficiency, and capability for immersive computing experiences.

* Define multi-generation hardware architecture strategy for AI inference and training systems across VR, AR, and wearable device platforms
* Lead system-level architectural exploration and trade-off analysis across compute, memory hierarchy, interconnect fabric, and power delivery for on-device AI workloads

* Define architectural requirements for camera subsystems including multi-camera synchronization, depth sensing, and low-latency visual processing for AR/VR applications

* Communicate architectural vision and technical rationale to executive leadership and cross-functional stakeholders through written proposals and design reviews

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 12+ years of experience in hardware systems architecture, with a focus on AI, ML, imaging systems, or high-performance compute systems
* Deep expertise in camera pipeline architecture, including image signal processing (ISP), sensor integration, and end-to-end imaging system design
* Experience defining SoC or system-level architecture for AI inference or training workloads, including memory subsystem design, compute hierarchy, and interconnect topology
* Experience architecting imaging subsystems for real-time computer vision applications, including multi-camera systems, depth sensing, and visual-inertial odometry
* Experience developing system performance models and using simulation or analytical frameworks to evaluate architectural trade-offs at scale

You'll make decisions that shape the consistency, durability, and latency guarantees that customer applications rely on.

Correctness under concurrency and failure is central to the role. You'll define and implement how queries read and modify data, how concurrent transactions become visible, and how durable state is recovered. You'll validate these systems using deterministic simulation, workload testing, and evidence from production.

### **Responsibilities**

* Improve query planning and execution, including index selection, row reads and writes, and performance as data volumes and access patterns change.
* Build transaction and storage paths that make writes durable and reads consistent. Define when changes become visible, how commits survive failure, and how recovery restores a correct view of the data.
* Design deterministic simulations that make rare event orderings and failures reproducible.
* Plan stateful upgrades that cannot be reversed by rolling back software. Carry them through staged rollout, failover, and recovery without putting existing data at risk.
* Participate in the service's on-call rotation and incident response.
* Own major changes from design through production. Coordinate implementation across teams when a change spans multiple parts of the service, and help trace failures across those parts.
* Mentor other engineers through design reviews, debugging, and incident analysis involving concurrency, durability, and recovery.

### **Desirable Skills, Knowledge & Experience**

* You have owned a database, storage engine, transaction system, or similarly correctness-sensitive stateful system from architecture through production. You can make architecture and implementation decisions when requirements or system boundaries are incomplete.
* You understand how query execution, indexing, transaction processing, and durable state shape what developers and operators observe.
* You understand how concurrency control, isolation, replication, and snapshots shape consistency, durability, and recovery. You can apply those concepts when operations arrive out of order, components fail independently, or the network partitions.
* You write and debug concurrent production software in Rust, Go, C++, or another systems language. You can trace failures across process, network, and durable-state boundaries.
* You have operated stateful systems through rollouts, scaling events, incidents, and recovery. You know the difference between transient unavailability and incomplete or incorrect recovery, and when a system is safe to return to service.
* You have led investigations where failures crossed systems owned by several teams.

* Your work on transaction processing or concurrency control has included defining snapshot visibility and recovery behavior.
* You've profiled database workloads and traced performance bottlenecks from query execution through durable storage.
* You've used deterministic simulation or another systematic method to uncover distributed-systems bugs that conventional tests missed.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager, AI Kernels & Performance Optimization — MTIA Software
jobs.description:
Meta designs and deploys its own AI systems. MTIA — the Meta Training and Inference Accelerator — is Meta's family of in-house AI accelerator ASICs, running recommendation and ranking workloads in production across Meta's data centers today and expanding into generative AI inference and training as successive silicon generations land.The MTIA Software team is part of the AI & Compute Foundation (ACF) organization within Meta Infrastructure. We build the entire stack a chip vendor would normally supply — compiler and LLVM toolchain, runtime, kernel authoring frameworks and libraries, developer tooling, and deep PyTorch integration — co-designing it with the silicon teams generation over generation.Within that stack, the AI Kernels and Performance Optimization team (KORE) owns the layer where silicon architecture meets arithmetic. Our mission is roofline-level performance and programmability at scale: we design and implement high-performance compute and communication kernels (GEMM, attention variants, normalization, collectives, elementwise and reduction fusions, sparse and quantized paths) against novel architectural features including matrix engines, on-chip reduction fabrics, and software-managed memory hierarchies. We ship kernel libraries with broad PyTorch operator coverage, build C++ and Python kernel authoring frameworks and DSL surfaces, and write production kernels against new architectures long before first silicon — turning hardware proposals into measured roofline evidence while the design can still change.We are seeking a Software Engineering Manager to lead a team of kernel and performance engineers doing this work. You will own the performance of workloads that serve billions of people, drive technical strategy for kernel development and optimization, and build a team that can deliver roofline-level performance on MTIA accelerators. jobs.description:
Do you love creating elegant solutions to highly complex challenges? Do you intrinsically see the importance in every detail? As part of our Silicon Technologies group, you’ll help design and manufacture our next-generation, high-performance, power-efficient processor, system-on-chip (SoC). You’ll ensure Apple products and services can seamlessly and efficiently handle the tasks that make them beloved by millions. Joining this group means you’ll be responsible for crafting and building the technology that fuels Apple’s devices. Together, you and your team will enable our customers to do all the things they love with their devices. Join us to help deliver the next groundbreaking Apple product. We have a critical impact on getting high quality functional products to millions of customers quickly, and we are hiring all levels from junior to senior roles.  
  
What happens when you run almost everything on an SoC all at once while powering down blocks, hammering new features, and running a complex suite of algorithms? You find bugs. That’s exactly what we do. We break Apple Silicon with our bare metal system level SW suite that runs mostly post-silicon, leverages pre-silicon and finds corner-case hardware bugs. Join our team to uphold the high quality of Apple Silicon.  
  
**Description**  
  
Develop SoC and CPU directed and random tests  
  
Debug issues pre-silicon or post-silicon  
  
Develop and maintain system-level SW platform  
  
Work with designers and architects to accomplish validation goals  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  
SOC and CPU knowledge; consider the following: Micro-architecture, Memory hierarchy, Interrupt and DMA, Clock and Power Gating, System level understanding, & Experience with SoC bringup  
  
C/C++ and Assembly language programmer  
  
Knowledge of Hardware and Software debug tools and methods  
  
Experience with embedded programming with an understanding of hardware-software interfaces  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
  
BS, MS or PhD in EE or CS

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $122,700 and $184,800, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  
  
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits

Job Description:

Prescient Edge is seeking a **Electrical Engineer - Controls & Automation** to support a Federal Government client.

**Benefits & Compensation:**

At **Prescient Edge**, we believe that acting with integrity and serving our employees is the key to everyone's success. To that end, we provide employees with a best-in-class benefits package that includes:

Prescient Edge is seeking an Electrical Engineer to support U.S. Navy Craft Automation & Controls Systems (CACS) development for autonomous Unmanned Surface Vehicles (USVs) in the Norfolk, Virginia area. * Coordinate closely with Government engineers, autonomy/software personnel, electrical and mechanical engineers, operators, vendors/OEMs, and other technical stakeholders.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager, AI Kernels & Performance Optimization — MTIA Software
jobs.description:
Meta designs and deploys its own AI systems. MTIA — the Meta Training and Inference Accelerator — is Meta's family of in-house AI accelerator ASICs, running recommendation and ranking workloads in production across Meta's data centers today and expanding into generative AI inference and training as successive silicon generations land.The MTIA Software team is part of the AI & Compute Foundation (ACF) organization within Meta Infrastructure. We build the entire stack a chip vendor would normally supply — compiler and LLVM toolchain, runtime, kernel authoring frameworks and libraries, developer tooling, and deep PyTorch integration — co-designing it with the silicon teams generation over generation.Within that stack, the AI Kernels and Performance Optimization team (KORE) owns the layer where silicon architecture meets arithmetic. Our mission is roofline-level performance and programmability at scale: we design and implement high-performance compute and communication kernels (GEMM, attention variants, normalization, collectives, elementwise and reduction fusions, sparse and quantized paths) against novel architectural features including matrix engines, on-chip reduction fabrics, and software-managed memory hierarchies. We ship kernel libraries with broad PyTorch operator coverage, build C++ and Python kernel authoring frameworks and DSL surfaces, and write production kernels against new architectures long before first silicon — turning hardware proposals into measured roofline evidence while the design can still change.We are seeking a Software Engineering Manager to lead a team of kernel and performance engineers doing this work. You will own the performance of workloads that serve billions of people, drive technical strategy for kernel development and optimization, and build a team that can deliver roofline-level performance on MTIA accelerators. Your team will profile and root-cause performance across the full stack — instruction scheduling, memory hierarchy and DMA behavior, on-chip interconnect, multi-device collectives — and drive fixes to the right layer, whether that is the kernel, compiler, runtime, or hardware. You will partner closely with silicon architecture teams on hardware/software co-design, quantifying the value of proposed features with real kernels and advocating for the changes the software stack needs. This is a hands-on technical leadership role where you will contribute directly to architectural decisions while enabling your team to move with speed and clarity.  
  
  

### **Software Engineering Manager, AI Kernels & Performance Optimization — MTIA Software Responsibilities:**

* Lead and manage a team of systems engineers delivering on multiple concurrent projects across ambiguous, high-impact areas of Meta's platform infrastructure
* Drive roadmap creation and technical strategy for systems-level software, ensuring alignment with broader product and engineering goals

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 4+ years of experience in software engineering with a focus on systems-level software, platform infrastructure, or distributed systems

* Experience driving technical roadmaps and executing against them with measurable outcomes in ambiguous or high-complexity environments

jobs.title: Senior Compute Platform Engineer, LSF - EDA Infrastructure
jobs.description:
NVIDIA's silicon does not tape out without the farm behind it. Our EDA compute environment runs millions of cores across federated LSF cells, and every simulation, synthesis run, and timing signoff on our roadmap passes through it. We are consolidating a dual-scheduler estate onto a single LSF platform, and we are looking for an engineer who knows LSF at the level of its internals — not just its configuration files.

This is a deep-specialist role. You will be the person the team escalates to when scheduling latency creeps up and nothing in the logs explains why.

What You'll Be Doing

Owning scheduler behavior across 15–25 federated LSF cells, including mbatchd and mbschd tuning, scheduling cycle analysis, and the contention patterns that appear as cells approach host-count ceilings.
Diagnosing MultiCluster forwarding problems — remote queue sizing, forwarding policy, cross-cluster pend behavior — where the symptom reported by users is "the farm is slow" rather than a clear failure.
Setting the technical design for cell topology and federation as the farm grows, and deciding what belongs in a cell versus what belongs in a new one.
Working with our IaC engineer to encode scheduler policy into a config schema that survives contact with MultiCluster, rather than one that looks clean and breaks at scale.
Partnering directly with CAD and methodology teams on workloads that break normal assumptions: 500GB+ memory jobs, interactive-versus-batch contention, and tape-out crunch bursts.

What We Need To See

BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
8+ years in HPC or large-scale batch compute, with 5+ years of that on IBM Spectrum LSF.
Demonstrated depth in LSF internals — you have debugged scheduler behavior beyond what the documentation covers, and you can explain a scheduling cycle from submission to dispatch.
Hands-on MultiCluster experience in a production, multi-site environment.
Strong Linux systems fundamentals, system programming languages and scripting in Python, Perl, and shell.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

You have worked on LSF as a developer or in escalation engineering, rather than only as a consumer of it.
Experience with LSF integration points: esub, eexec, elim, submit wrappers, RTM, or the LSF APIs.
Background in semiconductor or EDA compute, where license constraints and job constraints compete.
You have migrated a production estate off Slurm, PBS, or Grid Engine without a scheduled outage users noticed.

Design and govern environment topology, routing, capacity, deployment standards, Data Loss Prevention policies, and managed-environment settings across Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations, Dataverse, model-driven apps, and Power Automate; lead transitions from Lifecycle Services (LCS) to Power Platform Admin Center (PPAC) deployment models.

Description:

TriVector Services, Inc. provides quality aerospace engineering solutions to complex problems through a renowned team of engineering professionals. We are a Service-Disabled, Veteran-Owned, SBA-certified Small Business headquartered in Huntsville, Alabama. Our experienced team is dedicated to building lasting partnerships based on professional integrity and sound engineering principles. TriVector's **Experience** and exceptional **Performance** adds measurable **Value** to every project. TriVector Services, Inc., is seeking qualified candidates to fill our **Electrical Engineering Technician IV** position.

The Electrical Engineering Technician level IV (Service Contract Act (SCA) Occupation Code 30080) support NASA - Marshall Space Flight Center must be able to provide semi-professional technical support for engineers working in such areas as research, design, development, testing, or manufacturing process improvement. Work pertains to electrical, electronic, or mechanical components or equipment. These technicians are required to have some practical knowledge of science or engineering. Some positions may require a practical knowledge of mathematics or computer science. Included are workers who prepare design drawings and assist with the design, evaluation, and/or modification of machinery and equipment.

The Engineering Technician IV performs non-routine assignments of substantial variety and complexity, using operational precedents that are not fully applicable, such assignments that are typically parts of broader assignments, are screened to eliminate unusual design problems. This position may be assisted by lower level technicians and have frequent contact with professionals and others within the establishment, and performs one or a combination of such typical duties as:

* Perform unique assignments of substantial variety and scope as part of larger engineering, test, development, integration, or operations programs.
* Manage multiple tasks with guidance from Contract leadership regarding technical performance, task assignments, and prioritization based on direction from NASA Branch management.
* Conduct activities requiring safety certifications in coordination with Branch management, technical leads, or designated senior engineering personnel.
* Perform electrical assembly, installation, integration, checkout, and troubleshooting activities for engineering, test, and operational flight hardware systems.
* Conduct testing activities requiring the selection, adaptation, or modification of test equipment, instrumentation, controls, and procedures.
* Install, configure, operate, and maintain instrumentation, data acquisition systems, monitoring equipment, and associated support hardware used for engineering and test operations.
* Operate and maintain electrical, electronic, and instrumentation equipment used in laboratory, fabrication, integration, and test environments.
* Perform verification, calibration, maintenance, and functional checkout of instrumentation, sensors, measurement systems, and associated support equipment.
* Perform data collection, monitoring, and analysis activities using a variety of electronic, digital, and computer-based systems.
* Execute engineering and test operations using standard and specialized instrumentation, control systems, power distribution equipment, and data acquisition platforms.
* Fabricate, route, terminate, label, inspect, and test electrical wiring, harnesses, cables, and connectors in accordance with engineering documentation and industry standards.
* Interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, assembly drawings, and engineering documentation to support fabrication, integration, troubleshooting, and test activities.
* Assemble, integrate, and verify electrical and electromechanical hardware, subsystems, and support equipment to meet engineering and operational requirements.
* Support installation, integration, checkout, troubleshooting, and modification of flight hardware, developmental systems, prototype hardware, and ground support equipment.
* Perform continuity, insulation resistance, circuit verification, and functional testing of electrical systems and assemblies.
* Assist with configuration control activities, including hardware identification, documentation updates, and verification of installed configurations.
* Support anomaly resolution and failure investigations through inspection, troubleshooting, testing, data collection, and corrective action implementation.
* Obtain and maintain all certifications required to support assigned duties, including operation of material handling equipment, personnel lifts, and other specialized equipment as required by the scope of work.
* Perform assignments that are not completely standardized or prescribed.

Requirements:

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* U.S. Citizenship is required.
* Must have at least 5 years of relevant experience.
* Requires ability to obtain and maintain NASA Public Trust background screening requirements.
* Practical knowledge of science or engineering is required.
* Practical knowledge of mathematics is required.
* Must have at least a high school diploma or GED.
* Must be able to work from written and verbal instructions.
* Must adhere to MSFC and OSHA safety requirements, including use of appropriate PPE when necessary and follow written technical procedures.
* Must be dependable and willing to work hours outside the normal schedule.
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and workmanship.
* Must be able to pass a MSFC physical examination for any required safety-related certifications.
* Must be able to lift 40lbs with or w
