About Lockheed Martin Space  
Space is a critical domain, connecting our technologies, our security and our humanity. While others view space as a destination, we see it as a realm of possibilities, where we can do more — we can innovate, invest, inspire and integrate our capabilities to transform the future.

At Lockheed Martin Space, we aim to harness the full potential of space to cultivate innovation, reduce costs, and push the boundaries of what technology can achieve. We’re creating future-ready solutions, focusing on resiliency and urgency through our 21st Century Security® vision. We’re erasing boundaries and forming partnerships across industries and around the world. We’re advancing spacecraft and the workforce to fuel the next generation. And we’re reimagining how space can connect us, ensuring security and prosperity.

Join us in shaping a new era in space and find a career that's built for you.

About the Role  
This role will be a valued member of a tight-knit engineering team responsible for a variety of types of GNC (guidance, navigation & control) hardware, potentially including GPSR (Global Positioning System Receiver), RWA (reaction wheel assembly), CSS (coarse sun sensor), ST (star tracker), IMU (inertial measurement unit) or MTR (magnetic torque rod), while supporting multiple programs within LM Space. From procurement, through manufacturing, test, integration and on-orbit operation, you will have the opportunity to work with a variety of subject matter experts to learn on the job. Designs, develops, implements, verifies and tests algorithms to perform guidance, navigation and control of aircraft, spacecraft, launch vehicles and upper stages during powered and coast phases of flight, earth orbit, interplanetary cruise and orbital insertion, as well as during staging events. Navigation functions include the statistical processing of measured data points and their substitution into algorithms simulating physical reality. jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

#### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

The Space Ground Systems Engineering team solves the mathematical, physical, and algorithmic problems at the core of next-generation missile defense and fire control systems. We tackle dynamic battle-management challenges: fusing real-time sensor streams into track data, optimizing weapon-target assignment under uncertainty, and feeding high-confidence fire-control schedules back to the warfighter.

#### **ABOUT THE JOB**

We are looking for a Systems Engineer - Machine Learning to join our rapidly growing team in Huntsville, AL or Colorado Springs, CO. In this role, you will be responsible for bridging systems engineering, applied physics, and mathematical and machine learning to solve complex missile defense problems. You will design track-fusion pipelines, build threat-assignment algorithms, and conduct deep sensitivity analyses across complex architectures. This will require proficiency in applied math, physics, and algorithm development using Python or C++, alongside an understanding of sensor data and battle management workflows. If you are someone who moves quickly, loves diving deep into the math behind the system, and can operate autonomously to deliver verified, defensible technical solutions, then this role is for you.

#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* **Machine Learning:** Research, develop, and deploy complex machine learning models such as generative ai, reinforcement learning, deep neural networks, physics based neural models.
* **Algorithm Design and Development:** Formulate and solve complex physics problems using mathematical techniques.
  + Ex: Object detection, tracking, and discrimination. Weapon-Target Assignment (WTA), sensor allocation, and fire control scheduling.
* **Sensor Fusion & Tracking:** Work on the components of system architecture that ingest raw/processed sensor data, execute track fusion, and perform threat classification.
* **Parametric & Sensitivity Analysis:** Design, conduct, and defend rigorous trade studies, sensitivity analyses, and parametric evaluations to determine system boundaries and validate performance.
* **Prototyping & Modeling:** Rapidly translate mathematical equations into clean, functional code (Python / C++) to run non-customer-facing modeling, simulation, and algorithm verification.
* **Mission Systems Architecture:** Bridge the gap between low-level physics/threat intelligence inputs and high-level mission outputs.

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance
* **Experience:** 5+ years of relevant engineering experience
* Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Aerospace Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a related quantitative field.
* **Core Foundation:** Strong mastery of **applied mathematics, physics, and programming**.
* **Algorithmic Programming:** Proficiency in **Python** and/or **C++, Pytorch (or TensorFlow), Coding GPU's,** multi-agent reinforcement learning, mathematical modeling, experience implementing foundation models, and algorithm development (you don't need to be an enterprise software engineer, but you must be able to write robust code to solve math problems).
  + Windows, Linux, MATLAB,
* **Domain Knowledge:** Exposure to missile defense concepts, radar/sensor processing, flight dynamics, TOM, threat intelligence, discrimination algorithms, sensor tracking algorithms, kill assessment, integrated algorithms into operational systems, or fire control systems (GMD, NGI, SM3, Aegis, IBCS, C2BMC, SBI)
  + Military or defense operations experience is a strong plus.
* **Security Clearance:** **Active U.S. Secret clearance required**

#### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Top Secret / SCI eligible preferred.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Faex Health**

Faex Health turns stool images into gut-health insights. Our platform combines proprietary computer-vision models, color-density analysis, and Felix, our retrieval-grounded AI assistant, to help people track changes over time and to support clinicians and researchers. Faex runs on iPhone and Android in 13 languages across multiple regions. Live features include Faex MD for clinicians, women’s health with a period tracker, a GLP-1 gut-health journey, and partner APIs connecting to care and research ecosystems.

**The Role**

We are hiring a QA automation engineer to expand and formalize our existing test suite and CI. Today we run a Django test suite and browser regression tests, and an Azure DevOps pipeline runs tests and a secret scan on every pull request to our main and release branches. You will strengthen the frameworks, extend coverage across the web app, APIs, mobile apps, and image-analysis pipeline, and make test results part of every release decision. You will work directly with our CTO and developers.

**What You Will Do**

* **Test frameworks.** Expand and formalize our automation frameworks for UI, API, integration, and regression testing, building on the existing Django test suite, with clear structure, reusable components, and reporting.
* **Azure Pipelines integration.** Extend the Azure Pipelines YAML checks that already run tests and a secret scan on every pull request, publish results, and add quality gates that block failing builds.
* **Azure DevOps test management.** Organize test plans, suites, and cases, using Azure Test Plans where it adds value; log and track defects in Azure Boards linked to stories and builds; keep tests in Azure Repos.
* **Web UI automation.** Expand browser regression tests for the Django web app using tools such as Playwright or Selenium, covering our new Bootstrap 5 interface.
* **API testing.** Test REST and partner APIs, including FHIR-based integrations, authentication, and error handling.
* **Mobile testing.** Test the iPhone and Android apps that wrap our web app, covering photo upload, deep links, sign-in flows, and device differences, using tools such as Appium and cloud device testing.
* **Image-analysis pipeline testing.** Build regression checks that run labeled reference images through new model releases to confirm detection, color-density, and scoring results stay within agreed limits.
* **Release verification.** Run and extend smoke tests after Elastic Beanstalk deployments, building on the /health/ check in our deploy pipeline, and help decide whether to proceed or roll back.
* **Performance testing.** Create load and performance tests for scan processing, queues, and peak traffic, using tools such as Locust, k6, or JMeter.
* **Test data and compliance.** Build safe test data using synthetic or de-identified records, never real patient information, and support SOC 2 and HIPAA audit evidence.
* **Quality metrics.** Track coverage, flaky tests, and defect trends, and work with developers to improve testability.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years in software quality assurance, including 3+ years building test automation.
* Hands-on experience designing and maintaining an automation framework, not just writing scripts within one.
* Experience running and maintaining automated tests in CI/CD pipelines, triggered on pull requests and releases.
* Strong Python testing skills (Django test framework / unittest; pytest also valuable); experience testing Django or other Python web apps.
* Experience with browser automation using Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress.
* Experience with API testing tools and frameworks, such as Django’s test client, Python HTTP clients, or Postman.
* Solid understanding of CI/CD, Git branching, and test strategies such as unit, integration, end-to-end, and regression.
* Clear defect reporting and communication with developers.
* Comfortable working day to day with AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Kiro) and quick to pick up new tools as they change.
* Ability to work in the Denver office three days per week.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with the Faex app or experience testing health, wellness, or medical software.
* Experience with Azure DevOps: Azure Pipelines YAML, Azure Test Plans, Azure Boards, and Azure Repos.
* Experience with mobile automation using Appium or cloud device testing services.
* Experience testing machine-learning or computer-vision outputs.
* Experience with performance testing tools such as Locust, k6, or JMeter.
* Experience testing on AWS, including Elastic Beanstalk deployments and environment management.
* Experience with PostgreSQL and validating data in tests.
* Experience working under HIPAA, SOC 2, or FDA software quality requirements.
* ISTQB or a similar testing certification.

**How We Work**

* Small team, high ownership: you will set our testing standards, not just follow them.
* Evidence-led: every release decision should be backed by test results.
* Privacy by default: test data must never expose real health information.

Pay: $70,700.00 - $85,300.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Greenwood Vlg, CO 80111

jobs.title: Controls Hardware Engineer
jobs.description:
**Controls Hardware Engineer (Electrical & Motion Focus)**  
***Suwanee, GA***  
  
**ABOUT US**  
Located across the globe and with more than 45 years of experience, WSI is the industry leader in automated repairs for pressure equipment. WSI's industry experience, global presence, and best-in-class execution are key to delivering improved plant reliability safely and effectively.  
  
WSI has the mission to advance innovation for global infrastructure through specialized industrial technologies. At WSI, our people empower and define who we are. Our shared values are the foundation for building strong, trusting relationships with our employees, stakeholders, and customers. We're small enough for your ideas to make an immediate impact and large enough to offer you opportunities to grow professionally at any stage of your career.  
  
**JOB SUMMARY**  
We are seeking a skilled **Controls Hardware Engineer** to lead the physical design, schematic creation, and prototype assembly of our next-generation motion control systems. In this role, you will be the bridge between electronic component selection and physical execution. Your primary focus will be designing robust control circuits, mapping out industrial wiring architectures, and specifying hardware for PLC-based motion systems.  
  
This is a hardware-focused engineering role. While you will collaborate closely with our software engineering team, your principal responsibility will be the physical infrastructure: creating electrical drawings, designing panel layouts, and executing hands-on prototype builds.  
  
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Design and specify low-voltage DC control circuits, power distributions, and physical wiring topologies for multi-axis motion control systems independently suggesting solutions and identifying the information or resources needed to move the work forward.
* Create comprehensive, production-ready electrical schematics, point-to-point wiring diagrams, and control panel layouts using industrial CAD tools (e.g., AutoCAD Electrical, EPLAN).
* Lead the physical build, wiring, and hardware troubleshooting of initial prototype systems and test benches.
* Evaluate and select microprocessors, industrial controllers, sensors, motor drives, and safety interlocks required for high-performance motion applications researching and becoming proficient with new technologies as needed.
* Participate in and actively contribute to tooling design teams
* Work effectively with a high level of autonomy while maintaining strong communication and collaboration across multiple departments.
* Progress multiple projects and tasks based on schedule and budget commitments proactively identifying priorities, resolving obstacles, and escalating issues when appropriate.
* Contribute to plotting short- and long-term technology strategies for the business to support potential growth areas and technology differentiation
* Provide support as required to resolve technology deficiencies in the existing technology base including researching unfamiliar issues and developing solutions with limited direction.
* Provide technical mentoring to less experienced engineering personnel.
* Resolve complex and unique technical issues and provide expert technical reviews and troubleshooting.
* Other duties as assigned.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCES**

* BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or related field
* 5+ years of experience in electrical design, industrial control panel design, or physical hardware engineering for automation/motion systems.
* Mastery of industrial electrical schematic software (AutoCAD Electrical, EPLAN, SolidWorks Electrical, or similar).
* Deep understanding of circuit protection, industrial wiring standards, microprocessors, and sensor integration.
* Working knowledge of and adherence to applicable NEC, NFPA, and CSA standards, as well as applicable CE conformity requirements.
* Proven experience with hands-on mechanical/electrical assembly, wire crimping, soldering, and troubleshooting physical hardware with multimeters/oscilloscopes.
* Working knowledge of robotics and arc welding and machining processes is a plus
* Experience in computer-aided tools used to design electrical control systems
* Experience in design for high noise environment, a plus
* Support field personnel in troubleshooting problems with existing systems

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* **PLC Hardware Familiarity**: Experience specifying and wiring components within B&R Industrial Automation ecosystems (X20 system, ACOPOS drives, etc.) is highly preferred.
* **Cobots:** Familiarity with collaborative robot integration, safety zones, and end-of-arm tooling hardware.
* **PCB: (**printed circuit board) design and layout experience.

We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.*

**Who We Are**
--------------

AeroVect is transforming ground handling with autonomy, redefining how airlines and ground service providers around the globe run day-to-day operations. We are a Series A company backed by top-tier venture capital investors in aviation and autonomous driving. Our customers include some of the world’s largest airlines and ground handling providers. -------------------

We are looking for an experienced Staff Software Engineer who can design and build best-in-class planning systems for autonomous driving in structured, low-speed environments.

In this role, you'll be the technical backbone of the planning stack — owning the design and implementation of production-grade mission planning, behavior planning, and motion planning software. You'll work across the full planning pipeline to achieve category-defining vehicle autonomy for the airside, tackling hard problems in trajectory optimization, decision-making under uncertainty, and real-time constraint optimization.

This opportunity offers a deeply technical engineer the chance to shape a market-defining enterprise product that combines autonomous vehicle technology with a robotics-as-a-service (RaaS) business model. This role reports to our Planning Tech Lead and works closely with the autonomy engineering team.

You Will:

* Design, implement, and iterate on the mission planner, behavior planner, and motion planner for autonomous ground support equipment operating in airport airside environments.
* Drive key technical decisions across the planning stack — selecting algorithms, defining interfaces, and establishing the architecture that the team builds on.
* Prototype and evaluate new planning approaches (e.g., optimization-based methods, search-based planners, learning-augmented pipelines) and bring the best ideas to production.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with perception, controls, localization, and systems engineering teams to deliver an integrated autonomous driving system.
* Establish and promote best practices in software development, functional safety, and systems engineering as they apply to the planning domain.
* Mentor other engineers through technical guidance, code review, and design discussions.

You Have:

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Math, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, Physics, or a related field.
* Extensive hands-on experience designing and implementing planning modules for autonomous systems shipped to production or deployed in real-world operations.
* Strong programming skills in C++ (preferred) or Python, and experience with Linux-based operating systems.
* Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous technical problems and drive them to well-architected solutions independently.
* Excellent communication skills, proactiveness, and a strong sense of ownership.

We Prefer:

* MS or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field.
* Mastery of Modern C++ (14 and beyond) and safety-critical coding practices (e.g., MISRA, ISO 26262).
* 5+ years of industry experience in planning for robotic ground vehicles.
* In-depth understanding of DDS frameworks like ROS/ROS2 or other networking middleware.
* Experience in startup environments, demonstrating adaptability to rapidly changing priorities.

*Inventus Power is a global leader in advanced battery systems that specializes in designing and manufacturing high-quality, reliable, and innovative power systems for a broad range of portable, motive, and stationary applications. We are a US based company headquartered in Woodridge, Illinois and have a global presence that extends across four continents with five manufacturing facilities, three engineering technical centers, a multi-tiered sales service channel, and 3,000+ employees. For over 60 years, Inventus Power has been addressing the rapidly expanding power demands of a changing world through technology and engineered solutions. We continue to invest in our people and processes, while enhancing our products and capabilities in order to create a safer, smarter, and more sustainable battery-powered world.*

We are an ITAR facility and hire only U.S. persons who are defined as U.S. citizens or green card holders.

**What You’ll Do**

The Controls Software Engineer II will contribute to the development, integration, validation, and support of Battery Management System (BMS) software for xEV and advanced battery applications. This role will support requirements definition, controls algorithm development, software implementation, calibration, testing, and system integration activities while collaborating with hardware, systems, validation, and customer engineering teams

**Responsibilities (Including other duties as assigned)**

* Participate in requirements definition, software design, implementation, and testing activities for Battery Management System (BMS) software and controls functions.
* Develop, implement, and maintain battery control algorithms and features including State of Charge (SOC), State of Health (SOH), State of Power (SOP), charging control, fault detection, diagnostics, balancing, and battery safety functions.
* Support calibration, tuning, and optimization of battery algorithms to meet product performance, reliability, and safety requirements.
* Collaborate with systems, hardware, and validation engineers to ensure successful integration of BMS software into battery products and customer applications.
* Support integration and validation of battery systems with customer equipment, industrial machines, government applications, and electric vehicle platforms.
* Develop and execute software verification and validation plans including unit testing, integration testing, HIL testing, vehicle testing, and system-level testing.
* Analyze test data and system performance to identify issues and support continuous improvement of controls algorithms and software features.
* Perform software debugging, root-cause analysis, and corrective action implementation for issues identified during development, validation, manufacturing, and field operation.
* Support customer issue investigations and provide technical assistance related to BMS software performance, calibration, diagnostics, and system integration.
* Create and maintain software requirements, design documentation, test procedures, validation reports, and release documentation.
* Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and technical discussions to ensure compliance with customer, regulatory, and product requirements.

**What You Will Need**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Controls Engineering, or related discipline.
* 2-5 years of experience developing embedded software, controls software, or BMS software.

You will work with a team of engineers and be accountable for gathering and meeting the voice of the customer throughout development and integration of control strategies (requirements, design, simulation, integration and validation).

Accountability spans the full development cycle from concept to production implementation onto BMS controller. * Lead cross-functional engineering teams to implement robust BMS control strategies

* Hands on experience with CAN Communication and use of CANape

**Embedded Systems:** Extensive experience and knowledge of embedded systems and their applications; ability to develop embedded systems with varying levels of complexity to control the operations of the machine it is embedded within.  
  
**Problem Solving**: Extensive experience and knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

Join All World Machinery Supply as a Full-Time Automation Controls Engineer and immerse yourself in a dynamic work environment located in Roscoe, Illinois. This onsite position offers an exciting opportunity to collaborate with a talented team that prioritizes innovation and efficiency in the machinery industry. You will play a vital role in enhancing our production processes, promoting our values of transparency and dependability. With a competitive salary range of $70,000 to $90,000, you can contribute to projects that make a significant impact while enjoying a flexible and relaxed workplace culture.

You will be provided great benefits such as Medical (PPOHSA Plans), Dental, Vision, 401(k), Life Insurance, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Account, Competitive Salary, Paid Time Off. This is your chance to advance your career in a high-performance setting where customer satisfaction and professional growth are at the forefront of our mission. Embrace the challenge and join us in shaping the future of automation controls.

### **HELLO, WE'RE ALL WORLD MACHINERY SUPPLY**

All World is your one-stop shop solutions provider for aftermarket machine tool spare parts, services, repairs, and custom-engineered applications. Our mission is to empower today's manufacturing customer with solutions that fit their personalized needs and budget. Our growth-oriented company operates on six primary values to create maximum results in the workplace: support, transparency, respect, innovation, dependability, and efficiency.

### **ARE YOU EXCITED ABOUT THIS AUTOMATION CONTROLS ENGINEER JOB?**

As a Full-Time Industrial Controls Engineer at All World Machinery Supply, you will design and implement industrial automation control systems tailored to meet customer needs, ranging from simple motor controls to advanced motion and process control systems, including CNC control solutions. This role requires you to guide projects from initial concept through design, startup, and commissioning, while working closely with customers to provide practical and cost-effective solutions. You will specify necessary control components based on device specifications, generate a complete Bill of Materials (BOM), and produce detailed electrical schematics and layout diagrams for manufacturing. Collaborating with various departments, you will continuously enhance products and solutions, all while adhering to engineering standards relating to component manufacturers, documentation, and device coding.

Your expertise will play a pivotal role in driving innovation and efficiency within our organization.

### **WHAT YOU NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL**

To excel as a Full-Time Automation Controls Engineer at All World Machinery Supply, candidates should possess a High School Diploma or GED equivalent along with 1-2 years of relevant experience in the machinery or factory automation sectors. A strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current with evolving technologies is essential. Successful candidates will demonstrate excellent communication and problem-solving skills, along with a comprehensive understanding of electrical systems utilized in the Machine Tool Industry.

Proficiency in AC and DC circuitry is crucial, as well as experience in specifying and selecting electrical control components, including motor control, circuit protection, PLCs, sensors, and safety control devices. A solid command of CAD software for designing electrical schematics and documentation is required. Additionally, familiarity with automation control, process control, digital and analog systems, PLCs, HMIs, VFDs, and relevant safety codes and regulations will further enhance your contribution to our innovative team.

### **OUR TEAM NEEDS YOU!**

If you believe that this position matches your requirements, applying for it is a breeze. Best of luck!

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer

**Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Systems Engineer to join our IT Infrastructure team. This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining a hybrid cloud infrastructure with deep expertise in Microsoft Intune, networking, virtualization, and Microsoft 365 ecosystems. The ideal candidate will serve as a technical escalation point for complex infrastructure issues and drive strategic initiatives to modernize a customer technology stack. This role offers an exciting opportunity to work at the forefront of technology, driving innovation through system architecture, integration, and optimization. As a key member of our technical team, you will leverage your expertise in systems engineering, software development, and infrastructure management to deliver scalable, secure, and efficient solutions that support our business objectives. Your proactive approach and problem-solving mindset will help ensure our systems operate seamlessly and securely in a fast-paced environment.

* Architect, deploy, and manage Microsoft Intune for device enrollment, compliance policies, configuration profiles, and application deployment across Windows, iOS, and Android platforms

* Deploy, configure, and maintain Windows Server (2019/2022/2025) roles: AD DS, DNS, DHCP, File Services, Print Services, IIS, Certificate Services, Remote Desktop Services

* Administer Microsoft 365 tenant: Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive, Security & Compliance Center

* Administer Exchange configurations, mail flow rules, retention policies, and eDiscovery
* Configure Microsoft Defender for Endpoint/Identity/Office 365/Cloud Apps integration
* Implement and maintain firewall configurations across perimeter, internal segmentation, and cloud security groups
* Conduct vulnerability assessments and coordinate remediation with patching cycles
* Participate in incident response for infrastructure-related security events
* Support audit readiness (CMMC)
* Manage certificate lifecycle (PKI, public CAs, Let’s Encrypt, Azure Key Vault)

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 7+ years of progressive systems engineering experience in enterprise environments
* Required Certifications (at least 3 of the following):
* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102)
* Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)
* VMware Certified Professional (VCP-DCV / VCP-NV)
* Cisco CCNP Enterprise or Palo Alto PCNSE
* (ISC)² CISSP or CompTIA Security+ (for security-focused duties)

**Core Competencies**

* Systems Thinking: Ability to understand complex interdependencies across network, compute, storage, and identity layers
* Problem Solving: Structured troubleshooting methodology for multi-layer infrastructure issues
* Communication: Translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders; produce clear documentation
* Collaboration: Work effectively across Security, Application Development, Service Desk, and Vendor Management teams
* Continuous Learning: Proactive adoption of emerging Microsoft cloud technologies and industry best practices
* Operational Excellence: Focus on automation, standardization, and proactive monitoring over reactive firefighting

Join us as a Senior Systems Engineer to shape innovative solutions that empower our organization’s growth while advancing your career in a vibrant tech-driven environment!

Pay: $100,000.00 - $115,000.00 per year

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry's digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

  

Xometry is looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our Core Platform team. This role is a strategic technical leadership position focused on the architectural evolution of our flagship enterprise partnership.

While our current plug-ins function as external add-ons, you will be responsible for re-architecting Xometry's core application services to live natively within our partner's digital ecosystem. You will shape the technical direction of multiple products, establishing the engineering patterns that allow Xometry's AI—trained on millions of parts—to operate directly on our partner's native 3D geometry. Your goal is to move the architectural framework toward a "target state" where users experience zero-latency DFM feedback and one-click procurement without ever leaving their primary enterprise design environment.

This role requires a hybrid schedule (3 days a week) at our North Bethesda, MD or Waltham, MA office location.

**How You'll Contribute**
-------------------------

* **Software Development and Technical Craft:** You will design high-performance solutions that extend beyond a single org, establishing the organizational standards for how Xometry-AI is embedded into external PLM environments. You will advance our architectural framework to ensure it is extensible, scalable, and adheres to strict enterprise SLIs/SLOs.
* **AI Fluency:** You will lead the effort to integrate production ML pipelines into the application layer, ensuring the "science fiction speed" promised in our vision is realized through optimized model serving and real-time geometry analysis. In addition, you'll champion AI-assisted development practices across the team, actively mentoring engineers on effective use of AI tools to accelerate delivery, improve code quality, and reduce toil.
* **Problem Solving and Decision Making:** You will solve significant and unique challenges regarding data gravity and security. You'll create formal networks between our partner's and Xometry's engineering groups to develop new ways of conducting operations—specifically regarding "ring-fenced" data governance where part files remain securely within the partner's network infrastructure.
* **Scope and Impact:** You are responsible for establishing the strategic direction and leading the execution of this core integration. You will be a technical and business role model, ensuring that the integration of DFM (Manufacturability) and IQE (Pricing) AI engines creates a distinct, defensible edge for the partnership.
* **Collaboration and Communication:** You will facilitate technical discourse across the entire Xometry organization, leading to durable, well-documented decisions. As a primary point of contact for senior leadership, you will guide risk/reward conversations and champion cross-functional development across our marketplace and data science teams.
* **Operational Excellence:** You will define the reliability and security standards for our enterprise-grade deployments, whether partner-hosted or Xometry-hosted, ensuring seamless multi-tenant management.

**What You'll Bring to Xometry**
--------------------------------

* **Experience:** 12+ years of professional software development experience, with a history of scaling complex platforms.
* **Deep Technical Expertise:** Expert-level mastery of Python, AWS infrastructure, and modern frontend frameworks (React/NextJS) used for complex enterprise applications.
* **Systems Architect:** Proven experience shaping the technical direction of multiple teams and establishing engineering patterns as organizational standards.
* **Strategic Roadmap Execution:** A track record of securing endorsement for 6-12 month initiatives and driving them to successful production deployment.
* **Communication Excellence:** The ability to influence senior leadership and external partners on technical strategy and long-term technology investments.
* **Education:** Bachelor's in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.

**You Would Be A Great Fit With**
---------------------------------

* **Platform Experience:** Background in building "Software as a Service" (SaaS) platforms or complex B2B integration hubs.
* **Industrial Tech Background:** Experience with manufacturing, logistics, or CAD/PLM software ecosystems.
* **Security & Governance:** Deep understanding of enterprise data controls, dedicated tenants, and SOC2/ISO compliance within a cloud environment.
* **Distributed Systems:** Experience architecting large-scale ML platforms or high-frequency marketplace engines.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

The estimated base salary range for new hires into this role is $170,000 – $195,000annually + annual bonus, depending on factors such as job-related skills, relevant experience, and location. The total compensation package includes base, bonus, and equity.

We also offer a competitive benefits package, including:

* 401(k) match
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Life and disability insurance
* Generous paid time off including vacation, sick leave, floating and fixed holidays
* Maternity and bonding leave
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and other wellbeing resources
* A stipend for catered lunch on Tuesdays and Thursdays

Xometry is an equal opportunity employer and participates in E-Verify.

Xometry is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

jobs.description:
**About Forterra**  
  
At Forterra, we are unleashing autonomy at scale to transform the battlefield. Our mission is to build the foundational platforms that enable an intelligent ecosystem to coordinate, adapt, and execute with speed and precision even in the uncertainty and disruption of modern conflict. In an era marked by rapid technological change and evolving threats, we design for flexibility, survivability, and operational dominance.

Forterra delivers weapons, sensors, and battlefield effects through integrated autonomous networks reaching operational areas faster, safer, and without placing human lives at risk. Our systems operate with distributed control, dynamic routing, and real-time responsiveness, enabling sustained advantage across complex mission environments.

**About the role**

We are looking for a product focused Embedded Software/Firmware Engineer to help sustain and develop next generation, cutting edge, safe, and scalable autonomous vehicle hardware. You will work at the intersection of embedded systems and autonomous technology, supporting existing projects, bringing up new hardware platforms, writing firmware for microcontrollers and microprocessors, and ensuring system functionality and safety through rigorous testing. You will closely collaborate with deployed product teams, hardware, systems, and other FW engineers to support and develop new cutting edge platforms for Forterra.

**What you'll do**

Work with new hardware:

* Assist in developing hardware/FW through the full product lifecycle from ideation through manufacturing and support.
* Aid in establishing production line tooling, as well as diagnostics capabilities for existing systems.
* Help evaluate new pre-release hardware and tooling for use on next generation systems.
* Review schematics and provide guidance and feedback on signal assignment and wiring.
* Quickly establish a working knowledge of new complete systems, microcontrollers, microprocessors, sensors, and tooling with a view toward product development.
* Collaborate with hardware engineers to understand system architecture, participate in design reviews, and debug issues.
* Perform and support new board testing and characterization with low-level firmware.
* Create proof-of-concept setups testing isolated functions of new hardware.
* Work with hardware engineers to provide FW functionality for production line testing.
* Provide guidance to other teams adopting the new hardware and tooling platform.

Develop FW and SW:

* Develop FW for different stages of the product lifecycle; prototype through production.
* Develop board bring-up FW to test signals, busses, and processors to prove wiring.
* Develop tools in Windows or Linux to show signal states, test boards, and support characterization.
* Develop FW and SW to allow boards to operate as designed in a pre-production environment.
* Implement drivers, bootloaders, and system-level software for initial board functionality.
* Assist to get production level FW loaded, working, and tested on new boards.
* Provide test FW to support product manufacturing and automated infant mortality reporting.
* Develop and deploy test FW and SW revisions to aid in diagnostics of embedded Linux systems.

Testing & Validation:

* Develop test plans to validate processor, memory, and communication interfaces (Ethernet, CAN, I2C, SPI, UART, etc.) to support all phases of product development.
* Perform bring-up and debugging of embedded systems using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and debugging tools.
* Set up and execute final acceptance testing for hardware validation before deployment.
* Assist in developing manufacturing and production tests.
* Assist in debugging fielded issues and providing product improvements.

Collaboration & Documentation:

* Work closely with hardware, software, and systems engineers to ensure seamless integration.
* Document software architecture, test plans, and debugging procedures.
* Provide technical support for hardware and firmware during development and production.
* Implement best practices on documenting SW designs and committing code for other teams to use.
* Provide product documentation required to reach safety requirements, product manuals, test procedures, etc.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
* 3+ years of experience in embedded software development (Linux) and product development experience.
* 3+ years working with hardware test tools like Oscilloscopes, analyzers, and meters.
* Experience with ARM Cortex-M/R/A processors or similar embedded platforms.
* Strong proficiency in C/C++ for embedded systems.
* Experience with bare metal programming and RTOS (e.g., FreeRTOS, Zephyr).
* Some experience with Linux as a desktop or embedded in a device.
* Hands-on experience with board bring-up and low-level debugging.
* Knowledge of hardware communication protocols (Ethernet, CAN, I2C, SPI, UART).
* Familiarity with embedded development tools (JTAG debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers).
* Experience with TCP both on embedded platforms and larger systems.
* Experience reading schematics and integrated circuit data sheets.
* Time management and organizational skills.
* Troubleshooting and triage experience, ability to organize complex debugging scenarios.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with automotive or robotics hardware.
* Knowledge of safety-critical software development (ISO 26262, MISRA).
* Experience in regulated environments.
* Experience with embedded Linux.
* Familiarity with scripting languages (Python, Bash).
* Experience in Agile environments.
* Familiarity with Quality Assurance practices and documentation standards.
* Experience working with Contract manufacturers.

jobs.title: Undersea Acoustic Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**Description**

Are you a hands-on technical leader who enjoys working across the range of hardware design from computational models to laboratory measurements and field testing?

Are you searching for an opportunity to apply your skills in a creative and collaborative environment?

**If so, we're looking for someone like you to join our team at APL.**

We are seeking an engineer or physicist to lead the modeling and simulation, design, testing, and evaluation of acoustic transducers and sensor systems for undersea applications. You will contribute to advancing U.S. Navy capabilities through working with a multidisciplinary team to mature concepts from initial analysis through prototype and performance evaluation.You will apply expertise in acoustics, mechanics, materials, electronics, and signal processing to develop source and receiver technologies and assess performance from the component through the system level.

**As an Undersea Acoustic Systems Engineer, you will ...**

* Lead the analysis and implementation of acoustic sources, receivers, transducers, and/or arrays.
* Develop physics-based models of the electrical, mechanical, and acoustic transducer systems.
* Conduct design trades involving materials, geometry, bandwidth, sensitivity, source level, and directivity
* Plan and conduct laboratory, tank, and field testing to characterize systems performance.
* Compare measurements with model predictions and refine models accordingly.

  
**Qualifications**

**You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you...**

* Have a Bachelor's degree in Acoustics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Applied Physics, Ocean Engineering, or a related field.
* Have strong knowledge of acoustics, vibration, wave propagation, and electromechanical or piezoelectric systems.
* Have experience designing, modeling, and/or testing acoustic transducers, sensors, or related hardware.
* Are proficient in MATLAB, Python, or a comparable scientific programming language.
* Are able to lead technical efforts and work effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
* Are able to obtain an Interim Secret level security clearance by your start date and can ultimately obtain a Top Secret level clearance. If selected, you will be subject to a government security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship.

**You'll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you...**

* Possess a Master’s or PhD degree in a relevant discipline
* Have experience with underwater acoustic projectors, hydrophones, transducer arrays, or acoustic communications hardware.
* Have experience with multiphysics or finite-element modeling tools such as COMSOL
* Have experience designing, fabricating, integrating, or environmentally testing prototype hardware.
* Have experience evaluating transducers as part of an end-to-end sonar, communications, or sensing system.
* Have experience leading technical teams, mentoring staff, or applying collaborative software-development best practices.
* Have an active Secret or higher level clearance.

  
**About Us**

**Why Work at APL?**

The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) brings world-class expertise to our nation’s most critical defense, security, space and science challenges. While we are dedicated to solving complex challenges and pioneering new technologies, what makes us truly outstanding is our culture. We offer a vibrant, welcoming atmosphere where you can bring your authentic self to work, continue to grow, and build strong connections with inspiring teammates.

At APL, we celebrate our differences of perspectives and encourage creativity and bold, new ideas. Our employees enjoy generous benefits, including a robust education assistance program, unparalleled retirement contributions, and a healthy work/life balance. APL’s campus is located in the Baltimore-Washington metro area. Learn more about our career opportunities at https://www.jhuapl.edu/careers.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, occupation, marital or familial status, political opinion, personal appearance, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. APL is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to individuals of all abilities, including those with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in any part of the hiring process, please contact Accessibility@jhuapl.edu.

**Position Title:** **Field Service & Controls Engineer**

**Position Location: Glen Burnie, MD (preferred)**

**Salary Range:**  **TBD Based on Experience**

**Start Date:**  **ASAP**

**Role Purpose:**

Provide practical first-level support for customers experiencing electrical, controls, drive, propulsion, or system-interface problems. The engineer will assess faults, collect reliable evidence, perform approved troubleshooting and repairs, and coordinate escalation.

This is a hands-on field-service role, not primarily a PLC programming or software-development position.

**Main Responsibilities:**

- Provide remote and on-site troubleshooting support, particularly during equipment downtime.

- Diagnose electrical, controls, drive, LSM/LIM propulsion, sensor, network, and electromechanical interface problems.

- Interpret alarms, diagnostic traces, electrical schematics, P&IDs, manuals, and service instructions.

- Perform safe measurements using multimeters, insulation testers, current clamps, and oscilloscopes.

- Complete approved wiring checks, adjustments, component replacements, repairs, and upgrades.

- Collect fault logs, traces, measurements, photographs, and operating information for specialist escalation.

- Coordinate with customers and engineering teams until the issue is resolved or formally handed over.

- Prepare clear service reports and support commissioning, maintenance, training, retrofits, and spare-parts identification.

- Follow site-safety, lockout/tagout, and authorization requirements.

- Provide controls-related engineering support for upgrades, design changes, and product improvements.

- Maintain correct and accurate records for all Engineering changes.

- Provide superior Customer Service and maintain proactive communication with Customers and Suppliers.

- Resolve Customer issues in a timely and professional manner while maintaining safety & minimizing operational downtime.

**Key Requirements:**

- Electrical/electronic technician qualification, engineering technology degree, or equivalent practical field experience. A four-year engineering degree is helpful but not mandatory.

- Strong hands-on experience troubleshooting industrial automation, electrical machinery, motors, or drive systems.

- Working knowledge of AC/DC power, PLC-controlled equipment, HMIs, VFD/servo drives, industrial networks, sensors, and safety circuits.

- Ability to read electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, P&IDs, and technical documentation.

- Ability to generate new / revise existing 2D drawings.

- Ability to perform electrical measurements safely, including using an oscilloscope.

- Basic diagnostic familiarity with Siemens and/or Rockwell/Allen-Bradley systems. Programming expertise is not required.

- Methodical troubleshooting skills and the judgment to recognize when specialist escalation is necessary.

- Fluent English and the ability to communicate clearly with customers and interdisciplinary international teams.

- Willingness to travel approximately 25% and attend initial and ongoing training in Switzerland.

- Valid driver’s license and ability to work safely in industrial and amusement-ride environments.

- Must be willing to sign Confidentiality/Non-Disclosure Agreements

**Preferred Experience:**

Minimum 5 years of professional experience in field service, maintenance, or commissioning of industrial automation, transportation systems, amusement rides, or other safety-related machinery. jobs.description:
Company: Siemens EDA

Job Title: Software Engineer – C++ / Digital Logic Design

Job Reference #: 526831

Job Location: Burlington, MA

Siemens EDA is looking for a software development engineer to work in the Hardware Assisted Verification (HAV) division. HAV develops and manufactures emulators for functional verification of System-on-Chip circuit designs. In emulation systems, custom software compiles a circuit design's high level description into a low level binary representation that can be loaded and run on the emulation hardware. The individual that fills this position will become a member of emulator compiler specialists developing the compiler software for Siemens EDA’s next generation emulators.

The Software Development Engineer will have responsibilities in development and improvement of the part of the compiler that analyzes the customer design in order to map it on the emulator resources. This includes analysis of clock and data networks, partitioning, placing and synthesis of logic to support the mapping of the customer design onto the emulator. The individual will participate in design and implementation of new functionality for this part of the compiler as well as support current functionality. The work will be mostly in C++ on Linux. They will write system level tests that use software simulation as well as develop new testing methods. This position will include interaction with other software teams as well as Veloce hardware teams in an international, multi-site, development environment. Candidates must be able to work on-site from our Burlington, MA office.

**Job Qualifications**

**Required Skills**:

* BS, MS or PhD in Computer Science or Computer Engineering.
* 0 to 3 years of industry, software development experience in developing large C++ applications as part of a team.
* Demonstrated experience with algorithm and data structure design.
* Understanding of gate level digital logic design.
* Excel both in a team-oriented development and working independently.

**Desired Skills:**

* Demonstrated Experience in EDA software development, especially in timing analysis, synthesis, design partition or placement is a plus.
* Software engineering skills with experience in use of Unix/Linux OS.
* Demonstrated experience with software testing methods.
* Experience in use of Hardware description language (Verilog/Vhdl).
* Experience in use of a software simulation tools (Modelsim, etc).
* Knowledge of scripting languages (Python or SH script) would be useful.

This position will be subject to U.S. export control requirements under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and/or Export Administration Regulations (EAR). Employment is contingent on either verifying the U.S. Person status or obtaining any necessary export license.

A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. jobs.title: Staff Vehicle Controls Engineer, Steering
jobs.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo's fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Hardware Engineering is an innovative and collaborative group of electrical, mechanical, reliability, software and vehicle engineers. We design, build, and perfect the products which are the eyes and ears of Waymo's autonomous driving technology, and integrate those products into vehicle platforms. We're seeking curious and talented teammates to keep us moving in the right direction.

This role follows a hybrid work schedule and you will report to a Vehicle Systems Architecture Lead.

**You will:**

* Own steering system requirements (EPS and steer-by-wire) for the Waymo Driver through their full lifecycle, covering steering tracking performance, redundancy and safe behavior under faults
* Drive steering architecture and fault-tolerance trade studies, such as dual-wound motors, dual ECUs and leader/follower arbitration, redundant sensing, power and communication, degraded-assist levels and thermal derating, to deliver fail-operational steering
* Define and review steering fault monitors and the self-driving system's response to each fault (detection thresholds, debounce, latching and minimal-risk maneuvers), partnering with Functional Safety on ISO 26262 (ASIL D) safety concepts
* Serve as the technical lead with steering suppliers and vehicle OEM partners: review specifications, firmware release content and CAN/CAN-FD interface definitions, and drive supplier defects to closure across sample phases
* Lead root-cause investigations of steering issues found in HIL, on the test track and in the fleet, analyzing vehicle logs and CAN traces and building Python tools that automate analysis of fleet data
* Define verification strategy and sign off steering for driverless operation, covering steering performance (latency, bandwidth, rack speed, tracking error, tire-limit behavior), thermal and endurance cases, and evidence from HIL, track and fleet testing

**You have:**

* 7+ years of experience developing and integrating safety-critical systems in the automotive, autonomous vehicle, aerospace, robotics, or related industries, with at least part of that time focused on steering systems
* Demonstrated ownership of system-level requirements, architecture or control strategy for an automotive steering system (EPS, steer-by-wire or rear-wheel steering) at an OEM, Tier 1 supplier or AV company
* Working knowledge of steering hardware and physics: rack, column and pinion EPS layouts, BLDC/PMSM motors and inverters, torque and angle sensing, rack force, and tire and vehicle dynamics basics
* Strong foundation in systems engineering principles such as requirements definition and traceability, verification and validation, and HIL or vehicle-level testing
* Proficiency in Python or MATLAB for data and log analysis, and the ability to read C/C++
* Bachelor's Degree in a relevant Engineering or a related field (including ME, EE, CS, Robotics, Controls, Aerospace, etc.) or equivalent practical experience

**We prefer:**

* Experience with redundant or fail-operational steering (dual-channel EPS or steer-by-wire), especially on L4 self-driving platforms
* Experience applying ISO 26262 to steering: ASIL D safety concepts, FMEA/FTA, and how a supplier implements microcontroller safety mechanisms (e.g., lockstep cores, built-in self-tests and runtime reset limits)
* Proven experience in technical supplier management, including authoring Statements of Work (SOW) or Requirement Specifications, leading technical design reviews, and managing firmware releases for safety-critical ECUs
* Hands-on experience with Vector CANoe/CANalyzer, dSPACE, and vehicle-dynamics tools such as CarSim or IPG CarMaker
* Experience working within standard automotive development and production release processes for ECUs and firmware, such as APQP, phase gates and A/B/C/D samples
* Proficiency in Korean or Japanese, to support technical reviews with partners

**Travel requirements:**

* Up to 8 weeks of travel; (domestic and international) to support requirement implementation with partners or verification at test sites

jobs.description:
**ABOUT ROCKET LAB**

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

**NEUTRON**

Neutron is a medium lift launch vehicle capable of delivering the mega constellations of tomorrow, high assurance payloads, and human spaceflight. As a highly reusable launch platform, Neutron will deliver a highly cost-effective and reliable launch solution leveraging Rocket Lab's proven execution history with the Electron program.

**GROUND SYSTEMS ENGINEER II**

Based out of Rocket Lab's Test Facility at Stennis Space Center in Mississippi, the Ground Systems Engineer II is responsible for Design, Build, and Maintenance of critical test facilities to support the Archimedes rocket engine and the Neutron launch vehicles. You'll collaborate closely with Engine Propulsion and Test Operations teams to develop requirements for test stand design.

Your work will require technical discipline and expertise in mechanical design and build but will also require a strong understanding of instrumentation and test site operations. You will be responsible for maintaining and upgrading critical test facilities to meet the needs of the Archimedes engine test program. You may be asked to directly support Engine hardware and Engine test operations. You will become skilled in Ground Systems engineering and be expected to work independently in support of the overall test facility design, build, activation, and engine test efforts.

**WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO**

* Design, build, and integrate critical test systems to support all test objectives and requirements
* Work with a team of technicians and engineers to perform troubleshooting to resolve facility and test operations issues
* Develop maintenance protocols for new and existing facility infrastructure
* Collaborate with Archimedes engine and Neutron vehicle design teams to prepare and perform tests on key engine and stage hardware
* Work hand in hand with the test operators to complete design, build, installation and checkout of facility systems
* This includes helping maintain cleanliness and integrity of systems, ensure component level verifications are performed, and ensuring internal standards are met

**YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS AS A GROUND SYSTEMS ENGINEER II:**

* Bachelor's degree in mechanical or aerospace engineering; or other technical discipline
* 2+ years of experience in rocket engine test stand or launch complex design and build
* Working knowledge in Siemens NX and Teamcenter
* Familiarity with ASME B31.1

**THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE**

* Experiencing with NASA GFSSP, Ansys Fluent, and CAESAR
* Experience with JIRA for work tracking and scheduling
* Broad general background in your engineering discipline with ability to design systems and develop computer tools for automation or analysis
* Experience designing or operating facilities for liquid oxygen and liquid methane
* Experience in weld design and inspection
* Background that demonstrates personal development which might include pilot training, scouting, sports teams especially any leadership roles in those activities
* Working knowledge of computer networks and IT infrastructure
* Demonstrated experience working with various disciplines, fabricators and suppliers to achieve on-time project execution
* Ability to remain unfazed by ambiguity or changes in strategic direction while maintaining a positive attitude and being self-actualized and self-guided

*This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas*

  

**WHAT TO EXPECT**

We're on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that's not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other's backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

jobs.title: Sr. Automation/Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
It's exciting to work for a company that makes the world measurably better.

We're committed to bringing safety, quality, and customer focus to the business of advanced ceramics manufacturing.

**Job Title**

Sr. Automation/Controls EngineerAs the Sr Automation/Controls Engineer, you will serve as a senior technical expert in industrial automation and controls and executes against the function’s manufacturing and engineering strategy. You will be responsible for understanding, defining, implementing, and supporting automation and controls systems across manufacturing operations. Responsibilities include identifying process and equipment improvements, performing technical and cost-benefit analyses, developing equipment and controls specifications, evaluating equipment suppliers and system integrators, supporting project proposals, and leading equipment installation, programming, integration, commissioning, and technology transfer activities.  
  
You will also be accountable for improving manufacturing capability, yield, productivity, reliability, safety, and equipment effectiveness through development and application of automation technologies. You will support development and standardization of automation architectures, controls practices, and manufacturing data connectivity that can be effectively maintained and deployed across multiple manufacturing sites.

**Role & Responsibilities:**

* Serve as a senior engineering subject matter expert in industrial automation, controls, and related manufacturing technologies.
* Provide hands-on engineering support for the design, programming, integration, commissioning, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of automated manufacturing equipment.
* Lead complex troubleshooting and root-cause analysis involving PLCs, HMIs, electrical controls, instrumentation, motion systems, networks, sensors, and associated manufacturing equipment.
* Develop and maintain PLC and HMI programming standards, controls specifications, electrical/control system documentation, program backups, version control practices, and other automation standards to improve equipment maintainability and consistency.
* Design, program, commission, and troubleshoot Rockwell Automation control systems, including ControlLogix/CompactLogix and FactoryTalk platforms. Support legacy PLC platforms where required.
* Apply industrial networking and communication technologies such as EtherNet/IP and other applicable industrial communication protocols to connect machines, controls, and manufacturing systems.
* Support machine data collection and integration between automation systems and higher-level manufacturing, historian, database, or MES systems where applicable.
* Apply appropriate OT cybersecurity principles when designing, modifying, connecting, and remotely supporting industrial control systems.
* Specify, integrate, and troubleshoot automation technologies such as VFDs, servo/motion control, sensors, instrumentation, machine vision, robotics, and automated material handling where applicable.
* Apply machine safety principles, including safety circuits, interlocks, guarding interfaces, safety PLCs, and risk-reduction requirements in equipment design and modification.
* Review and develop electrical schematics, control panel designs, I/O requirements, P&IDs, and equipment interface requirements.
* Serve as a key technical interface with machine manufacturers, automation suppliers, system integrators, and other external engineering resources.
* Develop equipment and automation specifications and participate in supplier selection, design reviews, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), installation, startup, and commissioning.
* Execute capital equipment projects and technology transfers to meet manufacturing requirements, including training and technical support for plant engineering, maintenance, and manufacturing personnel.
* Collaborate with manufacturing, maintenance, engineering, quality, EHS, IT/OT, and business leadership to improve equipment performance, reliability, process capability, and productivity.
* Develop technical and business justification for automation and process improvement projects, including cost-benefit and risk analysis.
* Identify opportunities to standardize and replicate successful automation technologies and equipment solutions across manufacturing operations.
* Maintain awareness of developments in industrial automation, controls, robotics, machine vision, manufacturing data systems, and related technologies and help evaluate their application within the company.
* Prepare technical analyses, project updates, recommendations, and presentations for engineering, plant, and executive leadership.

**Job Requirements**

**Required Education & Experience:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Automation Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* Minimum of 5 years of controls, automation, or manufacturing engineering experience, with significant hands-on responsibility for industrial automation systems.

**Required Experience and Skills:**

  

* Demonstrated experience designing, programming, commissioning, troubleshooting, and improving PLC/HMI-based manufacturing equipment.
* Strong experience with Rockwell Automation platforms, including Studio 5000/ControlLogix and FactoryTalk, or equivalent industrial control platforms.
* Experience commissioning automated equipment for small and large capital projects.
* Strong understanding of industrial electrical controls, electrical schematics, instrumentation, sensors, motors, VFDs, and related automation hardware.
* Experience with industrial communication networks and protocols used to connect PLCs, HMIs, drives, instrumentation, and manufacturing systems.
* Working knowledge of machine safety principles and applicable electrical/control standards, including relevant NEC, NFPA, NEMA, ISA, IEC, and IEEE requirements.

**Job Title: Senior Electrical Hardware Engineer (SMES)**

**Job Code: 46517**

**Job Location:** **Camden, NJ (on-site)**

**Schedule: 9/80 Regular (every other Friday off)**

**Job Description:**

L3Harris – Integrated Systems & Encryption (IS&E) is a recognized global leader in the design, development and production of secure communication systems and products supporting mission-critical space, ground, air and naval operations. L3Harris IS&E is where employees have the opportunity to make a significant impact on our business and the world around us while thriving in an environment that continually fosters growth and career development. We are committed to providing best-in-class solutions to our customers with the highest level of integrity, excellence and uncompromised quality in everything we do. L3Harris offers a flexible working environment where contributions are recognized and rewarded

This role requires a deep understanding of advanced digital design principles, signal integrity, and high-speed data transmission. As a Senior Electrical Engineer (EE), you will be a crucial member of our engineering team, supporting end-to-end design and development of high-speed digital electronic modules and circuit boards. Your responsibilities will include reviewing and deriving hardware requirements, developing design concepts that meet these requirements, and performing detailed electrical design of circuitry. This may encompass microprocessors, program and data memories, FPGAs, voltage regulators, power reset sequencers, analog circuitry, and interface transceiver circuits.  
You will capture designs as schematic diagrams using our CAD tools, participate in design reviews, and collaborate with our ECAD department for layout and routing on printed wiring boards (PWBs). Once the PWB is fabricated and populated with components by our on-campus assembly facility, you will test and verify the electronics assembly, and support firmware and software integration. Our rigorous design review and documentation process includes the creation of requirements specifications, design documents, and comprehensive test plans and procedures.

**Essential Functions:**

* Support the design and development of high-speed digital Circuit Card Assemblies (CCAs) from concept through production.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including hardware, software, and systems engineering to ensure cohesive product development.
* Support signal integrity analysis and simulations to optimize high-speed data paths.
* Develop and review detailed schematics, layout designs, and documentation.
* Conduct design reviews and provide technical guidance to junior engineers.
* Ensure compliance with industry standards and best practices.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex design issues.
* Stay updated with the latest advancements in high-speed digital design technologies.
* Minimal travel required.

**Qualifications:**

* BSEE degree with 6 years minimum applicable experience required
* Experience in digital and analog circuit board design and test
* Hands-on experience with debugging and testing high-speed digital circuits using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and other test equipment.
* Experience with schematic capture and Printed Circuit Board (PCB) layout for high-speed digital circuits.
* Familiarity with PCB layout and design rules for high-speed circuits.
* Experience with standard CAD tools, Mentor Graphics Xpedition preferred.
* Knowledge of signal integrity and power integrity principles.
* Basic programming skills in languages such as Python, C, or MATLAB for test automation and data analysis.
* Familiarity with hardware description languages like VHDL or Verilog is a plus.
* Familiarity with standard electronic interfaces, such as I2C, USB, RS-232, Ethernet, SATA, PCIe
* Must have and maintain a U.S. Government Secret security clearance.

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

* MSEE preferred
* Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting skills with the ability to quickly isolate and resolve issues.
* Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, to collaborate with cross-functional teams and provide status updates.
* Ability to work well in a team environment and contribute to collaborative projects.
* Strong attention to detail to ensure accuracy and quality in design and testing.
* Ability to manage time effectively and prioritize tasks to meet project deadlines.

In compliance with pay transparency requirements, the salary range for this role is $93,341 - $175,188. This is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, as final offer amount may vary based on factors including but not limited to experience and geographic location. **DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Every motion our robots make starts with an actuator, and we’re looking for an Actuator Systems Engineer to help us build better ones. This role is for someone who enjoys the full loop: building a model of how a motor or transmission should behave, rigorously testing this around other industry standards, and then iterating on the hardware or firmware until the desired specification is met.
  
  
You’ll work across electrical, mechanical, and firmware design, and you’ll own actuator performance from the bench all the way to robots running in people’s homes. The things you learn and build will directly shape how safe, reliable, efficient, quiet, and strong our robots are.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Plan and run characterization testing on our actuators, covering things like torque constant, friction, efficiency, thermal behavior, and wear over time, and turn those results into models and specs the rest of the team can rely on

  

* Build and maintain electromechanical and thermal models of our actuators that help us predict robot performance, set safe operating limits, and support the controls and simulation teams

  

* Contribute to the electrical design of the actuator, including motor selection, motor drivers, sensing, and protection, working closely with our EE team and suppliers

  

* Contribute to the mechanical design of the actuator, including transmissions, bearings, housings, and thermal paths, with an eye toward torque density, efficiency, and manufacturability

  

* Write and tune motor control firmware, including current and position control, current and thermal limiting, calibration, and fault detection

  
About the team  
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.
