jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Cloudflare Hyperdrive
jobs.description:
### **About Us**

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world's largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine's Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World's Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we're not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we're looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you're the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you'll fit right in.

### **Available Locations | Austin, TX | New York, NY | San Francisco, CA or Seattle, WA**

### **About the Role**

The Cloudflare Hyperdrive team builds the technology that makes regional databases feel like they are global. Hyperdrive is a core piece of the Cloudflare Developer Platform that accelerates database queries from Cloudflare Workers by pooling connections and caching data at the edge. By eliminating the massive latency overhead of TCP, TLS, and database-specific handshakes, Hyperdrive allows developers to use the databases they already know and love—like PostgreSQL and MySQL—without the "cold start" performance penalties typically associated with serverless environments.

### **Responsibilities**

Hyperdrive is integrated directly into the Cloudflare global network and features:

* Global Connection Pooling: Maintains "warm" connections to origin databases across the globe, reducing connection times by up to 90%.
* Intelligent Query Caching: Automatically caches frequently run read queries as close to the user as possible.
* Protocol-Aware Proxying: Features custom-built implementations of database wire protocols (PostgreSQL and MySQL) to parse and optimize traffic in real-time.
* Seamless Integration: Works with existing ORMs and drivers, providing a simple connection string that "just works" for developers.
* The team is geographically distributed across North America.
* You will own your code from inception to release, delivering solutions at all layers of the software stack to empower Cloudflare customers. On any given day, you might write a design document that outlines how you plan to solve a specific problem, or fix a bug in how our user experience renders. You can expect to interact with a variety of languages and technologies including, but not limited to Rust, Go, C++, Typescript.

### **Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience**

* You have 5+ years of professional experience with Rust, Go, or C++. You understand how to write code that respects CPU and memory constraints.
* You are comfortable with the Linux networking stack. You know your way around TCP/IP, TLS, and WebSockets.
* You don't just use databases; you understand how they work. You're familiar with connection lifecycles, transaction states, and wire protocols.
* You enjoy the challenge of debugging complex, distributed systems and building for "five nines" reliability.

### **Bonus Points**

* Experience with PgBouncer, ProxySQL, or custom database middleware.
* Familiarity with the Cloudflare Workers ecosystem and the unique stateful connection challenges of ephemeral computing.
* You've contributed to database drivers, ORMs, or low-level networking libraries.
* Experience using eBPF, perf, or other profiling tools to find and kill bottlenecks.

### **Compensation**

jobs.title: Software Engineer, 3D Rendering
jobs.description:
Mirage is an AI video company focused on making creation dramatically easier. Our team tackles some of the hardest creative and technical challenges in generative media.  
  
We get to rethink how people collaborate with AI that can actually *do* creative work with them—defining entirely new interaction paradigms for AI-native video tools. We make that possible by building multimodal agents that turn creative direction into edits, rendering engines that composite multiple layers of video and graphics, and generative video models trained from the ground up that create new media when needed.  
  
All of this comes together in Captions, our creative workspace for generating, editing, and designing video. The technology behind Captions is now available more broadly: Tesseract gives any AI agent native video-editing capabilities, while developers can integrate our models into their own products through APIs.  
  
**Explore our work**  
Captions — Our flagship creative workspace
  
Tesseract — Our professional video engine for AI agents
  
Research — The foundation models we build in-house
  
Updates — The latest from Mirage
  
TechCrunch, Forbes, Fast Company — Press  
  
**Our Investors**

We’re very fortunate to have some the best investors and entrepreneurs backing us, including **Index Ventures, Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia Capital, Andreessen Horowitz,** **General Catalyst**, Uncommon Projects, Kevin Systrom, Mike Krieger, Lenny Rachitsky, Antoine Martin, Julie Zhuo, Ben Rubin, Jaren Glover, SVAngel, 20VC, Ludlow Ventures, Chapter One, and more.

*Please note that most of our roles will require you to be in-person at our NYC HQ (located in Union Square)*

**About the role**

We want Tesseract to render 3D that is indistinguishable from footage. You'll be the founding engineer for photoreal 3D in Tesseract, our Rust-based, cross-platform graphics and media rendering engine.

Tesseract already renders video, motion graphics, effects and compositing in a color- managed pipeline. You'll build 3D to the same standard: a fast interactive preview for editing, and a physically based final render, path-traced or hybrid ray-traced, that produces film-quality frames for export. Both run from one scene, material and lighting model, so what people see while they edit is what they export.

Scenes are authored by people and by AI agents, so render cost, failure modes and APIs matter as much as image quality. This is a foundational role: you'll make the core architectural decisions and help build the team around them.

**What you'll do**

* Define the architecture for photoreal 3D: how ray tracing, rasterization and denoising divide the work, and how that maps onto Metal, Vulkan, Direct3D and WebGPU.
* Build light transport: global illumination, reflections and refraction, soft shadows from area lights, and volumetrics such as haze, fog and light shafts.
* Build a physically based model for materials, lights and cameras: energy-conserving materials (metal, glass, clearcoat, sheen, translucency), lights in real-world units, and a camera with exposure, depth of field and motion blur.
* Own image quality: sampling, antialiasing, accumulation, denoising and firefly suppression, with frames that stay stable and deterministic across a video export.
* Scale scenes to production complexity with acceleration structures, instancing, culling and memory management, for millions of triangles and tens of thousands of objects.
* Integrate 3D into Tesseract's video, motion graphics and compositing pipeline, including ACES color management and render passes such as depth, normals, motion vectors and light groups.
* Make render cost predictable and rendering robust: performance budgets, profiling, and headless batch rendering on local and cloud GPUs.
* Design 3D APIs that work for people and AI agents alike: a clear scene representation, actionable validation errors, fast previews and render cost known before the render.
* Work with engine, product and AI teams, and help hire and grow the 3D rendering team.

**What makes you a great fit**

* Deep experience building physically based renderers in production: film or offline renderers, path tracers, or game engines with ray-traced or hybrid lighting.
* Strong command of light transport: the rendering equation, Monte Carlo integration, importance sampling, material models and denoising.
* Hands-on GPU ray tracing: building and traversing acceleration structures (BVHs), hardware ray-tracing APIs such as Metal ray tracing, Vulkan ray tracing or DXR, and compute-based fallbacks.
* A solid understanding of modern rasterization pipelines, and of how hybrid renderers combine rasterization with ray tracing.
* Hands-on experience with Metal, Vulkan, Direct3D or WebGPU, including compute shaders, GPU profiling and GPU debugging.
* Proficiency in Rust or C++, with strong reasoning about memory, concurrency and performance.
* Strong foundations in the mathematics of graphics: linear algebra, geometry, probability and sampling.
* An eye for realism: you can look at a frame, say why it doesn't read as real, and fix the cause.
* Experience owning complex technical projects and making architectural decisions in ambiguous problem spaces.

**Even better if…**

* You've worked on the internals of a production renderer or engine such as Cycles, Arnold, RenderMan, V-Ray, Karma, Unreal Engine (Lumen or its path tracer) or Unity HDRP.
* You've built or integrated ML denoisers, or worked on neural rendering.
* You've worked with color management (ACES, OpenColorIO), HDR output or film-look pipelines.
* You've built on cross-platform graphics abstractions such as wgpu, including extending them where they lack features such as ray tracing.
* You've optimized rendering for Apple silicon or mobile GPUs.
* You have experience with Rust, video compositing, or integrating 2D and 3D rendering in creative tools.

### **Benefits:**

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans
* 401K with employer match

Our data centers and the cloud infrastructure powering tens of thousands of servers forms the foundation upon which Meta's rapidly scaling services operate. Meta is at the leading edge of the global data center industry in both design and cloud operations. This role requires a forward-thinking systems professional with deep experience leveraging diverse software tools to identify cloud automation solutions for complex operational challenges with our Cloud partnerships (AWS, GCP, CoreWeave, and other NeoCloud). The ideal candidate performs deep data analysis to prioritize server repair automation in a hyperscale cloud environment, drives solutions through code, and collaborates effectively with globally distributed teams through clear written communication.  
  
  

### **Cloud Production Systems Engineer Responsibilities:**

* Identify and root cause systemic issues across the cloud server fleet and drive resolutions to maximize uptime and utilization by leveraging hardware failure data and diagnostic telemetry
* Write, review, and maintain code for diagnostic and cloud automation tooling that supports quality and efficient delivery of production servers at hyperscale
* Own and develop diagnostic tooling requirements that enable frontline operations teams to efficiently manage and repair the cloud server fleet
* Drive the escalation process for Data Center Operations to identify, root cause, and resolve complex cloud tooling and hardware issues affecting fleet health
* Execute operational validation and verification activities for new cloud product integration into the production environment
* Collaborate with cross-functional cloud tooling teams to provide an operations-centric perspective on open issues and contribute to their development roadmaps
* Perform deep data analysis to prioritize cloud automation opportunities for server repair workflows in a large-scale, heterogeneous hardware environment
* Build cross-functional relationships and influence policies and procedures to improve global cloud data center operations consistency and efficiency
* Mentor other engineers on evaluating and resolving cloud fleet issues and defining improvements to tools and operational processes
* Travel up to 25% to support global cloud data center operations and new site deployments

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 7+ years of experience in production systems engineering, infrastructure engineering, or system software development for large-scale cloud environments
* 7+ years of experience with hardware lifecycle management, fleet automation, or cloud data center operations systems spanning compute, storage, or networking infrastructure
* Experience developing systems software or automation tooling in Python, Bash, PHP, C, or C++ for Linux-based production environments at scale
* Experience with the configuration and maintenance of production systems, including web servers, load balancers, relational databases, storage systems, and messaging systems
* Experience communicating technical designs and cloud infrastructure decisions through written documentation and cross-functional stakeholder alignment across engineering and operations teams

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience designing or operating cloud configuration management and infrastructure-as-code systems for large heterogeneous hardware fleets
* Experience with data analysis and visualization tools used to prioritize fleet health initiatives and drive operational decision-making
* Experience supporting global, multi-site data center infrastructure deployments, including hardware qualification and regional rollout coordination
* Familiarity with distributed systems monitoring, alerting, and automated remediation pipelines at hyperscale

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.
  
  
Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations-ext@meta.com.  
  
$173,000/year to $245,000/year + bonus + equity + benefits

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer Principal/New Generation
jobs.description:
**Job Posting End Date**

10-30-2026

Please note the job posting will close on the day before the posting end date.

**Job Summary**

The Electrical Engineer will support gas, coal, renewable, and new-generation self-build projects by defining electrical design-basis requirements and supporting the technical specification, engineering, procurement, integration, and commissioning of power generation electrical systems. A required focus of this role is advanced knowledge of utility-scale power plant electrical systems and equipment, including generators, generator step-up transformers (GSUs), medium- and low-voltage distribution systems, switchgear, motor control centers (MCCs), protective relaying, grounding systems, black-start systems, auxiliary power systems, and grid interconnection requirements.  
This role collaborates with Architect & Engineering (A/E) and Engineering, Procurement & Construction (EPC) firms and coordinates with internal and external stakeholders to ensure electrical designs meet performance, reliability, maintainability, constructability, safety, cybersecurity, and regulatory requirements. The engineer will participate in RFx/OEM engagements, support self-build proposals, and provide construction, commissioning, startup, and lifecycle support across the generation portfolio.

**Job Description**

**What you’ll do:**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support development of electrical design-basis and equipment requirements (generators, transformers, switchgear, station service, UPS/DC, cabling).
* Assist with power system studies and data preparation (load flow, short‑circuit, protection coordination, arc‑flash, harmonics) under senior review.
* Review vendor drawings, technical bids, and RFx deliverables and prepare comments for senior engineers.
* Help prepare technical and procurement specifications and scope documents for proposals.
* Support OEM interfacing during procurement: submittal review, factory/field testing coordination, and lead‑time tracking.
* Provide construction and commissioning support: site inspections, cable/power testing, relay settings assistance, witness testing, and punch‑list follow‑up.
* Assist with protection relay settings, grounding design, cable routing, and MV/HV equipment testing.
* Ensure designs comply with relevant codes and standards (IEEE, NEC/NFPA70, ANSI, IEC) and assist with reliability/obsolescence tasks.
* Coordinate with mechanical, I&C, civil, and operations teams to resolve integration and SCADA/DCS interface items.
* Contribute to O&M documentation, spares lists, and lifecycle cost input.

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Understanding of protection relays, CT/VT selection, relay coordination fundamentals.
* Basic skills in grounding, cable sizing, testing, and MV/HV equipment installation practices.
* Ability to interpret single‑line diagrams, schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical reports.
* Familiarity with power electronics for renewables and storage is a plus.
* Proficiency in MS Office; familiarity with scripting or databases is beneficial.
* Effective written and verbal communication for cross‑functional coordination.

**Working Conditions**

* Approximately 25% travel, including day trips and overnight stays (up to a week or more).
* Work in both indoor and outdoor environments with exposure to heat, cold, noise, dust, fumes, and operating machinery.
* Mandatory safety gear required at generating stations: hard hat, eye/hearing protection, steel-toed shoes with heels and non-slip soles.
* Adherence to site-specific safety requirements is mandatory.

**What we’re looking for:**

**Engineer Principal SG9**

*Education/Experience:*

* Has typically acquired 8 or more years of related engineering experience along with a Bachelor's degree in engineering in a program accredited by ABET\*;
* Or 6 years of related engineering experience along with a Master's or PhD in engineering from a program accredited by ABET\*.
* Registration as a Professional Engineer (PE) in any U.S. state or Puerto Rico\*\* is preferred for this position unless approval to waive this requirement is given by the organization's EVP.

* ABET - Engineering Accreditation Commission of the Accreditation Board for Engineering and Technology.
* Individuals with a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering Technology can satisfy this degree requirement, if they obtain a certified Professional Engineering (PE) license.

*Acceptable alternative:*

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (non-ABET) plus a Master's degree or PhD in engineering from a university with an ABET accredited Bachelor's program.
* \*\* Confirmation is preferred to ensure the PE obtained in Puerto Rico aligns with NCEES standards.

\*\*\*VP or above may waive the requirement for a degree from a university with an Non ABET accredited program

*In addition:*

* Experience across gas, coal, and renewable projects; commissioning experience on simple/combined‑cycle plants.
* Experience with battery storage, inverters, or utility interconnection practices.
* Working knowledge of simple‑ and combined‑cycle plant electrical systems, generator synchronization, and MV/HV equipment.
* Familiarity with power system study tools and analysis methods.
* Experience reviewing vendor drawings and RFx responses.
* Proficiency with electrical design/analysis tools (ETAP, SKM/PowerTools, CYME, MATLAB, AutoCAD/MicroStation, or equivalent).

In addition to competitive compensation, AEP offers a unique comprehensive benefits package that aims to support and enhance the overall well-being of our employees.

**Where Putting the Customer First Powers Everything We Do**  
  
At AEP, we’re more than just an energy company — we’re a team of dedicated professionals committed to delivering safe, reliable, and innovative energy solutions. Guided by our mission to put the customer first, we strive to exceed expectations by listening, responding, and continuously improving the way we serve our communities. jobs.title: Facility Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**What Timken makes possible begins with you.**  
Those who came before us helped land a man on the moon, create the world's infrastructure, and introduce renewable energy alternatives. Now you can join the Timken team to write your own unique story and help drive what's next.

  

A career at Timken means you can have an immediate impact doing Work That Matters to the world— improving the efficiency of today's industrial equipment and preparing for the future of motion on our planet and beyond. New employees can start contributing right away, and there are many opportunities to advance your career at your own pace. Join our global team of 19,000 people in 45 countries, and start helping our customers push the limits of what's possible in their world of motion.

  

**PURPOSE**:  
  
This position exists to design, develop, construct, and maintain electrical control systems related to the function of the facility. This position will help maintain and troubleshoot the electrical systems pertaining to the building automation system, lighting system, and HVAC/chiller/boiler/cooling tower equipment and drives. This position will be responsible for integration basic level systems into the building automation system.  
This position will also design, develop, construct, and maintain electrical control systems for the implementation of new concepts on Research projects/testing systems.

  

**ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES**:

  

* Design and construct electrical control circuitry and programming logic for integration of lower level facility systems into the building automation system. Projects will be handled start to finish (design/build/install/startup). Position will work with outside controls contractor on the implementation of larger systems in order to meet project timelines.
* Function as facility lead on computerized lighting/shade control system.
* Assist facilities Principal Electrical Analyst on regular facility maintenance issues related to motor control centers, substation breakers, well water system, fire alarm control system, compressed air system, iron filtration system etc.
* Design and construct electrical control circuitry for prototype and test machinery based on the needs of the customers. Design and program PLC logic for such machines as well as data acquisition schemes.
* Prepare budgets and designs for projects less than $100,000/ 12 week project time frame.
* Communicate closely with pipe fitters, machinists, sheet metal workers, machine operators, engineers, design technicians, safety inspectors, and others, so that machinery may be constructed as efficiently as possible using the proper tools and procedures as outlined in various safety and electrical codes.
* Analyze prototype and test machinery using electrical and electronic test equipment , schematics, logic and wiring diagrams, flow charts, cycle graphs, and other technical data in order to determine what improvements or changes might be needed to obtain more precise and efficient machine operation. Uses the data to design and implement the solution.
* Provide possible solutions for problems which have occurred during design, instruction, or run-off of test machinery. Implement these changes with success without first consulting the Engineering Department.
* Keep informed about new types of electrical, electronic, and microprocessor controls by studying technical manuals, video tapes, attending factory schools and seminars, and working with field service engineers so that these controls may be integrated into futuristic machine controls with the least amount of difficulty, confusion, and expense possible.

  

**TECHNICAL FUNCTION SKILLS**:

  

* Proficient in CAD
* Ability to design and develop PLC ladder logic
* Ability to design and develop HMI programming
* Proficient in basic and advanced electrical tools (multimeters, o-scopes, data acquisition systems)
* Basic computer knowledge (Microsoft office)
* Understanding of NEC code and the ability to make decisions based upon it.
* Function knowledge of facility systems such as boilers, chillers, HVAC, variable speed fans, etc.
* Ability to program building automation system
* Building Operators Certificate Level 1

  

**EDUCATION:**

  

* Minimum: HS Diploma with 8+ years of relevant experience is required (i.e. test lab, facility maintenance etc.). Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Technology is preferred.

  

All qualified applicants shall be treated equally according to their individual qualifications, abilities, experiences and other employment standards. There will be no discrimination due to gender or gender identity, race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, sexual orientation, veteran/military status or any other basis protected by applicable law.

May also collaborate with Product Owners/Project Managers/Key Stakeholders to build a Proof of Concept (POC), followed by a Minimum Viable Product (MVP), and a market-ready product.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Onto Innovation is a leader in process control, combining global scale with an expanded portfolio of leading-edge technologies that include: 3D metrology spanning the chip from nanometer-scale transistors to micron-level die-interconnects; macro defect inspection of wafers and packages; metal interconnect composition; factory analytics; and lithography for advanced semiconductor packaging. Our breadth of offerings across the entire semiconductor value chain helps our customers solve their most difficult yield, device performance, quality, and reliability issues. Onto Innovation strives to optimize customers’ critical path of progress by making them smarter, faster and more efficient.

**Job Summary & Responsibilities**

The Regional Senior Systems Engineer for the Iris T1 platform will play a critical role in advancing Onto’s next‑generation optical metrology solutions.

This position focuses on developing new metrology capabilities, optimizing performance of existing Iris T1 systems, and delivering clear, data‑driven guidance to global field and customer teams.

The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with cross‑functional partners—including software engineering, hardware design, systems engineering, and applications scientists—to define system specifications, establish performance requirements, and ensure successful system integration. The role requires designing and executing experiments to validate system behavior, diagnose performance issues, and drive continuous improvement in optical hardware and measurement algorithms.

Additional responsibilities include supporting first‑in‑fab Iris T1 system installations, enabling initial tool matching and baseline performance validation, and developing training resources and documentation for regional field service and applications engineering teams. This role will require regional and international travel of up to 50%.

  

* Align, optimize, and validate precision optical subsystems within the Iris T1 platform
* Develop best practices and operational methodologies to maximize tool performance and measurement stability
* Design, execute, and analyze experiments to characterize, troubleshoot, and enhance optical metrology performance
* Create structured action plans and drive timely execution
* Develop and deliver progress reports, technical presentations for internal stakeholders and external customers
* Communicate system requirements, design specifications, and performance findings to multidisciplinary engineering teams
* Support on‑site activities including new tool installations, initial qualification, and matching of first‑in‑fab systems
* Generate technical procedures, documentation, and training materials for global engineering teams

**Qualifications**

* Master’s in engineering or physical sciences with emphasis in optical physics or related optical technologies – PhD preferred.
* 5+ years of semiconductor capital equipment engineering experience, preferably in optical metrology
* Hands‑on applications development experience with spectroscopic ellipsometry or related optical measurement techniques
* Demonstrated experience integrating precision optical and optomechanical components
* Proficiency in data analysis and scientific programming (e.g., Python, MATLAB)
* Strong analytical skills and a methodical, data‑driven approach to troubleshooting complex systems
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; collaborative team‑oriented mindset
* Hands‑on experience working with prototype systems in an R&D or laboratory environment
* Background in new product development, system bring‑up, or early‑stage metrology platforms
* Ability to travel regionally and internationally up to 50%

Why Join Onto Innovation?

At Onto Innovation, we believe your work should matter—and so should your well-being. That’s why we offer competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you and your family. From health, dental, and vision coverage to life and disability insurance, PTO, and a 401(k) with employer match, we’ve got you covered. You’ll also enjoy access to our Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), wellness initiatives, and cutting-edge tools—all within a collaborative, inclusive culture where your contributions are valued and recognized.

**Compensation & Growth**

* Base Salary Range:

$115,200.00 - $172,800.00, offered in good faith and based on experience, location, and qualifications.

* Additional Rewards: Annual bonus opportunities and potential long-term incentives tied to both company and individual success.

Empowering Every Voice to Shape the Future:

Onto Innovation is committed to creating a workplace where every qualified candidate has an equal opportunity to succeed. We evaluate applicants based on skills, experience, and potential - without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.description:
**Who we are**

Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly.

The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone.

At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn.

**What we are looking for**

We’re searching for a **Senior Software Engineer, ML Evaluation & Introspection Infrastructure** to join our Behavior Analysis team, reporting to the team’s engineering manager. Aurora’s trucks already haul freight on Texas highways with no one on board, and every new version of the learned model that drives them has to prove, on real driving data, that it is better and safer than the one before. Behavior Analysis builds the systems that make that call: the evals that compare model versions, the embedding search that makes every driving scenario findable, and the introspection tools that show why a model did what it did. Engineers build more than 100 training and eval datasets a week through our tools. We’re a small team, so each engineer owns whole systems, and we work agent-first: our tools are built for AI agents to drive as easily as engineers do. You’ll own core pieces of that loop and help lead what comes next: putting LLMs, VLMs and agents to work on analysis, so questions that take days to answer today take minutes.

**In this role you will**

* Build and scale evaluation pipelines that compare model versions on large driving datasets: offline evals, slice-based metrics, regression detection, and model-vs-model reports.
* Own embedding and vector-search pipelines over driving data, versioned per model, so engineers can search, cluster and compare how any model represents the world. This is where you’d start: owning embedding generation and search end to end.
* Build model introspection infrastructure (attention, attribution, ablations) that turns “why did the model do that?” from a research project into a query.
* Help define how frontier LLMs, VLMs and agents change ML analysis here: triaging, labeling, clustering and summarizing driving scenarios and eval results. We already have a prototype using LLMs for data curation, and you’d help decide where it goes next.
* Work side by side with the ML engineers training these models to decide what to measure, then make those measurements trustworthy, observable and cheap enough to run on every candidate model.
* Build the web app and CLI that engineers and AI agents use to find datasets, training runs, evals and their costs, designed with agents as first-class users.

* Typically 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend, data or ML infrastructure.

* Experience with distributed compute and container orchestration (e.g. Kubernetes, AWS Batch or similar).

**Desirable qualifications**

* ML evaluation infrastructure: eval harnesses, golden datasets, regression detection, A/B model comparison.
* Embeddings and vector search, or model introspection and interpretability tooling.
* Using LLMs, VLMs or agentic workflows to automate analysis, labeling or data curation.
* Autonomous vehicles, robotics or other large-scale sensor data.
* Observability for data systems (metrics, alerting, SLOs), and everyday use of AI coding agents.
* Coming from backend or data engineering and want to learn ML evaluation? Apply anyway: we’ll teach you the ML side.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Hayward Holdings Inc. (NYSE "HAYW") is one of the leading manufacturers of residential swimming pool equipment in the world, with a significant presence in the commercial pool market that is continuously growing. Hayward designs, manufactures, and markets a full line of residential and commercial pool and spa equipment including pumps, filters, heating, cleaners, salt chlorinators, automation, lighting, safety, flow control and energy solutions at our company owned facilities. Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, Hayward also has facilities in Tennessee, Arizona, and Rhode Island, Georgia, as well as Canada, Spain, France, Australia, and China.

**Overview:**

We're looking for a self-directed engineer who thrives with ownership — someone who can take a project from concept through manufacturing release with minimal oversight, while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to deliver industry-leading pool controls, electronics, and assemblies.

Join us to lead, grow, and make an impact as part of a company that values care, respect, and innovation.

**This position is based in North Kingstown, RI and is onsite 5 days a week.**

**Major Tasks and Responsibilities**

**1. Design Ownership**

* Analyze system and subsystem level requirements and evaluate technical solutions for new platforms.
* Generate electrical architecture solutions, topologies, and configurations to optimize the electrical design for new project needs.
* Design, model, simulate, implement, and verify circuits.
* Lead design reviews, optimize PCB layouts, and specify components for robust designs.

**2. Analysis and Verification**

* Support electronic circuit verification activities per industry accepted practices.
* Support DFMEA and other analyses to develop a robust product that meets market and safety requirements.

**3. Test, Validate, and Launch**

* Build and analyze bench level prototypes for proof-of-concept designs.
* Create and execute test plans to validate designs and ensure industry compliance (HALT, EMC/EMI, UL, CE).
* Partner with manufacturing teams for smooth production launches.

**4. Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Work with product, firmware, mechanical, and system architects to create cohesive product architectures.
* Maintain detailed technical documentation and communicate design strategies effectively.

**5. Continuous Learning**

* Stay up to date on industry trends and emerging technologies through conferences, research, and side projects.
* Champion and role model best practices within the electrical engineering team.

**Requirements**

Experience: 8–10+ years in electrical design and product development.

**Who You Are**

* Self-driven and independent — comfortable owning projects end-to-end with minimal oversight and a strong commitment to meeting deadlines.

**Required Experience**

* Proficiency with schematic capture tools (Altium, Xpedition, Zuken, OrCAD or Eagle) and knowledge of PCB layout and PCB construction.
* Experience with IoT-connected embedded systems, including wireless communication protocols (e.g., Wi-Fi, BLE, Zigbee) and cloud-connected device architectures.
* Knowledge of 3-phase BLDC motor drives, embedded systems, microcontrollers, and analog/digital circuitry.
* Familiarity with safety standards, EMC, and environmental compliance.
* Understanding of mechanical/thermal/packaging design for embedded systems in commercial and industrial markets.
* Experience with oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, power analyzers, and timing analyzers to support product verification.
* Technical knowledge of reliability testing including environmental, safety, and EMI/EMC verification procedures.
* Working knowledge of display controller and touch-controller interfaces (e.g., RGB, MIPI DSI, SPI, I2C), including backlight drive and power sequencing, touch tuning for wet, gloved, and high-glare conditions, ESD/EMC protection of the display and touch subsystem.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience using simulation and analysis tools such as LTSpice, Saber, Mathcad, or Maple.
* Experience with electrical product design in a regulated environment such as automotive, aerospace, or medical.
* Design For Six Sigma, DMAIC, Lean Six Sigma, or Shainin Red X certification.
* Hands-on experience designing and integrating user-interface displays and touchscreens for harsh, outdoor-exposed products, including full-color TFT LCD touchscreens (resistive and projected-capacitive) as well as simpler segmented, character, and LED displays and keypads.
* Proven track record translating customer and market requirements into product requirements, system architectures, and technical specifications.
* Experience leading or contributing to architecture trade studies, make/buy decisions, and platform selection (MCU/SoC, connectivity modules, sensors).

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) required; Master's degree in Electrical Engineering (MSEE) preferred.

**Why Join Hayward**

* **Impact at Scale:** Build the connected, IoT-enabled hardware inside smart pool products used in millions of homes worldwide.
* **Our Mission:** Transforming water experiences with innovation and sustainability.
* **Growth Opportunities:** A supportive environment for career advancement and professional development.
* **Inclusive Culture:** We value diversity and foster a collaborative workplace.
* **Comprehensive Benefits:** Competitive pay, health coverage, retirement plan matching, and paid time off.

**About Overwatch:**  
Overwatch Imaging is an imagery intelligence technology company working to bring sensor autonomy to time-critical airborne search, detection, tracking and monitoring missions. Founded in 2016 in Hood River, Oregon, we support private sector companies as well as federal, state and local agencies around the world with missions ranging from wildfire mapping and disaster response to law enforcement, border security, maritime domain awareness and tactical intelligence.

You will work alongside highly skilled engineers who are committed to engineering excellence, and your work will have a direct impact on the platforms we deliver.  
  
**Description**  
  
As a BMC Firmware Engineer, you will design, implement, test, and maintain BMC firmware features for server platforms. You will bring up BMC software on new hardware, work with ODM, OEM, and silicon vendor partners, and help ensure the firmware is robust against security threats. Your work will support strong infrastructure manageability, serviceability, and security.","responsibilities":"Develop and maintain BMC firmware features, including services, APIs, and management interfaces (Redfish, IPMI).  
  
Design scalable, maintainable BMC software that supports new hardware through configuration. Upstream changes to the OpenBMC community where appropriate and maintain downstream patches across releases.

Debug issues across hardware, firmware, and software boundaries using serial console, JTAG, and bus analyzers.  
  
Support EVT, DVT, and PVT builds, and work with global ODM, OEM, and contract manufacturing partners to resolve issues.  
  
Contribute to firmware security: secure boot, firmware signing, vulnerability triage, and patching.  
  
Write unit tests for new features, and support system-level validation by reproducing and fixing defects.  
  
Write clear technical documentation and contribute to design discussions.  
  
Stay current on new vulnerabilities, attack methods, and security standards (NIST, FIPS).  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  
Familiarity with PLDM and MCTP, and with PECI/APML.  
  
Experience with BMC security features such as secure or verified boot, firmware signing, root of trust, SPDM, and vulnerability management.  
  
Strong debugging and problem-solving skills across hardware, firmware, and software, with effective collaboration with vendor and hardware teams.  
  
Experience supporting BMC software on new hardware, including low-level debugging (JTAG, serial, oscilloscope, I2C analyzer).  
  
Exposure to EDKII/BIOS and platform enablement.  
  
Familiarity with RAS concepts (fault management, telemetry, recovery).  
  
Familiarity with cloud-scale operations and fleet management of BMC firmware.  
  
Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic, and sometimes ambiguous environment, and to identify and raise technical and schedule risks early.  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.  
  
7+ years of experience in embedded Linux development with strong C/C++ programming skills, plus scripting in Bash and Python.  
  
Hands-on experience with OpenBMC including IPMI, systemd and D-Bus services, Redfish, sensors and telemetry, and firmware update frameworks.  
  
Experience porting OpenBMC to new platforms, including build configuration, kernel and device tree changes, and platform-specific services.  
  
Experience integrating and scaling sensors in OpenBMC, with attention to service count, memory, and boot-time cost.  
  
Working knowledge of server platform interfaces such as I2C/I3C, SPI, PMBus, UART, GPIO, and Ethernet controllers.  
  
Experience taking firmware through product development stages, ideally EVT/DVT/PVT with ODM or OEM partners.

The base pay range for this role is between $175,000 and $308,500, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**About us**
============

Graphcore is one of the world's leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world's most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.

Graphcore's teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore enjoys a culture of continuous learning and constant innovation.

  

**Job Summary**
===============

We are seeking a Senior Systems or Staff Hardware Engineer to provide advanced operational, diagnostic, and engineering support for Graphcore's Arm-based hardware platforms across lab and data center environments.

This role focuses on supporting hardware bring-up, validation, and troubleshooting of complex AI compute platforms, including server blades, racks, and rack-scale infrastructure. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with engineering, platform, and data center teams to ensure the reliability and performance of next-generation AI systems.

  

**The Team**
============

The Systems Engineering and Hardware Engineering teams are responsible for enabling the bring-up, validation, and operational reliability of Graphcore's AI infrastructure platforms.

The team works closely with server engineering, firmware teams, platform architects, and data center operations to support the development, testing, and deployment of next-generation AI compute systems.

This collaborative environment enables rapid problem-solving and continuous improvement of Graphcore's hardware platforms from early development through production deployment.

  

**Responsibilities and Duties**
===============================

* Lead advanced break-fix troubleshooting for server blades, motherboards, power systems, and rack-scale infrastructure.
* Support engineering bring-up activities, including component validation and firmware interaction testing.
* Diagnose system-level failures involving thermal behavior, power anomalies, network configuration, and BIOS/BMC issues.
* Collaborate with server engineering teams to perform root cause analysis and propose corrective actions or design improvements.
* Support deployment and rollout of next-generation hardware platforms through structured validation and qualification cycles.
* Interface with facilities and infrastructure teams to understand environmental factors impacting system reliability.
* Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), troubleshooting guides, and validation documentation.
* Provide guidance and mentorship to junior technicians and engineers on troubleshooting methodologies and hardware diagnostics.
* Participate in on-call rotations or off-hours support during critical engineering milestones or hardware bring-up phases.

**Candidate Profile**
=====================

**Essential**
-------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline.
* 7+ years experience with server hardware architectures and board-level debugging.
* Experience analyzing system logs, hardware telemetry, and power/thermal metrics to isolate hardware failures.
* Hands-on experience with HPC systems, AI compute platforms, or rack-scale infrastructure.
* Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively in fast-paced engineering environments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Desirable**
-------------

* Experience supporting prototype or pre-production hardware bring-up.
* Familiarity with data center facilities, including liquid cooling and power distribution systems.
* Experience using Python, Bash, or automation tools for hardware validation or troubleshooting.
* Exposure to structured failure analysis and reliability engineering methodologies.

  

**USA Benefits**  
  
In addition to a competitive salary, Graphcore offers flexible working and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing and financial future. Our benefits include medical, dental and vision coverage, Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), Health Savings Accounts (HSAs), disability and life insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan, commuter benefits, wellness services and an Employee Assistance Programme (EAP). We welcome people of different backgrounds and experiences; we're committed to building an inclusive work environment that makes Graphcore a great home for everyone. We offer an equal opportunity process and understand that there are visible and invisible differences in all of us. We can provide a flexible approach to interview and encourage you to chat to us if you require any reasonable adjustments.

jobs.title: Advanced ATE Software Engineer
jobs.description:
As an Advanced Test Engineer here at Honeywell Aerospace, you will play a pivotal role in advancing the quality and reliability of aerospace products through innovative test engineering practices. You will lead the development and execution of sophisticated test plans and procedures, leveraging cutting-edge methodologies to ensure our aerospace solutions meet the highest standards of performance and safety.

You will report directly to our Engineering Manager, and you’ll work out of our Richardson, TX location on a Hybrid work schedule.

In this role, you will impact the aerospace industry by ensuring that Honeywell’s aerospace products are rigorously tested and validated, contributing to safer and more efficient air travel worldwide. Delivering mission-critical, electronic solutions that protect lives. Use your creativity and critical thinking to take our products from concept to customer. You will lead the development and execution of sophisticated test solutions for Monolithic Microwave Integrated Circuits (MMICs). This role involves analyzing detailed test requirements and designing advanced Automated Test Equipment (ATE) systems tailored to customer specifications. The engineer will create and implement comprehensive test strategies, including test plans, acceptance procedures, and rigorous design verification processes.

The position requires leadership in enhancing team test capabilities through planning, coordination, and development of custom test equipment, including fixture design and fabrication. Responsibilities include performing RF test setup, calibration, validation, and troubleshooting of complex assemblies to ensure accurate, repeatable measurements.

The engineer will develop and maintain automated test software using National Instruments LabVIEW, integrating instrumentation and databases to enable scalable, efficient, and high-throughput testing environments. Additional duties include conducting advanced troubleshooting, failure analysis, and root cause investigations for MMIC devices and RF assemblies, as well as executing product qualification and environmental stress testing to meet industry standards.

This role also involves generating detailed technical reports, managing test data systems, and supporting laboratory operations such as asset tracking and equipment maintenance. Precision work under microscopes for inspection, assembly support, and failure analysis are also required. The ideal candidate is highly technical, detail-oriented, and capable of working independently in a fast-paced engineering environment.

**Job Description**

**Summary**

The Electrical Engineer at PROPWR is a member of the PWRLIVE Center, PROPWR’s real-time engineering, field engineering, and asset reliability team. The primary focus of this role is supporting PWRLIVE Center during power system faults and events, protective relay coordination, and electrical troubleshooting support for power generation and distribution equipment. The electrical engineer will analyze relay event records and system data to determine root cause, guide field personnel through electrical troubleshooting, and drive corrective actions that improve asset reliability. In addition, the engineer will support the design, integration, and testing of electrical equipment at the system and sub-system levels, including troubleshooting documentation, integration drawings, and pre-installation testing.

**Responsibilities**

**PWRLIVE Center Support**

* Serve as an electrical engineering resource for the PWRLIVE Center, providing real-time and remote troubleshooting support to field personnel for in-service generation and electrical equipment.
* Analyze faults, trips, and abnormal operating events using relay event reports, oscillography, sequence-of-events records, and SCADA/historian data to determine root cause and recommend corrective actions.
* Develop, review, and maintain protective relay settings and logic for generator, transformer, feeder, and bus protection.
* Perform and maintain protection coordination studies, including time-current curves, to ensure selective and reliable operation of protective devices.
* Perform short-circuit and fault current calculations and verify equipment ratings; support arc flash studies as needed.
* Support relay testing and commissioning, including settings verification, secondary injection testing, and review of test results.
* Lead and support root cause analysis for electrical failures and recurring events; document findings and track corrective actions through closure.
* Identify trends in electrical events and equipment performance and recommend improvements to protection schemes, settings, and operating practices to improve fleet reliability.
* Develop and maintain PWRLIVE Center technical resources, including:
  + Electrical troubleshooting guides and decision trees
  + Fault and event analysis reports
  + Relay settings records and protection documentation
  + Lessons learned and technical bulletins for field personnel
Provide training and technical guidance to field and PWRLIVE Center personnel on protective relaying, fault response, and electrical troubleshooting practices.  

**Engineering & Project Support**

* Support systems design, integration, and testing of various equipment types.
* Provide technical support for integration testing and commissioning of equipment at the system and sub-system levels.
* Participate in electrical and power systems engineering projects and initiatives.
* Assist in developing milestones and tracking progress to meet project objectives.
* Develop and update documentation on a system and sub-system level, including:
  + Equipment SOPs
  + Single-line and three-line diagrams
  + Integration testing procedures
* Assist with medium voltage cable assembly design and interconnection methods.
* Collaborate with vendors and third-party suppliers, including relay and switchgear manufacturers, to ensure technical requirements are met and to resolve equipment issues.
* Work closely with senior engineers to learn and apply protection and power systems principles, analysis tools, and project management practices.
* Partner with stakeholders within PROPWR and ProPetro, including Field Operations, Engineering, and Project Execution, to address technical challenges and support operational goals.
* Identify potential technical risks and assist in developing mitigation strategies.
* Maintain compliance with Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) policies, attending all required HSE training sessions, safety meetings, and using proper PPE at all times.
Perform other duties as assigned.  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering required; Master’s or PhD preferred. EIT certification preferred; PE is a plus.
* 4+ years’ experience with electrical systems, including protective relaying, fault analysis, and electrical troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of protective relaying principles and protection schemes, including common ANSI device functions (e.g., 50/51, 87, 27/59, 81, 32, 40, 25).
* Experience with SEL microprocessor-based protective relays and meters (e.g., SEL-751, SEL-700G, SEL-735) is preferred.
* Experience with SEL software, including AcSELerator QuickSet for relay settings and SynchroWAVe for event analysis, is preferred.
* Ability to read and interpret relay event reports, oscillography, and COMTRADE files.
* Understanding symmetrical and asymmetrical components, short-circuit analysis, and protection coordination.
* Experience with power system analysis software (e.g., ETAP, PSCAD, PowerFactory) is preferred.
* Understanding of the NEC; familiarity with NESC, NFPA 70E, and IEEE C37 standards is preferred.
* Experience developing and interpreting single-line diagrams, three-line diagrams, and AC/DC control schematics.
* Exposure to AC systems up to 38kV and DC systems up to 120V.
* Experience with reciprocating generators or turbines, generator protection, or paralleling switchgear is a plus.
* Ability to lead root cause analysis and implement corrective actions.
* Experience in field operations and troubleshooting of medium voltage equipment preferred.

* Familiarity with SCADA, PLCs, and industrial communication protocols (e.g., Modbus, DNP3, IEC 61850) is a plus.

We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow on Carrier social media at @Carrier.

**About Automated Logic**

At Automated Logic, we've been developing and supporting intelligent building solutions that have helped customers, including small businesses to Fortune 500 corporations, operate their buildings more efficiently for over 40 years. Our products help reduce energy consumption, lower utility, operating and maintenance costs, and improve indoor air quality, occupant comfort, and productivity. Technology that supports the buildings and industry of today and tomorrow requires a wide range of talents and skill sets.

**About this role:**

The Controls Engineering Supervisor is a team leader of a selected number of Controls Engineers. Their primary responsibility is managing and training of their direct employees, and verification of their work. They will be responsible for the mentoring of new hires as well as current Engineering staff. * Programming of control algorithms including those that include third-party integration (using Eikon).
* Development of graphical and text-based interfaces for building automation systems (using Eikon and ViewBuilder).
* Testing of programming and interfaces prior to deployment.
* Functional testing (commissioning) of complex building systems such as chiller plants and large integrations.
* Final documentation of the building automation system that incorporates all changes made since issuance of the submittal.
* Adherence to project requirements and company and customer standards in all aspects of design, programming, and implementation.

* Mentorship and development of other Controls Engineers.
* Preform software and hardware quality control (QA/QC) reviews for all direct reports.
* Ensure deliverable dates from Project Managers are coordinated with Engineers and milestones are put in place to be sure to meet these requirements.
* Lead, document, and participate in yearly and semi yearly performance reviews for all of your Engineers.
* Clear communication and proactive expectation setting with manager and project teams both internal and external.
* Maintenance and advisement of customer and company design and programming standards including parts and practices.
* Adherence to safety standards. High regard for employee and subcontractor safety.
* Interviewing potential candidates for open Engineering positions.
* Adherence to ethics standards. Exemplifies the Carrier code of ethics.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree and 3+ years’ experience in the HVAC controls industry
  + Or
* High School Diploma/ GED and 5+ years’ experience in the HVAC controls industry.
* Possess and maintain valid and current form of government issued identification.
* Ability to report to assigned work location reliably.
* Willingness and ability to travel 10% of average workweek, including air travel, overnight hotel stays, and unexpected travel when required.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Degree in in an engineering or construction discipline.
* Advanced knowledge of enterprise IP networks, including layout and troubleshooting.
* Thoroughly understands electrical and mechanical building systems.
* Capable of designing and programming any project executed by Automated Logic, regardless of complexity.
* Able understand, write, and recommend modifications to sequences of operation for the automation of all building systems.
* Able to interpret plans (including architectural, mechanical, and electrical blueprints), specifications, and contract documents to deliver compliant but optimized designs.
* Able to concisely, accurately, and effectively request clarifications to technical or scope information via a formal RFI process.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer, Spacecraft Hardware
jobs.description:
**About Overview Energy**

Overview Energy is a mission-driven team committed to building a new layer of energy infrastructure: satellites in geosynchronous orbit that redirect solar energy to terrestrial solar projects via passively safe near-infrared light. We’re in the earliest phase, where every circuit board and harness that leaves our facility is designed, built, and tested end-to-end by a small, dedicated team. Headquartered in the Northern Virginia / Washington, DC area and backed by world-class investors, we are advancing the next generation of clean energy technology.

**About the Role**

We’re hiring an Electrical Engineer to design, build, and test the electronics behind our flight and ground hardware. You’ll report directly to our lead electrical engineer and work daily with our mechanical, embedded software, and systems engineers.

This is a generalist seat. One week you’re capturing a schematic and bringing up a new board on the bench. The next, you’re holding a supplier to its statement of work and checking that what ships matches what we specified.

This is built for someone a few years into their career who has already put real hardware on a bench and wants a far bigger slice of the system than a large prime can offer. The role is onsite daily at our Ashburn Virginia facility.

**What You’ll Do**

* Design and capture schematics for analog, digital, and power boards: sensors, data acquisition, power delivery, and the interfaces between them.
* Select components, build BOMs, and see boards through fabrication and assembly.
* Bring up new PCBs with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and bench supplies, then debug and characterize them against requirements.
* Support systems engineering on requirements, architecture, and interfaces.
* Design and document wire harnesses and interconnects: wire gauge, connectors, pinouts, and interface control documents (ICDs).
* Manage electronics suppliers and contractors: review statements of work, track deliverables, and verify what arrives against spec.
* Run power budgets and first-pass thermal and EMI checks, applying derating and space-environment practices to every design.
* Write test procedures and scripts that automate measurements and data analysis.
* Drive hardware anomalies to root cause and close out corrective actions.
* Write complete design reports, ICDs, and test procedures, so the next engineer can pick up your work without a meeting.

**What We’re Looking For From You**

* B.S. or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field.
* 2–5+ years of hands-on electrical hardware experience. Internships and co-ops count, as does a substantial hardware program such as CubeSat, Formula SAE, solar car, hybrid/EV, rocketry, or UAV teams.
* At least one piece of hardware you designed, built, or tested end-to-end and can walk us through on a whiteboard.
* Solid fundamentals in analog and digital circuits, plus enough embedded experience to work with microcontrollers and common communication buses.
* Schematic capture experience in Altium, KiCad (preferred), or a similar tool.
* Comfort on the bench with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and power supplies.
* Some experience working with an external supplier or contractor, even a single one on a single program.
* Ability to work onsite at our Northern Virginia facility.

**We Have a Strong Preference For**

* Hardware that has flown, or a full program cycle in space, aerospace, UAV, or another high-reliability field.
* Exposure to environmental testing: vibration, shock, and thermal vacuum.
* Familiarity with circuit design in LTspice or related simulation platforms such as SIMetrix/SIMPLIS, PLECS, or Qspice
* Power electronics or battery system experience.
* Wire harness design and fabrication.
* Range across mechanical, electrical, and embedded work.

The salary band for this position is $110,000 - $150,000 commensurate with experience. Individuals with demonstrated exceptional ability may be considered beyond this band.

**Our Benefits**

We take care of our people. In addition to competitive salary and equity, Overview Energy offers comprehensive medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, a health and wellness stipend, 4 weeks paid time off, 2 weeks sick leave, parental leave, and 401(k) matching. Benefits are subject to change at the Company's discretion.

**ITAR Requirements**

This position is subject to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Candidates must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Overview Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are based on merit, competence, and qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, ethnicity, veteran status, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, or any other legally protected status.

If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please contact us at talent@overviewenergy.com.

Research shows that women and individuals from underrepresented groups often only apply for roles where they meet every listed qualification. If you believe you can succeed in this role, we encourage you to apply - even if you don't check every box.
