AGE Solutions is a premier technology and professional services company, providing in-depth consulting, advanced technology solutions, and essential services throughout the U.S. government, defense, and intelligence sectors. Prioritizing innovation and client-focused solutions, we assist major agencies in addressing intricate issues and ensuring a more secure future.

We are seeking a **Systems Engineer** to support a DoD customer with storage and backup requirements across multiple on-premises and cloud environments. The selected candidate will provide engineering and administration support.

**Responsibilities Include:**

* Responsible for effective provisioning, operation, installation/configuration, and maintenance of systems hardware/software/related infrastructure.
* Provides technical support, guidance and hands-on delivery in the planning, implementation, and ongoing operations.
* Participates in technical research and development to enable continuing innovation within the infrastructure.
* Ensured that system hardware, operating systems, software systems, and related procedures adhere to organizational values and regulatory requirements.
* Documents specifications, project plans, configurations, test plans and results.
* Depicts complex ideas, issues, and designs to varied audiences; communicates project objectives, scope and status to project teams.
* Develops, integrates, and oversees storage arrays, fiber switches, backup solutions, and associated components.
* Monitors and reports on existing data restore and disaster recovery capabilities.
* Provides recommendations on process improvement/efficiencies.
* Maintains and oversees data backup solutions to ensure mission objective are met.
* Researches, builds, and implements file sharing technologies to meet customer requirements.
* Troubleshoots and advises on advanced storage issues/deficiencies.
* Performs routine equipment checks and preventative maintenance.
* Performs storage analysis, capacity planning, and performance planning of storage components.
* Authors and reviews operational procedures/documentation in relation to new and existing technologies.
* Authors/documents policies and procedures to support the operational storage environment and participates in the design and ongoing refinement of procedures and policies.
* Prepares reports on storage administration best practices, new technologies, etc., and recommends enhancements and configuration changes to improve and optimize existing storage technologies.

**Required Skills, Qualifications, and Experience:**

* **Experience:**
  + Three (3) years of overall professional experience in the engineering field. This includes evaluating, constructing, and integrating enterprise-level storage and backup software technologies.
  + Two (2) years hands-on experience with enterprise SAN (Storage Area Network) management to include capabilities and technologies such as: Fiber Channel zoning, iSCSI, FCoE (Fiber Channel over Ethernet) unified fabric, HBA/CNA (Host Bus Adapter/Converged Network Adapter), storage controllers, and LUN (Logical Unit Number), RAID (Redundant Array of Independent Disks), and file sharing / NAS (Network Addressable Storage).
  + Hands-on experience with enterprise hierarchical storage system management; operation of enterprise backup/restore services, using software such as Veritas NetBackup, Cohesity Cloud.
  + Two (2) years hands-on experience working with Department of War (DoW) IT systems.
* **Clearance:**
  + Top Secret Clearance or Secret Clearance with favorably adjudicated Tier 5/SSBI investigation.
* **Certifications:**
  + Must have a compliant DoD 8570 IAT II Certification such as: CySA+, GICSP, GSEC, Security+ CE, SSCP, CASP CE, CCNP Security, CISA, CISSP, GCED, or GCIH
  + Must also have one of the following current certifications:
    - AWS CSA Associate
    - AWS CSA Professional
    - GIAC GDSA
    - MC: Azure AA
    - MC: Azure SAE
    - NetApp Certified Data Administrator
    - NetApp Certified hybrid Cloud Implementation Engineer
    - NetApp Certified Hybrid Cloud Architect
    - NetApp Certified Hybrid Cloud Administrator
    - NetApp Certified Implementation Engineer - SAN Specialist, ONTAP
    - NetApp Certified Technology Associate
    - Pure Certified Data Storage Associate
    - Pure Certified FlashArrayTM Implementation Specialist
    - Veritas Certified Specialist – NetBackup
* **Location:**
  + Must reside within commutable distance of either Richmond, VA or Tracy, CA in order to work onsite full time.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certifications from multiple vendors including Pure, NetApp, Microsoft, AWS, and Google Cloud.

**Work Environment and Physical Demand:**

* Must be able to work from a computer for extended hours in an office environment and be able to work from comm closets when/as needed.

The projected salary range for this position is $110,000+ annually. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including years of relevant experience, active security clearance level, certifications, technical skillset, contract requirements, and overall qualifications.

**At AGE Solutions, we reward performance, invest in growth, and share success.** Our benefits support the whole person, professionally, financially, and personally.

* **26 Days Paid Leave:** Includes vacation, sick, personal time, and holidays. You choose how to use it.
* **Performance Bonuses:** Performance bonuses are awarded based on individual contributions and company-wide results, aligning recognition with impact.
* **401(k) with Match:** We match 3% of your contributions with immediate vesting.
* **Financial Protection:** Company-paid life insurance up to $300K and options for additional coverage for you and your dependents.
* **Health Benefits:** Multiple medical plans, dental, vision, FSA and HSA options to fit your needs.
* **Parental Leave:** 15 days of fully paid leave for new parents, because family matters.

jobs.title: Cloud Production Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking an experienced Cloud Production Systems Engineer to join the Data Center Operations team. Our data centers and the cloud infrastructure powering tens of thousands of servers forms the foundation upon which Meta's rapidly scaling services operate. Meta is at the leading edge of the global data center industry in both design and cloud operations. This role requires a forward-thinking systems professional with deep experience leveraging diverse software tools to identify cloud automation solutions for complex operational challenges with our Cloud partnerships (AWS, GCP, CoreWeave, and other NeoCloud). The ideal candidate performs deep data analysis to prioritize server repair automation in a hyperscale cloud environment, drives solutions through code, and collaborates effectively with globally distributed teams through clear written communication.  
  
  

### **Cloud Production Systems Engineer Responsibilities:**

* Identify and root cause systemic issues across the cloud server fleet and drive resolutions to maximize uptime and utilization by leveraging hardware failure data and diagnostic telemetry
* Write, review, and maintain code for diagnostic and cloud automation tooling that supports quality and efficient delivery of production servers at hyperscale
* Own and develop diagnostic tooling requirements that enable frontline operations teams to efficiently manage and repair the cloud server fleet
* Drive the escalation process for Data Center Operations to identify, root cause, and resolve complex cloud tooling and hardware issues affecting fleet health
* Execute operational validation and verification activities for new cloud product integration into the production environment
* Collaborate with cross-functional cloud tooling teams to provide an operations-centric perspective on open issues and contribute to their development roadmaps
* Perform deep data analysis to prioritize cloud automation opportunities for server repair workflows in a large-scale, heterogeneous hardware environment
* Build cross-functional relationships and influence policies and procedures to improve global cloud data center operations consistency and efficiency
* Mentor other engineers on evaluating and resolving cloud fleet issues and defining improvements to tools and operational processes
* Travel up to 25% to support global cloud data center operations and new site deployments

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 7+ years of experience in production systems engineering, infrastructure engineering, or system software development for large-scale cloud environments
* 7+ years of experience with hardware lifecycle management, fleet automation, or cloud data center operations systems spanning compute, storage, or networking infrastructure
* Experience developing systems software or automation tooling in Python, Bash, PHP, C, or C++ for Linux-based production environments at scale
* Experience with the configuration and maintenance of production systems, including web servers, load balancers, relational databases, storage systems, and messaging systems
* Experience communicating technical designs and cloud infrastructure decisions through written documentation and cross-functional stakeholder alignment across engineering and operations teams

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience designing or operating cloud configuration management and infrastructure-as-code systems for large heterogeneous hardware fleets
* Experience with data analysis and visualization tools used to prioritize fleet health initiatives and drive operational decision-making
* Experience supporting global, multi-site data center infrastructure deployments, including hardware qualification and regional rollout coordination
* Familiarity with distributed systems monitoring, alerting, and automated remediation pipelines at hyperscale

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.
  
  
Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations-ext@meta.com.

jobs.description:
**Overview**

APIs are the backbone of our connected digital world. The **API Management and AI Gateway team** is part of the **CoreAI** organization, which offers a comprehensive solution for managing the full API lifecycle—securing, governing, and controlling AI Tools. The platform empowers thousands of developers globally to build and manage Agentic, Web, Mobile, Event-Driven, and IoT applications. It also underpins key Microsoft services like Azure AI Foundry, Consumer Copilot, Logic Apps, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Bing, and more – enabling rich developer and consumer experiences.

Bringing simplicity to customers creates challenging engineering opportunities and we are hiring a **Senior Software Engineer - CoreAI** to tackle these challenges in areas like scalability, high-density, multi-tenancy, high availability, user experience and developer tools.

The rise of generative AI opens new frontiers – join the API Management and AI Gateway team to help shape the future of AI developer and application workloads!

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.

We’re looking for an engineer who is passionate about building new products in an AI-driven world while managing a globally distributed service. The individual stepping into this role delivers high-quality solutions independently and thrives in a collaborative, diverse team. Versatility, quick learning, and adaptability are essential.

In this role, you’ll design and deliver the next generation of services, features, and developer tools that shape how AI applications are built and operated. You’ll work across open-source and platform components in multiple programming languages. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to large-scale distributed systems and drive initiatives central to Microsoft’s Core AI strategy!

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead System Design & Architecture: Drive architecture discussions, author design documents, and ensure systems meet security, compliance, and scalability requirements while balancing long-term sustainability with short-term delivery.
* Deliver High-Quality Code: Write extensible, maintainable, and performant code; debug and optimize complex systems; and uphold engineering standards through rigorous code reviews.
* Drive Implementation & Deployment: Lead project planning and experimentation, validate the impact of changes, and ensure safe, reliable deployments across distributed environments.
* Ensure Reliability & Operational Excellence: Maintain live site health, develop incident response playbooks, lead root cause analyses (RCAs), and implement systemic improvements to reduce incident volume and improve SLAs.
* Advance Engineering Tools & Practices: Identify and build developer tools, apply automation in production workflows, and stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends.
* Shape Product Strategy: Influence the product roadmap by aligning technical direction with business goals, leveraging customer feedback, data insights, and competitive analysis.
* Foster Cross-Team Alignment: Collaborate with partner teams to deliver cohesive end-to-end experiences and ensure shared ownership of technical direction.
* Build Core Capabilities: Design and develop foundational platform components and reusable building blocks that accelerate innovation and team velocity.
* Other: Embody our culture and values

  
**Qualifications**

**Required/Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 4+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
  + OR equivalent experience.

**Other Requirements:**

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

**Preferred/Additional Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python.

* Hands-on experience developing in AI-enhanced environments using tools like GitHub Copilot or similar.

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. As a part of the Google Beam team, you'll work with incredible teammates across all major functions in a fast-paced product-oriented environment. Your contributions will have an impact on the future of communications with Google products. You will apply technology to solve that really important problem that we often want to be together and we can’t.

jobs.title: Senior Manufacturing And Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.  
  
Amazon LEO is seeking a Senior Manufacturing And Automation Engineer to develop, automate, and scale manufacturing processes for complex aerospace hardware, including PCBAs, battery packs, LRUs, and associated components. This role is responsible for transforming prototype and manual manufacturing processes into scalable, reliable, and efficient production solutions. The successful candidate will lead manufacturing process development, automation equipment integration, process optimization, and production readiness, ensuring manufacturing systems meet quality, throughput, safety, and cost objectives.  
The ideal candidate combines strong manufacturing process engineering expertise with hands-on experience in industrial automation, equipment design, robotics, and production system integration.  
  
Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Manufacturing Process Development: Develop, optimize, and industrialize manufacturing processes for PCBA, battery pack, LRU, and component assembly, improving efficiency, repeatability, quality, and scalability.  
  
Manufacturing Automation: Design, develop, and implement automated and semi-automated production systems incorporating robotics, PLCs, motion control, machine vision, sensors, and industrial controls.  
  
Equipment and Tooling Development: Define requirements and lead the design, fabrication, integration, and commissioning of manufacturing equipment, fixtures, tooling, and automated assembly stations.  
Process Capability and Optimization: Establish manufacturing process parameters, implement process controls, and apply PFMEA, DOE, SPC, and capability analysis to improve yield, reduce variation, and eliminate defects.  
  
Production Scalability: Develop manufacturing strategies and automation solutions to increase production capacity, reduce cycle time, minimize manual operations, and support production ramp-up.  
Equipment Integration and Qualification: Lead equipment acceptance, commissioning, process validation, and production release, ensuring manufacturing systems meet performance, safety, and reliability requirements.  
  
Manufacturing Troubleshooting: Lead root cause investigations of manufacturing defects, equipment failures, and process inefficiencies, implementing sustainable corrective actions.  
  
Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with Design Engineering, Manufacturing Operations, Quality, Test Engineering, and suppliers to improve manufacturability, implement process automation, and transition products into production.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience in developing functional specifications, design verification plans and functional test procedures
* Bachelor's degree or above in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering, or related STEM field
* 5+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, process development, industrial automation, or production equipment development.
* Experience developing and implementing manufacturing processes, automated equipment, or assembly systems.
* Hands-on experience with industrial automation technologies such as PLCs, robotics, sensors, motion control, or machine vision.
* Experience with manufacturing process troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or equivalent
* Experience working with interdisciplinary teams to execute product design from concept to production
* Experience with the project management of technical projects

Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. jobs.title: Electrical Hardware Design Engineer 4
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**The Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) has an outstanding opportunity for an Electrical Hardware Design Engineer 4 to join the Ocean Engineering Department (OED).**

**About this Opportunity:**

Reporting to the Ocean Engineering Department Head, the Electrical Hardware Design Engineer 4 will be an integral member of the Ocean Engineering Department that supports Principal Investigators (PIs) by creating specialized electrical systems used to observe the natural and physical world. The incumbent will design, build, test, document, and deploy electrical solutions for oceanographic, ocean acoustic, marine renewable energy, autonomous vehicle, and marine robotic systems and instruments.

The incumbent serves as a lead electrical hardware engineer responsible for the full lifecycle development of sophisticated research instrumentation and electrical systems, from concept development and requirements definition through design, integration, testing, deployment, and long-term operational support. Working under broad objectives and expected outcomes, the incumbent independently plans and executes complex engineering assignments for projects ranging from moderate to large scale, often involving unique technical requirements and environments where standard solutions are not available. The position routinely manages multiple concurrent projects with competing priorities and timelines, applying advanced engineering judgment to evaluate alternatives, anticipate technical risks, and develop innovative solutions to challenging research and operational problems. While collaborating closely with Principal Investigators, the Department Head, and multidisciplinary teams of software, mechanical, and field engineers, the incumbent is expected to operate with independence in defining technical approaches, making engineering decisions, and ensuring successful project execution. The position requires proactively translating scientific objectives into engineering requirements, identifying and resolving complex technical issues, adapting to evolving project needs, and delivering reliable systems that directly support critical research activities and field operations.

**Key Responsibilities:**

The successful candidate will independently lead and execute all phases of electrical hardware engineering for advanced research and development projects, from concept development and requirements definition through design, integration, testing, deployment, and lifecycle support. The position supports a diverse portfolio of oceanographic, marine robotics, marine renewable energy, and acoustic instrumentation projects, requiring the application of advanced engineering principles to solve complex technical challenges in demanding operational environments. Assignments may range from the development of specialized electronic subsystems and custom circuit boards to the architecture and implementation of sophisticated autonomous and distributed marine systems.

Core responsibilities include the ability to:

Design, Build, and Test Electrical Hardware (90% FTE):

* Approaches novel assignments and applies sophisticated research techniques, networks, and resources, and moves the project forward from inception to execution.

* Works on complex research endeavors that result in the creation of new concepts, applications, designs, or new areas of research.

* Gathers electrical system requirements from Principal Investigators.

* Designs and proposes system architectural designs to Principal Investigators.

* Establishes design approaches that balance performance, reliability, schedule, and cost

* Designs circuit schematics and PCB layouts using Altium software.

* Designs for requirements involving data acquisition from scientific sensors, power management for low-power systems, hardware/software interfaces, and reliability.

* Specifies and procures electrical components.

* Works alongside APL technicians and external vendors for the fabrication, assembly, and bench testing of electrical components parts.

* Hand-solders, debugs, and integrates PCB’s and electrical systems.

* Designs, documents, and builds custom electrical harnesses.

* Diagnoses, documents, and resolves electronic hardware problems.

* Presents technical approaches, design reviews, and project status to team members, Principal Investigators, and Department Heads.

* Adheres to APL Ocean Engineering documentation standards.

Deploy, Operate and Maintain Electrical Hardware Systems (10% FTE):

* Plans and supports the at-sea installation, operation, and maintenance of systems.

* Troubleshoots and proposes solutions to real-time problems at sea under significant time constraints and resource limitations.

**Overview**

Microsoft is the world’s center of expertise on topological quantum computing. We are building a scaled, fault‑tolerant quantum computer grounded in topological qubits and integrated end‑to‑end with the Azure Quantum software stack.

As a **Senior Quantum Systems Electrical Engineer**, you’ll collaborate closely with quantum physicists, systems software, RF/EE, and manufacturing/production to help define, design, and deliver FPGA‑based, ultra‑low‑latency digital subsystems that sit at the heart of our topological quantum engine—spanning readout classification, error‑decoder acceleration, room‑temperature front‑ends for cryogenic control, high‑speed interconnects, and precision clocking networks. Your work will directly impact logical‑qubit stability, throughput, and system scale.

At Microsoft Quantum, we aim to empower science and scientists to solve the world’s biggest problems by realizing advanced computing platforms at the intersection of high-performance computing, artificial intelligence, and quantum information technology. Microsoft Quantum will change the world of computing and help solve some of humankind’s currently unsolvable problems. **About Helion**

We are a fusion power company based in Everett, WA, with the mission to build the world's first fusion power plant, enabling a future with unlimited clean electricity. Our vision is a world with clean, reliable, and affordable energy for everyone.  
  
Since Helion's founding in 2013, we have raised $1.5 billion from long-time investors such as Sam Altman, Mithril, and Capricorn Investment Group as well as new investors including Thrive Capital, LightSpeed Venture Capital, SoftBank, and others to propel us forward. Our current prototype, Polaris, has reached record-breaking plasma temperatures of 150 million degrees Celsius (13 keV). Helion is continuing to iterate and on the path to the world's first fusion power plant, Orion.  
  
This is a pivotal time to join Helion. You will tackle real-world challenges with a team that prizes urgency, rigor, ownership, and a commitment to delivering hard truths – values essential to achieving what no one has before. Together, we will change the future of energy, because the world can't wait.

**What You Will Be Doing:**

You will drive the design and development of cutting-edge semiconductors for high-performance pulsed power systems used in Helion’s fusion generators. You will work in a fast-paced environment to develop, test, and implement high-reliability, high-efficiency switching components, with a strong emphasis on rapid development cycles. You will report directly to our Senior Manager of Electrical Engineering, and this is an onsite role located at our Everett, WA office.

**You Will:**

* Spearhead efforts to gather and utilize requirements for switching components and apply them toward design of physical products
* Drive the design and development of novel pulsed power electronics components and systems, focusing on high-efficiency, high-reliability semiconductor solutions
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure integration of electrical, mechanical, and physics-based principles in semiconductor development
* Lead development cycles, including hands-on prototyping, small-scale testing, and large-scale performance validation
* Conduct simulations, testing, and analysis to validate designs and iterate quickly using data-backed decision making
* Stay informed on emerging semiconductor materials, device architectures, and industry trends

**Required Skills:**

* Bachelor’s, Master’s, or higher degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related field
* 8+ years of experience in power electronics and high voltage semiconductor design
* Strong foundation in semiconductor physics, power electronics, and circuit design principles

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - MDASH
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Security represents the most critical priorities for our customers in a world awash in digital threats, regulatory scrutiny, and estate complexity. Microsoft Security aspires to make the world a safer place for all. We want to reshape security and empower every user, customer, and developer with a security cloud that protects them with end to end, simplified solutions. The Microsoft Security organization accelerates Microsoft’s mission and bold ambitions to ensure that our company and industry is securing digital technology platforms, devices, and clouds in our customers’ heterogeneous environments, as well as ensuring the security of our own internal estate.

The **MDASH team** is reimagining how organizations identify and remediate vulnerabilities in source code. Using AI agents and models, MDASH analyzes code to determine whether potential vulnerabilities are real and reachable, provides developers with actionable fixes, and helps verify that vulnerabilities have been successfully addressed.

We’re looking for a **Senior Software Engineer** to help build and evolve the MDASH scanning engine as we work to advance agentic code scanning. In this role, you’ll design and build systems that coordinate AI agents and models to analyze complex codebases, scale across programming languages and frameworks, validate security findings, generate high-quality fixes, and deliver reliable, efficient performance in production environments.

You’ll work closely with security researchers, applied scientists, model teams, and product managers to turn new techniques and evaluation insights into product capabilities. We’re looking for an engineer with experience building complex, large-scale systems, foundational knowledge of application security, and excitement about using AI to solve challenging problems in software security.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Design, build, and evolve the MDASH scanning engine, including agent orchestration, multi-model routing, code understanding, vulnerability detection, reachability validation, and fix generation and verification.
* Extend the engine's coverage across vulnerability classes, programming languages, frameworks, build systems, and codebase sizes, from single services to large monorepos.
* Integrate program analysis techniques into agent workflows to make detections more precise and grounded. These include static and dynamic analysis, taint tracking, call-graph and data-flow analysis, fuzzing, and sandboxed execution.
* Improve the engine's precision, recall, consistency, and fix quality, working from evaluation results, research findings, and production feedback.
* Optimize scan performance, scalability, cost, and latency so MDASH works well on enterprise-scale codebases and in CI/CD workflows.
* Build a secure, reliable, observable engine, with strong isolation for running untrusted code and clear telemetry for diagnosing agent behavior.
* Work with security research, applied science, model, and product teams to bring new techniques and models into the engine quickly and safely.
* Track the agentic security and code-scanning landscape, and bring forward ideas that make MDASH stand out against competitors.
* Write high-quality, well-tested code. Lead design reviews, take part in code reviews and on-call rotations, and help raise the engineering bar for the team.
* Mentor other engineers and model Microsoft values to help build an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 4+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python
  + OR equivalent experience.

**Other Requirements**: Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* **Microsoft Cloud Background Check:** This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python
  + OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python
  + OR equivalent experience.
* Experience building production systems with large language models, such as AI agents, multi-agent orchestration, tool calling, planning, context management, or code-understanding systems.
* Experience building or working on security scanners, static analysis (SAST), dynamic analysis (DAST), software composition analysis (SCA), compilers, or other program analysis tools.
* Working knowledge of vulnerability classes such as memory safety, injection, authentication and authorization, deserialization, path traversal, SSRF, and business-logic flaws.
* Experience with program analysis techniques such as taint analysis, data-flow and control-flow analysis, code property graphs, fuzzing, or symbolic execution.
* Experience building distributed, high-scale cloud services on Azure, including containerized or sandboxed execution.
* Familiarity with multiple software ecosystems and build systems across C/C

jobs.title: Senior Security Software Engineer EDR
jobs.description:
The Detection team within Apple Services Engineering (ASE) is responsible for finding any threat actors attacking approximately three quarters of Apple's systems and services. We do this by partnering closely with engineering teams to build a deep technical understanding of how their systems work, and a comprehensive understanding of the threats against them.  
  
A growing part of that mission is the endpoint detection and response (EDR) technology we build ourselves. It is a Swift-based agent that runs on Linux (x86 and ARM64) and on Apple operating systems running on Apple silicon. It collects security telemetry, evaluates detections directly on the host, and takes response action on the host. It also supports Apple's Private Cloud Compute (PCC), the system that extends the privacy and security of Apple devices into the cloud and runs the larger models behind Apple Intelligence. Most of your work will be on Apple's own internal servers, and some of it supports public-facing products used by hundreds of millions of people.  
  
**Description**  
  
We are looking for an exceptional engineer to help us grow this agent to protect a very large fleet, and to do it without ever taking production down. You will bring two things at once: the engineering depth to ship new capabilities quickly, and a reliability mindset that treats every release as something that runs on production hosts. You will take vague, high-stakes problems and turn them into working software, working with other teams to find out what to build and how. This is not a role where you will be handed pre-defined tickets.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  
Experience building or operating endpoint, host or agent software deployed at large scale, with performance and availability objectives.  
  
Experience with eBPF, EndpointSecurity or similar OS-level instrumentation, and an understanding of how those mechanisms can be evaded or disabled.  
  
Experience with Swift on server, concurrency in Swift, and cross-platform builds.  
  
Understanding of EDR or host-based detection techniques and the current industry state of the art.  
  
Experience with policy-driven detection logic (for example OPA/Rego), and with statistical techniques such as probabilistic data structures for bounded-memory anomaly detection.  
  
Experience with virtualization and hypervisor environments.  
  
Experience building CI/CD and release tooling for software deployed to hosts, including staged rollout and rollback.  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
  
7+ years of professional experience building, shipping and supporting production software or system software.  
  
Personal proficiency, in at least one high-level or scripting language (Python or Rust) and at least one low-level systems language (C or C++).  
  
Solid knowledge of operating system internals (processes, threads, memory, system calls, namespaces). Linux, macOS or both.  
  
Credible understanding of attacker behavior and security concepts, and of how malicious activity shows up in host telemetry such as process, network and file events.  
  
**Pay & Benefits**  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $175,000 and $308,500, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  
  
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses - including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  
  
Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

**Job Posting End Date**

10-30-2026

Please note the job posting will close on the day before the posting end date.

**Job Summary**

The Electrical Engineer will support gas, coal, renewable, and new-generation self-build projects by defining electrical design-basis requirements and supporting the technical specification, engineering, procurement, integration, and commissioning of power generation electrical systems. A required focus of this role is advanced knowledge of utility-scale power plant electrical systems and equipment, including generators, generator step-up transformers (GSUs), medium- and low-voltage distribution systems, switchgear, motor control centers (MCCs), protective relaying, grounding systems, black-start systems, auxiliary power systems, and grid interconnection requirements.  
This role collaborates with Architect & Engineering (A/E) and Engineering, Procurement & Construction (EPC) firms and coordinates with internal and external stakeholders to ensure electrical designs meet performance, reliability, maintainability, constructability, safety, cybersecurity, and regulatory requirements. The engineer will participate in RFx/OEM engagements, support self-build proposals, and provide construction, commissioning, startup, and lifecycle support across the generation portfolio.

**Job Description**

**What you’ll do:**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support development of electrical design-basis and equipment requirements (generators, transformers, switchgear, station service, UPS/DC, cabling).
* Assist with power system studies and data preparation (load flow, short‑circuit, protection coordination, arc‑flash, harmonics) under senior review.
* Review vendor drawings, technical bids, and RFx deliverables and prepare comments for senior engineers.
* Help prepare technical and procurement specifications and scope documents for proposals.
* Support OEM interfacing during procurement: submittal review, factory/field testing coordination, and lead‑time tracking.
* Provide construction and commissioning support: site inspections, cable/power testing, relay settings assistance, witness testing, and punch‑list follow‑up.
* Assist with protection relay settings, grounding design, cable routing, and MV/HV equipment testing.
* Ensure designs comply with relevant codes and standards (IEEE, NEC/NFPA70, ANSI, IEC) and assist with reliability/obsolescence tasks.
* Coordinate with mechanical, I&C, civil, and operations teams to resolve integration and SCADA/DCS interface items.
* Contribute to O&M documentation, spares lists, and lifecycle cost input.

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Understanding of protection relays, CT/VT selection, relay coordination fundamentals.
* Basic skills in grounding, cable sizing, testing, and MV/HV equipment installation practices.
* Ability to interpret single‑line diagrams, schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical reports.

**Working Conditions**

* Mandatory safety gear required at generating stations: hard hat, eye/hearing protection, steel-toed shoes with heels and non-slip soles.

* Familiarity with power system study tools and analysis methods.
* Experience reviewing vendor drawings and RFx responses.

Job Description
  
  
**Job Title:** AI/ML Software Engineer, Fairbanks Morse Technology
  
  
**Reports To:** Electrical and Controls Engineering Manager
  
  
**Location:** Beloit, WI (full-time, on-site)
  
  
Summary
  
Fairbanks Morse Technology’s goal is to create secure, mission-driven, advanced, and reliable technology solutions through artificial intelligence, digital technology, smart engineering solutions, automation, and Advanced IoT Solutions.
  
  
FMT is looking for an AI/ML Software Engineer to design and build complete software products from customer requirements. This is a developer role for someone who can gather and write down what the customer needs, then build the full application that meets it, and who designs it so it can be reused and expanded to other equipment, customers, and use cases.
  
  
This rolls will focus is applying AI/ML to predictive maintenance, root cause analysis, and driving action to fix the problem automatically, starting with U.S. Navy shipboard equipment. We are looking for someone who uses AI development tools safely and effectively to deliver working products quickly.
  
  
Principal Duties and Responsibilities
  

* Work with customers and stakeholders to gather requirements, document them clearly, and turn them into a technical plan.
* Design and build full applications (backend, APIs, data pipelines, and user interface) that meet those requirements.
* Architect products to be modular and reusable so they can expand to other assets, customers, and situations without a rewrite.
* Develop and deploy AI/ML solutions for predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, and root cause analysis.
* Connect detection and diagnosis to action by building workflows that recommend or trigger the fix, such as guided maintenance, work orders, or automated responses.
* Use AI coding assistants and tools to build and iterate quickly, while reviewing, testing, and securing all AI-generated work.
* Integrate with sensors, controllers, historians, and customer or third-party systems, including in disconnected edge environments.
* Write tests and documentation, use CI/CD, and build with security and compliance requirements (STIG, NIST, RMF) from the start.
* Demonstrate work to customers and stakeholders and keep them informed of progress and risks.
* Any other duties as the job requires.

Qualifications and Educational Requirements
  
Required
  

* BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of professional software development experience, including full-stack or full-application delivery from requirements through deployment.
* Proven ability to take an unclear customer need, define the requirements, and deliver a working, tested product.
* Strong Python and at least one other language such as C#, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, or C++.
* Experience building REST APIs, data pipelines, databases, and web user interfaces.
* Hands-on experience applying machine learning in production, such as anomaly detection, classification, or time-series analysis, using tools like PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn.
* Experience using AI coding tools to speed up development, with sound judgment on testing, code review, and protecting sensitive data.
* Experience with Git, CI/CD, Docker, and a major cloud platform (Azure preferred).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical trade-offs to customers and leadership.
* Ability to work independently and quickly in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.
* This position requires access or potential access to Unclassified Naval Nuclear Propulsion Information, which is Not Releasable to Foreign Nationals (NOFORN) data. Therefore, to meet NOFORN requirement, you will have to provide proof of US Citizenship and attest that you do not have dual citizenship. Acceptable proof of US Citizenship is a US Passport, US Birth Certificate or Naturalization Certificate.

Preferred
  

* Experience with predictive maintenance, condition-based maintenance (CBM+), or prognostics and health management.
* Experience with large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, or agentic workflows.
* Experience with industrial data sources and protocols such as PLCs, OPC UA, Modbus, or MQTT.
* Experience supporting U.S. Navy or Department of Defense programs, including Azure Government Cloud and RMF, STIG, and NIST requirements.
* Edge or embedded deployment experience on disconnected hardware.
* Cross-platform mobile development experience (for example .NET MAUI).

for a high-growth technology company in New York

Expect to work on services that handle heavy event traffic, connect to several external exchanges, and run on top of on-chain execution environments. You will work side by side with blockchain and product engineers to make trading fast and dependable, especially when markets are moving quickly.

What This Will Involve:

Risk and collateral management

Blockchain-backed state

Consistency across distributed components

Live data handling

Streaming and storage

Venue connectivity

Client-facing APIs

Reliability and tooling
: Profile and tune async Rust code, containerize services, and set up monitoring that supports zero-downtime deployments.

What You Bring:

Rust depth
: 2-5 years experience as a backend software engineer with in-depth Rust experience.
Systems fundamentals
: Working knowledge of databases, networking, and concurrency, with a habit of weighing performance trade-offs explicitly.
Async runtime experience
: Hands-on work with Tokio or an equivalent, with judgment about when message passing is safer than shared locks.
Data store experience

Interface design
: Experience building REST or gRPC APIs that are type-safe, clear in their errors, and easy to observe.
Evidence-driven approach

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Storage - Distributed Caching
jobs.description:
About The Team

The Storage organization builds and operates the online stateful systems and abstractions that DoorDash Engineering depends on: reliable, efficient, secure, and easy to use. Within Storage, the Distributed Caching team owns every caching offering at DoorDash end to end, including ElastiCache (Redis/Valkey), Boulder (our KVRocks-based key-value store for high-QPS feature serving), Entity Cache (read Bill Shen’s engineering blog post, “High-Performance Proxy Cache for DoorDash Services”), and the Distributed Lock Service, plus the smart clients (asgard-redis, valkey-go) that sit in front of them. These systems back critical product surfaces across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo: the team runs roughly 400 ElastiCache clusters serving hundreds of millions of GET requests per second in aggregate, and Boulder, our offline-to-online feature store, serves billions of feature lookups per second at peak.

About The Role

The team owns provisioning of clusters and the smart clients that sit in front of them, baking in sensible defaults so that other engineering teams get a turnkey caching solution instead of having to run their own. You'll help drive Boulder's evolution to scale further, improve cost efficiency, enhance performance, and support real-time updates; re-platform the Distributed Lock Service onto a strongly consistent backend; and build the self-serve tooling and recommendation engine that let customers describe a workload (QPS, TTL, payload size, latency profile) and get the right backend without talking to a human.

You'll go deep on cache invalidation, replication, sharding, compaction, and failover, while shipping the guardrails, automation, and observability that keep this scale operable by a small team.

You must be located in San Francisco, Seattle, or the New York Metro Area for this hybrid position. You will report to the Engineering Manager on the Distributed Caching team within the Storage organization.

You’re Excited About This Opportunity Because You Will…

Own high-leverage caching and locking services with direct, measurable customer impact: cost, latency, and reliability at multi million QPS scale.
Build and scale Boulder, our KVRocks backed key-value store, including compaction, sharding, and domain isolation.
Re-platform the Distributed Lock Service onto a strongly consistent backend with sharding
Contribute to the standardized smart caching client that bakes in failover, retry, and observability defaults so customers don't have to think about them.
Diagnose and resolve production issues that span cache invalidation storms, replication lag, hot shards, and noisy-neighbor contention, then turn each one into a durable guardrail rather than a one-off fix.
Collaborate closely with the teams that build on top of caching, including Taulu, ML Platform, and product engineering across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo.

We’re Excited About You Because…

You have 6+ years of full-time experience designing, building, and operating distributed, stateful systems in production, at least 2 of which involved caching or key-value storage at meaningful scale.
You are proficient in Go, or Java/Kotlin with deep expertise in concurrency, distributed systems, and production-grade backend services.
You have hands-on experience with distributed caching technologies (Redis/Valkey, Memcached, or similar) and understand their failure modes: replication lag, failover, hot keys, and cache invalidation.
You understand distributed systems fundamentals: consistency models, sharding and partitioning, replication, and consensus, and can reason about their trade-offs from first principles.
You have built or operated systems that require careful capacity planning and cost discipline at scale, and you default to right-sizing over over-provisioning.
You thrive in an execution-driven environment with a broad ownership area and a proven track record of shipping reliable infrastructure end to end.
You have proficiency in using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) in the full software development lifecycle, including designing, generating code, testing, monitoring, and releasing software.

Preferred

Hands-on experience with ElastiCache, Memcached, or Valkey in production.
Experience with KVRocks or RocksDB-family embedded storage engines (TiKV or similar), including compaction tuning and back-pressure handling.
Experience building or operating a distributed lock service.
Experience with Kubernetes and general cloud infrastructure operations.
Contributions to open-source caching, storage, or distributed systems projects.

jobs.title: Hardware Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

Constellation is creating the AI-human translation layer that ensures humanity evolves alongside our technology. Our mission is to leverage AI towards addressing deep and meaningful problems at the core of the human experience: empowering people towards their goals, augmenting our cognition and emotional wellness, and understanding ourselves and each other. Our path forward is to move away from AI that captures human knowledge towards AI that truly understands what it is to be human. We are generating the richest multimodal dataset ever collected to build a new class of foundation models and we're seeking the founding team of engineers to build the infrastructure that makes this ambitious future a reality.

**The Role**
------------

We are looking for a Hardware Engineer to own the hardware behind our data collection. Our multimodal collection rigs combine biosensors with video and audio capture, and every stream has to stay synchronized and running, session after session. Your job is to keep that growing fleet of rigs synchronized, healthy, and repeatable, and to build the custom hardware and firmware that make it work better.

This is a generalist role on a small founding team, spanning analog electronics, embedded firmware, and the software glue between devices and our data pipeline. It's research hardware, not volume manufacturing: we move quickly to answer questions, then make what works reliable enough to run every day. You'll work closely with our data collection team, software engineers, neuroscientists, and researchers.

We're hiring at multiple levels and will set title and scope to your experience.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Keep our fleet of collection rigs synchronized and healthy: integrate and maintain off-the-shelf devices, such as biosensors, cameras, and audio equipment, and diagnose failures quickly.
* Own time synchronization across every device and data stream.
* Build reliable, documented rigs, test fixtures, and automated validation that let researchers focus on the science.
* Design and bring up custom boards and sensor integrations where you determine off-the-shelf equipment falls short, from schematic and PCB layout through assembly and testing.
* Write and debug C/C++ firmware for microcontrollers and Python tooling for device control, signal-quality checks, and data validation; work with the Linux drivers on our capture machines.
* Partner with our software team on the interface between devices and our data ingestion infrastructure.
* Handle light mechanical work: enclosures, connectors, mounts, and 3D-printed parts that keep hardware durable and comfortable for participants.
* Decide what to build in-house versus contract out, and manage vendors and contractors when we do.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 3+ years of experience designing and bringing up electronic hardware, with significant hands-on work in both board design and embedded firmware.
* A track record of building physical things that worked in real use: instruments, devices, or research rigs.
* Able to work independently, make sound technical calls, and explain trade-offs clearly to non-hardware teammates.
* Hands-on experience with biosignals (e.g., EEG, ECG, EMG) or other low-noise measurements, including electrode contact, noise sources, grounding, and shielding.
* Schematic capture and PCB layout in Altium or KiCad, including mixed-signal boards.
* Strong C/C++ skills for writing microcontroller firmware (e.g., on ARM Cortex-M, ideally with an RTOS such as Zephyr or FreeRTOS). Comfortable going below the application layer on Linux to debug device drivers, USB and serial issues, and kernel behavior when hardware misbehaves.
* Python for test scripts, device control, and data analysis.
* Hands-on experience synchronizing data across multiple devices (hardware triggers, shared clocks, timestamping).
* Comfortable at the bench with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and JTAG/SWD debuggers.
* Demonstrably adaptable and excited about finding creative solutions to problems nobody has solved before.
* Passionate about positively impacting the well-being of humanity and not just capitalizing on it.
* You thrive in a high-bandwidth, collaborative environment.

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience writing Linux kernel modules or device drivers.
* FPGA or HDL experience (e.g., Verilog, VHDL).
* Prior work with research-grade sensing equipment, such as eye trackers or EEG systems, and with synchronization tools such as Lab Streaming Layer (LSL).
* Familiarity with other physiological sensing, such as fNIRS, EDA, or PPG.
* Medical electrical isolation and safety for equipment used with human participants (e.g., IEC 60601).
* A background in designing wearable, battery-powered, or Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices.
* Basic mechanical CAD and 3D printing.
* Interest in neurotech, mental health, or human-AI interaction.

**Benefits**
------------

* Comprehensive, high-quality health, dental, and vision insurance with premiums fully covered.
* A renovated, light-filled office with a quirky layout in the heart of San Francisco's Mission District, surrounded by world-class food and coffee.
* Relocation assistance for those joining us in SF and workspace setup stipend.
* Monthly team dinners and outings, plus twice-yearly off-sites and retreats.
* Fully stocked kitchen (snacks!)
* Sponsorship for travel to relevant conferences and regular professional development activities to help you level up.
* A minimum of 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave with a “soft-landing” transition back.
* Paid time off (PTO)

Compensation Range: $180K - $260K

* Deep experience with embedded Linux systems, kernel configuration, and bootloaders.
* Strong understanding of RTOS and real-time constraints.
* Experience interpreting schematics and hardware documentation for driver development.
* Proficient in networking and communications protocols with secure communication standards.
* Familiarity with cryptographic principles and embedded security applications.
* Experience in software integration, debugging, and system-level validation.
* Familiarity with parallel-processing frameworks such as OpenCL or CUDA is a plus.
* Excellent problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.
* Proven mentoring and collaborative skills.
* Active U.S. Security Clearance required.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:**  
The starting base salary for this position ranges from **$170,000 to $215,000 per year**, depending on the candidate’s job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to a competitive base salary, Innoflight offers a well-rounded compensation package that includes a Profit-Sharing Bonus and a Cash Performance Bonus to reward both individual and company performance. Additional benefits include:

**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE:**

At Innoflight

We are looking for a Senior or Principal Software Engineer to contribute to control-plane architecture and hands-on development for Positron AI inference systems. You will write software that connects low-level hardware capabilities to system management, diagnostics, security, and firmware updates. Go is our primary implementation language, with C, C++, Python, Bash, and other languages used where they fit the system boundary.

This role can fit a senior/principal software engineer or systems architect who remains a strong, current coder and wants ownership grounded in production implementation. The scope spans a wide swath of the platform. You will own substantial features end to end, from problem definition and architecture through implementation, integration, testing, and production validation.

jobs.description:

The Windows Engineering System is the backbone that lets Windows engineers design, code, build, validate, and ship at massive scale, securely and with high quality.

Our systems connect source code, dependencies, compilers, security controls, artifacts, diagnostics, and distributed infrastructure across a large and continuously evolving engineering ecosystem.

We partner with Windows product teams and Engineering Systems organizations to make builds faster, more reliable, secure, observable, and easier to use. Our work spans modern services and pipelines as well as mission-critical native tools and long-lived codebases. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Mission Dev - U.S. Government
jobs.description:
About Nominal

Nominal is building the connected test and operations platform powering the world's most advanced hardware systems, from spacecraft and autonomous vehicles to next-generation defense programs. Our platform gives hardware engineering teams a single place to ingest data, analyze performance, automate test execution, and collaborate across every phase of development, so they can move faster without sacrificing safety or precision. We're a fast-moving team that owns problems end-to-end, works across disciplines, and thrives at the intersection of hardware and software.

We serve top-tier commercial and defense customers, from autonomy leaders like Anduril and Shield AI to next-generation aerospace teams like Hermeus and REGENT, and performance engineering teams like Pratt Miller Motorsports, alongside mission partners within the U.S. Navy and U.S. Air Force on programs where failure isn’t an option. We’re backed by Sequoia, General Catalyst, Founders Fund, Lux Capital, and Lightspeed. Our team draws from SpaceX, Palantir, Anduril, Applied Intuition, and other leading companies, united by a common mission: giving hardware engineers the tools to build the future with speed, safety, and confidence.

As a Software Engineer
on the Mission Dev team, you will operate at the intersection of software engineering, customer deployment, and mission-critical government programs. You are not just shipping code — you are embedding with customers, deploying software into high-stakes environments, and owning outcomes from first integration to long-term success. You will bridge Nominal’s platform with real-world government applications across the Department of Defense, Department of Energy, NASA, and other U.S. government agencies.

This is a hybrid of software engineer, forward-deployed engineer, and technical program lead. You will write production-grade code, design integrations, manage deployments on government networks, and serve as a trusted technical advisor to mission operators. If you think like a startup founder, thrive in ambiguity, and want to see your code powering rocket test stands, autonomy labs, and mission-critical defense programs, Nominal is the place to do it.

🚀 About The Role

Mission Dev is one of the most unique roles at Nominal. You'll write production-grade code, embed with government customers on-site, and own the bridge between what our platform offers today and what a government program needs to succeed.

That might mean deploying Nominal onto a classified network for a Navy flight test squadron, building a custom telemetry pipeline for a DoD autonomy program, or standing up integrations at a NASA test facility, then watching an engineer use what you shipped yesterday and iterating on the spot. You'll work inside the constraints that come with federal environments: accreditation processes, air-gapped networks, strict cybersecurity requirements, and government acquisition timelines. The role requires someone who can deliver high-quality software without losing velocity in these environments.

Mission Devs are brought in when there's a specific technical gap to bridge. You might get looped in during pre-sales to integrate a program's data and demonstrate how Nominal fits their mission workflows, or you might be building program-specific tooling mid-deployment that evolves into a permanent product capability. The work you do for one program often becomes a core product used across our entire customer base — our video-alongside-telemetry capability, for example, started as a single customer need and is now a platform-wide feature. The "last 10%" looks different for every mission, and that's what makes the work compelling.

🔍 What We’re Looking For

5+ years of experience in software engineering, forward-deployed engineering, or a technical role that combined building with customer-facing work.
Experience working with or inside U.S. Government agencies, particularly DoD, and with deploying software on U.S. government networks.
Track record of shipping production software in dynamic or ambiguous environments.
Strong systems thinking — you can understand complex technical ecosystems end-to-end.
Clear communicator, comfortable writing technical documentation and presenting to executive stakeholders.
Willingness to travel up to 50%.
Curiosity about hardware systems and willingness to learn the physical domains our customers operate in.
Active TS/SCI clearance or the ability to obtain one is strongly preferred.

🎯 Why Nominal

Mission-critical impact with top-tier government and commercial customers
Backed by world-class investors
Work alongside elite engineers from SpaceX, Palantir, Anduril, and more
Build and deploy real systems powering rockets, aircraft, autonomous systems, and national security infrastructure

At Nominal, your code doesn’t sit in a demo environment — it powers real missions.

✨ Benefits/Perks

🏥 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance
🏖️ Unlimited PTO and sick leave
🍽️ Free lunch, snacks, and coffee
🚀 Professional Development Stipend
🛠️ In-office hardware lab with a $250 project stipend
✈️ Annual company retreat

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C.

1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C.
1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

EOS Defense Systems USA designs and produces highly accurate, cost-effective, modular, and scalable Remote Weapon Systems that give warfighters a decisive edge in counter-UAS and ground-to-ground missions. Trusted across platforms, we're at the forefront of defense innovation.  
  
At EOS our people are our strength. Here, engineers own their work throughout their life cycle. Working side by side with a small, multi-disciplinary team in a safe, collaborative workplace. The pace is fast, the mission is real, and you'll build your skills and grow your career while advancing technology that matters, from advanced effectors to AI. If you want hands-on engineering with real ownership and a direct line to the mission, EOS Defense Systems USA is the place to be.

**Software Engineering Lead (Remote Weapon Systems)**  
  
EOS is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Software Engineer Lead to direct a small, dedicated team of software engineers in the design, development, test, and integration of embedded software solutions of our high-performing, world-leading Remote Weapon Systems (RWS) development programs. The ideal candidate will set the technical direction for the team while cultivating a strong culture of ownership. You will be instrumental in providing senior-level technical leadership, mentoring junior talent, managing daily tasking, and maintaining strict accountability for engineering quality and delivery schedules.  
  
The role oversees cross-platform software for line-replaceable units (LRUs), command-and-control (C2) interfaces, and discrete electrical signals that enable reliable remote operation of our weapon systems. You will collaborate directly with our electrical engineering team, reviewing PCB schematics and component data sheets to ensure hardware aligns with software requirements. This is a critical leadership role that directly impacts our program success and team cohesion.  
  
This is an on-site position located at our facility.

* Technical Leadership & Oversight: Serve as the technical authority for the software engineering team, guiding the design, development, and integration of complex software solutions for RWS's.

* Tasking & Resource Management: Manage, prioritize, and assign engineering tasks across multiple concurrent programs to optimize team bandwidth and satisfy project milestones.
* Culture of Ownership & Accountability: Foster a strong culture of ownership where team members take pride in and maintain full accountability for the quality, reliability, and on-time delivery of their products.
* Schedule & Quality Management: Maintain engineering schedules, conduct rigorous design reviews, and ensure all engineering deliverables meet stringent aerospace/ defense quality standards.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with systems, electrical, and mechanical engineering leads to seamlessly integrate software into weapon platform architectures.
* System Integration & Field Support: Work cross-functionally to integrate software with RWS systems; travel as required to support customer reviews, field integration, and live-fire test operations.

  
**Required Qualifications:**  

* Education: BS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a highly related technical discipline.
* Experience: 8+ years of progressively responsible software engineering experience, with a strong focus on embedded systems.
* Platform & Hardware Expertise: Proven development experience with Microchip microcontrollers/microprocessors, their development ecosystems, and general C/C++ bare-metal and RTOS programming.
* Industry & Security: Demonstrated experience working in a Government Contracting Environment. Must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a Secret-level U.S. security clearance.
* Core Competencies: Exceptional written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills; willingness to travel to customer reviews or test ranges.

  
**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Advanced Degree: Master's degree in a relevant engineering or computer science field.
* Linux Build Systems & Tools: Hands-on experience building custom embedded Linux distributions using the Yocto Project.
* Middleware & Networking: Proficiency with DDS publish/subscribe middleware, TCP/UDP sockets, RS-232, and Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN) protocols.
* Advanced Weapon System Tech: Experience developing Command and Control (C2) software, integrating EO/IR or radar systems, and exposure to EO/IR test and evaluation instruments.

jobs.description:
**About Rivet**  
Rivet is an American company building integrated task systems — fusing hardened hardware with software, sensors, AI, and networking — for industrial workforces and defense personnel. We create capabilities that multiply the effectiveness of every individual and withstand the world’s toughest environments.  
  
We serve the people who build, operate, maintain, and defend our way of life. From technicians and engineers to first responders and service members, they embody the hard work, ingenuity, and meritocratic values that drive Western prosperity. Yet too often they are forced to rely on outdated tools that fail under modern pressures. Rivet exists to reset that priority.  
  
At Rivet, you’ll join a mission-driven team that fuses disciplines to deliver decisive outcomes where they matter most. Whether shaping our technology, strengthening our partnerships, or building our culture, every role here contributes to equipping the front lines with the modern systems they deserve.  
  
**Work Authorization Requirement: Due to the nature of our business and compliance with federal regulations, all candidates must be a "U.S. Person". Upon hire, you will be required to provide documentation verifying your status as a U.S. Citizen, a lawful permanent resident, or a protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).**

**Summary**

Rivet is looking for a hands-on Senior Software Engineer to own perceptual calibration for our next-generation AR wearables and devices running Android and embedded Linux. Accurate camera, IMU, and display calibration is what every tracking and display experience rests on: it keeps tracking stable, overlays registered to the real world, and rendering comfortable. This role spans calibration algorithms, calibration station and process design, and factory deployment, taking calibration from the lab bench to factory production lines. You will work closely with hardware, mechanical, robotics, perception, and manufacturing teams to deliver calibration that is accurate, repeatable, and efficient at production scale.

**Responsibilities**

* Build computer vision and signal processing algorithms that calibrate the geometric intrinsics, extrinsics, and time offsets of cameras, IMUs, and XR displays.
* Develop perceptual calibration processes for Rivet’s range of wearables and devices, covering calibration station design (sensor and target selection, metrology hardware requirements) and controlled data capture conditions.
* Deploy data capture processes and calibration binaries to factory sites, working with contract manufacturers (CMs) through bring-up, ramp, and mass production.
