jobs.description:
Denver, Colorado, US Posted On: 22-Oct-2026

Job Code: 0001128

Department: MANUFACTURING ENGINEERING - OPERATIONS

Salary: $90,000.00 - $160,000.00

**Summary of Position:**

  

The Electrical Engineer designs, analyzes, commissions, and optimizes electrical power systems across Liberty Energy's oilfield and power generation platforms. This role spans low, medium, and high voltage AC and 1000V DC systems, including generation, power distribution, microgrid, and substation applications, supporting both product development and field implementation.

  

Electrical Engineers work cross-functionally with other engineering disciplines, Manufacturing, Reliability, and Operations to deliver safe, robust, and scalable electrical designs for Liberty's field-deployed systems. Candidates typically bring primary depth in power systems design and commissioning and develop broader fluency across Liberty's full equipment and energy platform over time.

  

The ideal candidate thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment with periodic field interaction and demonstrates both technical rigor and practical field judgment. Level placement is determined by demonstrated experience, technical depth, and scope of independent contribution.

  

**Qualifications & Requirements:**

  

The following qualifications apply across all levels. Experience thresholds, certification expectations, and scope of responsibility for each tier are detailed in the Experience Tiers section.

* Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering from an ABET accredited program.

**Demonstrated knowledge in:**

* Protective relay and device selection and instrument transformer (CT/PT) specification
* Low Voltage (LV) AC, Medium Voltage (MV) AC, and 1000V DC power systems design and implementation
* Power system studies (Arc Flash, Grounding, Load Flow, Relay Coordination, and Short Circuit)
* Power Electronics
* National Electrical Code (NEC / NFPA 70)
* Substation design and construction
* Power distribution system design

**Proficiency in:**

* ETAP and/or other electrical modeling software
* AutoCAD and/or other CAD software
* Electrical equipment and cable sizing

**Experience Tiers:**

  

Level placement is determined by demonstrated experience, technical depth, and scope of independent contribution. Each tier builds on the requirements and responsibilities of the tier below.

  

**Electrical Engineer I (0-3 Years)**

*0-3 years of experience in electrical power systems design and electrical commissioning. Foundational knowledge across the technical areas above. Works under the direction of senior engineers.*

* Contributes to the design and implementation of LV, MV, and HV AC and 1000V DC electrical systems under direction.
* Supports electrical commissioning in the shop and the field, including testing and validation.
* Prepares drawings, one-line diagrams, calculations, equipment specifications, and bills of material with senior review.
* Builds foundational knowledge in Liberty's electrical platforms, engineering standards, and the National Electrical Code.
* Escalates technical issues appropriately and incorporates feedback from senior engineers.

**Electrical Engineer II (3-7 Years)**

*3-7 years of progressively responsible experience in electrical power systems design and electrical commissioning. Demonstrated ability to independently execute designs and commissioning in one or more areas.*

* Independently designs and implements LV, MV, and HV AC and 1000V DC electrical systems across assigned platforms.
* Leads electrical commissioning in the shop and the field, including energization, testing, and live troubleshooting.
* Performs power system studies (arc flash, grounding, load flow, relay coordination, and short circuit) and translates results into design and equipment selection decisions.
* Contributes to reusable design templates, equipment specifications, and internal best practices.
* Provides peer review for Electrical Engineer I deliverables and supports onboarding of new team members.

**Electrical Engineer III (7-12 Years)**

*7-12 years leading electrical design and commissioning for oilfield, power generation, or utility systems. Proven track record of technical mentorship, design ownership, and cross-functional delivery. Professional Engineer (PE) license strongly preferred.*

* Leads the design of complex LV, MV, and HV AC and 1000V DC electrical systems, including microgrid and substation scopes.
* Owns end-to-end design and commissioning of complex or multi-system deployments.
* Serves as a quality-control and compliance authority for initial design concepts and final drawing packages.
* Develops, maintains, and improves company electrical standards and equipment specifications.
* Serves as subject matter specialist across internal teams and external partners in one or more electrical domains.
* Mentors Electrical Engineer I and II through technical guidance and design review.

**Indicators & Attributes for Success:**

* Effective and decisive decision-making skills
* Attention to detail and commitment to documentation quality
* Strong problem-solving and systematic debugging ability across hardware, software, and field conditions
* Business acumen and customer/operations focus
* Clear written and verbal communication across technical and non-technical audiences
* Organizational and prioritization skills in a high-tempo, field-driven environment
* Flexibility and willingness to support field teams on short notice
* Accountability, ownership, and ethical practice
* Commitment to safety, continuous improvement, and technical excellence

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Design and implement LV, MV, and HV AC and 1000V DC electrical systems across Liberty's oilfield and power generation platforms, including generation, distribution, microgrid, and substation systems.
* Perform power system studies, including arc flash, grounding, load flow, relay coordination, and short circuit, and translate results

### **About Marcurius Multi-Mission Solutions**

Marcurius Multi-Mission Solutions is a fast-growing Defense technology company headquartered in Clearwater, Florida. Founded by US and UK veterans, Marcurius brings decades of frontline experience across Special Operations and Intelligence missions, with deep expertise in asymmetric warfare and the real-world employment of unmanned systems.

Marcurius is building a new kind of unmanned systems company – multi-domain, multi-platform, and mission-driven. We fuse battle-proven technologies, resilient command-and-control architectures, and operator-led doctrine to deliver capabilities that work in contested environments. Our initial focus is the rapid fielding of advanced Unmanned Surface Vessels (USVs) for modern maritime operations.

We're looking for a motivated, curious, and hands-on **Junior Software Engineer** to join our growing engineering team at Marcurius Multi-Mission Solutions.

In this role, you'll work alongside experienced engineers to develop, integrate, and test software supporting our advanced unmanned and autonomous systems. You'll contribute across a range of technologies, from software development and embedded systems to robotics, autonomy, and hardware integration.

We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys building things, solving technical challenges, and learning new technologies. You don't need to be an expert in every area, but you should have strong programming fundamentals, a practical problem-solving mindset, and the drive to take ownership of your work.

* Strong programming fundamentals with practical experience in **Python or C++**.

* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and willingness to learn new technologies.
* Interest in working across software development, embedded systems, and hardware integration.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Robotics, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.

* Experience with frontend development, databases, Git, or software development tools.

### **Work Environment**

* Onsite engineering and integration environment.
* Direct involvement in prototype development and system testing, including sea trials.
* Fast-paced development cycles with aggressive timelines.
* Close collaboration with multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Marcurius is a people-first, execution-focused organization assembling a high-impact team of Engineers and Operators. We strongly encourage applications from veterans and individuals with experience in maritime, defense, communications, and advanced technology sectors.

Digisat International Inc. is a small business government contractor based in Melbourne, Florida, supporting the Department of Defense as well as commercial customers. We're a close-knit team where engineers see their work through from concept to delivery. We're looking for an RF Systems Engineer to design, integrate, test, and field SATCOM systems for defense and commercial programs in the U.S. and abroad.

**What You'll Do**

* Define SATCOM system architectures and develop system-level requirements
* Perform RF system analysis, including satellite link budgets, noise figure, G/T, EIRP, gain, and cascade analysis
* Select and specify SATCOM components and subsystems such as antennas, BUCs, LNBs, amplifiers, filters, waveguide, and modems
* Integrate, test, and troubleshoot SATCOM terminals and RF hardware in the lab and in the field
* Install and commission SATCOM systems on-site, including antenna pointing, line-up, and coordination with satellite operators
* Use standard RF test equipment, including Keysight FieldFox analyzers, spectrum analyzers, power meters, and signal generators
* Develop test plans and procedures, and document results in clear technical reports
* Support design reviews, customer meetings, and technical proposals
* Work closely with program managers, engineers, and customers to deliver on schedule

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or a related field
* 5+ years of RF systems engineering experience, with a focus on SATCOM
* Strong understanding of RF and microwave theory, satellite communications, and link analysis
* Hands-on experience with RF integration, test, and troubleshooting, including waveguide and coaxial systems
* Proficiency with standard RF test equipment such as FieldFox analyzers, spectrum analyzers, and power meters
* Proficiency with the Microsoft Office suite; familiarity with Microsoft Project is a plus
* Clear written and verbal communication, including technical documentation and customer briefings
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as needed
* Valid U.S. passport, or the ability to obtain one before international travel

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with monopulse tracking downconverters
* Experience with servo control systems and full-motion tracking antennas
* Experience deploying satellite ground stations
* Experience on DoD programs
* Experience with X-, Ku-, or Ka-band systems

**Citizenship Requirement**

U.S. citizenship is required for this position due to government contract requirements.

**Work Arrangement**

We're flexible. On-site, hybrid, or remote are all on the table, with travel to customer sites and field locations as needed. Tell us what works best for you when you apply.

**Physical Requirements**

This role includes lab and field work. With or without reasonable accommodation, the candidate must be able to:

* Lift and carry equipment up to 50 lbs
* Climb ladders and antenna structures, and work at heights
* Work outdoors in varied weather conditions, including heat, cold, and rain
* Stand, kneel, and bend for extended periods during installation and testing
* Work in confined spaces such as equipment shelters and antenna enclosures

**Benefits**

* Paid time off

**Pre-Employment Requirements**

Any job offer is contingent on successfully completing a background check and drug screen. Digisat International Inc. participates in E-Verify.

**How to Apply**

Apply through Indeed with your resume. In a sentence or two, tell us about a SATCOM system or ground station you've designed, tested, or deployed and your role on it.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Digisat International Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Pay: $110,000.00 - $140,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Melbourne, FL 32904

Job Description:

**Our Opportunity**

Chewy is seeking a motivated **Software Engineer I** to join our Supply Chain IT Domain Services team in Plantation, FL or Boston, MA.

This team owns a suite of critical services that support inventory visibility, purchase order and transfer workflows, electronic data exchange, vendor compliance, and operational analytics across Chewy’s supply chain network. These systems span distributed services and data pipelines supporting both real-time and batch processing.

As an early career engineer, you will work with experienced engineers to design, build, test, deploy, and support reliable software. You will take ownership of well-scoped work while developing strong engineering, operational, and business fundamentals.

This is not a purely backend role. You’ll contribute across backend services, APIs, data workflows, and user-facing applications when needed, while learning to deliver complete solutions in a complex, system-heavy environment.

**What You’ll Do**

* Develop and maintain software using Java, Spring Boot, AWS, and related technologies with guidance from experienced engineers
* Deliver results on well-scoped features and technical improvements from implementation through testing, deployment, and production validation
* Build and support APIs, event-driven integrations, data workflows, and, when needed, user-facing applications
* Write clear, maintainable code and participate in code reviews, design discussions, and team engineering standards
* Create automated unit and integration tests and help improve the team’s testing and delivery practices
* Operate in the details by using logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and runbooks to troubleshoot issues and improve reliability and performance
* Participate in production support and on-call responsibilities with documented procedures, mentoring, and team support
* Use approved AI-assisted development tools responsibly to accelerate learning, coding, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting while validating generated output
* Put customers first by partnering with product, program, business, and engineering teams to understand needs and deliver practical supply chain solutions; earn trust by communicating progress, risks, and blockers early
* Apply spec-driven development (SDD) practices, with guidance, to translate requirements and acceptance criteria into reviewed designs, implementation plans, discrete tasks, tests, and delivered code
* Act as an owner for assigned work and contribute to operational excellence by improving documentation, observability, support readiness, and production stability

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Foundational programming experience through professional work, internships, co-op assignments, academic projects, or substantial personal projects
* Working knowledge of Java or another object-oriented programming language and the ability to learn Java and Spring Boot
* Understanding of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, debugging, and software testing fundamentals
* Familiarity with relational databases, SQL, REST APIs, source control, and modern software development practices
* Exposure to cloud-based application development and an interest in building on AWS
* Ability to learn unfamiliar systems, ask effective questions, discuss alternatives openly, apply feedback, and commit to team decisions once aligned
* Exposure to SDD workflows that move from requirements and acceptance criteria through design, tasks, implementation, and validation
* Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across a team
* Accountability for assigned work and willingness to communicate progress, risks, and blockers early
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment while balancing delivery, learning, and quality

**AI and Modern Development Experience**

We are looking for engineers who are interested in applying AI pragmatically in development workflows. This may include:

* Using approved AI-assisted tools such as Cursor, Codex, or Copilot to improve development efficiency
* Validating AI-generated code, tests, and documentation before use
* Using reviewed specifications as the source of truth for AI-assisted planning and implementation, then validating the result against requirements, acceptance criteria, and tests
* Recognizing when human review, security controls, and engineering judgment are required

**Bonus**

* Internship, co-op, or project experience developing cloud-based applications with AWS
* Exposure to Spring Boot, microservices, event-driven systems, data pipelines, or full-stack development using React or Vue
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, containers, observability tools, or agile delivery practices
* Interest in supply chain, logistics, inventory systems, e-commerce, or high-volume operational systems

In addition, this position is eligible for 401k and a new hire and annual equity grant. C08+ positions may also be eligible for annual bonus.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
AutoStore™ holds a simple yet powerful vision: to store and move things for everyone, everywhere. Founded in Norway, we've grown into a global technology company. AutoStore uses advanced software to automate and orchestrate order fulfillment. Our goal is to ensure orders arrive faster than ever, with minimal environmental impact. That's how we help brands exceed customer expectations.

  

We have more than 1600 systems in nearly 60 countries, and we grow continuously as a community of employees, partners, customers, suppliers, and connected technologies. Automation should make life easier, and by listening carefully to our community, we innovate to meet the industry's most complex needs. With AutoStore™, brands gain speed, efficiency, and improved workplaces. And much more floor space.

  

AutoStore – moving things forward.

  
  

**The Role:**

  

AutoStore is hiring an Entry-Level Software Engineer to join our team at the start of their career. You will help design, build, and test the software that powers our automated storage and fulfillment systems, working alongside experienced engineers on real production code.

  

We are looking for a recent graduate with a strong academic record and, ideally, some internship experience. You don't need to know everything on day one. What matters most is a genuine passion for software, curiosity about how things work, and an eagerness to learn quickly.

  

You will receive structured mentoring and hands-on training, including in C++ and Python, the core languages our team works with.

  
  

**Key Tasks and Responsibilities:**

  

**Software Development**

* Design, write, and maintain clean, well-structured code in C++ and Python under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Implement new features and fix bugs across our software products.
* Apply object-oriented design principles and follow the team's coding standards.

**Testing and Quality**

* Write unit and integration tests for the code you develop.
* Debug and troubleshoot issues, and learn to find root causes.
* Take part in code reviews, both receiving feedback and reviewing teammates' code as you grow.

**Collaboration and Delivery**

* Work in an agile team, contributing to sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives.
* Use Git and GitHub for version control, pull requests, and code reviews.
* Work with QA, DevOps, and product teammates to deliver working software.

**Learning and Growth**

* Develop your C++ and Python skills on the job through training, mentoring, and real project work.
* Write and update technical documentation as you learn our systems.
Ask questions early and often, and share what you learn with the team.  

  
  

**Key Qualifications:**
-----------------------

* Working knowledge of C++ and Python, or of another object-oriented programming language (e.g., Java, C#).
* If your experience is in a language other than C++ and Python, a commitment to learning both on the job.
* Basic familiarity with Git and version control.
* A genuine passion for technology and a strong eagerness to learn.
* Good problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate clearly in a team.
* Cumulative GPA (CGPA) of 3.5 or higher on a 4.0 scale, or equivalent.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, completed recently or within the next six months.  

  

**Nice to Have:**

* Internship, co-op, or placement experience in software engineering.
* Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design.
* Exposure to unit testing frameworks (e.g., GoogleTest, pytest).
* Basic experience with Linux, the command line, or debugging tools.
* Exposure to embedded systems, robotics, or real-time software.
* Experience with networking and communication protocols, including TCP/IP, MQTT, REST APIs, and WebSockets.
Personal projects, open-source contributions, or hackathon experience.  

  
  

**We Offer:**
-------------

AutoStore believes in taking care of employees and is dedicated to providing a supportive and rewarding work environment. Join us in our mission to store and move things for everyone, everywhere.

* Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans
* Health Savings Account (HSA) with a company contribution
* Generous Paid Time Off including 12 holidays, paid exercise time, paid volunteer time, and paid parental leave plans for all new parents
* Retirement 401(k) plan with employer match and discretionary profit sharing contribution
* Educational assistance and professional development programs, including mentorship/coaching programs with external industry leaders
Additional benefits include Group Life Insurance, Voluntary Additional Life Insurance, Disability Insurance, Employee Assistance programs, and more!  

  
  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

AutoStore is an Equal Opportunity Employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, pregnancy-related conditions, and lactation), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws and ordinances.

jobs.description:

In this role, you won’t just maintain systems—you’ll continuously improve them. You’ll apply your controls and automation knowledge to optimize preventive maintenance strategies, diagnose sophisticated issues, and enhance the performance of industry leading technologies such as conveyors, sortation systems, PLCs, scanners, vision systems, print

‑and apply equipment, and SCADA platforms. Your work will directly influence uptime, safety, and operational excellence across mission critical facilities.

* Troubleshoot and modify software programs for material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers, Allen Bradley Controllogix/Compactlogix PLC platform and RSLogix 5000 software package.
* Act as first level escalation in troubleshooting support, both on-site and remotely, as well as during and after business hours, to repair all MHE controls software systems. Respond quickly to emergency situations, summoning assistance as needed.

* Monitor material handling equipment metrics and partner with site team to resolve equipment electrical problems that create performance deficiencies.
* Proactively and effectively communicate with multiple stakeholders including, but not limited to, leadership, operations and the maintenance team on technical issues and project timelines and production impacts.
* Facilitate analysis and reviews of failures and processes to provide recommendations to implement improvements or retraining to avoid future incidents.
* Perform controls systems assessments to maintain and improve equipment reliability.

* Perform other job-related duties as needed or assigned.

What You’ll Need

* Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.
* Bachelor's Degree preferred with 2-5 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education may be considered.
* Experience in at least two engineering design cycles including specification, component selection and programming.
* 2+ years of experience working with PLC programming, robotics system components and controls, and SCADA-based monitoring and control systems.
* Ability to be available and work in a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays.
* Ability to independently solve problems and carry out general instructions in standard situations with limited to no oversight.
* Meet the physical requirements of this role including stooping, standing, walking, climbing stairs/ladders, and the ability to lift/carry heavy loads of 50 lbs. or more.
* Ability to guide the exchange of sensitive, complicated, and difficult information, convey performance expectations, and handle problems.

Preferred Qualifications

* 2+ years apprenticeship or equivalent experience in Control Systems troubleshooting/ programming.
* Experience supporting a range of different conveyors and sortation systems.
* Experience with robotic maintenance.
* In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Extensive organizational skills with a strong inquisitive mindset.
* Advanced math skills. Ability to calculate difficult figures such as percentages, fractions, and other financial-related calculations.

\*Must flexible with being on-call on weekends as needed\*

* PLC Programming Experience
* SCADA Experience

---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensures our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
Are you passionate about designing and optimizing the critical infrastructure that powers one of the world's largest and most complex networks? Amazon is looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer to take on a technical leadership role in the design, architecture, and continuous improvement of our data center infrastructure systems. In this role, you will tackle ambiguous, high-impact problems across global projects, driving solutions that are inventive, scalable, and maintainable. You will serve as a key technical resource, guiding infrastructure strategy and influencing decisions that shape the long-term reliability and efficiency of our facilities. If you are a collaborative problem solver who thrives on simplifying complex systems and mentoring others, we want to hear from you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Support the Data Center Design Engineering, Principal Engineering, and Hardware Engineering teams to design and develop innovative concepts into new mechanical cooling products (AHUs, chiller, pump skids, ADACs) used in AWS data centers.
* Lead the electrical aspect of new product design and development for mechanical cooling equipment, including motor controls, VFDs, power distribution panels, control wiring, and instrumentation integration.
* Collaborate with other disciplines such as mechanical engineering, structural engineering, controls/automation, reliability, QA/QC, and compliance to create well-thought-out products.
* Design and specify electrical systems for rotating equipment including fans, pumps, and compressors, ensuring proper motor sizing, protection, and control schemes.
* Create designs which meet or exceed our quality requirements while delivering a return on investment.
* Work with global suppliers and manufacturers to specify appropriate electrical components, devices, and bill of materials for AHUs, skids, and ADACs.
* Ensure compliance with federal, state, and municipal requirements and building codes across different countries, including UL, CE, IEC, NEC/NFPA 70, and other applicable standards for mechanical cooling equipment.
* Prepare, review, and approve product design and drawings including electrical schematics, single-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, cable schedules, and bill of materials.
* Define project scope and provide technical support for information requests prior to, and during manufacturing phases.
* Work with field engineering and commissioning teams to properly set up test processes and validate installation, operation, and performance of electrical systems within mechanical cooling products.
* Develop and review control logic, interlocks, and safety circuits for AHU, skid, chillers and ADAC assemblies in coordination with controls engineers.
* Ability to work on concurrent projects in multiple geographical regions.
* Support of Operations including failure mode and root cause analysis, maintenance and troubleshooting support, and operating procedure review for electrical systems in cooling equipment.
* Be a leader within the group as well as within internal and external teams that support the data center.
* Ability and willingness to travel domestic and internationally for up to 25% of the year.

  
A day in the life  
You might start your morning reviewing infrastructure designs for an upcoming global deployment, collaborating with partner teams to align on architectural decisions. Later, you could lead a project review where you assess proposed solutions for their long-term impact on systems and processes. In the afternoon, you may work through a complex power distribution or cooling challenge, diagnosing root causes and developing a path forward. Throughout, you will share your expertise with colleagues, helping to raise the technical bar across the team.  
  
About the team  
\*Why AWS\*  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
\*Diverse Experiences\*  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Amphenol Communications Solutions (ACS), a division of Amphenol Corporation, is a world leader in interconnect solutions for Communications, Mobile, RF, Optics, and Commercial electronics markets. Amphenol Corporation is one of the world’s largest designers and manufacturers of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor-based products and coaxial and high-speed specialty cable. ACS has an expansive global presence in research and development, manufacturing, and sales. We design and manufacture a wide range of innovative connectors as well as cable assemblies for diverse applications including server, storage, data center, mobile, RF, networking, industrial, business equipment, and automotive.

**Position: Advanced Automation Engineer - HSIO Overpass Solutions**

**SUMMARY:**

The Advanced Automation Engineer will serve as a primary technical interface between Amphenol and customers developing automated or semi-automated systems for HSIO Overpass cable installation. This role will focus heavily on understanding customer automation requirements, identifying installation and process challenges, developing practical automation solutions, and driving technical issues to resolution.

The role will work closely with customer engineering, automation, manufacturing, and operations teams to evaluate applications, troubleshoot automation problems, develop proof-of-concept solutions, and recommend improvements to product design, tooling, fixtures, equipment, and installation processes. Internally, the engineer will connect customer requirements with product development, NPI, manufacturing, quality, and operations teams to ensure solutions are robust, scalable, and ready for production.

The successful candidate will be a hands-on problem solver who is comfortable working directly with customers, leading technical discussions, troubleshooting complex automation issues, and converting customer challenges into actionable engineering solutions.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Serve as a primary customer-facing technical resource for automation, installation, handling, and manufacturability of HSIO Overpass cable solutions.
* Build strong technical relationships with customer engineering, automation, manufacturing, and operations teams.
* Engage directly with customers to understand automation requirements, installation challenges, production objectives, and system-level constraints.
* Lead customer discussions and technical reviews to identify automation opportunities, risks, and potential solutions.
* Act as the liaison between customer engineering teams and Amphenol product development, NPI, process engineering, quality, and operations.
* Own and drive automation-related customer issues from problem identification through root-cause analysis, corrective action, validation, and closure.
* Troubleshoot difficult automation and installation problems involving cable handling, routing, insertion, retention, orientation, fixturing, tooling, vision, force control, and product variation.
* Quickly assess customer automation failures and determine whether the root cause is related to product design, tooling, equipment, process parameters, controls, handling, or operator interaction.

* Support customers during automation trials, equipment development, proof-of-concept builds, system integration, and production launch.

* Establish troubleshooting methods and standardized approaches for common Overpass automation challenges.
* Identify opportunities for emerging automation technologies, robotics, machine vision, sensors, force control, and intelligent process monitoring.
* Translate lessons learned from customer applications into product design guidelines, automation standards, and internal best practices.
* Communicate customer requirements, technical findings, risks, action plans, and project status to internal leadership and cross-functional teams.
* Develop and maintain process documentation, work instructions, training materials, validation plans, and automation troubleshooting guides.
* Support the transition of successful customer automation concepts into scalable manufacturing processes.

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Automation Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related technical discipline.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

*Carlisle Companies is a leading manufacturer of building envelope products and solutions that make buildings more energy efficient, durable, and sustainable.*

*We deliver roofing, insulation, waterproofing, and architectural systems for commercial and residential projects using a focus on innovation and continuous improvement to solve today’s challenges.*

*We’re equally committed to our people, prioritizing safety, inclusion, career growth development, tuition assistance, and excellent benefits.*

*With manufacturing, engineering, R&D, and corporate functions across North America and globally, Carlisle offers stability, agility, and opportunity in a performance-driven culture. Do meaningful work and shape the future of building solutions; apply today and come grow with us.*

 **Job Description**

**Carlisle Construction Materials (CCM)** is seeking an experenced **Electrical Engineer** to join our team in **Greenville, IL**. The Electrical Engineer is responsible for handling or supervise those handling specific projects as directed by the Manager of Engineering. Projects include estimating cost design, layout and specs for materials and installation, obtaining bids for equipment and labor, and supervise the complete installation and startup. Projects range from minor modifications to large equipment installations. In addition, the Electrical Engineer will assist maintenance personnel with electrical troubleshooting related to PLC, HMI’s and other higher level electrical devices. This includes accountability for instructing and monitoring safety of all maintenance personnel, specifically with electrical safety programs such as Lockout/Tagout and Arc Flash/Electrical Safety Program.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

The person in this position will be utilized in a wide variety of situations. Regular duties are listed below. The position will be assigned to special projects as the plant identifies new areas in need of improvement. These special projects may be related to Safety, Regulatory, Process Improvement, Facility Improvement, etc.

* Engineering Activities (~70% of Time)
  + Design in-house equipment modifications and new installations to provide increased productivity. This requires electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic knowledge.
  + Troubleshoot maintenance and production problems on equipment to reduce downtime by utilizing technical knowledge, troubleshooting techniques, and available test equipment.
  + Plan, supervise, and communicate modifications to equipment to ensure safety, cost savings, and increase productivity.
  + Prepare sketches for fabrications, modifications, and installation of equipment to ensure the safety and productive operation of said equipment. Define parts, order parts, write reports, communicate project status, and update department project lists and review Maintenance Department’s previous night’s activities.
  + Create new and update old drawings using a CAD system.
* Other Misc. Duties (~30% of Time)
  + Attend and contribute regularly to job related plant initiatives (i.e. Safety, COS, Cost Savings).

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:**

* Ability to read and understand the various schematics and electrical prints for the equipment in CCM Greenville
* Ability to program and modify PLCs, VFDs, HMIs and other programmable equipment.
* Understand and adhere to the guidelines of an electrical safety plan based on NFPA, OSHA, NEC, Etc. codes and using it to ensure the safety of yourself and others.
* Proficiency with utilizing a computer, including Microsoft Office, SAP, and AutoCAD.
* Ability to access and utilize the software associated with the various VFDs, PLCs, Wonderware, and HMIs utilized throughout CCM Greenville.
* Demonstrate effective communication skills: written, oral, and electronic

**Equipment/Data:**

* Be able to operate electrical troubleshooting equipment, such as a multimeter, megger, oscilloscope, current probe, and computer.
* Be able to understand, modify, train others on PLC, VFD, Safety Controllers, and other electrical control devices.

**Work Environment/Time Worked:**

* Work Environment:
  + Approximately 70% of work time is spent in a climate controlled, relatively clean and quiet office environment. The remaining 30% is spent in a manufacturing plant environment working on projects or inventory related activities. On occasion this person will be required to attend meetings. The job itself can be very stressful at times and can require a fast pace. There will be occasions where machine failures will require intense focus and quick resolution while maintaining a safe work performance. These machine failures can happen at non-traditional work hours. An individual must be able to work on several different projects simultaneously and in order of priority to meet deadlines.
* Time Worked:
  + Core Hours 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM; 40 Hours/Week, Monday through Friday
  + The core hours are required to interface with other daylight departments and support groups. Depending on projects, additional time outside of the core hours may be required.
  + Comments – Due to the nature of the operation, this position will require occasional phone calls during off hours in order to keep production running or for the safety of the facility.

**Physical Requirements:**

Sitting, standing, some climbing stairs including catwalks, silos, ladders, etc. will be required along with stooping, bending and lifting. Sight and hearing is required to not only observe the process and personnel but also to effectively communicate with people and assist with problem solving. Must be able to move freely between facilities on the campus, as well as within each facility, in order to observe work processes and assist with problem solving and troubleshooting.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

There are no direct reports for this position but there are times when supervising maintenance or production operators will be required.

L3Harris' Space and Mission Systems seeks an Electrical Engineer with subsystem leadership experience to join our growing team. **Essential Functions:**

* Manages and maintains the electrical integration of the electronic subsystems, mission payload and communications payload according to internal and external ICDs

* Works closely with Software, Mechanical, and Integration and Test to own and oversee subsystem integration across the full program lifecycle
* Represent subsystem electrical engineering during major system level design reviews such as SRR, SDR, PDR and CDR and milestone reviews such as MRR, TRR, PSF, LRR and MDR
* Leads or participates in failure review boards, engineering review boards, change control boards to ensure electrical impacts are coordinated
* Creating and/or supporting delivery of Customer CDRLs

* Ability to lead diverse technical teams across internal and subcontractor efforts
* Ability to obtain a Secret US security clearance.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 6 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 4 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 10 years of prior related experience.

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

* Experience with electrical integration of electronics to meet mission performance
* Experience with leading electrical engineering teams
* Demonstrated experience leading electrical engineering teams through all phases of a space program; pursuits and proposal, design and development, integration and test, and operations
* Ability to make risk-based decisions balancing technical, cost and schedule
* Ability to lead, review, and coordinate electrical analyses and trades including power budgets, fault/failure analysis, EMI/EMC, grounding, signal/interface compatibility, and worst-case analysis
* Experience with electrical integration, testing, and troubleshooting of complex systems
* Well versed in developing or coordinating physical and functional electrical interface details such as first order circuit compatibility, voltage levels, current ratings, connector types, pin configurations, grounding requirements, signal protocols, data rates, communications interfaces and EMI/EMC/ESD considerations
* Experienced with electrical requirements validation, interface definition and closure, interconnect diagram development and ownership, sell-off, milestone entry/exit criteria
* Familiarity with electrical engineering processes and/or subsystems, such as power, command and data handling (C&DH), telemetry, tracking, and command (TT&C),
* Experience performing Worst Case analysis for power, analog, digital, and EMI across environmental requirements and derating
* Familiarity with tools such as DOORs, PSPICE, MathCAD, Matlab, Simulink, Allegro and MentorGraphics
* Ability to travel as required

#plabs26

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Software Engineer in Test with an interest in embedded firmware to join our IoT (Internet of Things) group. The group develops software for the microcontroller-based sensor hardware designed and manufactured in-house. Our products offer an interesting engineering challenge: microcontrollers with just a few hundred kilobytes of RAM and code space must collect data from sensors such as accelerometers and GPS, communicate with back-end systems over the Internet and nearby devices with Bluetooth, perform over-the-air upgrades with new firmware, and manage cryptographically-secured storage — all while using so little power that they can run for years on a battery.

CMT is looking for a **Software Engineer in Test II, Embedded Firmware** to help us change the world. CMT has helped protect over 65 million drivers and prevent over 126,000 crashes worldwide. We build AI to solve some of the most difficult challenges in mobility — understanding and reducing risk, detecting crashes, and getting people life-saving help. The problems are hard. The impact is real. No matter your role, your work will matter at CMT.

* Execute and monitor firmware test runs across simulated firmware on Linux servers and real firmware on device

* Use Python for test harnesses and scripting, with exposure to C for understanding firmware under test

jobs.title: Senior Staff/Principal Software Engineer - GPU System Software, Onboard Execution
jobs.description:
Zoox is building a purpose-built robotaxi from the ground up and running it on public roads today, with riders. Every perception, prediction, and planning decision runs on an onboard compute: a fixed-power, fixed-thermal, safety-critical, real-time system.

That makes GPU execution one of the most consequential engineering problems in the company. Each new model generation wants more compute. Each new vehicle generation needs to cost less, use less power, and stay safe. Closing that gap is not a kernel-tuning exercise. It takes an end-to-end technical vision for how the whole onboard AI workload is scheduled, shared, isolated, and sized across GPUs, and the authority to drive that vision across ML, autonomy, middleware, and hardware organizations.

You will join Zoox's Software Performance organization, which owns end-to-end performance of the onboard software stack: profiling and observability, GPU compute, and compute platform. You will work closely with Perception, Prediction, Planning, ML Infrastructure, and Hardware teams, and you will be a senior technical voice for onboard compute across the company.

We are looking for the technical leader who sets that vision. You will define how Zoox runs AI on the vehicle, and you will own the strategy for doing more with less compute on every vehicle we build next.

### **In this role, you will:**

* **Architect onboard GPU execution.** Define how perception, prediction, and planning workloads share onboard GPUs, including scheduling, multi-tenancy, isolation, and deterministic latency under contention.
* **Drive compute reduction.** Own the multi-year roadmap to cut onboard compute per vehicle by setting latency and utilization budgets and landing the biggest levers across models, runtimes, middleware, and hardware in real releases.
* **Shape hardware and platform direction.** Guide next-generation compute decisions (GPU and SoC selection, topology, memory budgets) with workload models and performance projections that justify them, then lead performance bring-up of each new platform.
* **Lead inference performance at scale.** Set direction for the inference stack (TensorRT, CUDA, custom kernels, quantization) and partner with ML teams so models are designed for the hardware they ship on.
* **Provide technical leadership.** Lead and mentor senior engineers, align directors and VPs through design docs, and make the hard calls when performance, safety, and schedule conflict.

### **Qualifications**

* BS in computer science, computer engineering, or related field and 10+ years in systems or performance engineering, including leading GPU or accelerator architecture across teams, or building and leading a performance engineering team.
* Deep CUDA platform (programming model, runtime, and driver) and NVIDIA GPU microarchitecture expertise (Ampere through Blackwell, Orin, Thor).
* Proven record setting technical direction and delivering large, measurable end-to-end gains in latency, utilization, or cost.
* Working knowledge of ML inference optimization (TensorRT, XLA, Triton, quantization, fusion) and expert C++ on Linux.
* Ability to align ML, systems, hardware, and leadership on a shared technical plan.

### **Bonus Qualifications**

* Real-time or embedded GPU experience: autonomy, robotics, AR/VR, games, or HPC.  
  Production GPU multi-tenancy (MPS, MIG, priority streams).  
  New GPU architecture or platform bring-up, benchmarking methodology, or workload modeling and projections.

**Base Salary Range**

There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. A sign-on bonus may be offered as part of the compensation package. The listed range applies only to the base salary. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level. Leveling, as well as positioning within a level, is determined by a range of factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate's relevant years of experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance. The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the range of levels Zoox is considering for this position.

Zoox also offers a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off (e.g. sick leave, vacation, bereavement), unpaid time off, Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights, Amazon RSUs, health insurance, long-term care insurance, long-term and short-term disability insurance, and life insurance.

**About Zoox**

Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team.

Follow us on LinkedIn

**Accommodations**

If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter.

***A Final Note:***

*You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.*

jobs.description:
**Mueller Coatings | East Bridgewater, MA**

Mueller Coatings is seeking a hands-on **Controls & Automation Engineer** to improve manufacturing performance through reliable controls, practical automation, and effective problem-solving.

In this role, you will design, program, troubleshoot, and improve systems supporting vacuum metalizing, spray coating, and related manufacturing operations. You will work closely with Production, Maintenance, Engineering, and Quality to reduce downtime, improve process consistency, and bring automation projects from concept to production.

Our values—**Excellence, Dependability, Teamwork, and Innovation**—guide how we work, solve problems, and support one another.

What You’ll Do

**Develop and improve control systems**

* Design, program, troubleshoot, and maintain PLCs, HMIs, sensors, motor controls, variable frequency drives, and industrial control networks.
* Develop equipment sequences, operator interfaces, alarms, and diagnostics that simplify operation and troubleshooting.
* Integrate controls for vacuum systems, coating equipment, ovens, conveyors, pumps, and material handling equipment.
* Upgrade aging control systems and maintain accurate electrical schematics, program backups, and revision records.

**Bring practical automation to the manufacturing floor**

* Identify opportunities to automate part handling, loading and unloading, coating application, inspection, and packaging.
* Develop automation concepts, project requirements, cost estimates, and expected operating benefits.
* Program and support FANUC and other robotic systems, and integrate robots, cobots, machine vision, and automated fixtures.
* Develop solutions that accommodate different part geometries, production volumes, and changeover requirements.
* Reduce manual handling, cycle time, process variation, and scrap.

**Solve problems and strengthen equipment reliability**

* Diagnose electrical, controls, and automation issues affecting production.
* Partner with Maintenance to identify root causes and implement lasting corrective actions.
* Improve equipment diagnostics and support preventive maintenance practices.
* Train operators and maintenance technicians on controls, proper operation, and fault recovery.
* Provide hands-on support during installations, startup, and production interruptions.

**Support quality, safety, and project execution**

* Develop controls that maintain repeatable temperature, timing, pressure, vacuum, and coating application parameters.
* Implement recipe management, process monitoring, data collection, and traceability where needed.
* Work with Quality and Process Engineering to verify that changes meet approved process specifications.
* Manage assigned projects through installation, commissioning, acceptance testing, and production handoff.
* Coordinate with equipment builders, integrators, contractors, and suppliers.
* Partner with EHS and Maintenance on machine guarding, interlocks, and safety controls, and follow established change control, lockout/tagout, and electrical safety procedures.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field; equivalent technical education and relevant experience will be considered.
* At least three years of hands-on experience in industrial controls, automation, or manufacturing equipment engineering.
* Demonstrated experience programming and troubleshooting PLCs and HMIs.
* Working knowledge of industrial electrical systems, instrumentation, sensors, motor controls, and control panel components.
* Ability to read, interpret, and update electrical schematics.
* Experience troubleshooting equipment that combines electrical, mechanical, pneumatic, and process systems.
* Strong problem-solving, project organization, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate with operators, technicians, engineers, and outside suppliers.
* Ability to work independently and have excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate effectively with other team members and facility leadership.

**Preferred experience includes:**

* Allen-Bradley/Rockwell Automation and AutomationDirect control platforms.
* FANUC robotics, cobots, machine vision, or motion control.
* Vacuum equipment, automated coating systems, spray equipment, cure ovens, or conveyors.
* Manufacturing data collection, equipment monitoring, or MES integration.
* Manufacturing environments with varied products and frequent changeovers.
* Machine safety systems and applicable industrial electrical standards.
* Evaluating automation investments through labor savings, capacity improvements, quality gains, and payback.

**What Success Looks Like**

Success means fewer recurring equipment failures, reduced controls-related downtime, improved throughput and process repeatability, and automation projects that achieve documented benefits. It also means completing projects within approved schedules and budgets and leaving employees with the documentation, training, and tools needed to support the equipment.

**Work Environment**

This position combines engineering work with regular hands-on activity on the manufacturing floor. Work may involve coating materials, operating machinery, elevated temperatures, and industrial noise. Required personal protective equipment and established safety procedures must be followed. Occasional support outside normal operating hours may be needed for installations, planned shutdowns, or urgent equipment issues.

We are a world-class team of professionals who deliver next generation technology and products in robotic and autonomous platforms, ground, soldier, and maritime systems in 50+ locations world-wide. Much of our work contributes to innovative research in the fields of sensor science, signal processing, data fusion, artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and augmented reality (AR).

QinetiQ US’s dedicated experts in defense, aerospace, security, and related fields all work together to explore new ways of protecting the American Warfighter, Security Forces, and Allies. Being a part of QinetiQ US means being central to the safety and security of the world around us. Partnering with our customers, we help save lives; reduce risks to society; and maintain the global infrastructure on which we all depend.

**Why Join QinetiQ US?**

If you have the courage to take on a wide variety of complex challenges, then you will experience a unique working environment where innovative teams blend different perspectives, disciplines, and technologies to discover new ways of solving complex problems. In our diverse and inclusive environment, you can be authentic, feel valued, be respected, and realize your full potential. QinetiQ US will support you with workplace flexibility, a commitment to the health and well-being of you and your family and provide opportunities to work with a purpose. We are committed to supporting your success in both your professional and personal lives.

Position Overview:

As a Senior Electrical Engineer at QinetiQ, you will be working hands-on to design, build, and troubleshooting mission-critical electronic systems for defense customers. Your work will span from multi-megawatt military vehicle electrification, compact underwater propulsion units for AUVs, unmanned ground robots, and the modernization of onboard power electronics and actuator systems for the Navy’s newest submarine designs, bringing proven technology into the next generation of undersea platforms.

QinetiQ’s Advanced Robotics and Mission Solutions (AR&MS) group draws on decades of experience developing and delivering leading-edge, mission-ready systems. From frontline unmanned ground robots to ship and submarine systems on which missions depend, our teams are driven by mission-led innovation and a commitment to overcoming the threats of tomorrow.

Responsibilities:

* Work within a multidisciplinary teams of mechanical, electrical, software, and controls engineers to design and support complex systems
* Work with the team to oversee the entire component life-cycle from proposal, concept design, prototype build, and production implementation.
* Design and develop new and novel features for existing products
* Troubleshoot and root cause challenging component and systems problems
* Spearhead the electrical design and testing to MIL-Spec

Required Qualifications:

* Bachelor of Science degree or higher in Electrical Engineering or equivalent discipline with 5+ years of related experience
* Hands-on experience building and testing systems
* Familiarity with MIL-Specs and MIL-PRFs related to electrical engineering
* Ability to see programs through from proposal to production
* Experience interfacing and collaborating with customers
* Prior mentorship roles especially within an engineering setting
* Experience with CAD/Analysis programs
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a DoD security clearance if required

Pay Transparency:

The salary range for this role is $94,100.00 - $130,000 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. QinetiQ US considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.

If because of a medical condition or disability you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please send an e-mail to staffing@us.QinetiQ.com or call (540) 658-2720 Opt. 1 and let us know the nature of your request and contact information.

jobs.description:
**Position Description**
------------------------

Seeking an experienced identity engineer for a position as part of the team supporting the Laboratory identity and access management platform. Blending a strong technical background in identity concepts and technologies with leadership qualities, this individual will help oversee a robust IAM landscape that is responsible for identity management, PKI, privileged access management, single sign-on and identity governance administration. The successful candidate for this position will have experience in architecting, deploying and administering various IAM solutions outlined above and displays skill in building relationships, managing time and tasks effectively and has solid communications skills in both writing and presenting. This position will work closely with other Laboratory technical teams and have a blend of both security and usability perspectives. A hybrid work arrangement, this candidate will be required to be on-site in an as-needed capacity and participate in an on-call rotation with off-hour support on occasion. This position reports to the enterprise platforms and infrastructure group within the Laboratory’s digital solutions department.

**Primary Duties**
------------------

* Architecture and Administration of the Laboratories Public Key Infrastructure consisting of both cloud and on premise components including certificate authorities / templates, certificate revocation services and hardware security modules.
* Lead engineer for multi-factor authentication and token management currently consisting of an assortment of tokens supporting certificate-based authentication for Windows, Macintosh, Linux and iOS.
* Certificate administration and management for end-point platform configuration and adoption of authentication supporting OS, VPN and Single Sign-On.
* Participation in the administration and design of identity management solutions including directories, account creation and updates and integration with an assortment of platforms facilitating access and systems management.
* Help create and maintain artifacts in support of the IAM landscape including technical, administrative and support knowledge, product roadmaps, strategic guidance, vendor management and operational procedures.
* Ensure systems compliance with Laboratory security policies and practices and ensure system availability and adoption by customers.
* Participate in IT service management for the IAM systems including incident, knowledge and problem management as well as fulfilling service requests as necessary.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* Bachelors Degree and/or 5-10 years of experience
* Strong working knowledge and experience with PKI services and operations including management of certificate templates, support and operation of PKI components and troubleshooting of certificate issues involving authentication, code signing and S/MIME operations.
* Experience with designing, deploying and supporting multi-factor authentication solutions and tokens including YubiKey, Smartcard (including DoD Common Access Card), Passkeys and Biometrics across various operating systems including Windows, Macintosh, Linux and Apple iOS.
* Familiarity with PKI systems based on Microsoft Certificate Services.
* Experience with identity management systems including design / support and administration practices. Ability to troubleshoot LDAP and Active Directory objects, attributes and permissions for variety of accounts including user, administrative, service and machine objects.
* Ability to utilize AI services in helping to troubleshoot, configure and deploy solutions. Familiarity with automation and orchestration principles for operational efficiency and scripting experience with Microsoft PowerShell, Python or Bash.
* Solid foundation with networking and infrastructure fundamentals including troubleshooting best practices with firewall and micro segmentation integration including ports and protocols, load balancing and name resolution.
* Understanding and hands-on experience with engineering best practices and principles including security design and best practices, systems management and monitoring, log file analysis, ensuring continuity of operations and development guidelines and practices.
* Proven leadership capabilities including accountability, demand management, effective delegation, time management, vendor management, and proven communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Working knowledge of Identity Management platforms including NetIQ/OpenText, Microsoft EntraID and Microsoft Active Directory.
* Understanding of Single Sign-On protocols and principles include SAML
* Experience with cloud-based architecture and systems management for hosting identity solutions including hybrid configurations with on premise IdM components.
* Understanding of security configuration guidelines and compliance involving NIST 800-171 to include security baselines, implementation and documentation. Experience with security audits is also a plus.
* Security certifications (e.g. CISSP, Security+) and foundational understanding of Splunk logging.

**Other Qualifications**
------------------------

* Ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance is required for this position.
* Participation in on-call rotation and occasional off-hour support is required.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

**Our Opportunity**

Chewy is seeking a motivated **Software Engineer I** to join our Supply Chain IT Domain Services team in Plantation, FL or Boston, MA.

This team owns a suite of critical services that support inventory visibility, purchase order and transfer workflows, electronic data exchange, vendor compliance, and operational analytics across Chewy’s supply chain network. These systems span distributed services and data pipelines supporting both real-time and batch processing.

As an early career engineer, you will work with experienced engineers to design, build, test, deploy, and support reliable software. You will take ownership of well-scoped work while developing strong engineering, operational, and business fundamentals.

This is not a purely backend role. You’ll contribute across backend services, APIs, data workflows, and user-facing applications when needed, while learning to deliver complete solutions in a complex, system-heavy environment.

**What You’ll Do**

* Develop and maintain software using Java, Spring Boot, AWS, and related technologies with guidance from experienced engineers
* Deliver results on well-scoped features and technical improvements from implementation through testing, deployment, and production validation
* Build and support APIs, event-driven integrations, data workflows, and, when needed, user-facing applications
* Write clear, maintainable code and participate in code reviews, design discussions, and team engineering standards
* Create automated unit and integration tests and help improve the team’s testing and delivery practices
* Operate in the details by using logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and runbooks to troubleshoot issues and improve reliability and performance
* Participate in production support and on-call responsibilities with documented procedures, mentoring, and team support
* Use approved AI-assisted development tools responsibly to accelerate learning, coding, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting while validating generated output
* Put customers first by partnering with product, program, business, and engineering teams to understand needs and deliver practical supply chain solutions; earn trust by communicating progress, risks, and blockers early
* Apply spec-driven development (SDD) practices, with guidance, to translate requirements and acceptance criteria into reviewed designs, implementation plans, discrete tasks, tests, and delivered code
* Act as an owner for assigned work and contribute to operational excellence by improving documentation, observability, support readiness, and production stability

**What You’ll Need**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Foundational programming experience through professional work, internships, co-op assignments, academic projects, or substantial personal projects
* Working knowledge of Java or another object-oriented programming language and the ability to learn Java and Spring Boot
* Understanding of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, debugging, and software testing fundamentals
* Familiarity with relational databases, SQL, REST APIs, source control, and modern software development practices
* Exposure to cloud-based application development and an interest in building on AWS
* Ability to learn unfamiliar systems, ask effective questions, discuss alternatives openly, apply feedback, and commit to team decisions once aligned
* Exposure to SDD workflows that move from requirements and acceptance criteria through design, tasks, implementation, and validation
* Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across a team
* Accountability for assigned work and willingness to communicate progress, risks, and blockers early
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment while balancing delivery, learning, and quality

**AI and Modern Development Experience**

We are looking for engineers who are interested in applying AI pragmatically in development workflows. This may include:

* Using approved AI-assisted tools such as Cursor, Codex, or Copilot to improve development efficiency
* Validating AI-generated code, tests, and documentation before use
* Using reviewed specifications as the source of truth for AI-assisted planning and implementation, then validating the result against requirements, acceptance criteria, and tests
* Recognizing when human review, security controls, and engineering judgment are required

**Bonus**

* Internship, co-op, or project experience developing cloud-based applications with AWS
* Exposure to Spring Boot, microservices, event-driven systems, data pipelines, or full-stack development using React or Vue
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, containers, observability tools, or agile delivery practices
* Interest in supply chain, logistics, inventory systems, e-commerce, or high-volume operational systems

  
The base salary range for this role is $92,500 - $160,000.00.

* The specific salary offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to the candidate’s relevant experience, education, and work location. In addition, this position is eligible for 401k and a new hire and annual equity grant. C08+ positions may also be eligible for annual bonus.

We offer different types of insurance and benefits, such as medical/Rx, vision, dental, life, disability, hospital indemnity, critical illness, and accident. We offer parental leave, family services benefits, backup dependent care, flexible spending accounts, telemedicine, pet adoption reimbursement, employee assistance program, and many discounts including 10% off pet insurance and 20% off at Chewy.com.

**Job Description**

### **About the Team**

Compute & Connectivity Hardware (CCH) is part of GM’s Vehicle Software & Electronics Engineering (VSEE) organization within Software & Services Engineering. The team develops the physical hardware foundation for GM’s software-defined vehicles, including compute, connectivity, networking, displays, and other electronic platforms that enable in-vehicle software, infotainment, ADAS, vehicle controls, and connected experiences.

  

CCH’s work spans architecture, requirements, hardware and electronics design, embedded hardware, systems integration, validation, launch, and in-market performance. Our engineers collaborate across software, systems, controls, cybersecurity, functional safety, vehicle engineering, suppliers, and manufacturing to develop reliable, production-ready hardware for GM’s vehicle portfolio.

  

**The Role**

At General Motors, we're redefining the vehicle through centralized computing, advanced electrical architectures, and software-defined capabilities. Our Software-Defined Vehicle (SDV) platform powers next-generation features including automated driving, connected services, and immersive digital experiences. At the center of this transformation is GM's in-house designed Central Compute Unit (CCU), a high-performance, liquid-cooled computing platform that serves as the foundation for future vehicle intelligence.

  

As a Senior Hardware Validation Engineer - Compute Validation, you will be responsible for validating and releasing next-generation compute hardware that powers GM's software-defined vehicles. You will lead validation activities for complex ECU platforms, owning test strategy, execution, issue resolution, and release readiness across environmental, EMC, and functional validation domains. This role requires strong technical leadership, hands-on debugging expertise, and close collaboration with hardware, software, systems, manufacturing, and vehicle integration teams.

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

Compute Hardware Validation

* Lead validation planning and execution for central compute platforms throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Develop validation strategies, test plans, and coverage aligned with product requirements, technical risks, and program milestones.
* Define interface validation requirements, test methods, and acceptance criteria.
* Drive issue identification, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and closure of hardware validation concerns.
* Partner with design engineers to incorporate validation learnings into product improvements and future designs.

Environmental & EMC Validation

* Own environmental validation activities including thermal, vibration, mechanical shock, humidity, and reliability testing.
* Lead EMC/EMI validation readiness, execution, issue triage, and corrective action tracking.
* Collaborate with internal and external laboratories to develop test setups, review results, and drive resolution of validation failures.
* Improve hardware robustness and compliance performance through data-driven validation insights.

Hardware Bring-Up & Debug

* Lead board bring-up and validation of prototype and production-intent hardware.
* Perform hands-on lab testing including power measurements, signal integrity assessments, thermal characterization, and stress testing.
* Investigate and resolve issues involving power delivery, high-speed interfaces, environmental performance, and EMC behavior.
* Assess validation results and provide clear recommendations regarding product readiness and technical risk.

Cross-Functional Leadership

* Collaborate with silicon vendors and cross-functional teams including hardware, software, systems, safety, manufacturing, and vehicle integration.
* Support technical reviews, validation reviews, and program milestone assessments.

Quality & Compliance

* Support DVP&R, DFMEA, requirements traceability, and coverage analysis.
* Communicate validation results, risks, and recommendations to engineering and program leadership.

* 7+ years of experience in hardware validation, embedded electronics, ECU development, or compute platform engineering.
* Strong experience validating complex automotive electronic modules or compute systems.
* Experience leading environmental and/or EMC validation activities for automotive hardware.
* Knowledge of automotive hardware development processes, reliability engineering, and product release methodologies.
* Strong understanding of: Digital electronics and embedded hardware fundamentals Power distribution and system architecture High-speed interfaces including PCIe, Ethernet, USB, and DDR Hardware bring-up, debugging, and failure analysis Automotive environmental and EMC validation processes
* Hands-on experience with lab equipment including oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, power supplies, multimeters, and debug tools.
* Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills.
* Proven ability to independently drive technical issues to resolution across cross-functional teams.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

Compute & Connectivity Hardware (CCH) is part of GM’s Software & Services organization and owns the hardware foundation for GM’s software-defined vehicles.
