jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, SLAM/VIO
jobs.description:
**About Rivet**  
Rivet is an American company building integrated task systems — fusing hardened hardware with software, sensors, AI, and networking — for industrial workforces and defense personnel. We create capabilities that multiply the effectiveness of every individual and withstand the world’s toughest environments.  
  
We serve the people who build, operate, maintain, and defend our way of life. From technicians and engineers to first responders and service members, they embody the hard work, ingenuity, and meritocratic values that drive Western prosperity. Yet too often they are forced to rely on outdated tools that fail under modern pressures. Rivet exists to reset that priority.  
  
At Rivet, you’ll join a mission-driven team that fuses disciplines to deliver decisive outcomes where they matter most. Whether shaping our technology, strengthening our partnerships, or building our culture, every role here contributes to equipping the front lines with the modern systems they deserve.  
  
**Work Authorization Requirement: Due to the nature of our business and compliance with federal regulations, all candidates must be a "U.S. Person". Upon hire, you will be required to provide documentation verifying your status as a U.S. Citizen, a lawful permanent resident, or a protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).**

**Summary**

We are building the perception stack that enables robust three/six degrees of freedom tracking, localization, and mapping in complex real-world environments. This role focuses on fusing data from cameras and inertial sensors to power SLAM / Visual-Inertial Odometry pipelines. We need an experienced perception software engineer who can create algorithms and systems that run in real time, handle uncertainty gracefully, and provide the foundation for advanced spatial intelligence on edge devices.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and optimize sensor fusion algorithms combining IMU and camera data for SLAM and VIO (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping & Visual Inertial Odometry)
* Implement state of the art structure-from-motion techniques using different sensor modalities to generate consistent 3D reconstructions
* Evaluate algos against public benchmarks and real-world datasets
* Integrate outputs into higher-level autonomy or collaborative mapping systems (i.e. shared mapping systems)
* Collaborate with HW, robotics and platform teams to ensure end-to-end performance
* Define metrics, testing frameworks and deployment strategies for production-ready perception systems

**Requirements**

* BS with 10+ years of academic or industry experience in inertial sensing, computer vision, robotics or related fields with shipped or published work (or MS with 8+ yrs of the above)
* Shipped SLAM/VIO features to product
* Strong background in linear algebra, 3D geometry, VIO (probabilistic filtering and/or factor-graph optimization), and visual mapping (incremental mapping, submaps, loop closure)
* Proficient in C++/Python with experience in real-time optimization
* Proficient in using and debugging geometric optimization frameworks (e.g. Ceres, GTSAM, g2o)
* Knowledge of sensor modelling, calibration and noise characteristics
* Experience with real-time processing pipelines on embedded or edge hardware
* Preferred track record of applied research in robotics or AR/VR

Compensation may vary within the posted range based on relevant experience, skills, education, and other job-related factors. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for equity and other forms of compensation. Eligible employees also receive a competitive benefits package, including unlimited PTO.  
  
Rivet is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law. Certain roles may require U.S. Person status, security clearance eligibility, or other requirements imposed by law or government contract.

Compensation Range: $210K - $300K

We are the global leader in ecommerce, on a mission to make every transaction more relevant. We've built our business around the Transaction Moment™, the span from cart to confirmation where customer attention and intent peak, and where more than 90% of a business's ancillary revenue potential sits untapped.

The Rokt Brain leverages advanced machine learning to determine the next best action for every customer in real time across the Rokt Network, powering 13 billion transactions a year for brands like: Live Nation, Fanatics, Macy's, AMC Theatres, PayPal, Uber, Hulu, Albertsons and more. Since 2012 we've grown from a Sydney startup, to a $3.5B company with 700+ Rokt'stars across eight offices and 15 markets, sustaining a Compound Annual Growth Rate of 40%+ for over a decade.

At Rokt, we practice transparency in career paths and compensation,
which is why we have a well-defined career ladder with clear compensation and career paths based on competency and ability.

Compensation for this role is ~$50.48/hour. In addition, you will receive a generous technology allowance to spend on a Macbook Pro M5 + accessories: yours to keep after the residency.

If you secure a full-time offer post-residency, total target compensation will be $127,000, including a fixed annual salary of $120,000, employee equity plan grant (RSUs), and world-class benefits.

This is the expected pay for the role. Final compensation is determined by the level assessed through the interview process and based on how your experience and skills map to our career ladder.

About The Role

The Rokt Residency is an 18 week, full-time, paid early-career program for software engineers working out of our office in New York City .

This cohort of residencies will run from January 12th 2027 through to May 18th 2027.

Residents will have the opportunity to receive full-time offers to join Rokt as Builders on the completion of their residency.

We are an AI-first company. We're a team of builders. That means the person who spots the problem is usually the person who fixes it, and "someone should build a tool for that" is treated as a volunteer sign-up sheet. We use AI and automation tools to move faster, and expect you to figure things out when the path isn't obvious. If you prefer established processes and clearly defined lanes, you probably won't like it here.

Rokt Builders use AI coding agents to write, test, and review code, which means a small team ships what used to take a large one. Teams use AI to investigate production issues, generate test coverage, and prototype new features in hours instead of weeks. Residents get the same enterprise AI tools from day one and are expected to use them to build faster.

How You Will Contribute

Build and deploy production services and features on a Rokt engineering team, from prototype through to release.
Use AI tools and automation to speed up coding, testing, and deployment.
Find performance bottlenecks and use data to improve systems that run at the scale of billions of transactions.
Work with product managers, designers, and senior Builders to ship features that drive revenue for Rokt and its partners.
Deliver measurable contribution to your team by the end of the Residency.

Requirements

Software engineering experience, including internships, personal projects, open-source work, or hackathons.
Strong computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, and how to write clean, tested code
Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python, Go, TypeScript, Java, or C#
Evidence that you have built and shipped something real, such as a project, product, or tool that other people use
Hands-on experience using AI coding tools to build software
Ability to work in fast-paced teams
Constantly looking for new ways to improve and accelerate a function
Availability to work full time in the office in New York, for the full 18 weeks.

Benefits

About Rokt'stars:

We move fast and decide with incomplete information, because a good decision this week can lead to a perfect one next quarter. We work as one team, which means the best idea wins regardless of who raised it or what level they are. We hire people who are brilliant and humble and who are obsessed with making the customer successful.

Benefits From Day One

Every employee has enterprise access to leading AI tools with generous usage limits, building AI fluency as a core skill.
Catered lunch every day and a fully stocked pantry
Dog-friendly offices so you can bring your best friend to work
Generous Required Technology Allowance

Job Details

Transport Network Automation Engineer
Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Transport Network Automation Engineer to design, develop, and maintain an end-to-end network automation framework that transforms engineering designs into validated, device-specific configurations and controlled production deployments.
This role will integrate Cisco Modeling Labs (CML) for network simulation and design validation, Robot Framework for automated testing, and Cisco Catalyst Center for production inventory, templating, provisioning, assurance, and compliance.
The ideal candidate combines deep enterprise networking expertise with strong network automation skills and will help improve the repeatability, reliability, security, and traceability of multi-site network deployments while reducing manual configuration and engineering effort.
Key Responsibilities
Network Design & Automation
Partner with Network and Transport Solution Engineers to translate network designs, diagrams, and technical requirements into structured, machine-readable data.
Develop and maintain data models for sites, devices, interfaces, IP addressing, VLANs, routing, QoS, security, management, and monitoring.
Identify incomplete, conflicting, or invalid design information before configuration generation and deployment.
Establish standardized design inputs, naming conventions, validation rules, and reusable automation patterns.
Separate common configurations from site-specific, device-specific, and platform-dependent requirements.
Maintain end-to-end traceability from network design through testing, deployment, and production validation.

Cisco Modeling Labs (CML)
Automate CML lab creation, configuration, startup, testing, and teardown using APIs and approved automation tools.
Map logical network devices and interfaces to appropriate CML virtual nodes and links.
Generate and apply configurations to CML environments for pre-production validation.
Identify configuration errors, addressing issues, routing problems, missing variables, and design defects before production deployment.
Validate routing adjacencies, VLANs, trunking, management connectivity, route propagation, inter-site connectivity, and expected failure scenarios.
Capture logs, test results, configuration snapshots, software images, and lab information for engineering documentation and audit purposes.
Identify functionality that requires physical-hardware validation when virtualization cannot fully reproduce platform-specific behavior.

Robot Framework & Automated Testing
Integrate Robot Framework testing into the network validation lifecycle.
Develop parameterized automated tests using approved network design and device data.
Build positive, negative, regression, resiliency, smoke, integration, and acceptance tests.
Automate validation of routing, connectivity, configuration completeness, management-plane controls, and expected operational states.
Publish test results and associate them with applicable designs, lab environments, template versions, and deployment packages.
Build repeatable regression testing environments for network templates and automation changes.

Cisco Catalyst Center
Develop, organize, version, and maintain Cisco Catalyst Center configuration templates.
Create reusable, modular, and platform-aware templates for Cisco network devices.
Define template variables, mandatory fields, dependencies, allowed values, and validation rules.
Generate device-specific and site-specific configuration inputs from approved engineering data.
Map sites, device roles, hardware platforms, software releases, and configuration requirements to appropriate templates.
Use Catalyst Center APIs and SDKs to retrieve and manage inventory, sites, templates, devices, compliance information, assurance data, and deployment status.
Automate controlled provisioning workflows while maintaining required approvals, change controls, and audit records.
Support configuration compliance, drift detection, remediation, and post-deployment validation.

Network Automation & Orchestration
Develop orchestration workflows connecting network design data, CML topology creation, automated testing, and production deployment.
Establish a common source of truth to minimize manual data entry across engineering documents, labs, testing platforms, templates, and production systems.
Ensure only approved and successfully validated configuration artifacts progress into production.
Implement automated unit, integration, regression, and network-functional testing.
Develop preflight checks, dry-run capabilities, approval gates, maintenance-window controls, and device reachability validation.
Support configuration backups, deployment sequencing, concurrency controls, retry policies, rollback, and recovery procedures.
Design automation to safely handle partial deployments, connectivity failures, unsuccessful tasks, and devices requiring manual intervention.
Ensure automation is repeatable, auditable, and does not unintentionally overwrite unrelated network configurations.

Engineering Collaboration & Technical Leadership
Serve as a technical bridge between network engineering, architecture, cybersecurity, deployment, and operations teams.
Guide engineers in creating automation-ready network designs and complete implementation packages.
Troubleshoot and explain network design issues, automation failures, test failures, template behavior, platform limitations, and deployment risks.
Recommend network and configuration standardization to reduce unnecessary complexity.
Perform root-cause analysis across design, data, automation, testing, platform, and operational issues.
Develop technical documentation, implementation guidance, troubleshooting procedures, and knowledge-transfer materials.
Provide technical mentoring and peer review to other engineers.

Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Typically 8–12 years of relevant professional experience with a bachelor’s degree or 6–10 years with a master’s degree.
Extensive experience with enterprise networking, including routing, switching, LAN/WAN, data center networking, carrier transport, or network architecture.
Strong understanding of IPv4/IPv6, OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, IS-IS, static routing, route redistribution, summarization, filtering, path selection, and routing policies.
Experience leading complex technical implementations, migrations, modernization initiatives, or engineering workstreams.
Experience across the engineering lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, integration, testing, implementation, documentation, deployment, and transition to operations.
Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues spanning multiple systems, technologies, devices, or locations.
Experience with network automation, infrastructure-as-code, APIs, source control, configuration validation, and automated testing.
Experience providing technical leadership, mentoring, peer review, or training to engineering teams.

Preferred Technical Experience
Hands-on experience with Cisco Modeling Labs (CML).
Experience with Cisco Catalyst Center configuration templates, APIs, provisioning, assurance, and compliance.
Experience developing automated network tests using Robot Framework or comparable automation/testing frameworks.
Experience with API-driven network automation and orchestration.
Experience with configuration templating and structured network data models.

Experience working across laboratory, integration, staging, and production network environments.
Experience with network modernization, hardware refreshes, end-of-support remediation, site migrations, data center migrations, carrier transitions, or technology consolidation.

Preferred Certifications
Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) Enterprise or comparable advanced networking certification.
Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert (CCIE) Enterprise Infrastructure is beneficial but not required.
Juniper, Arista, Nokia, Ciena, or comparable network/transport certifications.

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

  

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

*The Anduril Rocket Motor Systems (RMS) team is on a mission to build next generation solid rocket motors for a safer, more connected world. To achieve our vision of becoming a large-volume provider of tactical rocket motors, we will develop differentiated products and services that maximize our customers' capabilities, and we will establish and maintain a reputation of Quality and Reliability.*  
  
**ABOUT THE JOB**  
  
As the Sr. Electrical Engineer, you will specify, design, develop and install devices used to collect data on solid rocket motor burn performance. Additionally, you will design custom electronic solutions—including PCBs, firmware, and FPGA code—needed to manufacture and test solid rocket motors, which will include working with integrated safety-critical designs. This position also requires the ability to configure data collection systems and develop software applications used to collect the data. It is expected that you may oversee technicians during the instrumentation installation and during rocket motor testing/development. The right person for this role has direct, hands-on experience with the design, development, and installation of sensors used to collect a variety of metrics related to testing of solid rocket motors. If you are a hands-on leader, have an entrepreneurial spirit, and enjoy being the point person for collecting valuable performance data, then this role is for you. You will assist in the testing solid rocket motors which will include working with integrated safety designs used to initiate the motor.

#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Collaborates with other engineers to develop accurate, efficient equipment and instrumentation in accordance with safety and usability standards and client expectations.
* Collaborates with other electrical engineers to execute the safe arming and initiation of rocket motors under test.

* Proven experience in safety-critical hardware design, incorporating multi-fault tolerance, arm/fire inhibits, safe bleed-down circuits, and inadvertent initiation mitigation.
* Experience in high-voltage PCB layout and circuit design for motor initiation, including capacitor charging/discharge circuits, high peak-current switching, and creepage/clearance management
* Experience with the design, development, and installation of sensors employed to collect data on system performance.
* NI Labview or NI DAQmx experience or familiar with other COTS data acquisition systems
* Thorough understanding of signal conditioning for data acquisition, i.e. analog circuit design
* Intimate knowledge of the analog to digital conversion process, i.e. digital circuit design

* Able to select the correct sensors and design the placement of them to acquire the needed solid rocket motor performance metrics.

#### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Advanced degree in engineering
* Experience with circuit simulation tools (spice)

jobs.title: System Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Tacit**

We are an early-stage, deep tech startup based in San Francisco, developing innovative hardware that rethinks human-computer interaction. We are backed by General Catalyst, Khosla Ventures, and Greylock Partners, with a founding team from Stanford, BrainGate, Oculus, and Tesla. While we can’t reveal too much just yet, our team is tackling cutting-edge engineering challenges to bring revolutionary products to life.

**About the role**
------------------

We're looking for a **System Electrical Engineer** to validate, debug, and improve the core electrical blocks of our next-generation sensing hardware. You'll sit between design and validation: you'll bring up prototypes on the bench, find out how each architectural block really performs, root-cause what doesn't, and feed those findings back into the next schematic and layout.

Your work spans the product from prototype to mass production: bring-up, design updates, and test implementation. The goal of each design cycle is better performance, lower power, and smaller area. As our products move toward production, there is room to grow into supporting builds with our contract manufacturers.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Bench validation and characterization

  + Bring up prototype boards and get them to a stable, measurable state.
  + Write and run validation plans for architectural blocks: power rails, battery charging and power management, high-speed interfaces, sensor front ends, and mixed-signal paths.
  + Characterize blocks across voltage, load, temperature, and operating modes, and compare results against design intent.
* Debug and root cause

  + Run systematic debug across analog, digital, and power domains using oscilloscopes, logic and protocol analyzers, spectrum analyzers, power supplies, electronic loads, and current probes.
  + Root-cause issues such as rail noise and ripple, signal integrity problems, noise coupling into sensitive analog paths, unexpected resets, and excess power draw.
  + Separate real failures from measurement artifacts, and back conclusions with data.
* Design improvement for performance, power, and area

  + Turn validation findings into concrete schematic and layout changes for the next prototype cycle.
  + Own schematic and PCB updates for the blocks you validate, working with the senior hardware team on architecture and component choices.
  + Find savings in power consumption, quiescent current, board area, and component count without losing performance.
* Test implementation, yield, and reliability

  + Build repeatable bench test setups and automate measurements where it speeds up learning.
  + Use statistics across units and builds to set limits, spot outliers, and track yield.
  + Run reliability and stress testing, and feed failure findings back into the design. Over time, help turn bench tests into production tests and support builds with contract manufacturers.
* Cross-functional work

  + Work closely with mechanical, firmware, and software engineers on bring-up, debug, and design trade-offs.
  + Write clear validation reports and debug summaries that drive design decisions.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* **3+ years of experience** in electrical engineering, hardware design, or hardware validation.
* Strong EE fundamentals: analog and mixed-signal circuits, power conversion and regulation, signal integrity, power integrity, and grounding.
* Strong hands-on debug skills, with a track record of root-causing hardware issues on real boards.
* Hands-on experience with board bring-up and lab instruments such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, power supplies, electronic loads, and probes.
* Experience with schematic capture and PCB design for multi-layer boards, in Altium Designer or an equivalent tool.
* Working knowledge of high-speed interfaces such as USB, Quad-SPI, MIPI, or DDR, and low-speed buses such as I2C, SPI, and UART.
* Experience with power and battery systems: DC-DC converters, LDOs, PMICs, and Li ion/Li-poly charging.
* Ability to write clear validation plans and reports.
* Comfortable working in a fast-moving startup where engineers own large parts of the hardware.

**Strong candidates may have**
------------------------------

* Python or similar scripting for lab automation and instrument control (PyVISA, SCPI).
* Embedded firmware experience in C/C++, enough to add test hooks and diagnostics.
* Background in signal integrity and power integrity simulation, using tools such as HyperLynx, Ansys SIwave, or Cadence Sigrity.
* Familiarity with RF circuits and components.
* Experience with wearable, body-worn, or battery-powered devices with tight power, size, and thermal limits.
* Experience with low-noise analog front ends, biopotential sensing, or other sensitive sensor interfaces.
* Statistical analysis of test data across units and builds, such as yield, limits, and outlier detection.
* Production test exposure: test fixtures, boundary scan/JTAG, ICT, or calibration flows. Experience supporting EVT, DVT, or PVT builds with contract manufacturers.
* Familiarity with EMI/EMC pre-compliance testing and reliability or environmental testing.

**Success in this role looks like**
-----------------------------------

* Each prototype is brought up quickly, and its key blocks are measured and understood.
* Hardware issues are caught early and root-caused with data, not guesswork.
* Each design cycle shows measurable gains in performance, power, or board area.
* Validation plans cover the real technical risks, and bench results match how the product behaves in use.
* Bench tests become repeatable and automated, ready to carry into production test as builds ramp.

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive equity package
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Company size: 40-60 people
* Unlimited PTO
* Visa sponsorship
* 4% 401k matching

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Systems ML
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a Software Engineer to join the MTIA (Meta Training & Inference Accelerator) Software Tooling team, which develops and maintains the tooling ecosystem for Meta's in-house AI accelerator ASICs. The Tooling team provides debugging, profiling, memory analysis, and monitoring capabilities for the whole MTIA Ecosystem, redefining ML accelerator tooling by leveraging Meta's full-stack ownership from silicon specs to fleet observability.In this role, you will design and build developer tools across the MTIA tooling ecosystem, with a primary focus on debugging, sanitizer technology, and fault isolation for AI workloads running on MTIA hardware at scale. You will work at the intersection of compilers, runtime, hardware, and ML frameworks, collaborating with cross-functional partners to deliver a high-quality developer experience for Meta's custom AI accelerators.  
  
  

### **Software Engineer, Systems ML Responsibilities:**

* Lead the design and development of MTIA's profiling and debugging tooling, including performance profiling, live debugging, and core dump for accelerator workloads
* Build tooling capabilities spanning performance profiling, kernel-level diagnostics, and multi-rank fault isolation
* Contribute broadly to the MTIA SW tooling infrastructure — profiling, performance debugging, memory analysis, monitoring, and reliability analysis for training and inference workloads
* Own significant components end-to-end, from technical design through implementation, production rollout, and long-term maintenance
* Collaborate closely with the MTIA compiler, runtime, kernel, and hardware teams to instrument the software stack with the hooks, sanitizers, and debuggers that are required
* Drive AI-native tooling approaches, leveraging automation and LLM-guided diagnostics to reduce time-to-root-cause
* Partner with internal product teams across advertising, recommendations, and generative AI to understand developer pain points and prioritize tooling investments
* Communicate architectural decisions through design documents and cross-team reviews
* share debugging methodology and best practices with engineers across the MTIA stack

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, a relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 4+ years of experience in systems software engineering, performance engineering, developer tooling, or a closely related field
* Experience building debugging, sanitiser, profiling, or diagnostic tools for complex software/hardware systems
* Proficiency in C++ and Python, including low-level systems programming and scripting for tool automation
* Experience working across multiple layers of a system stack (compiler, runtime, OS/driver, hardware)
* Track record of leading the technical design and delivery of tooling or infrastructure projects through to production deployment
* Experience debugging issues across application, runtime, and hardware boundaries, with the ability to trace issues across application, runtime, and hardware boundaries

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience with Linux kernel and driver-level debugging, hands-on experience with sanitizer and dynamic-analysis technology, or building comparable memory checking tools
* Experience working at the device-software boundary — accelerator runtime/driver internals, DMA and memory-mapped device behavior, on-device fault handling or firmware-assisted error reporting

* Experience with compiler-based instrumentation and runtime shadow-memory techniques underlying sanitizers (LLVM instrumentation passes, interceptors, allocator red zones)
* Track record of building developer tools adopted by large engineering populations, ideally with contributions to open-source projects (LLVM sanitizers, gdb, Valgrind, Triton, etc.)
* Bachelor's degree + 5+ years, Master's degree + 3+ years, or PhD + 2+ years in systems software, developer tooling, or accelerator software development

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. **Why Freeform?**

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer- Infrastructure and Security
jobs.description:
**We believe power is a promise - a shared commitment to be there for others when it matters most.**
====================================================================================================

For more than 65 years, we've turned big ideas into solutions that help protect homes, strengthen businesses and build a more resilient, efficient, sustainable energy future.

Ready to Power a Smarter World with us?

We believe power is a promise - a shared commitment to be there for others when it matters most. For more than 65 years, we've turned big ideas into solutions that help protect homes, strengthen businesses and build a more resilient, efficient, sustainable energy future. Ready to Power a Smarter World with us?

The Home Software Platform (HSP) is the shared cloud foundation behind Generac's connected home energy products - PWRcell, PWRmicro, HSB Generator, Load Management, and HEMS. As a Senior Staff Software Engineer focused on Infrastructure and Security, you will shape how that platform is architected and defended: designing the cloud infrastructure behind Generac's home energy software - the applications, services, data, and connected devices it spans - and embedding security into every layer of it. You will work closely with SRE and engineering teams to lead and influence technical direction across the platform. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role with organization-wide technical influence.

**Responsibilities:**

* Provide architectural leadership and direct technical influence over HSP-wide infrastructure decisions on AWS, defining the patterns, guardrails, and reference architectures that engineering teams build on across the platform.
* Design scalable, resilient, cost-efficient infrastructure for a high-volume cloud platform - APIs and services, data and streaming pipelines, compute and storage, and device-to-cloud data flows.
* Help shape infrastructure-as-code standards (Terraform, AWS CDK, or equivalent) so that environments are reproducible, reviewable, and auditable end to end.
* Drive the platform's security posture as a first-class design concern: threat modeling, secrets management, network segmentation, and data protection for device and consumer data.
* Lead cloud security architecture across the AWS account structure: IAM boundaries, least-privilege access, encryption in transit and at rest, key management, and tamper-evident audit logging.
* Partner with SRE teams to strengthen the observability and reliability backbone - metrics, tracing, logging, alerting, and SLOs.
* Partner with product engineering teams to review designs, unblock hard infrastructure and security problems, and raise the bar on operational and secure-coding practices through mentorship and technical leadership.
* Contribute to multi-year platform architecture and technology strategy, translating platform capabilities into concrete, buildable infrastructure and security roadmaps.
* Lead build-vs-buy evaluations for infrastructure and security tooling, and guide the technical integration of selected third-party services.
* Partner with SRE teams to drive cost visibility and optimization across the cloud estate without compromising reliability or security.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10+ years of progressive software engineering experience, with a substantial focus on cloud infrastructure and platform engineering.
* Deep, hands-on expertise architecting production systems on a major public cloud, preferably AWS.
* Several years of hands-on security engineering across secure architecture, identity and access management, and threat modeling, applied to large-scale distributed systems.
* Strong proficiency with infrastructure-as-code, containers and orchestration, CI/CD, and modern observability tooling.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Deep familiarity with the AWS security and networking stack (IAM, KMS, VPC design, GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail, Config, WAF).
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code at scale using Terraform and/or AWS CDK, including module design and policy-as-code guardrails.
* Track record of building high-volume distributed cloud platforms; experience with device-to-cloud patterns (OTA update, edge computing, telemetry pipelines) is a plus.
* Experience securing consumer data and connected-device fleets, including relevant privacy and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar).
* Proficiency with container orchestration (Kubernetes / EKS) and event-driven and streaming architectures.
* Practitioner-level experience building or deploying AI/LLM-powered applications and tooling, including hands-on use of Claude via Amazon Bedrock.
* Familiarity with the home energy domain - HEMS, demand response, utility APIs, and grid-services integrations.
* Strong technical-communication skills: able to translate complex infrastructure and security trade-offs into clear, actionable narratives for engineering teams and technical stakeholders.
* A track record of raising engineering standards through mentorship, design review, and pragmatic technical leadership.

Generac is committed to fair and equity compensation practices. The salary range for this role based in Pewaukee, WI is $141,400 - $190,900. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidate's relevant work experience, skills, certifications and geographic location. This position includes a comprehensive benefit package that includes medical, dental and vision plans; life, long-term disability, flexible, spending and health savings accounts, accrued paid time off, eight paid holidays in 401(k) retirement benefits.

**Job Description**

**Controls / Process Automation Engineer III**

**Pay Range**: $87,000 - $118,000 depending on relevant experience and qualifications

**Location**: North Venice, FL 34275

The Process Automation Engineer provides ownership or custodian support for site process automation and data collection systems for PGT Venice manufacturing operations. Partnering with operations, engineering, IT, and maintenance functions will be critical to effectively supporting these site systems. This position provides technical mentoring and coaching for the process automation staff. This position requires direct technical support of process automation systems and projects

**Responsibilities**

Manage and oversee 24/7 support of site process automation and data collection systems for manufacturing and utilities systems

* Own the commissioning and qualification process for process automation systems; develop and ensure compliance with established local quality standards
* Develop, maintain, and implement the process automation functional agenda for the site
* Ensure function is aligned and driven to meet engineering goals, and partner with Quality, Engineering, and Operations leadership to deliver operational results
* Function as system owner for exclusive process automation systems not assigned to other engineering or operations functions
* Assign resources to provide system custodianship for site process automation and data collection systems
* Own and manage site procedures and technical standards for the automation function
* Direct and oversee continuous improvement and recapitalization of owned and custodianed systems for the site
* Direct and oversee root cause investigations of owned and custodianed system nonconformances
* Provide management support for automation contractor personnel

**Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor of Science in Engineering: preferably Electrical, Mechanical, or related field, or extensive experience in similar roles
* Minimum 10 years’ manufacturing experience: automation, process, plant, project delivery, or related areas
* Software proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
* Proficiency in programming process automation systems including common PLC and SCADA platforms
* Strong communication and networking skills
* Knowledge of manufacturing safety requirements for automated systems

**Travel requirements**

Ability to travel occasionally domestically (up to 30%)

**Physical demands / Work environment**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Usual office environment with frequent sitting, walking, and standing, and occasional climbing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, crawling, and balancing
* Frequent use of eye, hand, and finger coordination enabling the use of office machinery
* Oral and auditory capacity enabling interpersonal communication as well as communication through automated devices such as the telephone

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Front-end Development/Full Stack)
jobs.description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

**Job Description**
-------------------

This position will be responsible for the analysis, design, testing, development and maintenance of best in class software experiences. The candidate is a self-motivated individual who can collaborate with a team and across the organization. The candidate takes responsibility of the software artifacts produced adhering to U.S. Bank standards in order to ensure minimal impact to the customer experience. The candidate will be adept with the agile software development lifecycle and DevOps principles.  
  
**Essential Responsibilities:**  

* Responsible for designing, developing, testing, operating and maintaining products
* Takes full stack ownership by consistently writing production-ready and testable code
* Consistently creates optimal design adhering to architectural best practices; considers scalability, reliability and performance of systems/contexts affected when defining technical designs
* Performs analysis on failures, propose design changes, and encourage operational improvements
* Makes sound design/coding decisions keeping customer experience in the forefront
* Takes feedback from code review and apply changes to meet standards
* Conducts code reviews to provide guidance on engineering best practices and compliance with development procedures
* Accountable for ensuring all aspects of product development follow compliance and security best practices
* Exhibits relentless focus in software reliability engineering standards embedded into development standards
* Embraces emerging technology opportunities and contributes to the best practices in support of the bank’s technology transformation
* Contributes to a culture of innovation, collaboration and continuous improvement
* Reviews tasks critically and ensures they are appropriately prioritized and sized for incremental delivery; anticipates and communicates blockers and delays before they require escalation

**Basic Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent work experience
* Five to six years of relevant experience

  

**Required Skills**

* **React (18.x), JavaScript (ES6+), and modern front-end development expertis**e.
* Experience building scalable, enterprise web applications using micro frontends and Module Federation.
* **Strong skills in HTML, CSS/SCSS, CSS Modules,** responsive design, and reusable UI components.
* Experience with **state management using Zustand, React Context, and asynchronous data handling.**
* Proficiency integrating **REST APIs, web services, and third-party platforms using Axios.**
* Knowledge of **authentication, MFA integration, and frontend security best practices.**
* Experience developing **accessible, WCAG-compliant,** internationalized, and localized applications.
* Hands-on experience with **Jest, React Testing Library, and Playwright for automated testing.**
* Proficiency with Git for source code management and CI/CD pipelines for deploying code.
* Familiarity with financial applications, payment systems (ACH, RTP, Wire Transfers), and **Java/Spring Boot** environments.
* Familiarity with relational and NoSQL databases.
* Knowledge of AI Functions.

**Location expectations**  
This role requires working from a U.S. Bank location three (3) or more days per week.

  

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants.

**Benefits:**

Our approach to benefits and total rewards considers our team members’ whole selves and what may be needed to thrive in and outside work. That's why our benefits are designed to help you and your family boost your health, protect your financial security and give you peace of mind. Our benefits include the following:

* Healthcare (medical, dental, vision)
* Basic term and optional term life insurance
* Short-term and long-term disability
* Pregnancy disability and parental leave
* 401(k) and employer-funded retirement plan
* Paid vacation (from two to five weeks depending on salary grade and tenure)
* Up to 11 paid holiday opportunities
* Adoption assistance
* Sick and Safe Leave accruals of one hour for every 30 worked, up to 80 hours per calendar year unless otherwise provided by law

Review our full benefits available by employment status here.

U.S. Bank is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or veteran status, and other factors protected under applicable law.

**E-Verify**

U.S. Bank participates in the U.S. Department of Homeland Security E-Verify program in all facilities located in the United States and certain U.S. territories. The E-Verify program is an Internet-based employment eligibility verification system operated by the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services.

U.S. Bank will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment. U.S. Bank conducts background checks consistent with applicable local laws, including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act as well as the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. U.S. Bank is subject to, and conducts background checks consistent with the requirements of Section 19 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act (FDIA). **What You Will Do:**

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

The Cybersecurity Engineering team needs an additional Secure Systems Engineer I. The Cybersecurity Engineering team is a shared services team that supports the development of products throughout the Avionics Strategic Business Unit wherever the customer has security requirements, or the system is exposed to cyber threats by it’s connectivity or operational use. We develop tools and testing techniques to highlight residual defects in product design or implementation. These defects can lead to vulnerabilities that negatively impact the confidentiality, integrity, or availability of a system. Members of the security engineering team pursue security excellence by embedding with the design and implementation teams as subject matter experts supporting our Secure System Development Life Cycle (SSDLC).

Supporting this Cyber Security Engineering team’s mission involves: developing threat models and information flow architectures to ensure data can be properly isolated in motion and while at rest, implementing mandatory access controls (MAC) through the development of Security Enhanced Linux (SELinux) policies, developing and executing fuzzing and penetration tests to evaluate the robustness of the exposed attack surface, reviewing code to identify weaknesses in the implementation of security functions, and conducting vulnerabilities assessments of proposed and in-service systems.

  

* Developing and executing fuzzing and robustness tests to evaluate a products attack surface
* Conducting vulnerability assessments of proposed and in-service systems
* Embedding with development teams to address product security concerns
* Developing threat model / data flow diagrams to ensure data can be properly isolated in motion and at rest
* Assisting w/ implementing mandatory access controls (MAC) through the development of SELinux policies
* Assisting with creation of security documentation to support Airworthiness Certification

**Qualifications You Must Have:**

* Requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM).
* Coding experience in C++ or Python
* Familiarity with Linux OS

**Qualifications We Prefer:**

* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with a demonstrated passion for the field.
* Completed coursework or personal projects focusing on embedded systems security.
* Experience with embedded system integration and testing.
* Understanding of IP networking architectures and concepts.
* Knowledge of version control systems (e.g., Git).
* Proficiency in the Microsoft Office Tool Suite.

jobs.description:
DCCA is a veteran-owned IT business specializing in providing innovative solutions to a variety of government agencies and commercial enterprises since 1982. DCCA is proud to offer career growth opportunities and a competitive compensation and benefits package. Visit our website at: www.dcca.com

Systems Engineering

Candidate must have an active TS/SCI w/Poly

For over 40 years, DCCA has provided a broad range of IT services to government agencies and commercial enterprises, helping them to feel confident in their IT infrastructure. With DCCA, these organizations can be confident in the flexibility and skill of their IT partners, allowing them to upgrade their technology quickly and efficiently. Better yet, thanks to DCCA’s successful track record, clients can rest assured knowing DCCA can tackle any problem with ease, allowing them to focus on the work that matters.

Internally, DCCA prides itself on a culture built on integrity and inclusivity, allowing its employees to build lasting skills and relationships. As a veteran owned business, DCCA knows the importance of recruiting employees with a wide range of backgrounds, allowing for every problem to be approached by a diverse array of perspectives. Join us and be part of a team that has a people first mentality and a dedication to excellence.

Key Tasks:

* Support the operation and maintenance of system engineering architecture/design. Analyzes user's requirements, concept of operations documents and high level system architectures to develop system requirements specifications. Analyzes system requirements and leads design and development activities. Guides users in formulating requirements, advises alternative approaches, and conducts feasibility studies. Provides technical leadership for the integration of requirements, design, and technology. Incorporates new plans, designs and systems into ongoing operation.
* Develops technical documentation, system architecture and system design documentation. Guides system development and implementation planning through assessment or preparation of system engineering management plans and system integration and test plan.Communicate with other program personnel, government overseers, and senior executives.
* Manage system requirements and derived requirements to ensure the delivery of production systems that are compatible with the defined system architectures(s) - Department of Defense Architecture Framework (DoDAF).
* Assist with the development of system requirements functional requirements and allocation of the same to individual hardware, software, facility and personnel components
* Coordinate the resolution of action items from Configuration Control Board (CCB) meetings, design reviews, program reviews and test reviews that require cross-discipline coordination
* Analyze and implement key interface control documents by tracing to ground requirements and design
* Support trade studies, performance analyses, risk and opportunity assessments
* Oversee and guide the management of ground segment capabilities/requirements – allocation, verification, and validation
* Provide support to software development and cyber security initiatives
* Analysis and establishment of verification attributes for requirements/capabilities (Verification Test method, level, approach, success criteria, and Test Requirements).
* Use case development, and trace artifacts to architecture constructs
* Provide leadership / mentorship of technical teams to define, direct implementation, and operate complex systems
* Provide engineering support across multiple and diverse mission partners by tailoring concepts to meet mission partner needs
* Prepare and give presentations to peers/management/customers
* Work collaboratively in a cross-discipline environment with both the internal and external customers to maintain a positive and productive work environment

Required Education / Certifications:

* Associate Engineer (CT7): Entry-level to experienced, but still a learner typically with an advanced degree and 0 years experience or bachelors degree and 0-2+ years experience or equivalent
* Engineer 1 (CT8): Career level typically with an advanced degree and 3+ years experience or bachelors with 5+ years experience or equivalent
  
* Senior Engineer (CT9): Emerging authority typically with an advanced degree and 7+ years experience or bachelors with 9+ years experience or equivalent; applies extensive expertise

  

* Principal Engineer (CT10): Expert, authority in discipline typically with an advanced degree and 12+ years experience or bachelors with 14+ years experience or equivalent

  

* Engineer Consultant (CT11): Senior consultant to top management typically with an advanced degree and 18+ years experience or bachelors with 20+ years experience or equivalent

The proposed salary range for this position in Maryland is 75,000 to 260,000. Final salary will be determined based on various factors. Our comprehensive benefit offerings include healthcare, retirement plan, paid disability and life insurance programs, employee assistance program, paid and unpaid leave programs, education assistance, and wellness initiatives.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**Location:**Stevensville, MD/ Columbia, MD  
**Type:** Onsite  
**Travel:** 10%

  

**About Us:**  
Sealing Technologies, a Parsons company, innovates and delivers high-performance deployable anywhere technologies that push what's possible at the edge, enabling organizations across the globe to solve complex challenges with speed and confidence. We design, engineer, and deliver products and deployable technologies built for environments where traditional infrastructure falls short.

  

**Position Overview:**  
Sealing Technologies, a Parsons Company, is looking for an experienced and talented Systems Engineer to join our team of engineers delivering cutting-edge solutions. In this role, you will contribute to engineering efforts spanning hardware and software integration, systems engineering, and security engineering, working directly with internal teams and customers to define system architecture, drive engineering change requests, and execute implementation plans that deliver mission outcomes.

This position is based onsite at the Enterprise Modernization Center (EMC) in Stevensville, MD, with periodic visits to our headquarters in Columbia, MD as needed. Travel to a customer site in Virginia is also required on a quarterly basis.  
  
**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Perform BOM analysis.
* Receive BOMs from the customer and evaluate requests against current warehouse inventory.
* Create pick orders in Flowtrac.
* When a description is provided instead of a SKU, research viable options online, prioritizing TAA-compliant products. Notify the customer when non-TAA options must be used.
* Perform new product analysis and assist the customer in exploring new products as requested, providing both procurement and technical insight.
* Coordinate procurement and warehouse operations to ensure stock is maintained and pick orders are fulfilled; provide feedback to the customer weekly or as requested.
* Develop consistent Flowtrac operational processes and write SOPs to track those processes.
* Communicate effectively with the Prime contract and end customer.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* U.S. Citizenship.
* 5 years of experience in systems engineering (server hardware), systems architecture, and network security architecture.
* 2 years of experience with current defensive cyberspace TTPs.
* Knowledge and experience with network protocols, virtualization, architecture design, and defense-in-depth practices.
* Knowledge of server hardware including initial setup/installation, testing, and configuration.
* Understanding of infrastructure security, hardening processes, techniques, and industry best practices.
* Experience writing SOPs for operational or logistics processes.
* Experience performing BOM analysis and evaluating material requests against inventory.

jobs.title: Firmware Architect & Subsystem Technical Leader, Acacia
jobs.description:
Meet the Team
  
  
Acacia (part of Cisco) is the industry market leader and pioneer in high-speed coherent optical transceivers and pluggable optical interconnects. Acacia’s groundbreaking coherent optical solutions are deployed across all hyperscaler cloud providers and telecommunications networks, interconnecting data centers across metropolitan spans, thousands of kilometers of terrestrial fiber, and deep submarine links.
  
  
With the explosive growth of artificial intelligence and machine learning workloads driving unprecedented bandwidth requirements, Acacia products are expanding into data center fabrics and high-performance compute clusters. In addition to powering deep-space optical communication systems, Acacia leads the client-side optics market with breakthrough PAM4 DSP architectures, including 1.6T PAM4 DSP platforms.
  
  
Joining Acacia’s Software team means collaborating with world-class engineers to push boundaries of optical networking.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
As an Embedded Software Engineering Technical Leader for this team, you will serve as a principal firmware architect guiding the embedded CPU software architecture that configures, manages, and optimizes Acacia’s transceiver subsystems and future System-on-Chip (SOC) architectures.
  
  
**In this high-impact technical leadership role, you will:**  

* Lead end-to-end architecture, design, and implementation of high-reliability, low-latency embedded firmware for multi-core microcontrollers (ARM Cortex-R and Cortex-M).
* Partner directly with ASIC, DSP, Optical, and Hardware Engineering architects to co-design hardware/software interfaces, configure complex optical subsystems, and resolve critical hardware-software boundary challenges.
* Architect robust multi-threaded control-plane firmware, Board Support Packages (BSPs), device drivers, and real-time state machines on bare-metal and RTOS platforms.
* Establish best-in-class firmware engineering standards, mentor senior and intermediate engineers across the software organization, and drive multi-functional alignment from high-level system modeling down to low-level register and bit-level implementation.
* Provide technical direction and intermediate leadership runway to help scale our growing engineering presence in the community.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field with 12+ years of professional experience to include:
  
  

* 10+ years in low-level embedded C and C++ programming for resource-constrained hardware environments.
* 8+ years architecting and developing real-time embedded firmware on bare-metal systems and real-time operating systems (RTOS such as VxWorks, FreeRTOS, ThreadX, or similar).
* Experience crafting lfirmware for ARM processors/microcontrollers (such as ARM Cortex-M or Cortex-R cores), including BSPs, device drivers and hardware peripheral interfaces (I2C, SPI, UART, MDIO).
* Ability to work 100% onsite in Maynard, MA during the initial one-year onboarding period (with hybrid flexibility available thereafter).

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Firmware architecture for optical transceivers, high-speed mixed-signal ICs, photonics, or telecommunications transmission hardware.
* Development of control-plane software, state machines, and multi-processor/multithreaded communication protocols.
* Successful leadership of firmware engineering projects and collaborating across ASIC design, DSP modeling, Hardware, and SQA teams.
* Proficiency with modern version control and CI/CD tools (Git, Jira, Perforce) and automation scripting (Python, Shell).
* Experience in semiconductor/hardware environments or engagement with optical industry standards bodies (e.g., OIF, IEEE).

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

jobs.title: Forward-deployed Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**
--------------------

GripFusion is building the next generation of sports performance technology with Tactile Intelligence. As our Forward-Deployed Software Engineer, you will expand every surface where GripFusion meets the athlete, from the ForceBall to the iPad, mobile, and web experiences that turn tactile data into decisions.

This is a product-facing engineering role reporting to Will Shawn, Head of Software. You will work across the full stack, spend time with players and coaches to understand how they use novel tactile data, and turn what you learn into shipped product. You will bring design and athlete thinking to every decision.

You will work alongside our product, embedded, data science, and design teams to build new visualizations, connect GripFusion to the systems our customers already use, and carry common design practices across our baseball and golf platforms.

**What You'll Build**
---------------------

* **The iPad app.** Extend and harden our primary product, built in React Native on an AWS backend and used by teams today.
* **The web dashboard.** Build a new React dashboard where coaches and staff review sessions, compare athletes, and share insights.
* **The mobile** **app.** Build a mobile app that communicates directly with the ForceBall and supports broader use cases at the field.
* **Novel visualizations.** Invent new ways to show tactile and athlete data, including 3D graphics that make the invisible obvious.
* **Integrations.** Pull in data from the other systems teams already use, so GripFusion fits naturally into their workflow.
* **The golf platform.** Contribute to our golf product and carry common design patterns and components across baseball and golf.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Work across the full stack, from BLE device communication and cloud services to mobile and web interfaces.
* Partner with players, coaches, and team staff to understand user needs and how they interact with tactile data.
* Balance quick prototyping and discovery with production-level engineering, testing, and deployment.
* Work with design to shape the user experience, and establish shared design practices across verticals.
* Partner with embedded and data science to define device data transmission, state handling, and data formats.
* Visit MLB teams to test with athletes and coaches, and bring product thinking back to the software stack.
* Use AI development tools every day, and help shape how the software team builds with them.

**Desired Skills & Qualifications**
-----------------------------------

* 4+ years shipping production software across mobile and web, ideally with React Native, React, and TypeScript.
* Full-stack experience, including cloud backends on AWS and the CI/CD and release pipelines that get apps to users.
* A track record of working directly with clients, users, or stakeholders to shape what gets built.
* Daily, hands-on use of AI coding tools and agentic workflows.
* Experience with hardware systems, Bluetooth or other device data transmission, and device state diagrams (preferred).
* Offline-first mobile architecture and on-device data analysis (preferred).
* Data visualization or 3D graphics on web or mobile, such as three.js, WebGL, or React Three Fiber (preferred).
* Experience integrating third-party data sources and APIs (preferred).
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* **An owner.** You take product and technical ownership end to end, from first conversation to shipped feature.
* **A builder who explores.** You love quick prototypes and discovery, but you know when a prototype needs to become a product.
* **Product- and design-minded.** You care about how an experience feels, not just whether it works.
* **An athlete at heart.** You have competed or coached, and you understand how players train, compete, and take feedback.
* **A great communicator.** You are as comfortable in a clubhouse with players and coaches as you are in a code review.
* **AI-first.** You embrace AI tools as a core part of how you design, build, and ship.

**Impact & Growth**
-------------------

This role is designed to grow with the company. You will shape how GripFusion shows up for athletes and coaches across every surface we build. As our baseball and golf platforms expand, you will have a seat at the table on product direction, design practices, and how our AI-first engineering team works.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

* **Base salary:** $110,000 to $145,000, commensurate with experience.
* **Equity:** 0.1% to 0.25%.
* **Benefits:** Healthcare, dental, vision, and retirement matching.

**Work Environment**
--------------------

* Full-time, in-person role based at GripFusion's Performance Lab headquarters in Ann Arbor, MI, including our in-house pitching lab, with up to 10% travel to MLB/NCAA teams and partners.
* Collaborative, innovation-first startup environment working across hardware, firmware, software, design, and data science.
* Direct access to leadership and the opportunity to build a new category of sports performance technology from the ground up.
* Career development opportunities and professional growth.
* Family first, with a close-knit team that enjoys solving hard problems.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

**Boeing Defense, Space & Security (BDS)** is seeking a **Senior Systems Engineer** to join the **F/A-18 Systems Engineering Integration and Test (SEIT) Team** in **Berkeley, MO**.

The Senior Systems Engineer is responsible for leading cross-functional integration to drive engineering excellence in the execution of our F/A-18 software development activities. The individual selected for this role will be primarily focused on the Technical Integration role for Software Development and Advanced Systems activities.

**Position Responsibilities**

* **Ensure Engineering Excellence:** Responsible for leading integration across multiple engineering and program teams to ensure safety, technical excellence, and product integrity. Drives adherence to Boeing and program processes, setting high standards for quality and performance
* **Systems Engineering Approach:** Ensure an integrated systems engineering approach. Take ownership to manage requirements and ensure full traceability. Manage the configuration of the integrated system to ensure dependencies are well understood. Responsible for ensuring comprehensive certification and verification activities, demonstrating a commitment to excellence
* **Build Strategic Partnerships:** Develop and nurture strong relationships with the United States Navy (USN), engineering functions, and program management. Leverage these partnerships to enhance collaboration and drive program success
* **Manage Technical Baseline:** Oversees the technical baseline, including mission systems configuration, technical performance measures, architecture diagrams, and Risk Identification and Opportunity (RIO) assessments. Foster a culture of proactive technical oversight and continuous improvement
* **Problem Solver:** Demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills by driving complex emerging issues to prompt resolution. Investigate System Anomaly Reports in partnership with Mission Systems to ensure a high quality deliverable
* **Project Leadership:** Work closely with technical experts and teammates to achieve program objectives and build customer trust. Will be responsible for managing the software configuration set (SCS) engineering change proposals (ECPs), generating labor estimates for development efforts, leading technical working groups, and presenting at Engineering Review Boards and Change Control Boards
* **Technical Leadership:** Manages and leads the Interface Control Working Group, maintains the Mission Systems Architecture Diagrams, and updates Worst Case Scenario analyses

**Travel may be required up to 10% of the time; Domestically and/or internationally depending on business needs.**

**This position requires the ability to obtain a U.S. Security Clearance for which the U.S. Government requires U.S. Citizenship.** An interim and/or final U.S. Secret Clearance Post-Start is required

jobs.description:
**About Sandia**
----------------

  

Sandia National Laboratories is the nation’s premier science and engineering lab for national security and technology innovation, with teams of specialists focused on cutting-edge work in a broad array of areas. Some of the main reasons we love our jobs:

* Challenging work with amazing impact that contributes to security, peace, and freedom worldwide
* Extraordinary co-workers
* Some of the best tools, equipment, and research facilities in the world
* Career advancement and enrichment opportunities
* Flexible work arrangements for many positions include 9/80 (work 80 hours every two weeks, with every other Friday off) and 4/10 (work 4 ten-hour days each week) compressed workweeks, part-time work, and telecommuting (a mix of onsite work and working from home)
* Generous vacation, strong medical and other benefits, competitive 401k, learning opportunities, relocation assistance and amenities aimed at creating a solid work/life balance\*

World-changing technologies. Life-changing careers. Learn more about Sandia at: http://www.sandia.gov

  

* These benefits vary by job classification.

**What Your Job Will Be Like**
------------------------------

  

The High Reliability Special Communications Department (5372) is seeking a motivated Systems Engineer and Project Lead to drive the development of advanced RF/microwave special communications systems. Our systems are used in high-impact, high-consequence national security applications. You'll work alongside deep technical experts in RF, DSP, and embedded systems. Prior RF experience is helpful but not required.

On any given day, you may be called upon to:

* Develop trust-based partnerships with organizations internal and external to Sandia.
* Lead and listen to a multidisciplinary team of engineers and subject-matter experts.
* Define and manage system requirements, architectures, and interfaces, and conduct trade studies to inform design decisions.
* Guide the team through design reviews and verification, and release documentation to realize fielded products.
* Plan and lead integration, test, and field-test activities.
* Manage technical, cost, and schedule risk across the project lifecycle.
* Mentor staff and help grow the department's systems engineering capabilities.
* Provide programmatic and technical status updates to Sandia management and external partners.
* Align and negotiate with internal and external stakeholders, production partners, and government organizations.

Some travel is required for this position. Due to the nature of the work, the selected applicant will be required to work onsite. Relocation provided for those who qualify.

**Salary Range**
----------------

  

$117,500 - $235,700

* Salary range is estimated, and actual salary will be determined after consideration of the selected candidate's experience and qualifications, and application of any approved geographic salary differential.

**Qualifications We Require**
-----------------------------

* A Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline and five (5) years of directly relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of directly relevant education and engineering or scientific experience that demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and ability to perform independent research and development
* Active DOE Q security clearance or equivalent (e.g. DOW Top Secret)

**Qualifications We Desire**
----------------------------

  

The ideal R&D S&E Systems Engineer candidate will in addition possess the following:

* Graduate degree in Engineering or a highly related field where an independent research project was a graduation requirement (e.g., independent project, thesis, or dissertation).
* Experience working with Nuclear Security Enterprise (NSE) laboratories and plants including Pantex, Kansas City National Security Campus (KCNSC), Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL), Los Alamos National Laboratory, and Kansas City National Security Campus/New Mexico Operations (KCNSC/NMO).
* Experience working on engineering design, qualification, production, or related modeling/simulation projects.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams.  

Also for this posting we are seeking individual with the following experience:

* Two or more years of demonstrated leadership experience.
* Experience leading engagements with DoD/DoW and NNSA sponsors.
* Demonstrated success leading teams to meet performance, cost, and schedule targets.
* Experience with high-rigor projects and teams (e.g., nuclear weapons, hypersonics, space payloads).
* Ability to obtain and maintain SCI access, which may require a polygraph test.

**About Our Team**
------------------

  

The High Reliability Special Communications Department (5372) develops terrestrial, airborne, and space-based special communications systems for surveillance, reconnaissance, and high-value target and material control. Our work spans long- and short-range communications and transponder systems, typically using ultra-low-power signaling techniques. Design challenges include highly miniaturized electronics, efficient low-power transceivers, and signal extraction in very low signal-to-noise ratio environments. Our staff bring a diverse skill set spanning microwave circuit design, antenna design, signal analysis, digital signal processing, embedded software development, mechanical design, and systems engineering, and work together to carry solutions from initial concept through fielded capability. We serve a variety of government organizations conducting specialized missions, giving our work real-world impact.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Raleigh, NC, USA; Durham, NC, USA**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (e.g., Java and C++).
* 2 years of experience using SQL, or other relational databases.
* 2 years of experience building and managing distributed software systems and infrastructure.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.
* 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms in either an academic or industry setting.
* 2 years of experience with performance, large-scale systems data analysis, visualization tools, or debugging.
* Experience developing accessible technologies.
* Experience programming in Kotlin.

**About the job**
-----------------

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

In this role, with your technical expertise, you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

AI will change the future of work in profound ways, and our products— Gmail, Docs, Drive, Calendar, Sheets, Vids and Meet are at the forefront. From pre-computed summaries for email threads, summaries for meetings, and videos created from a document using lifelike AI avatars, our AI opportunity is huge. Our mission is to meaningfully connect people so they can create, build, and grow together and as part of the team you can build how productivity tools should work 5-10 years into the future. You will work with model builders (Google DeepMind), work with exceptional leaders, and have the ability to impact billions of users across the world.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
