* Write product or system development code.
* Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.
* Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).
* Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.
* Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Sutphen Corporation is the oldest continuously family-owned and operated fire truck manufacturer in the United States of America. With a mission to build the safest, most reliable fire trucks in the world, Sutphen has manufactured emergency fire apparatus for fire departments all over the country for more than 135 years.  
We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Electrical Engineer to join our team in Dublin, Ohio. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, testing, and troubleshooting electrical systems in our custom-built fire apparatus. You will work closely with mechanical engineers, technicians, and production staff to ensure our vehicles meet stringent quality, safety, and regulatory standards.

**Why Join Team Sutphen?**  

* Safety is our priority
* Family-owned and operated
* First shift operation
* High-quality and extremely affordable benefit packages
* A collaborative and challenging environment fostering high engagement and retention
* We have fun building the highest quality product that saves lives and property

**What You’ll Do**  

* Design, test, and support the installation of electrical systems for custom fire apparatus.
* Develop and maintain hardware selections, electrical schematics, and wire-harness diagrams for system integration.
* Develop and validate software components using C or C++ and proprietary vehicle systems.
* Provide hands-on production support for electrical assembly and installation.
* Apply engineering principles to root-cause investigations and technical documentation.
* Participate in technical reviews of requirements, specifications, designs, and related engineering artifacts.
* Help establish and enforce standards and procedures in a multidisciplinary design environment.
* Address component obsolescence and initiate continuous-improvement projects.
* Design practical solutions within estimated budgets and execute action plans with suppliers.

**What You Bring**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering.
* At least five years of relevant experience.
* Experience with schematic design, bill-of-materials development, and component selection.
* Knowledge of J1939 CAN bus.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Responsibilities:

Noblis is seeking a hands-on Electrical Engineer to support electrical design, system integration, and engineering laboratory development for U.S. Navy shipboard systems. The ideal candidate has practical experience in electrical design, technical troubleshooting, and integration of electrical and electronic equipment.

This position requires proficiency in AutoCAD 2D, a strong understanding of electrical circuits and wiring, and the ability to work independently in a laboratory environment. The engineer will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, support laboratory operations, and mentor new engineers in safe laboratory practices.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop, modify, and maintain shipboard electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and system drawings using AutoCAD 2D.
* Provide electrical engineering support for the design and integration of shipboard control systems.
* Construct, configure, and maintain engineering laboratories, including equipment racks, wiring assemblies, and fixtures.
* Install, commission, and troubleshoot electrical and electronic equipment and associated systems.
* Operate, commission, test, and troubleshoot Rockwell PLC hardware and associated electrical interfaces.
* Integrate new equipment and modify existing laboratory systems to support engineering requirements.
* Train and mentor engineers in laboratory construction, safe wiring practices, and equipment operation.
* Review and maintain engineering drawings and technical documentation.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to identify and resolve technical issues.
* Provide occasional support for equipment procurement and laboratory maintenance.

**Work Location and Travel**

* This is primarily an **onsite position in Philadelphia, PA**, requiring hands-on electrical design, equipment construction, integration, and troubleshooting.
    
  Occasional remote work may be permitted based on project requirements and management approval but is not guaranteed.
* This position may require periodic travel to observe and gain familiarity with existing shipboard systems, equipment, and operational environments.
    
  As engineering solutions mature and are fielded, the role will transition to include direct shipboard technical support, with increased travel. This is anticipated within approximately two to four years.

Required Qualifications:

**Required Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline with substantial electrical or electronics coursework.
* Experience: Minimum will be 1 to 3 years of relevant professional engineering experience.
* Security Clearance: US Citizen and an active DoD Secret security clearance or ability to obtain one.
* Certification: Current CompTIA Security+ or another DoD-recognized certification satisfying applicable CSWF IAT Level II baseline requirements or able to obtain a Sec+ with in 6 months of hire.

**Required Skills/Knowledge/Experience**

* Proficiency with AutoCAD 2D, including creating, modifying, and interpreting electrical and mechanical schematics, wiring diagrams, and system drawings.
* Strong understanding of electrical circuits, wiring practices, and electrical system design.
* Experience working with analog and digital signals (e.g., 4-20 mA, 0-10V), industrial communication protocols (e.g., Modbus), and associated electrical interfaces for controller and sensor integration.
* Hands-on experience constructing, wiring, and modifying electrical equipment racks, assemblies, and laboratory fixtures.
* Experience installing, configuring, integrating, and troubleshooting electrical and electronic equipment, including field devices such as transducers and limit switches.
* Ability to independently diagnose electrical and electronic equipment problems and implement corrective actions.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary engineering teams and technical stakeholders.

**Physical requirements**

This position primarily involves work in an engineering laboratory environment with occasional travel to naval industrial or shipboard settings. Employees must be capable of standing and walking for extended periods within laboratory spaces and must be able to lift and carry equipment, tools, and materials weighing up to fifty pounds on a regular basis, with occasional lifting of heavier objects with assistance.

The role requires the ability to bend, stoop, kneel, crouch, and reach overhead to install, configure, and troubleshoot equipment mounted in racks and enclosures. Workers must possess sufficient manual dexterity to manipulate and assemble small components, including connectors, wiring terminations, fasteners, and hardware during equipment assembly, troubleshooting/repair and wiring tasks, as well as the ability to operate hand and power tools.

Adequate vision is necessary to read technical manuals, interpret electrical schematics, identify color-coded wiring, and detect safety hazards. Hearing capability must be sufficient to perceive warning signals, alarms, and verbal communications in a laboratory environment.

When supporting shipboard operations, employees may be required to climb vertical ladders, stairs, and steep inclines; work in confined spaces with limited ventilation and restricted movement; traverse uneven, wet, or slippery surfaces; and work in varying environmental conditions including extreme temperatures and high humidity. Workers must be capable of responding quickly to emergency situations, including evacuating confined spaces and moving to emergency stations.

Reasonable accommodations may be available for qualified individuals with disabilities who can perform the essential functions of the position with or without such accommodation.

  
Desired Qualifications:

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience supporting U.S. Navy shipboard electrical or control systems, including familiarity with control system programs.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space. AWS Data centers have multiple components such as generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, etc. All these components have local control systems that interact with each other via open and/or proprietary communications protocols. The BMS is the primary method of control of all mechanical systems within a data center. The EPMS is the primary method of monitoring all electrical systems within a data center.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Train and assist internal customers and stakeholders with the creation, design, configuration, validation, installation, commissioning and operation of BMS and EPMS systems.

• Provide technical assistance and support to operations during life cycle of the data center. • Review results and action items from the quarterly maintenances for BMS and EPMS and take actions to get them resolved.  

* Develop BMS & EPMS projects scope of work, schedule, budget, and level of efforts (LOE) to projects requested by customers and stakeholders.
* Manage scope, schedule, finance and execution of BMS and EPMS improvement projects in AWS data centers.
* Assist in procurement related activities including request for quotation/proposals, responding to request for information, review of vendors proposal and issuance of purchase orders.

• Participate in AWS global on-call schedule to provide immediate BMS and EPMS technical support to in-service data centers. • Attend project related meetings, coordinate with project leaders and regularly report status to Controls and stakeholder’s management.  

* Support Controls projects related commissioning activities in the data centers.
* Review, implement, troubleshoot and iterate on the controls sequence of operation (SOO) and provide necessary feedback to the design team.
* Develop and modify controls logic programming and graphical user interfaces.
* Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements and navigate challenging situations.
* Financially manage BMS and EPMS service contracts.
* Frequently visit (locally) assigned in-operation data centers to troubleshoot, meet customers, supervise vendor’s work to ensure compliance with the scope, design, SOO and applicable local codes.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
* Experience carrying new design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
* Experience in MS Excel, Word, and Windows Operating Systems
* Experience with power management and power monitoring systems

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure experience
* Knowledge of critical data center equipment
* Knowledge of engineering documentation, electrical diagrams and standard operating procedures
* Knowledge of building codes and regulations including Life Safety, BOCA, NFPA, NEC, or OSHA
* Experience in project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure
* Experience in Data Center Engineering Operations, with a deep understanding of electrical and mechanical data center infrastructure
* Experience reading and interpreting construction specifications and drawings for all domains

We are pleased to announce the opening for a Data Platforms Integrator (Engineer 4 / Analyst 4), who will support the Missile Defense Agency's (MDA) Next Generation Environment (NGE) program and become part of our technology company operating in missile defense, cybersecurity, test range modernization, biotechnology, and space control marketspaces. In this role, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor in a Systems Engineering and Technical Assistance (SETA) capacity, directly supporting the Government Chief Technology Officer (CTO) and NGE leadership. You will provide technical oversight and integration guidance for the NGE Data Design Area, supporting the development of a secure, resilient hybrid multi-cloud environment.

You will evaluate existing applications, databases, and modern data platforms across AWS, Azure, and on-premises environments to ensure alignment with the Department of Defense (DoD) Zero Trust Strategy. Your work will focus on data discovery, classification, protection, and access governance to ensure mission-critical information remains secure and accessible only to authorized users.

**Responsibilities:**

You'll be responsible for:

* Overseeing integration of Policy Enforcement Points (PEPs) and Policy Decision Points (PDPs) to support dynamic authorization and secure data access.
* Providing technical guidance for data virtualization, database security, and access governance across AWS, Azure, and on-premises VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) environments.
* Ensuring compliance with DoD Data-at-Rest (DAR) requirements, Key Management Service (KMS) integration standards, Hardware Security Module (HSM) requirements, and applicable JSIG and NIST SP 800-207 guidelines.
* Evaluating data platform modernization strategies and integration approaches to improve interoperability, security, and enterprise data governance.
* Leading technical exchange meetings (TEMs) with integration contractors, database vendors, and security technology providers to evaluate proposed solutions and resolve cross-platform integration challenges.
* Translating Government leadership requirements into actionable engineering solutions while maintaining alignment with NGE architecture and DoD cybersecurity standards.

Degrees in Computer Science, Data Management, Cybersecurity, or a related technical discipline are preferred.
* You must have a minimum of 6 years of experience analyzing, architecting, and integrating complex enterprise databases, including relational database management systems (RDBMS), NoSQL platforms, storage solutions, and data pipelines.

* You must have hands-on experience architecting and securing enterprise data storage and analytics services across both AWS and Microsoft Azure environments.
* You must have experience designing, accrediting, and operating data platforms within classified DoD environments.
* You must possess an active Top Secret security clearance with current SCI eligibility (TS/SCI).

Principal Software Engineer / Technical Lead — Healthcare Interoperability

**Company:** Sovereign Logic Systems LLC

**Location:** Phoenix Metropolitan Area, Arizona — Strongly Preferred

**Work Arrangement:** Phoenix-area candidates preferred; hybrid or remote arrangements may be considered for highly qualified applicants.

**Experience:** 10+ years of professional software engineering experience preferred; minimum 3 years of professional Go (Golang) and JavaScript experience required.

**Position:** Planned paid, project-based technical leadership engagement, with potential future full-time employment.

**Indeed Hiring Timeline:** More than 4 weeks. This represents the anticipated recruitment and candidate evaluation period, not a confirmed funding or employment date.

**Anticipated Start Date:** To be determined. Any project engagement or employment start date is contingent upon sufficient available financing, company authorization, and a separate written agreement.

**Potential Future Full-Time Base Salary:** $165,000–$195,000 annually, subject to financing, qualifications, and final responsibilities.

About Sovereign Logic Systems

Sovereign Logic Systems LLC is a Phoenix-based, pre-revenue technology company developing proprietary emergency medical information continuity technology and supporting healthcare software applications.

Our planned technology ecosystem includes patient-facing and authorized emergency-responder-facing applications intended to improve access to critical emergency information during time-sensitive situations.

Our goal is to complement existing electronic health records, EMS documentation platforms, hospital systems, and established healthcare infrastructure—not replace them.

We are preparing for a privately financed commercial development program and seeking an experienced Principal Software Engineer / Technical Lead to establish the technical foundation for our software applications.

About the Opportunity

We are seeking a highly experienced, hands-on software engineer with demonstrated technical leadership, software architecture experience, and strong proficiency in Go (Golang), JavaScript, and modern web application development.

The selected professional will evaluate the architecture and development requirements of two interconnected applications: one designed for individuals managing essential emergency information and another intended for authorized emergency medical responders.

The Principal Software Engineer will have responsibility for software architecture recommendations, technology selection, development planning, and software engineering practices.

The company is particularly interested in browser-accessible, cross-platform application development that can support appropriate mobile, tablet, desktop, and rugged-device environments.

However, the final architecture will be determined through technical assessment rather than being mandated in advance.

The position will report to the Founder & CEO and collaborate with established systems architecture and embedded engineering leadership.

We are prioritizing experienced technical leadership before expanding the application software development team.

**Recruitment is beginning in advance of financing.** The initial engagement is planned as a limited-scope paid project that may proceed only when sufficient financing is available and written authorization has been completed.

Successful collaboration may lead to additional funded milestones or consideration for future full-time employment.

Neither an initial project start date nor future full-time employment is currently guaranteed.

Initial Project Responsibilities

The initial funded engagement will focus on software architecture assessment, engineering coordination, and commercial development planning.

Responsibilities will include:

* Review proposed patient-facing and emergency-responder-facing application workflows, functional requirements, and operational use cases.
* Evaluate browser-accessible, web-first, native, hybrid, and other appropriate software architecture options.
* Assess the suitability of Go (Golang), JavaScript, TypeScript, and related technologies for backend services, application interfaces, and integrated software development.
* Recommend appropriate programming languages, frameworks, databases, infrastructure, and development tools.
* Evaluate secure backend architecture, APIs, user authentication, authorization, and identity-management requirements.
* Assess system behavior during intermittent connectivity, unavailable services, incomplete records, and conflicting information.
* Review patient information management, data provenance, versioning, integrity, and auditability requirements.

jobs.title: Senior Battery Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we're building rockets to serve today's needs and tomorrow's breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that's just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven't been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you're in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you'll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we're writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it's early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

**About the Team:**  
The Avionics team is responsible for the full lifecycle of Terran R's nervous system — designing, building, testing, installing, and operating the hardware that connects and controls every major electrical system on the vehicle and ground. Engineers are deeply embedded into other functions within Relativity, working closely with propulsion, GNC, fluids, and stage engineering teams to ensure seamless integration and operation. As a Staff Engineer, you'll help shape Terran R's fundamental avionics architecture, own critical flight hardware, and build and grow the team that delivers it.  
  
**About the Role:**  
You will join the team developing the vehicle's high-voltage battery system and grow into technical ownership of it as a complete product, covering cell, mechanical, thermal, electrical/BMS, and vehicle integration. Early on, you will work closely with experienced battery engineers to learn the current design, its history, and how it flies. Over time, you will take on more of the system's technical direction. You will be the link between the battery's mechanical and electrical disciplines and the rest of the vehicle. You'll help turn mission and vehicle needs into a clear, traceable battery specification, and help shape the architecture that meets it. This is a hands-on technical role with real cross-functional influence. As the battery team grows, it offers a clear path to technical leadership, including leading other engineers.  
  
Architecture & Requirements

* Partner with the vehicle and power-system architecture team to define battery requirements from the top down — deriving energy, power, voltage, thermal, mass/volume, and life requirements from mission profile, ConOps, and power-system needs rather than anchoring on legacy designs
* Own and maintain the battery specification — the single source of truth for battery requirements, interfaces, and verification criteria — with full traceability
* Drive battery architecture and cell down-selection through documented trade studies (requirement driver options evaluation criteria rationale recommendation), in collaboration with the battery mechanical, test, and BMS engineers
* Define and manage interface control (electrical, mechanical, thermal, data) between the battery and the vehicle

Cross-Functional Definition

* Work with Flight Sciences, ConOps, and the Criteria team to define the battery's environmental and loads requirements — launch and flight vibration/shock, thermal environments, thermal cycling, EMI/EMC, altitude/vacuum, and mission duty cycles
* Partner with the avionics/EE team to define BMS requirements and scope — cell monitoring, balancing, protection (OVP/UVP/OCP), contactor/heater control, state estimation, and fault management
* Coordinate with the mechanical and vehicle-integration teams on packaging, mounting, thermal management, and installation interfaces
* Work with the criteria and structures teams to close structural, thermal, and safety margins

Safety & Verification

* Own battery safety architecture — thermal-runaway detection and propagation mitigation, venting/burst-disc strategy, physical cell protection, and hazard analysis
* Define the verification and qualification strategy — qualification and acceptance test programs at cell and pack level, test-as-you-fly philosophy, and the data systems that turn test results into rapid design feedback
* Lead FMEA/FTA, reliability analysis, and identification/mitigation of single points of failure

Program & Technical Leadership

* Carry technical program-management responsibility for the battery effort — schedule, risk, dependencies, and status — and serve as the organized, single point of communication for battery status across teams
* Represent the battery at vehicle design reviews (PDR/CDR-class), safety review boards, and cross-functional forums
* Support supplier and cell-vendor engagement, including benchmarking, RFI/RFQ evaluation, and technical down-selection
* Contribute to producibility/DFM and NPI as the design matures, and lead structured root-cause and corrective-action (RCCA) for anomalies

**About You:**

* 5+ years of battery systems development experience across the product lifecycle (concept design qualification), including HV lithium-ion packs
* Demonstrated ability to derive and own requirements top-down, with rigorous trade studies and traceable specifications — not just execute a fixed design
* Working depth across the battery stack: cell selection/characterization, pack architecture, thermal management, BMS scope, and safety/abuse behavior
* Strong understanding of battery

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Parallel Systems is pioneering autonomous battery-electric rail vehicles designed to transform freight transportation by shifting portions of the $900 billion U.S. trucking industry onto rail. Our innovative technology offers cleaner, safer, and more efficient logistics solutions. Join our dynamic team and help shape a smarter, greener future for global freight.

### **Senior Electrical Engineer**

Parallel Systems is seeking a **Senior Electrical Engineer** to lead the design, development, integration, and validation of vehicle electrical systems for our production autonomous battery-electric rail vehicles. This role will own critical electrical architectures and subsystems, including power distribution, traction and braking interfaces, safety-critical control systems, wiring harnesses, and compute/sensor networks.

As a senior technical contributor, you will drive electrical engineering decisions from initial concept through production deployment, establish robust design and verification processes, and ensure reliable integration across mechanical, software, and autonomy systems. You will be responsible for developing high-reliability electrical systems that meet demanding performance, safety, and regulatory requirements while supporting the transition from prototype development to production.

The ideal candidate brings substantial experience designing and integrating complex electrical systems in automotive, rail, aerospace, or other vehicle-based applications. You are comfortable taking ownership of ambiguous technical challenges, leading cross-functional engineering efforts, and balancing hands-on execution with system-level technical leadership.

#### **Responsibilities**

* **Own end-to-end electrical system development:** Lead the architecture, design, development, integration, and validation of vehicle electrical systems, including power distribution, wiring harnesses, commercial-off-the-shelf hardware, and electrical test infrastructure.
* **Drive technical design decisions:** Establish electrical design requirements, define system interfaces, evaluate design tradeoffs, and make recommendations that balance performance, reliability, safety, cost, and manufacturability.
* **Lead safety-critical engineering:** Develop and maintain system-level risk assessments, Design Failure Mode and Effects Analyses (DFMEAs), hazard analyses, and verification and validation plans for critical electrical subsystems.
* **Lead system integration:** Coordinate electrical interfaces with mechanical, embedded software, controls, and autonomy teams to ensure reliable operation across vehicle subsystems and dependencies.
* **Drive hands-on testing and troubleshooting:** Lead hardware bring-up, bench testing, prototype vehicle integration, fault isolation, and root-cause analysis to resolve complex electrical and system-level issues.
* **Support production readiness:** Partner with manufacturing, suppliers, and contract manufacturers to transition electrical designs from prototypes to production, addressing design-for-manufacturing, assembly, testability, and quality requirements.
* **Establish engineering standards:** Develop and maintain electrical design practices, interface specifications, test procedures, and validation methods that improve system reliability and repeatability.
* **Own engineering documentation and configuration:** Ensure accuracy and traceability of schematics, wiring diagrams, bills of materials (BOMs), test reports, engineering changes, and release documentation.
* **Provide technical leadership:** Mentor engineers as needed, review electrical designs, identify technical risks, and drive resolution of complex engineering challenges across the product lifecycle.

### **What Success Looks Like**

* **30 Days:** You've reviewed existing vehicle architectures and are contributing to the definition of system-level requirements for new or upgraded subsystems (e.g., braking control, high-voltage distribution). You're actively participating in safety reviews and design discussions.
* **60 Days:** You're leading the design and documentation of a new electrical subsystem. You've outlined validation and compliance testing plans and are driving system alignment across disciplines.
* **90 Days:** You've completed a first-pass system architecture for a new subsystem and led its integration into a prototype or test vehicle. You're actively shaping the roadmap for future electrical system upgrades and regulatory milestones.

### **Basic Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* 5+ years of relevant experience designing, developing, integrating, or validating electrical systems for vehicles or other complex electromechanical products.
* Demonstrated ownership of electrical systems or subsystems through multiple stages of the product development lifecycle, from concept and design through testing and production.
* Strong understanding of vehicle power distribution, electrical architecture, control systems, and embedded communication protocols such as CAN and Ethernet.
* Experience defining system requirements, managing electrical interfaces, and developing verification and validation strategies.
* Proven ability to troubleshoot complex electrical systems using first-principles analysis, structured debugging, and root-cause investigation.
* Experience with electrical design and documentation tools such as SolidWorks Electrical, Altium, RapidHarness, or equivalent.
* Ability to work cross-functionally and communicate technical decisions, risks, and tradeoffs to engineering and manufacturing stakeholders.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience developing and deploying electrical systems for automotive, rail, aerospace, commercial vehicles, or heavy industrial equipment.
* Experience with traction, braking, high-voltage power distribution, vehicle control systems, or other safety-critical vehicle subsystems.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Platform Overlay & Networking
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

**About The Team**
------------------

The Sentry Tower Software team develops robotic systems that provide force protection capabilities, monitoring the perimeter of secure areas, land or sea, for approaching people, vehicles, and vessels. We live in a world where security officers are increasingly overwhelmed by sensor data feeds. Our products leverage advanced sensor fusion and autonomy to seamlessly render activity in the environment to Lattice's common operating picture.

**About the Job**
-----------------

Every Sentry Tower we ship, across Counter-Intrusion and Air Defense, boots from a common software platform: a NixOS-based overlay that defines the base images, the system services, the compute configuration for each hardware generation, and the network topology that ties the tower's payloads together. That platform is the foundation the entire product line stands on, and we are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to own it.

This is a systems and infrastructure role with unusually direct product consequences. The tower's network is not a datacenter network: it is a set of VLANs and bridges carrying camera, radar, GPS, and sensor-board traffic over a mix of mesh radio, cellular, and satellite backhaul, on hardware that sits at the far end of a very long support loop. When a business line adds a new payload with its own switch, or when a routing priority is wrong, the failure shows up in the field. You will own the topology as a contract: define it, document it, review changes against it, and make the correct integration the easy one.

You will also be a primary steward of our build and configuration system. Our images are fully declarative and reproducible, spanning several compute generations and a dozen product variants, and we are actively consolidating legacy per-product configurations into a common, composable base.

Our Product: https://www.anduril.com/sentry

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------

* Own the shared base of our NixOS overlay: system modules, compute platform definitions, common tower services, and the image definitions that every product variant composes from.
* Own the tower network topology end to end: VLAN and subnet allocation, bridging, link ranking and failover across heterogeneous backhaul, NAT and firewall policy, and the physical-port-to-payload mapping for each carrier board.
* Define and enforce the integration contract that business line teams use to add network-attached payloads, so their additions extend the platform instead of diverging from it.
* Drive the consolidation of legacy, per-product configurations into the common overlay, with build-time checks that keep them from drifting back apart.
* Support and extend our real-time messaging layer as services migrate from the legacy pub-sub bus to its next-generation replacement, including the topic and schema contracts that define who owns which data.
* Debug problems that cross every layer at once: kernel and device tree, systemd unit ordering, Nix evaluation, link-layer configuration, and the sensor daemons on top.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**
---------------------------

* 4+ years of professional software engineering with substantial time in Linux systems, embedded platforms, or infrastructure work.
* Deep, practical networking knowledge: VLANs, bridging, routing and policy routing, DHCP, multicast, NAT, and firewalling, plus fluency with ip, tcpdump, and Wireshark for diagnosing real traffic.
* Strong experience with declarative configuration management and reproducible builds. Nix or NixOS is what we use and what we most want to see; adjacent depth in Bazel, Buildroot, Yocto, or infrastructure-as-code tooling (Terraform, Ansible, Pulumi) is a solid substitute.
* Proficiency in Rust or C++, enough to read and modify the services that sit on top of the platform, not just the configuration that deploys them.
* Comfort operating and troubleshooting real hardware: serial consoles, provisioning and reflashing, boot problems, and remote debugging of systems you cannot physically reach.
* Demonstrated ability to define a technical interface that other teams build against, and to hold that line through code review and documentation rather than authority.
* US person status required, with eligibility to obtain and maintain a US security clearance.

**NICE TO HAVE**
----------------

* Hands-on NixOS experience, including writing modules and maintaining flakes.
* Python for tooling and automation.
* Experience with NVIDIA Jetson platforms (Xavier, Orin, Thor) including BSP integration, device trees, and JetPack upgrades.
* Fleet-scale operational experience: over-the-air update systems, observability pipelines, or long-lived embedded deployments.
* Familiarity with CAN, SNMP, or managed-switch configuration in an embedded context.
* Experience setting up and maintaining CI/CD for large build graphs and hardware-in-the-loop pipelines.

Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offer

Meta Robotics Studio builds consumer humanoid robots that bring Meta's AI into the physical world. Our robots run on NVIDIA Jetson Thor with Meta-designed carrier boards and JetPack OS. The Robotics OS team owns everything between the silicon and the robot learning stack. On one chip, our robots run real-time control loops over EtherCAT while large vision-language-action (VLA) models run on the GPU. Our job is to make that computer do both, deterministically, every time it boots.We are hiring a software engineer to help architect and evolve the robotics OS, Meta's build of NVIDIA Jetson Linux for Thor-class robot compute. Working with the team, you will help shape the multi-year technical direction for the robot's operating system, including how we build, release and update it, how it shares one computer between real-time control and AI workloads, and how it scales from a lab of prototypes to a large fleet of production robots. You will work closely with hardware, firmware, controls, and AI engineers across Meta, and with NVIDIA's Jetson engineering teams as one of several technical points of contact on the platform. This is a hands-on role: when a new board spin won't boot or the control loop misses a deadline, you will be in the kernel log alongside the rest of the team.

* Contribute to the technical strategy and multi-year roadmap for the Robotics OS. **Principal Laser Controls Engineer**
-------------------------------------

### **Role Overview**

We are seeking a Principal Laser Controls Engineer to define and drive the control architecture for advanced laser-based optical modules. This role demands deep expertise in laser physics, control systems, and embedded implementation. You will own the technical vision for laser control—spanning optical power regulation, current control, thermal stabilization, and wavelength calibration—ensuring robust, scalable, and production-ready solutions across the full product lifecycle.

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Define and own the **end-to-end laser module control architecture**, including:

  + **APC (Automatic Power Control)** loops for stable optical output
  + **ACC (Automatic Current Control)** strategies for laser drive optimization
  + **Automatic calibration frameworks** (power, current, aging compensation, temperature drift)
  + TEC (Thermoelectric Cooler) control for wavelength and thermal stability
  
* Lead the design, modeling, and optimization of laser control loops, accounting for:

  + Laser non-linearities (L-I curves, threshold behavior)
  + Aging, degradation, and environmental variations
  + Noise, stability margins, and transient performance
  
* Architect **closed-loop control strategies** that balance performance, reliability, and manufacturability across PVT and lifetime conditions
  
* Develop and own module embedded **laser control firmware**, including:

  + Real-time control loops
  + Calibration routines (factory + in-field)
  + Fault detection, protection, and recovery mechanisms
  
* Establish **modeling and correlation frameworks** linking simulation to silicon and optical performance

### **Qualifications**

  

* MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Photonics, Controls, or related field
  
* ~12–15+ years of experience with deep focus on **laser systems and control**
  
* Strong expertise in:

  + APC/ACC loop design and optimization
  + Laser behavior (L-I-V characteristics, thermal effects, degradation mechanisms)
  + Feedback control theory and real-world implementation
  
* Proven experience implementing **calibration algorithms** (factory and adaptive/in-field)
  
* Strong embedded firmware background for real-time control systems
  
* Proficiency in modeling and simulation (MATLAB/Python/Simulink or equivalent), with demonstrated correlation to hardware
  
* Track record of driving **system-level architecture** and influencing cross-functional teams

### **Nice to Have**

  

* Experience with pluggable optical modules and CMIS
  
* Familiarity with high-speed optical links, SerDes
  
* Experience with reliability engineering (lifetime drift, burn-in, field performance)
  
* Exposure to high-volume manufacturing, yield optimization, and test infrastructure

### **Why Join Us**

  

* Define the control and calibration backbone of next-generation laser products
  
* High ownership across laser physics, control algorithms, and system integration
  
* Opportunity to shape product direction in a fast-paced, execution-driven environment

jobs.title: GPU Kernel Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Relace**

Relace is building a globally distributed inference cloud. Customers send us requests, we run them on our own fleet of GPUs across the world, and we compete on price, speed and reliability against companies far larger than us. We have customers and revenue today, we’re venture backed, and the team is still small, so roles come with a lot of responsibility and room to grow.

We build our own stack, and the fleet runs on Kubernetes across multiple clouds. Performance here is the business: making the system ten percent faster makes the company roughly ten percent more money, and we can show you the number.

Some numbers: we process 800B+ tokens a day, we’ve grown 3x in the last three months, we are regularly one of the top providers by volume on OpenRouter, and we raised a $23M Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, with Matrix Partners and Y Combinator.

**The role**

You would work at the bottom of the stack, writing and tuning the code that runs directly on the GPU: making the hardware do more work per second and per dollar, shrinking models so they’re cheaper to run without making them worse, and hunting down the many boring reasons a GPU sits idle. We don’t require GPU or CUDA experience. We’d rather have an excellent low-level systems engineer with no GPU background than an average CUDA programmer; learning to program a GPU on top of that takes a few months.

**What we need to see**

* Around five or more years of low-level performance work where the speed of the system mattered: operating systems, drivers, databases, compilers, trading systems, inference engines.
* Strong C or C++ and genuine comfort at a low level: memory, concurrency, caches, hardware behaviour.
* A track record of making something significantly faster, where you can explain precisely why it was slow and what you changed. This matters more than anything else on this list.
* The habit of measuring. You profile before and after, and you’re suspicious of numbers that came from a sloppy test setup.

**Nice to have**

Operating system, hypervisor, driver, firmware or real-time systems work; performance tools you built for other engineers to use; compiler work; actual GPU experience, whether at NVIDIA or AMD or through open-source work on the common inference projects. We can teach you the GPU, but we can’t teach performance instincts.

**Working here**

San Francisco, in person, five days a week. This is a senior role, with competitive compensation plus equity.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensures our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
Within AIS, the DC Robotics team is growing in maturity, so now is the time to join and drive game changing and rapid innovation used by AWS globally. Our designs will fundamentally change the data center, providing operational and financial benefits that are critical to the success of the AWS business and its millions of customers. Our engineers solve challenging technology problems and take big bets on new concepts, enabling AWS services to continue to revolutionize the industry. This role provides the opportunity to be a technical lead driving the innovations being developed and deployed in the next generation data centers.  
  
AWS is seeking a Robotics Engineer to support building systems that operate in our data centers and collect rich sensor data at scale. We're seeking a Generalist Machine Learning Engineer to own the ML that turns robot-collected data — imagery, LiDAR, thermal streams, etc — into useful, reliable outputs. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of reliable performance in production across a broad range of problems — perception, model fine-tuning, evaluation, and the pipelines that feed and serve them. This role closely collaborates with robotics and software engineers so model outputs are usable downstream, and so field data feeds back into better training data and better models.  
  
As Amazon has a global presence, intermittent travel will be necessary and should be expected to be approximately 30% to AWS offices, data centers, suppliers, vendors, and product validation tests. While most travel will be domestic, some international travel may be required.  
  
About the team  
Why AWS  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Diverse Experiences  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, machine learning, engineering, or related fields
* 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, including shipping ML to production.
* Strong general software engineering and debugging skills, and fluency in Python.
* Hands-on experience owning problems across the full ML stack: data/feature pipelines, model training, evaluation, and deployment.
* Hands-on experience with the AWS ML stack (or equivalent) — Amazon SageMaker AI (training, tuning, endpoints), Amazon Bedrock, S3-based data/feature pipelines, and GPU training on EC2.
* Computer vision / perception experience (detection, segmentation, recognition) on real-world sensor data — RGB, PCD, etc.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience as the sole or lead ML engineer on a team of otherwise non-ML engineers.
* Familiarity with robotics data and tooling (ROS 2, MCAP, sensor fusion) and edge deployment.
* Experience fine-tuning and evaluating open models / LLMs, and building evaluation harnesses.

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

The Hardware Platform Organization is Anduril's central hardware engineering org. We build the shared technologies, tools, and infrastructure that power hardware development across every Anduril division, from actuators and propulsion to batteries, avionics, rocket motors, and test operations. Our teams set engineering standards, run development manufacturing and test sites, and develop core technology products that ship across multiple product lines.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

We are looking for Senior Electrical Engineers to join our rapidly growing Hardware Platform organization, supporting defense hardware development across propulsion and weapons systems programs  
  
**Propulsion:** Develop and test cutting edge electronics for propulsion system. We are looking for a self-starter with deep technical experience in defense or aerospace hardware development to apply these skills in propulsion flight controllers, power electronics, high-efficiency motor controllers, and electromagnetic actuators.  
  
**ESAD**: Develop fuzing circuitry for missile systems, closely collaborate with vehicle development teams to design, document, and produce tailored fuzing systems and effectors. Develop system interconnect diagrams and define wire harnesses that connect electronic equipment within the vehicle.

#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Own full-cycle PCB design for high-reliability defense hardware — from requirements capture and schematic design through component selection, layout (Altium preferred), bring-up, test, debug, and system integration — while setting the technical standard for execution across the team
* Architect and optimize circuit solutions for safety-critical aerospace and defense applications, including power electronics, motor/actuator drivers, digital control systems, fuzing circuitry, or vehicle interconnect — depending on program focus
* Drive rigorous design analysis across programs: worst-case analysis (WCA), thermal analysis, DFMEA, component derating, and signal/power integrity analysis to ensure reliability across extreme vibration and temperature environments
* Define test strategies and lead Design Verification Testing (DVT), qualification testing, and functional testing from board bring-up through ground and flight test
* Develop system interconnect diagrams and define wire harnesses, with an eye toward integration complexity and scalability across vehicle variants
* Serve as a technical authority across mechanical, thermal, software, systems, quality, and manufacturing teams — driving alignment on cross-discipline tradeoffs throughout development
* Lead and facilitate peer-level and cross-discipline design reviews; provide substantive technical feedback that shapes design decisions
* Lead root cause and failure analysis in support of ground test and field operations, and drive corrective action across teams
* Define vendor evaluation criteria and lead sourcing decisions for critical electrical components and subsystems
* Mentor and technically guide junior and mid-level engineers on design methodology, analysis rigor, and test approach

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent,
* 8+ years of experience designing, testing, and troubleshooting complex PCB designs, with demonstrated depth in at least one domain relevant to defense or aerospace hardware
* Deep expertise in analog, digital, and power electronics, with a track record of delivering hardware in challenging environments
* Expert proficiency with electronic CAD tools (Altium Designer strongly preferred)
* Proficiency with circuit simulation tools (LTSpice or equivalent) and experience applying simulation to validate designs before hardware build
* Strong competence with lab test equipment and test automation; experience designing or directing structured DVT and qualification campaigns
* Deep familiarity with standard interfaces including CAN, I2C, SPI, Ethernet, USB, and PCIe, and experience with MCU, CPU, and FPGA-based architectures
* Demonstrated experience designing for signal integrity and power integrity in high-reliability environments
* Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

#### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Active DoD Secret or Top Secret clearance, or DOE L/Q
* Master's degree in Electrical Engineering
* 8+ years of experience in defense, aerospace, UAS, missile, or maritime hardware development
* Experience with propulsion electronics: motor controllers, power distribution/conversion, flight controller circuits, or electromagnetic actuators
* Experience with fuzing, ordnance, or other safety-critical weapon systems electronics
* Familiarity with MIL-STD-1316, MIL-STD-882E, MIL-STD-2105, or DoD Weapons Safety Board processes
* Experience with MATLAB/Simulink for control loop modeling or system simulation
* Familiarity with avionics design standards: DO-254, DO-178C, DO-160
* Experience scaling electronics designs to production volume, including DFM/DFT considerations
* Track record of mentoring engineers and shaping technical practices at the team or program level

The Hardware Platform Organization is Anduril's central hardware engineering org. jobs.description:
**ABOUT ROCKET LAB**

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

**SPACE SYSTEMS**

At Rocket Lab, we're not just launching rockets — we're building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more.

Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it's a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

**PRINCIPAL SYSTEMS ENGINEER – MISSION ARCHITECTURE**

Based out of Rocket Lab's global headquarters in Long Beach, CA the **Principal Systems Engineer** is responsible for leading the formulation of all new satellite systems, supporting capture of new civil, national security, and commercial business. You will manage the development and maintenance of technical budgets, requirements definition, test planning and execution, and overall management of the systems engineering process, including validation of customer requirements. You will support the Vice President of Business Development and Strategy and the broader Space Systems Business Development organization, with deliverables required for internal leadership, board of directors, and investors.

**WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:**

* Lead Rocket Lab's satellite engineering formulation supporting business development and new opportunity capture
* Develop and maintain:
* + Technical budgets for vehicle performance
  + System requirements and verification techniques
  + Simulations and analysis across vehicle functions
  + Test methods and data analysis
* Lead and own technical development of spacecraft missions
* Assist with program and product management
* Develop, in collaboration with team members, interface specifications, CONOPS definition, and other design documents
* Work directly with customers and our internal leadership team to shape requirements and write the core architecture for key proposals

**YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering (software, computer, electrical, aerospace, mechanical, or other technical engineering discipline)
* 12+ years of experience in the aerospace industry
* Experience supporting satellite and/or spacecraft development programs
* Ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI security clearance
* US citizenship is required, due to program requirements

**THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:**

* Active TS/SCI clearance
* Master's or PhD in engineering (software, computer, electrical, aerospace, mechanical, or other technical engineering discipline)
* Understanding of key spacecraft subsystems and their associated components, including: attitude determination and control (ADCS), electrical power systems (EPS), space-ground communications, on-orbit command and data handling (C&DH), and thermal control
* Thorough understanding of the space environment, orbital mechanics, and rigid body dynamics
* Highly effective and professional verbal and written communication skills with team and internal/external customers
* Previous experience with proposals and tech volume authorship
* Experience with MATLAB, Python, and STK
* Experience with CAD modeling and drawing
* Experience with requirement management tools such as JAMA or DOORS
* Experience with satellite operations
* Ability to work in a dynamic environment with competing priorities

*This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.*

**WHAT TO EXPECT**

We're on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that's not an easy task. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. jobs.title: LLM Inference Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**
------------------

We’re seeking an inference systems engineer to build the distributed serving and high-performance networking layer behind our large language models. You will own the path from model server to GPU fabric: prefill/decode disaggregation, KV-cache transfer, multi-node execution, and the observability and benchmarks needed to make those systems reliable in production. This role sits in the Inference team within the company’s Model team and partners closely with Model, Infrastructure, and Application engineering.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**
------------------

* Design, implement, and operate disaggregated LLM serving architectures, including independent prefill and decode pools, KV-cache transfer, routing, batching, and failure recovery.
* Optimize multi-node inference across modern GPU systems using NVLink, NVSwitch, NVLS, InfiniBand, RoCEv2, GPUDirect RDMA, NCCL, UCX, and related communication paths.
* Build and tune serving systems using SGLang, vLLM, NVIDIA Dynamo, TensorRT-LLM, or comparable frameworks.
* Profile end-to-end performance across compute, memory, network, and storage; improve time to first token, inter-token latency, throughput, tail latency, and cost per token.
* Develop repeatable benchmark and capacity-planning workflows across model architectures, GPU types, parallelism strategies, and concurrency levels.
* Productionize serving on Kubernetes with health checks, autoscaling, safe rollouts, metrics, tracing, and actionable diagnostics.
* Diagnose complex distributed failures such as collective timeouts, topology mismatches, packet loss, congestion, KV-transfer stalls, GPU OOMs, and uneven load.
* Partner with model researchers and platform engineers to launch new models, serving features, and hardware generations safely.

**LOCATION REQUIREMENT**
------------------------

We believe the best ideas happen together. To support fast collaboration and a strong team culture, this role is expected to be in our Menlo Park office five days a week, unless otherwise specified.

**WHAT YOU BRING**
------------------

### **Must-Have:**

* Production experience building or operating distributed systems, high-performance computing systems, or large-scale ML inference platforms.
* Strong understanding of LLM inference, including tensor/pipeline/data parallelism, continuous batching, KV-cache management, and prefill/decode behavior.
* Hands-on experience with GPU communication and networking technologies such as NCCL, NVLink/NVSwitch, InfiniBand, RoCE, RDMA, UCX, or equivalent systems.
* Strong Python skills and working proficiency in C++ or another systems language.
* Ability to profile and debug performance across application, runtime, kernel, network, and infrastructure layers.
* Experience deploying production workloads on Kubernetes and operating them with clear reliability and observability standards.
* Clear written and verbal communication across research, infrastructure, and product-facing teams.
* Master's or PhD Required

### **Nice-to-Have:**

* Direct experience with disaggregated serving, KV-cache transfer, NVIDIA Dynamo/NIXL, SGLang, vLLM, or TensorRT-LLM.
* Experience with NVLS, SHARP, GPUDirect RDMA, UCX, RDMA congestion control, or GPU-cluster topology optimization.
* CUDA, Triton, custom kernel, or low-level GPU performance experience.
* Experience with speculative decoding, multi-LoRA serving, quantization, or cache-aware routing.
* Contributions to open-source inference, networking, or distributed-systems projects.
* Experience benchmarking new GPU platforms and turning results into production architecture decisions.

**REFERENCES**
--------------

* Polaris: A Safety-focused LLM Constellation Architecture for Healthcare — https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.13313
* Polaris 2 — https://www.hippocraticai.com/polaris2
* Personalized Interactions — https://www.hippocraticai.com/personalized-interactions
* Human Touch in AI — https://www.hippocraticai.com/the-human-touch-in-ai
* Empathetic Intelligence — https://www.hippocraticai.com/empathetic-intelligence

**Why Join Hippocratic AI**
---------------------------

**Reinvent healthcare with AI that puts safety first.** We’re building the world’s first healthcare‑only, safety‑focused LLM — a breakthrough platform designed to transform patient outcomes at a global scale. This is category creation.

**Work with the people shaping the future.** Hippocratic AI was co‑founded by CEO Munjal Shah and a team of physicians, hospital leaders, AI pioneers, and researchers from institutions like El Camino Health, Johns Hopkins, Washington University in St. Louis, Stanford, Google, Meta, Microsoft, and NVIDIA.

**Backed by the world’s leading healthcare and AI investors.** We recently raised a $126M Series C at a $3.5B valuation, led by Avenir Growth, bringing total funding to $404M with participation from CapitalG, General Catalyst, a16z, Kleiner Perkins, Premji Invest, UHS, Cincinnati Children’s, WellSpan Health, John Doerr, Rick Klausner, and others.

**Build alongside the best in healthcare and AI.** Join experts who’ve spent their careers improving care, advancing science, and building world‑changing technologies — ensuring our platform is powerful, trusted, and truly transformative.

**Equal Opportunity**
---------------------

Hippocratic AI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a team that reflects the patients we serve. We actively encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. If you require accommodations during the hiring process, please contact people@hippocraticai.com.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, LLVM Compiler - MTIA
jobs.description:
Meta designs and deploys its own AI systems. MTIA, the Meta Training and Inference Accelerator, is Meta's family of in-house AI accelerator ASICs, deployed in production across Meta's data centers and expanding workload coverage from ranking and recommendation to generative AI. The MTIA Software team is part of the AI & Compute Foundation organization. Because the hardware is ours, the software is ours too: we build the entire stack a chip vendor would normally supply: compiler and toolchain, runtime, kernel libraries, developer tooling, and deep PyTorch integration, co-designed with the silicon teams generation over generation.The GenAI Frameworks org owns the layer where a model meets the machine. We take frontier models, including large language, multimodal and diffusion models, and make them run efficiently on MTIA. Our work determines how fast those models respond, how much context they can afford to hold, how many of them a given amount of silicon can serve, and how quickly a newly released model can be running and trusted in production.We are hiring a Software Engineer to own a key area of GenAI inference on MTIA, spanning serving frameworks, distributed inference, graph-mode execution and compilation, and core PyTorch integration. This is a domain-expert role: you will set technical direction for your area, drive ambiguous multi-quarter programs across team boundaries, and own the quality bar for accuracy, stability, performance, and test coverage on custom silicon.

* Enable frontier models on MTIA and validate accuracy against GPU baselines, closing correctness gaps and distinguishing real regressions from stale references

* Partner with kernel, compiler, and silicon teams on hardware/software co-design, producing framework-level evidence that shapes the future silicon while the design can still change
* Provide technical leadership: mentor other engineers, raise the design quality through reviews, and communicate decisions clearly through design documents and cross-team reviews

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience with generative AI inference or training frameworks, or production model-serving systems

* Experience with GenAI inference optimization: prefill and decode optimization, KV-cache management and compression, batching and scheduling, and reasoning about latency and throughput tradeoffs

Ready to Power a Smarter World with us?

The Home Software Platform (HSP) is the shared cloud foundation behind Generac's connected home energy products - PWRcell, PWRmicro, HSB Generator, Load Management, and HEMS. As a Senior Staff Software Engineer focused on Infrastructure and Security, you will shape how that platform is architected and defended: designing the cloud infrastructure behind Generac's home energy software - the applications, services, data, and connected devices it spans - and embedding security into every layer of it. You will work closely with SRE and engineering teams to lead and influence technical direction across the platform. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role with organization-wide technical influence.

**Responsibilities:**

* Provide architectural leadership and direct technical influence over HSP-wide infrastructure decisions on AWS, defining the patterns, guardrails, and reference architectures that engineering teams build on across the platform.
* Design scalable, resilient, cost-efficient infrastructure for a high-volume cloud platform - APIs and services, data and streaming pipelines, compute and storage, and device-to-cloud data flows.
* Help shape infrastructure-as-code standards (Terraform, AWS CDK, or equivalent) so that environments are reproducible, reviewable, and auditable end to end.
* Drive the platform's security posture as a first-class design concern: threat modeling, secrets management, network segmentation, and data protection for device and consumer data.
* Lead cloud security architecture across the AWS account structure: IAM boundaries, least-privilege access, encryption in transit and at rest, key management, and tamper-evident audit logging.
* Partner with SRE teams to strengthen the observability and reliability backbone - metrics, tracing, logging, alerting, and SLOs.
* Partner with product engineering teams to review designs, unblock hard infrastructure and security problems, and raise the bar on operational and secure-coding practices through mentorship and technical leadership.
* Contribute to multi-year platform architecture and technology strategy, translating platform capabilities into concrete, buildable infrastructure and security roadmaps.
* Lead build-vs-buy evaluations for infrastructure and security tooling, and guide the technical integration of selected third-party services.
* Partner with SRE teams to drive cost visibility and optimization across the cloud estate without compromising reliability or security.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10+ years of progressive software engineering experience, with a substantial focus on cloud infrastructure and platform engineering.
* Deep, hands-on expertise architecting production systems on a major public cloud, preferably AWS.
* Several years of hands-on security engineering across secure architecture, identity and access management, and threat modeling, applied to large-scale distributed systems.
* Strong proficiency with infrastructure-as-code, containers and orchestration, CI/CD, and modern observability tooling.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Deep familiarity with the AWS security and networking stack (IAM, KMS, VPC design, GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail, Config, WAF).
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code at scale using Terraform and/or AWS CDK, including module design and policy-as-code guardrails.
* Track record of building high-volume distributed cloud platforms; experience with device-to-cloud patterns (OTA update, edge computing, telemetry pipelines) is a plus.
* Experience securing consumer data and connected-device fleets, including relevant privacy and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar).
* Proficiency with container orchestration (Kubernetes / EKS) and event-driven and streaming architectures.
* Practitioner-level experience building or deploying AI/LLM-powered applications and tooling, including hands-on use of Claude via Amazon Bedrock.
* Familiarity with the home energy domain - HEMS, demand response, utility APIs, and grid-services integrations.
* Strong technical-communication skills: able to translate complex infrastructure and security trade-offs into clear, actionable narratives for engineering teams and technical stakeholders.
* A track record of raising engineering standards through mentorship, design review, and pragmatic technical leadership.

As lead engineer, responsibilities include total delivery of the electrical and instrumentation deliverables and services on time, within performance budget and meeting quality expectations. Duties may include performing advanced engineering work serving as a technical specialist for complex engineering assignments. * Developing conceptual layouts and cost studies as necessary to determine the simplest, most efficient approach to solving engineering tasks at hand.

* Producing detail design calculations and sketches for materials of construction associated with the project. Calculations produced will be neatly prepared and organized for efficient checking by others and efficient use by drafters/designers for preparing drawings and as a deliverable when required.

* Checking calculations made by other engineers to ensure accuracy, conformance to codes, specifications, design criteria and conformance to good engineering practice.

* Ability to determine motor control center loading.

* Ability to create accurate electrical installation documents from the information found on vendor equipment drawings.
