jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Embedded Software EngineerJob Category: Information TechnologyTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCIEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: Up to 25%Type of Travel: Outside Continental USAnticipated Posting End: 12/26/2026  
  

**The Opportunity:**

  

The Embedded Software Engineer works on the operations floor, alongside the intelligence operators and analysts who use a government-owned, multi-source analytic capability to do their mission. You will sit with the people doing work that’s critical to National Security, make the capability perform for them at the point of use, and return what you learn – how the mission actually uses the capability, where it falls short, and what it needs next – to the team that is continually enhancing the capability.

  
  

The role carries two functions: First, adoption and mission value: training, capability integration, workflow analysis, troubleshooting, and tradecraft support at the seat, so mission value is realized where the work happens. Second, forward sensing: structured, disciplined observation of use cases, friction, and unmet need, fed directly into the capability roadmap. This role is primarily defined by the second function.

  
  

**Responsibilities:**

  

* Work with the on-site analysts to understand their mission and create innovative software solutions that streamline their workflows.
* Design and develop software products that interface with the enterprise software tools already in use by the analysts to increase the intelligence value of the available data.
* Catalog all generated software in a manner that allows it to be tracked and incorporated into an enterprise software baseline if/when required.
* Develop working proficiency in the supported organization’s analytic tradecraft, sufficient to translate operator problems into technical terms and technical constraints into operator terms.
* Provide on-site integration, configuration, workflow automation, and troubleshooting support for the fielded analytic capability directly to end users. Diagnose problems in place and commit to a resolution path within 48 hours.
* Capture and document observed use cases, capability gaps, workflow friction, and unmet mission need in a structured format, and report them on a defined cadence into the capability development roadmap.
* Support connection of the enterprise analytic capability to adjacent mission systems and data sources at the site, within the fielded baseline and under the customer’s configuration control. Where a local workaround is warranted, it is coordinated with the core development team for incorporation into the enterprise baseline rather than maintained as standalone local software.
* Deliver hands-on training and best-practice support to users, sustain the customer’s trust in every interaction, and operate at all times within contract scope, site security requirements, and the organizational-conflict-of-interest framework.
  

  

**Qualifications:**

*Required:*

  

* Active TS/SCI security clearance and a polygraph preferred
* 10+ years of operational intelligence experience — military, Intelligence Community, or contractor — in an analytic, targeting, collection, watch-floor environment or direct software development support to any of these functions.
* Demonstrated technical fluency with analytic tools, data systems, and their integration: able to configure, troubleshoot, and adapt fielded capability with users in real time.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently at a customer site with limited direct supervision, exercising sound judgment in ambiguous conditions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear, structured observation reporting for a technical audience and communicate critical information to a geographically dispersed team across numerous time zones
* Willingness to relocate to, or work extended assignments at, the supported mission location, including OCONUS.
  

  

**Qualifications:**  
*Desired:*

  

* Bachelor’s degree in a technical, intelligence, or related discipline, or equivalent operational experience.
* Prior assignment at a joint or combined operational headquarters, a national intelligence agency, or an equivalent operational intelligence organization.
* Familiarity with geospatial, multi-source, or object-based analytic platforms and their data architectures.
* Experience in a forward-deployed engineer, embedded technical support, or field engineering role in a classified environment.

jobs.title: Controls Engineer (Robotics)
jobs.description:
Controls Engineer

Location: Loveland, CO  
Full-Time | On-Site | Approximately 30% Travel

We’re looking for a Senior Controls Engineer who knows industrial automation and can own projects from programming through startup.

This is a hands-on role. You’ll be working on custom automation equipment, Fanuc Robotics, programming PLCs and HMIs, troubleshooting systems, supporting installations, and working directly with customers and the rest of the engineering team.

The biggest thing we’re looking for is someone who is genuinely strong with Allen-Bradley / Rockwell controls and is comfortable walking into a machine or automation system, figuring out what’s going on, and getting it running.

Robotics and vision experience are a plus, but strong controls experience is much more important.

What you’ll be doing:

* Programming and troubleshooting Allen-Bradley PLCs using Studio 5000
* Developing and modifying HMI applications
* Designing controls for new automation equipment
* Debugging and commissioning equipment in-house and at customer facilities
* Working with drives, servos, sensors, safety systems, industrial networks, and other controls hardware
* Troubleshooting electrical and controls issues
* Supporting projects from design through installation and startup
* Working directly with customers during commissioning and startup
* Helping guide less experienced engineers when needed
* Traveling to customer sites for installations, startups, and service work

Travel is typically around 25% and comes with the territory in custom automation. It won’t be every week, but you should be comfortable getting on-site when a project needs you.

What we’re looking for:

We’re looking for someone with solid real-world controls experience, not someone who has only made minor PLC changes or supported existing equipment.

Ideally, you have:

* Strong Allen-Bradley / Rockwell PLC programming experience
* Strong Studio 5000 experience
* HMI programming experience
* Experience with industrial automation or custom machinery
* Experience commissioning and starting up equipment
* Strong electrical troubleshooting ability
* Experience with VFDs, servos, safety systems, sensors, and industrial networks
* The ability to work independently and take ownership of projects
* Good communication skills with both customers and other engineers

Experience with Fanuc robots, Keyence vision systems, or robotic automation is a plus, but it is not required.

Why this role is worth looking at:

This isn’t a plant maintenance controls job where you’ll spend your day keeping the same equipment alive.

You’ll work on different automation projects, solve different problems, and be involved in projects from the engineering stage all the way through startup.

If you like building things, troubleshooting equipment, programming controls, and seeing a project actually come to life, this is the kind of role you’ll probably enjoy.

We’re looking for someone in the Northern Colorado / Denver-area market, or someone who is seriously planning to relocate to the area.

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

**Automation Engineer – JLL**
=============================

**What this job involves:**  
We are seeking an experienced Automation Engineer to design, develop, and implement automation control systems for industrial processes and warehouse distribution equipment. The role requires strong knowledge of engineering principles, programming, and control system technologies, with a focus on improving the reliability and performance of conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print-and-apply systems, and SCADA devices. All work must follow established policies and procedures, with safety as a top priority.

**What your day-to-day will look like:**

* Serve as site technical expert in automation control systems and mentor Apprentices to meet safety and technical standards.

* Design, develop, implement, and optimize control systems and software; maintain and troubleshoot equipment including PLC/PC controllers and industrial networks.

* Adhere to strict documentation and Automation Change Management procedures.

* Partner with operations, engineering, and support teams to optimize MHE systems and deliver projects.

* Monitor MHE metrics, analyze performance issues, and lead troubleshooting efforts locally and remotely.

* Conduct root cause analysis, implement process improvements, and drive continuous improvement projects for performance and cost savings.

* Communicate technical issues, timelines, and operational workarounds to leadership and stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 4-year degree or knowledge equivalent to a 4-year degree

* Proven ability to lead, train, and mentor less experienced automation engineers.

* Proficiency in CMMS use, troubleshooting, and working with multiple stakeholders to coordinate complex maintenance activities.

* Advanced verbal and written English skills with ability to interpret and communicate policies.

* Strong problem-solving mindset, adaptability, and commitment to continuous improvement.

* Flexibility to work varied shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 2+ years of PLC programming, troubleshooting, and HMI/control network design, along with SCADA systems and KPIs.

* Hands-on experience with motor controls (VFDs, DC drives, starters) and industrial electrical systems (480V 3-phase, 120 VAC, 24VDC).

* Proficiency in RSLogix5000 Studio, FT View, and other controls software, with experience in controls design and systems integration.

* Ability to interpret, modify, and develop mechanical and electrical drawings.

* Field service engineering and technical training experience, including conveyors, sortation, ASRS, and industrial robotics.

* Proven record in remote technical support and driving automation system improvements.

jobs.title: GNC Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Description:

You will develop the guidance and control software that carries a flight vehicle from ascent through atmospheric entry and an autonomous runway landing. Your algorithms and C++ code will be exercised in high-fidelity simulation, hardware-in-the-loop environments, and ultimately in flight. You will help maintain the six-degree-of-freedom simulation that the broader program depends on for design decisions and mission confidence. If you value simple, testable software and want your work connected directly to vehicle performance, this role offers meaningful end-to-end ownership.

**WORKSITE**: Onsite in Titusville, Florida

**WORK SCHEDULE:** Full-time; schedule based on program needs

**PAY RATE:** Salary determined based upon experience

**WHAT WE OFFER:**

Paid sick leave based on state regulations after 90 days of employment

Medical, dental, and vision coverage after a waiting period (60% paid by Fortuna)

Free TeleMedicine and Mental Health support for all employees and their families.

Additional voluntary benefits: Group Life Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Critical Care, Short-Term Disability

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

Develop, integrate, test, and maintain flight GNC algorithms in C++ for ascent, entry, terminal-area energy management, approach, and autonomous landing.

Build and maintain a high-fidelity six-degree-of-freedom vehicle simulation used for algorithm development, verification, and program decision-making.

Model vehicle dynamics, sensors, actuators, atmosphere, navigation inputs, and failure cases with appropriate fidelity for each phase of flight.

Design and execute software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop tests, analyze results, and resolve discrepancies between models, hardware, and expected performance.

Collaborate with flight software, avionics, aerodynamics, propulsion, systems, test, and operations teams to define interfaces and verify integrated behavior.

Support mission rehearsals, flight-readiness activities, console operations, and post-flight data review for test and flight events.

Requirements:

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING:**

At least five years of experience in guidance, navigation and control, flight controls, vehicle dynamics, robotics controls, or flight-critical embedded software.

Strong C++ development skills and a solid foundation in control theory, numerical methods, rigid-body dynamics, and state-space modeling.

Experience developing or maintaining six-degree-of-freedom simulations and validating algorithms through software-in-the-loop or hardware-in-the-loop testing.

Experience with flight-critical software, autonomous vehicles, launch vehicles, reentry vehicles, missiles, aircraft, or spacecraft is strongly preferred.

Bachelor's degree in aerospace, mechanical, electrical, computer engineering, computer science, applied mathematics, or a related discipline, or equivalent directly relevant experience.

Ability to work onsite in Titusville, Florida, communicate technical results clearly, and develop straightforward, testable, maintainable code.

Fortuna is a certified veteran-owned IT consulting and staffing company, comprised of practicing professionals all of whom are committed to excellence in providing the most efficient and innovative information technology solutions customized to our clients' specifications.

Career Site: www.gofortuna.com.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a highly skilled, adaptable, and customer-focused Sr. Network/Systems Engineer to join our Managed Service Provider (MSP) team based in Jacksonville, FL. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, monitoring, and troubleshooting complex networks, systems, and security infrastructures for a diverse portfolio of clients.

Unlike a traditional in-house IT role, an MSP Network Engineer must balance multiple client environments simultaneously, shifting smoothly from proactive solution architecture to diagnosing and resolving intricate, multi-layered computer problems. This position requires mostly work from our main office and traveling to local customer sites across the greater Jacksonville area. We place a premium on candidates who possess elite customer service skills, are highly responsive to client needs, have a passionate willingness to learn new technologies on the fly, and are eager to mentor and train junior IT staff.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Complex Troubleshooting:** Act as a high-level technical investigator to diagnose, isolate, and resolve complex IT and network infrastructure issues, identifying root causes across hardware, operating systems, and cloud dependencies.
* **Customer-Centric Support:** Serve as a highly responsive, consultative technical resource for clients, ensuring all communication is prompt, clear, and reassuring during disruptions.
* **Infrastructure Management:** Deploy, configure, and maintain multi-vendor network hardware including managed PCs, servers, switches, firewalls, VOIP phones and wireless access points (WAPs).
* **Security Infrastructure Management:** Oversee, configure, and actively manage clients' advanced endpoint and network security solutions, including **EDR, MDR, and XDR** platforms.

* **Team Mentorship:** Actively share knowledge, provide technical guidance, and **help train junior IT staff and help desk technicians** to elevate the team's overall capabilities.
* **Continuous Learning:** Rapidly adapt to and adopt new vendor tools, software suites, and emerging technologies on the fly as clients update their tech stacks.
* **Documentation:** Maintain meticulous, up-to-date documentation of client network topologies, configuration backups, credentials, and security profiles.

**Travel & Schedule Requirements**

* **In-Office & Local Travel:** This is an in-office position requiring regular travel to customer locations throughout the Jacksonville area.
* **Travel Flexibility:** Must be flexible and ready to travel out-of-town to client sites within day of notice to address urgent client requests.
* **Out-of-Town Travel:** Occasional overnight or out-of-town travel may be required based on project needs.
* **Reimbursement:** All business-related travel and mileage will be reimbursed per company policy.
* **Off-Hours Support:** Candidates must be flexible to provide support and handle network deployments during off-hours or weekends when required to minimize client downtime.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* **Advanced Problem-Solving:** A proven track record of solving complex IT problems under pressure, demonstrating structured troubleshooting methodologies.
* **Adaptability & Growth Mindset:** A strong desire and demonstrated ability to research, learn, and implement unfamiliar technologies independently and quickly.

jobs.title: Offshore Recovery Electrical Engineer I
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we're building rockets to serve today's needs and tomorrow's breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that's just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven't been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you're in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you'll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we're writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it's early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

**About the Team:**

The Offshore Recovery team is responsible for designing, building and operating the maritime vessels used to land and recover the Terran R launch vehicle. This isn't your standard desk job. We are a lean, fast-moving team who cover the full project lifecycle – beginning with system requirements definition and design, hands-on with build and activation in the shipyard, all the way through supporting critical offshore recovery missions at sea. We collaborate with teams across the company, including Terran R designers, launch pad builders and rocket engine testers!

**About the Role:**

* Support the design, integration, testing, and operation of electrical systems aboard the recovery barge throughout the engineering lifecycle, including development, construction, sea trials, certification, and offshore mission support.
* Provide engineering support for electrical systems, including low-voltage control systems, rocket ground systems, programmable logic controllers (PLCs), networking, high-power distribution, and RF telemetry.
* Support offshore recovery operations by verifying electrical system functionality and assisting with troubleshooting to enable safe and reliable landing and recovery of Terran R.
* Collaborate with engineering, marine, and operations teams to resolve technical issues, improve system performance, and support mission readiness.
* Incorporate lessons learned from initial recovery operations into the design and integration of future landing platforms and recovery systems.

**About You:**

* You have a bachelor's degree or higher in engineering, with academic projects, internships, or other hands-on experience applying engineering principles to physical hardware or electrical systems.
* You have a foundational understanding of electrical engineering principles and can apply technical knowledge to unfamiliar systems and engineering challenges.
* You can communicate technical information clearly and coordinate effectively with engineering, construction, and operations teams.
* You can work collaboratively across disciplines, contribute to shared technical objectives, and support activities outside your primary area of responsibility as project needs evolve.
* You are willing to travel an average of at least 25% of the time, with potential for weekend work and schedule variations to support shipyard activities, construction, sea trials, certification, and offshore mission operations.
* You can work in marine and offshore environments as required by the role, including supporting field activities and collaborating with teams during system integration, testing, and operational readiness.

**Nice to haves but not required:**

* Familiarity with low-voltage control systems, programmable logic controllers (PLCs), networking, or RF systems.
* Familiarity with high-power electrical distribution systems.
* Experience supporting engineering, testing, or operations in a marine environment.

**Successful candidates must clear a background check administered by the US government to obtain clearance for on-site work at our government partner location in Cape Canaveral, Florida.**

**We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.**

***If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact us at*** ***accommodations@relativityspace.com******.***

***Please note: Relativity Space does not accept unsolicited resumes, candidate profiles, or referrals from recruitment agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited submission - via email, our website, social media, or directly to an employee - will be deemed the property of Relativity Space, and no fee will be owed absent a current, fully executed agreement with Talent Acquisition that specifically authorizes submissions for the applicable role.***

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer - Core Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

At Anduril's Tactical Recon and Strike (TRS) team, we're pushing the boundaries of aerial drone technology. We're the driving force behind groundbreaking products like Ghost, Anvil, Bolt, and Altius, taking them from concept to fully operational systems that are reshaping the landscape of defense and security. Our team tackles the entire spectrum of small drone development (Group 1-3), from the drones themselves to the critical equipment needed for testing, deployment, and operation. We thrive on solving complex challenges, collaborating with specialist teams to deliver cutting-edge solutions for our customers. In TRS, you'll be at the forefront of innovation, working with state-of-the-art technology and pushing the limits of what autonomous systems can achieve. If you're passionate about creating transformative technology and want to be part of a team that's shaping the future of defense capabilities, we want to hear from you. Join us in our quest to develop game-changing aerial systems that are redefining what's possible in tactical reconnaissance and strike operations.

#### **THE ROLE**

This position is on the TRS Core Infrastructure team and will be focused on building the infrastructure to field TRS Products such as Altius, Ghost, Bolt and Anvil. Our charter is to provide the foundation for teams across Anduril to deploy cutting edge TRS autonomy and to tie it all together into an easy-to-use product. The solutions that you will create address the current needs of our customers and will have immediate impact towards the success of our products.  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design, build, test, and release the backend services used during manufacturing and deployment of Anduril Products.
* Help define foundational software architectures, configuration processes, and user experience workflows for our products, working directly with chief engineers, program managers, flight test engineers, and end-user customers to demonstrate capability and iterate on feedback.
* Work directly with frontend technologies like TypeScript/React/PySide, high-performance backend technologies like Golang/Python/Rust, and software product lifecycle technologies like NixOS/CircleCI/Docker.
* Interface with engineers developing every aspect of the system from low-level Linux drivers to cutting edge autonomy and streamlined user interfaces.
* Test and evaluate your software at multiple levels of rigor using simulations, benchtop hardware, and live flight assets.

**Required Qualifications**

* At least 3+ years working with a variety of programming languages such as Python, Rust, C++, Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, etc.
* Have experience working with customers to deliver novel software capabilities
* Want to work on building the tools that technicians, engineers, and operators will use to prepare Altius for real-world missions
* Have built user interfaces using popular frontend frameworks (React, PySide, etc)
* Are passionate about user experience and always strive to provide the most streamlined product
* Have an intuition for finding solutions to complex problems that involve multiple first and third party technologies (related to simulation, data management, compute infrastructure, networking, and more)
* Enjoy collaborating with team members and partners in the autonomy domain, and building technologies and processes which enable users to safely and rapidly develop and deploy autonomous systems at scale
* Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* You've built or invented something: an app, a website, game, startup
* Previous experience working in an engineering setting: a startup (or startup-like environment), engineering school, etc.
* Professional software development lifecycle experience using tools such as version control, CI/CD systems, etc.
* A deep, demonstrated understanding of how computers and networks work, from a single desktop to a multi-cluster cloud node (UDP, TCP, gRPC, REST, etc.)
* Experience creating infrastructure for robots or other complex embedded devices
* Experience building scalable backend software systems with various data storage and processing requirements
* Experience with industry standard cloud platforms (AWS, Azure), CI/CD tools, and software infrastructure fundamentals (networking, security, distributed systems)
* Ability to quickly understand and navigate complex systems and established code bases
* Experience with modern build and deployment tooling (e.g. CircleCI, Docker, NixOS, Terraform)
* Experience designing complex software systems, and iterating upon designs via a technical design review process
* Familiarity with industry standard monitoring, logging, and data management tools and best practices
* A bias towards rapid delivery and iteration

The **Senior Electrical and Controls Engineer** is a technical leader responsible for driving the design, development, and implementation of electrical and control systems across Compu Dynamics Modular's data center and commercial modular products. * Calculate electrical loads, select equipment, and perform code analysis to ensure design compliance.
* Generate complete electrical Bills of Material
* Collaborate with manufacturing teams to ensure designs meet production best practices and are constructible.
* Develop PLC and HMI based environmental monitoring systems from a hardware and software perspective
* Select monitoring systems and instruments as required, including biometric access, alarming systems, fire detection systems, leak detection, temperature, pressure, and humidity sensors

* Lead efforts to ensure compliance with NEC, local codes, safety regulations, and internal documentation standards.

* Deep knowledge of electrical power systems, controls, and modular design.

Work is primarily performed in an office or collaborative environment with occasional site visits. Field work may include exposure to active construction, elevated temperatures, and energized equipment.

The Georgia Tech Research Institute (GTRI) is the nonprofit, applied research division of the Georgia Institute of Technology (Georgia Tech). GTRI's renowned researchers combine science, engineering, economics, policy, and technical expertise to solve complex problems for the U.S. federal government, state, and industry.

Georgia Tech's mission is to develop leaders who advance technology and improve the human condition. The Institute has nine key values that are foundational to everything we do:

jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
SEL (Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories) seeks a professional and innovative individual to join our Equipment Automation Engineering (EAE) team in Lewiston ID. SEL is a 100 percent employee-owned company that specializes in creating and manufacturing digital products and systems that protect and control power systems around the world.

The Equipment Automation Engineering team supports manufacturing and vertical integration teams by understanding our manufacturing processes, recommending solutions, and executing projects.

The successful candidate will be dependable, responsible, and self-motivated, and work closely with other EAE automation controls engineers, EAE mechanical engineers, Production representatives, and related Engineering teams to develop, successfully implement, and support custom manufacturing automation solutions.

**As an Automation Controls Engineer, a typical day might include the following:**

1. Designing or upgrading custom automated manufacturing equipment.

2. Developing and maintaining a detailed understanding of industrial automation/control systems including related hardware, protocols, serial and network communications, security, and logic programming.

3. Laying out new industrial electrical control panels which are NFPA79/NEC/UL508A compliant and creating electrical schematics.

4. Creating product documentation such as operating manuals, spare parts lists, and maintenance manuals.

5. Managing electrical cabinet builds.

6. Creating machine interactions with plant-wide Manufacturing Execution System (MES).

7. Introducing automated processes into production, and training Maintenance and Production teams to support after deployment of equipment.

8. Managing project scope, schedule, and budget for assigned projects.

9. Mentoring Associate Engineers and Technicians.

10. Other duties as assigned.

**This job might be for you if you have:**

1. B.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechatronics, or related discipline; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

2. Typically 2+ years relevant experience in designing, implementing, and/or modifying automation solutions in a manufacturing environment.

3. Working knowledge in the area of PLCs (example: Allen Bradley, Mitsubishi), HMI/GUI layout, Field Bus Networks, Vision Systems, and integration of Robotics.

4. Familiarity with electrical prints and standards for industrial equipment.

5. Demonstrated proficiency in programming PLCs.

6. Familiarity with some of the following programming methodologies:

* State machines
* Pick and place automation
* Parallel processing
* PID Control
* Data management

7. Proven ability to design fault-tolerant systems with error handling and recovery processes.

**Location Information**

**Lewiston, ID** – This position is located in Lewiston, ID where you'll enjoy an unmatched quality of life. Enjoy the smaller town life: country space, freedom from traffic, easy access to recreational activities in nearby mountains, rivers, and forests, as well as great schools and universities.

**Competitive pay. Superior benefits. Inspiring work.**

People are at the core of our company and we hire employee-owners. We welcome you to learn more about how we support employees.

* We’re 100% employee owned. Retirement benefits include an employer funded stock ownership plan (ESOP) and personal 401(k) options.
* We offer top tier medical, prescription, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance.
* We recognize the importance of a healthy life balance and offer: 10 paid holidays, annual vacation accrual starting at 12 days, 9 paid sick days, and paid family and medical leave that covers 90% of your pay.
* We foster growth and development of our employees through avenues such as STEM courses, apprenticeships, tuition assistance, and engineering development programs.
* Ask our team about other benefits including wellness, fertility, adoption, and flexible spending benefits.

NORC at the University of Chicago is seeking a Systems Engineer to join the Secure Computing and Operations group. BAE Systems is seeking a full-time Systems Engineer (w/Mechanical focus) to be a part of our Interface Management team working on the US Sea-Launch-Cruise-Missile (SLCM-N) Weapons Program. The selected candidate will work closely with numerous engineering teams supporting the US Navy's Strategic Systems Programs command and its industry partners.
  
  
About SLCM-N
  
In response to global threats, SSP is continuing to defend our nation by adding a second nuclear defense system option to their mission responsibilities with the SLCM-N Program. SSP is building this modular, survivable cruise missile system that will be outfitted on some submarines and surface ships. SSP is responsible for designing, developing, building, and deploying the SLCM-N Weapons System and BAE Systems is supporting our customer in the pre-development activities for the program.
  
  
Our primary function is to ensure that all weapon system interface requirements are correctly defined and properly allocated to the cognizant organization. This is achieved by performing technical change evaluations and interfacing with government and contractor activities to define Weapon System Coordinated Interfaces. Accuracy, integrity, the ability to work independently, and a natural curiosity are important traits for a successful candidate to demonstrate.
  
  
About BAE Systems and the U.S. Navy’s Strategic Systems Programs (SSP)
  
Our organization has supported the U.S. Navy’s Strategic Systems Programs (SSP) continually since the program’s inception in the 1950s. SSP developed the first sea-based, underwater-launched Strategic Weapon System (SWS), a defense system that is truly critical to our national security. For more than six decades, SSP has maintained and upgraded this weapon system and we have been there every step of the way. The sea-based SWS is the ultimate stealthy weapon system and as the first leg of the U.S. nuclear triad. With over 70% of our nation’s nuclear arsenal its importance to maintaining world peace cannot be overstated. The development of Columbia, the most advanced nuclear-powered, nuclear-armed submarine ever designed, as well the next D5LE2 weapon system is under way and will begin to be rolled out over the next decade. The Navy projects this system to be operational through 2084, meaning the program will have a total life span of more than 120 years. This is a truly unique program and BAE Systems employees on this program understand they are part of an important legacy.
  
  
As a decades long sole source partner on multiple contracts on behalf of our customer, our program has remarkable stability and is concurrently experiencing significant growth. Combined, these factors provide ample opportunity for professional growth and development for capable and talented individuals on our team.

jobs.title: Scientific Software Engineer – Machine Programming
jobs.description:
**Summary**

This role helps the scientists who build and operate QuEra's neutral-atom quantum computers program those machines effectively. You will maintain the domain-specific language and compiler stack, built on the open-source Kirin toolchain, that experimental physicists use every day to run their experiments.

You will work closely with physicists and control stack engineers. You'll help machine teams turn new experiments into working programs, keep the toolchain reliable as our hardware evolves, and drive its integration with our control system. The role suits an engineer who enjoys building tools and also helping others succeed with them.

**Responsibilities**

* Maintain the domain-specific language and its compilation stack: triage issues, fix bugs, review pull requests, manage releases and keep CI, tests and dependencies healthy.
* Act as the point of contact for machine and testbed teams programming their experiments. Help them build new experiments, port legacy programs and diagnose compilation or runtime problems.
* Work with control stack engineers on integrating compiled programs with our control system. This includes defining and evolving the program representation passed between the compiler and the control system, keeping the two in sync across releases, and debugging problems that span both.
* Turn user problems into minimal reproducible reports, regression tests and focused fixes, and work with the compiler team on larger language or IR changes.
* Find and fix performance problems in program compilation and execution, such as compile time, program size and timing correctness.
* Write and maintain user-facing documentation, tutorials, example programs and agent skills that make it easier for physicists to write correct programs.
* Work with the hardware control team to support new channel types, control hardware and machine configurations.
* Collect feedback from machine users and turn it into a prioritized roadmap for usability improvements.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Strong Python skills, including type hints, packaging and testing (pytest).
* Enjoys building tools for, and working closely with, scientists who are not professional software developers. Clear written and verbal communication.
* Experience working across team boundaries: agreeing on interfaces, coordinating changes between components and debugging problems that span several systems.
* Experience debugging unfamiliar code and reducing complex failures to minimal reproductions.
* Familiarity with the full software lifecycle: version control, code review, testing, CI/CD, logging, profiling, debugging and documentation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with compilers, domain-specific languages or SSA-based intermediate representations (experience with Kirin, MLIR or LLVM is a plus).
* Background in experimental physics, especially AMO or atomic physics lab control (AWGs, AOMs/AODs, DDS, timing systems, cameras).
* Experience with real-time or embedded control systems, FPGAs, or experiment-control frameworks such as ARTIQ or Labscript.
* Experience with real-time scheduling or execution systems, such as runtime schedulers, streaming or instruction-dispatch systems.
* Experience with C++ or Rust.
* Contributions to open-source libraries.
* Experience using AI coding agents in a development workflow.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon is seeking a talented, enthusiastic, and motivated Interdisciplinary Senior Systems Engineer to join a dynamic team that provides leadership for concept development, architecture, and design of robotics systems and industrial equipment. This candidate should be motivated to adapt well-tried systems engineer principles into a new and emerging industry. The preferred candidate would have demonstrated experience in robotics, mechatronics, experience with machine safety and/or functional safety standards, and possess excellent communication skills. This position reports directly to the System Architect.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The Senior Interdisciplinary Systems Engineer will:
  

* Define, expand, and explore the design space for complex, multidisciplinary robotics and automation problems
* Identify and analyze the cross-functional tradeoffs between design alternatives, including impact on performance, schedule, cost, risk, complexity, and scale
* Break down and frame problems using con-ops, use cases, structural/functional decompositions, and other system representations to clarify needs and align technical teams
* Identify design choices to ensure our products are safe, reliable, and usable, and can be deployed and supported at Amazon scale
* Build quantitative models and analyses (Excel, MATLAB, Python, internal tools) to conduct trade studies, refine requirements, and understand key system drivers across the integrated systems of systems
* Perform technical risk assessments (such as TRL, Gap Analysis, FMEDA, HARA, etc.), devise mitigation plans, and create system test strategies
* Develop and communicate system integration and evaluation strategies and plans in support of program learning, technical risk reduction, verification, and validation
* Drive and prioritize execution of system test campaigns that span lab and field testing environments in collaboration with subsystem development and test teams (test readiness reviews, test execution, post-test analysis and reporting)
* Guide and inform, via analyses, cross-functional architecture definition
* Mentor junior engineers in engineering best practices, and participate in hiring of new team members

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or above in engineering or equivalent STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) field
* 7+ years of professional experience
* Experience with eliciting and clarifying business and end user needs, and connecting those needs to system concepts, requirements, and designs
* Experience leading technical collaborations and creating alignment across diverse groups (e.g. hardware engineering, software engineering, controls, functional safety, program management)
* Experience identifying and analyzing dependencies, tradeoffs, and sensitivities across multi-disciplinary systems

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with industrial robotics and automated material handling solutions
* Experience with machine learning systems
* Experience developing and supporting hardware/software systems across the product life cycle
* Experience with scalable production systems
* Experience with developing safety-critical systems and supporting related regulatory compliance needs
* Experience with 1 or more relevant domains: Industrial Automation, Robotic Vehicles/Manipulation, Autonomy, Perception and Controls
* 9+ years of experience in integrated system design

Our platform promises substantial improvements to the accuracy of diagnosis and the efficacy of treatment of diseases like cancer, leveraging modern approaches in machine learning and artificial intelligence. -------------------

We're looking for a **Staff Software Engineer** to be a technical leader on the team building AISight, our digital pathology platform used by pathologists and labs worldwide. jobs.description:
Latitude AI (lat.ai) is building the future of Ford's autonomy roadmap to make travel safer, less stressful, and more enjoyable for everyone. Bringing this vision to scale, our fully in-house developed hands-free ADAS platform will debut on the all-new Ford Fathom in 2027.

When you join the Latitude team, you'll work alongside leading experts across machine learning and robotics, cloud platforms, mapping, sensors and compute systems, test operations, systems and safety engineering – ***all dedicated to redefining the relationship between people and their vehicles for millions of customers.***

As a Ford Motor Company subsidiary, we operate independently to develop automated driving technology at the speed of a technology startup. Latitude is headquartered in Pittsburgh with engineering centers in Dearborn, Mich., and Palo Alto, Calif.

**Meet the team:**

The Virtual Test Ecosystem (VTE) team ensures that our simulation (fully synthetic) and resimulation (replay engine using vehicle logs) workflows run efficiently and reliably at large scale. We use a mix of open source and cloud provider services to implement a processing framework that's cloud-agnostic as well as capable of running on-prem. The results of these simulations is business-critical for us - they're used in order to allow autonomy developers and testers to do large-scale safety and performance testing of changes prior to in-vehicle testing. We interact with engineers throughout the onboard and offboard stack in order to ensure smooth end-to-end capabilities.

**What you'll do:**

* We run vehicle simulations at unprecedented scales in order to ensure we're releasing a safe product. You'll support this via improvements to our sim/resim cloud framework and applications that run on this framework. In terms of implementation, this involves a lot of Python coding, interacting with open source packages and various AWS/GCP services. In terms of analysis, we're constantly looking for bottlenecks that limit scalability or otherwise hinder performance. You'll put together benchmarking to identify these spots and associated dashboards to track and summarize the information. Then armed with that information, you'll implement solutions to increase efficiency.
* It's not enough to have a framework that is functional - it needs to be intuitive and easy to use. We take our best guesses at this, but things evolve over time based on user interaction - both direct feedback as well as realizing how users are accidentally misusing or misinterpreting the results. VTE supports autonomy, systems, test, and a variety of other teams across the organization. Having an eye for how the system is being used, what users need, and a willingness to engage with these users on future improvements is critical.
* We also can't build it all, so we want to make the framework well-documented and as self-serve as possible for others to extend it (while being there to answer questions). For example, when there's a new portion of the autonomy stack, we want that autonomy team to be able to update resim to add it in themselves so that they can iterate quickly.
* In order to run logs through resim, we need to first know what logs are interesting. You'll contribute to the ecosystem of how we manage storing and searching for these logs efficiently, including how we automate indexing the interesting actors and interactions in a scene and how we determine our dataset coverage.
* Once we've run resim, we want to do something with the updated logs. Frequently this involves metrics to analyze the AV's performance; these metrics could range from low-level performance of a particular detector in the stack to if the AV is meeting high-level business objectives. You'll both work on the sim/resim cloud framework implementation to make this easy for all developers to add in their metrics and support the metrics implementation themselves as needs arise.

**What you'll need to succeed:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics or a related field and 4+ years of relevant experience (or Master's degree and 2+ years of relevant experience, or PhD)
* Expertise in writing Python code that's efficient, well-documented, and well-tested
* 2+ years' experience writing scalable applications that execute in a cloud or HPC environment
* 2+ years' experience writing software that interacts with AWS and/or GCP services
* Familiarity with NumPy and scientific programming
* Willingness and desire to learn how onboard and offboard components interact with each other and propose solutions to improve how developers and testers work with both systems

**Nice to have (optional):**

* C++ development experience
* Experience with Kubernetes

**What we offer you:**

* Competitive compensation packages
* High-quality individual and family medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Health savings account with available employer match
* Employer-matched 401(k) retirement plan with immediate vesting
* Employer-paid group term life insurance and the option to elect voluntary life insurance
* Paid parental leave and Adoption/Surrogacy support program
* Paid medical leave
* Unlimited vacation and 15 paid holidays
* Daily lunches, snacks, and beverages available in all office locations
* Pre-tax spending accounts for healthcare and dependent care expenses

* Monthly wellness stipend

jobs.title: Battery Lab Test Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

At General Motors, our product teams are redefining mobility. Through a human-centered design process, we create vehicles and experiences that are designed not just to be seen, but to be felt. We’re turning today’s impossible into tomorrow’s standard —from breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design, intelligent software, and next-generation safety and entertainment features.

  

Every day, our products move millions of people as we aim to make driving safer, smarter, and more connected, shaping the future of transportation on a global scale.

  

**Why work for us**

Our culture is focused on building inclusive teams, where differences and unique perspectives are embraced so you can contribute to your fullest potential as you pursue your career. Our locations feature a variety of work environments, including open workspaces and virtual connection platforms to inspire productivity and flexible collaboration. And we are proud to support employee volunteer interests and make it a priority to join together in efforts that give back to our communities.

  

**The Role:**

The Lab System Integration Engineering (LSIE) team is a part of a central engineering resource group that supports various battery, component, and propulsion test laboratories as well as vehicle garages in Pontiac, Warren, and Milford, Michigan. The Test Site Systems Engineer will directly support the Global Battery Systems Lab (GBSL), the Wallace Battery Cell Innovation Center (WBCIC), and the Root Cause Warranty Center (RWC) at the Warren Technical Center campus with a focus on the software environments and automation platforms that enable safe, efficient testing.

  

The Global Battery Systems Lab (GBSL-W) and Wallace Battery Cell Innovation Center (WBCIC) utilize various automation software systems to operate 24/7. The Global Battery Systems Lab has testing capabilities that include traditional environmental testing, vibration, safety and abuse, exploratory development testing, and maintains commonality with GM’s battery lab located in Shanghai, China (GBSL-S). The Wallace Battery Innovation Center houses battery cell test chambers, cell formation chambers, a material synthesis lab, a slurry mixing and processing lab, a coating room, an electrolyte production lab, and a forensics lab with material analysis equipment and advanced software The Root Cause Warranty Center (RWC) performs advanced diagnostic and failure analysis on returned components as well as full systems, using specialized test equipment, data analytics, plus forensic methods to resolve complex warranty issues. These labs and the results they produce are used by GM’s growing team of engineers working on advanced batteries and electrified vehicles, in support of the vision of a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions, and Zero Congestion.

  

This role manages the lab software ecosystem for GBSL, WBCIC, and the RWC. Scope includes TCWS (test cell workstation) builds and configurations, LSIE’s test automation toolchain, small operational applications, the Influx/Telegraf/Grafana metrics stack, Databricks interfaces for moving lab data into analytics pipelines, and Windows-based operating environments for critical test PCs. The engineer will use enterprise automation tooling (e.g. Ansible, Baramundi) to provision test systems, manage fleets, execute software deployments, coordinate environment changes, maintain configuration records plus change records, and standardize how test sites use enterprise toolchains. The focus is on solutions that meet operator and lab needs while staying aligned with enterprise direction.

  

An engineer seeking end-to-end ownership of the software backbone that keeps more than 100 battery test beds running across GBSL, WBCIC, and the RWC will be well-matched to this position. The engineer in this position will design and standardize back-end environments, deployment pipelines, Windows test-fleet automation, and metrics pipelines that connect enterprise platforms to day-to-day lab operations while building a broad skill set across DevOps, site systems, and large-scale test automation. **This is an onsite role at the Warren Technical Center to ensure direct engagement with lab operations, test systems, and partner teams.**

**What You'll Do (Responsibilities):**

* Support testing PC builds, related test software configuration, and deployments across GBSL/WBCIC/RWC in partnership with DevOps engineers.
* Maintain software environments on critical test PCs by coordinating OS and security updates with IT while managing LSIE-owned applications plus configurations.
* Own lifecycle management for key test systems, including version control, compatibility planning, environment upgrades, and major platform migrations.
* Own the metrics pipeline for lab test systems across Influx, Telegraf, Grafana, and test automation systems
* Support and maintain LSIE’s test automation toolchain that underpins daily lab operations at GBSL/WBCIC/RWC.
* Maintain software change logs, configuration records, runbooks, and standard test PC images to support traceability, audit readiness, and faster root-cause analysis.
* Act as the technical bridge between LSIE, Computer Aided Testing (CAT), and IT for infrastructure decisions that affect the test environment.
* Evaluate, pilot, and implement tools from pertinent teams so they fit site needs
* Standardize software support approaches, toolchains, and configurations across GBSL/WBCIC/RWC to reduce redundant local solutions
* Provide advanced troubleshooting and escalation support for software issues that impact test execution, working with LSIE application engineers, lab operations, CAT, and IT.
* Plan and execute complex software and infrastructure changes that affect the labs including source control or license migrations, environment upgrades, and other enterprise-driven changes
Support weekend or off-shift needs for planned changes and high-priority software issue

* 5+ years of progressive experience designing commercial electronic products (or M.S. with 3+ years).

* Hands-on experience with the full hardware design cycle: circuit design, schematic capture, component selection, PCB layout direction and review, board bring-up, testing, and troubleshooting.
* Experience designing embedded hardware using microcontrollers, processors, sensors, power supplies, and digital communication interfaces.
* Working understanding of signal integrity, thermal mitigation, power analysis, and impedance matching in real designs.
* Ability to articulate circuit and architecture tradeoffs clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Demonstrated initiative, ownership, and the ability to deliver technical work independently while managing multiple priorities.

**Desired But Not Required**

* Experience developing connected or wireless products from concept through production.
* Working knowledge of RF fundamentals and wireless technologies such as Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, Zigbee, cellular, GNSS/GPS, or LoRa.
* Experience leading or supporting regulatory and product certification activities, such as FCC, UL, ETL, ETSI, PTCRB, or other applicable standards.
* Experience in a product development consulting, design services, or other customer-facing engineering environment.
* Systems engineering exposure: requirements definition, architecture, V&V, and product lifecycle management.
* Familiarity with Digi System-on-Modules (SOMs), Single-Board Computers (SBCs), or XBee products.
* Experience using scripting or automation to improve engineering development, testing, or analysis.

Thea Energy is leveraging recent breakthroughs in stellarator physics and engineering to create a faster and simpler approach to commercializing fusion energy. The company is reinventing the stellarator using computer-controlled arrays of planar coils thereby replacing the intricate, complex modular magnets required in all other stellarator architectures. Thea Energy is on a mission to create a limitless source of zero emission energy for a sustainable future.

The Electrical Engineering Manager is accountable for the engineering execution and operating readiness of electrical and power supply systems used by Thea Energy's technology development programs. jobs.description:
**Job Details:**
================

**Job Description:**
--------------------

At Intel, we create world-changing technology that improves the life of every person on the planet. By joining the Advanced Packaging Technology and Manufacturing (APTM) Yield Group, you will be part of a team tasked with the critical objective of driving yield and defect improvement across our entire advanced packaging portfolio. We solve highly complex physical and electrical problems to ensure our latest packaging technologies successfully transition from development into high-volume manufacturing.

We are seeking a APTM Yield Analysis/Device Engineer to drive technology development, transfers, and manufacturing ramps in Rio Rancho, New Mexico. In this role, you will analyze massive, multi-dimensional datasets to identify where manufacturing processes, test content, and inline metrologies must be optimized. Acting as a strategic technical advisor, you will set clear engineering priorities, lead cross-functional problem-solving initiatives, and directly influence our technology yield roadmap.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Data Synthesis & Insight Extraction:** Extract insights from structured and unstructured factory datasets using statistical methods, machine learning, and tools like JMP or Python.
* **Failure Correlation:** Correlate electrical and physical failure mechanisms by utilizing deep knowledge of Failure Analysis (FIFA), Design for Test (DFT), Sort/Test, and Integration/Process flows.
* **Defect System Optimization:** Manage inline defect metrologies, evaluate detection capabilities, and drive inline defect reduction programs across the factory.
* **Technical Program Leadership:** Lead a small group of engineers (direct or indirect) to execute experiments, resolve nonstandard yield events, and ensure smooth technology transfers to High-Volume Manufacturing (HVM).
* **Stakeholder Reporting & Collaboration:** Deliver detailed technical reports summarizing yield and device health to upstream and downstream partners, establishing clear action plans to achieve best-in-class yield levels.

**As a Successful Candidate, You Will Bring:**

* **Leadership & Cross-Functional Influence:** Instills a high-performing team culture with a willingness to lead, guide, and collaborate across diverse organizational boundaries.
* **Tolerance for Ambiguity & Flexibility:** Adapts rapidly to changing priorities, new technical fields of study, and fluctuating business demands.
* **Strategic Prioritization & Autonomy:** Works with minimal direct oversight to prioritize critical path items and resolve complex, unstructured technical issues.
* **Executive Communication:** Delivers concise, high-impact technical presentations to influence decision-making among diverse groups at all levels.

Apply today to join Intel New Mexico's APTM Yield Group and lead the technical breakthroughs that power global computing. Let's build the future together.

You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Experience would be obtained through a combination of prior education level classes, and current level school classes, projects, research and relevant previous job and/or internship experience.

You will own and engineer the detection, investigation, and response capabilities that protect our global platforms while leading the charge into AI-augmented defense, using AI to compress the time between a vulnerability's disclosure and its exploitation in the wild.

You will act as the bridge between deep, code-level investigation and enterprise-wide risk reduction, ensuring our software supply chain, cloud infrastructure, and applications are not just compliant, but resilient by design.

**Role:** Senior Controls & Automation Engineer

**Department:** Production  
**Reports To:** General Manager

**Employment Type:** Salary  
**Shift:** 1st  
**Location:** Jamestown, NY

**Salary/Pay Range:**  75,000 – 80,0000 per year  
**Benefits:** Health, Dental, Vision

**Job Summary:** The Senior Controls & Automation Engineer designs, develops, programs, commissions, troubleshoots, and optimizes automated manufacturing systems used in battery module production. This role provides technical leadership for PLCs, HMIs, robotics, motion control, machine vision, and industrial communication networks to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient manufacturing operations.

The Senior Controls & Automation Engineer works closely with manufacturing, maintenance, process engineering, quality, production leadership, and equipment suppliers to improve equipment performance, increase throughput, reduce downtime, and support new equipment installations and production launches. This position also provides technical guidance and mentorship to controls engineers, automation technicians, and maintenance personnel.

**Key Responsibilities:**

***Controls Engineering & Automation***

* Design, develop, program, and maintain PLC-based control systems using Siemens, Allen-Bradley/Rockwell Automation, or equivalent platforms.
* Develop and maintain HMI/SCADA applications, alarm systems, equipment interfaces, and production monitoring functionality.
* Integrate industrial robots, servo drives, motion control systems, sensors, actuators, machine vision, barcode readers, and automated inspection equipment.
* Support automated battery cell module and pack assembly processes.
* Integrate production equipment with industrial networks, manufacturing execution systems (MES), and plant monitoring systems.
* Review electrical schematics, control panel designs, I/O lists, network architecture, and equipment specifications.

***Troubleshooting & Continuous Improvement***

* Lead complex troubleshooting efforts involving PLCs, electrical controls, robotics, sensors, drives, and automated equipment.
* Identify root causes of recurring equipment failures and implement permanent corrective actions.
* Improve equipment cycle times, uptime, reliability, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).
* Develop preventive and predictive maintenance strategies in collaboration with maintenance teams.
* Analyze equipment downtime and production data to identify opportunities for automation improvements and cost reduction.
* Provide technical support during production escalations and critical equipment breakdowns.

***Equipment Installation & Commissioning***

* Lead controls activities for new equipment installations, system upgrades, retrofits, and production line expansions.
* Support factory acceptance testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), commissioning, validation, and production ramp-up.
* Collaborate with OEMs, integrators, contractors, and internal engineering teams to ensure equipment meets functional and performance specifications.
* Verify machine functionality, interlocks, alarms, sequence logic, and safety-related control requirements before equipment release.
* Maintain controls documentation, software backups, troubleshooting guides, and change records.

***Safety, Quality & Compliance***

* Ensure automation systems support appropriate machine safeguarding, safety interlocks, emergency stops, and safety-related control requirements.
* Follow applicable OSHA, NFPA, and other relevant electrical and machinery safety standards.
* Support risk assessments, safety reviews, and corrective actions related to automated equipment.
* Maintain compliance with plant engineering standards, change-control procedures, and equipment validation requirements.
* Support quality investigations and process improvements related to automated assembly and inspection systems.

***Technical Leadership & Collaboration***

* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and training to controls engineers, automation technicians, and maintenance personnel.
* Establish and promote controls programming standards, software documentation practices, and equipment design guidelines.
* Coordinate automation priorities with manufacturing, maintenance, quality, and process engineering teams.
* Manage technical issues with equipment vendors and integrators to ensure timely resolution.
* Support engineering project planning, technical reviews, equipment specifications, and project execution.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* Typically 7+ years of experience in industrial controls, automation engineering, or manufacturing equipment integration.
* Strong experience programming and troubleshooting industrial PLCs, preferably Siemens and/or Allen-Bradley/Rockwell Automation.
* Experience developing HMI/SCADA applications, industrial networks, servo systems, and automated equipment.
* Hands-on experience with robotics, machine vision, motion control, and complex automated manufacturing lines.
* Experience commissioning equipment, supporting production launches, and resolving complex manufacturing issues.
* Strong understanding of electrical schematics, industrial controls hardware, and machine safety principles.
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects, mentor personnel, and collaborate across departments.
* Excellent analytical, communication, documentation, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in battery manufacturing, battery module assembly, automotive, electronics, or other high-volume automated manufacturing environments.
* Experience with robotic integration, automated fastening, laser or resistance welding, dispensing systems, and end-of-line testing.
* Familiarity with MES integration, industrial data collection, OEE monitoring, and m

jobs.title: Senior Motion Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
The National Synchrotron Light Source II is an X-ray light source used by visiting researchers around the world, spanning industry, academia, government, to advance our knowledge in a wide range of scientific disciplines such as life sciences, quantum materials, energy storage, advanced materials science, physics, chemistry, and biology. From batteries and microelectronics to drug design and future quantum computers, NSLS-II enables its growing research community to study materials with nanoscale resolution and exquisite sensitivity by providing cutting-edge capabilities. The Data Science and Systems Integration Division of the National Synchrotron Light Source II (NSLS-II) works collaboratively with scientific, engineering, and technical staff to enable continued operations and further develop experimental capabilities of the 30 and growing number of state-of-the-art synchrotron beamlines. The NSLS-II offers a large-scale scientific facility working environment, which combines the scope of a large industrial facility with the excitement and challenges of world-class research experiments.

  

**Position Description**

The National Synchrotron Light Source-II is seeking exceptional candidates for the Instrument and Controls group within the Data Science and Systems Integration (DSSI) Division to lead the development and implementation of advanced motion control. The candidate will develop facility standards, implement motion controls for new beamline constructions and upgrades, and mentor junior staff. The candidate will additionally develop device drivers and graphical interfaces for motion controls instrumentation.

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Develop and implement the facility’s motion control strategy and standards
* Work collaboratively with scientific, engineering, and technical staff to deliver software and motion control solutions for beamlines
* Implement motion control systems for accelerator and beamline construction and upgrades
* Mentor junior staff
* Collaboratively develop software tools and services for NSLS-II
Work with varied teams to troubleshoot technical issues and advance experimental capabilities  

**Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Engineering, or related STEM discipline and 8+ years of relevant experience.
* Extensive experience with motion control technologies
* Demonstrated programming experience in C, C++, or Python
* Experience in open-source software development using best practices, such as version control tools for collaborative development, automated builds and testing, etc.
* Working knowledge of developing in a Linux operating system environment
* Practical knowledge of software and hardware engineering practices that include gathering requirements, design, testing, documentation, source code management and release procedures
* Demonstrated initiative and ability to take ownership of projects and tasks
* Effective oral and written communication skills and interpersonal skills
Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with professionals from diverse backgrounds  

  

**Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Bachelor’s or higher degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related STEM discipline and 10+ years of relevant experience.
* Experience with Experimental Physics and Industrial Control System (EPICS), TANGO or other SCADA control systems.
Experience with control software for scientific equipment, especially for synchrotron accelerator or synchrotron experiments  

  

**Other Information:**

Brookhaven National Laboratory is committed to providing fair, equitable and competitive compensation. This is a multi-level role and the full salary range for this position is $109,150.00 - $182,033.00 / year. You will be placed at the level and salary commensurate with your experience. Salary offers will be commensurate with the final candidate’s qualification, education and experience and considered with the internal peer group.

  

**Brookhaven National Laboratory is committed to employee success and we believe that a comprehensive employee benefits program is an important and meaningful part of the compensation employees receive. Review more information at** **BNL | Benefits Program**

  

Brookhaven National Laboratory requires all non-badged personnel including visitors to produce a REAL-ID or REAL-ID compliant documentation to access Brookhaven National Laboratory – view more information at www.bnl.gov/real-id . This is due to nationwide identification requirements for federal site access as required by the federal REAL ID Act . **Those not in possession of a REAL ID-compliant document will not be permitted to access the site which includes access to the Laboratory for interviews** .

  

As a U.S. Department of Energy laboratory, Brookhaven National Laboratory requires employees to obtain and maintain a DOE Uncleared Personal Identity Verification (UPIV) credential in accordance with Homeland Security Presidential Directive 12 (HSPD-12) requirements. The credentialing process is completed as part of onboarding and enables access to DOE facilities and information systems. As a condition of employment, the selected candidate must be able to obtain and maintain a UPIV credential. These requirements are established under DOE Order 206.2 Chg. 2, *Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM-* Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM) *)* , and DOE Order 473.1A- Physical Protection Program- Physical Protection Program .

  

**About Us**

Brookhaven National Laboratory (www.bnl.gov) delivers discovery science and transformative technology to power and secure the nation’s future. Brookhaven Lab is a multidisciplinary laboratory with seven Nobel Prize-winning discoveries, 37 R&D 100 Awards, and more than 70 years of pioneering research. The Lab is primarily supported by the U.S. Department of Energy’s (DOE) Office of Science. Brookhaven Science Associates (BSA)

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Options Execution
jobs.description:
**DRW** is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it's not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. **DRW** is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

We are seeking a **Senior Software Engineer** to develop new and improve existing low-latency trade execution systems for our Asia Equity Options business. As a member of the desk, you will be integral in the interaction between research and trading teams; you will have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge low-latency technologies and will be surrounded by senior technologists providing you with the best possible environment to succeed.  
  
How you will make an impact:

* Have significant experience developing high-availability systems in C++ and Python with very tight resource/latency constraints
* Experience interfacing with ultra-low-latency FPGA trading systems
* Strong experience working on highly distributed systems
* Analyzing and discussing requirements from stakeholders
* Facilitating discussions on code implementation, testing, software architecture best practices
* Driving projects and leading new initiatives
* Actively engaging with others on the development team to resolve challenging design and coding issues
* Evaluating appropriate new technologies, tools, frameworks, and software components for integration

What you bring to the team:

* Strong understanding of C++ 17 and beyond, Boost, STL
* Knowledge of Python is a plus
* A minimum of 4 years of experience in the trading industry
* Prior experience working on options or derivative products
* A background in multi-threaded programming and a strong understanding of hardware/software interaction
* Are comfortable working "under the hood" and skilled in performance tuning (applications, Linux, socket I/O, etc.) and troubleshooting
* Experience working with Research teams and Quantitative Researchers
* Strong understanding of software engineering principles and best practices
* Dedicated team player and a passionate problem solver with strong interpersonal skills

The annual base salary range for this position is $200,000 to $225,000 depending on the candidate's experience, qualifications, and relevant skill set. The position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition, DRW offers a comprehensive suite of employee benefits including group medical, pharmacy, dental and vision insurance, 401k (with discretionary employer match), short and long-term disability, life and AD&D insurance, health savings accounts, and flexible spending accounts.
