Our designs are scalable, efficient, and sustainable, tailored to meet the evolving needs of our clients in a dynamic industry.

  

**Summary/Objective:**

The **Senior Electrical and Controls Engineer** is a technical leader responsible for driving the design, development, and implementation of electrical and control systems across Compu Dynamics Modular's data center and commercial modular products. This role provides expertise from early-stage concepting through manufacturing, installation, and site commissioning. The Senior Electrical and Controls Engineer is a key contributor to product innovation and standardization and serves as a mentor to junior engineers, modular designers, and project managers .

  

This individual is recognized as a subject matter expert within the company and plays a critical role in maintaining compliance with all codes, improving processes, and delivering cutting-edge modular infrastructure solutions.

  

**Essential Functions:**

**1. Electrical Design & Engineering Leadership**

* Lead the electrical and controls system design process for modular product development, including commercial and data center applications.
* Develop and review one-line diagrams, electrical schematics, cable schedules, load lists, and detailed designs using AutoCAD
* Calculate electrical loads, select equipment, and perform code analysis to ensure design compliance.
* Generate complete electrical Bills of Material
* Collaborate with manufacturing teams to ensure designs meet production best practices and are constructible.
* Develop PLC and HMI based environmental monitoring systems from a hardware and software perspective
* Select monitoring systems and instruments as required, including biometric access, alarming systems, fire detection systems, leak detection, temperature, pressure, and humidity sensors

* Guide electrical scope development during bids and conceptual design phases; assist in cost estimation and proposal generation.

* Coordinate vendor selections based on technical and performance requirements; manage relationships with manufacturer representatives.
* Review external control schematics and ensure alignment with modular system needs.

* Lead efforts to ensure compliance with NEC, local codes, safety regulations, and internal documentation standards.
* Develop and maintain internal electrical design standards, tools, and templates.
* Research and implement industry best practices for modular system design and integration.

**5. Mentorship & Technical Leadership**

* Provide training and guidance to junior engineers and modular design staff.
* Conduct peer reviews and technical audits across project teams.
* Contribute to long-term engineering strategy and process improvement initiatives.

  

**Competencies:**

* Deep knowledge of electrical power systems, controls, and modular design.

* Proficiency in AutoCAD, Revit and Microsoft Office Suite.

* Familiarity with controller software (e.g., PLC and HMI based systems)

* Fundamental understanding of industrial networking protocols and BMS interface

* Excellent communication and technical writing skills.

* Strong analytical and creative problem-solving abilities.

This role may mentor and oversee work performed by junior engineers or modular designers but does not have formal direct reports.

Work is primarily performed in an office or collaborative environment with occasional site visits. Field work may include exposure to active construction, elevated temperatures, and energized equipment.

Full-time, non-exempt. Work hours follow the service department schedule and may include occasional overtime.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Embedded BSP/Kernel (Robotics OS)
jobs.description:
Meta Robotics Studio builds consumer humanoid robots that bring Meta's AI into the physical world. Our robots run on NVIDIA Jetson Thor with Meta-designed carrier boards and JetPack OS. The Robotics OS team owns everything between the silicon and the robot learning stack. On one chip, our robots run real-time control loops over EtherCAT while large vision-language-action (VLA) models run on the GPU. Our job is to make that computer do both, deterministically, every time it boots.We are hiring a software engineer to help architect and evolve the robotics OS, Meta's build of NVIDIA Jetson Linux for Thor-class robot compute. Working with the team, you will help shape the multi-year technical direction for the robot's operating system, including how we build, release and update it, how it shares one computer between real-time control and AI workloads, and how it scales from a lab of prototypes to a large fleet of production robots. You will work closely with hardware, firmware, controls, and AI engineers across Meta, and with NVIDIA's Jetson engineering teams as one of several technical points of contact on the platform. This is a hands-on role: when a new board spin won't boot or the control loop misses a deadline, you will be in the kernel log alongside the rest of the team.  
  
  

### **Software Engineer, Embedded BSP/Kernel (Robotics OS) Responsibilities:**

* Contribute to the technical strategy and multi-year roadmap for the Robotics OS. This covers the board support package (BSP), kernel, OS image, update system, real-time behavior, GPU platform, and fleet tooling across every robot program and compute platform (AGX Thor, IGX Thor, and future NVIDIA silicon)
* Architect the next-generation OS image, including the move to a Yocto / meta-tegra based build. Make it reproducible, hermetic and secure, and make it fast for many engineers to iterate on
* Define and drive the production update strategy: atomic A/B and over-the-air updates, rollback, secure and verified boot, fusing and signing, and factory provisioning, so we can ship to a growing fleet safely
* Shape the platform's real-time architecture. Help define how CPU cores, interrupts, memory and the GPU are divided between control loops at kilohertz rates and large AI models. Set the latency budgets and the measurement infrastructure that proves we meet them
* Collaborate with NVIDIA's Jetson engineering teams alongside other Meta engineers: share requirements, push fixes upstream, and help plan how we adopt new Jetson Linux / JetPack releases with minimal fork debt
* Partner with electrical, firmware, and mechanical engineers on new compute and carrier-board designs. Weigh in early on SoC configuration, interfaces, power and thermal so boards are easier to bring up and software stays simpler
* Drive bring-up of new boards and modules end to end: boot chain (MB1/MB2, UEFI), BPMP and device tree, pinmux, PCIe/USB/Ethernet, power profiles, and the drivers for robot hardware (EtherCAT, USB-C power delivery, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, sensors, cameras)
* Help set the quality bar for the RT kernel and out-of-tree drivers: kernel configuration, ABI compatibility, and a plan to upstream changes or align with Meta's kernel instead of carrying long-lived patches
* Build the reliability and observability foundation: crash and kernel-log capture, symbolization, boot-time tracing, health telemetry, and fleet triage tooling, so that any robot failure can be diagnosed remotely
* Raise the bar for the engineers around you through design reviews, mentorship, and technical hiring. Grow OS and embedded talent on the team, and help shape on-call and operational practices

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 10+ years of experience building and shipping system software for embedded Linux or Android-based products
* Experience architecting and owning an operating system, BSP or platform software stack on a shipped hardware product
* Deep experience with C and Linux kernel internals, including device drivers, device tree, scheduling, interrupts, and memory management
* Proficient in at least one of C++, Rust or Python
* Experience driving new-SoC or new-board bring-up on ARM64, from boot chain through kernel to a production OS
* Experience designing OS image build and release systems, such as Yocto/OpenEmbedded, Buildroot, Debian packaging or AOSP, including the strategy for updates and release management
* Experience debugging hard cross-layer problems spanning hardware, firmware, kernel and user space
* Experience influencing technical direction across multiple teams or organizations, including external silicon or hardware vendors

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience growing a platform from prototype to production fleet scale
* A track record of upstream contributions to the Linux kernel, Yocto or related open-source projects
* Experience designing secure boot, verified boot and OTA / A/B update systems for a large device fleet
* Experience with EtherCAT, CAN-FD or other robotics fieldbuses, and with host-to-microcontroller architectures (FreeRTOS, Zephyr)
* GPU platform experience: CUDA, NVML/MIG, TensorRT, or deploying ML inference on edge devices alongside real-time workloads
* Deep hands-on experience with NVIDIA Jetson (Orin / Thor) and Jetson Linux / JetPack, including custom carrier-board bring-up, BCT/BPMP configuration, nvidia-oot, and flashing and mass-production tooling

jobs.title: Principal GNSS Systems Engineer, Amazon LEO
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are seeking an exceptionally skilled Senior GNSS Systems Engineer with a minimum of 10 years of hands-on experience in GNSS engineering, satellite systems, and advanced positioning, navigation, and timing (PNT) technologies. This is a senior-level technical leadership role requiring deep, first-principles expertise across the full GNSS signal chain — from satellite constellation physics and signal generation through receiver design, carrier phase tracking, and precision position and time solutions delivered to ground terminals.  
The successful candidate will lead the design and delivery of a custom satellite-based wireless positioning and timing transfer service operating across S-Band and L-Band frequencies. This system will transmit simultaneous multi-source signals that ground terminals can receive, correlate, and process to extract carrier phase differentials, enabling high-accuracy ranging, time delta computation, and precise geolocation. The role demands mastery of both the theoretical underpinnings of GNSS — including relativistic time corrections, ionospheric and tropospheric propagation modeling, and CDMA spreading code correlation — and the practical engineering required to implement real-world satellite communication subsystems. This position sits at the intersection of satellite communications engineering, precision time and frequency, and advanced signal processing. The engineer will own the GNSS subsystem architecture end-to-end, contribute to the TT&C subsystem, and serve as the technical authority on all matters related to satellite-based PNT service design, clock disciplining, and time transfer over wireless and optical physical mediums.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The Senior GNSS Systems Engineer will serve as the technical lead and subsystem owner for the spacecraft GNSS architecture, driving all aspects of design from initial requirements definition through hardware acceptance.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Master's degree (or higher) in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, or a closely related technical field. A Bachelor's degree may be considered with exceptional demonstrated experience.
* Minimum 10 years of professional engineering experience in GNSS systems engineering, RF systems engineering, satellite payloads, TT&C design, or precision PNT system development.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience with at least two of the major GNSS constellations (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo) at the signal and systems engineering level — not limited to receiver integration.
* Proven experience designing or significantly contributing to precision time transfer systems, including two-way time transfer (satellite or optical medium), with documented accuracy results at the nanosecond level or better.
* Demonstrated experience implementing Kalman filter-based navigation or timing solutions in real-world systems, with measurable performance results.
* Experience with RF systems engineering across S-Band and/or L-Band frequencies, including link budget derivation, antenna specifications, and receiver performance analysis.
* Proven track record managing RF hardware development cycles with external suppliers and defining strict test and qualification parameters for flight hardware.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience designing a custom satellite-based PNT service from initial concept through operational deployment — including waveform design, ground terminal specification, and algorithm development.
* Practical experience with optical time transfer systems (White Rabbit, TWFTF) and integration of optical and RF time references in hybrid synchronization networks.
* Expertise in Alternative PNT (Alt-PNT) system design and evaluation, including non-GNSS positioning technologies and GNSS-independent timing sources.
* Experience with GNSS security: anti-spoofing detection, signal authentication (OSNMA, Chimera), and cryptographic protection of PNT services.
* Background in precise orbit determination (POD) and its integration into GNSS timing error budgets for high-accuracy applications.
* Familiarity with satellite communication standards (CCSDS) and their application to TT&C and custom PNT service link layer design.
* Proficiency in Python and/or MATLAB for signal simulation, filter design, and automated test data analysis.

  
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**Platform Engineer, Endpoint Engineering**
===========================================

*PLEASE NOTE: This position is located in Seattle, WA and requires attendance at our office three days a week.*

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States. LendingTree and its affiliates ("LendingTree") will not provide or assume sponsorship for employment visas for this position, now or in the future.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

We're seeking a Platform Engineer to join the Endpoint Engineering team within Digital Workplace. Our team treats Windows and Mac endpoints as products, building, securing, and delivering them through code, automation, and repeatable pipelines.

In this role, you'll help manage and improve the platforms that support every employee device at LendingTree, including Microsoft Intune, Iru, and our patching and security tools. You'll work at the intersection of IT and software engineering, using scripting, automation, version control, and CI/CD practices to deliver secure, reliable, and compliant endpoints. You'll also have the opportunity to strengthen your software engineering skills by working alongside experienced engineers in a collaborative, learning-focused environment.

**How You'll Make an Impact**
-----------------------------

* **Support and improve endpoint platforms:** Maintain and troubleshoot endpoint management solutions, including Microsoft Intune, Iru, and ManageEngine Endpoint Central, while supporting Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android devices.
* **Automate endpoint management:** Develop and maintain PowerShell and Python scripts and API integrations to reduce manual work, improve consistency, and streamline endpoint operations.
* **Build and maintain deployment pipelines:** Support CI/CD pipelines that validate, package, test, and deploy applications, scripts, and policies through test and pilot rings into production.
* **Strengthen endpoint security and compliance:** Implement and maintain security baselines, encryption, endpoint detection and response (EDR), Conditional Access, and device compliance policies in partnership with Information Security.
* **Improve reliability and visibility:** Monitor endpoint health, patching, and compliance metrics; maintain dashboards and alerts; troubleshoot issues; and support incident response and root cause analysis.
* **Apply engineering best practices:** Maintain endpoint configurations as code in Git, participate in code reviews, validate changes before broad deployment, and create documentation that supports reliable operations.

**Who You'll Work With**
------------------------

You'll join the Endpoint Engineering team within Digital Workplace, working alongside senior engineers who will help you develop your technical and software engineering skills. You'll collaborate with Information Security, Identity & Access Management, Infrastructure, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Service Desk, and Productivity Apps teams to deliver secure, reliable endpoint experiences across LendingTree.

The team emphasizes collaboration, code review, automation, documentation, and repeatable engineering practices. You'll have opportunities to contribute to larger endpoint initiatives while taking ownership of assigned work and learning from experienced teammates.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 4+ years of related experience supporting enterprise endpoints across Windows and macOS.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune and a macOS mobile device management (MDM) platform, such as Iru, Jamf, or a similar solution.
* Experience writing automation scripts, with PowerShell required and some experience in Python or another general-purpose programming language.
* Working knowledge of Git, including commits, branches, and pull request workflows.
* Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and pipelines, such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.
* Experience working with REST APIs, ideally Microsoft Graph, and an understanding of REST/JSON integrations.
* Experience packaging and deploying applications to managed endpoints.
* Understanding of Entra ID, Conditional Access, device compliance, endpoint security baselines, disk encryption, and EDR solutions such as Microsoft Defender.
* Experience administering and troubleshooting Windows 10/11 and macOS, with familiarity in iOS and Android device management.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills, particularly across endpoint, enrollment, and policy issues.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**What Will Help You Thrive**
-----------------------------

* **Product mindset:** You think about the endpoint as a product and the employee as the customer, focusing on reliability, security, and user experience.
* **Automation mindset:** You look for opportunities to eliminate repetitive tasks, improve consistency, and make endpoint operations more efficient.
* **Engineering curiosity:** You're interested in learning software engineering practices, improving your scripting skills, and understanding how code and automation can improve IT operations.
* **Problem-solving approach:** You investigate issues methodically, look beyond immediate symptoms, and work toward identifying root causes.

As a Senior Staff Software Engineer focused on Infrastructure and Security, you will shape how that platform is architected and defended: designing the cloud infrastructure behind Generac's home energy software - the applications, services, data, and connected devices it spans - and embedding security into every layer of it. You will work closely with SRE and engineering teams to lead and influence technical direction across the platform. jobs.title: Systems Engineer (Firmware)
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
====================

Each year, 2.5 trillion hours are spent on household chores. At Matic, we’re on a mission to recapture that lost time, and we’re doing it by revolutionizing home robotics.

Our first product, also called Matic, is a Wall-E-esque floor cleaning robot. We've built what amounts to "full self-driving in the home” with real-time 3D mapping, adaptive path-tracking, and a precise semantic understanding of the home. Our breakthroughs in spatial AI allow Matic to work reliably in real homes, using only RGB cameras and neural networks running on-device.

**Privacy First**
-----------------

What happens in the home, stays in the home. Our robots are private by design, with all data processing performed by the robot itself, not in the cloud.

**Our Approach**
----------------

Before the iPhone, consumers adopted several distinct devices; cell phones, PDAs, and portable music players each served a particular need. We believe in a similar progression for home robotics, starting with single-purpose robots and building iteratively toward more complex capabilities over time.

**Our Culture**
---------------

Matic is a tight-knit and collaborative team, singularly focused on building products our customers will cherish. We're ultra-hardworking people committed to solving tough problems that save precious time and energy.

**About the role**
==================

As the name “firmware” may imply, this role closes the gap between our software and our hardware. In this role, you will be the hardware team’s window into Matic’s software, and you will be the software team’s window into Matic’s hardware. Firmware engineers are fundamentally cross-discipline and are expected to operate with product-focused systems-level thinking.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

Firmware at Matic is a broad domain, and you will work on a wide variety of projects such as:

* Bring-up and support for hardware changes (electrical and mechanical). For example:

  + A new sensing mechanism to detect when the waste bag is full from water during mopping - requires updating device drivers to interface with the new sensor, implementing tests to ensure the new system is working as expected during assembly, and coordinating robot behaviors to accommodate the new system (data filtering, updating the bag fullness check).
* Design and improve the behavioral logic and controls algorithms for Matic’s physical systems
* Analyze robot logs along with motor and sensor data to debug hardware failures. For example:

  + Customer reports their Matic isn’t charging despite being properly docked
  + Employee testing their Matic at home mentions that their robot suddenly started making weird clicking sounds while mopping
* Support internal processes with tooling to interface with Matic’s motors and sensors

**What we look for**
--------------------

We're looking for strong software experience with electromechanical projects. This likely includes deep experience with microcontrollers (bare-metal programming, RTOS, communication protocols), a fundamental understanding of electronics (schematics, datasheets, motors, sensors, batteries), and intuition for physical systems (motors, moving parts, materials). You should have strong experience writing embedded C/C++, and we hope you are eager to learn Rust if you aren’t already familiar with it (see: why we use Rust).

### **Must haves:**

* 2+ years of industry experience or equivalent (e.g. grad school)
* Core software skills:

  + data structures, control flow, computer systems
  + deep experience with systems programming language(s): C, C++, rust, etc.
  + experience / comfort with scripting / prototyping language(s): python, etc.
* Experience with hardware (the more the better):

  + Motors (brushed and brushless DC, drivers, operating principles)
  + Controls systems
  + Sensors (datasheets, device drivers, data filtering)
  + Electrical fundamentals
  + Mechanical intuition
  + You’ve built things (robots, PCBs, 3D-printing, anything)
* Experience with microcontrollers (STM32, PIC, ESP32, etc.)
* Soft-skills:

  + Multi-disciplinary team & leadership experience
  + Thinks broadly, connecting insights from across the system to solve problems
  + Meticulous, detail oriented, organized
  + Fixated on edge-cases and testing

### **Nice to have:**

* Friendly & approachable personality

  + non-combative, selfless, team-first mentality
* Higher-level robotics exposure:

  + computer vision, machine learning, path planning, SLAM

**We’d love to hear from you if…**
----------------------------------

* You love diagnosing complex electromechanical issues
* You are genuinely motivated to help those around you
* You are passionate about learning outside of your normal comfort zones
* You are excited to do great work

**Compensation**

Base $120,000 — $200,000

Actual Compensation will depend on skills, experience and qualifications. Base Salary is one part of the total compensation package. The role is also eligible for equity through the company’s discretionary equity program, along with a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental and vision coverage access to a 401(k) plan.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Rhoda Platform
jobs.description:
At Rhoda AI, we’re building the next generation of generalist intelligent robots. We own the full robotics stack from high-performance hardware and robot systems to the infrastructure and state-of-the-art foundation world models that control our robots. Our robots are designed to be generalists capable of operating in complex, real-world environments and handling long-tail edge cases, made possible by our cutting edge research and end-to-end system design. We've raised over $450M and are investing aggressively in model research, infrastructure, hardware development, and manufacturing scale-up to make generalist robotics a reality.

We're looking for a Software Engineer to help build and maintain the broad software foundation that keeps our robots running. You'll work across the full onboard stack — from networking and communication infrastructure to perception and control integration, data collection pipelines, and the tooling that lets us continue to develop and improve our robots in the field.

**What You'll Do**

* Build and maintain the networking and communication infrastructure that connects onboard robot systems to each other, to the cloud, and to teleoperation and monitoring systems
* Own data collection pipelines that capture sensor, telemetry, and behavioral data from the robot and reliably upload it to cloud storage for model training
* Build and maintain telemetry and observability systems — giving the team real-time visibility into robot health, system state, and field performance
* Develop internal tooling that accelerates robot software development: deployment pipelines, logging infrastructure, debugging tools, and field testing utilities
* Productize the Rhoda Platform to enable efficient integration with vendor robotic hardware platforms
* Support bring-up and field testing of new hardware revisions, debugging issues across the full onboard software stack
* Collaborate closely with ML, perception, and control engineers to ensure onboard systems meet the data quality and reliability requirements of model training and deployment

**What We're Looking For**

* For experienced hires: 2+ years of experience in robotics software engineering, embedded systems, cloud software, or a closely related field; For new graduates: solid educational background in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or related fields
* Passion about a fast-moving & collaborate working environment
* Strong software engineering fundamentals in C++, Python, or Rust
* Experience with networking, IPC, and communication protocols for hardware-software systems (e.g., gRPC, DDS, MQTT, WebSockets)
* Familiarity with cloud storage and data upload pipelines (e.g., AWS, GCP, S3, GCS)
* Experience with ROS/ROS2 or similar robotics middleware in production or research contexts
* Ability to debug across the full stack — from driver-level issues to application behavior to failures in a distributed system, on live hardware
* Excellent engineering principles and high standard on work deliverables
* Comfort working directly with physical hardware in fast-moving, ambiguous environments

**Nice to Have (But Not Required)**

* Experience building telemetry and observability systems for embedded or edge platforms
* Familiarity with perception pipelines or control systems and how they interact with the broader robot stack
* Background in streaming systems or low-latency data transport for real-time robot operation
* Experience with over-the-air (OTA) software updates and deployment infrastructure for robot fleets
* Exposure to learned perception or control models and their integration into real-time robot stacks
* Prior work on early-stage hardware programs (prototype or pre-production robots)

**Why This Role**

* Your work is the connective tissue of the robot — the networking, monitoring, data, and tooling infrastructure you build directly determines how fast the team can develop, debug, deploy and improve our robots in the field
* Work across the full onboard stack alongside perception, control, and ML engineers on a platform that is pushing the frontier of what robots can do
* High ownership in a small, fast-moving team where your contributions shape the development velocity and reliability of the next generation of robots

The Software Engineer develops tools that automate production and test activities, acquires and processes engineering data, and provides analytical capabilities to characterize product performance and reliability. jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer - Field Deployment & Support
jobs.description:
**About Destro AI**

Destro AI is building the intelligence layer for robotics — the system that coordinates robots, humans, and workflows across complex real-world operations. Founded by former leaders from HAI Robotics, Dexterity, and Matic, Destro is built on a simple thesis: robotics has solved movement, but not decision-making. Destro is backed by investors who have previously invested in and built companies like Brex, Figma, Notion, and Instacart.

Destro's MothershipOS is a shared brain across all robots, unlocking complex factory and warehouse workflows. Unlike traditional systems that rely on local intelligence on each robot, Destro brings global intelligence across the entire operation. Destro recently closed its Seed round at one of the highest valuations for a robotics company at this stage, and is already deploying in production with large enterprise operators.

**About The Role**

We're hiring a Robotics Forward Deployed Engineer, to own the software that runs MothershipOS in live customer warehouses. This role is responsible for writing and maintaining production code, not solely for troubleshooting it, and will serve as the engineering presence on-site when systems need to be brought up, stabilized, or restored to full function.

**Schedule Expectations**

This is a field deployment role, not a standard office-hours position. Warehouse operations run multiple shifts, and go-lives, incidents, and integrations are not confined to business hours.

* Regular work outside standard business hours should be expected, including nights and weekends. Go-lives are frequently scheduled during off-hours or weekend downtime windows to avoid disrupting customer operations.
* This role may be paged for production issues, including robot faults, network outages, and server failures, outside normal hours, and is expected to respond promptly, either remotely or on-site.
* Extensive travel to customer sites is required, at times on short notice.
* Candidates seeking a fixed 9-to-5, Monday-through-Friday schedule are unlikely to find this role a fit.

**What You'll Do**

*Software*

* Write, test, and maintain the software services that run MothershipOS at customer sites, including deployment tooling and diagnostic utilities.
* Design and build internal tools that make field deployments faster and more repeatable.
* Translate field learnings into production-hardening fixes and improvements in the core codebase.
* Maintain clear technical documentation and runbooks so issues can be diagnosed consistently across sites.

*Field Deployment*

* Deploy and validate Destro's software stack in live warehouses, working directly with customer operations, IT, and engineering teams.
* Own production issues end-to-end during launch and stabilization, including off-hours incidents.
* Improve uptime, throughput, and reliability of deployed systems through both code and infrastructure changes.

*Systems and Infrastructure*

* Build and maintain containerized services (Docker Compose) running on Destro-managed servers and edge devices.
* Work with cloud infrastructure (GCP) for image management, versioning, and deployment tooling.
* Configure and troubleshoot networking, including VLANs, DHCP, internal DNS, and certificate-based service security.
* Debug across the full stack: robot state faults, sensor issues, API failures, container networking, database queries, and monitoring dashboards.

**Who You Are**

* 2 to 6 years of experience in systems engineering, robotics software, backend engineering, infrastructure, or field engineering, with genuine software development experience rather than field support alone.
* Comfortable being paged off-hours and traveling on short notice.
* Able to operate independently in ambiguous, high-pressure environments without a fully specified solution.
* Calm under pressure, direct with customers, and demonstrates strong ownership.

**Technical Skills**

*Required*

* Strong Python or C++, with the ability to write maintainable, production-grade code.
* Hands-on Docker/Docker Compose experience, including building, deploying, debugging, and versioning images.
* Linux/server administration: command line, logs, processes, systemd, firewalls.
* Networking fundamentals: DHCP, DNS, VLANs, static IP reservations, TLS/certificates.
* Experience with APIs and communication protocols (REST, WebSockets, MQTT).
* Proficiency with Git and standard software development workflows.

*Strongly Preferred*

* Experience with AMRs, warehouse automation, or fleet management.
* Cloud deployment experience, ideally GCP.
* Familiarity with observability tooling such as Grafana, Prometheus, or time-series databases.
* WMS/WES/ERP integration experience.

*Nice to Have*

* Experience with robot task allocation, scheduling, or routing.
* Experience with wearables, scanners, or other warehouse hardware.

STR's Intelligence Division researches, develops, and transitions advanced analytics and machine-learning solutions for challenging national-security problems. Our team includes engineers and researchers with advanced backgrounds in engineering, computer science, mathematics, and data science who apply deep technical expertise and creativity to mission-critical challenges.

Our work spans data analysis, deep learning, and statistical methods across networking, communications, social media, text, time series, geospatial, and imagery data. We develop capabilities under constraints not typically encountered in commercial environments. U.S. Government analysts use our tools and technologies to extract, enrich, and act on intelligence information worldwide.

This includes system architecture, requirements development and traceability, interface management, system integration, design risk management, verification and validation, and technical decision-making.

This position partners closely with Product Management, Portfolio Management, Software, Firmware, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Service, and other Engineering functions to translate customer and business needs into technically sound product architectures and executable engineering plans.

* Develop and maintain system and subsystem requirements with clear acceptance criteria, bidirectional traceability, and disciplined change control.

jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing!

The Platform Engineer is a hands-on member of Neogen’s Platform Engineering team within the Software and Firmware Engineering organization. This role supports Neogen Analytics, Neogen’s SaaS platform for food safety customers, while building the shared infrastructure, automation, deployment capabilities, and self-service tools used by internal product teams and external development partners.

The Platform Engineer treats the platform as an internal product by understanding developer needs, creating reusable solutions, and establishing practical standards and paved paths for cloud infrastructure, software delivery, observability, security, and operational support.

This position balances production support and operational responsibilities with the development of platform capabilities that improve reliability, security, developer productivity, and scalability over time. * Develop self-service solutions for environments, access, onboarding, and other recurring platform needs.

**Job Description**  
Our employees work on the world’s most advanced electronics – from detecting threats for F-35 pilots to illuminating the night for soldiers. Spanning air, land, sea, and space, we are developing the technology of tomorrow, delivered today. Drawing strength from our differences, we’re innovating for the future. And you can, too.
  
  
Our flexible work environment provides you a chance to change the world without giving up your personal life. We put our customers first – exemplified by our mission: “We Protect Those Who Protect Us®.” Sound like a team you want to be a part of? Come build your career with BAE Systems.
  
  
In Countermeasure & Electromagnetic Attack Solutions (CEMA), we provide next-generation threat detection and countermeasure solutions to provide unparalleled electronic warfare capabilities to enhance mission survivability.
  
  
You will be a technical member of the Countermeasure & Electromagnetic Attack Solutions (CEMA) Systems Engineering Group that is responsible supporting design, development, integration, implementation, test and verification/validation of EW systems across multiple business areas. As an individual contributor, you will be responsible for and support technologies on next-generation military/commercial applications. You will also perform, delivering technical value, in the role of a Systems Engineer, for programs ranging from developing prototypes, full rate production, and sustainment of systems.
  
  
Because of the need for consistent, in-person collaboration and/or the requirement to perform all work onsite due to the nature of this particular role, it will be performed full-time on site. This means work will be conducted on location at a BAE Systems facility 100% of the time
  
  
**Required Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* Hold an active Top Secret clearance
* BS in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering or Computer Science/Engineering.
* At least one year experience of System Design Review (SDR) Development
* Ability to prioritize and adjust to dynamic project needs.
* Experience with systems engineering processes, methodologies and tools.
* Some knowledge of C++ or other software programming languages.
  

  
  
**Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* BS in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering or Computer Science/Engineering and 4 years experience.
* Experience with integration in a system integration lab.

**Pay Information**
  
Full-Time Salary Range: $79365 - $134921
  
  
Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.  
  
  
  
**About BAE Systems, Inc.**
  
BAE Systems, Inc. is the U.S. subsidiary of BAE Systems plc, an international defense, aerospace and security company which delivers a full range of products and services for air, land and naval forces, as well as advanced electronics, security, information technology solutions and customer support services. Improving the future and protecting lives is an ambitious mission, but it’s what we do at BAE Systems. Working here means using your passion and ingenuity where it counts – defending national security with breakthrough technology, superior products, and intelligence solutions. As you develop the latest technology and defend national security, you will continually hone your skills on a team—making a big impact on a global scale. At BAE Systems, you’ll find a rewarding career that truly makes a difference. Electronic Systems (ES) is the global innovator behind BAE Systems’ game-changing defense and commercial electronics. Exploiting every electron, we push the limits of what is possible, giving our customers the edge and our employees opportunities to change the world. Our products and capabilities can be found everywhere – from the depths of the ocean to the far reaches of space. At our core are more than 14,000 highly talented Electronic Systems employees with the brightest minds in the industry, we make an impact – for our customers and the communities we serve.

jobs.title: Cryogenic Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**Full-time | On-site in the Research Triangle area, North Carolina | Reports to the Scientific and Technical Director**

LH3M is developing a cryopump and sorption collector for lunar gases. Initial work uses small loads of standard helium, predominantly He-4, followed by controlled mixed-gas experiments. We seek an engineer or experimental physicist with substantial hands-on experience designing, commissioning and troubleshooting low-temperature apparatus.

You will own the collector’s cryogenic and thermal performance. Evaluate commercial cryopumps and refrigeration hardware, develop cold surfaces and sorbent assemblies, and determine how collected gas can be retained and recovered through controlled regeneration.

**Responsibilities**

* Assess commercial cryopump suitability, required operating temperatures, cooling capacity, access and modification constraints.
* Develop thermal budgets, shielding, supports, thermal interfaces, temperature sensing and control with the systems engineer.
* Evaluate staged capture of water, nitrogen and oxygen while measuring helium transmission, retention and losses.
* Design and conduct tests of capture efficiency, sorption capacity, breakthrough, regeneration and recovery over repeated cycles.
* Commission cold and vacuum systems, diagnose performance limits, and establish documented operating and safety procedures.

**Required experience**

* Degree in mechanical engineering, physics, applied physics or a related field, or equivalent specialist experience.
* Demonstrated personal responsibility for helium-temperature cryogenic apparatus, including cooldowns, thermometry, thermal troubleshooting and vacuum operation.
* Working knowledge of conduction and radiation heat loads, vacuum practices, leak detection and gas handling.
* Ability to design quantitative experiments, assess uncertainty and explain results clearly. Relevant industrial and research experience are both welcome.

**Preferred experience**

Cryopumps, adsorption or sorption, cryocoolers, cold traps, residual gas analysis, and gas inventory measurements. Experience modifying commercial equipment is especially valuable. A PhD is welcome but not required.

**What success looks like**

A defensible cold-system design and repeatable measurements showing where helium goes during capture, retention and regeneration, with thermal limits and losses understood.

*Provide a résumé and describe a cryogenic system you personally commissioned or modified, including a performance problem you diagnosed.*

Pay: $125,000.00 - $155,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
### **About the Role**

Want to own automation work from the first sketch to startup? As our Controls Engineer, you’ll design, program, install and improve the control systems that keep our plant running. You’ll work on the plant floor and own projects from start to finish. Your work will make our equipment more reliable, cut downtime and keep the plant safe. You’ll work closely with Engineering, Maintenance and Production.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Develop, commission and improve PLC programs, HMI applications, safety systems and MES data collection
* Design control-system architecture, including panels, electrical hardware, instrumentation, networks and communication protocols
* Troubleshoot controls, electrical and mechanical issues hands-on to get production back up safely
* Write and test ladder logic that is maintainable and reusable, mainly on Allen-Bradley platforms
* Build HMI screens that make complex machinery and processes easy to run
* Design industrial control panels to NFPA 79, NEC and UL 508A requirements
* Create and maintain electrical schematics, panel layouts, drawings and specifications
* Select and size components and recommend spare parts
* Use machine alarms, status and process data to improve reliability and performance
* Manage capital and improvement projects on scope, schedule, quality and budget, from concept through startup and handoff

### **What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering or a related field. We’ll also consider an associate degree with relevant experience, or an equivalent mix of education and experience.
* 5+ years of hands-on controls engineering experience in manufacturing
* Advanced skill programming and troubleshooting PLCs, HMIs, safety devices and automated equipment
* Advanced ladder-logic and Allen-Bradley PLC experience
* Strong electrical and mechanical knowledge and solid mechanical aptitude
* Experience managing several projects at once and implementing equipment, process or facility improvements
* Working knowledge of OSHA requirements and industrial electrical standards
* Proficiency with AutoCAD, Microsoft Office and Microsoft Project
* Strong troubleshooting, organizational and communication skills, and the ability to juggle competing priorities

### **Nice to Have**

* Lean manufacturing or Six Sigma
* ISO 9001 quality systems
* CMMS experience
* Industrial ovens and NFPA 86
* Experience with machine diagnostics or improving manufacturing data visibility

### **Schedule & Work Environment**

* First shift, with occasional off-shift and on-call support
* Regular plant-floor presence in an active manufacturing environment
* Occasional travel to other company locations

### **Why Join Us**

You’ll have broad ownership of controls and automation work, from design and installation through troubleshooting and continuous improvement. Your work will shape the plant’s equipment reliability, production performance and safety for years to come.

jobs.description:
Company Overview:

We are a world-class team of professionals who deliver next generation technology and products in robotic and autonomous platforms, ground, soldier, and maritime systems in 50+ locations world-wide. Much of our work contributes to innovative research in the fields of sensor science, signal processing, data fusion, artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and augmented reality (AR).

Being a part of QinetiQ US means being central to the safety and security of the world around us. In our diverse and inclusive environment, you can be authentic, feel valued, be respected, and realize your full potential. We are committed to supporting your success in both your professional and personal lives.

Position Overview:

QinetiQ US is seeking an experienced Senior Systems Engineer to serve as a Test and Evaluation (T&E) Lead in support of the U.S. Army C5ISR Center Javelin Seeker effort. The successful candidate will provide programmatic and technical oversight of contractor-executed verification, qualification, integration, and developmental test activities across the full acquisition life cycle, ensuring that test planning, readiness, execution, and reporting are aligned with system requirements, program risk, and Army acquisition decision needs.

The candidate will serve as a technical advisor to government and industry stakeholders, supporting T&E strategy, review of contractor-developed test documentation, readiness assessments, evaluation of test results, and independent technical assessments of system progress and qualification status. This role is well suited for candidates with experience in acquisition-level test and qualification for complex defense systems, especially EO/IR systems, seekers, sensors, or other hardware-intensive integrated systems. Candidates may come from government, SETA, FFRDC, prime contractor, or major subsystem supplier backgrounds with experience in system verification, qualification, integration and test, and requirements traceability.

Responsibilities:

* Provide systems engineering and programmatic oversight of contractor-executed test and evaluation activities in support of component qualification and acquisition decision milestones.
* Develop, review, update, and staff T&E strategies, test plans, verification approaches, and qualification documentation in alignment with system requirements and program objectives.
* Ensure traceability between system requirements, verification methods, qualification events, and test results.
* Support T&E planning across the full acquisition life cycle, including requirements development, design maturation, integration, verification, qualification, and formal program reviews.
* Lead or support Test and Evaluation Working Integrated Product Teams (T&E WIPTs), Test Readiness Reviews (TRRs), and other technical reviews.
* Review contractor-developed test procedures, readiness artifacts, safety documentation, data packages, and test reports for technical rigor, completeness, and contractual compliance.
* Coordinate with government organizations, test centers, laboratories, and contractor teams to support test planning, scheduling, resource alignment, and execution.
* Support independent technical assessment of test adequacy, qualification status, system performance, and program risk.
* Evaluate test discrepancies, root cause analyses, corrective action plans, and regression or retest activities.
* Prepare technical briefings, system assessment inputs, verification status updates, and leadership recommendations for government decision-makers.
* Support assessment of EO/IR subsystem and integrated sensor performance through functional, environmental, interface, and system-level verification activities.

Required Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline.
* 8+ years of systems engineering, test and evaluation, integration and test, or qualification experience supporting defense acquisition programs.
* Demonstrated experience supporting acquisition-level verification, qualification, developmental test, or system evaluation activities across the full acquisition life cycle.
* Experience providing government, SETA, program office, or lead engineering oversight of contractor-performed test activities.
* Experience developing, reviewing, or assessing test plans, procedures, readiness documentation, verification documentation, and test reports for complex defense systems.
* Experience with requirements development, verification planning, requirements traceability, and technical review processes.
* Experience supporting the development, integration, qualification, or test and evaluation of missile systems, seekers, sensors, EO/IR payloads, or other complex hardware-intensive defense systems.
* Strong analytical, technical writing, and briefing skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with government, contractor, and cross-functional engineering stakeholders.
* Must have an Active DoD Secret or higher level clearance.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience supporting U.S. Army or DoD

The Controls Engineer (E2) is responsible for developing PLC, HMI, and robot-program code, designing electrical control panels and wiring systems, and commissioning automation systems at customer sites. This role is central to Emtech's controls and automation capabilities — working with platforms including EtherCAT, UDP, and Codesys to integrate robotic systems for clients. Emtech offers a coordinated benefits package designed to support your health, your finances, and your future. Full-time employees (30 or more hours per week) are eligible for:

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Data Ingestion
jobs.description:
About Us

Founded in 2021, Axion is at the forefront of transforming product quality and customer satisfaction in manufacturing. Our cutting-edge AI-powered platform empowers manufacturers to swiftly identify, thoroughly investigate, and effectively resolve quality issues while simultaneously elevating customer experiences and outcomes.

As trailblazers in end-to-end quality intelligence, we're setting new industry standards. Our innovative approach enables industrial, aerospace, consumer, and medtech manufacturers to harness the power of quality and post-market data, driving down costs and boosting business performance.

Our vision extends beyond mere problem-solving; we're committed to reshaping the future of manufacturing. By seamlessly integrating advanced AI technology with deep industry expertise, Axion is paving the way for smarter, safer, and more efficient production processes across diverse sectors.

Backed by leading investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Amplo, Boeing, and RTX Ventures, Axion is poised to lead the quality revolution in manufacturing.

About The Role

We're looking for an experienced Backend Engineer to build and scale the production data ingestion systems that brings customer data into the Axion platform. This is a senior individual contributor role with direct architectural ownership and product impact.

The ideal candidate has strong experience working in early-stage companies, building and scaling complex, data-intensive backend systems. In this role, you would work with customer, service, field, telematics, warranty, and aftermarket data from dozens of enterprise systems, often in incompatible formats and with little structure or connection between sources.

Getting data onboarding right is essential because everything downstream depends on the integrity of that data. You’ll work closely with both Engineering and Product leadership to define and improve how manufacturer data is ingested, mapped, validated, and prepared for use across the platform.

Key Responsibilities

Own technical architecture for our data ingestion system, including ingestion pipelines, schema mapping, validation, transformation, and the orchestration that carries customer data from the source to production-ready dataset.
Build and harden the backend services and cloud infrastructure (Python, Postgres, and Kubernetes) that make onboarding a new manufacturer fast, repeatable, and observable, rather than a bespoke engineering project every time.
Solve integration challenges at the source: enterprise warranty, telematics, ERP, and service systems with inconsistent schemas, unreliable delivery, and no shared vocabulary between them.
Establish rigorous data quality and reliability standards (validation, lineage, monitoring, and alerting) so that pipeline degradation is caught by us before it's noticed by a customer.
Partner across Engineering, Product, and customer-facing teams to shape the technical vision and roadmap for data onboarding workflows.
Raise engineering standards through code review, design docs, and the technical direction others build on.
Mentor engineers on data architecture and system design, unblocking hard problems and sharing context generously.

Requirements

Minimum 5+ years of backend software engineering experience, with deep, recent, hands-on fluency in Python.
Strong cloud architecture experience—designing, deploying, and operating distributed services in production, with Kubernetes and containerized workloads.
Demonstrated depth with Postgres and relational data modeling, including performance, migrations, and schema design under real production load.
A track record of solving genuine data integration problems: heterogeneous sources, messy real-world inputs, and turning all of it into something reliable that downstream systems can depend on.
A pragmatic, tools-not-platforms approach to the data ecosystem—you pick the right technology for the problem rather than building an identity around a single proprietary stack.
A track record of technical mentorship; you make the engineers around you better without needing formal authority.
A firm believer in a "Data First" philosophy who can make sound decisions in ambiguous, fast-moving situations.
A strong executor in fast-paced environments who can balance shipping MVPs with a commitment to production-grade systems.

Who You Are

You’re a builder and operator who thrives in fast-moving, high-accountability environments. You take pride in getting things done — thoughtfully, efficiently, and without drama. You’re energized by ambiguity, skilled at bringing clarity, and comfortable flexing between strategy and execution.

You value feedback — giving it, receiving it, and acting on it — and you see collaboration as a competitive advantage, not a burden. You’re low-ego but high-agency: you care about winning as a team more than being right individually. You move quickly, communicate directly, and make decisions grounded in impact and data.

You don’t need constant direction — you create momentum. You take ownership for outcomes, and you expect the same from those around you.

How We Operate

We move fast, work smart, and hold ourselves to a high bar. Axion is a place for people who take pride in their craft and are motivated by meaningful work. We respect time off and boundaries, but we’re also realistic: hard problems sometimes require weekend pushes or late-night thinking sessions. We support that balance — intensity with respect for recharge.

We stay highly collaborative and connected throughout the day — much of our communication happens over Slack. We move quickly, share feedback often, and keep discussions open so decisions and context flow freely. If you value crisp communication, rapid iteration, and a steady hum of collaboration, you’ll fit right in.

We

Collaborate deeply. Feedback is part of how we build — everyone has a voice, and ideas win on merit.
Leave ego at the door. Titles don’t define value; contribution does.
Bias toward action. We iterate fast and favor progress over perfection.
Communicate with clarity. Direct, transparent, and always in service of the mission.
Act like owners. Everyone is accountable for outcomes, not just tasks.
Sustain excellence. We push hard but don’t glorify burnout — we’re in this for the long game.

If you want to help shape a company redefining how manufacturing operates — and you thrive in a culture that rewards ownership, speed, and candor — you’ll feel at home here

What We Offer

Work with cutting-edge AI technology making a tangible impact in manufacturing
Collaborative, mission-driven team and supportive leadership
Generous time off
Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits
Lunch stipend…. And much more

Ready to drive the future of manufacturing with AI? Apply today to join our team and help us build the category-defining platform for quality intelligence.

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Agentic Platform
jobs.description:
About Us

Founded in 2021, Axion is at the forefront of transforming product quality and customer satisfaction in manufacturing. Our cutting-edge AI-powered platform empowers manufacturers to swiftly identify, thoroughly investigate, and effectively resolve quality issues while simultaneously elevating customer experiences and outcomes.

As trailblazers in end-to-end quality intelligence, we're setting new industry standards. Our innovative approach enables industrial, aerospace, consumer, and medtech manufacturers to harness the power of quality and post-market data, driving down costs and boosting business performance.

Our vision extends beyond mere problem-solving; we're committed to reshaping the future of manufacturing. By seamlessly integrating advanced AI technology with deep industry expertise, Axion is paving the way for smarter, safer, and more efficient production processes across diverse sectors.

Backed by leading investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Amplo, Boeing, and RTX Ventures, Axion is poised to lead the quality revolution in manufacturing.

About The Role

We're looking for an experienced Software Engineer to help architect and scale the agentic systems at the core of the Axion platform. This is a senior individual contributor role: you'll own design decisions that determine how our agents reason, act, and integrate with enterprise data, working in close partnership with Engineering and Product leadership. The hard problem is the data—customer, service, field, telematics, warranty, and aftermarket signals that are disconnected and mostly unstructured—and the bar is high, because an agent's conclusion can drive a recall or a redesign. The ideal candidate thrives in early stage companies, has deep experience building complex, data-intensive systems, and knows what it takes to make non-deterministic, LLM-driven systems reliable in production.

Key Responsibilities

Own technical architecture for our agentic systems—orchestration, tool use, memory, retrieval, evaluation, observability, and the guardrails that keep agents reliable when the input data is noisy and incomplete.
Build and harden the reasoning layer and infrastructure that take customer data from ingestion through agent-driven reasoning to root-cause insight, at the scale and reliability manufacturers require.
Establish rigorous evaluation and testing for non-deterministic systems—measuring agent accuracy against expert-validated ground truth and the outcomes customers track: detection rates, investigation speed, and warranty cost.
Partner across Engineering and Product to shape the technical vision and roadmap for the agent platform.
Raise engineering standards through code review, design docs, and the technical direction others build on.
Mentor engineers on agentic patterns and system design, unblocking hard problems and sharing context generously.

Requirements

4+ years of software engineering experience, with recent, hands-on focus on building agentic systems (LLM orchestration, tool/function calling, multi-step and multi-agent reasoning, retrieval and context engineering, and interoperability protocols such as MCP, or comparable work).
Demonstrated ability to design and own complex distributed systems, ideally in data-intensive B2B SaaS environments.
Hands-on fluency with the modern agentic stack and a strong intuition for the failure modes of non-deterministic, LLM-driven systems—plus the evaluation and observability practices needed to tame them.
Experience turning messy, heterogeneous real-world data into something a model can reason over reliably.
A track record of technical mentorship; you make the engineers around you better without needing formal authority.
A firm believer in a "Data First" philosophy who can make sound decisions in ambiguous, fast-moving situations.
A strong executor in fast-paced environments who can balance shipping MVPs with a commitment to production-grade systems.

Who You Are

You’re a builder and operator who thrives in fast-moving, high-accountability environments. You take pride in getting things done — thoughtfully, efficiently, and without drama. You’re energized by ambiguity, skilled at bringing clarity, and comfortable flexing between strategy and execution.

You value feedback — giving it, receiving it, and acting on it — and you see collaboration as a competitive advantage, not a burden. You’re low-ego but high-agency: you care about winning as a team more than being right individually. You move quickly, communicate directly, and make decisions grounded in impact and data.

You don’t need constant direction — you create momentum. You take ownership for outcomes, and you expect the same from those around you.

How We Operate

We move fast, work smart, and hold ourselves to a high bar. Axion is a place for people who take pride in their craft and are motivated by meaningful work. We respect time off and boundaries, but we’re also realistic: hard problems sometimes require weekend pushes or late-night thinking sessions. We support that balance — intensity with respect for recharge.

We stay highly collaborative and connected throughout the day — much of our communication happens over Slack. We move quickly, share feedback often, and keep discussions open so decisions and context flow freely. If you value crisp communication, rapid iteration, and a steady hum of collaboration, you’ll fit right in.

We

Collaborate deeply. Feedback is part of how we build — everyone has a voice, and ideas win on merit.
Leave ego at the door. Titles don’t define value; contribution does.
Bias toward action. We iterate fast and favor progress over perfection.
Communicate with clarity. Direct, transparent, and always in service of the mission.
Act like owners. Everyone is accountable for outcomes, not just tasks.
Sustain excellence. We push hard but don’t glorify burnout — we’re in this for the long game.

If you want to help shape a company redefining how manufacturing operates — and you thrive in a culture that rewards ownership, speed, and candor — you’ll feel at home here

What We Offer

Work with cutting-edge AI technology making a tangible impact in manufacturing
Collaborative, mission-driven team and supportive leadership
Generous time off
Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits
Lunch stipend…. And much more

Ready to drive the future of manufacturing with AI? Apply today to join our team and help us build the category-defining platform for quality intelligence.

Axion is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity, or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

EOS Defense Systems USA designs and produces highly accurate, cost-effective, modular, and scalable Remote Weapon Systems that give warfighters a decisive edge in counter-UAS and ground-to-ground missions. Trusted across platforms, we're at the forefront of defense innovation.

At EOS our people are our strength. Here, engineers own their work throughout their life cycle. Working side by side with a small, multi-disciplinary team in a safe, collaborative workplace. The pace is fast, the mission is real, and you'll build your skills and grow your career while advancing technology that matters, from advanced effectors to AI. If you want hands-on engineering with real ownership and a direct line to the mission, EOS Defense Systems USA is the place to be.

**Senior Embedded Software Engineer (Remote Weapon Systems)**  
  
EOS is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, test, and integrate embedded software solutions that extend the capabilities of our high-performing, world-leading Remote Weapon Systems (RWS) across multiple programs. The ideal candidate will be a senior technical professional who can bridge the gap between hardware and software. In this role, you will integrate various technologies such as the development of multi-platform software for Line-Replaceable Units (LRUs), command-and-control (C2) interfaces, and discrete electrical signals to enable full remote control of our weapon systems. You will collaborate directly with our electrical engineering team, reviewing PCB schematics and component data sheets to ensure hardware perfectly aligns with software requirements.  
  
**This is an on-site position located at our facility in Huntsville, AL.**  
  
**Responsibilities:**  

* Embedded Software Architecture & Development: Design and implement robust, real-time software solutions across bare-metal, FreeRTOS, and Embedded Linux environments.
* Hardware-Software Co-Design: Review PCB schematics and component datasheets; collaborate extensively with electrical engineers to guarantee hardware effectively supports software capabilities.
* Control & Fire-Control Systems: Support critical technology upgrades by modifying DSP-based motor-control software and enhancing our Java-based Fire-Control System (FCS).
* LRU Engineering: Develop software for critical line-replaceable units, integrating command-and-control (C2) interfaces with discrete electrical signals for comprehensive remote operation.
* System Integration & Field Support: Work cross-functionally to integrate software with EO/IR and radar systems; travel as required to support customer reviews, field integration, and live-fire test operations.

  
**Required Qualifications:**  

* Education: BS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a highly related technical discipline.
* Experience: 8+ years of progressively responsible software engineering experience, with a strong focus on embedded systems.
* Platform & Hardware Expertise: Proven development experience with Microchip microcontrollers/microprocessors, their development ecosystems, and general C/C++ bare-metal and RTOS programming.
* Industry & Security: Demonstrated experience working in a Government Contracting Environment. Must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a Secret-level U.S. security clearance.
* Core Competencies: Exceptional written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills; willingness to travel to customer reviews or test ranges.

  
**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Advanced Degree: Master's degree in a relevant engineering or computer science field.
* Linux Build Systems & Tools: Hands-on experience building custom embedded Linux distributions using the Yocto Project.
* Middleware & Networking: Proficiency with DDS publish/subscribe middleware, TCP/UDP sockets, RS-232, and Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN) protocols.
* Advanced Weapon System Tech: Experience developing Command and Control (C2) software, integrating EO/IR or radar systems, and exposure to EO/IR test and evaluation instruments.
* Next-Gen Innovation: Familiarity with AI/Machine Learning concepts and their practical application to advance automation and targeting software in remote weapon systems

**Outstanding Benefits/Perks:**  

* Excellent insurance coverage
* 401(k) match
* Generous PTO
* Tuition Reimbursement
* 9/80 Work Schedule

An Equal Opportunity Employer for disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, other protected veterans, and armed forces service medal veterans. jobs.description:
**Description**

**Looking for an opportunity to make an impact?**

At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainably. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.

**Your greatest work is ahead!**

Leidos’ ***Defense Uncrewed Systems Integration*** ***and Test*** is seeking a motivated and ambitious **UAS** **Cyber SW Engineer** to join the Software, Simulation, Systems Engineering and Integration Directorate (S3I) Joint Technology Center – Systems Integration Lab (JSIL) Technology and Certification Center. As a **UAS** **Cyber SW Engineer**, you’ll be an integral part of a dynamic engineering team that supports UAS cyber systems. This role bridges the gap between software engineering and cybersecurity. The candidate will be responsible for the security architecture, secure coding, static/dynamic code analysis, and vulnerability remediation for critical application software across the full software development lifecycle. Working directly within an Agile/Scrum team, the candidate will ensure complex systems meet rigorous DoD cybersecurity requirements (such as DISA STIGs/SRGs and RMF standards) while actively contributing to modern continuous integration and automated software delivery pipelines.

**If this sounds like the kind of environment where you can thrive, keep reading!**

**Leidos Defense Sector** provides a diverse portfolio of systems, solutions, and services covering land, sea, air, space, and cyberspace for customers worldwide. Solutions for Defense include enterprise and mission IT, large-scale intelligence systems, command and control, geospatial and data analytics, cybersecurity, logistics, training, and intelligence analysis and operations support. Our team is solving the world’s toughest security challenges for customers with “can’t fail” missions. To explore and learn more, click here!

**Are you ready to make an impact? Share your resume with us today!**

**Primary Responsibilities**

* **Secure Software Development & Engineering:** Participate in the full lifecycle design, coding, testing, and integration of secure embedded and application software for military systems using C/C++ and Object-Oriented methodologies.
* **Static & Dynamic Code Analysis:** Perform, analyze, and track static and dynamic code analysis scan results (e.g., Parasoft, Coverity, Fortify) to identify vulnerabilities, eliminate security flaws, and guide development remediation efforts.
* **Security Control Implementation & Hardening:** Work with cross-functional software teams to implement and automate technical security controls, including DISA STIGs, SRGs, and industry best practice hardening guidelines across Linux, databases, and application baselines.
