jobs.description:
San Mateo, CA, United StatesEngineeringID: 36414

  

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Roblox’s data platform processes petabytes of data daily, powering analytics, ML, and product decisions. The Data Platform Compute team owns the compute layer underneath it: the Kubernetes (EKS) clusters where all of Roblox’s Spark workloads run, and the software that lets engineers, analysts, and ML practitioners submit and run that work reliably and cost-effectively.

As a Senior Software Engineer on this team, you will build and operate the systems that sit between our users and the cluster. These include the Spark job submission service, our internal Spark libraries, interactive notebook compute, and cluster lifecycle automation. You’ll have real ownership, you’ll work on problems where the design is not yet settled, and you’ll help decide which technologies Roblox adopts next.

**You Will:**

* **Build and own core compute platform services:** Design, build, and operate the software behind Spark job submission, including APIs, scheduling integration, and the libraries users depend on.
* **Launch interactive Spark at scale:** Deliver Spark Connect to support notebook workflows, including provisioning and managing the EKS compute that backs them, with sensible isolation, resource limits, and cost controls.
* **Run a safe, automated cluster fleet:** Build fleet management automation for EKS, such as blue-green rollouts that validate new AMIs and Kubernetes versions before they reach production workloads, with minimal disruption to running jobs.
* **Make jobs run better without user effort:** Develop our auto-tuner, which analyzes Spark history and event logs to recommend or apply job configuration changes that improve performance and reduce cost.
* **Own batch scheduling on Kubernetes:** Operate and upgrade our YuniKorn-based scheduling, including queue design, quotas, fairness across tenants, and version upgrades.
* **Shape what we adopt next:** Evaluate emerging technology such as native Spark acceleration (e.g., Apache Comet). Run rigorous benchmarks on real Roblox workloads and make a clear recommendation backed by data.
* **Be an owner of reliability and cost:** Define SLOs and metrics, build observability, and drive down toil, incidents, and compute spend across a multi-tenant platform.
* **Partner across the company:** Work with data engineering, ML, analytics, and infrastructure teams to understand their needs, communicate changes, and migrate users to better paths.

**You Have:**

* 5+ years of experience building and operating production-grade distributed systems or infrastructure platforms.
* **Spark on Kubernetes:** Hands-on experience running Apache Spark on Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, or self-managed) as a platform, including executor and driver behavior, resource tuning, and troubleshooting failed or slow jobs. We are looking for platform builders, not just Spark users.
* **Kubernetes depth:** Strong experience operating production Kubernetes clusters at scale, such as upgrades, node lifecycle, autoscaling, and operators or controllers.
* **Engineering foundations:** Strong proficiency in at least one of **Go, Java, Scala, or Clojure**, with a track record of writing clean, well-tested, maintainable backend code. Python is a plus, since much of our tuning and analysis tooling uses it.
* **Cloud fluency:** Experience with AWS (EKS, EC2, IAM, S3) or GCP equivalents, and infrastructure-as-code.
* **Operational ownership:** Experience taking a system from design through production operation, including on-call, incident response, and observability.
* **Technical leadership:** Ability to influence design decisions across teams, mentor engineers, and drive alignment on cross-cutting changes.
* B.S. in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
* Bonus Points:
  + Experience with YuniKorn, Volcano, Kueue, or other batch schedulers on Kubernetes.
  + Experience with Spark Connect, Livy, Kyuubi, or other interactive and gateway layers for Spark.
  + Experience with the Spark Operator, Karpenter, Helm, Terraform, or Argo.
  + Experience building tooling that uses Spark event logs or metrics for tuning, cost attribution, or anomaly detection.
  + Experience maintaining internal Spark builds or driving Spark version upgrades.
  + Familiarity with native execution engines (Comet, Gluten, Velox) or JVM performance tuning.
  + Experience migrating workloads from YARN/Hadoop to Kubernetes.
  + Contributions to open-source projects in the data or Kubernetes ecosystem.
  + Experience operating at consumer-internet scale (100M+ users).

Our team owns Apache Airflow and the Kubernetes (EKS) infrastructure underneath it, running 8,000+ DAGs every day, most of them Spark jobs. You will set the long-term architecture for how Roblox orchestrates data at scale, and you will be hands-on in making it faster, more reliable, and easier for hundreds of engineers to use.

**You Will:**

* **Define the Orchestration Strategy:** Own the multi-year architecture for Airflow and the surrounding platform, including scheduler and executor design, multi-tenancy, upgrades and migrations, and where the platform should evolve next.
* **Scale and Harden Airflow:** Find and remove scaling limits across the scheduler, metadata database, executors, and DAG parsing. Make sure thousands of daily DAGs run with predictable latency and strong SLAs.
* **Own Orchestration on Kubernetes:** Lead the design and operation of our EKS clusters for orchestration and Spark workloads, including autoscaling, resource isolation, cost efficiency, and deployment automation.
* **Build Platform Tooling for Internal Engineers:** Design the APIs, custom operators and providers, libraries, and self-service tooling that let data teams build, deploy, and monitor pipelines safely.
* **Drive Observability and Reliability:** Establish SLOs, alerting, and diagnostics for pipelines and platform components. Lead incident reviews and fix the root causes in code, not just in runbooks.
* **Lead Across Teams:** Work with data platform, governance, data science, and product engineering teams to align roadmaps, guide technical decisions, and build consensus on complex initiatives.
* **Raise the Engineering Bar:** Set standards for code quality, design, and operational readiness. Mentor staff, senior, and mid-level engineers.

**You Have:**

* B.S. equivalent in CS or sufficient experience.
* 10+ years of experience designing, building, and operating production-grade, large-scale distributed systems.
* **Workflow Orchestration Depth:** Deep, hands-on experience designing, running, and scaling a production data-related workflow orchestrator or job scheduler (thousands of workflows or DAGs a day). Apache Airflow is ideal, but experience with an equivalent system (Dagster, Prefect, Temporal, or a large in-house scheduler) is also welcome. You understand scheduler and executor design, metadata store performance, task isolation, retries and idempotency, and safe upgrades and migrations.
* **Kubernetes Expertise:** Proven experience managing and scaling production Kubernetes clusters on AWS (EKS), including Helm, autoscaling (Karpenter or Cluster Autoscaler), and GitOps-style deployment.
* **Software Engineering Foundations:** Strong proficiency in Python, plus Go or Java, with a record of writing clean, well-tested platform and tooling code. You are a software engineer who builds and improves systems, not someone who mainly handles tickets and operations.
* **Data Workload Familiarity:** Working knowledge of how Spark jobs run on Kubernetes (Spark on K8s, spark-operator, or EMR on EKS) and how orchestration interacts with them.
* **Platform Mindset:** Experience building platforms used by other engineers, with strong instincts for APIs, observability, reliability, and developer experience.
* **Cross-Organizational Technical Leadership:** A track record of influencing direction across a large engineering organization and driving multi-quarter projects from concept to production.
* **Extreme Ownership:** You define the problem when requirements are unclear, unblock dependencies, and see complex work through to stable production.
* Bonus Points:
  + Contributions to Apache Airflow or related open-source projects (Airflow providers, Helm chart, spark-operator, Karpenter, Argo CD).
  + Experience with other orchestration systems (Dagster, Temporal, Argo Workflows, Flyte) and the judgment to know when each fits.
  + Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code, Prometheus/OpenTelemetry, and cost optimization or chargeback for shared platforms.
  + Experience operating infrastructure at consumer-internet scale.

LASP is looking for a Senior Software Engineering Department Manager to lead the 63-person department that delivers flight and ground software for LASP's space missions and science instruments. The department was recently formed from previously separate software groups (flight software, operations software, data systems, and web applications) to create a cohesive organization that spans the mission lifecycle, uses common practices and tools, unifies technical authority, and fosters technical interchange across software disciplines.

  
  

You will lead the department through its functional leads, set its technical direction, and own how LASP develops and verifies software, bringing a mission-level perspective to LASP's software strategy. You will report to the Deputy Director for Technology and serve on the Technology Division leadership team.

  
  

This is a unique opportunity to shape a new part of the organization, including its practices, its tools, and its culture, while supporting missions that LASP builds and operates.

Founded a decade before NASA, the Laboratory for Atmospheric and Space Physics (LASP) at the University of Colorado Boulder is revolutionizing human understanding of the cosmos. We employ over 600 scientists, engineers, support personnel, and students that work closely to cultivate creative ideas and explore novel solutions to make the impossible possible.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**  

BAE Systems Space & Mission Systems (SMS) is seeking a Lead Systems Engineer to provide Element-level systems engineering leadership for advanced technological system development. This role is responsible for ensuring alignment between stakeholder needs, system architecture, and subsystem performance while guiding the program through design, integration, and validation.
  
  
This position is for an experienced individual who can work in and lead a multi-disciplinary team through every stage of program’s lifecycle to develop, maintain, verify and communicate the technical baseline for a program or part of a program that includes Segment, Element. and/or Subsystems level ownership. You’ll coordinate with Customers, the Program Management Office, the Chief Systems Engineer, the Chief Engineer and other engineering disciplines, suppliers, and partners as applicable to lead the architectural development, technical integration, and verification of space systems and their associated ground and launch systems as necessary.
  
  
The Engineering, Science and Analysis (ESA) Strategic Capabilities Unit comprises the technical talent and organizational leadership that enables the successful delivery of high-impact discriminating technologies for our customers’ missions. Our collaborative, cross-functional teams are committed to innovation, integrity, continual learning and strong execution.
  
  
**What You’ll Do:**

* The Lead Systems Engineer is the authority for the technical requirements baseline of a program and will supervise and lead a team of Systems Engineers to define mission objectives, identify stakeholders, and establish system architecture during the development, design, integration, and V&V of a mission.
* Work with Engineering Management and the PMO to manage the staffing assignments for a team of Systems Engineers.
* Work closely together with the PMO and CSE to balance technical performance with programmatic constraints.
* Provide systems engineering leadership of technical teams in the development, verification, delivery, and operations of Segments, Elements, and Subsystems of space-based missions.
* Support the proper allocation, traceability, and verification of requirements at all levels through the lifecycle of the program.
* Interact with our teams of subject matter experts to develop the required allocation analysis and verification artifacts.
* Interface with and support the program’s stakeholders including the Customer, PMO, suppliers, and internal SBUs.

* Own and delegate requirements and interface verification with I&T activities according to company processes to ensure a successful V&V campaign.
* Use Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) for architecture to requirements traceability and interface development in coordination with Customers
* Own the System-level technical budgets.
* Mentor other system engineers assigned to the team.
* Support the program Risk & Opportunity Management and ERB processes.
* Prepare and give presentations to peers, management, and customers.
* Maintain a regular and predictable work schedule.
* Establish and maintain effective working relationships within the department, the Strategic Business Units, Strategic Capabilities Units and the Company. Interact appropriately with others in order to maintain a positive and productive work environment.
* Perform other duties as necessary.

**On-Site Work Environment:** This position requires regular in-person engagement by working **on-site five days** each normally scheduled week in the primary work location. Travel and local commute between company campuses and other possible non-company locations may be required.
  
  
**Working Conditions:**

* Work is performed in an office, laboratory, production floor, or cleanroom, outdoors or remote research environment.
* May occasionally work in production work centers where use of protective equipment and gear is required.
* May access other facilities in various weather conditions.
  

  
  
**Required Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* BS degree or higher in Engineering or a related technical field is required plus 6 or more years related experience.
* Each higher-level degree, i.e., Master’s Degree or Ph.D., may substitute for two years of experience. Related technical experience may be considered in lieu of education. Degree must be from a university, college, or school which is accredited by an agency recognized by the US Secretary of Education, US Department of Education.
* A current, active TS/SCI security clearance is required with ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI Polygraph.
* Experience using requirements database tools (DOORS, Jama, Cameo Requirements Modeler, e.g.)
* Experience with Cameo Enterprise Architecture, SysML and DoDAF/UAF/UPDM.
* Demonstrated ability to manage effective and verifiable requirements – detail oriented.
* Demonstrated experience in systems engineering processes, including requirements development, requirement allocation, change management, verification and validation – a self-starter that will own this activity.
* Demonstrated experience leading multi-disciplinary teams including meeting schedule and performance goals.

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Requirements**  

"We Power the Magic!" That's our motto at Disney Experiences Technology (DXT). Our team creates world-class immersive digital experiences for the Company's premier vacation brands, including Disney's Parks & Resorts. We are responsible for the end-to-end digital and physical Guest experience for all technology and digital-led initiatives across Food & Beverage, and Merchandise lines of business.

This role sits within the Retail & Restaurant Technology organization and supports the Point of Sale (POS) platform — the system that powers every merchandise and dining transaction across our parks and resorts. Our platform is a large-scale, distributed, event-driven system. We work with a polyglot stack (PHP, Go, Python, Java) that we are actively modernizing, and we need engineers who embrace the platform as it is while helping shape what it becomes. The main client of our services is the POS terminal itself — an Android-based hardware device used by thousands of Cast Members every day — so reliability, performance, and thoughtful API design directly impact the Guest and Cast experience.

The Lead Software Engineer will report to the Manager, Software Engineering.

What You Will Do

* Lead and personally build (hands-on coding expected) scalable, well-documented backend services and APIs across our polyglot platform — PHP and Go microservices today, with a growing Java/Spring footprint — from technical specification through production delivery.
* Set architectural direction for the POS platform: translate complex functional, technical, and business requirements into solution and system designs, produce architecture diagrams and proof-of-concepts, evaluate technology choices, and ensure new solutions integrate cleanly with surrounding Disney systems.
* Drive the modernization roadmap, playing a leading technical role in the migration of existing PHP and Go microservices into Java/Spring applications — defining migration patterns, sequencing, coexistence strategies, and quality gates so we modernize without disrupting daily park operations.
* Own the full software development life cycle for your team's deliverables: planning, estimation, design reviews, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, release management, production support, and post-incident root-cause analysis.
* Lead and mentor a team of backend Software Engineers — provide day-to-day technical direction, unblock engineers, review designs and code, grow junior talent, and foster a culture of engineering excellence and psychological safety.
* Assess and communicate risk: identify technical, delivery, and operational risks early; give clear direction on trade-offs; and escalate to leadership with well-formed options and recommendations when decisions exceed the team's authority.
* Design and operate event-driven and streaming integrations using Amazon Kinesis and RabbitMQ, ensuring our transaction, inventory, and reporting flows are resilient, idempotent, and observable.
* Steward our data layer, designing performant schemas and access patterns on Amazon Aurora (MySQL-compatible), guiding ORM usage, and safeguarding transactional integrity for a system where every record represents real money and a real Guest.
* Champion AI-assisted engineering, embedding tools such as Claude, Cursor, and Codex into the team's daily workflow — from design and coding to testing and troubleshooting — and shaping responsible adoption practices that raise both velocity and quality.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with product owners, program management, architecture, QA, hardware/terminal teams, and vendor partners to align solutions with current and future business needs, and represent the team in tactical and strategic forums with all levels of leadership.
* Support production, participating in on-call rotations and go-lives for a platform where availability matters most during the moments our Guests are creating memories.

Required Qualifications and Skills

* 7+ years of progressive experience designing, building, and operating large-scale, high-volume backend systems and services, including 2+ years leading engineers or serving as technical lead across the full software development life cycle.
* Strong hands-on expertise in PHP (modern PHP 8+; experience with a major framework such as Laravel or Symfony) and Go (idiomatic Go for microservices; familiarity with common toolkits such as Gin, Echo, or gRPC-Go).
* Working proficiency in Java and Spring / Spring Boot, with the ability to lead the design and buildout of new Java services as part of our microservices migration.
* Deep understanding of RDBMS fundamentals — schema design, indexing, query optimization, transactions, isolation levels — with hands-on experience on Amazon Aurora and/or MySQL, and practical experience with ORMs (e.g., Hibernate/JPA) including knowing when *not* to use them.
* Production experience with streaming and eventing architectures: Amazon Kinesis (or Kafka) for streams and RabbitMQ (or similar broker) for messaging — including delivery guarantees, ordering, dead-lettering, replay, and backpressure.
* Expertise designing REST APIs and service contracts, plus experience with binary serialization formats such as Protocol Buffers (Protobuf) and gRPC-style service communication.

jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

  

**Department Overview**
-----------------------

The Motorola Solutions Advanced Development Engineering team, located in Plantation, FL., specializes in the design and development of world class Mission Critical Communications equipment. This team develops RF modems, integrated circuits, and other related circuit modules and subsystems for use in our radio products. We need an innovative and motivated radio device system engineer. As a member of our team you will have opportunities to work on a variety of circuits and system designs. This position requires 100% on site presence Monday thru Friday at our engineering facility located in Plantation FL.

**Job Description**
-------------------

The **Radio Device System Engineer** will work with commercial off-the-shelf ICs as well as custom CMOS technologies to develop RF transceiver systems to be utilized in hi-reliability public safety communications equipment. This position will be one of a team of advanced technologists that will conceive, design and implement radio systems with off-the-shelf semiconductor devices as well as custom mixed signal digital, RF and analog circuits and subsystems using robust design methodologies for deployment in two way radio equipment. The completed RF transceiver systems are intended for use in Motorola Solutions radio products.

  

The following are activities related to this job and require prior experience:

* **System Architecture & Definition:** Translate product-level radio requirements into comprehensive architectural specifications for mixed-signal SoCs including antenna tuners, PLLs, fractional multi-loop synthesizers, ADCs and DACs, baseband and RF amplifiers/filters, AGC sub systems, digital state machines, embedded microprocessors, memories, memory interfaces. Must be able to communicate and work with radio product development hardware and software architects to achieve product level requirements.
* **System Level Modeling:** Develop behavioral system models to accurately determine and manage block level specs for a radio modem lineup including hardware, firmware and software components. Arbitrate block level spec adjustments throughout the design process to accomplish the overall system performance goals on finished silicon and complete radio product implementation.
* **IP Evaluation & Integration`:** Collaborate with internal and external IP providers to integrate high-speed analog peripherals, data converters (ADC/DAC).
* **Power & Performance Optimization:** Develop power-modeling and thermal management strategies across multiple operating modes and low-power states
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with digital design, analog layout, firmware/software, verification, and test engineering teams from specification to silicon tape-out, bring-up and ultimately deployment into radio products. Work with external contractor SMEs to define and implement specialized subsystems in our custom IC designs.
* **Documentation:** Work with team members to document transceiver and sub-systems requirements, theory of operation, step-by-step functional operation instructions, troubleshooting, engineering & manufacturing test procedures and related procedures.

  

**Qualifications**

  

* Solid experience in analog/mixed-signal circuit block and feedback control system modeling like PLL and AGC subsystems, design and verification using Cadence or equivalent CAD tools.
* Knowledge of multi-loop feedback control systems and modeling such systems.
* Experience in assessing 3rd party IP and COTS ICs for modem development.
* Experience with embedded processors.
* Experience with digital signal processing as applied to modulation and demodulation of signals in a faded radio channel environment.
* Experience implementing high-speed interfaces (hyperRAM MIPI, LPDDR, Ethernet) within a radio modem and mitigating interaction with RF signal processing.
* Knowledge of SoC power management architectures, clocking schemes, and voltage domains.
* Experience with Verilog-A/Verilog-AMS/System Verilog/Universal Verification Methodology (UVM) for digital and analog/mixed signal (AMS) designs. Familiar with shell and scripting languages
* Experience as a technical team leader and providing direction to other technical staff in the development of radio transceivers.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Founded and headquartered in Switzerland, Avaloq is continuously expanding its global footprint with around 2,500 colleagues in 12 countries, and more than 170 clients in 35 countries. We are an industry-leading provider of wealth management technology and services for financial institutions around the world, including private banks and wealth managers, investment managers, as well as retail and neo banks. Our research led approach and continual innovation is powered by the passion and creativity of our colleagues.

We are always looking for talented people to join us on our mission to orchestrate the financial ecosystem and democratize access to wealth management. Avaloq offers the opportunity to work closely with some of the world’s leading financial institutions as we jointly develop and shape careers. Championing a collaborative, supportive and flexible work environment empowers our colleagues to reach their full potential.

 **Job Description**

Avaloq’s R&D Lab is building a SaaS, API-first, composable banking platform. You will help develop its Rust backend, creating financial technology where precision, quality and scalability matter, while working closely with engineers in Fort Lauderdale and Zurich.

These 3 roles are among the first engineering roles at our new Fort Lauderdale development center, offering significant scope for ownership as the team grows. You will work directly with clients, see how your solutions are used and bring those insights back into the product. The role includes onboarding with the Zurich team, collaborative mornings and productive afternoons, with regular travel to Switzerland and occasional travel to client sites.

**Our stack**

Rust with Tokio and the AWS SDK for Rust. Serverless-first on AWS, using Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS and S3, with GitHub Actions for CI/CD. Clients integrate through our APIs and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). We do not run containers.

**Useful domain experience**

Depending on the role, relevant experience may include wealth and asset management, discretionary portfolio management, investment performance and attribution, portfolio valuation and rebalancing, benchmarks and fees, or US investment taxation, including tax lots, cost basis, holding periods, wash sales, corporate actions, withholding and tax reporting.

What you'll do:

* Design, develop and test Rust backend services for complex financial products, with a focus on accuracy, scalability and reliability.
* Translate complex financial rules and mathematical concepts into precise, efficient and testable software, accounting for numerical precision and edge cases.
* Build scalable solutions using historized, non-relational data models and asynchronous, event-driven architectures.
* Contribute to technical specifications, design discussions and code reviews, using AI coding agents while maintaining rigorous review standards and accountability.
* Own features through the development lifecycle, from implementation and automated testing to deployment and monitoring, working alongside Platform and SRE engineers.
* Work directly with clients and domain specialists to analyse product questions, solve problems and bring insights back into product development.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Strong programming foundations in a statically typed language such as Rust, C++, Java, Scala, Kotlin, C#, Go or TypeScript.
* Master’s degree or PhD in computer science, mathematics, physics or a related quantitative field.
* Strong modelling skills, including experience or understanding of historized data, effective dating, immutability and audit trails.
* Strong analytical ability and intellectual curiosity, with the ability to quickly learn new technologies and complex financial domains.
* Clear and confident communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts effectively to both technical and business audiences.
* Ability to work independently within a distributed team and travel to Switzerland and client sites when required.

It would be a real bonus if you have:

* Production Rust experience, or experience with another systems/strongly typed language such as C++, Haskell, OCaml or Scala.
* Experience in wealth or asset management technology, including investment performance, portfolio construction/rebalancing, or tax, accounting and other rule-heavy financial software.
* Experience with AWS serverless and event-driven architecture, particularly Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, S3 and API Gateway, or related distributed-systems technologies.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering, client-facing product development, research or open-source software.

  
**Additional Information**

This role includes onboarding with the existing team in Zurich, regular travel to Switzerland and occasional travel to client sites.

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.

In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self.

We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.

### **Overview**

The Georgia Tech Research Institute (GTRI) is the nonprofit, applied research division of the Georgia Institute of Technology (Georgia Tech). Founded in 1934 as the Engineering Experiment Station, GTRI has grown to more than 2,900 employees, supporting eight laboratories in over 20 locations around the country and performing more than $940 million of problem-solving research annually for government and industry. GTRI's renowned researchers combine science, engineering, economics, policy, and technical expertise to solve complex problems for the U.S. federal government, state, and industry.

### **Georgia Tech's Mission and Values**

Georgia Tech's mission is to develop leaders who advance technology and improve the human condition. The Institute has nine key values that are foundational to everything we do:

1. Students are our top priority.
  
2. We strive for excellence.
  
3. We thrive on diversity.
  
4. We celebrate collaboration.
  
5. We champion innovation.
  
6. We safeguard freedom of inquiry and expression.
  
7. We nurture the wellbeing of our community.
  
8. We act ethically.
  
9. We are responsible stewards.

Over the next decade, Georgia Tech will become an example of inclusive innovation, a leading technological research university of unmatched scale, relentlessly committed to serving the public good; breaking new ground in addressing the biggest local, national, and global challenges and opportunities of our time; making technology broadly accessible; and developing exceptional, principled leaders from all backgrounds ready to produce novel ideas and create solutions with real human impact.

### **Project/Unit Description**

The Applied Embedded Systems (AES) division of the Electronic Systems Laboratory (ELSYS) supports multiple research products and projects in concert with development teams who are building complex, multi-faceted embedded and electronic systems. AES predominantly focuses on the research, development, testing, and deployment of embedded electronic and electromechanical systems. These systems provide our sponsors with technological solutions in the fields of Electronic Warfare (EW), Radar, command and control, communications, avionics, entertainment, physiological monitoring, and other applications. This research position will support electronic hardware development needs of the Open Systems Development Branch (OSDB). This includes developing hardware from existing open standards such as OpenVPX as well as developing hardware that is driving new open standards.

### **Job Purpose**

The Embedded Software/Firmware Engineer is responsible for developing algorithms and code for real-time signal processing to include communication and data transfer between system level hardware and embedded hardware. The Embedded Software/Firmware Engineer develops designs based on embedded firmware systems, such as Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA), Digital Signal Processors (DSPs), microcontrollers/computers, Application-Specific Integrated Circuits/systems (ASICs), and or Graphics Processor Units (GPUs). These designs also require development of documentation to support future reviews of design and enhancements. This position requires extensive knowledge of development environments for Xilinx and Altera (Intel) technologies, software development and configuration skills, and computer operating systems. The Embedded Software/Firmware Engineer applies engineering principles to firmware software creation and implementation of real-time hardware interface firmware and analysis, debugging, and testing of these systems.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Design, test, and develop software packages to meet requirements and open system standards
* Develop and maintain software and scripts to support software development and processes
* Follow embedded software/firmware development processes
* Contribute to research reports, white papers, and competitive proposals

### **Additional Responsibilities**

* Firmware programming and coding, real-time hardware interface coding, and design of architecture / algorithms
* Firmware analysis for reliability and debugging and testing of firmware to meet requirements
* Follow firmware development processes and verify managed developers are following processes
* Supervise student developers
* Contribute to research reports, white paper and competitive proposals
* Contribute to the development and composition of new/updated open standards
* Participate in technical meetings with GTRI and sponsor personnel, and support issue tracking and hardware development planning
* Contribute to proposal efforts by developing white papers, RFI/RFP responses, sponsor briefs, and by proposing new research areas suitable for internal research and development (IR&D) funding
* Perform other duties as assigned.

### **Required Minimum Qualifications**

* Experience with open hardware standards (e.g. OpenVPX)
* Experience developing hardware for embedded environments, including but not limited to FPGA designs, embedded microcontroller designs, embedded Linux, RTOS implementations, etc.
* Knowledge of computer architectures as it relates to embedded hardware and communications standards, e.g., Ethernet, PCI Express

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Active Secret Clearance
* Experience with Intelligent Platform Management Interface (IPMI) or other forms of open systems management
* Experience with high-speed processing, especially signal processing
* Knowledge of avionics protocols and interfaces, including but not limited to ARINC- and VITA-standard protocols, Serial, discrete, MIL-STD-1553 and/or analog interfaces

>10%

**Levels 1, 2**

jobs.title: Flight Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
Astria is a custom heavy-lift drone that combines lift motors with a cyclorotor for lateral force. It runs our own Simulink-built controllers on PX4-based flight hardware. It flies real installs on utility lines today. You'll contribute to controller changes from idea to flight. That means modeling the vehicle, designing and tuning the controller, testing it on the stand, flying it with our pilots, and reading the logs to find out what actually happened. It's a small team, so you'll be in the shop and in the field, not just at a desk. We're an AI-driven company. AI tooling runs throughout our engineering workflow, including MATLAB and Simulink work, log analysis, and simulation.

### **About Pitch Aeronautics Inc.**

Pitch Aeronautics (www.pitchaero.com) is a rapidly growing startup creating game-changing solutions for the utility industry. Pitch has developed a drone to install our line sensor, bird diverters, and other equipment on power lines. Our drone-deployable line sensors wirelessly transmit environmental and line characteristics to an online secure API to help utilities push more power through existing lines, prevent wildfires, and improve grid reliability.

At Pitch we’ve fostered a collaborative, fun, “get-stuff-done” working environment. We believe in moving fast and creating products and prototypes rapidly. If you’re looking for a place where you can make a difference on day one, be empowered to achieve, and love working in small teams, we want to meet you!

### **Description**

**Responsibilities**

* Design, model, and tune flight controllers (attitude, position, altitude, yaw, trim) in MATLAB/Simulink and deploy them to PX4-based flight hardware.
* Build and maintain vehicle dynamics models, including the cyclorotor, and extend our simulation capability (e.g., Gazebo, SITL).
* Write test plans and run test-stand and flight tests with the drone ops crew.
* Analyze flight logs (PX4 ULog) for tracking error, motor saturation, and vibration, and build tools that make that analysis faster.
* Make the controller robust to estimator events such as EKF resets, IMU switches, and GPS dropouts.
* Characterize propulsion (thrust vs. RPM, motor and prop selection) and fold the results back into the control code.
* Develop control for aerial manipulation: precise lateral positioning, wind rejection, and contact with the conductor during sensor install and removal.
* Configure and integrate motor controllers over DroneCAN.
* Document controller design decisions and changes, manage control code in Git, and post clear updates for the team.
* Mentor technicians and interns, and work with pilots on how the aircraft feels to fly.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with a focus on controls.
* 3+ years designing and testing control systems for UAVs, aircraft, or robots, or a graduate degree with significant hands-on flight-test work.
* Strong MATLAB/Simulink skills, including code generation for embedded targets.
* Solid grounding in classical control: PID/PD design, feedforward, saturation and anti-windup, rate and jerk limiting, and frequency-domain analysis.
* Hands-on flight or hardware testing experience, including reading logs to diagnose problems.
* Python for data analysis and tooling; Git.
* Clear technical writing.
* Able to work on-site in Boise and travel occasionally for field tests and installs.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience with PX4 or ArduPilot internals (uORB, EKF2) and Pixhawk/Cube hardware.
* Multirotor or unconventional rotorcraft dynamics; cyclorotor experience is a big plus.
* Aerial manipulation or contact control.
* State estimation and sensor fusion.
* Simulation with Gazebo, SITL, or HITL.
* CAN/DroneCAN and motor controller integration.

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Senior Research Software Engineer will support the Midwestern Regional Climate Center (MRCC) and the Indiana State Climate Office (IN-SCO) as a member of their research teams. This position will help researchers use large-scale research computing systems and provide the computational tools and expertise needed to answer their research questions through the testing, development, and implementation of software applications, tools, and components. Solve computation and data problems raised by researchers. Work collaboratively with RCAC, MRCC, and IN-SCO staff, other Regional Climate Centers, campus researchers, national partners and vendors to implement novel computing and data technologies. For this R&M Engineering Analyst position, you will be responsible for lifecycle reliability and maintainability (R&M) planning, influencing design for reliability and design for maintainability, modeling and predicting R&M performance, optimizing supportability resources to achieve readiness at cost targets, operational performance assessment and improvement, and facilitation of a cross functional readiness review process as a framework to achieve reliability, maintainability, and availability goals.

Our mission-first software and data engineering platform modernizes data operations, utilizing advanced workflows, CI/CD, and secure DevSecOps practices. At Clarity, we are people-focused and set on being a destination employer for top talent, offering an environment where innovation thrives, careers grow, and individuals are valued. We are hiring a Senior Principal Platform Engineer to build and run the on-prem Kubernetes platform that teams across Clarity Innovations depend on. Half of this job is software: you will own our in-house cluster provisioning tool as a product. The other half is operations: you will keep the clusters, storage, networking and hardware underneath it healthy.

Rapid Capabilities is the product development org at Clarity Innovations, home of the Aurora Enterprise and Manifest product suites. We run lean, in Extreme Programming (XP) teams, so you will pair with engineers daily and ship in small, tested increments.

* Gather requirements from internal teams and turn them into a roadmap for the provisioning platform.

* Integrate the tool with CI/CD, observability, secrets management and access control.

* Plan, run and regularly test backup, disaster recovery and etcd maintenance.

**Manage the infrastructure underneath**

* Manage bare-metal and virtualized infrastructure, working with data center and IT teams on hardware provisioning and replacement.
* Design and maintain infrastructure across on-prem data centers and AWS / Azure, using infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi or similar) wherever possible.

**Build security in**

* Embed security and compliance into the platform: secrets management, IAM, policy-as-code and supply chain security.

* Mentor & elevate the team: coach junior/mid‑level engineers; establish best practices for requirements, modeling, integration, test, and technical writing.

Why Join?

* Mission impact: Influence systems that Sailors rely on every day; measurably improve Fleet safety and readiness.
* Technical leadership: Set architecture, lead integration/V&V, and shape milestone decisions on major Navy programs.
* Growth & collaboration: Work with seasoned engineers and prior‑service teammates; mentor others while advancing MBSE and Digital Engineering practices.

**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Systems, Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace, Computer, or related).
* 9+ years of systems engineering experience delivering complex hardware/software systems in DoD/Navy environments, including leadership of multi‑disciplinary teams.
* Experience supporting Foreign Military Sales (FMS) programs is required.
* Advanced proficiency in MBSE and SysML (e.g., Cameo/MagicDraw), DOORS/DOORS NG, and Digital Engineering methods (digital thread/twin).
* Demonstrated success owning architecture, requirements, integration, and V&V for large programs (preferably ACAT I/MDAP scale).

* Experience with modeling & simulation to support performance analysis (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink, Python) and test planning.
* Exceptional communication skills for technical briefs, stakeholder engagement, and decision support.
* Clearance: Interim Secret required to start; ability to obtain/maintain Secret
* Travel: 10% (including OCONUS).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior‑service U.S. Navy experience or direct NAVAIR/NAVSEA systems/test engineering background.
* Domain exposure to AAG, EMALS, ALRE, shipboard control systems, high‑energy/linear motor drives, power conversion/distribution, and motion control.
* Experience with Operational Test & Evaluation (OTF), interoperability testing, and Fleet exercises; familiarity with OTR/OTD.

Why Join

Technical leadership: Set architecture, lead integration/V&V, and shape milestone decisions on major Navy programs.

jobs.title: Senior Principal Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today's five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a Principal Systems Engineer to join our growing team in Lanham, MD. This is a senior technical leadership role with system-level authority across multiple programs: owning system architecture, setting technical direction, resolving the most complex cross-cutting issues, and developing the next generation of systems engineering leads.

The ideal candidate brings a record of leading systems engineering on complex space or comparable programs from concept through launch and operations, is trusted by executives, customers, and engineers alike, and thrives in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment where no two days look the same.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the technical authority for systems engineering across multiple programs, owning system architecture and technical direction from concept through verification, validation, launch, and on-orbit operations.
* Define and own system architectures and mission concepts, leading trade studies and making and defending key technical decisions in response to customer and internal needs.
* Establish top-level system requirements and govern their allocation, flow-down, and interface control across subsystems, suppliers, and organizations.
* Own technical budgets and margin philosophy (mass, power, link, thermal, schedule) at the program and constellation level, and ensure rigorous tracking across subsystems.
* Drive system-level integration across engineering disciplines (RF, software, mechanical, electrical, GNC, operations) and lead resolution of the most complex cross-cutting technical issues and anomalies.
* Provide technical leadership for proposal and business development efforts, including solution architecture, basis-of-estimate development, and cost/schedule inputs, and represent AST in technical engagements with customers and government partners.
* Serve as senior technical lead for major design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR) and technical interchange meetings (TIMs), presenting to executive leadership, customers, and independent review boards.
* Lead technical risk management: identify and quantify top program and technical risks, drive mitigation, and advise leadership on risk-informed decisions.
* Define and evolve systems engineering processes, standards, practices, and drive their adoption across the organization.
* Mentor and develop SE leads and engineers, serve as a technical coach across the department, and contribute to hiring and talent growth.
  

**Qualifications**

**Education:**

Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field required; Master's degree or PhD strongly preferred

**Experience:**

A minimum of 12 years of systems engineering experience, with at least 5 years serving as SE Lead, Chief Engineer, or equivalent on a program of record or flight program, including end-to-end lifecycle experience on at least one program through launch and on-orbit operations

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in a relevant engineering discipline.
* Experience in space, satellite, or defense programs, ideally satellite communications, phased array, or RF payload systems.
* Experience establishing or leading SE practices and configuration control processes at the program or organizational level.

**Soft Skills:**

* Proven ability to lead and influence without direct authority across cross-functional teams and at the executive level.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including ability to brief and build trust with executive, customer, and government audiences.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity: able to define the path forward and make sound decisions when requirements are incomplete or roles are fluid.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, with the judgment to balance technical rigor against schedule and cost.
* Ability to manage multiple competing priorities across programs in a dynamic, fast-moving environment.
* Demonstrated mentor who builds technical talent and raises the bar for the team.
* Self-starter who takes ownership and drives issues to closure without close supervision.

**Technology Stack:**

* Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) for documentation, analysis, and reporting.
* Requirements management tools: DOORS, Jama, or equivalent, with experience defining requirements management practices.
* MATLAB / Simulink for analysis and trade studies (preferred).
* Confluence and Jira for program tracking and collaboration.
* STK (Systems Tool Kit) for mission analysis (preferred).

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to work in a standard office environment and use a computer for extended periods.
* Occasional travel to other AST SpaceMobile facilities or customer/government sites (up to 20%).

*This job description may not be inclusive to the duties and responsibilities listed. Additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time or the scope of the job may change as needed by business demands**.*

Category: Engineering

Job ID: R29291

Brand: Bose Corporation, U.S.A

widget: Full time

**Description**
---------------

At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. Privately owned, fiercely customer-focused, and driven by our values, we continue to lead industries and transform lives through sound.

===================

The audio engineering team is seeking a senior software engineer to lead the development of the tools, frameworks, and infrastructure that enable our acoustics, DSP, and embedded engineering teams to create next-generation audio products.

This role combines software architecture, audio technology, embedded systems, and engineering productivity. You will partner with technical experts across acoustics, signal processing, controls, and embedded systems to build scalable solutions that accelerate research, prototyping, algorithm development, and product realization.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Architect and develop software platforms for audio measurement, signal analysis, algorithm development, rapid prototyping, and system characterization.
* Lead the design of frameworks that connect desktop engineering environments with DSPs, embedded processors, audio SoCs, measurement systems, and prototype hardware.
* Drive the evolution of engineering tools, APIs, automation workflows, and visualization environments used across multiple product and technology teams.
* Enable efficient interaction with embedded systems through hardware-control, communication, and digital-audio interfaces.
* Partner closely with engineers to understand workflow challenges, develop solutions, and improve development velocity and experimentation efficiency.
* Provide technical leadership in software architecture, development practices, testing, deployment, and long-term maintainability.

**Required Qualifications**

* BS/MS in Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Acoustics, DSP, or a related discipline.
* 8+ years of experience developing engineering software, technical computing applications, embedded systems, or audio/DSP solutions.
* Demonstrated programming skills in Python with experience in C/C++ development. Application knowledge of Matlab and LLM is highly desirable.
* Strong understanding of digital signal processing, real-time audio systems, and engineering measurement methodologies.
* Experience designing scalable, maintainable software architectures used by multiple teams or products. Version control (Git) and collaboration is implied.
* Experience interfacing software with embedded systems, laboratory instrumentation, or data-acquisition platforms.
* Deep knowledge of modern software-development practices including source control, automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD, packaging, and release management.

**Preferred Qualifications**

At Bose, you're inspired to be and do your best and are rewarded for your unique talents! We are a proudly independent company—driven by purpose, guided by our values, and united by a belief in the power of sound. As the world leader in audio experiences, we’re creating what’s next—pushing boundaries and delivering transformative sound experiences for people everywhere. At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is hiring a Embedded Engineering Manager to build and lead a new embedded team for a next-generation wearable. The team owns the firmware that members interact with directly on the device: how it responds to them, how it presents their data, and how it feels to use every day. It takes that firmware from early prototypes through new product introduction and into production.

This role combines technical leadership with people management. You will lead a team of full-time and contract firmware engineers and grow it as the program scales. You will take part in architecture decisions with the program's technical leads, review the team's code, and own its delivery schedule. You won't be the team's primary developer, but you will be close enough to the code to step in when it helps. You will work closely with Product, Design, Hardware, and Quality, and with the firmware teams building sensors, connectivity, and power on the same device.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own the team's planning and delivery cadence, keeping scope, dependencies, and risk visible to partners and leadership.
* Partner with Product and Design to turn member experience goals into firmware requirements that fit the hardware's memory, compute, and power budgets.

* Foster a culture of high standards, direct feedback, accountability, psychological safety, and continuous learning.

* 5+ years of embedded firmware development in C or C++, including experience as an engineering manager or team lead responsible for mentorship, feedback, and career development.

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**About the Team**

STR's Intelligence Division researches, develops, and transitions advanced analytics and machine-learning solutions for challenging national-security problems. Our team includes engineers and researchers with advanced backgrounds in engineering, computer science, mathematics, and data science who apply deep technical expertise and creativity to mission-critical challenges.

Our work spans data analysis, deep learning, and statistical methods across networking, communications, social media, text, time series, geospatial, and imagery data. We develop capabilities under constraints not typically encountered in commercial environments. U.S. Government analysts use our tools and technologies to extract, enrich, and act on intelligence information worldwide.

**The Role**

As a Lead Software Engineer, you will lead the technical execution of mission-relevant software systems that operationalize advanced analytics, machine learning, and data-processing capabilities. You will apply software and systems engineering expertise to develop scalable, secure, maintainable applications that operate in complex customer environments.

You will work with software engineers, systems engineers, researchers, and mission partners to translate customer needs into executable technical plans. You will own technical delivery for an assigned project or major subsystem, guiding architecture, implementation, integration, testing, demonstration, and transition.

**What You Will Do:**

* **Lead project execution:** Lead software development from requirements definition through implementation, integration, test, demonstration, deployment, and sustainment
* **Translate mission needs into plans:** Convert customer objectives into requirements, architectures, development plans, milestones, performance measures, and acceptance criteria
* **Lead the technical team:** Lead and mentor software engineers and collaborate with systems engineers, researchers, DevSecOps personnel, and mission partners
* **Manage technical work:** Decompose complex work into actionable tasks; manage dependencies, technical risks, interfaces, and progress toward program objectives
* **Own project architecture:** Design and oversee architectures spanning services, APIs, data pipelines, databases, ML integrations, user interfaces, and deployment infrastructure
* **Drive integration and quality:** Lead design reviews, code reviews, integration activities, testing, customer demonstrations, and release readiness; ensure reliability, security, maintainability, and performance
* **Support growth and transition:** Contribute technical content to proposals, customer engagements, and transition planning while ensuring delivered capabilities are reusable and mission relevant

**Who You Are:**

* **Education and experience:** PhD with 2+ years, MS with 6+ years, or BS with 8+ years of relevant experience in computer science, software engineering, computer engineering, or a related technical discipline
* **Clearance eligibility:** Ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret security clearance, for which U.S citizenship is needed by the U.S government
* **Technical delivery leadership:** Experience leading software development efforts or major workstreams involving applications, services, distributed systems, data platforms, or related domains
* **Systems engineering:** Experience translating customer needs into software requirements, designs, development plans, test plans, and integrated capabilities
* **Software development****:** Proficiency in one or more programming languages, such as Python, C++, Java, Go, or similar languages, with experience developing and maintaining production-quality software
* **Engineering practices:** Experience with Git, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, containers, issue tracking, documentation, and secure software-development practices
* **Communication and collaboration:** Ability to lead technical discussions, communicate risks and tradeoffs, and work effectively with customers and multidisciplinary teams

**Even Better**

* **Clearance:** Active Secret, Top Secret, or TS/SCI security clearance
* **Architecture experience:** Experience designing system or software architectures for distributed, data-intensive, real-time, cloud, on-premises, or edge systems
* **DevSecOps experience:** Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure automation, container orchestration, cloud platforms, monitoring, logging, and security tooling
* **Large codebase experience:** Experience developing software in large, multi-team code bases using collaborative engineering practices
* **Decentralized systems:** Familiarity with message queues, stream processing, distributed computing, or microservices
* **Customer and capture support:** Experience supporting technical proposals, customer demonstrations, technical briefings, or capture activities with DoW or IC customers
* **Modern development tools:** Experience using LLM-enabled development tools, such as Cursor or Codex, in a secure and effective engineering workflow

**Pay Information**  
Full-Time Salary Range: $180,000 - $230,000

STR is a growing technology company with locations near Boston, MA, Arlington, VA, near Dayton, OH, Melbourne, FL, Carlsbad, CA, Atlanta, GA, and Denver, CO. We specialize in advanced research and development for defense, intelligence, and national security in: cyber; next generation sensors, radar, sonar, communications, and electronic warfare; and artificial intelligence algorithms and analytics to make sense of the complexity that is exploding around us.

jobs.title: Senior Sensor Electronics Engineer
jobs.description:
**Overview:**

Draper is an independent, nonprofit research and development company headquartered in Cambridge, MA. The 2,000+ employees of Draper tackle important national challenges with a promise of delivering successful and usable solutions. From military defense and space exploration to biomedical engineering, lives often depend on the solutions we provide. Our multidisciplinary teams of engineers and scientists work in a collaborative environment that inspires the cross-fertilization of ideas necessary for true innovation. For more information about Draper, visit www.draper.com.

**Job Description Summary:**

A Senior Sensor Electronics Engineer designs, specifies, develops, and tests analog electronics for a wide array of applications, such as analog front ends, signal conditioning, analog-to-digital conversion, radiation hardened designs, motor controllers, low noise power conditioning for precision instrumentation, and precision feedback systems. The engineer develops the architecture, designs these circuits, performs simulations, implements the physical layout, verifies and tests designs. They also perform a variety of engineering activities throughout the life cycle to support planning, design, test, deployment, and sustainment.

**Job Description**

**The Team:**

Embedded Platform System & Infrastructure (EPSI) is a production level group that supports the definition, design, and development of all embedded controllers related to vehicle mechatronics. The Low Voltage Infrastructure (LVI) organization within EPSI is focused on the development of controls & diagnostic software centered around on-vehicle low voltage power generation, energy storage, power management, and distribution.

  
  

**The Role:**

This **Senior Controls Software Engineer** role is paramount to the successful review, development, simplification, integration and release of VIP (Vehicle Interface Platform) and SDV2.0 architectures controller software. There is no better time to join this domain as we evolve to the next generation of low voltage power strategy, innovation, and capability for EVs, ICE and every product GM has to offer!

  

We are seeking creative, highly motivated, agile thinkers with passion and expertise in embedded controls. The selected candidate will learn, modify existing and develop new innovative controls strategies, which will be at the core of all vehicles within the General Motors portfolio and essential to keeping General Motors at the forefront of low voltage related technologies.

**What You'll Do (Responsibilities):**

* Lead development and implementation of controls development for complex low voltage related features in embedded C and C++. Proficiency in both is vital as this role will be centered around improvements, best practices institution, code efficiency, vulnerability surface mitigation and addressing feature to feature interference.
* Research and develop novel solutions to controls challenges.
* Contribute to ART Feature and user story elaboration into individual work items. Contribute to ensuring that definition of done and acceptance criteria are well defined
* Provide information as required to calibration procedures.
* Ensure compliance to safety and governmental regulations while following GM-internal best practices.
* Work cross-functionally with System Engineers, other Software Engineers, Architects, Calibrators, Scrum Managers and Scrum Leaders to ensure robust design.
* Collaborate with other team members to define and integrate components, check functionality on the bench and in the vehicle.
* Design and manage key strategic interfaces within deliverables to enable component reuse and consistency to standard methodologies.
* Lead and support other specialists in root cause analysis and resolution of issues related to the low voltage electric power domain.
* Verify functional performance of controls designs through testing (Unit, HIL, SIL, Vehicle), data analysis, and verification of acceptance criteria.
* Document Intellectual Property.
* Participate in the relevant team and program events: Program Increment Planning, DSU (Daily Stand Up), iteration reviews, ART inspection and adapt sessions etc.
* Build the capability of the team through mentorship, creation of training material, development of tools, etc.
Identify opportunities and drive improvement initiatives through to completion for process, workflow, and strategic changes.  

  
  

**Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications):**

* Bachelors degree (or higher) in Engineering, Computer Science, or relevant discipline.
* 5+ years Engineering experience related to embedded controls, calibration, integration, or software development.
* Skilled with software development in C, C++, and/or Python.
* Understanding of embedded controls development and delivery processes, including SAFE/Agile.
* Experience using embedded controls test assets (SIL, HIL, Vehicle, etc) and tools (INCA, MDA, etc).
* Expert capability to capture and analyze data to verify system and feature performance.
Proficiency with control system theory and application to embedded systems including state space feedback control, adaptive control, and model predictive control (or equivalent).  

  
  

**People Skills:**

* Strong partnership and teamwork skills, with demonstrated ability to learn from and share knowledge cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment with sometimes incomplete requirements.
* Analytical problem-solving skills where problems are unusual and difficult.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex projects and assignments with autonomy and accountability for results.
Consistent demonstration of innovative thinking that is customer-centric.  

  
  

**What Will Give You A Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications):**

* Masters in Engineering with focus on controls or Software Engineering.
* In-depth knowledge of automotive low voltage systems and hardware components.
* Strong understanding of low voltage controls features, software, and calibration.
* DFSS Black Belt.
* Record of invention: patents, awards, or publications.
Experience with safety critical design.

* Job Type: Full time
* Work Type: Hybrid

In this position...

* Author and manage interface definitions for the functions you define, including CAN and Ethernet signal definitions

jobs.title: SR Industrial Robotics Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you looking to join a dynamic team that provides its people with the tools to be successfull and opportunities to grow?
  
Universal Logistics is a leading provider of customized transportation and logistics solutions, offering a comprehensive suite of services including transportation, value-added, intermodal, and specialized services utilized throughout entire supply chains.
  
Universal has immediate career opportunities in your area. Apply today to become part of the Universal team!

**Position Description**
------------------------

The Industrial Robotics Engineer will be based in Warren, MI and will develop, engineer, and launch industrial and collaborative robotic automation across Universal Logistics operations and customer facilities.

This role focuses on robotic applications including material handling, sequencing, kitting, palletizing, depalletizing, machine tending, packaging, and other automation solutions designed to improve safety, quality, productivity, ergonomics, and process consistency.

  

The Industrial Robotics Engineer will serve as a hands-on manufacturing and automation engineer and project owner. This position will work with robotic cells, end-of-arm tooling, machine vision, controls, safety systems, equipment suppliers, customers, and cross-functional teams to take projects from concept and process development through build, commissioning, production ramp-up, and final handoff to operations.

  

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop industrial and collaborative robotic concepts and manufacturing processes.
* Conduct feasibility, cycle-time, capacity, layout, ergonomic, process-flow, and technical trade-off studies to determine the appropriate automation solution.
* Define technical requirements, RFQs, and Statements of Work (SOWs) for robotic cells, including: Robot selection End-of-arm tooling Fixtures Machine vision Sensors Guarding and safety devices Controls Conveyance Equipment interfaces
* Manage automation projects with system integrators and equipment suppliers from concept and design through build, FAT, installation, SAT, commissioning, and production ramp-up.
* Manage project timing, cost, scope, risks, and technical deliverables.
* Serve as the engineering interface between customers and cross-functional teams, including Operations, Controls, IT, Safety, Quality, Maintenance, and Facilities.
* Lead design reviews, process reviews, FMEA activities, risk assessments, and site-readiness planning.
* Support robot and cobot programming, PLC/HMI integration, machine vision, sensors, and end-of-arm tooling.
* Troubleshoot and debug equipment while validating safety, quality, cycle time, throughput, uptime, process capability, and production readiness.
* Develop acceptance criteria, operating standards, training, spare-parts requirements, preventive-maintenance requirements, and lessons learned.
Complete formal project handoffs to Operations and help standardize successful automation designs for future applications.  

  

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Manufacturing, Industrial, Mechatronics, Robotics Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related technical field.
* 2+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, automation engineering, robotics integration, controls, or equipment launch within a manufacturing, warehousing, or logistics environment.
* Working knowledge of industrial and/or collaborative robots, end-of-arm tooling, PLC/controls, machine vision, sensors, safety systems, and integrated robotic cells.
* Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, electrical schematics, layouts, and technical specifications.
* Experience with cycle-time analysis, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and project coordination.
* Ability to manage suppliers, schedules, technical deliverables, and launch-related issues.
Willingness to travel and support non-standard hours during critical installation, commissioning, and production launch periods.  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong self-starter with a manufacturing engineering mindset and the ability to independently own projects, work directly with customers, coordinate cross-functional teams, and drive technical issues to resolution.
* Hands-on experience with industrial robot or cobot platforms such as FANUC, ABB, KUKA, Yaskawa, Universal Robots, or similar systems, including programming, simulation, or commissioning.
* Experience with Allen-Bradley/Rockwell PLCs and HMIs, safety PLCs, industrial networking, servo systems, and robotic equipment integration.
* Experience with machine vision, force/torque sensing, grippers, vacuum tooling, fixtures, quick-change tooling, and other end-of-arm tooling technologies.
* Understanding of industrial and collaborative robot safety requirements, machine guarding, risk assessments, lockout/tagout, and applicable ANSI/RIA and ISO standards.
* Experience with AutoCAD, SolidWorks, robot simulation, virtual commissioning, FAT/SAT, run-at-rate validation, Lean/Six Sigma, automotive manufacturing, or other high-volume production environments.

* Data Analysis: Advanced understanding of data analysis methods, including statistical analysis, correlation, and trend identification. Capable of using data to inform decisions and optimize moderately complex control systems.
* Control Systems Tools & Hardware: Advanced proficiency in controls engineering tools and hardware, including PLC programming, HMI/SCADA, motion controllers, torque drivers, vision systems, and edge devices, with the ability to apply them to moderately complex systems.

**Other Qualifications:**

* 4 Year Bachelors BS degree and 4+ years equivalent experience

Energy Management oversees the reliable, safe and efficient operation of mechanical, electrical, and civil utilities systems in approximately 250 buildings on the Twin Cities campus. Home to the University’s technical and professional engineering staff, as well as a select group of skilled tradespeople, the group maintains the campus utility infrastructure and provides technical and engineering expertise to the U’s Capital Planning, Facilities Management building operations, and other facilities-related units across the U of M system. The Twin Cities campus has a total electric utility budget of approximately $51M per year. The system includes more than twelve miles of underground steam tunnels and four high voltage (13,800 Volt) switch stations. The Utility Operations group manages and maintains this complex infrastructure, as well as overseeing storm water management, sanitary sewer systems, municipal water distribution, chilled water distribution, steam and condensate, and compressed air systems.  
  
This position provides engineering support under the guidance of the Assistant Director of Maintenance and Operations and reporting directly to the Assistant Director of Facilities Engineering and Energy Efficiency. The position provides engineering technical support of air handler preventative maintenance programs; development of documentation and protocol for Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC) systems, and supports a team of trades in maintenance of these specific systems under a narrow-focused program of revitalizing the university HVAC systems and preventative maintenance. Develop and document Building Automation System control strategies for optimizing system performance. Recommend changes to operating procedures, maintenance strategies and repair plans based upon on-site investigations. Work with district engineering groups to develop energy efficiency programs that can be submitted for rebates through utility programs.

* Provide technical support to work teams responsible for repair, maintenance, and operations of building, facilities, and physical infrastructure.
* Gather data to analyze building, facility, and physical infrastructure problems and coordinate the review.
* Review HVAC system design, design intent, and existing protocol within the building automation system and building drawings. Develop updates to design and control documentation.
* Develop specific preventative maintenance protocol for operations staff. Review existing PM documentation and make recommendations (steps to follow, duration of PM, frequency, etc).

Energy Efficiency & Conservation (25%)

* Identify energy efficiency opportunities on HVAC systems and make recommendations to district energy engineers.
* Make recommendations and implement changes to Building Automation System controls for efficient operation.
* Make recommendations and implement changes to building mechanical systems for efficient operation of facilities.
