jobs.title: Lights Out Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
At the interface of design, engineering and supply logistics, REHAU Automotive and SRG Global combine to form RESRG - a leading global supplier of coated exterior systems and components. With a combined track record of over 160 years across four continents and 22 production sites, RESRG's 10,000 skilled team members manufacture the latest exterior systems and components for the world's leading automotive manufacturers.
  
  
We are looking for you to join our team as a Lights Out Automation Engineer at our Portageville, Missouri facility!
  
  
Your Job
  
You will help create one of the most advanced manufacturing operations in North America.
  
This is an opportunity to help define and deploy the next generation of manufacturing where robotics, AI, machine vision, autonomous material flow, advanced controls, and digital technologies work together to enable increasing levels of autonomous production and ultimately support our Lights-Out Manufacturing roadmap.
  
As part of RESRG's Operations Transformation team, you will lead the design, programming, deployment, and optimization of robotic and automation systems that directly advance our lights-out strategy. You will help transform Portageville into a showcase facility where innovative automation technologies deliver new levels of safety, quality, productivity, and operational excellence.
  
If you are passionate about robotics, enjoy solving difficult engineering challenges, and want to build technology that changes how factories operate, we want to hear from you.
  
  
What You Will Do in Your Role
  

* Design, build, program, commission, and optimize advanced robotic manufacturing systems.
* Develop next-generation automation solutions supporting our Lights-Out Manufacturing vision.
* Program and integrate industrial robots, PLCs, HMIs, servos, drives, and motion control systems.
* Implement advanced machine vision and AI-driven inspection technologies.
* Develop autonomous material handling solutions utilizing AGVs, AMRs, and intelligent logistics systems.
* Lead automation projects from concept through production launch.
* Partner with plant operations, maintenance, quality, and manufacturing engineering teams to identify and execute high-impact automation opportunities.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and help shape the future automation roadmap for Portageville and other RESRG facilities.
* Troubleshoot complex system issues and continuously improve equipment performance, reliability, and OEE.
* Contribute to new standards, automation architectures, and best practices that will be replicated across the enterprise.
* Serve as a technical leader for robotics and controls initiatives that accelerate OAMI advancement.

Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)
  

* BS/MS in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics Engineering, or related field.
* 3+ years of experience implementing industrial automation systems.
* Strong hands-on experience programming industrial robots and PLC-based control systems.
* Experience integrating vision systems, sensors, drives, and automation components.
* Ability to lead projects from concept through startup and production stabilization.
* Strong troubleshooting skills and a passion for continuous improvement.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

What Will Put You Ahead
  

* FANUC robot programming and vision experience.
* Allen-Bradley Studio 5000, ControlLogix, FactoryTalk, and PowerFlex expertise.
* Experience with AI-enabled inspection systems.
* Experience with AGVs, AMRs, autonomous logistics, or warehouse automation.
* Automation simulation and digital twin experience.
* Experience commissioning highly automated manufacturing cells or production lines.
* Automotive manufacturing experience.
* Knowledge of Industry 4.0, IIoT, MES integration, and smart factory technologies.

Join the Team Building the Future
  
At RESRG Automotive, we believe the next generation of manufacturing will be defined by intelligent automation, digital connectivity, and autonomous operation. If you're excited by the challenge of helping build a Lights-Out Manufacturing environment and advancing one of the industry's most aggressive automation roadmaps, Portageville is where you can make your mark.
  
About the Company
  
We are a fast-growing global manufacturer with a strong internal culture that values respect, diversity, and purposeful work. We offer career paths that enable professional growth, a team-focused environment, and a commitment to safety and wellness.
  
Our Benefits
  
Our goal is for each employee and their family to live fulfilling and healthy lives. Our benefits package includes medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, AD&D, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, paid parental leave, and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description. Speak to your recruiter for details on benefits that apply to you.
  
Equal Opportunities
  
Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. Except where prohibited by state law, some offers of employment are conditioned upon successfully passing a drug test. This employer uses E-Verify.

* Experience developing firmware for microcontroller-, SoC-, or DSP-based embedded systems.

Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical designs, decisions, and test results.

jobs.title: Staff Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Description:

**Job Summary:**

The Staff Platform Engineer sets the technical direction for the platform and solves infrastructure problems that span teams. The role stays hands-on — writing and reviewing infrastructure code and operating production systems — but most of its impact comes from shaping how the whole engineering organization builds, deploys, and runs software, without formal management authority. Staff engineers may also serve as a team's Tech Lead, a role that carries no change in title, band, or bonus.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Regularly audit and evaluate the platform's architecture, and lead the design and delivery of major
* architectural changes across teams on an annual basis.
* Write technical proposals for those changes and build agreement on them with product and engineering
* stakeholders.
* Set org-wide standards for infrastructure patterns, delivery practices, tooling, and technology choices.
* Partner with Buyer and Cargo engineering leadership so the platform supports what their teams need to build
* next.
* Define observability, reliability, and incident standards, and take on the hardest production problems: systemic
* bottlenecks, performance crises, and failures under heavy contention.
* Plan and carry out large migrations, such as database moves, network re-architecture, and project
* restructuring, without disrupting live auctions.
* Own the platform's security, cost, and capacity strategy.
* Mentor senior engineers and act as a force multiplier, influencing direction without formal authority.

Requirements:

**Qualifications / Requirements:**

* **Autonomy:** Leads strategy — defines technical direction without day-to-day oversight.
* **Technical Depth:** Visionary — deep expertise with the ability to see and shape the broader technical landscape.
* **Leadership Impact:** Force multiplier and system architect — makes entire teams more effective.
* **Business Impact:** Strategic — future-proofs systems and drives technical decisions that enable business growth.
* **Experience:** 7-10+ years of professional engineering experience, with a demonstrated record of infrastructure or platform impact across teams.
* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Advanced study in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline (Master's or equivalent graduate-level work) is a strong differentiator at this level.

**Technical Skills**

* **Languages:** Expert-level proficiency in TypeScript and strong proficiency in Go or Python.
* **Infrastructure as Code:** Sets standards for infrastructure as code — state management, resource lifecycle, refactoring and aliasing, and reusable component design. Pulumi in TypeScript is a strong plus.
* **Cloud:** GCP architecture expertise — designs for reliability, cost efficiency, and scale across GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub, and BigQuery.
* **Networking:** Network architecture expertise — multi-project VPC design, private service connectivity, load balancing, mTLS, and traffic management.
* **Databases:** Deep expertise in operating MySQL, PostgreSQL, and distributed SQL — replication, connection pooling, schema evolution at scale, and zero-downtime migrations.
* **Observability:** Designs and owns observability strategy — alerting, SLOs/SLAs, and distributed tracing.
* **Security:** Understands security at the architecture level — auth patterns, secrets management, network security, IAM, and defending against abusive traffic.
* **Technical Fundamentals:** Expert-level distributed systems knowledge — consensus, replication strategies, concurrency control under write contention, exactly-once semantics, and fault-tolerant design; OS and runtime internals relevant to performance (GC behavior, syscall overhead, context switching); systems design fluency — can decompose and reason about large-scale distributed architectures from first principles.

**Nice to Have**

* Temporal or other durable workflow orchestration.
* CockroachDB, PgBouncer, or large-scale database migration and replication.
* Cloud Armor, WAF, or bot-mitigation experience.
* Vertex AI or other ML serving infrastructure.
* Experience architecting systems with heavy write contention, such as many users acting on the same records at once in bidding, inventory, or payments.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Ability to remain seated or stationary for extended periods while working at a computer.
* Frequent use of hands and fingers for typing, mouse use, and other computer-related tasks.
* Ability to communicate effectively in person, by phone, and through electronic communication.
* Ability to occasionally stand, walk, bend, reach, or move about the office.
* Ability to occasionally lift and carry office equipment or materials up to 10–15 pounds.
* Visual ability sufficient to read computer screens, documents, and other work-related materials.
* Ability to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.

Working independently under limited supervision, performing highly complex and specialized software project activities. Can function as a leader on project teams and may oversee other engineers. * Complete software design and development documents in compliance with Laborie QMS, ISO and other relevant standards.
* Work with the Software Test Team to develop test methods/cases, unit testing and/or V&V pass criteria and where viable assist with the development of automated test scripts.
* Design modular software that is flexible and appropriate to a growing, multi-year program. Anticipate the software needs of future products and extensions.
* Manages assigned work items according to provided priorities.
* Maintains high standards of software quality by closely following the department's Quality Plan.
* Estimates progress and reports on status of assigned projects.

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science and/or equivalent and 10+ years of experience.
* Solid track record of designing and developing production ready software, knowledge of software implementation best practices and deployment strategies
* Practical programming experience developing software (at least one modern OO language) for a medical device (IEC 62304).
* Experience with unit- and integration-level testing and automated testing is recommended.
* Experience in the following areas:
* C#/.NET/ SQL/Entity Framework/ADT/WPF/WCF/Unit Testing (NUnit, Moq)

* Ability to quickly learn new technology and apply knowledge to solve technical and business problems.

* Strong technical writing capability and excellent oral communication skills.
* Motivated self-starter with the ability to determine when to act and when to ask for support.
* Ability to work both independently and within a team in a fast-paced, changing environment.

Our Mission every day is to operate as a world-class specialist medical company making and advancing technologies that preserve and restore human dignity. jobs.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Description**  
We put our customers first – exemplified by our mission: “We Protect Those Who Protect Us®."
  
  
Our employees work on the world’s most advanced electronics. Spanning air, land, sea, and space, we are developing the technology of tomorrow, delivered today. Drawing strength from our differences, we’re innovating for the future. And you can, too.
  
  
Are you a Software Engineer with 8 to 20+ years of experience looking for the next step to grow your career? Do you want to design and write software that really matters and be a part of a cause greater than yourself? Then, help us protect those that protect us by developing next generation electronic systems products and solutions. We need your talent, motivation, and vision to join our growing team in Wayne, New Jersey.
  
  
BAE Systems is seeking a talented Principal level Software Engineer to help us create the world’s most advanced solutions in Communications, Navigation and Electronic Warfare for our defense related customers.
  
  
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Software Engineer to be a key contributor to the development, integration, and deployment of complex software systems essential to national security. You will operate as a hands-on engineer, guiding software engineering teams, resolve challenging issues, and serve as a trusted technical interface with both internal stakeholders and our customers. You will be empowered to influence technical direction and drive innovation within a collaborative and fast-paced program environment.
  
  
BAE Systems offers competitive pay, benefits, and important work-life balance initiatives including every other Friday Off and Flextime. BAE also believes in a culture of recognition for the extraordinary contributions of our skilled employees.
  
  
Because this role involves a combination of collaborative/in-person and independent work, it will take the form of a hybrid work format, with time split between working onsite and remotely.  
  
  
  
**Required Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* Bachelor’s Degree (or higher) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field and a minimum of 8+ years work experience.
* Background in embedded and/or application software development in C++
* Foundation in Object-Oriented design and implementation principles
* Experience performing software testing, validation, and verification activities
* Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership and guide engineering teams
* Has experience with Agile Development
* Has experience with source code control systems, such as Git.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, and strong presentation skills.
* Must be eligible for a US DoD security clearance
  

  
  
**Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* Experience with signal processing techniques and filtering algorithms
* Knowledge of Linux-based development and deployment environments
* Experience with DevSecOps
* Experience with Containers including Docker and Kubernetes
* Experience with scripting languages and development of automation
* Experience developing Defense, Aerospace, Military or Mission-Critical systems
* Experience integrating software across distributed, networked, embedded or real-time computing environments
* Experience working directly with Government or Defense Industry customers
  

  
  
**Pay Information**
  
Full-Time Salary Range: $145049 - $246584
  
  
Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.
  
  
Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.  
  
  
  
**About BAE Systems, Inc.**
  
BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.
  
  
Our culture is performance-driven and values-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters.

------------------------------

  

We are seeking a Configuration Management (CM) Architect to help shape the future of digital engineering across the 02232 ND CM Department. In this role, you will work at the systems level to strengthen the strategies, business processes, tools, and data structures that enable effective configuration management for complex, mission-critical programs.

You will partner with Systems and Product Realization teams to ensure they have the methods, infrastructure, and guidance needed to meet requirements, maintain technical integrity, and execute successfully. Your work will support department and enterprise efforts related to modernization, stockpile sustainment, shared components, and PRIDE, with an emphasis on common digital workflows, improved collaboration, and advancing digital thread capabilities across sites.

This role requires broad knowledge of engineering data architectures, change control, high-fidelity technical data packages, the ND systems lifecycle, and the Phase X/6.x process, including associated milestones and deliverables. You will apply that knowledge to develop scalable, practical solutions that improve consistency, compliance, and coordination across programs.

On any given day, you may be called on to:

* Serve as the department-level CM architect and facilitator, partnering with internal and external stakeholders to guide strategic CM initiatives.
* Provide leadership across ND programs and within the 02232 department by aligning CM Leads on decisions, requirements flow-down, implementation strategies, and deliverables.
* Architect scalable CM solutions, data flows, and business processes that strengthen traceability, data integrity, and digital thread implementation across modernization efforts.
* Advise on CM-related federal and corporate requirements, including DPBPS, RPSS, and LPS, to improve consistency, compliance, and overall CM capability.
* Support PRIDE and related initiatives by developing and implementing digital business process architectures, models, and approaches that accelerate product realization.
* Partner with engineering, project management, and test/qualification teams to strengthen CM practices that support program execution and digital engineering objectives.
* Define and improve CM processes, tools, and program plans to create a more consistent framework across programs.
* Guide the use and enhancement of CM and digital engineering tools to reduce redundant effort and strengthen data quality across authoritative sources.
* Support product and requirements data management by helping teams use product structures, maintain clear sources of truth, and improve information continuity across modernization programs.
* Improve review readiness, requirements management, engineering authorization approaches, and related practices that support model-based product definition and effective configuration control.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
At Skip-Line, your next circuit will hit the highway.

**Smart sensors. Embedded systems. Machines that move. An industry ready for its next big leap.** If that sounds more exciting than designing another gadget destined for a drawer, keep reading.

At Skip-Line, we build the brains behind modern pavement marking equipment. Our electronic controls, sensors, and embedded software turn paint trucks into autonomous precision machines that mark highways, roads, and runways smarter, with less waste and better data.

We’re the leading technology company in an industry most people drive past without thinking about. Look closer: there’s real-time control, laser sensing, connected hardware, and a whole lot of engineering between “put paint on pavement” and “get it right at speed.” And we’re hiring a collaborative, passionate, Electrical Engineer to help build what’s next.

**Job Location:** Adams Center, NY\* *(see details below)*

* *Must reside in Northern or Central New York regions with the ability to commute to our office on a hybrid schedule.*

**Base Salary:** $78,000 - $135,000, based on experience and demonstrated capabilities.

**What You’ll Do:**

You’ll design, build, and test (or sometimes break on purpose) the electronics behind our next generation of hardware. You’ll work side by side with our embedded, product, and production teams. Here’s what that involves:

* **Design the electronics behind smart machines:** You’ll design and build circuits, boards, and electrical interfaces for controllers, sensors, and connected pavement marking systems.
* **Board bring-up:** You’ll bring new boards to life by building prototypes, doing board bring-up, and troubleshooting with the persistence the problem requires.
* **Lead compliance testing:** You’ll plan and prepare for compliance testing, map out what our products need to pass, prep hardware for EMC/EMI testing, collaborate with outside test labs, and keep at it until we pass.
* **Make hardware and software play nicely:** You’ll collaborate with embedded engineers to investigate system behavior and solve problems across the hardware/firmware seam.
* **Make the call.** You’ll evaluate compliance requirements, recommend practical priorities, and explain the tradeoffs between design changes, testing, cost, and ship dates; know when to make a decision independently and when to bring in the right expertise.
* **Make the next build better.** You’ll partner with production teams on testability, component choices, and troubleshooting, so every new board is easier to make, test, and fix.

**A great design earns its place on the truck.** Through compliance testing, you’ll help build equipment crews can trust and products ready for market.

**What You Bring:**

* A Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
* Hands-on PCB design and board bring-up experience.
* Compliance testing: Hands-on EMC/EMI experience, including prepping products for testing, working with outside labs, and turning failed results into design fixes is a must-have.
* Working knowledge of microcontrollers, sensors, and communication protocols like CAN.
* Comfort reading schematics, working with electronic components, and using tools such as oscilloscopes and multimeters.
* A methodical debugging habit: gather evidence, isolate the cause, fix it, and verify the fix.
* Ownership, sound judgment, and clear communication.

**Big plus:** Real EMC/EMI compliance experience. You’ve been to the test lab, failed a scan and figured out why.

**Never been near a paint truck? No problem. Bring your engineering curiosity. We’ll introduce you to the trucks.**

**Why Skip-Line?**

* **Real technology. Visible impact.** Our lineup spans precision striping controls, cloud-connected data logging, and laser-based material monitoring. Your work helps crews do a difficult job better.
* **A tight team where your ideas ship.** You won’t be a cog. You’ll decide what technology goes on paint trucks, challenge assumptions, and help shape better products with an innovative, collaborative team.
* **Modern tools, real judgment.** Use AI and modern tooling freely. Just understand the circuit and own the result.
* **Benefits that support life beyond the bench.** Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance; a 401(k) retirement with company match; paid vacation and sick time; and a paid week off at Christmas, and more.
* **Established leadership. Continuous Innovation.** We’ve been advancing pavement-marking technology since 1969. We’re not done inventing.

**Build something worth putting on the road.**

Send your resume to **hr@skipline.com** with **“Electrical Engineer — Skip-Line”** in the subject line.

**Want to stand out?** Include a few sentences about a hardware problem you solved: what went wrong, how you found it, and what you changed. A project link is welcome. **Please don’t share confidential work.**

**The road ahead needs better technology. Help us build it.**

*Skip-Line is an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment and consider applicants without regard to protected characteristics under applicable federal, state, and local law.*

jobs.title: Systems Software Engineer, Hardware Validation
jobs.description:
**Systems Software Engineer, Hardware Validation**

**About us:**

Voyant Photonics builds silicon photonic chips that steer and switch light at high speed. They power next generation, chip-scale FMCW LiDAR for robotics and autonomy, and optical circuit switches (OCS) for AI data centers. Based in NYC, we’re a hands-on team designing, building, and deploying frontier hardware to solve problems that matter, from how machines see to how AI scales.

**About the role**

Our tech stack spans FPGA and ASIC logic, microcontroller firmware, Linux drivers and cross platform user-facing APIs, and every layer changes every week. We're hiring engineers, at more than one level, to keep them integrated, tested and releasable.

**What Actually Matters**

Code is cheaper to write than ever. Knowing what should be written, and what "done" means, is the job. We want someone with strong, well-reasoned opinions about how software should be organized and how test coverage should grow, who argues for them, and who changes their mind when the evidence says so.

Things we believe in as a team:

* **Fix it at the source.** A bug gets fixed where it lives, even when that's someone else's code. The friction of working in each other's areas is worth it.
* **Live at the tip.** Every repo tracks the latest of everything it depends on. Small, frequent bumps surface breaks while they're still cheap to fix.
* **Duplicated code is broken code.** Two copies drift apart, and then one of them is wrong.
* **It doesn't work until someone else has run it on hardware.** Your own simulation or bench is where you start, not where you're done.

Disagree with one? Tell us why when you apply.

**What You'll Do**

* Own releases from commit to customer: build, verify, version and ship product bundles (FPGA bitstreams, firmware, drivers, APIs), including field updates, with release notes and runbooks people trust.
* Grow our HIL CI to cover every subsystem, and bring each new product into it from its first bring-up board.
* Track every bug CI finds to its root cause, whether that's Python, Rust, firmware, a Linux driver or FPGA logic, then fix it.
* Take our products into the systems that use them: time sync, calibration, sensor fusion, and open-source ecosystems like OCP and ROS.

**What We're Looking For**

* 2+ years of software engineering experience, or equivalent depth from research, internships or serious personal projects. We'll scale scope to experience.
* Strong Python, and comfort debugging languages you don't write every day.
* Hands-on hardware experience: bring-up, reading schematics, and using lab instruments to tell a software bug from a board bug.
* CI/CD experience, ideally against real hardware.
* Proactive communicator who cares about documentation to support cross functional team members & customers.

**Nice to Have**

* Rust, C++ or embedded C (we use STM32)
* Linux device drivers, especially SPI and custom low-level interfaces
* Reading System Verilog well enough to debug across the FPGA boundary
* HIL rigs and lab automation (SCPI/VISA, self-hosted CI runners)
* Timing and signal-integrity debug across SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet and JTAG/SWD, plus board rework
* Fiber optics and optical test equipment
* Datacenter networking, PTP, point clouds or ROS 2
* Supporting software that external customers depend on

**What You'll Gain**

* Ownership of the release and test architecture for our products, from first bring-up to shipping: real decisions, not someone else's pipeline.

jobs.title: Staff+ Software Engineer, VectorDB
jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

Anthropic is looking for a Staff+ Software Engineer to work on the vector search infrastructure behind Claude. Retrieval is how Claude learns about the world. Web search across claude.ai, the API and agentic surfaces, memory across conversations, and the reinforcement learning workloads that train our next models all depend on fast, cheap, high-recall nearest-neighbor search over billions of vectors.

You'll join a small team responsible for the vector database layer that serves Claude's retrieval workloads: its architecture, performance, scalability and cost. This is a foundational role. The team is small, core architectural decisions are still open, and the engineers who join now will shape how the system evolves.

The role sits in our Databases organization and works day to day with the Search Platform team, which owns web search indexing, retrieval and serving, and the Memory & Search team, which owns search and memory inside claude.ai.

We're looking for someone who has built vector or search systems that ran in production, at scale, with real users and a real on-call. You'll be hands-on in the code, and you'll also be the person deciding how the pieces fit together.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own the core of Anthropic's vector database layer: index structures, storage layout, query execution and the serving layer
* Own production readiness - benchmarking against exact search, capacity planning, onboarding new workloads, and the operational tooling to run it at scale
* Drive the recall, latency and cost trade-offs - quantization, filtered search, index build and refresh strategy, and how compute and storage are separated and scaled
* Scale throughput by an order of magnitude as research and training demand grows, and work out whether the bottleneck is architecture, hardware or engineering bandwidth
* Extend the retrieval stack toward hybrid retrieval - lexical search and fused ranking alongside vector search
* Set the evaluation methodology for the system - recall targets, latency objectives, cost per query, and the regression detection that keeps them honest
* Set technical direction for a growing team - lead design reviews, make architectural decisions others build on, and mentor the engineers joining the effort
* Share the on-call for the systems you own

**Minimum qualifications**
--------------------------

* Direct experience building a vector database or approximate nearest-neighbor search system that ran in production at scale
* Deep knowledge of ANN index structures (graph-based, clustering-based or disk-resident approaches), vector quantization and filtered search
* Experience with search relevance and ranking
* Strong systems programming skills in a language such as Rust, C++ or Go, including performance-critical and memory-intensive code
* Experience designing and operating large-scale distributed storage or serving systems with strict latency and reliability requirements
* A track record of independently scoping and delivering ambiguous, multi-quarter technical projects
* Strong written and verbal communication, with experience driving alignment across teams with different priorities
* Interest in AI safety and Anthropic's mission

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with object-storage-backed or disaggregated compute and storage database designs
* Experience building or operating full-text search engines (inverted indexes, BM25) or hybrid retrieval systems
* Familiarity with embedding models and the retrieval demands of LLM training and inference
* Experience using GPUs or other accelerators for index build or search
* Prior experience as a technical lead on a database or search infrastructure team

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$320,000 - $485,000 USD

**Logistics**
-------------

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

**Location-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineering Technician
jobs.description:
Join our Team as a **Electrical Engineering Technician**!

**The Role:**

Join our team as an **Electrical Engineering Technician** and put your electrical expertise to work supporting the development, integration, and testing of electric forklift systems and components.

In this hands-on role, you'll build and troubleshoot electrical harnesses, assemblies, and test fixtures while working with electrical schematics, diagnostic equipment, and prototype systems. You'll collaborate with engineering teams to solve technical challenges, support testing, and keep projects moving in an environment where priorities can shift and no two days are exactly alike.

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Read, interpret, and create electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and component layouts for test fixtures and equipment.
* Fabricate, assemble, and repair electrical wiring harnesses, power harnesses, panels, and test fixtures using proper crimping, soldering, wire routing, and assembly techniques.
* Operate electrical test equipment, including multimeters, oscilloscopes, current clamps, thermocouple loggers, strain gauges, and voltage/current data loggers.
* Troubleshoot electrical systems on electric forklifts, test fixtures, and prototype equipment using standard and specialized diagnostic tools.
* Support electrical system integration by installing, calibrating, and testing motor controllers, vehicle wiring harnesses, sensors, and other electrical components.
* Build and support test stands and fixtures used for electrical system integration and testing.
* Document testing, troubleshooting, and integration activities using Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and PTC Creo Schematics.
* Maintain laboratory equipment, tools, workbenches, and soldering stations in accordance with 5S practices and applicable safety standards.

**What We're Looking For:**

* Associate degree in Electrical/Electronic Technology or a related field, or at least two years of equivalent hands-on electrical/electronic experience.
* Hands-on electrical harness and panel fabrication skills, including wire preparation, crimping, soldering, and assembly.
* Practical understanding of low-voltage DC electrical systems and troubleshooting techniques.
* Proficiency in reading and interpreting electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, harness drawings, assembly prints, connector pinouts, PCB/PCA drawings, and component datasheets.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including fluency in English.
* Effective time management and organizational skills, with the flexibility to adapt to changing priorities.

**What Sets You Apart:**

* Familiarity with electric forklift electrical systems or similar electric vehicle technologies.
* Exposure to C, C++, Python, or similar programming languages, including scripting, embedded systems, or test automation.
* Understanding of communication protocols and interfaces such as CANopen, RS-232, RS-485, and Ethernet.
* Familiarity with electrical and manufacturing standards, including IPC/WHMA-A-620, UL 583, UL 758, UL 62, NFPA 70/NEC, and NFPA 79.

**Where and When You'll Work:**

* This is an in-person role located at our Greene, NY site —ideal for those who thrive in a hands-on, team-oriented environment.

**What Your Total Compensation & Benefits Package will look like:**

**Wage** - $27.52 - $40.33 per hour. Compensation depends on the selected candidate's education and experience.

**Relocation:** This role may be eligible for relocation assistance.

**World Class Benefits:**

* Competitive Salary
* Performance Bonus
* Generous Paid Time Off and 13 Paid Holidays
* Affordable Medical plans and no-cost Dental & Vision options
* 100% 401(k) match up to 6%
* Company-Paid Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability
* Tuition Assistance Program
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with access to mental health care, legal support, and financial guidance
* Recognition and Kaizen (continuous improvement) Reward Programs
* Meaningful opportunities for personal and professional development
* Best in class work culture!

Toyota Material Handling North America (TMHNA), the industry leader in forklift sales, comprises two main brands: Toyota Material Handling and The Raymond Corporation. We believe investing in the best people, products, and processes will fuel our future success, and we will always be driven by our foundational principles of “respect for people” and “continuous improvement”. jobs.description:
**Disney Entertainment & ESPN Technology**

On any given day at Disney Entertainment & ESPN Technology, we’re reimagining ways to create magical viewing experiences for the world’s most beloved stories while also transforming Disney’s media business for the future. Whether that’s evolving our streaming and digital products in new and immersive ways, powering worldwide advertising and distribution to maximize flexibility and efficiency, or delivering Disney’s unmatched entertainment and sports content, every day is a moment to make a difference to partners and to hundreds of millions of people around the world.

*A few reasons why we think you’d love working for Disney Entertainment & ESPN Technology*

* **Building the future of Disney’s media business:** DE&E Technologists are designing and building the infrastructure that will power Disney’s media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come.
* **Reach & Scale:** The products and platforms this group builds and operates delight millions of consumers every minute of every day – from Disney+ and Hulu, to ABC News and Entertainment, to ESPN and ESPN+, and much more.
* **Innovation:** We develop and execute groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms and enhance how audiences experience sports, entertainment & news.

We’re looking for an experienced Software Engineering Manager to lead the JavaScript-based Disney Media Player experience across web and connected-device surfaces. This team is responsible for delivering high-quality playback experiences used by millions of viewers across Disney+, Hulu, ESPN+, and ABC News, with ownership spanning playback quality, client-side performance, reliability, and operability.  
  
In this role, you will provide both technical and organizational leadership, guiding the design and evolution of a highly scalable player platform that runs across a diverse device ecosystem from web browsers to connected TVs and streaming devices. You will partner closely with Product, Design, and other platform engineering teams to align strategy, execution, and operational excellence.

The ideal candidate is a pragmatic engineering leader who creates clarity in ambiguous environments, communicates effectively with technical and non-technical partners, and build a culture grounded in accountability, inclusion, operational discipline, and continuous learning.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead and grow the JavaScript Disney Media Player engineering team through hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development.
* Own execution of the team roadmap, balancing feature delivery, technical investment, platform reliability, and operational excellence.
* Provide technical leadership for the player stack, architecture decisions, and engineering best practices in partnership with senior engineers.
* Partner closely with Product, Design, TPM, and platform teams to align priorities, manage dependencies, and deliver high-quality customer experiences.
* Foster a culture of accountability, inclusion, continuous learning, and data-driven decision making to improve playback quality, performance, and reliability across devices.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years of relevant software engineering experience, including significant experience leading and managing engineering teams.
* 5+ years of hands‑on, production experience with high-quality JavaScript and modern web application development.
* Experience building or supporting media playback technologies in web‑based or connected‑device environments.
* Experience leading teams through the full software delivery lifecycle, including development, release, and operational support of consumer‑facing applications.
* Experience owning application availability, reliability, and performance in production environments.
* Strong communication and leadership skills with a demonstrated ability to grow, mentor, and develop engineers.
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical teams, influence stakeholders, and manage cross-functional dependencies.
* Demonstrated success building inclusive, high-performing engineering teams.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Familiarity with streaming media concepts and technologies (MSE/EME, HLS, MPEG-DASH, Transport Stream, CMAF).
* Experience delivering playback or streaming video experiences at scale.
* Experience with connected TV, OTT, or streaming device platforms.
* Background partnering closely with Product, Design, and Platform teams on complex, highly visible products.
* Demonstrated success managing and supporting teams distributed across multiple time zones.
* Experience using data, metrics, or experimentation to inform technical decisions and improve user experience.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II, Backend Full Stack - IT Product
jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  
  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  
  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  
  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the IT Product Team**
-----------------------------

The IT Product Engineering team is critical to unifying Rippling's workforce management system, bridging the gap between HR and traditional IT administration. Our mission is to build software that enables businesses to manage employee devices, applications, and access security automatically, leveraging Rippling's single source of employee truth (the HRIS). We automate the complexity of IT management from the moment a new employee is hired to the moment they offboard.

### **What We Build**

We build the mission-critical software that simplifies IT for organizations, turning complex, manual processes into simple, one-click solutions. Our core product domains include:

* **Device Management (MDM):** Developing systems to securely enroll, configure, manage, and inventory corporate devices (macOS, Windows, iOS, etc.), including policy enforcement and remote wipe capabilities.
* **App Management & Identity:** Creating the centralized platform for provisioning and de-provisioning employee access to hundreds of third-party SaaS applications, ensuring instant security and compliance through integrated identity and access management (IAM).
* **Inventory & Asset Management:** Building the core financial and logistical systems to track physical assets, manage software licenses, and automate IT procurement from device ordering to deployment.
* **Security & Compliance:** Developing the mechanisms for setting, managing, and enforcing security policies across all devices and applications, ensuring employee and corporate data remain protected.

**What you will do**

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Cambridge Design Partnership is looking for a Senior Systems Engineer to operate as Technical Lead on a range of complex Electromechanical products for our clients. Working alongside a Project Manager to manage a multidisciplinary team, you will bring mechanical, electrical, firmware, and software elements together to ensure the complete product works as intended.

This is a practical, delivery-focused role. You will shape requirements and architecture, assess risks and technical options, plan integration and testing, and help resolve issues as ideas become working prototypes and production-ready designs. You should be just as comfortable discussing a design with a client as you are investigating a problem in the lab.

We are particularly interested in engineers with an electrical or mechatronics background who enjoy thinking beyond their own discipline. You will work with talented specialists across a variety of product development projects and take on technical responsibility appropriate to your experience.

**Job Duties and Responsibilities**

Systems Engineering and Product Ownership

* Take a whole-product view of development, from initial feasibility and concept selection through detailed design, integration and verification.

* Manage Technical Risk and develop effective Risk Control Measures to ensure products are safe to use and meet regulatory constraints
* Comfortable managing mechanical, electronics, firmware, software and other specialists together so that individual subsystems work as one coherent product.
* Spot technical gaps and risks early, agree priorities with the team and drive engineering issues through to resolution.

Requirements, Architecture and Interfaces

* Take the lead on defining, reviewing and maintaining system requirements, making sure they are clear, testable and linked to the needs they address.

* Take a hands-on approach to technical challenges, working with engineers to investigate unexpected behavior and find the root cause of problems.

* Manage design reviews and risk assessments, helping the team make sound decisions on performance, reliability, safety and design maturity.
* Manage DFMEA and Risk Registers, assessing risk acceptability and tracing risks through Risk Control Measures to implementation

Integration, Test and Verification

* Plan how subsystems will be brought together and tested, with clear methods and acceptance criteria for demonstrating product performance.
* Support the build and integration of electromechanical prototypes, helping diagnose issues across electronics, controls, firmware, software and mechanisms.

jobs.description:
If you’re a hardware engineer at a large defense contractor and your ideas keep getting lost in layers of approval, this role puts you one step from the CTO. At Kraken Kinetics, you’ll design, build and test the electrical systems inside safe-and-arm and fuzing systems for unmanned platforms, technology that goes directly into the hands of US warfighters.

Kraken Kinetics designs and manufactures warheads and firing systems for unmanned and autonomous weapon platforms, and gets them to production quickly. In this hands-on role, you’ll report to the Director of Engineering/CTO and work across every electrical system the team builds, taking designs from schematic through prototype, test and qualification. You’ll have real ownership of your work, a direct line to leadership, and the space to bring forward ideas and see them built.

**This Role Suits You If:**

* You want to own your designs from concept to test, not hand them off and lose sight of them
* You have ideas that aren’t being heard where you are now
* You enjoy a fast pace and a team that moves quickly from decision to action
* You want your work to make a direct difference to warfighters in the field

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Design and develop electrical systems for ESADs, fuzing and related kinetic systems, from schematic capture to PCB layout
* Own PCB design for signal integrity, power distribution and thermal management
* Build prototypes and lead testing and qualification, including environmental and stress testing
* Write and debug microcontroller firmware in C/C++
* Troubleshoot hardware and carry out root cause analysis using JTAG, oscilloscopes and bench testing
* Work with mechanical, software and systems engineers on integration, interfaces and ICDs
* Ensure designs comply with MIL-STD-1316, MIL-STD-810, MIL-STD-202 and IPC-2221

* Support assembly, testing and field deployment of prototype and production systems

**Experience Required:**

* ESAD, fuzing, safe and arm, warhead or payload experience strongly preferred; engineers from avionics, munitions test, medical devices or other high-reliability electronics will also be considered
* Analog and digital circuit design, PCB layout (Altium or similar) and embedded C/C++ for microcontrollers (Preferred)

jobs.title: Reliability Engineer- Electrical Engineering
jobs.description:
Amphenol Communications Solutions (ACS), a division of Amphenol Corporation, is a world leader in interconnect solutions for Communications, Mobile, RF, Optics, and Commercial electronics markets. Amphenol Corporation is one of the world’s largest designers and manufacturers of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor-based products and coaxial and high-speed specialty cable. ACS has an expansive global presence in research and development, manufacturing, and sales. We design and manufacture a wide range of innovative connectors as well as cable assemblies for diverse applications including server, storage, data center, mobile, RF, networking, industrial, business equipment, and automotive.

The **Reliability Engineer (Electrical Engineering)** will lead electrical reliability, signal-integrity validation, and product qualification for cable backplane assemblies used in AI and hyperscale data centers. The role will develop scalable test strategies and automated systems, characterize high-speed channels and electrical interfaces, and identify failure mechanisms under electrical and environmental stress. In partnership with design, manufacturing, quality, and external laboratories, the engineer will drive root-cause resolution and design and process improvements. This position is based in Etters, PA or Raleigh, NC. Approximately 20% travel is expected.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Develop electrical reliability and validation strategies, test plans, acceptance criteria, and coverage across the product life cycle.
* Architect and validate automated electrical test systems, fixtures, breakout boards, and loopback setups for laboratory and manufacturing use.
* Characterize signal and electrical performance using TDR, VNA, BERT, oscilloscopes, source-measure units, and related equipment.
* Evaluate channel, power, ground, shielding, continuity, resistance, and dielectric performance before, during, and after environmental and accelerated-life testing.
* Apply DOE, MSA, reliability statistics, and data analysis to ensure test capability and identify degradation trends and failure thresholds.
* Lead electrical failure analysis and document results, risks, and recommendations for design, qualification, manufacturing, and customer decisions.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical, electronics, or reliability engineering with an electrical focus; advanced degree preferred.
* 5+ years in electrical reliability, product validation, signal-integrity testing, or automated test-system development; interconnect experience preferred.
* Strong knowledge of circuit fundamentals, transmission lines, differential signaling, impedance, grounding, shielding, power integrity, and electrical failure mechanisms.
* Hands-on experience developing automated test systems, interpreting schematics and interconnect drawings, and troubleshooting intermittent or mixed-mode failures.
* Working knowledge of reliability statistics, DOE, MSA, sampling methods, data analysis, and cross-functional project execution.
* Ability to travel approximately 20% to manufacturing sites, laboratories, suppliers, and customer locations.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with high-speed serial channels, cable and connector validation, S-parameters, calibration, de-embedding, and simulation-to-measurement correlation.
* Automation experience using Python, LabVIEW, MATLAB, PLCs, or comparable control and data-acquisition tools.
* Experience with HALT, HASS, ALT, ORT, ESS, thermal cycling, vibration, and shock testing with in-situ electrical monitoring.

**Description**
===============

**Senior Mainframe Systems/Platform Engineer**
==============================================

**z/OS, CICS, MQ and zCEE**
---------------------------

  

### **Position Overview-(Remote-Onsite)**

The Senior Mainframe Platform Engineer is responsible for the engineering, health, security, resiliency, connectivity, and performance of mission-critical mainframe platforms. This position provides technical leadership across z/OS, CICS, MQ, zCEE, networking, hardware, storage, performance management, and capacity planning within a Parallel Sysplex environment.

  

The successful candidate will lead complex engineering initiatives, develop platform roadmaps, troubleshoot critical incidents, support technology modernization, and establish standards that improve platform availability, scalability, and operational efficiency. This individual will also provide technical direction, education, and mentoring to engineers, programmers, analysts, and technical support associates.

  

This can be either a remote or onsite position.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Maintain the overall health, security, resiliency, availability, connectivity, and performance of z/OS, CICS for z/OS, MQ for z/OS, and zCEE across multiple Sysplexes and central electronic complexes.
* Engineer, install, configure, customize, maintain, and support z/OS operating systems, application subsystems, independent software vendor products, and related mainframe technologies.
* Support CICS, CICSPLEX, MQ, zCEE, Workload Manager, Coupling Facility, SMF processing, DASD, hardware configurations, channels, IPL processes, storage management, and Parallel Sysplex environments.
* Design and support mainframe networking and connectivity, including TCP/IP, SNA/APPN, LU6.2, sockets, EXCI, TCP, UDP, ICMP, routing protocols, AT-TLS, IPsec, and z/VM SSL Server.
* Diagnose and resolve complex z/OS and z/VM connectivity, encryption, transmission, performance, and capacity issues.
* Execute and analyze packet traces, system dumps, traces, logs, and performance data to identify root causes and restore service.
* Lead troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for high-priority CICS, MQ, zCEE, networking, and mainframe platform incidents.
* Identify opportunities to eliminate recurring issues, reduce mean time to recovery, and improve monitoring, automation, resiliency, availability, and scalability.
* Develop platform roadmaps, technical strategies, reference models, blueprints, implementation playbooks, operating standards, and technology lifecycle plans.
* Translate application and business requirements into technical definitions, engineering designs, integration requirements, and implementation plans.
* Develop, document, and deliver pre-implementation and post-implementation impact analyses for technology refreshes, hardware changes, software upgrades, and application releases.
* Create and maintain platform documentation, operational procedures, workflow diagrams, reports, key performance indicators, capacity plans, and technical support materials.
* Review and develop automation solutions that reduce manual, repetitive, or inefficient processes.
* Evaluate and prototype new platform features, third-party products, subsystem technologies, and engineering strategies.
* Lead or contribute to product evaluations, on-site assessments, proofs of concept, and enterprise adoption recommendations.
* Perform software installation and maintenance activities using SMP/E and related mainframe tools.
* Apply formal change-control practices within a regulated environment.
* Coordinate with application programmers, users, infrastructure teams, security partners, software vendors, and management to identify symptoms and deliver accurate problem resolution.
* Provide technical direction, training, and mentoring to engineers, programmers, analysts, and technical support associates.
* Influence technical activities and special initiatives without necessarily having direct reports.
* Manage multiple priorities and deliver work within established commitments in a complex, rapidly changing environment.
Participate in a rotating 24x7 on-call support schedule.  

  

### **Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
Seven or more years of professional experience in z/OS or mainframe systems engineering.  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Significant hands-on experience with one or more of the following:
  + z/OS installation, customization, and maintenance
  + CICS for z/OS
  + MQ for z/OS
  + zCEE for z/OS
  + Mainframe networking
  + Performance management and capacity planning
  + Storage or hardware configuration
  + Independent software vendor product installation and maintenance

* Three or more years of experience in technical or project leadership, platform road mapping, or KPI development, with demonstrated success guiding technology strategy, owning platforms, planning portfolios, and developing engineering talent.

* Advanced experience with SMP/E.
* Experience diagnosing, debugging, tuning, and resolving complex mainframe platform issues.
* Experience supporting production systems through formal change-management and incident-management processes.
* Experience creating detailed technical documentation, procedures, standards, and implementation plans.Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical information to engineers, application teams, vendors, management, and executive stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to prioritize multiple assignments and meet committed delivery dates.
* Expert knowledge of IBM Z and related technologies, including z/OS, CICS, CICSPLEX, MQ, zCEE, DB2 for z/OS, Parallel Sysplex, Coupling Facility, and GDPS.
* Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, SNA/APPN, TCP, UDP, ICMP, routing, mainframe communications, and z/OS Communications Server.

jobs.title: Data Center Controls Engineer, AMER US West Controls
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space. AWS Data centers have multiple components such as generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, etc. All these components have local control systems that interact with each other via open and/or proprietary communications protocols. The BMS is the primary method of control of all mechanical systems within a data center. The EPMS is the primary method of monitoring all electrical systems within a data center.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Train and assist internal customers and stakeholders with the creation, design, configuration, validation, installation, commissioning and operation of BMS and EPMS systems.
  
  
Provide technical assistance and support to operations during life cycle of the data center. Review results and action items from the quarterly maintenances for BMS and EPMS and take actions to get them resolved.
  
  
Develop BMS & EPMS projects scope of work, schedule, budget, and level of efforts (LOE) to projects requested by customers and stakeholders.
  
  
Manage scope, schedule, finance and execution of BMS and EPMS improvement projects in AWS data centers.
  
  
Assist in procurement related activities including request for quotation/proposals, responding to request for information, review of vendors proposal and issuance of purchase orders.
  
  
Participate in AWS global on-call schedule to provide immediate BMS and EPMS technical support to in-service data centers.
  
  
Attend project related meetings, coordinate with project leaders and regularly report status to Controls and stakeholders’ management.
  
  
Support Controls projects related commissioning activities in the data centers.
  
  
Review, implement, troubleshoot and iterate on the controls sequence of operation (SOO) and provide necessary feedback to the design team.
  
  
Develop and modify controls logic programming and graphical user interfaces.
  
  
Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements and navigate challenging situations.
  
  
Financially manage BMS and EPMS service contracts.
  
  
Frequently visit (locally) assigned in-operation and/or under construction data centers to troubleshoot, meet customers, supervise vendor’s work to ensure compliance with the scope, design, SOO and applicable local codes.
  
  
A day in the life  
As a Data Center Controls Engineer, your primary customers are Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO), who depend on you to deliver reliable, well integrated Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS). The problems you solve are technical: modifying controls logic to address operational issues, developing Methods of Procedure (MOPs) for firmware upgrades, or investigating complex alarm discrepancies across monitoring systems. For new builds, you own the controls scope from vendor submittal review through commissioning and turnover. You manage vendor relationships, budgets, and schedules for both service contracts and capital projects. Your internal stakeholders include your Controls Manager, Controls Technicians you provide technical direction to, and partner teams (Construction, Critical Projects Implementation, Commissioning, DCEO).
  
  
About the team  
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Why AWS
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Amphenol Communications Solutions (ACS), a division of Amphenol Corporation, is a world leader in interconnect solutions for Communications, Mobile, RF, Optics, and Commercial electronics markets. Amphenol Corporation is one of the world’s largest designers and manufacturers of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor-based products and coaxial and high-speed specialty cable. ACS has an expansive global presence in research and development, manufacturing, and sales. We design and manufacture a wide range of innovative connectors as well as cable assemblies for diverse applications including server, storage, data center, mobile, RF, networking, industrial, business equipment, and automotive.

The **Reliability Engineer (Electrical Engineering)** will lead electrical reliability, signal-integrity validation, and product qualification for cable backplane assemblies used in AI and hyperscale data centers. The role will develop scalable test strategies and automated systems, characterize high-speed channels and electrical interfaces, and identify failure mechanisms under electrical and environmental stress. In partnership with design, manufacturing, quality, and external laboratories, the engineer will drive root-cause resolution and design and process improvements. This position is based in Etters, PA or Raleigh, NC. Approximately 20% travel is expected.

* Develop electrical reliability and validation strategies, test plans, acceptance criteria, and coverage across the product life cycle.

jobs.title: Firmware Engineer III
jobs.description:
**ABOUT FIREFLY AEROSPACE**
===========================

**Firefly Aerospace is a space and defense technology company that enables our world to launch, land, and operate in space – anywhere, anytime. As the partner of choice for critical space missions, Firefly is the only commercial company to launch a satellite to orbit with 24-hour notice and the only company to achieve a successful Moon landing. Our launch vehicles, lunar landers, and orbital vehicles provide government and commercial customers with full mission services from low Earth orbit to the Moon and beyond. Headquartered in north Austin, Texas, Firefly is looking for passionate, hardworking innovators to join our team and help fuel our successful trajectory into space.**


**SUMMARY**

In this role you will help design, develop, test, and integrate the embedded flight software for Firefly spacecraft. You will work in a group of software engineers through all stages of spacecraft software development processes and collaborate with other engineering teams.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Design, develop, and test embedded firmware for microcontrollers and microprocessors in bare-metal or RTOS environments.
* Architect and implement low-level drivers, communication protocols (I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, etc.), and system-level firmware for real-time applications.
* Collaborate with hardware engineers to define system architecture, debug hardware/firmware interactions, and ensure seamless integration.
* Optimize firmware for power efficiency, performance, and memory constraints in resource-limited embedded systems.
* Participate in code reviews, maintain high-quality code standards, and document firmware designs and processes.
* Contribute to system-level debugging, performance profiling, and validation of embedded systems.
* Optionally, support FPGA integration, including firmware interfacing with FPGA designs, or contribute to custom OS builds using tools like Yocto or Buildroot.

QUALIFICATIONS

**Required**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 5+ years of professional experience in embedded firmware development in Linux environments.
* Proven track record of delivering real-world industry projects involving embedded firmware developed as bare-metal or RTOS applications (e.g., FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or similar).
* Strong programming skills in C/C++ for embedded systems, with experience in assembly language as a plus.
* Experience with communication protocols (I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, USB, Ethernet, etc.) and real-time system constraints.
* Familiarity with debugging tools (JTAG, SWD, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers) and embedded development environments.

**Desired**

* Experience developing C++ applications for embedded systems.
* Proficiency in CI/CD workflow development for embedded firmware projects (e.g., Teamcity, GitLab CI, or similar).
* Experience with FPGA development, including firmware integration with FPGA designs.
* Familiarity with custom OS builds using Yocto, Buildroot, or similar embedded Linux build systems.

**Firefly offers outstanding benefits for our employees, including generous health, dental and vision plans with low plan deductibles, parental leave, relocation benefits, educational reimbursement, short term disability, and flexible PTO options.**
=========================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

Firefly Aerospace, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Firefly is governed based on merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

The Electrical Engineer is responsible for the design, development, and integration of high-reliability and harsh environment electronics hardware for aircraft electrical systems; secondary emphasis in the fields of Motors, Electronic Controllers, and Electro-Mechanical Actuation, and Manufacturing processes. The individual must be able to read, interpret, and create requirements documents, test plans and procedures, technical drawings, schematics, and computer-generated reports.  
  
  
  
Job Requirements and Qualifications:
  
  
Knowledge
  
  
- A minimum of a Bachelor of Science Degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university.
  
- Working knowledge of Project Management Planning (PMP) to include Cost and schedule experience.
  
- Design new complex analog and digital circuits including power supplies, motor inverters, active and passive power filters.
  
- Knowledge of thermal design and high-temperature applications.
  
- Familiarity with FPGAs, various I/O devices, and RF devices for aerospace application is desirable.
  
- Working knowledge and experience in mechanical/electro-mechanical systems and the applications of electro-hydraulic components.
  
- Work in a cross-functional, agile team that includes Systems Engineering, Mechanical Systems, Electrical Systems, Test Systems, Software, and Project Engineering.
  
- Carries out detailed electrical design work including 3D modeling, simulation and design verification testing, as required.
  
- Working knowledge of standard work, metrics and continuous improvement. (i.e., 5S, Lean Six Sigma, etc)
  
- Working knowledge of military/aerospace design standards/specifications
  
- Working knowledge of root cause and corrective action tools and processes
  
  
Skills and Abilities
  
  
- Experience in designing any of the following: Sensors, Inverters, and Power Supplies.
  
- Ability to analyze and produce technical reports in support of customer proposals, specifications, manuals, and other data to evaluate the feasibility, cost and maintenance requirements of those designs and applications.
  
- Ability to design and conduct research that tests and analyzes the feasibility, operation, and performance of equipment, components and systems.
  
- Ability to analyze complex situations, seek relevant data, diagnose information in order to solve problems and generalize alternative methods to identify the best possible solution.
  
- Ability to effectively interface with customers, team members and individuals in technical discussions and solutions.
  
- Ability to relate to co¬workers, inspire others to participate, and mitigate conflict with co-workers.
  
- Ability to manage multiple assignments and tasks, set priorities, and adapt to changing conditions and work assignments; flexible team player who thrives in environments requiring ability to effectively prioritize and juggle multiple concurrent projects.
  
- Ability to accept, learn and adapt to new technology.
  
- Ability to respond to, anticipate and manage change.
  
- Ability to listen, write, and speak to convey information effectively.
  
- Ability to understand/produce technical drawings/system schematics (hydraulics/mechanical/electrical/electro-mechanical)
  
- Ability to co-ordinate with the other Functional discipline (electronics and testing) within the department to produce multidisciplinary design solutions
  
- Able to produces designs to customer requirements and specified deadlines and achieves the required timescales
  
- Excellent communication skills, dealing with other employees and external clients
  
- Excellent written and oral communication skills, self-motivated team player. Effective problem solving capabilities and committed to undertaking professional development

- Ability to weigh risk vs. sound business principles (i.e., product dispositions)
  
- Ability to create and debug embedded system programming desired but not required.
  
  
Experience
  
  
- 10 year+ of experience in electrical systems and/or electro-mechanical desired but not required. Experience in industrial and other related backgrounds will be considered.
