jobs.title: Senior Embedded Engineer
jobs.description:
**Important:** This position is based in our **Houston, TX office near Hobby Airport**, and **both the position and interview process require candidates to be available to work and interview in our Houston office.** This is a primarily hands-on role supporting our engineering, laboratory, and manufacturing operations.

**About the Role**
------------------

Heath Consultants is seeking an experienced Senior Embedded Engineer to join our Product Engineering team. In this role, you will play a key part in the design, development, testing, and support of sophisticated **embedded electronic instrumentation and systems used in the natural gas utility industry**.

This is a hands-on engineering position for someone who enjoys working across the boundaries of **electronics, embedded firmware, instrumentation, sensing, and systems engineering**. You will have the opportunity to take products from concept and design through prototype, testing, manufacturing, and ongoing product improvement.

As an Electrical Engineer III, you will serve as an experienced technical contributor and help shape engineering decisions through sound technical judgment, hands-on problem solving, and collaboration with teams across the organization.

You’ll work closely with **firmware, software, mechanical engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, repair, and product management** to develop reliable products that serve real-world customer needs in the gas utility market.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Electronics & Embedded Systems**

* Develop embedded and real-time systems using **C, C++, Python, and/or MATLAB**.
* Apply electrical engineering principles across **analog, digital, power, and embedded firmware** systems.
* Design and support **low-power electronics for portable, handheld instruments**, including wired and wireless connectivity.
* Lead or contribute to electronics architecture and design, including **schematics, PCB layouts, board bring-up, design reviews, and product release support**.
* Perform PCB designs and edits as well as guide local and remote PCB designers by establishing clear layout requirements and constraints, including:
  + Board stack-up
  + Component placement
  + Grounding
  + Power routing
  + High-speed routing
  + Design for Manufacturing (DFM)

### **Firmware, Software & Simulation**

* Develop and troubleshoot embedded firmware and real-time systems.
* Work within modern engineering development processes using tools such as **GitHub, Jira, and Visual Studio**.
* Implement power converter and control system simulations using tools such as **MATLAB, Simulink, and PSpice**.
* Troubleshoot electrical, firmware, and system-level problems using a structured, root-cause approach.

### **Product Development & Problem Solving**

* Evaluate design tradeoffs involving **cost, performance, reliability, manufacturability, and schedule**.
* Translate customer and field needs into engineering requirements and practical technical solutions.
* Evaluate prototypes and designs and recommend improvements.
* Support product development through key phases including:
  + Hardware requirements definition
  + Research and development design
  + Verification and validation
  + Test planning and execution
  + Manufacturing design transfer
  + Product release and sustaining engineering
* Identify opportunities to incorporate new components and emerging technologies to improve **product cost, performance, size, reliability, and capability**.

### **Collaboration & Technical Leadership**

* Serve as a technical resource and contribute to architecture and design decisions.
* Communicate technical information clearly with engineering and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Work with outside suppliers and manufacturers on system- and project-level activities.
* Coach and mentor less-experienced engineers and technicians throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Apply sound engineering judgment to resolve technical challenges and support successful product outcomes.

### **Compliance & Industry Standards**

* Apply applicable standards, regulations, and engineering guidance related to the development and manufacture of products for the **natural gas utility market**.
* Consider relevant **safety, environmental, wireless, and international compliance requirements** throughout product development.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in **Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline**.
* **4-7 years experience** in a research & development, manufacturing, or engineering environment, preferably with portable instruments.
* Demonstrated expertise in **embedded electronics, instrumentation, sensing, or related product development**.
* Proficiency with electrical CAD tools such as **Altium**.
* Proficiency in developing embedded firmware.
* Proficiency in developing software tools.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and the ability to create clear, professional technical documentation.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, product management, and other cross-functional teams.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

Candidates with experience in the following areas are especially encouraged to apply:

* Experience with Microcontroller based hardware and firmware development (AVR, ARM, Renesas, NXP, etc.)
* **Real-Time Operating System (RTOS)** based product development.
* **FPGA or RTL coding**, particularly for timing control, sensor interfaces, or signal processing.
* **Intrinsic Safety** design.
* Optical sensors, transducers, infrared (IR), or similar sensing technologies.
* Hands-on use of laboratory equipment including **oscilloscopes, power supplies, and spectrum analyzers**.
* Experience in product development phases such as hardware requirement definition, R&D design outputs, verification/validation test plans & protoc

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Hexium is modernizing Atomic Vapor Laser Isotope Separation (AVLIS) into a scalable industrial technology for domestic isotope production. We are designing and building complex systems combining high-power lasers, electro-optics, precision controls, instrumentation, and custom electronics.

Our engineers work directly on the hardware, from initial design and prototyping through integration and testing. As an Electrical Engineer, you'll build systems that are central to Hexium's technology and to critical U.S. energy and national-security supply chains.

**Role**

We're looking for an Electrical Engineer to design, build, and test the power electronics, power supplies, and control hardware behind our laser and separation technology, including high-temperature and induction heating hardware. This is a hands-on, iterative design role within our Technology Development group, with a focus on developing reliable, multi-kilowatt power systems for complex experimental environments. Beyond power systems, you'll contribute to instrumentation, diagnostics, and lab controls work across the company.

The ideal candidate has practical experience designing and testing power electronics. They're comfortable around high-voltage hardware and enjoy solving hard problems through hands-on experimentation and close collaboration with scientists and mechanical engineers.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and test power electronics and power supplies, including inverters and their control and protection circuitry
* Iterate hardware from bench-scale prototypes to robust, multi-kilowatt lab systems
* Develop control, feedback, and safety interlock systems for power and thermal processes
* Evaluate, specify, and integrate commercial power equipment alongside in-house designs
* Contribute to instrumentation and diagnostics projects, including sensor signal conditioning and data acquisition (DAQ)
* Own the hardware development cycle: schematic capture, PCB layout, prototyping, bench testing, and iteration
* Work directly with scientists and mechanical engineers to turn requirements into working hardware
* Support installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting of electrical and control hardware

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related field (e.g., Engineering Physics, Computer Engineering)
* 3+ years of hands-on electrical hardware design experience
* Hands-on design and test experience in power electronics (inverters, motor drives, power supplies, induction heating)
* Experience with schematic capture and PCB design (Altium, KiCad, Allegro, or similar) and circuit simulation (SPICE, PLECS, or similar)
* Confident with lab test equipment (oscilloscopes, differential and current probes, power analyzers) and with iterative, trial-and-error hardware development
* Able to work safely with high-voltage equipment
* Able to work on-site in Austin, TX
* Candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain a DOE Q-level security clearance
* This role will be exposed to export-controlled information and requires compliance with applicable export control laws and regulations

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of hands-on electrical hardware design experience
* Experience with induction heating or resonant power converters (series/parallel resonant, LLC, soft switching)
* Experience with IGBT or SiC MOSFET power stages, gate drivers, magnetics design (Litz wire, matching transformers), and water-cooled power hardware
* Electromagnetic or thermal simulation (COMSOL, ANSYS Maxwell, or similar) for coil and load design
* Low-noise analog design: transimpedance or charge amplifiers, lock-in amplifiers, or ion detection and spectrometry electronics
* High-temperature measurement and control (thermocouples, pyrometers, closed-loop temperature control)
* Embedded or lab control experience (microcontrollers, PLCs, LabVIEW, or Python for DAQ)
* Background in a national lab, university research group, or hardware startup
* Currently holds an active DOE Q or DoD TS clearance

**Physical Requirements**

* Extended periods at a lab bench performing fine-motor tasks (soldering, board assembly, probing) requiring sustained hand-eye coordination and dexterity
* Ability to work near energized high-power and high-temperature equipment and in laser-controlled areas under lab safety protocols (may require laser safety training/certification and PPE use)
* Occasional lifting/carrying of test equipment up to 30 lbs
* Frequent close-vision work (component-level inspection, microscope/magnification use)

**Work Environment**

On-site role based in Austin, TX. Primarily lab-based, split between electronics benches, high-power test areas, and a controlled laser lab. This is an on-site, hands-on role with limited remote flexibility given the equipment and hardware dependencies. Work in laser-controlled areas requires lab safety training (LSO-administered), and high-power work follows Hexium's electrical safety procedures.

**Benefits**

* Stock Options
* Paid Time Off
* 401(k) Matching
* Medical, Dental, Vision insurance
* HSA & FSAs

**Screening**: Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check.

**Firefly Aerospace is a space and defense technology company that enables our world to launch, land, and operate in space – anywhere, anytime. As the partner of choice for critical space missions, Firefly is the only commercial company to launch a satellite to orbit with 24-hour notice and the only company to achieve a successful Moon landing. Our launch vehicles, lunar landers, and orbital vehicles provide government and commercial customers with full mission services from low Earth orbit to the Moon and beyond. Headquartered in north Austin, Texas, Firefly is looking for passionate, hardworking innovators to join our team and help fuel our successful trajectory into space.**


**About the Role**

Join Firefly's Ground Systems team as a Level III Instrumentation & Controls Engineer and become the technical authority for the systems that make launch, orbit, and landing possible. This isn't theoretical engineering—it's expert-level design, technical leadership, and strategic direction for the control systems and instrumentation that monitor rocket engines, manage cryogenic propellants, and enable rapid-fire test campaigns across all of Firefly’s programs. As a Level III engineer, you are the subject matter expert and technical leader. You'll architect complete control system solutions from concept through commissioning, lead complex projects and multiple engineers on time-sensitive initiatives, and serve as the go-to authority when the toughest technical challenges arise. Your control architectures will span all of Firefly's test stands, test fixtures, and launch sites. Your technical decisions will influence and shape the evolution of rapidly evolving launch and in-space programs. Your expertise will guide the next generation of engineers developing Firefly's ground infrastructure. This role demands technical mastery and leadership. You'll work at the highest technical level—defining standards, driving innovation, developing roadmaps, and representing Firefly's I&C capabilities to internal and external stakeholders. You'll lead technical teams through the most complex challenges, make architectural decisions that impact multiple programs, and resolve problems that other engineers escalate to you. When a novel test requirement demands a control solution that doesn't exist yet, you'll architect it. When a major customer has concerns about data integrity or performance, you'll be in the room explaining our approach. When a critical project needs expert leadership to stay on track, you'll take the reins. jobs.title: Senior Robotics Engineer
jobs.description:
Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you've come to the right place!

E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are building a highly-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system that will fundamentally change the design, economics, manufacturing and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems.

We're intentional, we're unapologetically curious and we're 100% committed to innovate space-based communications and deliver actionable intelligence that will expand global economies, protect space and our planet and enhance our overall quality of life.

The E-Space Manufacturing team builds the world's most advanced aerospace products at high rate and high precision.

As a Senior Robotics Engineer, you'll program and integrate the ABB and Fanuc robots that assemble our satellites. You'll own robotic cells end-to-end - from path planning and EOAT integration to commissioning and cycle-time optimization - and serve as the dedicated robotics owner the team needs as we scale. This is a hands-on role for someone who has deployed industrial robots in production and wants to build a robotics function from a strong foundation. This position reports to the Manufacturing Engineering leadership team.

### **What you'll be doing:**

* Program, simulate, and deploy ABB and Fanuc robots for assembly, pick-and-place, and material-handling applications.
* Own robotic cells from concept through commissioning, including path planning, EOAT integration, and safety.
* Optimize cycle time, reliability, and throughput of production robotic cells.
* Integrate robots with Beckhoff controls, vision systems, sensors, and end-of-arm tooling.
* Develop and maintain robot programs, frames, and tooling calibrations.
* Lead on-floor commissioning, troubleshooting, and handover of production cells.
* Mentor junior robotics engineers and set programming standards.

### **What you will bring to this role:**

* 5+ years programming and integrating industrial robots in production - ABB and/or Fanuc.
* Hands-on experience with robot cell design, EOAT integration, and commissioning.
* Familiarity with machine vision, sensors, pneumatics, and safety systems.
* Understanding of how robotics integrate with PLC/motion control (Beckhoff a plus).
* Strong troubleshooting skills on live production equipment.
* BS in Robotics, Mechanical, Electrical, or Mechatronics Engineering, or equivalent.

### **Extra points for the following:**

* Both ABB and Fanuc programming experience.
* Offline programming / simulation (RobotStudio, Roboguide).
* Machine-vision and force-control integration.
* Aerospace, PV/solar, or thin-film manufacturing background.

### **Closing**

This is a full time, exempt position, based out of our Arlington, TX facility.

We are redefining how satellites are designed, manufactured and used - so we're looking for candidates with passion, deep knowledge and direct experience. If that's your experience, then we'll be immediately wow-ed.

E-Space is not currently able to provide employment sponsorship for candidates who do not hold work authorization for the location of this role.

**Why E-Space is right for you:**

As a member of our team, you will play a crucial role in driving our success. Our team members have a strong sense of dedication and responsibility; this includes a strong commitment to our mission to create an entirely new suite of global capabilities to improve lives, business efficiencies and build a smarter planet. This means that there will be times when extra hours, including nights and weekends, may be needed to meet critical deadlines and mission goals. In return, we offer a dynamic work environment with opportunities for professional growth and development and the chance to make a meaningful impact in a high-growth industry.

We want you to make the most of your journey at E-Space. That's why we support and invest in the physical, emotional and financial well-being of our team members and their families. Some of what you can expect when working at E-Space:

* An opportunity to really make a difference
* Sustainability at our core
* Fair and honest workplace
* Innovative thinking is encouraged
* Competitive salaries
* Continuous learning and development
* Health and wellness care options
* Financial solutions for the future
* Optional legal services (US only)
* Paid holidays
* Paid time off

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

This position combines electronics troubleshooting, PCB repair, prototype development and manufacturing support.

You'll work directly with our engineering, production and customer support teams to diagnose electrical problems, repair boards, test new hardware and help improve the reliability of our products.

We're looking for someone who can identify the root cause of a problem, not just replace parts until something works.

This is a hands-on position in our Houston manufacturing facility, working with real hardware every day.

**Electronics Troubleshooting & Repair**

* Perform precision soldering, hot-air rework and surface-mount component replacement.
* Troubleshoot power supplies, MOSFET drivers, microcontrollers and electronic control circuits.
* Investigate intermittent electrical failures using oscilloscopes, multimeters and other diagnostic equipment.
* Support production technicians with electrical troubleshooting to minimize manufacturing downtime.

**Prototype Development & Testing**

* Assemble, modify and test prototype electronic assemblies.
* Build, modify and troubleshoot wiring harnesses.
* Program, flash and test PCBs.
* Assist engineering with new hardware development and prototype validation.

**Failure Analysis & Quality Improvement**

* Investigate electronic failures reported by manufacturing and customer support.
* Document failure symptoms, diagnostic findings, root causes and corrective actions.
* Track recurring failures and recommend improvements.
* Perform incoming inspection and first-article testing of electronic assemblies.
* Work with engineering to verify hardware improvements and design revisions.

Required Qualifications

* At least 3 years of hands-on electronics troubleshooting, PCB repair or related experience, or equivalent technical education and practical experience.
* Strong soldering and surface-mount rework skills, including fine-pitch components.
* Experience diagnosing electronic circuits at the component level.
* Proficiency with oscilloscopes, digital multimeters and bench power supplies.
* Ability to read and interpret electronic schematics, PCB layouts and wiring diagrams.
* Experience troubleshooting switching power supplies, microcontrollers and electronic drivers.
* Familiarity with wiring harness assembly, connectors and crimping.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to document technical findings clearly and work collaboratively with engineering and manufacturing teams.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with embedded electronics, firmware programming or debugging.
* Familiarity with RP2040/RP2350 microcontrollers, UART, SWD or similar interfaces.
* Experience with automated testing, Python or custom test fixtures.
* Background in industrial electronics, robotics, arcade equipment, amusement devices or electronics manufacturing.

9. Architect resilience and fault tolerance into fleet-management subsystems, including high availability (HA), failover semantics, cluster replication, and disaster recovery.

3. Solid experience with enterprise Java architectures (WildFly or comparable application servers; Java EE / Jakarta EE technologies such as EJBs, JPA, JMS, JAX-RS).

4. Strong relational and analytical database architecture skills (MariaDB, MySQL, ColumnStore, or PostgreSQL): schema design, index optimization, complex query tuning, transaction management, and safe, zero-downtime migration strategies.

8. Solid Linux systems programming and networking fundamentals: POSIX concepts, process lifecycle, inter-process communication, sockets, TCP/IP, and diagnostic tooling.

9. Demonstrated experience integrating agentic AI

New automated manufacturing equipment is designed, built and performance tested by us, then set up at its final destination for final commissioning and start of production.

 **What You'll Do**

* Take the lead controls engineering role, leading a team of controls engineers to complete capex projects on accelerated timelines
* Design high performing equipment by collaborating with mechanical & electrical engineers on topics such as machine layout, tooling design, process strategies and hardware selection of motors & drives, actuators, and sensors
* Challenge requirements & assumptions, identify & delete unnecessary parts & processes and find ways to reduce complexity
* Estimate project labor requirements and plan the team’s schedule, reducing large and complex project scopes into simple, clear, and aggressive objectives, that your team will execute under your direction
* Accelerate your team toward success by providing consistent leadership throughout all phases of the project. You’ll set aggressive goals for them, review their progress, support them technically and professionally and make necessary course corrections along the way
* Define software architecture by creating diagrams and flow charts for high level topology, device level control, and process sequencing
* Program PLCs and HMIs for state control, motor control, servo motion control, and pneumatic actuations
* Program industrial robots for material handling and process applications
* Work hands-on with the equipment during the debug phase to bring it to a high performing and robust state by performing validations and exception testing for hardware, software, and processes
* Travel to the factory for on-site commissioning of the equipment, performing final validations, and supporting it into production. Ability to travel up to 25%, potentially on short notice

  
**What You'll Bring**

* 8+ years’ experience programming, debugging, and commissioning industrial machines of moderate to high complexity
* Experience programming PLCs from brands like Siemens, Allen Bradley, or Beckhoff. Siemens PLC programming experience is preferred
* Strong mechanical aptitude and proficiency with hand tools
* Strong electrical aptitude and experience with industrial electrical wiring for 3-Phase AC power and DC control circuits and proficiency with electrical diagnostic tools
* Proficiency with viewing mechanical and electrical CAD documents with software like SolidWorks, AutoCAD, and Eplan
* Experience working collaboratively with a large team. Project leadership experience is a plus
* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Computer Science, or equivalent), or equivalent experience

jobs.title: Principal RF Electrical Engineer

HawkEye 360 is seeking a Principal RF Electrical Engineer and Team Lead on the Space Team. The Space Team's mission is to design, build, and test small commercial satellites that provide revolutionary RF geospatial analytics.

You will lead electrical and RF design of our space platforms, with emphasis on digital, analog, and power electronics design as well as RF payloads including Software Defined Radios (SDRs), RF front ends, and antenna systems. You'll oversee PCB design from schematic capture through layout and manufacturing while also defining and executing performance tests to verify mission requirements. You will lead a small team of RF and Electrical Engineers, providing technical guidance and mentorship while remaining hands-on with design and test activities.

This role requires strong Electrical and RF Engineering expertise, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work cross-functionally with mechanical, software, payload, and systems engineering teams.

**Your main responsibilities will be:**

* Design digital, analog, and power electronics for satellite flight hardware while overseeing team execution of schematic capture, PCB layout, RF chain design, and power subsystem development to ensure technical accuracy and on‑schedule delivery.
* Lead PCB design and layout activities with attention to RF design considerations including controlled impedance, grounding, shielding, power distribution, and signal integrity.
* Establish engineering best practices, design standards, and review processes to maintain high reliability and consistency across all hardware designs.
* Facilitate root‑cause analyses and corrective action efforts, aligning engineering teams around data‑driven problem solving for flight hardware anomalies.
* Manage task planning, delegation, and technical roadmapping to ensure the RF/EE team meets program milestones from concept through flight qualification.
* Work closely with PCB Contract Manufacturers (CMs) to ensure quality control and timely delivery of flight hardware.
* Design and develop RF payload architectures and Software Defined Radio systems for space-based RF collection missions.
* Develop test procedures and automation scripts to characterize SDR and RF front-end Performance.
* Support spacecraft integration and testing efforts, including the design of Electrical Ground Support Equipment (EGSE), flatsats for functional testing, and satellite flight hardware testing.
* Perform first article hardware unit testing, including reception inspection, burn-in testing, thermal validation, and hardware checkouts.

**Your skills and qualifications:**  
**Essential education and experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in RF/Electrical Engineering or related field.
* 10+ years of hands-on experience designing and testing RF electronics, including SDRs, mixers, filters, amplifiers, and receiver chains.
* Expertise in PCB design and layout (Altium or similar) including schematic capture, component selection, and layout for mixed-signal and RF applications.
* Strong Understanding of power electronics, high-speed digital design, and analog circuit design.
* Strong understanding of RF fundamentals (impedance matching, S-parameters, noise figure, linearity, etc.) and software-defined radio architectures.
* Experience using lab equipment such as Spectrum Analyzers, Network Analyzers, Signal Generators, Noise Figure Analyzers, and RF test chambers.
* Hands-on flight hardware experience (satellite integration, RF lab testing, prototyping, troubleshooting).
* Experience handling ESD-sensitive components and operating in cleanroom environments.
* Strong communication skills to explain complex technical concepts to cross-functional stakeholders.
* 1+ years of technical leadership, project leadership, or team lead experience.

**Desirable:**

* Experience working in the smallsat or space industry with RF payloads or communication systems.
* Experience designing for radiation environments (TID and Proton)
* Experience with version control (git) and modern engineering workflows.
* Proficiency with Python, MATLAB, C++, or other coding languages for RF analysis and test automation.
* Experience with RF simulation tools (ADS, CST, Genesys, HFSS, Scikit-RF, Emerge, or similar) and RF modeling.
* Familiarity with CAD (NX, SolidWorks, etc.) to support electro-mechanical integration.

**Company Overview:**

HawkEye 360 is equipping defense, intelligence, and national security leaders with mission-critical signals intelligence to enable faster, better decision making. By detecting, geolocating, and characterizing radio frequency emissions worldwide, HawkEye 360 delivers trusted domain awareness and early warning indicators to the US Government and allied partners. Our space-based collection, proprietary signal processing, and AI-powered analytics transform knowledge of RF spectrum into a strategic advantage. Proven by operational mission success, HawkEye 360 is redefining how signals intelligence strengthens national and global security.

*HawkEye 360 is committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, making decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class.*

**Required Education:**

* Bachelors and nine (9) years or more experience; Masters and seven (7) years or more experience ; PhD or JD and four (4) years or more experience.

* Deep technical knowledge of Army terrestrial sensing platforms, to include Tactical Land Signals Intelligence (SIGINT), Electronic Warfare (EW), Cyberspace, and electro-optical/infrared (EO/IR) sensors.

* Proven track record navigating the Army Requirements Determination, JCIDS, and Defense Acquisition System pathways specifically for intelligence or electronic sensor payloads.
* Expert understanding of tactical data dissemination, sensor-to-shooter links, and processing/analytics principles that turn raw terrestrial sensor data into combat-ready intelligence.
* Exceptional ability to translate highly complex technical specifications (e.g., frequency ranges, gain, sensor processing limitations) into plain-language mission impacts for senior military leaders.
* Capacity to independently identify capability gaps in current terrestrial fleets, evaluate emerging commercial/defense tech, and formulate mitigation strategies.

**Clearance:**

* Candidate must have an active TS/SCI clearance with the ability to obtain TS/SCI Poly.

Target salary range: $140,001 - $180,000. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

jobs.title: Senior Principal Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today's five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a Principal Systems Engineer to join our growing team in Lanham, MD. This is a senior technical leadership role with system-level authority across multiple programs: owning system architecture, setting technical direction, resolving the most complex cross-cutting issues, and developing the next generation of systems engineering leads.

The ideal candidate brings a record of leading systems engineering on complex space or comparable programs from concept through launch and operations, is trusted by executives, customers, and engineers alike, and thrives in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment where no two days look the same.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the technical authority for systems engineering across multiple programs, owning system architecture and technical direction from concept through verification, validation, launch, and on-orbit operations.
* Define and own system architectures and mission concepts, leading trade studies and making and defending key technical decisions in response to customer and internal needs.
* Establish top-level system requirements and govern their allocation, flow-down, and interface control across subsystems, suppliers, and organizations.
* Own technical budgets and margin philosophy (mass, power, link, thermal, schedule) at the program and constellation level, and ensure rigorous tracking across subsystems.
* Drive system-level integration across engineering disciplines (RF, software, mechanical, electrical, GNC, operations) and lead resolution of the most complex cross-cutting technical issues and anomalies.
* Provide technical leadership for proposal and business development efforts, including solution architecture, basis-of-estimate development, and cost/schedule inputs, and represent AST in technical engagements with customers and government partners.
* Serve as senior technical lead for major design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR) and technical interchange meetings (TIMs), presenting to executive leadership, customers, and independent review boards.
* Lead technical risk management: identify and quantify top program and technical risks, drive mitigation, and advise leadership on risk-informed decisions.
* Define and evolve systems engineering processes, standards, practices, and drive their adoption across the organization.
* Mentor and develop SE leads and engineers, serve as a technical coach across the department, and contribute to hiring and talent growth.
  

**Qualifications**

**Education:**

Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field required; Master's degree or PhD strongly preferred

**Experience:**

A minimum of 12 years of systems engineering experience, with at least 5 years serving as SE Lead, Chief Engineer, or equivalent on a program of record or flight program, including end-to-end lifecycle experience on at least one program through launch and on-orbit operations

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in a relevant engineering discipline.
* Experience in space, satellite, or defense programs, ideally satellite communications, phased array, or RF payload systems.
* Experience establishing or leading SE practices and configuration control processes at the program or organizational level.

**Soft Skills:**

* Proven ability to lead and influence without direct authority across cross-functional teams and at the executive level.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including ability to brief and build trust with executive, customer, and government audiences.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity: able to define the path forward and make sound decisions when requirements are incomplete or roles are fluid.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, with the judgment to balance technical rigor against schedule and cost.
* Ability to manage multiple competing priorities across programs in a dynamic, fast-moving environment.
* Demonstrated mentor who builds technical talent and raises the bar for the team.
* Self-starter who takes ownership and drives issues to closure without close supervision.

**Technology Stack:**

* Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) for documentation, analysis, and reporting.
* Requirements management tools: DOORS, Jama, or equivalent, with experience defining requirements management practices.
* MATLAB / Simulink for analysis and trade studies (preferred).
* Confluence and Jira for program tracking and collaboration.
* STK (Systems Tool Kit) for mission analysis (preferred).

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to work in a standard office environment and use a computer for extended periods.
* Occasional travel to other AST SpaceMobile facilities or customer/government sites (up to 20%).

*This job description may not be inclusive to the duties and responsibilities listed. Additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time or the scope of the job may change as needed by business demands**.*

AST SpaceMobile is an Equal Opportunity, at will Employer; employment is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

At Spacelabs Healthcare, you make a difference.

Every member of our worldwide team plays an integral role in improving treatment and helping providers deliver exceptional care to their patients. From newborns to centenarians, more than 60 million people benefit each year from the advancements we make in patient monitoring and management, care coordination and clinical decision support.

Driven by the belief that anyone who seeks care could be a member of our own family, our team is dedicated to solving the greatest challenges the healthcare system currently faces, including the need to enhance the patient experience, improve population health, reduce costs, support care team well-being and advance health equity. As part of our mission, we take pride in creating services and technologies that are personalized and tailored to support the needs of healthcare providers anywhere in the world.

* Seek self-improvement and are adaptable to suggestions and feedback.

Our Engineers have the privilege of working on complex, highly engineered machines and are involved at all stages of the aircraft life cycle, from product development to manufacturing and direct support to our airline customers. If you’re interested in designing, creating, and testing the present and future of Airbus products across the globe, join our mission to connect the world.

Nestled in the heart of the stunning Columbia River Gorge in Bingen, WA, our workplace offers innovation and the ability to contribute to game-changing solutions while enjoying the flexibility to spread your wings. Whether it's solving complex challenges, or celebrating victories, you’ll be part of a cohesive crew that thrives on innovation and the beauty that the Pacific Northwest has to offer!

**Software Development (~55%)**

* Design, implement, and maintain embedded software for UAV flight platforms
* Contribute to the development of Ground Control Station (GCS) software, including user interfaces, telemetry, and mission tools
* Write reliable, maintainable, and well-documented code in C++, C, Python and/or MATLAB
* Develop and support real-time flight software, including control loops, sensor drivers, and mission logic
* Implement and test communication protocols such as UART, CAN, TCP/IP, UDP, and serial
* Design, develop and support software tools for UAV system configuration
* Develop software modules and system services targeting embedded Linux platforms, including process management, device interfaces, and inter-process communication

**Testing & Integration (~20%)**

* Support testing and debugging in both lab environments and during field flight tests
* Collaborate with hardware, electrical, and systems engineers to bring up and integrate new UAV platforms

**Documentation & Architecture (~10%)**

* Document internal designs, software architecture, and interfaces to support maintainability and team alignment

**Support & Maintenance (~10%)**

* Maintain and support existing embedded and ground control software
* Support software tools for UAV system configuration

**Professional Development (~5%)**

* Stay current with UAV industry developments and continuously grow your skillset
* Collaborating with other software developers
* Regularly report on activities and progress

* B.S. or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field
* 2+ years of experience in embedded software development, either through industry roles or substantial project work
* Experience with C++.
* Experience with Python.
* Familiarity with embedded Linux or real-time operating systems (RTOS)
* Exposure to UAV flight control concepts, sensor integration, or telemetry systems
* Experience using Git and development tools such as Gitlab or similar
* Strong focus on writing clean, well-documented code with an emphasis on maintainability
* Familiarity with modern UI software architecture and development practices (e.g., Qt, PyQt, or similar frameworks)
* Able to work legally in the US (valid work visa and work authorization)

**Preferred Education/Skills:**

* M.S in Embedded System Engineering, Software Engineering, Control System Engineering
* Experience with UAV autopilot software
* Exposure to Ground Control Station software
* Hands-on experience with UAV flight testing or platform integration
* Awareness of aerospace safety standards or robust software validation practices
* Basic understanding of aircraft systems, particularly in the areas of guidance, navigation, and control (GNC).
* Exposure to real-time operating systems (RTOS) and/or safety-critical software

jobs.description:
**As a Firmware Engineer focused on Cybersecurity, a typical day might include:**

* Participate in the design, implementation, and test of embedded firmware systems with emphasis on cybersecurity.
* Design and implement security features such as secure boot, firmware signing and updating, authentication and access control, cryptographic services, secure key storage, and security event logging.
* Apply secure coding practices, threat modeling, and security design reviews throughout the firmware development lifecycle.
* Perform security testing and vulnerability analysis, including static analysis, fuzzing, and penetration testing; analyze and remediate identified vulnerabilities.
* Understand hardware and software interactions, and collaborate with Hardware Engineers on hardware-based security features (e.g., secure elements, TPMs, hardware crypto accelerators, and debug-port protection).
* Support compliance with applicable cybersecurity standards and customer requirements (e.g., NERC CIP, IEC 62443, IEEE 1686, and NIST guidance).
* Prepare and maintain security requirements, designs, and test documentation.
* Mentor Associate Engineers and Technicians in secure development practices.

***Required Qualifications***  
Typically 2+ years' experience in embedded systems firmware development including:

* Real-time firmware design
* C, C++ and assembly languages
* Embedded Linux systems development (C, C++, Python, and other scripting languages)

Working knowledge of cybersecurity fundamentals for embedded systems, including:

* Applied cryptography (symmetric/asymmetric encryption, hashing, digital signatures, PKI, TLS)
* Secure boot and secure firmware update
* Secure coding practices and memory-safety vulnerabilities
* Threat modeling and risk assessment

Strong writing, documentation, and speaking skills

Ability to learn new skills and assume new responsibilities

Ability to work cooperatively in a team environment

***Preferred Qualifications***

* Experience with static analysis, fuzzing, and penetration testing tools
* Experience with hardware security features (secure elements, TPMs, TrustZone or equivalent, hardware crypto engines)
* Experience with secure network protocols and role-based access control
* Knowledge of cybersecurity standards (NERC CIP, IEC 62443, IEEE 1686, NIST)
* Security certifications (e.g., CSSLP, GICSP, or similar)
* Industrial controls
* 3-phase electric power systems
* Modern communications protocols
* Digital and analog circuitry
* Digital communications and signal processing
* Project management

**Pullman, WA** - SEL corporate office is located in Eastern Washington where you'll enjoy an unmatched quality of life. Enjoy the smaller town life: country space, freedom from traffic, easy access to recreational activities in nearby mountains, rivers, and forests, as well as great schools and universities.

Microsoft Silicon and Cloud Hardware Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft’s expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft’s “Intelligent Cloud” mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Skype, OneDrive and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for passionate engineers to help achieve that mission. As Microsoft's cloud business continues to grow the ability to deploy new offerings and HW infrastructure on time, in high volume with high quality and lowest cost is of paramount importance.

The Silicon and Cloud Hardware Infrastructure Engineering Firmware Development team is responsible for design and development of Server and Rack Infrastructure Firmware for Microsoft's online services. We work closely with Microsoft product groups, industry partners and researchers to architect and develop server hardware solutions that meet the requirements for our cloud services platforms at the lowest possible cost of ownership (TCO). We need to be always learning and insatiably curious. We need to be willing to lean into uncertainty, take risks and move quickly when we make mistakes, recognizing failure happens along the way to mastery. And we need to be open to the ideas of others, where the success of others does not diminish our own.

#azurehwjobs #SCHIE #schiefwcoe

jobs.description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.

**About the Role**
------------------

This role is part of Blue Origin Operations — which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance — supporting Manufacturing and Supply Chain across all Blue Origin facilities. You will sit on the software team within Operations that builds tools in direct support of our Manufacturing Engineers.

We are returning humankind to the Moon, and Blue Origin's Manufacturing Engineers build the hardware that gets us there. On our small AI Solutions team, you will own the backend and data layer behind the tools a 100+ person Manufacturing Engineering organization depends on. Several enterprise systems describe the same products from different angles, and they do not always agree. Your work turns that into one trusted picture of the product: the data models, integrations, and APIs our applications and AI features are built on. This is a systems-design role at its core, and the best engineers here also make a point of understanding the people they build for, so you will spend time on the floor with Manufacturing Engineers to learn the work before building for it.

  

**Special Mentions**
--------------------

* Shifts: 1st | Mon–Fri (8am–5pm)
* Location: Renton, WA (fully onsite / "work from work," co-located with the Manufacturing Engineering organization and production floor)
Relocation: Available  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own the backend services, APIs, and data models behind the tools our team builds, primarily in Python, holding the technical-design and code-review bar as they grow.
* Build integrations that bring product data together from our enterprise systems, reconciling sources that describe the same things in different ways.
* Improve, harden, and modernize existing applications — not just greenfield work — including auth, data integrity, testing, and technical debt.
* Shape our product data so AI features can actually use it: structure, naming, and context a model can navigate reliably — plus human-in-the-loop safeguards and the evaluations that show whether those features are working.
* Deploy and operate the team's services on our cloud infrastructure (AWS), including CI/CD, monitoring, day-to-day reliability, and a share of on-call.
* Spend time with Manufacturing Engineers to learn how their work actually flows, and use data to validate that what you ship is actually helping the engineers who use it.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
* 5+ years of software engineering experience, with demonstrated ownership of production backend services
* Strong backend and API development in Python or a comparable language (REST and/or GraphQL), including interfaces that applications and AI agents both build on
* Depth in relational data modeling and SQL — changing a schema and migrating data in production without breaking the applications built on it
* Experience integrating multiple systems of record: reconciling identifiers, handling incomplete or inconsistent data, and building pipelines that recover cleanly from partial failure
* Hands-on experience deploying and running applications on AWS and containerized infrastructure
* Comfortable integrating LLMs into products, with judgment about what data a model can actually work with and whether an AI-assisted system is genuinely working — designing evaluations, questioning flattering results, and reviewing AI-generated code for correctness
Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration; able to work directly with non-technical users to turn their needs into working software  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience designing a shared data model or service that multiple applications depend on
* Experience preparing data for retrieval or agentic use, where the data's shape rather than the prompt was what made it work
* Experience modeling complex hierarchical data, such as product structures or bills of materials
* Experience connecting documents and engineering artifacts into structured workflows
* Prior experience building software in, or in direct support of, a manufacturing, aerospace, hardware production, or operations environment
* Familiarity with manufacturing execution systems (MES), work-order/work-instruction authoring systems, or PLM — or a demonstrated habit of learning a domain deeply before building for it
* Experience building internal tools that other engineers or operators actually adopted
Experience with lakehouse and analytics platforms (e.g., Databricks, Spark SQL)  

  
  

Base Pay Range for:

WA applicants is $164,652.00 - $230,512.80

**Other site ranges may differ**

  

**Culture Statement**

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Meanwhile, you’ll have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen. The **Engineering Manager, Embedded Firmware & Electrical Engineering (IoT Connectivity)** will lead a team of embedded firmware, electrical, and connectivity engineers focused on designing and delivering new connected products. You will be responsible for the device connectivity architecture and strategy, strategic roadmap planning, resource allocation and scope management, oversight of technical reviews and design decisions, and process improvement and change management. This includes working in a team environment with marketing, project management, cloud and mobile software, mechanical engineering, and global manufacturing operations. This position will sit at our Headquarters in Brookfield, Wisconsin.

-------------------------------------------------------------------

* Build, manage, and motivate a world-class team of embedded firmware and electrical engineers to deliver new-to-world connected products.

* Own the connectivity architecture for Milwaukee Tool devices, including BLE, Wi-Fi, cellular (LTE-M/NB-IoT), and other wireless protocols, spanning hardware, firmware, and cloud/mobile interfaces.

* Lead the end-to-end design of embedded IoT devices, from concept, requirements, and architecture through schematic/PCB design, firmware development, validation, and transition to global manufacturing.

* Define IoT firmware strategy, including RTOS/Linux platforms, bootloaders, secure boot, over-the-air (OTA) updates, device provisioning, and fleet-management capabilities.

* Drive device security and compliance practices, including secure key storage, encrypted communication, vulnerability management, and regulatory certification (FCC, IC, CE/RED, Bluetooth SIG, and carrier).

* Own RF and wireless performance, including antenna design/selection, coexistence, range, throughput, and power-consumption trade-offs in battery-powered and harsh jobsite environments.

* Organize and align across product teams and commercial managers to develop a robust connected-product strategy and development roadmap.

* Drive communication with marketing, product teams, and platform engineering to capture the voice of the customer and translate it into connectivity features and user experiences.

* Grow the team to increase project capacity while maintaining exemplary performance; recruit, develop, and retain top embedded and connectivity talent.

* Create and manage robust project roadmaps and resource plans with converged scope; drive urgency in schedules and accountability for key project metrics.

* Champion firmware and hardware development processes (CI/CD, automated and hardware-in-the-loop testing, code review, requirements traceability, and release management) suited to connected products.

* Mentor and coach the team in engineering best practices including task management, root cause analysis, firmware design, circuit/PCB design, simulation, and PCBA manufacturing.

* Lead the development of test plans, procedures, and test cases for embedded systems and connectivity subsystems, including interoperability, field, and certification testing.

* Lead technology investigations, develop system requirements, and define future architectures and reusability strategies, including common connectivity stacks and shared building blocks across products and platforms.

* Maintain strong awareness of competitive offerings, emerging wireless/IoT standards, and the business climate to shape a best-in-class roadmap.

* Quickly, effectively, and candidly frame up and escalate business risks and opportunities to senior leadership.

Identify new innovations and strategic opportunities, including edge intelligence/ML, while considering financial impact and competitiveness.  

  

**What TOOLS you’ll bring with you:**
-------------------------------------

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**  
  
Shift: First Shift

MGS has an exciting opportunity for a **Controls Software Engineer** to join our **MGS****Automation** team.

As a **Controls Software Engineer** at MGS, you will be responsible on control systems for pharmaceutical and medical device equipment - PLC application code, machine HMI, device and motion integration, and the data and validation layers that make equipment production and audit ready. Working within project teams and established software standards, the role focuses on writing clean, maintainable machine software on challenging, diverse projects.

Below are additional duties and responsibilities:

* Execute the software design, development, and debug of multi-station automated assembly and test systems
* Design, structure, and develop PLC application code on Rockwell (Studio 5000), Beckhoff (TwinCAT) or similar - clean, modular, reusable, and well-documented
* Architect machine software: state machines, sequencing, fault handling, and standard/reusable code frameworks
* Develop machine HMI applications (Beckhoff or Ignition) for operator interaction, data collection, and traceability
* Program and integrate peripheral devices (servo/motion drives, robotics, vision and inspection systems, smart sensors, and other field hardware)
* Design and program equipment to customer and internal build specifications, applying established design standards and techniques
* Develop software design specifications from requirements
* Apply software engineering best practices across controls deliverables: version control (Git - GitHub / Azure DevOps), branching/merging, code review, and configuration management
* Build structured software testing and validation
* Develop machine-level data, traceability, and integration features for production and audit readiness
* Translate electrical and I/O designs into robust, maintainable control software, and assist with that design work as project needs require
* Support customer start-ups and site acceptance testing as necessary
* Partner with mechanical, project management, and quality teams across the project lifecycle
* Serve as a software point of contact for customers on controls-related aspects of projects
Any other duties as assigned.  

**Experience and Skills:**

A qualified **Controls Software Engineer** candidate would fulfill these requirements:

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field; a two-year technical program in a related field, combined with relevant hands-on experience, is an acceptable alternative
* 3+ years of software development experience, including industrial controls programming, or strong software engineering experience with demonstrated aptitude to learn PLC platforms
* Strong programming fundamentals: modular/structured design, state machines, Boolean logic, data structures, and software testing and validation
* Hands-on experience programming industrial PLCs on Rockwell (Studio 5000) and/or Beckhoff (TwinCAT), or equivalent software experience with a clear path to ramp on these platforms
* HMI development experience (Beckhoff, Ignition, or comparable)
* Experience using version control (Git) in a collaborative, multi-developer environment
* Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills, and a documentation-minded approach to code
* CI/CD or DevOps practice and automated/structured testing
* Industrial Automation standard language experience (IEC 61131-1) / structured-text and ladder logic programming
* Vision systems, servo/motion control, and robotics integration

As a global provider of healthcare manufacturing solutions, MGS provides the right balance to drive vital innovations: robust end-to-end solutions combined with the strong customer focus and seamless collaboration of an agile partner. Come join Apple's growing wireless silicon development team. Our wireless SoC organization is responsible for all aspects of wireless silicon development, with a particular emphasis on highly energy-efficient design and new technologies that transform the user experience at the product level. All of this is driven by a world-class vertically integrated engineering team spanning RF/Analog architecture and design, Systems/PHY/MAC architecture and design, VLSI/RTL design and integration, Emulation, Design Verification, Test and Validation, and FW/SW engineering. In this role, you will help de-risk our silicon well ahead of tape-out by owning the pre-silicon emulation environment that enables the team to exercise and verify new designs early and with confidence. We are looking for a wireless PHY systems engineer for this role: your understanding of the full signal chain, from RF and PHY through MAC and firmware, will help ensure that each emulated design not only comes up but behaves as intended. Prior Palladium experience is not required, and we will help the right candidate ramp up on the platform. If you enjoy a fast-paced and challenging environment, collaborate with people across different functional areas, and thrive during crisis times, we encourage you to apply.  
  
**Description**  
  
This role is central to Apple's pre-silicon verification effort for wireless SoCs, centered on the Palladium emulation platform. You will be the first to bring up each newly released emulation build, and you will design and own the framework and infrastructure - register maps, initialization and boot sequences, clock and reset, and system-level configuration - that brings the emulated SoC into an operational state and enables the wider team to run their own design verification. Sustain, extend, and maintain this emulation infrastructure across multiple silicon generations, establishing it as a long-lived, reusable platform rather than a per-project effort.  
  
Support pre-silicon emulation efforts for silicon validation, including test development, debug, and performance characterization on emulation platforms.

Digital design fundamentals and a solid understanding of SoC architecture and system-level hardware/software interaction.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Relling:** Relling (YC S25) builds ready-to-deploy robot workcells for US manufacturers. We design and test in San Francisco and put systems to work on factory floors. This is a full-time, in-person role in Potrero Hill, San Francisco.
  
  
**What you'll do:** Design, build and wire control panels for robotic workcells, from schematics and panel layout through wiring, labeling and documentation. Select and integrate power distribution, motor drives and servo amplifiers, PLCs, safety relays and controllers, sensors, I/O and industrial networks such as EtherCAT and EtherNet/IP. Design wiring harnesses and cable routing for robots and end-of-arm tooling, and design and bring up custom PCBs where off-the-shelf parts fall short. Commission cells on the factory floor, troubleshoot electrical faults under real production conditions, and make sure every system is safe, serviceable and built to code.
  
  
**What we're looking for:** Hands-on experience designing and building electrical systems you can explain end to end, such as control panels, harnesses, power electronics or PCBs. Strong fundamentals in circuits, power, grounding and shielding, and comfort with schematic and layout tools (e.g. EPLAN, AutoCAD Electrical, KiCad or Altium). Familiarity with industrial standards and machine safety (NFPA 79, UL 508A, safety-rated circuits) is a strong plus. A practical approach to debugging: measurements, root causes and validation.
  
  
**How to apply:** Apply with your resume and a short description of an electrical system you built or shipped. Project links are optional. Tell us what you owned, what failed and how you tested the fix.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer - Apple Reference Image
jobs.description:
Reference Image is one of Apple's most ambitious end-to-end security and imaging initiatives: a system that lets users cryptographically verify that a photo genuinely came from an Apple device sensor, unaltered. It spans everything from the image sensor, through on-device capture and RAW pipelines, to Private Cloud Compute (PCC) processing and signing, all the way to viewing and sharing experiences across iOS and macOS.  
  
We're looking for a Systems Engineer to join the Reference Image team and own key pieces of the technical architecture and cross-stack integration, someone who can reason across hardware security, cloud infrastructure, and application-layer behavior. You'll work under the guidance of the project DRI, taking ownership of specific systems-level work streams while helping drive alignment across a distributed, multi-team effort toward a coherent, secure, and shippable system.  
  
**Description**  
  
In this role you’ll be expected to:  
  

* Contribute to and help maintain the systems architecture for Reference Image, spanning sensor-level signing, on-device RAW capture pipelines, and cloud-based development in PCC.

  

* Contribute to the design and implementation of cryptographic key rotation, certificate lifecycle management, and revocation frameworks.

  

* Work closely with Security and Privacy teams to help threat-model end-to-end media authenticity workflows, evaluating cryptographic integrity, data privacy, and downstream non-destructive edit handling.

  

* Help evaluate and advance standard and extended image container formats to support secure provenance and authenticity metadata.

  

* Coordinate with PCC/Cloud infrastructure teams on specific integration points to ensure the signing and certificate infrastructure scales and meets the security bar.

  

* Represent your work stream's technical tradeoffs in cross-functional forums (Photos, Camera Capture, ISP/hardware, QA, Privacy, Legal, Marketing), proactively identifying and resolving cross-team technical dependencies and blockers.

  

* Contribute to scoping and planning for future hardware generations under the direction of the DRI.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  
Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, still-evolving system with real security stakes and public-facing implications (e.g., newsroom/wire-service use cases).  
  
Capable of coding to fill functional gaps in the team.  
  
Familiarity with trusted time stamping mechanisms and their role in establishing chain-of-custody for signed data.  
  
Experience working on flagship security or trust features that ship across multiple operating systems.  
  
Familiarity with international privacy/regulatory considerations affecting feature availability by region.  
  
Experience standing up or evolving 3rd-party applications involving sensitive capabilities.  
  
Familiarity with certificate management practices, including issuance, validation, and revocation workflows.  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
  
BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field and 5+ years of experience in industry.  
  
Familiarity with cryptographic signing/verification concepts (certificates, secure boot, key management, revocation) and comfort partnering closely with Security/Privacy teams.  
  
Experience with image/media pipelines (RAW processing, ISP behavior, DNG/JPEG/HEIF formats) is a strong plus.  
  
Experience with distributed cloud infrastructure and confidential compute environments (PCC or similar) preferred.  
  
Ability to work effectively across many stakeholder teams (hardware, platform software, cloud, privacy, legal, QA) on ambiguous, evolving requirements, while keeping the project DRI informed of key tradeoffs and risks.  
  
Strong communicator who can translate deep technical tradeoffs into clear guidance for both engineering and non-engineering stakeholders (e.g., legal, marketing, support).  
  
**Pay & Benefits**  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $150,400 and $277,600, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  
  
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses - including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits

jobs.title: (1109256) Autonomy Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Diversified Services Network, Inc. (DSN) is seeking a full-time **Autonomy Systems Engineer** to join our **fully onsite** team that's split between two locations in **Mossville** & **Peoria**, IL. We offer full benefits, PTO, 401k, and more! If you're looking to grow your career within an extremely reputable, stable Fortune 100 company - let's talk!

Position Overview

As an **Autonomy Systems Engineer** on the Surface Loading Autonomy team, you will help develop the next generation of autonomous machines for the construction industry, including excavators, wheel loaders, and articulated trucks. You will be responsible for integrating autonomy solutions with the base machine – helping define the requirements and system architecture that bring autonomous machine systems together, working hands-on with a wide range of onboard electronics in both lab and on-machine environments, and coordinating with other teams to implement, validate, and demonstrate autonomous solutions.

Team & Work Environment

* Onsite position, split between hands-on machine work at the proving ground and office-based work
* Part of a 6–10 person engineering team supporting a larger autonomy program with team members across multiple locations
* PPE (safety glasses, safety shoes, and reflective vest) will be provided

Key Responsibilities

* Install, commission, and test autonomy hardware on machine
* Flash software on machine and validate proper functionality
* Support prototype and test machine builds and updates
* Perform live monitoring of CAN and Ethernet traffic on the machine and validate data
* Troubleshoot connectivity and data issues as they arise, including debugging and correcting wiring, harness, sensor, positioning-system, and time synchronization issues
* Partner with machine development teams, on machine, to determine the best way to deliver autonomous features and resolve issues
* Lead or support system integration, functional testing, and validation activities
* Decompose customer requirements into system-level technical requirements
* Document system architecture, design decisions, and success criteria with clear traceability, ensuring understanding and compliance across subsystem teams
* Coordinate activities across autonomy development, machine system development, and machine validation teams, including global team members
* Communicate system readiness, technical risk, designs, and trade-offs between time, resources, and quality to stakeholders at multiple levels
* Help develop and execute standard work
* Serve as a subject matter expert for surface loading machine autonomous solutions

Team & Work Environment

* Collaborate with a local team of 3-6 engineers, with the opportunity to work alongside other US-based teams
* Split time between an office setting and an on-site proving ground (approximately 20%)
* Personal protective equipment (PPE) will be provided for work at the proving ground

 **Requirements**

**Required Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field from an accredited institution **AND** 5–7 years of professional experience
* **OR** Master’s degree **AND** full 5 years of experience

**Required Qualifications**

* Proven experience as a Systems Engineer supporting product development of autonomous machines, including the integration of hardware and software
* Experience collaborating with systems integration and validation teams to validate hardware and software both in the lab and on machine
* Knowledge of and experience with construction equipment such as articulated dump trucks, hydraulic excavators, and wheel loaders
* Proven ability to support production products through design, implementation, customer rollout, and support
* Experience with autonomy hardware, including vision systems (camera, lidar, radar), GNSS, and IMU
* Knowledge of on-machine electrical systems and best practices, including harnessing and wiring
* Experience integrating autonomy protocols and software, including CAN, Ethernet, and ROS2
* Strong working knowledge of centralized machine command and control system architectures in mining or construction
* Uses data-driven arguments, active listening, and tailored messaging to influence decisions and build consensus, while keeping leadership and external partners informed
* Very detail oriented, able to work independently and as part of a team, and stays current on advancements in the autonomy and mining industries

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in an autonomy-related field
* Experience in the construction or mining industry
* Knowledge of C++ and software development for autonomous systems

  
**Benefits**  

* 401(k)

* Dental insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Disability insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Paid Holidays
