jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Verustruct is developing a suite of robotic construction technologies to automate the building of affordable, sustainable, safe, and aesthetically appealing housing. The company’s mission is to help close the U.S. housing gap of 4.5 million homes by transforming how residential structures are designed and built. Verustruct focuses on integrating advanced robotics, automation, and novel construction methods into practical, scalable solutions. Team members collaborate across disciplines to bring next-generation construction systems from concept to field deployment, with a strong emphasis on real-world impact and long-term sustainability.

**About the Role**

Build the electrical systems that turn robotic construction devices into reliable, autonomous machines.

Verustruct is hiring a Senior Electrical Engineer to own electrical architecture and subsystem development for our robotic construction platform. You will take systems from requirements and circuit design through board bring-up, embedded integration, machine testing, and field deployment.

Our robots combine motors, actuators, sensors, embedded controllers, and construction processes in a demanding physical environment. You will make those systems operate predictably together, with particular attention to power integrity, communications, fault handling, serviceability, and safe machine behavior.

This is a hands-on technical ownership role with opportunities to mentor engineers and shape the electrical team’s standards as we grow. It is full-time and on-site in Torrance, California.

**What You'll Do**

* Define electrical architectures, subsystem requirements, power budgets, and interfaces across robotic formwork, locomotion, material delivery, consolidation, and auxiliary tools.
* Own custom electronics from component selection and schematic capture through PCB layout, fabrication, assembly, bring-up, and revision.
* Develop power-distribution, motor-control, actuator-interface, and sensor-interface hardware, including appropriate protection, grounding, shielding, and thermal management.
* Write, review, and debug embedded C/C++ on STM32-class microcontrollers for sensing, actuator control, communications, diagnostics, and fault handling.
* Define and validate CAN/CAN FD network architecture, including physical topology, termination, message interfaces, bus loading, and recovery behavior.
* Design harnesses, connector interfaces, electrical enclosures, and service features for equipment exposed to vibration, dust, moisture, and electrically noisy loads.
* Partner with controls and software engineers to define timing requirements, operating states, watchdog behavior, and responses to communication or component failures.
* Develop emergency-stop, interlock, and power-isolation architectures in coordination with system safety requirements and the broader engineering team.
* Create verification plans, test fixtures, and automated tests that demonstrate electrical performance and fault response at board, subsystem, and machine levels.
* Lead electrical integration and root-cause investigation, using measured evidence to resolve intermittent and cross-disciplinary failures.
* Own electrical release documentation and design reviews, support suppliers and manufacturing partners, and mentor junior engineers.

**Requirements**
----------------

**What We're Looking For**

* Substantial electrical product-development experience, typically 7+ years, with ownership of complex electromechanical systems.
* Demonstrated delivery of custom electronics from design through working hardware and integrated system testing.
* Strong fundamentals in analog and digital electronics, power conversion and distribution, motor drives, signal integrity, and circuit protection.
* Proficiency in schematic capture and PCB design using KiCad, Altium, or comparable tools.
* Practical embedded C/C++ experience and the ability to debug hardware and firmware together.
* Experience integrating motors, actuators, encoders, sensors, and communications such as CAN, SPI, I2C, and UART.
* Strong bench skills with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, debuggers, electronic loads, and other electrical test equipment.
* Experience with harness design, grounding, shielding, and troubleshooting noise or power-related failures in operating machines.
* Clear technical communication, sound design-review judgment, and a willingness to work directly on prototype hardware.
* A degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Benefits**
------------

Benefits include:

* **Health insurance:** Silver PPO plan, 80% company-paid, with optional dental and vision coverage
* **Retirement:** 401(k) plan with 4% employer match
* **Time off:** Flexible PTO policy and observed federal holidays
* **Relocation support:** Available for exceptional candidates relocating to the Los Angeles / Torrance area
* **High-ownership role:** Opportunity to help lead mechanical engineering for a venture-backed robotics company tackling housing affordability

Compensation Range: $160K - $205K

jobs.title: Systems Engineer - Sentinel

Auria is seeking an experienced **System Engineer (SE) – All Levels** to support the Sentinel program (formerly called the Ground Based Strategic Deterrent - GBSD). This position is in Huntsville, AL. The candidate has a unique opportunity to join a true development team and contribute to the engineering design of our nation’s next-generation Intercontinental Ballistic Missile (ICBM) system. Auria supports the Air Force’s sustainment, development, production and deployment of hardware and system modifications for the ICBM Ground and Airborne Launch Control Systems, Launch Facilities, and associated infrastructure. **This position’s standard work schedule is a 9/80.** The 9/80 schedule allows employees to work nine-hour days, which creates a three-day weekend every other week. **This position is 100% on-site at a contractor facility in the Colorado Springs, CO area. Relocation assistance is available.**

**WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT TO DO:**

As a System Engineer (SE) you will be assigned to an Agile Scrum Team supporting the Command & Launch (C&L) segment of the Sentinel program, and the Command and Control (C2) Software Team. You will be responsible for supporting C2 Software Team system engineering activities associated with capability buildup for the Sentinel Flight Test Campaign. You will support a team of engineers to define, develop, decompose, analyze, verify, and validate architectures and requirements. In this role, you will be supporting program leadership and the customer to define and maintain the C&L technical baseline. You will support the program through SE artifact maturity and milestones. You will utilize Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) principles to model various processes, tools, and activities that span the entire program.

As a System Engineer, you will be a pivotal member of the C2 Software Team. This position requires an engineer who is accountable to the team, customer, program management, and program leadership. Responsibilities will include:

* Technical Contributions: Support the C2 technical software requirements baseline, ensuring alignment with program goals and objectives.
* Teaming and Collaboration: Support fellow C2 Software Team members in agile software requirements development, fostering growth in critical program efforts.
* Execution: Support technical execution in support of major program events, collaborating within and across the program portfolio.
* Systems Challenges: Support focus on resolving high-level systems challenges, ensuring the execution of the overall technical plan within the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS).
* Strategic Initiatives: Support strategic initiatives on tools, processes, and cross-segment technical reviews, driving technical rigor into technical interchange meetings.
* Perform requirements analysis, review and document source data for requirements, generate requirements verification, and work with suppliers and internal teams to ensure products designed meet requirements.
* Interface with subject matter experts, analysts, architects, designers, system engineers and specialty engineers to capture Sentinel Node structure and behavior across SysML/UML frameworks.
* Apply the principles of engineering to design components and systems using applicable standards and specifications.

jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview:

At The Marzetti Company, our mission is to make every meal better through high-quality, flavorful food. The Automation & Controls Engineer is a hands-on technical resource responsible for the reliability, improvement, integration, and cybersecurity of automation systems across food processing, packaging, plant utilities, and facility infrastructure.

Working with a high degree of independence, this role supports day-to-day production, resolves complex controls issues, modernizes legacy systems, and delivers automation projects that improve safety, food quality, throughput, equipment uptime, and the operator experience. The engineer partners closely with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Quality and Food Safety, Continuous Improvement, Information Technology, and external OEMs and system integrators.

Technology Environment:

* **PLC and machine control:** Allen-Bradley/Rockwell Automation ControlLogix and CompactLogix using Studio 5000; additional platforms may include ABB, Bosch Rexroth, Mitsubishi, Omron, and Siemens.
* **Visualization and manufacturing systems:** Ignition SCADA and historian capabilities, FactoryTalk View, ThinManager, and manufacturing execution systems (MES).
* **Connectivity and data:** EtherNet/IP, OPC UA, Modbus TCP/RTU, MQTT, Profibus, IO-Link, Microsoft SQL Server, database interfaces, and Python scripting.
* **OT infrastructure:** Managed industrial switches, VLANs, segmented OT networks, firewall rules, Claroty xDome Secure Access for secure remote access, role-based access control, and Purdue Model/five-layer OT architecture.
* **Plant systems:** Processing and packaging equipment, robotics, servo and motion systems, VFDs, instrumentation, building management systems, and plant utility systems.

Responsibilities What You'll Do:

**Automation & Controls Engineering**

* Program, troubleshoot, maintain, and optimize PLC-based control systems, with primary emphasis on Allen-Bradley/Rockwell Automation ControlLogix and CompactLogix platforms using Studio 5000.
* Support and troubleshoot other controls platforms deployed within the facility, which may include ABB, Bosch Rexroth, Mitsubishi, Omron, and Siemens systems.
* Develop, maintain, and improve SCADA/HMI applications using Ignition and FactoryTalk, including tag structures, alarms, trends, historian data, reports, recipes, security roles, and operator interfaces.

jobs.description:
**Your Job**

Molex is offering a highly visible role for a Signal Integrity Systems Engineer, and you will design leading-edge solutions for the data services industry, influence next-generation active cable platforms using innovative chips in coordination with engineers from various disciplines.

You will also work closely with our Hyperscale customers and marketing teams to understand the customer's application needs and translate them into best-in-class winning solutions. You may also spend firsthand time on Molex lab facilities and deliver innovative development solutions supporting our products and driving revenue.

**Our Team**

Molex, a subsidiary of Koch Industries, creates connectivity solutions that enable technologies to transform the future and improve lives. With operations in more than 40 countries, Molex offers connectivity products, services, and solutions for the data communications, medical, industrial, automotive, and consumer electronics industries. We do more than develop customer solutions-we create connections for life.

Molex is looking for a Signal Integrity Systems Engineer to support and develop Active cable designs for Hyperscalers. Our business is witnessing tremendous growth owing to an increasing need for Artificial Intelligence and data transfer rates. You will be working under leadership that has been setting and driving industry standards in data centers for more than 30 years.

**What You Will Do**

* Own system-level SI analysis for high-speed channels including AEC, ACC, DAC, connectors, and PCB interconnects.
* Develop and analyze end-to-end channels for 112G and 224G PAM4 applications.

* Hands-on experience with VNA, TDR/TDT, high-speed oscilloscopes, and BERTs.

* Experience with Python, MATLAB, or similar scripting environments for SI data analysis.
* Experience with 112G/224G PAM4 or similar high-speed SerDes.
* Experience with AEC/ACC/DAC cables and high-speed connectors.
* Experience with IBIS-AMI modeling and simulation.
* Understanding of IEEE, OIF, and/or relevant industry specifications.
* Experience with CMIS, QSFP, OSFP, or other pluggable optical/electrical interfaces.
* Experience correlating simulation models with physical measurements.
* Experience with automated SI data processing using Python.
* Strong problem-solving and cross-functional communication skills.

You’ll join a collaborative team building state‑of‑the‑art power electronics—closed‑loop power supplies, EMI filters, high‑efficiency conversion stages—and guide designs from concept through qualification. This hands‑on role spans power conversion systems, magnetics, EMI mitigation, and PFC solutions, offering opportunities to innovate at every stage of the hardware lifecycle.

As a **Senior Electrical Engineer**, you will apply deep expertise in switching converters, magnetics, control loops, manufacturability, and testability to deliver high‑reliability aerospace hardware. **Potential Onsite Locations:**  

* Cedar Rapids, IA
* Fort Wayne, IN

* Perform circuit analysis, modeling, simulation, and component selection aligned to system requirements.
* Generate engineering documentation: requirements, design descriptions, schematics, BOMs, and test plans.
* Support integration, verification, validation, and qualification testing new and existing designs.
* Partner closely with Systems, Mechanical, Software, Manufacturing and Digital Hardware teams throughout the product lifecycle.
* Diagnose and solve issues related to power conversion performance, reliability, EMI/EMC, and thermal behavior.
* Ensure adherence to aerospace standards and mission assurance expectations.
* Mentor junior engineers and support a culture of technical excellence.

* Hands-on design expertise with power supply topologies (buck, boost, flyback, forward, resonant, PFC, etc.).
* Strong understanding of power supply control schemes, including differences between peak current mode and voltage mode control, with the ability to design appropriate compensation, place poles/zeros, and evaluate converter stability.
* Thorough understanding of EMC/EMI requirements, associated mitigation techniques, and designing power systems to meet regulatory standards.
* Experience in schematic capture and PCB design for power supplies.
* Ability to perform power electronics simulations.
* Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and minimum 5 years prior relevant experience **or**an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 3 years of experience
* The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance

**Qualifications We Prefer:**

* Experience across a range of power levels and switching frequencies in DC/DC and AC/DC power conversion.
* Power supply design experience from 10 W to multi-kW.

* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to all audiences.
* Expertise in digital control, complex topologies such as phase-shifted bridge or LLC, and designing protection features (over voltage, undervoltage, overcurrent, etc.).
* Experience selecting appropriate COTS magnetics, with the ability to design custom inductors or transformers when needed.

* Proficient in selecting and integrating key power components with consideration for thermal stress, derating, and overall thermal management.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**

We are seeking a Broadcast Media Systems Software Engineer with a strong focus on data streaming and real-time processing platforms to help design, build, and operate scalable, high-throughput, low-latency systems. This role will work on distributed systems that ingest, process, and deliver streaming data used for analytics, machine learning, monitoring, and mission-critical applications. You will collaborate closely with data engineers, platform engineers, product teams, and infrastructure to ensure reliability, performance, and scalability across streaming pipelines.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain scalable data streaming pipelines
* Develop and operate transport and broadcast media related architectures
* Implement custom transport logic and socket architectures to handle high-throughput packet and frame-level media streams
* Optimize systems for throughput, latency, and resource efficiency
* Participate in capacity planning and performance tuning
* Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and metrics for streaming applications
* Integrate and customize open-source media frameworks including FFmpeg, GStreamer, and TSDuck into proprietary streaming ecosystems.
* Implement low-level wrappers and APIs using C, C++, or Rust to interface directly with core networking and hardware-accelerated video codecs.
* Ensure strict stream compliance, packet ordering, fault tolerance, and frame-accurate timing across all linear playout systems.
* Optimize media software for CPU cache locality, minimal memory allocation, zero-copy data paths, and overall resource efficiency.
* Implement robust monitoring, logging, and metrics specifically tailored for packet-level streaming health, jitter, and transport stream analytics.
* Debug production issues related to packet loss, latency spikes, frame corruption, backpressure, or clock drift.
* Support on-call rotations and incident response for critical data systems
* Collaborate with broadcast engineering teams to build, integrate, and test streaming, MAMs, playout, automations, and graphics systems.
* Collaborate with product, analytics, and ML teams to support new use cases
* Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code
* Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and technical discussions
* Contribute to documentation and engineering best practices

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 3+ years of professional software engineering experience.
* Systems Programming: 2+ years of hands-on experience programming real-time applications at the Low-Level / Packet Level using C, C++, or Rust.
* Must be highly comfortable with manual memory management, pointer manipulation, and multi-threaded optimizations.
* Strong experience in a modern concurrency language like Go or Python for stream orchestration, tooling, and control-plane API development.
* Network Protocols: Deep, foundational understanding of UDP and TCP/IP networking mechanics. Direct experience managing socket programming, custom congestion control, packet pacing, and error correction techniques (ARQ / selective retransmission).
* Media Transport: Proven experience with broadcast and linear video workflows, including media containers and multiplexing (specifically MPEG-TS wrappers).
* Experience building custom stream troubleshooting, diagnostic, or real-time monitoring software.
* Codecs: Codec-agnostic architecture mindset with low-level implementation knowledge of H.264/AVC, H.265/HEVC, and emerging standards like AV1.
* Automation & Scripting: Strong scripting capabilities in Python or Bash for stream orchestration, pipeline automation, and local-first systems management.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct development experience with libsrt, librist, RTMP, or similar APIs.
* Deep familiarity with open-source media frameworks like FFmpeg, Astreamer, GStreamer, TSDuck and low level packet streaming tools.
* Experience using network analysis tools to debug packet loss, jitter, clock drift, and MTU issues on live networks.
* Familiarity with broader broadcast media components, including automation protocols, digital playout systems, on-air graphics engines, and Media Asset Management (MAM) platforms.
* Familiarity with AWS, GCP, or Azure specifically regarding networking components (firewall traversal, listener/caller architecture, and high-bandwidth ingress).
* Lightweight containerization experience or portable streaming endpoints or edge-compute tools.
* Knowledge of serialization formats (like Protobuf or JSON) strictly for control-plane APIs and performance telemetry aggregation.

Its teams will work side-by-side with customers to co-design, deploy, and continuously improve AI systems that deliver measurable, customer-defined outcomes. jobs.description:
Join our Deloitte AI & Engineering team to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.  
  
**Work You'll Do**  
  
As a Project Software Engineer II on the HCI team, you will join the infrastructure team supporting a new unified importer identity and onboarding platform - providing full visibility across every importer entity and individual applying on its behalf, all running on AWS.  
  
You'll design, build, and operate cloud infrastructure for identity verification, biometric matching, and ACE Portal integration, working alongside developers, identity/policy specialists, and stakeholders through Release 1, Release 2, and ongoing O&M. You will work on core AWS infrastructure supporting a mobile identity-verification app, Salesforce orchestration, and ACE Portal integration, as well as biometric/identity services, including hosting and scaling Iprove (facial recognition/liveness) within AWS environment. In addition, integration infrastructure connecting to ATS/NVC (vetting), Salesforce, and ACE. Environments supporting Release 1 (Year 1 launch) and Release 2 running in parallel with steady-state O&M. Security infrastructure supporting the ATO process - access controls, audit logging, encryption for a system handling PII and biometric data. Scheduling/appointment infrastructure for background check and fingerprinting workflows, if in scope.  
  
**Key Responsibilities** :  

* Design and maintain AWS infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CloudFormation)
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines across two concurrent release tracks. Configure networking, IAM, and security groups per federal requirements
* Stand up and scale compute for biometric/ML workloads under real onboarding volume
* Implement monitoring/logging/alerting (CloudWatch) to support O&M
* Support integration between AWS-hosted services, Salesforce, ATS/NVC, and ACE
* Support ATO documentation and audits (access control evidence, data flow diagrams, encryption, vulnerability scanning)
Collaborate with identity/policy stakeholders on credentialing infrastructure. Support patching, tuning, and capacity planning as the platform scales

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships

* Ability to meet deadlines

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. jobs.title: Embedded Real Time Operating System Staff Software Engineer (QuRT OS, Zephyr)
jobs.description:
**Company:**
------------

Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.

**Job Area:**
-------------

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > DSP Architecture and Design

**General Summary:**

**General Summary**

Qualcomm is seeking a Staff Embedded Software Engineer (6+ years of experience) to join the Core Platform Kernel software team. The Core Platform Kernel team develops and deploys real-time operating system (RTOS) software across multiple subsystems on Qualcomm SoCs, servicing Mobile Handset, XR, Compute, Automotive, Cloud AI, and IoT market segments. The team is responsible for the deployment and evolution of two RTOS platforms at scale: QuRT OS and Zephyr RTOS.

  

As part of Qualcomm's continued investment in open source software, this role will help drive our Zephyr strategy and serve as a technical leader for Qualcomm's engagement with the Zephyr ecosystem. We are specifically seeking engineers who can contribute to and help maintain upstream Zephyr components while enabling Zephyr deployment across Qualcomm products. This role is well suited for engineers who enjoy deep technical work, influence system architecture, collaborate across organizational boundaries, and have a passion for building software that benefits both Qualcomm products and the broader open-source community.

  

What You'll Do As a Staff Engineer, you will:

* Design, implement, and maintain RTOS and low-level system software components.
* Own and drive resolution of complex system-level issues involving performance, stability, scalability, and correctness.
* Lead feature development from problem definition through deployment.
* Analyze crash dumps, traces, and logs to perform deep root-cause analysis.
* Collaborate closely with hardware, systems, validation, and software teams to deliver robust solutions.
* Participate actively in design and code reviews, influencing technical direction and engineering standards.
* Drive Qualcomm's engagement with the Zephyr open-source community through technical discussions, code reviews, and upstream collaboration.
* Mentor engineers on upstream development practices, code quality, and community engagement.
Influence technical roadmaps, architecture decisions, and software quality initiatives across the organization.  

  

You will be expected to take ownership of key technical areas, make sound engineering tradeoffs, and help raise the effectiveness of the broader team through technical leadership and example. QuRT OS QuRT OS is Qualcomm's real-time operating system optimized for the Hexagon DSP, enabling high-performance, low-power workloads including edge AI, modem processing, audio, sensor processing, and other specialized compute workloads. In the QuRT OS space, you will:

* Drive enhancements to expose the full capability of the Hexagon processor architecture.
* Design and implement new RTOS features with attention to correctness, performance, and maintainability.
* Own features end-to-end: requirements, architecture, implementation, testing, documentation, integration, and support.
Improve CI, automation, and test infrastructure to increase development velocity and software quality.  

  

Zephyr RTOS The Core Platform Kernel team is a major adopter of Zephyr RTOS across Qualcomm SoCs and subsystems. We maintain a scalable Zephyr platform while contributing improvements back to the upstream community. This role is focused on technical leadership, stewardship, and upstream engineering within the Zephyr ecosystem. Successful candidates will possess a strong understanding of RTOS architecture, embedded systems, and open-source development practices. In the Zephyr space, you will:

* Serve as a maintainer or technical owner for key Zephyr subsystems, drivers, platform infrastructure, or architecture components.
* Review, guide, and integrate contributions from both internal and external developers.
* Design and implement new Zephyr capabilities with an emphasis on upstream acceptance and long-term maintainability.
* Lead architecture discussions and influence technical direction within the Zephyr project.
* Drive Qualcomm's upstream contribution strategy and ensure internal development aligns with community best practices.
* Collaborate with maintainers and contributors from other companies across the Zephyr ecosystem.
* Enable Zephyr deployment across Qualcomm platforms through board support packages, architecture enablement, driver development, and system software integration.
* Improve testing, CI infrastructure, release readiness, and software quality across upstream and Qualcomm-maintained components.
* Represent Qualcomm in technical working groups, design reviews, and community discussions.
Help shape the future evolution of Zephyr through upstream contributions, reviews, and technical leadership.  

  

**How You Work (Tools, Automation & Modern Engineering)**

Staff Engineers at Qualcomm are expected to be force multipliers, not just individual contributors. In practice, this means:

* Applying modern development tools, including AI-assisted tools, when they meaningfully improve productivity or code quality.
* Leveraging automation, scripting, CI systems, debuggers, profilers, static analysis tools, and simulation environments to improve engineering effectiveness.
* Exercising strong engineering judgment regarding when automation is appropriate and when deeper hands-on investigation is required.
Continuously identifying opportunities to improve engineering workflows, developer productivity, and software quality.  

  

You are not expected to be an AI expert, but you are expected to be tool-fluent, curious, adaptable, and pragmatic.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.

OR
  
Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or relate

jobs.title: Production Systems Engineer, Edge
jobs.description:
Meta's Edge compute fleet - around 162,000 servers in more than 600 locations worldwide - is how our users reach us. Unlike most of Meta's hardware, this fleet doesn't run in our own data centers: it lives in Edge PoPs terminating user connections, and in ISP and cell-service-provider locations running caching for partner networks.The Edge Hardware team is the hardware engineering partner to the Traffic organization that owns this footprint. We are a key partner in hardware selection and qualification, qualify firmware across every component, investigate failures in the deployed fleet, and define the detection and remediation tooling that keeps it healthy. The work sits directly in the user path: a hardware fault we miss becomes a user-visible availability problem. You'd work day to day with an engineer being hired alongside you, and with the team in Dublin who owns the area today - plus the wider Edge and hardware reliability teams, and your Traffic partners, on both coasts.  
  
  

### **Production Systems Engineer, Edge Responsibilities:**

* As a Production Systems Engineer on Edge Hardware, you'll contribute across New Product Introduction and Sustaining work on Meta's Edge compute fleet, taking ownership of well-defined areas and growing your scope as you ramp
* Qualify successive server generations and new platforms into the fleet, and sustain existing generations for the 3–5 years they remain deployed
* Build out failure detection and remediation coverage - new checks, porting existing validation to new vendor hardware, cleaning up noisy checkers that currently create work for partner operations teams
* Help requalify components that have reached end of sale (new NICs, SSDs), unblocking Meta's ability to purchase Edge servers and replace failed parts
* Improve fleet visibility, surfacing failures we currently detect late or not at all
* Take on part of the firmware qualification cadence - NIC, BIOS, BMC, management engine, GPU VBIOS, PSU, flash

* Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Degree must be completed prior to joining Meta

* 2+ years of experience developing automation or tooling in Python, Go, or a comparable scripting or systems programming language for infrastructure or hardware management
* Experience with server or network hardware components including switches, routers, NICs, and compute platforms, including hands-on troubleshooting and failure analysis
* Experience with configuration management, fleet management, or hardware lifecycle tooling in a large-scale data center, edge, or cloud infrastructure environment

* Experience working across time zones and with cross-functional partners in different sites

jobs.title: Vehicle Battery Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

Anduril's Maritime Division is transforming American sea power to meet the defining national security challenges of our era and secure our future of maritime dominance.  
  
We are scaling at a historic pace, anchored by Arsenal-2, our new software-defined shipyard being built in Baltimore County, Maryland. It's part of a new $6.6 billion investment in America's submarine industrial base.  
  
Arsenal-2 is purpose-built to break long-standing industrial bottlenecks and scale production of critical components for the Navy's Virginia-class attack submarines to support fleet requirements. At the same time, it will build the industrial muscle to field our next-generation AUVs at scale.  
  
We aren't waiting for the new shipyard to be completed. The work on this transformation starts right now, with development inside our new 160,000 square foot Proto-Factory in Orange County, California, where the team is already laying the foundation. As the prototyping hub for Arsenal-2, this facility gives us a multi-year head start, proving out the advanced manufacturing methods, digital workflows, and quality systems that will scale across our broader shipyard network.  
  
In Anduril's Maritime Division, we are actively building America's next decisive advantage at sea—and this is the moment to join us.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

You will own energy storage system design for a maritime autonomous vehicle. Reporting to the Vehicle Systems Lead, you will drive cell selection, module design, thermal management, and pressure-rated packaging for battery systems that must deliver ultra-long-range endurance under pressure.  
  
Your spectrum of support will be diverse in nature and require you to leverage your technical expertise as well as leadership skills to set objectives, build cross-functional teams, and rapidly drive to completion. The ability to leverage your intuition and prior experience will be key in making sure the right design, analysis, and test steps are completed to ensure success. The ideal candidate will leverage their experience executing and successfully completing prior highly optimized multi-disciplinary projects.

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Own energy storage architecture: cell chemistry selection, module design, and pack integration
* Design pressure-rated battery enclosures for full-ocean-depth operation
* Perform battery sizing, energy budget analysis, and cycle life modeling
* Drive thermal management design for safe operation across environmental conditions
* Define charging profiles and integration with external charging interfaces
* Interface with energy distribution, structural, and production teams
* Support prototype builds, testing, and design-for-manufacturability reviews
* Contribute to safety analysis for energy storage systems
* Travel up to 25% to test sites and vendor facilities

### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent
* 5+ years of experience in battery system design, energy storage, or power electronics
* Experience with lithium-ion or equivalent high-energy-density battery systems
* Familiarity with battery management systems and thermal management
* Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret security clearance

### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with marine or subsea battery systems
* Working knowledge of battery safety standards (UN38.3, IEC 62619, or military equivalents)
* Experience with pressure-rated enclosure design
* Familiarity with battery modeling and simulation tools
* Experience in defense or maritime robotics

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. Develops software including operating systems, compilers, routers, networks, utilities, databases and Internet-related tools. Determines hardware compatibility and/or influences hardware design.

Contributions impact technical components of HPE products, solutions, or services regularly and sustainable. * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent.
* Typically 6-10 years experience.

* Extensive experience with multiple software systems design tools and languages.
* Excellent analytical and problem solving skills.
* Experience in overall architecture of software systems for products and solutions.

jobs.description:
At Zone 5 Technologies, we're redefining what's possible in unmanned aircraft systems. Our team of engineers and innovators is developing cutting-edge autonomous solutions that push the boundaries of UAS technology - solving complex challenges that matter.

We're building the future of UAS capabilities, and we're looking for exceptional talent to join us. If you're driven by hard problems, energized by rapid innovation, and ready to make an impact on next-generation flight systems, you belong here.

We are seeking a highly motivated Electrical Engineer III/IV to join our team. As an unmanned aerial systems (UAS) company, we are looking for an individual with experience overseeing small projects and wire harness production work, The ideal candidate should have experience producing, diagnosing and troubleshooting wire harnesses circuits in UAS platforms and should be familiar with Altium for documenting wire harness designs.

**Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop and test electrical systems and components for UAS platforms
* Develop and debug microcontroller systems and circuits
* Work with mechanical and software engineers to integrate electrical systems into UAS platforms
* Develop and maintain schematics, wiring diagrams, and documentation for electrical systems in UAS platforms
* Act as the Avionics liaison between engineering and the production line.
* Address and close out non-conformances from the production line.
* Develop and perform electrical tests and test procedures to verify system functionality
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality electrical systems

**Qualifications:**

* BS or MS in Electrical Engineering or a related field and 5+ years of experience
* Experience with diagnosing and troubleshooting circuits in UAS platforms
* Proficiency in Altium for circuit board / harness design
* Knowledge of analog and digital circuits, power supplies, and CAN bus communication
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to work well in a team environment

Expected outcomes:

* 3 Months: Work on existing UAS electrical systems projects, learning our development processes and systems. Participate in cross-functional teams to integrate electrical systems into UAS platforms.
* 6 Months: Take on more responsibility, including leading small electrical systems projects and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Take over responsibility for closing out avionics NCRs from the production line.
* 12 Months: Take over full responsibility as the liaison between the avionics design engineering team and the production line.

Pay Range by level/location:

SLO: Level III - $131,000 - $161,000; Level IV - $160,000 - $200,000

FWB/DFW: Level III - $116,000 - $150,000; Level IV - $145,000 - $190,000

#LI-CR1

Benefits:

* Competitive total compensation package
* Comprehensive benefit package options include medical, dental, vision, life, and more.
* 401k with company-match
* 3 weeks of paid time off each year
* 40 hours of sick time
* 12 annual company holidays

Why Join Zone 5 Technologies?

* Innovative Environment: Work on cutting-edge technology that is shaping the future of defense and aerospace.
* Collaborative Culture: Join a team of passionate professionals dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what's possible.
* Career Growth: Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.

**Responsibilities of the Role:**
=================================

* The candidate must have experience with agentic coding workflows, including using AI coding assistants, agent-based development tools such as Github Copilot, Claude Code, or autonomous coding workflows to accelerate software delivery.
* The candidate must have strong experience building modern web interfaces using React, TypeScript, reusable components, responsive design, API integration, and clean fr
* ontend architecture.
* The candidate should be comfortable working across the frontend and backend, integrating React applications with APIs, services, databases, and AI-powered workflows.
* The candidate should have strong software engineering fundamentals, including clean code, version control, debugging, testing, deployment practices, and collaboration in an engineering team.
* Practical experience building AI agents that can perform multi-step tasks, reason through workflows, call tools, interact with APIs, retrieve context, and complete tasks with minimal human intervention.
* Experience with agent development frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, Bedrock AgentCore, AutoGen, or similar tools.
* Experience with LLM application patterns such as prompt engineering, RAG, tool calling, structured outputs, embeddings, and AI response evaluation.
* Nice to have skills
* Experience building AI-powered user experiences such as chat interfaces, human-in-the-loop review screens, streaming responses, agent activity traces, and approval workflows.
* Experience building AI-enabled applications in financial services, investment management, risk, research, portfolio management, or similar business domains.
* Experience with backend technologies such as Python, FastAPI, Node.js, Snowflake DB, Redis, message queues, and API orchestration.
* Experience building applications for web and handheld devices, including responsive design, mobile-friendly workflows, accessibility, and performance optimization.
* Experience with cloud-native delivery, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, secure deployment practices, and production support.
* Familiarity with enterprise integration patterns, authentication/authorization, data security, auditability, and compliance-aware application design.
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders to refine ambiguous requirements, prototype solutions, gather feedback, and deliver high-visibility applications.

**Requirements of the Role:**
=============================

* Build modern React-based web interfaces for AI-powered applications.
* Use agentic coding workflows to accelerate development, improve productivity, and deliver high-quality software.
* Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs, AI services, databases, and workflow systems.
* Collaborate with product, engineering, and business teams to turn requirements into working applications.
* Contribute to the design and implementation of AI-enabled workflows, with opportunities to build more advanced agent capabilities over time.

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
***Position Function:***

This position is responsible for maintaining and supporting the bank's infrastructure and participates in various projects to continually improve its efficiency and security. Position requires a high level of technical knowledge to perform problem identification and resolution of hardware, software, network carrier, and security issues. Operates across several computer environments and platforms.

Designs, implements, administers, and supports the Bank's enterprise server, application, and cloud platforms. Performs the core responsibilities of a Senior Systems Engineer across operating systems, application hosting and middleware, identity, endpoint management, Microsoft 365 administration, certificates, deployment, monitoring, and production support, while providing additional senior-level engineering expertise in Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS).

Serves as a senior technical subject matter expert for hybrid systems and cloud solutions. Leads design and implementation of Azure and AWS services, cloud-hosted application platforms, migrations, automation, security controls, identity integration, resiliency, and operational standards. Coordinates with infrastructure-as-a-service and network providers while retaining technical ownership of server, application, cloud, identity, endpoint, and administration outcomes.

Performs all duties and interacts with internal and external customers in a manner that is expressly aligned with the Company's Core Values of approaching all actions with a “Voyaging Spirit” and being “Positively Ohana”. Exhibits core competencies that result in consistent delivery of positive Customer Interactions, Empowerment and Ownership and demonstrates key professional and performance skills such as Active Listening, effective Oral and Written Communication, Action and Solution Oriented and Thoroughness.

***Primary Accountabilities:***

* **Systems and Application Engineering**
  + Performs senior systems-engineering responsibilities across Windows Server and, where applicable, Linux; Active Directory; DNS; DHCP; application hosting and middleware; application deployment; service accounts; monitoring; patching; and production troubleshooting.
  + Designs, implements, configures, and administers platforms such as Microsoft IIS, web/application servers, Windows services, Java/JBoss/WildFly or comparable runtimes, scheduled jobs, and supporting application components.
  + Administers certificates and TLS dependencies including requests, renewals, installation, bindings, trust chains, keystores, expiration monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  + Leads server and application lifecycle work including technical design, migrations, upgrades, implementation, rollback, validation, operational transition, and root-cause analysis.
  + Coordinates with infrastructure-as-a-service providers for underlying compute, storage, backup, virtualization, and data-center services while retaining responsibility for systems and application requirements.
* **Microsoft Endpoint, Identity and M365 Administration**
  + Administers Microsoft Intune for device enrollment, configuration, compliance, application packaging and deployment, endpoint security, update policies, and advanced troubleshooting.
  + Administers Microsoft Entra ID including users and groups, enterprise applications, Conditional Access, MFA, SSO, RBAC, application registrations, service principals, hybrid identity, and privileged-access controls.
  + Supports the Microsoft 365 administration suite including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint/OneDrive, licensing, tenant configuration, security controls, service health, and issue resolution as assigned.
  + Integrates endpoint, identity, Microsoft 365, on-premises systems, SaaS, Azure, and AWS services into consistent secure-access and administration patterns.
* **Network Management Support**
  + Provides network service support such as building servers, switches, routers, and workstations. Performs software testing and upgrades and assisting network users with network related problems. Ensures Enterprise systems are available to internal and external customers for access 24x7 and is operating at peak performance levels. Assists in communication and coordination of network maintenance schedules, backups, and other downtime to users.
* **Cloud Engineering**
  + Designs, deploys, configures, and administers Azure and AWS services supporting enterprise applications, including compute, storage, networking, load balancing, DNS, private connectivity, backup, monitoring, and appropriate managed platform services.
  + Designs and supports cloud-hosted application architectures, hybrid integrations, landing-zone patterns, subscriptions/accounts, resource organization, tagging, policy guardrails, and standardized platform configurations.
  + Implements cloud identity and access using Microsoft Entra ID, AWS IAM, RBAC, federation, SSO, MFA, service identities, application registrations, secrets, and least-privilege access patterns.
  + Leads cloud migrations and modernization efforts, including workload assessment, dependency mapping, target-state design, migration planning, testing, cutover, rollback, optimization, and operational handoff.
  + Troubleshoots complex cloud compute, application, identity, networking, security, performance, availability, and integration issues and serves as the senior escalation point for production cloud services.
* **Automation, Security, Reliability and Technical Leadership**
  + Builds and maintains automation and infrastructure-as-code using PowerShell, Python, APIs, Terraform and/or native cloud tooling such as ARM templates, or AWS CloudFormation to deliver repeatable and auditable deployments.
  + Implements monitoring, logging, alerting, backup, high availability, disaster recovery, vulnerability remediation, secrets management, encryption, policy compliance, and recovery testing for assigned systems and cloud services.

jobs.title: Cloud Production Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a experienced hardware engineering professional with technical leadership experience and skills in Server Hardware, high performance Compute, Storage, Accelerators (GPU), and/or Networking, ideally in a data center environment. Our data centers, the global fleet of servers installed in them, and the growing cloud capacity Meta operates alongside them are the foundation upon which our rapidly scaling infrastructure efficiently operates and on which our innovative services are delivered. Our Production Platform Engineers are responsible for the performance of the compute, storage, and accelerator (GPU) platforms that run Meta's production workloads, both in our own data centers and on capacity Meta consumes from cloud providers. They are responsible for the health of the server fleet, from NPI production operational test through end of life. Responsibilities include identifying systemic hardware, firmware, and tooling issues; engaging in hands on problem solving; and collaborating effectively with engineering, tooling, and onsite provisioning and break fix teams to improve performance of the fleet.This position carries the cloud platform scope for the team. Meta's cloud footprint is growing toward the scale of the fleet we run ourselves, across several cloud providers, and product groups expect the same reliability and availability from it. Because Meta does not design this hardware and does not have physical access to it, the engineer in this role works through each cloud provider's own repair and escalation process, reaches diagnostic conclusions with partial telemetry, and builds the technical evidence that supports cloud provider accountability. This remains a platform engineering role across both environments. It is not a cloud only role.This position requires a high degree of understanding of our platforms, leveraging technical expertise and using data to identify trends across the fleet and proactively identify and mitigate performance and reliability issues. Experience organizing and prioritizing work across multiple teams in a large-scale, distributed environment and experience partnering with cross-functional teams to drive outcomes in a large-scale, distributed environment.  
  
  

### **Cloud Production Platform Engineer Responsibilities:**

* Serve as subject matter expert for compute, storage, and accelerator (GPU) platforms in Meta's production data centers and on capacity Meta consumes from cloud providers, anticipating and diagnosing issues for the operations teams, and escalating as appropriate to hardware design and NPI teams
* Act as the deep escalation point for cloud hardware issues, taking handoffs from the cloud triage teams and driving hardware and software investigation through to resolution
* Identify systemic hardware issues within a single cloud provider and across cloud providers, separating cloud provider specific behavior from platform behavior already characterized in Meta's own fleet
* Represent Meta's reliability, diagnosability, and serviceability expectations to cloud providers, compiling the technical evidence those conversations depend on
* Carry findings from the cloud environment back into Meta's own platform work, and apply what is already known about Meta's platforms to accelerate diagnosis in the cloud
* Provide end to end lifecycle support (operational test through end of life decommissioning) of hardware platforms and new technologies in the data centers
* Drive complex technical investigations globally and spanning multiple disciplines such as Hardware, Software/Firmware, Networking and Power & Cooling
* Analyze health of the global fleet of servers to proactively identify systemic issues, and take appropriate action to quickly mitigate impact
* Work closely with HW Engineering, Release to Production, and Systems Integration teams to take new server and storage platforms into mass production in the data centers
* Identify risks early in new hardware programs and contribute the test methods needed to characterize the product and assure end customer needs are met
* Act as product owner for specific server and/or storage platforms. Perform and drive RCA and CA, in collaboration with hardware and software engineering teams
* Issue timely alerts and fixes to operations teams, and assure a robust feedback pipeline to engineering teams
* Build strong relationships and collaboration with engineering and cross functional teams across the company. Actively solicit feedback from teams, and use that feedback to improve operational effectiveness as infrastructure scales
* Provide serviceability feedback on production hardware resulting in more efficient repair activities

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* BS or BA in electrical, mechanical, or computer engineering, or equivalent hardware-engineering-related experience
* 10+ years of experience with server hardware systems in an internet operations environment, or on a development team in design or test validation
* Experience triaging and debugging hardware platforms
* Familiarity or experience in NPI server platform development
* Familiarity with Linux or Unix Operating systems
* Experience training and mentoring technicians and/or engineers
* Demonstrated technical skills and experience creating documentation for users of all levels
* Communication experience and interpersonal skills, with the experience communicating and partnering effectively within all levels of the organization
* Experience with building relationships with customers and vendors
* Expert at leveraging large volumes of data to improve decision making processes in the hardware functional domain (understanding the metrics and statistics)

* Experience in data center system and process automation

jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a experienced hardware engineering professional with technical leadership experience and skills in Server Hardware, high performance Compute, Storage, Accelerators (GPU), and/or Networking, ideally in a data center environment. Our data centers, the global fleet of servers installed in them, and the growing cloud capacity Meta operates alongside them are the foundation upon which our rapidly scaling infrastructure efficiently operates and on which our innovative services are delivered. Our Production Platform Engineers are responsible for the performance of the compute, storage, and accelerator (GPU) platforms that run Meta's production workloads, both in our own data centers and on capacity Meta consumes from cloud providers. They are responsible for the health of the server fleet, from NPI production operational test through end of life. Responsibilities include identifying systemic hardware, firmware, and tooling issues; engaging in hands on problem solving; and collaborating effectively with engineering, tooling, and onsite provisioning and break fix teams to improve performance of the fleet.This position carries the cloud platform scope for the team. Meta's cloud footprint is growing toward the scale of the fleet we run ourselves, across several cloud providers, and product groups expect the same reliability and availability from it. Because Meta does not design this hardware and does not have physical access to it, the engineer in this role works through each cloud provider's own repair and escalation process, reaches diagnostic conclusions with partial telemetry, and builds the technical evidence that supports cloud provider accountability. This remains a platform engineering role across both environments. It is not a cloud only role.This position requires a high degree of understanding of our platforms, leveraging technical expertise and using data to identify trends across the fleet and proactively identify and mitigate performance and reliability issues. Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Peraton has an immediate opening for a Jr./Mid-level **Software Engineer** who will join our team at the White Sands Complex in Las Cruces, NM. Your role in this position will include software requirements gathering, software design, development, troubleshooting and debugging.

  

Peraton is the prime contractor on the SENSE contract for NASA at the White Sands Complex near Las Cruces, New Mexico. Operating here are two functionally identical satellite ground terminals: The White Sands Ground Terminal, and the second TDRSS Ground Terminal. These two terminals ensure uninterrupted communications between various ground stations, NASA’s orbiting fleet of Tracking and Data Relay Satellites (TDRS), customer spacecraft (satellites), and the computer systems that support such spacecraft. The WSC also serves as an interface for distributing satellite data to control centers and scientists who then use the daily influx of data to expand our ever-growing knowledge of the Earth and the universe.

* Performs systems modeling, simulation and analysis to provide appropriate telemetry, tracking, and command software solutions.

jobs.title: Cloud Production Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a experienced hardware engineering professional with technical leadership experience and skills in Server Hardware, high performance Compute, Storage, Accelerators (GPU), and/or Networking, ideally in a data center environment. Our data centers, the global fleet of servers installed in them, and the growing cloud capacity Meta operates alongside them are the foundation upon which our rapidly scaling infrastructure efficiently operates and on which our innovative services are delivered. Our Production Platform Engineers are responsible for the performance of the compute, storage, and accelerator (GPU) platforms that run Meta's production workloads, both in our own data centers and on capacity Meta consumes from cloud providers. They are responsible for the health of the server fleet, from NPI production operational test through end of life. Responsibilities include identifying systemic hardware, firmware, and tooling issues; engaging in hands on problem solving; and collaborating effectively with engineering, tooling, and onsite provisioning and break fix teams to improve performance of the fleet.This position carries the cloud platform scope for the team. Meta's cloud footprint is growing toward the scale of the fleet we run ourselves, across several cloud providers, and product groups expect the same reliability and availability from it. Because Meta does not design this hardware and does not have physical access to it, the engineer in this role works through each cloud provider's own repair and escalation process, reaches diagnostic conclusions with partial telemetry, and builds the technical evidence that supports cloud provider accountability. This remains a platform engineering role across both environments. It is not a cloud only role.This position requires a high degree of understanding of our platforms, leveraging technical expertise and using data to identify trends across the fleet and proactively identify and mitigate performance and reliability issues. Experience organizing and prioritizing work across multiple teams in a large-scale, distributed environment and experience partnering with cross-functional teams to drive outcomes in a large-scale, distributed environment.  
  
  

### **Cloud Production Platform Engineer Responsibilities:**

* Serve as subject matter expert for compute, storage, and accelerator (GPU) platforms in Meta's production data centers and on capacity Meta consumes from cloud providers, anticipating and diagnosing issues for the operations teams, and escalating as appropriate to hardware design and NPI teams
* Act as the deep escalation point for cloud hardware issues, taking handoffs from the cloud triage teams and driving hardware and software investigation through to resolution
* Identify systemic hardware issues within a single cloud provider and across cloud providers, separating cloud provider specific behavior from platform behavior already characterized in Meta's own fleet

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
ASRC Federal is a leading government contractor furthering missions in space, public health and defense. As an Alaska Native owned corporation, our work helps secure an enduring future for our shareholders. Join our team and discover why we are a top veteran employer and Certified Great Place to Work™
  
  
​​ASRC Federal Advanced Research LLC (AFAR)​ is seeking an ​Electrical Engineer​ to join our ​Air-to-Ground Communications (AG COMM)​ team that supports the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA). This is a ​full-time​ ​on-site​ position at the ​Mike Monroney Aeronautical Center (MMAC)​ in ​Oklahoma City, OK​.
  
  
​​The AG COMM program comprises the infrastructure, facilities, and protocols that allow air traffic controllers to communicate via voice and data with pilots in flight.​
  
  
Citizenship/Permanent Residency Requirement
  
  
All candidates must have the following to pass the Federal Background Investigation and obtain the FAA Public Trust security clearance.
  

* Be a US Citizen.
* Has resided in the US for three (3) consecutive years.
* RealID Driver’s License/ID or current US Passport.

Relocation Requirement
  
  
Candidate must reside or be willing to relocate within a commutable distance to the ​Mike Monroney Aeronautical Center (MMAC)​ in ​Oklahoma City, OK​.
  
  
Education & Experience Requirement
  
  
All non-US Degrees must have a US Equivalency Certificate provided by the candidate at the time of application.
  

* A ​Bachelors (ABET)​ degree in ​Engineering or related IT field, such as Physics, Aerospace, Chemistry, Computer Science, or Mathematics.​
* Experience with NAS facilities, systems, and equipment is highly desirable.​
* 3 - 6​ years of related work experience.

Required Skills
  

* Solid foundation in circuit theory, power systems, grounding, and signal integrity.
* Skilled in interpreting schematics, wiring diagrams, and system block diagrams.
* Structured troubleshooting methodology including root cause analysis and fault isolation.
* Understanding of system integration principles involving hardware, firmware, and software interaction.
* Experience with programming in Python.
* Supports field service calls and explains complex technical issues to non-technical personnel.​
* Ability to:
* Work independently, as well as on a team, in an agile environment.
* Research, troubleshoot and problem solve quickly.
* Learn on the job/willing to self-teach.
* Communicate effectively through verbal and written communication with high organization.
* Write clear, structured technical documentation.

Preferred Skills
  
  

* Familiarity with industry safety standards and electrical best practices.
* Support for electrical engineering tasks in lab, field, and production environments.
* Participation in after-hours or mission-critical support when required.
* Working knowledge of Windows, UNIX, and UNIX-like operating systems (AIX, Linux).
* Troubleshooting and problem-solving experience.
* Experience with networking protocols and technologies including TCP, UDP, DHCP, SNMP, and VoIP.
* Understanding the importance of testing throughout all phases of engineering and programming.
* Ability to merge and apply technical skills across multiple environments and tasks.​

Essential Daily Job Duties
  
  

* Evaluate electrical systems, equipment, and applications.
* Take and support field service calls.
* Provide real-time troubleshooting support to field technicians.
* Document incident findings and corrective actions.
* Support remote and on-site system diagnostics.
* Participate in after-hours or mission-critical support when required.
* Contribute to system and hardware design, development, and testing.
* Create and update documentation for systems and hardware.​

Work Environment
  
  

* Standard flexible work schedule.
* Travel is ​10 - 25%​.
* Cubicle environment.

We invest in the lives of our employees, both in and out of the workplace, by providing competitive pay and benefits packages. Benefits offered may include health care, dental, vision, life insurance; 401(k); education assistance; paid time off including PTO, holidays, and any other paid leave required by law. The salary offered will depend on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, education, geographic location, internal equity, business needs, and other factors permitted by law. Posted pay ranges are a general guideline only and are not a guarantee of compensation or salary.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, gender, color, age, sexual orientation, gender identification, national origin, religion, marital status, ancestry, citizenship, disability, protected veteran status, or any other factor prohibited by applicable law.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer I, Manufacturing and Test
jobs.description:
**Electrical Engineer I – Manufacturing & Test**

**Reading Thermal Systems (RTS) | Reading Bakery Systems**

Put your electrical engineering knowledge to work on instruments that measure temperature, heat flux, air velocity, and humidity.

RTS is seeking an Electrical Engineer I – Manufacturing & Test to support the manufacture, testing, calibration, and improvement of thermal measurement products, including the SCORPION® data logging system. You’ll work alongside experienced engineering and manufacturing personnel, gain hands-on experience with sensors and electronics, and help ensure products meet established quality and performance requirements.

This early-career opportunity is suited to an electrical engineering graduate who enjoys hands-on testing, troubleshooting, and practical problem-solving.

**What You’ll Do**

Your primary responsibilities will be:

* **Outgoing quality assurance — approximately 50%:** Test finished products before shipment, document findings, and verify compliance with established procedures.
* **Calibration support — approximately 25%:** Calibrate customer data loggers and sensors returned for service.

The remaining 25% of your role will include:

* Investigating production issues and troubleshooting circuitry, components, firmware, and measurement systems with guidance from experienced engineering staff.
* Creating and updating test specifications, work instructions, manufacturing records, and training materials.
* Helping develop, build, and validate production test systems, fixtures, and calibration procedures.
* Conducting engineering tests and analyzing product accuracy, reliability, and performance.
* Supporting the transition of prototypes into repeatable manufacturing processes.
* Assisting with component substitutions and engineering changes.
* Reviewing production and field data to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Supporting product assembly, repair, and manufacturing activities as needed.

**What You’ll Bring**

* A bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering.
* Foundational knowledge of circuits, printed circuit boards, microprocessors, C programming, and CAD.
* Hands-on testing and troubleshooting experience from coursework, laboratory work, projects, internships, or employment.
* Familiarity with hardware and software interfaces used in test equipment or measurement systems.
* Interest in sensors, instrumentation, physics, and thermal measurement.
* Ability to interpret schematics, engineering drawings, and technical instructions.
* Strong attention to detail, analytical skills, and clear written and verbal communication.
* Ability to handle small components and perform fine-pitch soldering and rework.
* A willingness to learn, follow established procedures, and work collaboratively.

Experience with calibration, embedded firmware, data acquisition, thermal systems, or production fixtures is a plus.

**Work Requirements**

This position may require overnight domestic travel and occasional international travel. Responsibilities include regularly lifting or moving up to 10 pounds and occasionally up to 50 pounds. Work may involve production baking environments with high temperatures, humidity, noise, and other manufacturing hazards. Appropriate personal protective equipment is required.

Twenty-Six Defense, headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas, is a leading provider of high-performance products, system solutions, and aftermarket support services focusing on the defense, homeland security, and commercial aviation markets. With facilities throughout the U.S., Twenty-Six Defense supports those who contribute to the national security of the United States. Twenty-Six Defense is wholly owned by Elbit Systems Ltd. (NASDAQ: ESLT and TASE: ESLT), a global high-technology company engaged in a wide range of programs for innovative defense and commercial applications.
  
Fueled by more than 800 talented employees and a proud 65-year legacy of night vision production excellence, Twenty-Six Defense’s Warfighter Systems business is rooted in the heart of Virginia’s Roanoke Valley. Surrounded by the scenic beauty of the Blue Ridge Mountains, you’ll find a unique blend of southern hospitality, outdoor adventure, and the energy of a thriving city – all alongside a purpose you can be proud of coming to work each day.
  
As a world leader in low-light sensor technology, the Warfighter Systems team is engineering the future of image intensifiers and night vision goggle systems as we enter a new era of the networked battlespace. Trusted by the U.S. and nearly 100 allied countries, our technology supports those in harm’s way during the most critical moments, with one goal in mind: bring them home safely.
  
The work our employees perform each day plays a direct role in national security, and our shared purpose is what truly makes Warfighter Systems so extraordinary. Join our collaborative team, where each voice is valued, and you can thrive, develop, and make a real impact!
  
  
Job Summary
  
The Software Automations Engineer works with a team of automation engineers and process engineers to translate process control concepts into machinery, support and modify software interfacing with hardware on existing equipment, and design new program controlled processes to meet manufacturing requirements. Basic electronics knowledge and familiarity with industrial protocols and interface techniques are applied to the developed programming solutions.
  
This role participates in the full software development life cycle, including specification, design, programming, implementation, integration, commissioning, and debugging. The position offers opportunities to apply program design to robotics, electronics, machine vision, analog and digital signal applications, data systems, and mechatronics.
  
Software development experience should include proficiency in various computer languages to address programming objectives related to automated process control, test/measurement, and data integration. Programs are created to connect construction and testing processes to test equipment, data collection systems, analog and digital control points, machine vision systems, motion control, and other specialized peripherals.
  
Responsibilities
  
The Software Automations Engineer collaborates with technicians and engineers across multiple departments to:
  

* Document project requests to create statements of work, use cases, and related documentation.
* Identify opportunities to improve system quality, efficiency, and robustness.
* Write clean, well tested code with effective error handling.
* Create test plans and ensure quality using industry best practices such as unit and regression testing.
* Develop proofs of concept for new and innovative solutions.
* Enable data movement between equipment and databases.
* Break down large, complex technical projects into defined stages and deliverables.
* Work across multiple software and hardware platforms.

Qualifications
  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science (BSCS), Computer Engineering (BSCE), Electrical Engineering (BSEE), or a major in computer programming/engineering with a minor in electrical engineering.
* Proficiency with Visual Studio, SQL Server, MS Office, and Windows.
* Experience with relational databases and SQL.
* Ability to produce and maintain high quality, tested, and efficient code following industry standards.
* Strong understanding of design patterns, multithreading, and distributed systems.
* Experience in object oriented analysis and design using common design patterns.
* Practical understanding and motivation to apply software programming skills to control electronic components and interfaced systems.
