jobs.title: Cloud Production Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a experienced hardware engineering professional with technical leadership experience and skills in Server Hardware, high performance Compute, Storage, Accelerators (GPU), and/or Networking, ideally in a data center environment. Our data centers, the global fleet of servers installed in them, and the growing cloud capacity Meta operates alongside them are the foundation upon which our rapidly scaling infrastructure efficiently operates and on which our innovative services are delivered. Our Production Platform Engineers are responsible for the performance of the compute, storage, and accelerator (GPU) platforms that run Meta's production workloads, both in our own data centers and on capacity Meta consumes from cloud providers. They are responsible for the health of the server fleet, from NPI production operational test through end of life. Responsibilities include identifying systemic hardware, firmware, and tooling issues; engaging in hands on problem solving; and collaborating effectively with engineering, tooling, and onsite provisioning and break fix teams to improve performance of the fleet.This position carries the cloud platform scope for the team. Meta's cloud footprint is growing toward the scale of the fleet we run ourselves, across several cloud providers, and product groups expect the same reliability and availability from it. Because Meta does not design this hardware and does not have physical access to it, the engineer in this role works through each cloud provider's own repair and escalation process, reaches diagnostic conclusions with partial telemetry, and builds the technical evidence that supports cloud provider accountability. This remains a platform engineering role across both environments. It is not a cloud only role.This position requires a high degree of understanding of our platforms, leveraging technical expertise and using data to identify trends across the fleet and proactively identify and mitigate performance and reliability issues. Experience organizing and prioritizing work across multiple teams in a large-scale, distributed environment and experience partnering with cross-functional teams to drive outcomes in a large-scale, distributed environment.  
  
  

### **Cloud Production Platform Engineer Responsibilities:**

* Serve as subject matter expert for compute, storage, and accelerator (GPU) platforms in Meta's production data centers and on capacity Meta consumes from cloud providers, anticipating and diagnosing issues for the operations teams, and escalating as appropriate to hardware design and NPI teams
* Act as the deep escalation point for cloud hardware issues, taking handoffs from the cloud triage teams and driving hardware and software investigation through to resolution
* Identify systemic hardware issues within a single cloud provider and across cloud providers, separating cloud provider specific behavior from platform behavior already characterized in Meta's own fleet
* Represent Meta's reliability, diagnosability, and serviceability expectations to cloud providers, compiling the technical evidence those conversations depend on
* Carry findings from the cloud environment back into Meta's own platform work, and apply what is already known about Meta's platforms to accelerate diagnosis in the cloud
* Provide end to end lifecycle support (operational test through end of life decommissioning) of hardware platforms and new technologies in the data centers
* Drive complex technical investigations globally and spanning multiple disciplines such as Hardware, Software/Firmware, Networking and Power & Cooling
* Analyze health of the global fleet of servers to proactively identify systemic issues, and take appropriate action to quickly mitigate impact
* Work closely with HW Engineering, Release to Production, and Systems Integration teams to take new server and storage platforms into mass production in the data centers
* Identify risks early in new hardware programs and contribute the test methods needed to characterize the product and assure end customer needs are met
* Act as product owner for specific server and/or storage platforms. Perform and drive RCA and CA, in collaboration with hardware and software engineering teams
* Issue timely alerts and fixes to operations teams, and assure a robust feedback pipeline to engineering teams
* Build strong relationships and collaboration with engineering and cross functional teams across the company. Actively solicit feedback from teams, and use that feedback to improve operational effectiveness as infrastructure scales
* Provide serviceability feedback on production hardware resulting in more efficient repair activities

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* BS or BA in electrical, mechanical, or computer engineering, or equivalent hardware-engineering-related experience
* 10+ years of experience with server hardware systems in an internet operations environment, or on a development team in design or test validation
* Experience triaging and debugging hardware platforms
* Familiarity or experience in NPI server platform development

jobs.description:
Job ID: 2618069

**Location:** Springfield, VA, US

**Date Posted:** 2026-10-16

**Category:** Engineering and Sciences

**Subcategory:** Systems Engineer

**Schedule:** Full-Time

**Shift:** Day Job

**Travel:** No

**Minimum Clearance Required:** Top\_Secret

**Clearance Level Must Be Able to Obtain:** None

**Potential for Remote Work:** ORA\_ON\_SITE

**Description**

**Position Description:**

The Enterprise & Mission Solution Business Unit currently has an opening for a Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) Systems Engineer to support the Department of State (DoS) Bureau of Information Resource Management (IRM) PKI program. This program provides transparent security services in support of the Department’s goals to secure communications among Department staff and systems. The position falls under the "Vanguard 2.2.1" contract.

This is a senior-level PKI engineering position within the Vanguard 2.2.1 program’s Enterprise Engineering Office (EEO), providing PKI engineering and integration support, administering, maintaining, and deploying various PKI systems based on Entrust solutions, onsite at the various DoS Datacenters and at certain selected DoS domestic and overseas locations. The preferred candidate must possess strong skills in designing, installing, configuring, and maintaining PKI systems. Additionally the preferred candidate should have some experience in providing tier-3 level support in large enterprises.

  

**Description of Duties:**

* Providing PKI engineering support in the operation of a number of PKI systems deployed at the Department of State.
* Manage and maintain enclaved server hardware, storage, switches, server operating systems, and Hardware Security Modules (HSMs).
* Directly working with customer to analyze requirements and then deploy security related solutions to meet those requirements.
* Providing problem analysis following any service issues to prevent recurrence
* Performing product evaluations and making product recommendations
* Identifying security risks to systems and suggest mitigations
* Developing test cases for software/hardware testing and developing test evaluation reports for stakeholders.
* Developing and updating systems documentation (e.g., ConOps, Operating procedures, systems architecture documents)

**Qualifications**

**Required Education/Experience:**

* Minimum 5 years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s degree or 3 years of relevant work experience with a Master’s degree
* Excellent MS-Windows Server administration & maintenance
* Familiarity with PKIs and related technologies (LDAP directories, HSMs, OCSP) and security practices
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills
* Working knowledge of Entrust suite of PKI products (Security Manager, Administration Services, Security Manager Proxy) especially in a government setting.
* Hands-on experience with Hardware Security Modules (HSMs)
* Experience with directory products (LDAP), such as Critical Path or Active Directory
* CISSP, Security+, or similar certification
* Network device configuration – Cisco and Juniper firewalls and switches
* Network infrastructure diagnostics (TCP/IP general networking knowledge, network monitoring tools)
* Virtualization technologies (ESX/ESXi)
* Working knowledge of External storage solutions
* Interpersonal skills including the ability to collaborate effectively, self-awareness, and excellent written and oral communications.

**Desired Experience/Skills/Attributes:**

* Working knowledge of Entrust suite of PKI products (Security Manager, Administration Services, Security Manager Proxy) especially in a government setting.
* Hands-on experience with Hardware Security Modules (HSMs)
* Experience with directory products (LDAP), such as Critical Path or Active Directory
* CISSP, Security+, or similar certification
* Network device configuration – Cisco and Juniper firewalls and switches
* Network infrastructure diagnostics (TCP/IP general networking knowledge, network monitoring tools)
* Virtualization technologies (ESX/ESXi)
* Working knowledge of External storage solutions
* Interpersonal skills including the ability to collaborate effectively, self-awareness, and excellent written and oral communications.

  
Target salary range: $100,001 - $140,000. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

jobs.title: PNT Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Description**: IS4S is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Software Engineer to support the development of embedded software for Assured Positioning, Navigation, and Timing (APNT) systems working on-site in our Auburn, AL or Huntsville, AL location. The successful candidate will contribute to the development of navigation algorithms, sensor interfaces, platform integration, and software testing for resilient navigation solutions operating in challenging environments, including conditions where GPS/GNSS may be degraded, denied, or unavailable.

This role offers the opportunity to work across the embedded software development lifecycle, from algorithm implementation and hardware interfacing to integration, testing, and performance evaluation. The ideal candidate has strong modern C++ programming skills, experience developing software in Linux environments, and a commitment to producing reliable, maintainable, and well-tested software.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Develop and maintain embedded software components for assured PNT systems using modern C++.

Implement and support navigation algorithms that process data from inertial sensors, GPS/GNSS receivers, clocks, and other navigation sources.

Develop and maintain software interfaces to sensors, embedded hardware, and host platforms.

Integrate software components with navigation hardware and platform systems, troubleshooting hardware/software interface issues.

Develop and execute unit, integration, and system-level tests to verify software functionality and performance.

Analyze test results, investigate defects, and support debugging and performance optimization.

Use Git-based version control, automated build systems, and CI/CD pipelines to support software quality and repeatable development workflows.

Collaborate with systems, hardware, and navigation engineers to develop, integrate, and demonstrate assured PNT capabilities.

**Required Qualifications**

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.

Experience developing software in modern C++, including object-oriented programming, standard library features, and sound software design practices.

Experience developing, building, debugging, and testing software in a Linux environment.

Proficiency with Git or an equivalent modern version control system, including branching, merging, and collaborative development workflows.

Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated software build, test, and integration processes.

Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to write clear, maintainable, and well-documented software.

Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary engineering team.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience with embedded software development on Linux-based platforms.

Familiarity with navigation algorithms, sensor fusion, inertial navigation systems (INS), GPS/GNSS, or other PNT technologies.

Experience interfacing with hardware using serial communications, Ethernet, SPI, I²C, CAN, or similar protocols.

Experience with unit testing frameworks and software quality tools, such as static analysis, code coverage, and automated linting.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Senior Software Engineer

**Location**: Huntsville, AL

**Salary Range:** $123,600 - $164,800, plus bonus eligible

**Company Overview**

Founded in 2004 with locations in Atlanta, GA, Fort Worth, TX, Denver, CO, & Huntsville, AL, Thompson Software Solutions (TSS) is a mission-driven aerospace and defense software and systems engineering company supporting the U.S. military, defense primes, and commercial space partners. We specialize in the development, integration, test, and deployment of safety & mission-critical software systems that power next-generation aircraft, defense platforms, and space technologies. Our team understands what it takes to modernize complex embedded systems while maintaining the rigor, compliance, and reliability required for mission and safety-critical environments.

As a defense-focused company of highly skilled and dedicated engineers, we take pride in solving complex technical challenges that directly impact national security and operational readiness. We partner closely with customers across the military aviation and space domains to deliver resilient, future-ready solutions with portability, sustainability, and long-term mission success in mind.

**Description**

**Thompson Software Solutions** is seeking a **Senior Software Engineer** to support the development of embedded flight software and Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) capabilities for an advanced missile platform. This role offers the opportunity to design and integrate mission-critical software operating in high-performance, real-time environments where precision, reliability, and deterministic execution are paramount.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will develop embedded flight software, contribute to the architecture, design, implementation, integration, and verification of real-time systems supporting missile guidance, navigation, and control functions. You will work at the intersection of software, hardware, and control algorithms to ensure accurate sensor processing, state estimation, trajectory management, and actuator command execution under strict timing and performance constraints.

This position requires deep expertise in embedded and real-time software development, including low-level hardware interfaces, multi-threaded and deterministic system design, integration with GNC algorithms, and operation within safety- and mission-critical frameworks. Experience supporting hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) environments, simulation integration, system-level test, and flight qualification activities is highly valued.

You will collaborate closely with software engineers, GNC engineers, systems engineers, integration and test teams, and program leadership to mature capabilities from lab development through system qualification and flight test.

The successful candidate will join a high-performing software engineering team focused on delivering next-generation missile capabilities. This role requires strong systems thinking, exceptional analytical and troubleshooting skills, and the ability to lead in a fast-paced, high-consequence development environment where performance and reliability are mission critical.

Selected applicants will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. Continued eligibility for access to classified information is required throughout employment, as dictated by program needs.

* 5+ years of embedded software development

* Experience communicating and documenting complex technical designs
* Ability to work in a collaborative and team-based environment
* Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills

* Low-cost Medical / Dental / Vision coverage options
* 401K with generous employer match
* Responsible Paid Time Off + Paid Holidays

**Description**

Sanmina Corporation (Nasdaq: SANM) is a global powerhouse in integrated manufacturing solutions serving the fastest growing segments of the global Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) market. We are a global engine providing the end-to-end manufacturing backbone for the world's most essential and innovative brands. Whether it's autonomous vehicles, life-saving medical tech, next-gen aerospace, or AI/cloud infrastructure - our integrated solutions don’t just meet standards—they redefine them.

At SCI Technology, a Sanmina Company, we serve those who serve by delivering innovative, trusted and comprehensive products and services that meet and exceed the unique needs of the Defense and Aerospace sector. From avionics to tactical and airborne communications, counter-UAS, integrated manufacturing and cradle-to-grave product life cycle support, we deliver high-reliability solutions that keep service members connected and protected in the field.

Our heritage dates to 1961, as an early supplier to the space program in Huntsville, Alabama. Today, SCI offers a complete range of Defense & Aerospace solutions through our three business segments – Products, Systems Build, and Life Cycle Services . It’s SCI summed up - ALL WE DO to serve those who serve .

At this time, SCI is recruiting highly qualified candidates whose background and career goals meet our needs for the following position in Huntsville, AL.

**Position Title:** Software Engineer

### **Summary**

We are looking for an enthusiastic Web Developer to support a unique team within our manufacturing and test engineering department. As our Web Developer, you will collaborate closely with SQL Server architects to design, build, and maintain web-based tools that drive our fast-paced manufacturing environment. As your experience progresses, you will have the opportunity to hone your skills in full-stack development, advanced application architecture, and database integration.

### **What You'll Do**

* **Front-End Development:** Collaborate with SQL Server architects to develop intuitive web front-ends for robust database solutions.
* **Workflow Tools:** Design and build custom, internal web-based tools to support manufacturing and production workflows.
* **Code Maintenance & Integration:** Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code for web applications while ensuring seamless and secure integration between web interfaces and backend SQL Server databases.
* **Troubleshooting & Support:** Oversee application performance, debug issues, and troubleshoot user-reported concerns in collaboration with IT help desk and engineering teams.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with production teams to gather requirements, continuously improve software tools, and communicate project statuses, activities, and achievements to internal and external stakeholders.
* **Documentation:** Maintain internal documentation for custom tools, user guides, and application architecture.

### **What You'll Bring**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 1–3 years of experience in web development, software engineering, or a related field.
* **Front-End Technologies:** Experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern web frameworks.
* **Backend Technologies:** Familiarity with backend development (e.g., C#, ASP.NET, Visual Studio) and API integration.
* **Database Management:** Familiarity with Microsoft SQL Server, writing queries, and interacting with relational databases.
* **Core Skills:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills, along with impeccable attention to detail.

### **How to Stand Out**

* Knowledge of manufacturing or production process workflows .
* Advanced experience with full-stack development, database architecture, or complex SQL query optimization .
* Prior background supporting test engineering or high-reliability hardware production operations .

### **Why Join Us?**

At Sanmina, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. Your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

Sanmina is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment. Sanmina provides equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

  

Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

The **Effector Digital Products** (EDP) department designs digital electronic circuit cards and electronic units which are supported from proposal through transition to production. Our systems are subject to environments ranging from the frigid, sub-zero vacuum of space to the blistering heat of the desert floor, to the high pressures of the ocean depths.

The Digital, RF and Power Team is seeking a **Principal Digital Design Engineer** with digital electronics design and analysis skills to join our team.

This position is **100% ONSITE** in Tucson, Arizona.

**What You Will Do**

We are looking for candidates willing to collaborate, innovate, and team with our engineers to generate and utilize today’s cutting-edge technology to design digital electronics circuits that implement missile guidance, video and digital signal processing. Our technology base includes high-speed digital electronics, configurable logic, and homogeneous / heterogeneous multiprocessor designs.

The **Principal Digital Design Engineer** is responsible for the design, analysis, simulation, test, and integration of digital electronic modules and/or CCAs for Missile applications. The candidate should be experienced in all aspects of circuit card design including:

* hardware designs with processors
* FPGAs
* memory
* industry interfaces, such as PCIe, Ethernet, I2C, SPI, and UART

**Qualifications You Must Have**

* Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and a minimum of 8 years of prior relevant experience
* Minimum of 8 years of engineering digital circuit design experience to include at least 2 of the following:
  + Development and design of electronic circuit designs, multi-assembly system/unit design
  + Ability to take a design concept from the block diagram or requirements level to development of a complete hardware design, and verification via test and integration
  + Experience with PCB design process and expertise in tools used to design (schematic capture), analyze and simulate designs prior to hardware execution.

**Qualifications We Prefer**

* Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering
* Experience with embedded test techniques, design for test, design margin analysis and design for production for complex circuit card assemblies between 16 and 32 layers
* Experience using Mentor Graphics Design Creation (Siemens EDA) tools: DxDesigner, xDX Designer VX, and Xilinx (Zynq Ultrascale, Vivado, Atrix)
* Experience using PCB electronic circuit design software: HyperLynx signal integrity, power integrity, and analog simulation, Xpedition Enterprise (xPCB)
* Constraint Editor System (CES)
* Experience with FPGA code development or software
* Experience leading a program transition from development to production
* Experience managing technical/schedule risks to identify cost reduction opportunities to meet assigned deadlines
* Experience with intellectual property generation (patents & publications)

**What We Offer**

Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.

* This position offers relocation

**Learn More & Apply Now!**

Employees who are working in **Onsite roles will work primarily onsite**. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.

**Description**
---------------

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Sr. Principal Electrical Engineer 4 – Electrical Ground Support Equipment (EGSE)

Northrop Grumman Space Systems is currently seeking an experienced Principal Electrical Engineer to join our electrical ground support equipment group in our Chandler, AZ facility. Our electrical ground support equipment (EGSE) team supports our programs with the design, test, and sustainment of all EGSE and test support equipment hardware used in the integration and launch of our vehicles. Our EGSE team members work in a diverse set of roles across the lifecycle of a program.

Job Duties: Based on specific objectives, work with a system electrical engineering team to perform analysis, design, and test of complex “system level” designs with a focus on the electrical ground support equipment and test support equipment for the launch vehicle.

Job responsibilities:

* Broad understanding and application of company electrical engineering technical standards.
* Broad technical expertise and working knowledge of other related disciplines.
* Prepares and presents electrical engineering materials for Requirements and Design Reviews.
* With minimal guidance, studies basic design concepts and criteria for more complex problems.
* Applies electrical engineering principles to adapt or improve upon heritage features from previous successful designs of a similar nature.
* Actively and effectively participates and contributes in a positive manner while supporting team decisions and goals.
* Makes an extra effort to provide quality internal and external customer service.
* Constantly seeks new sources of information and provides information necessary to meet customer needs.
* Disciplined with escalation when required.
* Derives requirements through multiple sources of documentation and design meetings.
* Evaluate, with supervision, uncertainty and risks associated with requirements and designs.
* Patriciate in trade studies for both internal projects and procured equipment.
* Act with safety as your number one priority through every aspect of the role.
* Provides formal peer review of simple engineering designs or analyses for less experienced engineers.
* Completing day-to-day activities with no oversight of senior engineers.

Desired Experience:

* Design, test, and/or integration and deployment of electrical ground support equipment (EGSE) or test support equipment (TSE).
* Design, test, programming, and/or integration and deployment of automated test equipment (ATE).
* Testing of avionics, electronic components, or electrical systems using purpose designed test equipment.
* Burndown of nonconformances and/or root cause failure analysis of electronic systems.
* Release of engineering documentation including technical drawings, specifications, and test procedures.
* Leading teams or personnel in the execution of test procedures.
* Leading teams or personnel in the design of electronic equipment.
* Management or tracking of projects through a product life cycle.
* Support of manufacturing engineering during the production of test equipment products.
* Experience with telemetry systems including decoms and chapter 10 recorders.
* Development or support of Hardware-in-the-Loop (HiL) or other integrations labs.
* Problem solving not only for technical issues, but also for schedule, cost, resource and other project challenges.
* Mentoring and cross-training team members across a diverse set of technologies and equipment architectures used to meet customer requirements.
* Knowledgeable with the use of basic test equipment such as power supplies, oscilloscopes, DMMs, and electronic loads.
* Broad or high-level circuit design and analysis.

Also seeking experience in any of the following:

* LabVIEW/TestStand programming and NI hardware and software products.
* Contributions to process improvement initiatives.
* CompTIA Security+ or similar certifications.
* Usage and troubleshooting of networks, Windows systems, and RHEL or other Linux distributions.
* Experience with classified test systems or systems subject to cyber security policies.

Basic Qualifications for Principal Electrical Engineer - 4

* Requires 8 years with a Bachelor’s in Engineering or 5 years with a Master’s in Engineering.
* Ability to obtain DoD Secret Clearance at time of application.
* U.S. Citizenship is required
* Proficient knowledge of electrical engineering principles.
* Design, Test, or Integration experience with EGSE or similar equipment.
* Experience with processes applicable to operating EGSE in secure environments.

jobs.description:
### **About Mainspring**

Mainspring Energy manufactures and delivers fuel-flexible, low-emissions local power solutions that rapidly add new capacity and deliver reliable, affordable, and sustainable electric power. The company began commercial shipments of its Mainspring Linear Generators in 2020 and today has hundreds of megawatts in advanced development and field operations for leading Fortune 500 companies, data centers, and utilities. Mainspring also partners with global energy leaders including AEP, NextEra Energy Resources, Schneider Electric, and more.

The core values that ground our work, guide our decisions, and connect us together:

* Pragmatic Optimism
* Excellence without Ego
* Proactive Collaboration

### **Job Overview**

Mainspring Energy has fundamentally redefined onsite power generation. Our breakthrough product—the Mainspring Linear Generator (LGen)—is a completely new category of energy technology. Distinct from an engine, turbine, or fuel cell, the LGen directly converts straight-line motion into electricity using a low-temperature, non-combustion thermochemical reaction.

With only two moving parts per core, a frictionless air-bearing system, and zero-flame chemical conversions, we deliver over 46% net AC electrical efficiency. More importantly, it is the world’s only commercially available technology capable of real-time fuel-switching under load, seamlessly transitioning between natural gas, biogas/RNG, propane, hydrogen, and ammonia.

Behind this mechanical simplicity lies an incredibly complex software abstraction layer. To achieve dynamic load-following, sub-millisecond grid synchronization, and real-time thermochemical adaptive fuel mixing, our proprietary controls manage thousands of high-frequency variables simultaneously.

As a Senior Staff Software Test & Automation Engineer, you will architect the core validation and automation frameworks that ensure this distributed energy asset operates with 100% safety and utility-scale reliability. You will own the strategy for testing the intersection of real-time embedded software, predictive control loops, and multi-fuel dynamics.

### **Responsibilities**

* Architect Automation & Test Infrastructure: Design, scale, and maintain custom hardware test beds alongside robust, reusable test automation frameworks, software tools, and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines
* System Validation & Integration: Develop comprehensive test plans, test cases, technical test approaches, and traceability matrices to validate complex hardware/software integrations and resolve system-level bottlenecks
* Root Cause & Failure Analysis: Lead deep-dive failure analysis, debug and diagnose issues found during testing, and champion risk mitigation strategies to ensure test stability and environmental reliability
* Strategic Coverage: Drive risk-based testing strategies, performing risk analysis to ensure 100% comprehensive test coverage of all critical-path functionalities
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with development teams and support cross-functional engineering initiatives to diagnose system anomalies and vet new technologies

### **Qualifications (Must Haves)**

* Experience & Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field with 16+ years of professional experience, or a Master’s degree with 15+ years in an SDET, Embedded Test, or Software Engineering role
* Strategic Automation Leadership: A proven track record of leading complex automation projects from design to implementation, combined with the foundational ability to perform deep-dive manual exploratory testing and technical test case design
* Technical Versatility: Strong hands-on software development experience in Python and C++, with the flexibility to navigate, debug, and contribute to diverse codebases (including Bash scripting) as the project requires
* AI Workflow Ownership: Demonstrated proficiency in leveraging AI coding assistants as a force multiplier for productivity, combined with the professional judgment to challenge, validate, and expand upon AI-generated solutions to ensure system integrity and long-term maintainability
* Domain Expertise: Professional experience testing and validating systems in at least three of the following areas: Cloud computing, embedded systems, networking, IoT with RTOS, controls, simulations (MIL/SIL/PIL), emulators, or complex algorithms

### **Desirable Qualifications**

* DevOps & Infrastructure: Experience working with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, and configuration management via Ansible
* Industry Tooling: High proficiency with common industry test and development workflows like Jira, Xray, GitLab, or equivalent tools

This position is **onsite** at our **Menlo Park HQ**. The salary will be adjusted to reflect local market conditions based on employee location as well as the experience of the employee. Along with the base salary, Mainspring offers pre-IPO stock options + benefits.

**Optical Communications Software Engineer – Modem Integration** 
**Bright Silicon Technologies | Pleasanton, CA | Full time**
==============================================================================================================================

**About the Role**
==================

Bright Silicon Technologies (BST) develops precision optical systems built around our Lightfield Directing Array (LDA), a MEMS micromirror array for fast, precise control of light. Our OCTANE free-space optical communications terminal brings together free-space optics, fiber-based photonics, and communications hardware to enable high-bandwidth links between ground and airborne platforms.  
  
We’re looking for a software engineer to own modem integration and communications software for OCTANE. You’ll build the software that configures and monitors our (expected to be a COMET) modem, connects it to the terminal’s data interfaces, and manages link operation and recovery. Working with our photonics, firmware, controls, and hardware engineers, you’ll take a working laboratory system toward reliable outdoor and mobile operation, targeting Space Development Agency (SDA) interoperability.

==================

* Own modem software integration for our free space optical communications terminal. Develop C/C++ software for modem configuration, telemetry, host interfaces, network interface and data transfer.
* Define software interfaces and acceptance criteria, including applicable SDA Optical Communications Terminal (OCT) requirements. Coordinate link states and timing with pointing, acquisition, and tracking (PAT) software.
* Implement link state machines, startup and shutdown sequences, fault handling, and recovery after fades or interruptions.
* Build Python tools and automated bench and hardware-in-the-loop tests. Measure throughput, latency, packet loss, and bit error rate to verify link performance.

* Experience using Python or a similar language for test automation and data analysis, with working knowledge of communications performance measurements.

* Experience with COMET or other optical communications modems, including configuration, telemetry, and host integration.

Your work will directly support products operating in demanding environments where reliability and performance are essential.

* Build automated hardware-in-the-loop tests to validate system performance and reliability.
* Troubleshoot complex technical issues across embedded hardware and software systems.

**Desired Skills**

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Embedded Systems
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a Software Engineer to join our embedded engineering team, where you will develop low-level software and firmware that powers consumer hardware products. In this role, you will work at the intersection of hardware and software, building reliable, performant embedded systems that operate under strict resource constraints. You will contribute to the full embedded software development lifecycle, from system bring-up and driver development to real-time operating system integration and hardware abstraction layer design, helping shape the foundation of Meta's next generation of connected devices.  
  
  

### **Software Engineer, Embedded Systems Responsibilities:**

* Design, implement, and maintain embedded firmware and low-level software components for resource-constrained hardware platforms
* Develop and debug hardware abstraction layers, device drivers, and board support packages for custom silicon and peripherals
* Integrate and configure real-time operating systems (RTOS) to meet latency, power, and memory requirements
* Write automated tests including unit, integration, and hardware-in-the-loop tests to validate firmware behavior across expected and error conditions
* Instrument firmware with logging, metrics, and alerting to support observability and production reliability
* Collaborate with hardware engineers, silicon teams, and product partners to define firmware interfaces and resolve cross-disciplinary dependencies
* Participate in code reviews to improve firmware quality, identify common embedded software defects, and share knowledge with peers
* Analyze and optimize firmware for power consumption, memory footprint, and real-time execution performance
* Own embedded software components end-to-end, including responding to production issues and maintaining code health through deprecation of obsolete implementations
* Produce clear technical documentation for firmware interfaces, bring-up procedures, and system behaviors to support current and future contributors

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of experience developing embedded firmware or low-level software in C or C++
* Experience with real-time operating systems (RTOS), bare-metal programming, or embedded Linux environments
* Experience developing or debugging device drivers, hardware abstraction layers, or board support packages for microcontrollers or SoCs
* Experience writing automated tests and using debugging tools such as JTAG, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, or serial debuggers to isolate and resolve firmware defects

jobs.title: Staff Embedded Linux Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**About SirenOpt**

SirenOpt helps manufacturers make better, safer, and more reliable micro- and nano-materials. These materials are the building blocks of critical sectors of the global economy such as batteries, computer chips, aircraft components, and power systems. But, surging material demand and growing complexity are pushing production to unprecedented scales and speeds, leaving manufacturers effectively flying blind. Small, undetected variations during production lead to wastage, lower performance, higher costs, and safety risks.

SirenOpt is changing this by developing a manufacturing intelligence platform that non-destructively probes materials during production, revealing critical internal information without damaging them. Using a novel combination of cold atmospheric plasma, physics-informed machine learning, and predictive analytics, SirenOpt generates unique, real-time material fingerprints that capture material signals not accessible through conventional measurement techniques. These insights give manufacturers unprecedented visibility into how materials behave as they are made.

We turn hidden data into actionable intelligence to help manufacturers reduce variability and thus increase yield and performance. The technology can be deployed as a standalone tool or integrated directly into factory production lines. SirenOpt is currently deploying early versions of its platform with some of the largest industrial manufacturers in the world across North America, Europe, and Asia.

**About the job**

**Job Title:** Staff Embedded Linux Software Engineer — Firmware Team

**Location:** On-Site (San Leandro, CA)

**Job Type:** Full-Time

**Role Overview**

SirenOpt is seeking an **Embedded Linux Software Engineer** to join a small, high-impact firmware team building the embedded software stack for a commercial bench-top scientific instrument. The platform is an AMD/Xilinx FPGA SoC (Zynq / UltraScale+) running PetaLinux, with a mix of userspace applications, device drivers, and real-time control interfacing with custom programmable logic.

You'll work alongside an embedded systems architect who owns the Linux application layer, peripheral subsystems, protocol design, and hardware integration. Your core mandate is threefold: share the Linux application workload, own test automation infrastructure, and establish CI/build reliability. You'll write production code and the tooling that proves it works.

This is a small, documentation-driven team, and you'll be expected to write clear design docs and track progress in Jira/Confluence. The role combines hands-on lab work with prototype hardware and desk-based software development, following a sequenced release cadence (HDL OS/drivers embedded applications system integration).

**What You'll Do**

* Develop embedded Linux application software in C (userspace, POSIX)
* Develop userspace and kernel-space drivers for internal and external devices (sensors, actuators, instruments)
* Implement and extend application-level command/control/data protocols over TCP/IP
* Implement communication drivers for industrial instruments (mass flow controllers, vacuum gauges, motor controllers) over serial and CAN interfaces
* Design, build, and maintain hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) automated test systems
* Develop host-side test tooling (Python GUIs, emulators, scripted instrument drivers)
* Establish and maintain CI/CD pipelines and reproducible build infrastructure
* Participate in hardware bring-up, board-level validation, and lab bench debugging
* Contribute to architecture decisions, documentation, and design reviews

**What We're Looking For**

* S., M.S., or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field, with 10+ years of relevant industry experience
* C for embedded Linux userspace, including threading, IPC, and POSIX APIs
* Python for test automation (pytest or equivalent framework) and scripted instrumentation
* TCP/IP socket programming on Linux (non-blocking I/O, connection lifecycle, streaming)
* UDP for discovery and lightweight telemetry
* Bus and serial protocols: UART, SPI, I2C, and CAN
* RS-232 and RS-485, including byte-level protocol implementation (framing, CRC, state machines, multi-device arbitration)
* Hardware bring-up and board-level debugging using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and protocol analyzers
* Producer-consumer and ring buffer patterns for real-time data flow
* Hardware-in-the-loop test development and execution

**Nice to have:**

* Linux DMA programming (scatter-gather, buffer pool management, AXI-DMA)
* CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Docker-based build environments)
* Yocto or PetaLinux BSP experience
* Unit test frameworks for C (gtest, cmocka, Unity)
* Familiarity with FPGA register interfaces (UIO, devmem, register maps)
* Performance profiling and network analysis (Wireshark, throughput characterization)
* Python GUI development for test/operator tooling (Tkinter, PyQt)
* Familiarity with scientific or process-control instrumentation

**Benefits**

* Equity and Salary compensation depends on experience
* Health, Dental, Vision plans provided
* 401k matching provided
* Time off: 20 days of PTO per year, plus approximately 15 paid US holidays per year

* Collaborate with controls, embedded, systems, and robotics engineers to manage differences between simulated and physical interfaces.
* Establish standards for software development, testing, documentation, code review, release management, and operational ownership.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, computer engineering, robotics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of industry experience developing software for simulation, machine learning, robotics, computer vision, or autonomous-systems. Experience with high-volume image, video, time-series, or scientific data and formats such as Parquet, Zarr, or HDF5.
* Strong proficiency in Python and at least one additional language such as C++, Java, or TypeScript.

* Experience building data-intensive applications or data-processing pipelines. Experience designing and operating production-quality backend or platform systems. Experience with asynchronous processing, distributed workers, message queues, or event-driven architectures.

* Strong understanding of API design, data modeling, concurrency, failure handling, and distributed-system fundamentals.
* Experience with Docker, Linux, testing, observability, and production deployment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, MuJoCo, Gazebo, PhysX, or another robotics simulation platform. Familiarity with USD assets and scene composition.
* Experience with coordinate transforms, robot kinematics, joint states, trajectory representations, sensor synchronization, or closed-loop control.
* Experience with ROS or ROS 2 and GPU-enabled applications or infrastructure.
* Experience with Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Ray, Celery, Kubernetes, Slurm, or cloud batch systems.
* Experience building scientific, engineering, ML, or internal developer tools.
* Experience with PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow, MLflow, or Weights & Biases.

jobs.description:
**Company:**

Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.

**Job Area:**
-------------

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Machine Learning Engineering

**General Summary:**

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what is possible to enable next-generation experiences and drive digital transformation, creating a smarter, connected future for all.

  
  

As a Senior Staff Software Engineer in the Qualcomm AI Stack SDK Software team, you will provide technical leadership for bringing state-of-the-art AI models to Snapdragon platforms using Qualcomm’s AI software stack and model-enablement frameworks.

  
  

You will lead the analysis, adaptation, optimization, quantization, compilation, and execution of modern model architectures, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Large Vision Models (LVMs), Vision-Language Models (VLMs), and Large Multimodal Models (LMMs). You will work closely with AI Research teams to understand model internals, identify operator- and graph-level gaps against Qualcomm AI accelerator backends, and develop scalable solutions that can be reused across model families.

  
  

The role operates at the intersection of model architecture, machine learning algorithms, graph transformations, quantization, compiler and runtime technologies, and hardware-aware optimization. You will define technical direction and improve the Qualcomm AI software stack and model-enablement frameworks through reusable model adaptations, quantization recipes, graph optimizations, compilation flows, and execution interfaces.

  
  

You will collaborate with ML Research, AI accelerator hardware and software teams, compiler and runtime teams, Product Management, Program Management, QA, and customer engineering teams to take new model architectures from initial analysis through production-quality execution on Qualcomm devices.

  
  

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will lead and manage a small team of engineers while continuing to contribute as an individual contributor, drive architecture and implementation, establish engineering priorities, mentor team members, and own delivery across multiple model-enablement initiatives.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 6+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.

OR
  
Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 5+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
  
OR
  
PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 4+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead the bring-up and enablement of new LLM, LVM, VLM, and multimodal model architectures on Snapdragon platforms.

* Partner with AI Research teams to understand model architecture, tensor flows, attention and cache behavior, model inputs and outputs, and performance-sensitive computation patterns.

* Analyze model graphs and identify operator-level, graph-level, precision, memory, and runtime gaps against Qualcomm AI accelerator backends.

* Own the architecture and design of scalable model-enablement solutions, including component boundaries, APIs, stage contracts, configuration schemas, artifact interfaces, extensibility mechanisms, and integration across model, quantization, compiler, and runtime systems.

* Define scalable approaches for model re-authoring, graph adaptation, graph lowering, decomposition, fusion, layout transformation, and backend-specific optimization.

* Architect reusable model-enablement solutions instead of model-specific workarounds, and integrate them into Qualcomm’s AI software stack and model-enablement frameworks.

* Lead the design of declarative and extensible pipeline capabilities, including reusable stages, model mappings, quantization recipes, configuration interfaces, artifact handoffs, caching, validation, and execution workflows.

* Develop and optimize model preparation, quantization, calibration, export, compilation, and on-device execution flows.

* Apply quantization techniques such as post-training quantization, quantization-aware training, mixed precision, weight and activation quantization, blockwise or groupwise quantization, calibration, and accuracy-recovery optimization.

* Evaluate accuracy, latency, throughput, memory usage, model size, and power efficiency across floating-point, prepared, quantized, compiled, and on-device execution checkpoints.

* Guide enablement of advanced Generative AI features such as KV-cache optimization, prefill and decode graphs, LoRA, Mixture-of-Experts, speculative decoding, multimodal processing, and vision encoders.

* Debug complex issues across model architecture, PyTorch and ONNX graphs, quantization, compiler, runtime, operating system, and hardware layers.

* Mentor engineers, develop technical expertise within the team, and establish engineering practices for maintainable and production-quality AI software.

* Communicate technical strategy, project status, dependencies, and risks to engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

**Job Description:**

At VMware by Broadcom, we are building new possibilities for our customers by accelerating digital business transformation. We're modernizing data centers for greater agility and productivity, integrating public clouds for faster time to market, empowering digital workspaces to improve mobile experiences, and transforming cyber security.

ESXi Operating System is at the core of VMware Cloud Foundation's (VCF) virtualization technology. It is a platform built from scratch for the explicit purpose of running virtual machines and containers. ESXi is widely used by most large corporations, due to its advanced capabilities, performance, and quality.

The VMKernel Core team is responsible for the design, implementation, and architectural direction of the VMKernel – the operating system kernel for ESXi. The VMKernel Core team works across ESXi but its focus is the core kernel subsystems providing key functionality used by other groups within VMware by Broadcom as well as partner companies.

As an engineer on the core team, you will

* Learn the tools and processes necessary to become a successful VMKernel engineer and will participate in the design and development of novel operating system techniques and algorithms for managing both virtual and real computer hardware.
* Design and implement kernel locking techniques, filesystems, various forms of kernel APIs to interface with device drivers (vmkapi) user programs (POSIX) and other subsystems and invent new OS security and patching infrastructures.
* Work with multiple engineering teams to architect, design, implement and deliver new products based on the enterprise-class VCF virtualization platform.
* Take on opportunities to own parts of the core kernel infrastructures and with experience, take on ownership and lead larger parts of projects.

-----------------

* BS degree in Computer Science or related field and 8+ years of relevant industry experience. Or MS degree in Computer Science or related field and 6+ years of relevant industry experience. Or PhD and 3+ years of relevant industry experience
* Strong understanding of kernel-level OS architectures such as Linux, Unix, Solaris, BSD-like systems, Windows, embedded real-time Operating Systems
* Extensive kernel-level development experience and expertise with synchronization in preemptive multi-threaded environments. Experience with Intel x86 CPU architecture and Intel based server architecture. Similar experience and understanding of AMD architecture, a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Robotics Systems Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Cyngn, Inc.**

Based in Mountain View, CA, Cyngn is a publicly-traded autonomous technology company. We deploy self-driving industrial vehicles -**specifically autonomous tuggers**- to factories, warehouses, and other facilities throughout North America. To build this emergent technology, we are looking for innovative, motivated, and experienced leaders to join us and move this field forward. If you like to build, tinker, and create with a team of trusted and passionate colleagues, then Cyngn is the place for you.

**Key reasons to join Cyngn:**

**We are small and big.**

With under 100 employees, Cyngn operates with the energy of a startup. On the other hand, we’re publicly traded. This means our employees not only work in close-knit teams with mentorship from company leaders—they also get access to the liquidity of our publicly-traded equity.

**We build today and deploy tomorrow.**

Our autonomous vehicles aren’t just test concepts—they’re deployed to real clients right now. That means your work will have a tangible, visible impact.

**We aren’t robots. We just develop them.**

We’re a welcoming, diverse team of sharp thinkers and kind humans. Collaboration and trust drive our creative environment. At Cyngn, everyone’s perspective matters—and that’s what powers our innovation.

**About the role**

As a **Senior Robotics Systems Software Engineer on Cyngn’s Autonomy team**, you will develop, integrate, and deploy software across the autonomous driving stack for our industrial vehicles.

This role is ideal for a strong robotics generalist who enjoys working across subsystem boundaries. Depending on the problem, you may contribute to behavior and decision-making, motion planning, controls, localization, perception interfaces, simulation, or vehicle integration.

You will work closely with engineers across autonomy, vehicle infrastructure, hardware, QA, and deployment to turn robotics algorithms into reliable production systems operating on autonomous tuggers and forklifts at customer sites.

**What you'll do**

* Design, develop, test, and deploy software for autonomous industrial vehicles across areas including behavior and decision-making, motion planning, controls, and vehicle systems.
* Write and maintain production-quality C++ and Python software running on Cyngn’s autonomous vehicle platforms.
* Develop and integrate algorithms for navigation, trajectory generation, vehicle control, obstacle handling, and autonomous behaviors.
* Integrate autonomy software with sensors, drive-by-wire systems, vehicle hardware, and other onboard software components.
* Bring up, validate, and debug software on real vehicles, tracing issues across autonomy modules, middleware, hardware interfaces, and vehicle behavior.
* Develop simulation scenarios, testing infrastructure, metrics, and regression tests to validate autonomy behavior before deployment.
* Investigate field issues and edge cases, reproduce failures, identify root causes, and implement robust production solutions.
* Support deployment and validation of autonomous vehicles at customer facilities, translating real-world observations into improvements across the autonomy stack.
* Collaborate closely with engineers in Planning, Controls, Perception, Localization, Vehicle Infrastructure, Hardware, QA, and Operations.
* Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, technical design, and continuous improvement of Cyngn’s autonomy software.

**Priorities: 3-6-12 Month Goals**

**First 90 Days**

* Build a working understanding of Cyngn’s autonomy architecture, simulation environment, vehicle platforms, development workflow, and deployment process.
* Partner with engineers across autonomy, infrastructure, hardware, QA, and operations to trace representative vehicle behaviors, build working relationships, and identify high-value reliability, integration, and test-coverage risks.
* Deliver one scoped production improvement—such as fixing a well-understood autonomy defect, adding a regression scenario, or improving diagnostic tooling—and validate it in simulation and, where appropriate, on a vehicle.
* Propose a prioritized plan for addressing one or two larger cross-stack risks, including candidate success metrics, data sources, and how each metric will be measured.

**By 6 Months**

* Complete a production-quality autonomy improvement that spans two or more subsystem boundaries and has been accepted into a release candidate and/or at production customer sites.
* Establish the agreed baseline metrics and demonstrate early improvement, such as improved scenario pass rate, fewer interventions, reduced tracking error, or faster failure resolution.
* Add reusable simulation scenarios, regression tests, diagnostics, or validation tools that are incorporated into the team’s release-candidate testing.
* Publish a technical design or process improvement that is reviewed and adopted by the affected teams.

**By 12 Months**

* Demonstrate sustained, measurable production improvement against the six-month baseline through broader deployment and fleet monitoring.
* Own a significant autonomy capability from design through implementation, vehicle validation, deployment, and production monitoring.
* Improve team effectiveness through documentation, code and design reviews, and reusable cross-stack debugging practices.
* Demonstrate technical ownership through observable signals: serving as a reviewer for one or two repositories, leading triage for a class of field issues, or maintaining adopted runbooks and tools used by other engineers.

**Qualifications**

* BS, MS, or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience developing software for robotics, autonomous vehicles, or other autonomous systems.
* Strong proficiency in modern C++ and working proficiency in Python.
* Hands-on experience

**Staff Engineer, Platform Firmware Engineer**

Location: San Jose, CA (On-site)

Ayar Labs is shattering AI data bottlenecks by moving data at the speed of light. As pioneers of co-packaged optics (CPO), we are using light instead of electricity to move data faster, further, and with a fraction of the energy needed to fuel the explosive growth of AI models. Backed by industry giants like NVIDIA, AMD and Intel and manufactured in partnership with the world’s leading semiconductor ecosystem, Ayar Labs’ co-packaged optics solution is key to unleashing next-generation AI scale-up architectures.

We are seeking a Sr. Staff Platform Firmware Engineer to own the board-level and platform-emulation firmware used to enable, validate, and demonstrate Ayar Labs’ electro-photonic products. This role focuses on firmware running on STM32-based boards that emulate customer platforms, control external hardware, and validate embedded firmware running inside Ayar Labs’ and customers’ SoCs.

This is a highly system-oriented, hands-on role operating at the intersection of hardware, firmware, and customer platforms, with deep influence on board design, validation strategy, and customer enablement.  
  
**What You’ll Do**  

* Own and evolve platform-level firmware running on STM32-based systems used for demos, validation, and customer enablement.
* Develop firmware that controls and monitors ADCs, DACs, regulators, laser modules, and other board-level components.
* Build and maintain firmware that emulates customer platforms, enabling realistic system behavior without requiring full customer SoCs.
* Support and scale firmware across multiple board designs, balancing reuse, configurability, and maintainability.
* Lead board bring-up and sign-off, working hands-on in the lab to validate functionality and readiness.
* Review schematics and PCB designs, providing actionable feedback to the hardware team when changes materially improve firmware robustness, testability, or system reliability.
* Coordinate closely with the embedded firmware team responsible for photonic IC control, ensuring clean interfaces and effective system validation.
* Develop board-level firmware that controls, exercises, and tests embedded firmware running inside Ayar Labs’ and customers’ SoCs
* Partner with systems, validation, and customer-facing teams to debug complex cross-domain issues.

  
  
**Required Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field, with 4+ years of platform firmware experience.
* Strong experience with bare-metal platform firmware development in C.
* Hands-on experience with STM32 microcontrollers (or similar ARM-based MCUs).
* Proven experience with board bring-up, lab debugging, and hardware/firmware integration.
* Ability to review schematics and board designs and collaborate deeply with hardware teams.
* Experience supporting multiple hardware platforms within a shared firmware architecture.
* Proficiency with Git-based development workflows.

**Preferred Skills**

Embark on an enriching journey with PROCEPT BioRobotics, where our vision, mission, and values guide everything we do as a company. As our company succeeds and grows, we improve the quality of life of patients, provide more effective treatment options for surgeons, uphold the trust of our shareholders. That starts with a commitment to our People with a focus on creating an evolving landscape for your career, brimming with transformative opportunities that provide continuous career growth opportunities.

At PROCEPT, we believe every person matters. Every employee, every patient, every caregiver. * Design, develop, test, maintain, and document electrical systems for PROCEPT’s products in accordance with PROCEPT’s quality system.
* Contributor within electrical engineering team to develop new products and support capital equipment and accessories.
* Support multiple electronics subassemblies used within Procept’s electromechanical capital equipment, including controllers and interfaces with CMOS camera modules, sensors, pumps, motors, cables, and wiring harnesses.
* Support Supplier Engineering and/or Supply Chain with specification, evaluation, and analysis of alternate components and second-source suppliers.

* Develop HW/SW test systems and/or fixtures for R&D and manufacturing teams
* Ensure designs consider mechanical, firmware, software, and system interactions, as well as testability, manufacturability, and usability.

* Provide input for project schedules.
* Support agency testing for UL, CE, and other certifications (ie. IEC 60601).
* Host and participate in review activities for circuit design, layout design, component selection, and subsystem risk analysis and mitigation.
* Work independently, requiring minimal supervision.
* Maintain trained status for, and comply with, all relevant aspects of the PROCEPT BioRobotics Quality Management System to ensure product and support regulatory compliance.
* Understand and adhere to the PROCEPT BioRobotics Quality and EHS policies.

jobs.description:
**Bring more to life.**

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Molecular Devices, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

Join Molecular Devices and help drive scientific discovery for life science customers in academia, biotech, pharma, and government. Our automated and AI-enabled technology empowers researchers to tackle complex questions and gain deep insights, accelerating the development of safer, more effective therapeutics. As part of our team—rooted in collaboration, authenticity, and innovation—you’ll ultimately contribute to groundbreaking science that enhances lives globally and shapes a healthier future for all.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The **Senior Firmware Engineer** is responsible for designing, developing, verifying, and maintaining embedded firmware for advanced scientific imaging and automation instruments. The role supports shared and complementary embedded technologies across the imaging instrument platforms, including real-time control, precision motion, imaging hardware, communications, firmware updates, environmental control, diagnostics, and multi-board integration.

This position reports to the Software Engineering Manager and is part of the Engineering team located in San Jose, California. This is an on-site role supporting hands-on instrument development and integration.

**In this role, you will have the opportunity to:**

  

* Design and deliver production embedded firmware in C and modern C++ for STM32-based controllers, creating maintainable architectures for multi-board scientific instruments and board-specific applications.
* Lead hardware bring-up, subsystem integration, and performance optimization across motion, imaging, illumination, sensing, temperature control, and other instrument functions in partnership with electrical, mechanical, systems, test, application software, and manufacturing teams.
* Develop and troubleshoot real-time FreeRTOS and CMSIS-RTOS applications, including task scheduling, synchronization, queues, notifications, timers, interrupts, DMA, memory usage, and fault recovery.
* Implement reliable device communication and update capabilities, including peripheral drivers, framed host-device protocols, CRC-protected messaging, Ethernet/TCP services, embedded networking, bootloaders, flash programming, image verification, and persistent configuration.
* Strengthen product quality and technical execution by building unit, integration, hardware-assisted, and hardware-in-the-loop tests; maintaining build and continuous-integration workflows; leading design and code reviews; documenting interfaces and decisions; mentoring engineers; and driving root-cause analysis of regressions and field issues.

**The essential requirements of the job include:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of professional embedded firmware development experience, including ownership of production systems through development, integration, release, and maintenance.
* Expert proficiency in embedded C and strong proficiency in modern C++ for resource-constrained microcontrollers, with practical experience on STM32 or comparable Arm Cortex-M platforms.
* Hands-on experience developing RTOS-based and non-RTOS embedded systems, including interrupts, DMA, timers, concurrency, memory constraints, and fault handling. Experience designing and maintaining hardware-facing firmware using UART, I2C, SPI, PWM, ADC/DAC, GPIO, Ethernet/TCP, or comparable interfaces. Ability to read schematics and datasheets and diagnose hardware–firmware interactions using oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, logic analyzers, and other standard bench tools.
* Demonstrated experience with code reviews, automated testing, technical documentation, and disciplined root-cause analysis for complex embedded products.

**Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:**

  

* Willing and able to travel up to 10%.
* Able to lift up to 50 pounds.

**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**

  

* Experience developing scientific instruments, microscopy systems, laboratory automation, imaging systems, or other complex electromechanical products.
* Experience integrating device drivers with application software.

jobs.title: Senior PLM Software Engineer, Manufacturing Systems
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

Maritime Digital Production (MDP) is the software and digital systems function within Anduril's Heavy Metal division. We build the software-defined shipyard. That means the full technology stack running Anduril's shipbuilding factories: the data infrastructure that makes every machine and sensor visible in real time, ArsenalOS (our manufacturing execution system that workers and planners use every shift), the scheduling engine that replans production in minutes instead of days, and the AI systems that eliminate manual toil from both the shop floor and business operations.  
  
This work is anchored by Arsenal-2, our software-defined shipyard being built in Baltimore County, Maryland. It's part of a new $6.6 billion investment in America's submarine industrial base. ArsenalOS is the digital backbone of that yard. It connects fabrication and outfitting to material movement and inspection. Planners get one real-time view of production. We aren't waiting for the yard to open. Development is already underway here in Orange County, California. The team is proving out the manufacturing methods and digital workflows that will scale across the shipyard network.  
  
MDP operates at the boundary between Operational Technology and Information Technology. Our systems live where factory-floor machines, edge compute, and OT networks meet enterprise platforms and cloud infrastructure. We incubate solutions close to the production line, validate them with real operators building real hardware, harden them for reliability and security, and then scale them across multiple sites. The environment is fast, physical, and consequential. When our systems go down, production stops. The output of our work is not a dashboard: it is a ship.  
  
This is not a support function. It is a strategic investment by Anduril in the premise that digitizing the manufacturing lifecycle end-to-end, from engineering definition through scheduling through execution through field feedback, is how Heavy Metal will out-build, out-adapt, and out-scale the traditional defense industrial base. MDP is scaling from a founding team to 70+ engineers across multiple U.S. sites. You will be joining early, working on hard problems with real operational stakes, and shaping how manufacturing software is built at Anduril from the ground up.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

MDP is building the manufacturing digital thread that connects engineering release to the machines and inspection systems on the factory floor. You'll own the Development and integration integration layer between Teamcenter and Anduril's ArsenalOS platform so CAM programs, CAI/CMM programs, tools and fixtures, and inspection results move automatically instead of by hand.

#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Build and own the integrations that carry CAM and CAI data out of Teamcenter and onto the shop floor, including NX CAM outputs, DNC dispatch to machine controls and the return path for as-run data.
* Develop custom Teamcenter extensions using ITK and SOA, along with BMIDE data model changes and Active Workspace interfaces, to support manufacturing workflows that off-the-shelf configuration can't reach.
* Close the inspection loop by integrating CAI and metrology systems so measured results land back in the digital thread as structured data rather than static reports.
* Make EBOM to MBOM propagation and model-based definition data flow automatically into downstream manufacturing and quality systems.
* Unblock partner teams across scheduling, applied AI and manufacturing systems by exposing manufacturing data through APIs they can build on.
* Partner with manufacturing engineers and factory operators to understand production workflows and translate them into software requirements.
* Write production-quality code with comprehensive tests, participating in code review and architectural discussions.
* Deploy and operate your systems in factory environments, including edge compute clusters and OT networks.
* Leverage AI tooling (coding assistants, automation) in your development workflow and contribute to team engineering practices.
* Join an on-call rotation supporting production factory systems.

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 8+ years of experience in a software engineering role building production systems, ideally in a fast-paced environment.
* Deep expertise in Teamcenter development: 5+ years hands-on with ITK and SOA customization in C++ and Java, BMIDE data modeling and Active Workspace.
* Demonstrated experience building custom Teamcenter handlers, services and integrations, not only configuring workflows and templates.
* Working knowledge of manufacturing data domains, including CAM, CAI, CMM, and NC programming outputs, machine dispatch, metrology and inspection data, and the relationship between EBOM and MBOM.
* Experience authoring and developing NX Open programs to automate NX/Design Center workflows.
* Strong technical fluency in modern software architectures, APIs, distributed systems, CI/CD, and cloud or edge infrastructure.
* Experience building systems that must operate reliably under real-world operational constraints (high availability, low latency, or constrained environments).
