**Description of Duties:**

The **Senior Systems Engineer** supports SLS Program / NASA systems on the Amentum ESSCA contract.

The key purpose of the position is to plan and perform systems engineering, development, assembly, test, verification, certification, integration activities specifically for the SLS Upper Stage for Artemis IV and beyond. Provide support to implement additional requirements for the ARTEMIS and MAESTRO software including design, development, integration and testing with Upper Stage partner(s). Facilitate integration as needed between SLS Core Stage test & integration facilities and Upper Stage test & integration facilities.

Responsibilities:

The Senior Systems Engineer will provide systems engineering support to the NASA SLS Upper Stage program office at MSFC. The skills needed to support the Core Stage consists of all the skills provided to the ES53 IATF, including Simulations software developers, systems engineers, integration and test engineers, and mechanical and electrical technicians.

Additional responsibilities are defined below:

* Perform or coordinate systems engineering activities including Trade Studies and Analysis, Requirements Definition and Traceability, Requirements Allocation and Verification, Interface Definition, System Integration and test, and Design Verification and Validation. Also ensure requirements and specifications can be verified and validated, including risk mitigations, usability and NASA requirements.

* Work closely with SLS Upper stage program office and IATF software, hardware, and facility development personnel during development, understanding of configurations in development, operation, verification, and validation of IATF systems and emulators.

* Assist the project verification and validation team by defining and delivering verification and validation project deliverables.

* Ensure that all test systems and equipment are appropriately validated and controlled.

* Review and analyze IATF system test data and record pass/fail results and conclusions. Ensure that results are traced to requirements.

* Measure and report on progress toward completion of verification and validation, and summarize the verification and validation performed, the data reviewed, and conclusions reached in compliance.

* Support completion of development testing, to characterize designs and understand trade-offs.

* Create or contribute to project deliverables which may include verification and/or validation plans, protocols, and reports; execution of the plans and protocols; and resolving deviations.

* Manage timeline for verification and validation activities and generate status reports.

These activities will continue as the launch vehicle architecture matures and the SLS program completes program phases, reviews and schedule milestones.

**Overview:**

Draper is an independent, nonprofit research and development company headquartered in Cambridge, MA. The 2,000+ employees of Draper tackle important national challenges with a promise of delivering successful and usable solutions. From military defense and space exploration to biomedical engineering, lives often depend on the solutions we provide. Our multidisciplinary teams of engineers and scientists work in a collaborative environment that inspires the cross-fertilization of ideas necessary for true innovation. For more information about Draper, visit www.draper.com.

**Job Description Summary:**

A Senior Precision Analog/Power Electronics Engineer designs, specifies, develops, and tests analog/ power electronics for a wide array of applications, such as switched-mode power conversion, battery management circuitry, distributed power architectures, wireless power transfer, radiation hardened designs, motor controllers, low noise power conditioning for precision instrumentation, analog front ends, signal conditioning, analog-to-digital conversion, precision feedback systems, and dc/dc conversion. The engineer develops the architecture, designs these circuits, performs simulations, implements the physical layout, verifies and tests designs. They also perform a variety of engineering activities throughout the life cycle to support planning, design, test, deployment, and sustainment.  
  
Applicant will be responsible for carrying out circuit simulations to verify custom spice models against component specifications. The engineer will collaborate closely with the part designer and model designers to verify and modify both as necessary.

**Job Description:**

**Duties/Responsibilities**

* Optimizes system designs for reduced size, weight, and power.

We are looking for an engineer who is naturally curious, relentlessly analytical, and driven to understand how things actually work. The ideal candidate is the person with the home lab, the engineer who takes systems apart to understand them, researches the problem until they find the answer, and is never satisfied with “that's just how it works.”

This is not a traditional single-system engineering role. You will work across a large enterprise environment spanning 28 IT engineering disciplines, helping solve complex operational problems, develop new capabilities, automate processes, and improve the effectiveness, security, and compliance of systems supporting tens of thousands of devices and users.

The problems will change constantly. So will the priorities. We are looking for someone who is excited by that.

* **Continuously improve the environment**. Identify weaknesses, inefficiencies, security gaps, operational problems, and opportunities for automation—and take ownership of improving them.

**Job Description: Systems Engineer – Energy Systems & Embedded Software**

**Company:** NAVIA Energy Inc.  
**Location:** San Jose, California (with customer-site travel)  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Travel:** Required, including vendor facilities, customer sites, and energy system deployment locations  
**Work Authorization:** U.S. Citizenship Required

**About NAVIA Energy**

NAVIA Energy is developing an AI-powered autonomous energy operations platform that integrates solar PV, battery energy storage systems (BESS), inverters, smart load controllers, and grid-connected energy assets. Our technology helps commercial and industrial facilities, microgrids, and mission-critical installations improve energy efficiency, reliability, resilience, and operational performance.

**Position Overview**

NAVIA Energy is seeking a versatile, hands-on Systems Engineer to support the integration, installation, commissioning, testing, and optimization of distributed energy systems. The ideal candidate combines practical knowledge of solar and battery systems with embedded software development, industrial communication protocols, system performance monitoring, and field engineering.

The engineer will work closely with NAVIA's engineering team, equipment vendors, installation contractors, and customers to develop, integrate, test, and deploy complete energy management solutions at customer sites.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Energy Systems Integration and Deployment**

* Support the design, integration, installation, and commissioning of solar PV systems, battery energy storage systems (BESS), inverters, smart load controllers, meters, and associated electrical equipment.
* Coordinate with solar EPCs, battery suppliers, inverter manufacturers, electrical contractors, and other technology vendors.
* Support grid-connected and microgrid deployments, including grid import/export configurations, energy flow management, and load control.
* Assist with electrical system integration, equipment configuration, functional testing, troubleshooting, and site acceptance testing.
* Work with engineering teams to translate system designs into reliable field deployments.

**2. Embedded Software and Communication Protocols**

* Develop, configure, test, and debug embedded software for energy monitoring, control, and edge computing systems.
* Implement and troubleshoot industrial communication protocols, particularly **Modbus RTU and Modbus TCP**.
* Integrate communication interfaces with inverters, BESS controllers, meters, sensors, and smart load controllers.
* Develop device drivers, communication interfaces, configuration utilities, and diagnostic tools as needed.
* Support hardware-software integration, firmware validation, and system-level debugging.

**3. Software Installation and System Configuration**

* Install, configure, and maintain NAVIA software on edge computers, gateways, and customer-site systems.
* Support software deployment, firmware updates, device provisioning, network configuration, and remote connectivity.
* Validate data acquisition and communication between field devices and NAVIA's energy management platform.
* Document installation procedures, configuration settings, troubleshooting steps, and software release versions.

**4. Energy Performance Monitoring and Optimization**

* Establish and track performance metrics for solar PV, BESS, inverters, grid interaction, and controllable loads.
* Collect and analyze operational data, including energy generation, consumption, battery state of charge, charging/discharging power, grid import/export, and system efficiency.
* Develop performance dashboards, test reports, and system validation procedures.
* Identify performance deviations, communication failures, energy losses, and equipment integration issues.
* Support testing and validation of energy management algorithms, automated controls, and AI-based optimization functions.

**5. Customer-Site Engineering and Technical Support**

* Work directly with engineering teams to prepare, install, commission, and validate systems at customer sites.
* Conduct site assessments, equipment inspections, integration testing, and troubleshooting.
* Coordinate with customers, contractors, and vendors to resolve technical issues and meet deployment schedules.
* Provide technical documentation, training, and post-deployment support.
* Travel to customer locations and vendor facilities as required.

jobs.title: Spacecraft Flight Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Proteus Space is a Los Angeles-based spacecraft technology company established to capitalize on a rapidly evolving space landscape and the urgent need to deliver resilient orbital capabilities to maintain and increase our national science and security interests. We combine serious space flight experience with an open minded, first-principles approach, leveraging advanced computational design and Industry 4.0 practices to deliver custom spacecraft and mission solutions with industry leading speed, precision, and reliability. We seek to enable every payload and mission with a fully custom, purpose-built spacecraft bus, designed and delivered using Proteus™, our patent-pending, automated computational design platform, with industry leading reliability.

**Role Description**

We are seeking a Spacecraft Flight Software Engineer to join our flight program team. This is a full-time, in office role for an experienced professional with a proven track record of hands-on work across spacecraft flight software (FSW). In this role, you will design and implement the software architecture that controls everything from core telemetry and bus communications to complex boot behaviors and memory management. You will bridge the gap between high-level logic and low-level hardware, ensuring our spacecraft operates with industry-leading reliability in the harsh environment of space.

**Key Responsibilities**.

● Build and maintain spacecraft FSW architecture.

● Implement new software components and communication protocols to support mission-specific payload requirements.

● Ensure the smooth operation of core system tasks, including telemetry collection, precise time-stamping, rate group scheduling, and robust bus communications.

● Develop drivers and logic for interfacing with FPGAs and GPIOs to control spacecraft hardware.

● Design and manage memory storage solutions, making critical design decisions regarding volatile vs non-volatile memory to ensure data integrity.

● Develop and implement critical boot behaviors, partition swapping logic, and fail-safe recovery modes.

● Manage the codebase using Gitlab, including the development and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and development.

● Execute comprehensive test campaigns on flatsat testbeds and flight units to verify software performance under flight-like conditions.

● Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate subsystems with the spacecraft main compute element.

● Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.

● Document design processes, test results, and system performance.

● Provide technical guidance on FSW architectures to fellow engineers, fostering a culture of excellence and innovation.

**Minimum Qualifications**

● Bachelor’s or advanced degree in computer science, aerospace engineering, or similar field.

● 5-7 years of flight software experience in aerospace or related fields, with heavy emphasis on hands-on spacecraft code development and testing

● Proficiency in Python, C/C++, and embedded Linux.

● Strong proficiency with Gitlab and CI/CD workflows.

● Strong ability to collaborate effectively in a dynamic environment while maintaining a positive and professional attitude.

● Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

● Must possess or be willing and eligible to obtain a United States Department of Defense Top Secret security clearance.

**Desired Qualifications:**

● Proficiency in frameworks such as FPrime or CFS, and strong grasp of core computer architecture principles including operating systems, memory architecture, and I/O interfaces

● Demonstrated expertise with hardware-level protocols (I2C, CAN, UART, RS485, etc.) and interfacing with FPGAs and GPIOs.

● Experience working in clean room environments and adhering to ESD protocols.

● Experience with memory management, file systems, and bootloader development for embedded systems.

Pay: $150,000.00 - $225,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* On-site gym
* Paid time off
* Referral program
* Relocation assistance
* RSU
* Stock options
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Do you possess or be willing and eligible to obtain a United States Department of Defense Top Secret security clearance?
* How many space missions have you developed flight software for?
* How many years experience do you have with flight software frameworks such as FPrime, CFS, MAX?

* Do you have at least 5 years of hands-on flight software experience with a primary focus on high-level application software, mission management logic, or onboard autonomy?
* Do you have any experience with GDS or operations?

### **Company Description**

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.

### **Job Description**

**Primary Function of Position:**

We are seeking a Staff Electrical Engineer to join the Advanced Product Development (APD) research and development team at Intuitive Surgical. In this role you will be responsible for both embedded architecture definition, motor control systems and the design and implementation of high-speed compute platform PCAs. As a Staff Electrical Engineer, you will work with a small multidisciplinary start-up-like team chartered with inventing the future of computer-augmented robotic surgery. You will be involved in delivering features by integrating complex functionality into complete surgical robot solutions, and seeing these through verification, validation and product release.

The successful candidate must excel in a high-energy focused small-team environment, be able to drive to solutions from rough requirements, and have a commitment to high product quality. Quick learning and a desire to deeply understand requirements, develop high-fidelity prototypes, and rapidly iterate are essential. A strong sense of shared responsibility and shared reward is required, as is the desire to make work fun, collaborative, and interesting. **Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Design, bring-up, and integration of custom printed circuit assemblies (PCAs).

* Collaborate on system design and architecture with other Advanced Development engineering team members, including FPGA logic design, mechanical, software and controls.
* Identify and implement key components in actuation of robotic systems (e.g. position and motion sensing, vision, embedded display and UI, and the driving of brushed and brushless DC motors).
* Implement PCB designs that balance performance, cost, and manufacturability.
* Perform board level bring-up and troubleshooting.
* Perform formal risk analysis and develop mitigations.
* Discover and develop new vendors and their technologies – develop the design and performance understanding to transform these into robust building blocks for future platforms.
* Write detailed design documentation, including specifications and verification plans per Intuitive’s guidelines.
* Write V&V (Verification and Validation) protocols and associated scripts, as well as protocol execution.
* Follow rigorous design control methodology from design specification through design transfer to manufacturing.

### **Qualifications**

**Skill/Job Requirements:**

* Minimum BS degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering
* Minimum 12 years industry experience in embedded system design
* Demonstrated expertise in dense Printed Circuit Board (PCB) design
* Strong understanding of digital logic design and transmission line theory
* Strong understanding of BLDC motor control systems, GAN FETs, Current sensing mechanisms
* Design experience with products that have real-world physical interaction (sensing and actuation)
* Experience in design, testing, and troubleshooting to meet electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) requirements
* Familiarity with a broad range of electronic components and hardware, including FPGAs (Xilinx preferred), memories, logic, signal conditioning, and communication interfaces
* Expertise with schematic capture tools (OrCAD preferred)
* PCB layout experience desired (Allegro preferred)
* Exposure to FPGA logic design, tools, and verification process (Verilog and ModelSim preferred)
* Excellent ability to debug and characterize electronic systems using standard bench test equipment such as oscilloscopes, function generators, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, etc.
* Proficiency in using scripting languages for development and test (Python preferred)
* Experience with all phases of the product development lifecycle, including design, implementation, debug, verification, validation, and transfer to manufacturing
* Comfort with concepts of design input, design output, traceability, and risk analysis
* Hands-on engineering experience with proven ability to work well in a team environment
* Excellent communication and documentation skills
* A passion to get to the root cause of tough technical problems!

jobs.title: Principal Test Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
At **d-Matrix**, we are focused on unleashing the potential of generative AI to power the transformation of technology. We are at the forefront of software and hardware innovation, pushing the boundaries of what is possible. Our culture is one of **respect and collaboration.**

We value humility and believe in direct communication. Our **team is inclusive**, and our differing perspectives allow for better solutions. We are seeking individuals passionate about tackling challenges and are driven by execution. Ready to come find your playground? **Together**, we can help shape the endless possibilities of AI.

**Principal Test Automation Engineer**

**Location:** Santa Clara, Ca / Remote, US

**Role Overview**

d-Matrix is hiring a Principal Software Engineer to define and build how we use AI-enabled automation across the software development lifecycle, from build and CI through testing and release. Our codebase spans a kernel compiler, firmware, device drivers, and an inference serving stack running on silicon we designed ourselves. Tests require real hardware, correctness is numerical rather than pass/fail, and failures can originate in any of several layers. You will set the technical direction for AI-enabled workflow automation and build the foundations other engineers rely on, including the agent harness, integrations into GitLab, Jira, test results, and logs, guardrails, and evaluation methods that show whether an automation actually helped. You will stay hands-on and ship the hardest pieces yourself, working alongside a Senior/Staff engineer in the same area while raising the bar for how the broader engineering organization uses AI in its daily work.

**What You Will Do**

* Set the technical direction for AI-enabled workflow automation across build, CI, test, and release.
* Build the shared foundation, including the agent harness and tool integrations into GitLab, Jira, test results, logs, and observability data.
* Develop evaluation methodology to measure whether an automation saves time and preserves correctness.
* Define guardrails and standards for where AI acts autonomously, where it proposes and a human decides, and how every change stays auditable.
* Deliver the first Quality Engineering automations, including cross-layer failure attribution, failure clustering and defect deduplication, coverage-gap analysis, and release-readiness summaries.
* Raise the bar across engineering through shared patterns, design reviews, and mentoring.
* Determine when an agent, a deterministic tool with a narrow model step, or a simple script is the right solution, and teach that judgment to others.

**What You Will Bring**

* Extensive production software engineering experience, with strong Python skills.
* Enough Rust and/or C++ experience to understand build flows and diagnose compiler errors.
* Experience shipping AI-enabled tools or automation that others relied on in production, beyond demos.
* Deep hands-on experience with LLM APIs, agent harnesses, tool integration, and context engineering.
* Experience designing evaluations for nondeterministic systems, showing that an automation helped without breaking something else.
* Sound judgment about when AI is the right tool, including examples of choosing not to use it.
* Strong fluency across the development lifecycle, including CI/CD, testing, and release processes.
* A track record of setting technical direction across teams that do not report to you.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to compilers, firmware, or hardware-in-the-loop test environments.
* Experience building tool integrations with MCP or similar protocols.
* Experience working with GitLab, Jira, or Prometheus APIs.
* Experience managing cost and latency in LLM-based systems.
* Daily use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot, with well-formed opinions on where they help and where they do not.

**Equal Opportunity Employment Policy**

**d-Matrix** is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcomed and empowered to do their best work. We hire the best talent for our teams, regardless of race, religion, color, age, disability, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, genetic information, marital status, national origin, political affiliation, or veteran status. Our focus is on hiring teammates with humble expertise, kindness, dedication and a willingness to embrace challenges and learn together every day.

**d-Matrix** does not accept resumes or candidate submissions from external agencies. We appreciate the interest and effort of recruitment firms, but we kindly request that individual interested in opportunities with d-Matrix apply directly through our official channels. This approach allows us to streamline our hiring processes and maintain a consistent and fair evaluation of al applicants. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

Compensation Range: $195K - $285K

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Machina Labs:**

Engineering moves at software speed. Manufacturing doesn't. Yet.

Machina Labs is changing that. We build intelligent, software-defined factories that produce complex metal structures directly from digital design. By integrating advanced metal forming, robotics, and automated production inside a flexible factory architecture, we enable customers to move from prototype to production in weeks, not years.

Backed by Lockheed Martin, Toyota, and NVIDIA, we're building the manufacturing infrastructure that defense, aerospace, and advanced mobility programs will run on.

If you want to work on hard problems that matter and see them fly, drive, and defend, this is the place.

### **Job Description:**

Machina Labs is seeking a **Senior Electrical Engineer** to serve as both individual contributor and technical lead for the electrical systems behind our robotic manufacturing platforms.

You will own electrical design across the production cell and the platforms that follow, along with the architecture, standards, interfaces, and supplier relationships those machines depend on. You will make consequential calls on cost, schedule, compliance, and production readiness, lead technical engagement with suppliers, certification bodies, and customers, and set the bar for electrical work across Mechanical, Robotics, Automation, and Manufacturing.

The ideal candidate has led the electrical design of industrial machinery, robotics, CNC, or automation equipment across more than one machine or program, has taken machinery through compliance, and still wants to be hands-on while we grow the team.

### **What you will own:**

**Electrical architecture across platforms:**

* Own electrical design across the production cell and future platforms, including the electrical record: schematics, interconnect diagrams, panel layouts, and harness drawings, released and revision-controlled in PDM.

* Set the electrical architecture and documentation approach that can be reused across platforms.

* Define and govern interfaces between robot controllers, PLC panels, end effectors, and instrumentation under change control, and make the architecture, protection, and interface calls that affect cost, schedule, and production readiness.

* Perform, document, and set the practice for power distribution, grounding and bonding, and signal integrity analysis for 480VAC and 24VDC systems, drives, sensors, and I/O.

* Partner with the controls and software team, who own PLC and robot programming, on I/O, safety logic, and industrial network architecture.

* Lead investigation of complex and intermittent electrical problems across power, controls, and integration, and deliver root causes.

**Suppliers and production:**

* Own the technical relationship with outsourced panel and harness suppliers: release packages, approve deviations, drive quality issues to root cause, and prepare the supply base to build repeatably at production volume.

* Correct how panels and harnesses are built in-house today and set the build and inspection standard both in-house and supplier builds are held to.

* Design and review PLC and control panels for manufacturability and serviceability.

* Resolve the electrical problems that have resisted resolution, including those that cross disciplines, suppliers, and field installations.

**PCBAs and instrumentation:**

* Design and review custom PCBAs and instrumentation, and set the review, bring-up, and production release practice for board-level work.

**Compliance and machine safety:**

* Own the compliance approach for our machines against UL/IEC and machine safety requirements, and lead hardware through it.

* Lead technical engagement with certification bodies and customers on electrical matters.

* Anticipate systemic electrical and safety risk across programs and establish the design review practice that stops it before it reaches the floor.

**Technical leadership:**

* Set the technical standard for electrical work across the hardware team, including design standards, symbol libraries, and review checklists.

* Lead electrical design reviews across Mechanical, Robotics, and Manufacturing, and mentor and develop the engineers doing electrical work.

* This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required for this role. Duties and responsibilities may change based on business needs.

### **Required Background & Experience:**

* B.S. in Electrical Engineering or equivalent.

* 7+ years of electrical engineering on industrial machinery, robotics, CNC, or automation equipment, including end-to-end ownership of electrical design across multiple machines or a platform.

* Experience setting electrical standards, running design reviews, and developing other engineers.

* Electronic system, device, or instrumentation design, including PCBA schematics, bring-up, test, and validation.

* 480VAC power distribution and 24VDC control: panel design, drives, PLC I/O, safety circuits, grounding.

* Industrial network design (EtherCAT, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET).

* Diagnosing or mitigating EMI/EMC issues on servo drives and sensor wiring in high-noise industrial environments (shielding, grounding, cable routing).

* Fluency in electrical CAD (EPLAN, SolidWorks Electrical, AutoCAD Electrical, or similar) and producing release-quality schematics and harness drawings.

* Experience as the engineering owner for contract electrical system builds such as panels or harnesses.

* Strong documentation and change control discipline.

* Must be a U.S. person as defined under ITAR, due to access to export-controlled information.

* Able to work onsite in Chatsworth, CA, with occasional travel to suppliers, customers, or additional Machina factory sites.

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience taking industrial machinery through compliance (UL 508A, NFPA 79, NFPA 70 (NEC), IEC 60204-1, IEC 62061, or equivalent).

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Backend)
jobs.description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with omniscient systems purpose-built for today's realities. Designed and built by top U.S. military veterans and Silicon Valley innovators, CHAOS Industries' products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats. In a world where technological threats move at unprecedented speed, CHAOS Industries delivers advanced sensing and detection solutions that give the ultimate advantage: time.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised $1B in total funding from leading investors including 8VC, Accel, and NEA. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

  

### **The Role**

You'll join a small, highly collaborative team in San Francisco building the software behind some of the world's most advanced radar systems.  
Working alongside software, hardware, and systems engineers, and the teams who take these systems into the field, you'll design the backend services and data pipelines that turn raw sensor data into decisions people can act on.  
We're looking for builders who learn quickly and enjoy hard distributed systems and real-time data problems.

### **What You'll Build**

* Edge-to-Cloud Data Delivery - robust, low-latency systems that move sensor data from radars in the field, often over constrained bandwidth, to the services and operators that depend on it.
* Backend Services - high-performance Python (FastAPI) services that ingest, process, and distribute real-time sensor data reliably and securely at scale.
* Live and Replay Data - the streaming, storage, and replay of detections, tracks, and telemetry that power high-speed live views and playback of 3D geospatial data fused from multiple sensors.
* Fleet Orchestration - the coordination and decision-making layer that optimizes how a growing fleet of sensors operates as conditions in the field change.
* Platform Architecture - help shape the technical direction of the platform, making architectural decisions that support new capabilities, increasing scale, and long-term maintainability.

### **What We're Looking For**

We're looking for exceptional software engineers who are excited by hard technical problems and building systems that matter. Beyond our core stack, we care more about strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly than about any specific technology.

You'll thrive in this role if you:

* Have strong production experience building backend services in Python (FastAPI or similar).
* Have built real-time or streaming data systems - message queues, WebSockets, time-series data - and enjoy hard distributed systems problems.
* Have owned a production system end to end - designed it, shipped it, and fixed it when it broke.
* Are eager to learn new technologies and adapt to new technical domains.
* Care deeply about reliability, security, and scalability.
* Get real leverage from AI coding tools, with a considered view on what to delegate to them and what not to.
* Communicate well and enjoy collaborating across teams.

Experience in any of the following is a plus:

* Building geospatial or 3D data visualizations in TypeScript and React.
* Edge computing, or moving data reliably over constrained or unreliable networks.
* Azure or another major cloud platform.
* Hardware, sensors, robotics, telemetry, or defense systems.

### **Requirements**

* Must be a U.S. Person (U.S. citizen or permanent resident), as required for access to controlled technology.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance.
* Based in, or willing to relocate to, the San Francisco Bay Area. This role is onsite in our SF office.

  

**Why CHAOS?**

* **Health Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company
* **Additional benefits**: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more
* **Our Perks:** Free daily lunch, 'No meeting Fridays', unlimited PTO, casual dress code
* **Compensation Components:** Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses
* **Team Growth:** 250 employees and counting across 5 global offices

***$140k-240k***

*The stated compensation range reflects only the targeted base compensation range and excludes additional earnings such as bonus, equity, and benefits. If your compensation requirements fall outside of the range, we still encourage you to apply. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations.*

jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About This Role**

The Cloud Storage team at Crusoe is seeking a **Senior Staff Software Engineer** to serve as a primary architect and visionary for our storage strategy. While a Staff Engineer leads features, a Senior Staff Engineer defines the multi-year technical roadmap that underpins our AI-scale infrastructure. You will be a multiplier, responsible for the architectural strategy, integrity and global scalability of our bespoke storage services. You will work at the physics of the stack, bridging the gap between high-performance NVMe hardware and globally distributed, S3-competitive object stores.

**What You’ll Be Working On**

* **Architectural Vision & Strategy:** Define and drive the long-term technical strategy for Crusoe’s storage engine. Identify industry trends (e.g., CXL, NVMe-oF) and integrate them into a cohesive roadmap.
* **System Programming Expertise:** Leverage proven experience in system programming with languages such as **C, C++, Go, and/or Rust** to build the foundations of our V2 storage re-architecture.
* **Storage Protocols:** Architect and implement solutions utilizing industry-standard storage protocols such as **NFS, SMB, iSCSI, and NVMe/TCP.**
* **Open Source Stewardship:** Drive and maintain a track record of contributions to the open-source community (e.g., **Ceph, GlusterFS, Lustre, Spectrum Scale, OpenEBS**).
* **Technical Authority:** Serve as the final arbiter for critical architecture decisions across the Foundations organization. Lead complex design reviews that intersect storage, networking, and virtualization.
* **Deep Performance Engineering:** Lead "tiger teams" to solve the most ambiguous and difficult bottlenecks in the stack—from kernel-level IO context switching to global tail-latency in distributed clusters.
* **Strategic Collaboration:** Work closely with Executive Leadership and Product to align technical capabilities with business milestones, such as our imminent path to IPO.

**What You’ll Bring to the Team**

* **Cloud Storage Expertise:** 12+ years of experience building and operating large-scale, complex distributed cloud computing infrastructure products.
* **Troubleshooting & Tuning:** Strong troubleshooting and performance tuning skills; ability to profile and optimize the entire IO path.
* **High-Drive Mindset:** Self-motivation to thrive in a fast-paced environment with a high degree of ownership and minimal supervision.
* **Masters of Consistency & Durability:** Deep theoretical and practical knowledge of distributed state and data protection at petabyte scale.
* **Software Engineering Fundamentals:** Mastery of professional software engineering practices for the full SDLC, including coding standards, build processes, and testing.
* **Communication & Collaboration:** Ability to champion and lead initiatives across the engineering organization, such as tech talks and technical reading groups.

**Bonus Points**

* **Public Cloud & AI/ML:** Expertise in one or more Public Cloud offerings (**AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI**) and familiarity with AI/ML frameworks (**PyTorch, Tensorflow, JAX**) and MLOps.
* **High-Throughput I/O:** Experience with cutting-edge I/O architectures like **DAOS or SPDK**.
* **Networking Foundations:** Background in **RDMA** and high-performance networking, including **SmartNICs and RoCEv2**.
* **Distributed Systems Mastery:** Experience with highly available and scalable systems such as **Cassandra, MongoDB, Redis, or Kafka**.
* **Theoretical Depth:** Strong knowledge of distributed systems fundamentals including **CAP Theorem, Paxos/RAFT, consistent hashing, and sharding strategies**.
* **Education:** Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

**Benefits:**

* Volunteer time off

**Compensation Range**

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $245,000 - $290,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

The Build Environments and Tools team owns developer productivity infrastructure related to build orchestration, build systems, and containerized build environments that engineers rely on daily to build and test software.

* Detail-oriented with a strong focus on data integrity and alert quality

jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

**About the Role:**

CrowdStrike Falcon Host is a two-component security product. One component is a “sensor”: a driver installed on client machines that observes system activity and recognizes malicious behavior, then provides on-box prevention capability and remote telemetry to the Falcon Host cloud. The sensor processes thousands of events per second to provide deep visibility into operations on the endpoint, and performs rich correlation and computation to identify malicious events and blocks malicious activity.

The cloud component aggregates sensor telemetry for each customer’s network, correlates malicious behavior across multiple machines, and presents our customers’ operations teams with a prioritized summary of the threats detected in their environments.

This is a **Sr. Software Development Engineer II** (SDE) role in the **CTIO** team that is bringing multiple AI-based strategies together into an integrated capability on our next-generation sensor (lightweight agent) across macOS, Linux, and Windows platforms. The Sr. SDEs in the team own the design and development of the features that put AI on the endpoint: operationalizing machine learning models inside the sensor, building the data pipelines that collect, transform and deliver sensor telemetry for model training, evaluation and on-device inference, and integrating those capabilities with the core sensor features. Features will cross-cut most core OS subsystems such as file system, memory, process, and networking, and many are built with shared components across platforms. The team operates under the Agile development principles and ships frequently.

The **CTIO** team at CrowdStrike is responsible for defining and executing the company's technology vision and strategy, driving innovation and overseeing the development and evolution of the Falcon platform. The CTIO ensures CrowdStrike maintains its position as a technology leader by fostering engineering excellence, aligning technical capabilities with business objectives, and anticipating emerging threats and market trends.

**What You’ll Do:**

  

* Collaborate with all the sensor development teams, across the company, on architecture and strategic initiatives.
* Conceptualize and develop new product features.
* Provide guidance and support to development teams in designing and implementing software for cross-platform delivery (Windows, macOS, Linux).
* Take ownership of features throughout the entire lifecycle, from initial design to final delivery, including presenting product demonstrations at the conclusion of each sprint.
* Engage in cross-functional collaboration with teams situated in various locations.

**What You’ll Need:**

  

* Deep knowledge of C/C++; Swift experience required for macOS-focused candidates; Windows OS Kernel and Driver Development experience required for Windows-focused candidates.
* Hands-on experience operationalizing machine learning models on the endpoint, including building the data pipelines that collect, transform and deliver sensor telemetry for model training, evaluation and on-device inference.
* Extensive, fundamental understanding of internals for your primary platform (macOS, Linux, or Windows)
* Proven experience in debugging memory corruption issues, process contentions, and system performance bottlenecks.
* Demonstrated experience collaborating with teams to successfully deliver major features and releases.
* Ability to lead, mentor, communicate, collaborate, and operate effectively within a geographically distributed team.

**Bonus Points:**

  

* Demonstrated strong background in developing scalable, light-weight, and highly performing systems
* In-depth OS system expertise regarding core concepts and subsystems
* Familiarity and experience utilizing Agile methodologies
* Knowledge of security principles
Experience with eBPF

jobs.description:
Overview:

We are seeking a full-time **Staff Software Engineer - GNSS/INS** at Garmin's site in Boulder, CO. This role is on our Core Platform Technology team and will develop GNSS and INS based positioning solutions. This is an innovation and exploration role where you will work closely with all of Garmin's product segments to explore, align and advance positioning technology in all of Garmin's product categories.

Responsibilities:

**Essential Functions**

* Contribute to advanced technical research and development in positioning technologies
* Design, implement, test and document complex software applications using C/C++ for use in embedded systems
* Participate in peer reviews of software designs, algorithm designs and software implementation
* Collaborate with colleagues on software/algorithm design approaches and implementations
* Provide reliable solutions to a variety of positioning problems using sound problem solving techniques
* Conduct technical research and feasibility studies on new technologies, providing insight and recommendations to engineering management
* Represent Garmin among industry partners, peer groups and regulating agencies
* Contribute inventions, new designs, and techniques regarded as significant advances to the product and/or application development process
* Apply advanced theories, principles, and concepts in development of new principles and theories
* Utilize knowledge of principles, forecasts new technology and provides business directions based on them
* Provide guidance and mentoring to less experienced software engineers in areas such as software methodology, cost analysis, and project management
* Mentor and provide guidance to less experienced software engineers (Software Engineer 1 & 2 & Senior Software Engineers)

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Math, Physics or related field **AND** a minimum of 14 years relevant experience **OR** an equivalent combination of education and experience
* Experience in positioning algorithms for consumer applications with a strong understanding of GNSS measurements and error sources, estimation techniques including least squares & Kalman filtering, blunder/fault detection, multi-constellation and multi-frequency, AGNSS, inertial navigation systems, inertial sensors, sensor fusion and other geomatic related topics.
* Proficient in software development and engineering with C/C++ for embedded, real-time environments
* Strong ability to use scripting languages (i.e. Python, Matlab etc.) or C++ to automate data analysis of large amounts of data to verify positioning algorithms
* Proven ability to explore and research technical algorithmic problems and implementing appropriate algorithmic solutions
* Demonstrate a successful track record in managing exceedingly complex problems and providing success solutions which are highly innovative and ingenious
* Experience with architecting solutions for multiple groups and/or disciplines
* Must be positive, detail oriented, organized, team oriented and a driven problem solver, multi-tasker, and self-starter with the ability to prioritize and lead in a fast paced, deadline-driven environment

**Desired Qualifications**

* Expertise in inertial navigation techniques (e.g. vehicle and pedestrian dead reckoning, GNSS aided INS)
* PVT (Position, Velocity, Timing) experience in the consumer/embedded space
* Knowledge of carrier phase measurement processing methods
* Knowledgeable in GNSS measurement generation, tracking loops and how measurements are impacted by environment.
* Experience in MEMS sensor technology, including error source modeling and quantification of accelerometers and gyroscopes
* Experience in detection of GNSS denial of service, jamming or spoofing events
* Experience in Java

jobs.title: Senior Electronics Hardware Engineer - 1691
jobs.description:
Scientific Applications & Research Associates, Inc. (SARA) is a world-class Defense Research and Development enterprise, with a charter to create new and emerging technology innovations in support of Commercial & Government organizations. We have expertise in RF, EMP, Pulsed Power, Acoustics and Threat Warning Systems, and we prioritize partnering with our customers to address real-world problems with cost-effective solutions… that work.

The SARA High Power Electromagnetics Division (HPEM) is looking for a remarkably talented, motivated, and imaginative **Senior** **Electronics Hardware Design Engineer** to support research and development activities and transition innovative technologies to the DoD, DoE, and their contractors in Colorado Springs, CO. The candidate will have the opportunity to grow and learn with talented engineers, physicists, and technicians on long-standing programs and new programs supporting our customers. Our small group will allow the candidate to experience, contribute, and collaborate in a multidisciplinary nature from conception all the way through to operation.

The **Senior** **Electronics Hardware Design Engineer** will be responsible for electrical system architecture, schematic capture, layout design, and prototype or delivery testing of complex research and development-oriented electronics. Further design implementation, maintenance, and improvement will be a standard practice for all developed circuit designs. This position demands a high degree of understanding in electrical engineering fundamentals, and the ability to directly apply engineering skills and practices into real products and designs. This is a hands-on design role for someone who thrives on creating new solutions and seeing them through to completion. The ideal candidate combines creative design thinking with rigorous technical implementation skills.

**Core Responsibilities:**

* Design and architect new electronics systems from concept through implementation, including system architecture, PCB design, and validation
* Developing quality control and testing procedures to be incorporated into regular design process
* Writing detailed technical reports on designs, test results, and intended testing & operating procedures
* Supporting highly technical engineering and scientific teams on field test activities when necessary
* Providing technical mentoring and support to develop the skill sets within the team

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, or related field
* 12 – 15 years of design experience in the field of Electrical Engineering
* Excellent written & verbal communication, attention to detail, and multitasking skills
* Adaptability to work in a highly flexible, fluid, and fast-paced team environment
* Willingness to participate in roughly 5%-time travel for customer briefings and testing events
* US Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain DoD security clearance
* May require light physical effort, involving standing, sitting and use of hands while performing duties, carrying or lifting up to 50 pounds
* Working environment is indoor, moderately quiet, reasonably clean, well-lighted and well-ventilated, moderate physical hazards may exist

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 15+ years of design experience in the field of Electrical Engineering
* Active DoD TS/SCI Security Clearance
* Master’s Degree in Electrical Engineering + 10 years or Bachelor’s Degree + 12 years of experience in a specialized EE field
* Deep experience in analog, digital, high voltage, data integrity, or power & protection circuit design

**Example Desired Proficiencies:**

* Strong portfolio demonstrating innovative and novel electrical system designs
* Extensive experience in high power solid-state switching design and system architecture
* High voltage system design and improvements
* Complex power generation
* Gate drive circuitry and architecture
* Snubber and protection circuitry and architecture
* STM32 Microcontroller based control systems
* Data acquisition and processing circuitry

**SARA offers a competitive benefits package to include:**

* Medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance; and other supplemental programs
* A generous PTO program (vacation, sick, holiday)
* Tuition & certification reimbursement
* Flexible work schedules
* Discretionary Employee bonuses
* 401(k) match/profit sharing
* Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)

Pay Range

Salary at SARA is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $125,000 to $175,000 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of SARA’s total compensation package for employees. Positions are on-site, unless indicated otherwise.

Application Deadline: November 13, 2026

SARA is an equal employment opportunity employer.

At **CesiumAstro**, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We are looking to add a **Senior Staff Power Electronics Engineer** to our team. In this role you will apply advanced power electronics engineering principles to lead the design, development, integration, and verification of power conversion and power distribution hardware for complex products and platforms. This role contributes to product development by solving highly complex engineering challenges, advancing power electronics methodologies, and serving as a primary technical resource across multiple programs to improve efficiency, reliability, and mission success.

* Advance power electronics design practices, verification methodologies, engineering processes, and configuration management across development programs.
* Evaluate engineering methods, testing approaches, and development processes to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Lead initiatives that enhance efficiency, reliability, manufacturability, and design quality.

* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, power electronics, electronics engineering, or a related engineering field with 12–15 years of related experience, or Master's degree with 8–12 years of related experience, or PhD with 5–8 years of related experience in power electronics, electrical design, power conversion, hardware development, or a related engineering discipline.

jobs.title: Associate Laser Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
At Infleqtion we solve the world’s most challenging problems using cutting-edge quantum technology. Our mission is to commercialize atom-based quantum products that provide orders of magnitude improvements in sensing and computing applications. We are proud to work tirelessly to create and lead the quantum ecosystem towards meaningful advancements today and set the technology roadmap for tomorrow.

POSITION SUMMARY

Within Infleqtion’s Quantum Computing Product Group, the Hardware Engineering Team is seeking an Associate Laser Systems Engineer for neutral-atom quantum computing hardware. You will carry out well-defined laser assembly, characterization and control tasks, building practical judgment through laboratory work and design reviews. You’ll have dedicated time for technical learning and hands-on training, supported by regular guidance from experienced engineers.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES Typically, you will be entrusted with:

 Assemble and align assigned laser paths using reviewed layouts and laser-safety procedures.

 Calculate expected power levels and frequency shifts for assigned setups, and compare predictions with measurements.

 Measure laser power, polarization, beam profiles and short-term stability against provided acceptance criteria.

 Set up detectors, modulation stages and feedback controls using reviewed procedures; record their response and operating settings.

 Work with engineers to isolate alignment, signal or lock problems, test fixes and flag issues beyond the assigned scope.

 Record setup changes, measurements and test conditions so others can reproduce the work; submit procedure improvements for review.

 Plan assigned tasks, report progress and blockers, and incorporate feedback from design and test reviews.

 **Requirements**

WE HOPE YOU HAVE:

 Bachelor’s degree in optical engineering, physics, electrical engineering or a related field. Prior industry experience is not required.

 Understanding of laser and optical fundamentals, with practice explaining beam propagation, polarization, interference and frequency.

 Hands-on practice assembling an optical or electro-optical setup and taking measurements while following laboratory safety procedures.

 Practice interpreting detector signals and explaining how gain, noise and negative feedback affect a measurement or control loop.

 Experience analyzing measurements, comparing them with predictions and explaining differences using calculations, spreadsheets or scripts.

 Experience keeping accurate setup and measurement records, checking work for errors and flagging unexpected results.  Experience explaining technical work clearly, raising questions or problems early, and incorporating feedback.

WE HIGHLY VALUE:

 Project experience with laser characterization, optical modulation or feedback control.

 Experience using Python or comparable tools to collect and analyze laboratory data.

 Experience with atomic spectroscopy, optical resonators or low-noise photodetection

Coursework, laboratory classes, research, internships and projects can demonstrate these skills. Preferred qualifications are helpful, not required.

NOTE

 Job responsibilities and requirements are illustrative, other responsibilities may be assigned as needed.

 This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Please note that any offer for employment may be conditioned on authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export control laws and regulations without sponsorship for an export license.

TRAVEL Up to 10% travel may be required.

WORKING CONDITIONS and PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS Work will normally be performed in an office and laboratory environment and around technical equipment including computers and lasers. Able to sit, stand, bend, lift and carry up to 40 pounds without assistance. Able to efficiently use automated office equipment such as laptops, copiers, and printers; able to effectively engage in communications (via phone, computer, or in-person). Any required Personal Protective Equipment will be provided and must be properly used in accordance with company requirements

 **Benefits**

* 100% company-paid medical, dental, vision, short/long-term disability

* Unlimited PTO
* 401(k) match

**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

What We’re Doing

At Lockheed Martin, innovation and integrity drive everything we do. Within Rotary and Mission Systems, our teams develop advanced avionics and mission-critical solutions that power modern defense platforms. We value your skills, education, and ideas—and give you opportunities to think big, grow, and build technology that matters.

The Work

We are seeking an Staff Software Engineer to join a Mission Systems team that develops software applications supporting critical business and mission objectives. The incumbent will execute all phases of the software development lifecycle—requirements analysis, design, implementation, testing, and documentation—under very general supervision. Success requires strong teamwork, clear communication, and the ability to coordinate with Systems Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Program Management, and the Software Architecture group. Familiarity with Agile development, DevSecOps, DO‑178C, C/C++, Python, Linux, GitLab, and Atlassian tools is desired.

Who We Are

We’re a collaborative team of engineers and innovators developing high-performance avionics systems. Our work combines systems, software, hardware, and integration expertise to deliver reliable capabilities for critical aerospace and defense missions.

Who You Are

You’re a detail-oriented engineer who enjoys turning complex problems into a structured, well designed software product. You communicate effectively, collaborate across disciplines, and are motivated to understand how software, hardware, and systems work together.

You bring:

* A foundation in systems engineering, software engineering, or a related discipline.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Familiarity with software development and management tools.
* Understanding of embedded software and hardware/software integration.
* Strong communication and teamwork skills.

Why Join Us

Build your career while contributing to cutting-edge avionics and mission systems. At Lockheed Martin, you’ll work alongside experienced engineers, grow your technical skills, and help shape technologies that support critical missions.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field, and 9 years of professional experience or a Master’s degree with

* 7 years of experience.
* Demonstrated expertise in embedded software‑systems engineering, full‑life‑cycle development, hardware‑software integration, and software architecture/design.
Ability to travel occasionally (* 4‑6 times per year) and to communicate effectively with senior internal and external stakeholders.

**Desired Skills**
------------------

* Expertise in multiple programming languages (C/C++, Python, C#) and software‑architecture patterns.
* Strong background in Agile Scrum, serving as Scrum Master or Product Owner (certification preferred).
* Experience with DO‑178C, safety‑critical development, and model‑based engineering (MBSE, SysML/UML).
* Ability to mentor junior engineers and lead small development teams.
* Excellent stakeholder communication and presentation skills for inter‑organizational and customer engagements.
* Background in MBSE, SysML/UML, and modeling tools (Cameo, Rhapsody).
* Hands‑on DevSecOps experience: CI/CD pipelines, static code analysis, unit testing, automated test environments, and Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence).
* DO‑178C compliance, safety‑critical development, and automated testing for embedded systems.
* Proven technical leadership of multi‑site, multidisciplinary software teams; Scrum Master/Product Owner certifications preferred.
* Excellent presentation, negotiation, and customer‑relationship management skills; experience with CAM/proposal development a plus.

**Pay Information**

Full-Time Salary Range: $135700.00 - $251900.00

Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

**Benefits offered:** Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

* Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.
* For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. ----------------------------

**Who we are**

Lockheed Martin is a global leader in aerospace, defense, and technology solutions. We are a thriving center of engineering expertise, fostering a culture that encourages creativity, excellence, and the creation of exceptional products. Our team is made up of dedicated professionals who are passionate about pushing the boundaries of what's possible.

**The Work**

This role will support installation, test and maintenance of the new Columbia Class Navy Ballistic Missile submarines. The ideal candidate will work with other government contractors and crews on installation and test, submarine tasks, advanced support maintenance, troubleshooting tasks and contractor tasks. The candidate will support training and familiarization of the Navigation subsystem as well as coordinate frequent communications/meetings with the customer and leadership under direction of team leads. This position will require periodic travel and temporary duty (TDY) assignment. Assignment will include work at Electric Boat Shipyard in Groton, CT and Quonset Point, RI.

**Why Join Us**

Your Health, Your Wealth, Your Life

Joining Lockheed Martin means becoming part of a team that's making a significant impact in the field of engineering. When you choose to work with us, you'll enjoy:

* An excellent working environment equipped with state-of-the-art tools.
* The opportunity to work alongside industry leaders and top-notch professionals.
* A chance to be a part of solving some of the world's most challenging engineering problems.
* A culture that encourages creativity, excellence, and the development of remarkable products.

If you're ready to take your career to the next level, work on groundbreaking projects, and be a part of a team that thrives on innovation, we encourage you to apply and be a part of our mission.

**Who we are**

DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today's threats and prepare for a quantum-safe future at www.digicert.com

**Job summary**

**This position is for the SSL Store, powered by DigiCert**

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build and run the platform behind our certificate management, TLS and vulnerability monitoring, uptime, and security products. The platform is a TypeScript monorepo: Fastify and Express services, Next.js and React frontends, MySQL and Redis, queues and workers on AWS, deployed to Kubernetes through Terraform, Helm, and Azure DevOps pipelines. It also carries a legacy .NET estate that we are steadily retiring, and a growing set of AI-assisted features and internal tooling.

You will own features end to end, from schema and API through UI, pipeline, and production. We work in a small team with a lot of surface area, so the job rewards engineers who pick up whatever the problem needs, whether that is a new framework, a scanner's quirks, or a cloud primitive they have not touched before

**What you will do**

* Design, build, and ship features across the full stack: Fastify or Express APIs, Next.js and React frontends, MySQL schemas and migrations, SQS-driven workers, and the infrastructure that runs them.

* Security awareness as a habit: authentication and authorization flows, secrets handling, input validation, and dependency hygiene.

### **Overview:**

The Georgia Tech Research Institute (GTRI) is the nonprofit, applied research division of the Georgia Institute of Technology (Georgia Tech). Founded in 1934 as the Engineering Experiment Station, GTRI has grown to more than 2,900 employees, supporting eight laboratories in over 20 locations around the country and performing more than $940 million of problem-solving research annually for government and industry. GTRI's renowned researchers combine science, engineering, economics, policy, and technical expertise to solve complex problems for the U.S. federal government, state, and industry.

### **Georgia Tech's Mission and Values**

Georgia Tech's mission is to develop leaders who advance technology and improve the human condition. The Institute has nine key values that are foundational to everything we do:

1. Students are our top priority.
  
2. We strive for excellence.
  
3. We thrive on diversity.
  
4. We celebrate collaboration.
  
5. We champion innovation.
  
6. We safeguard freedom of inquiry and expression.
  
7. We nurture the wellbeing of our community.
  
8. We act ethically.
  
9. We are responsible stewards.

Over the next decade, Georgia Tech will become an example of inclusive innovation, a leading technological research university of unmatched scale, relentlessly committed to serving the public good; breaking new ground in addressing the biggest local, national, and global challenges and opportunities of our time; making technology broadly accessible; and developing exceptional, principled leaders from all backgrounds ready to produce novel ideas and create solutions with real human impact.

### **Project/Unit Description**

A full-time research faculty position exists in the Unmanned Systems Integration Branch of the Robotics and Autonomous Systems Division (RASD) within the Aerospace, Transportation, and Advanced Systems Laboratory (ATAS).
  
  
The Unmanned Systems Integration Branch focuses on the development, integration, testing, and evaluation of unmanned systems across multiple domains. Systems engineering expertise is applied to sensors, platforms, and embedded systems, with a focus on Small Unmanned Aircraft Systems (sUAS) as well as systems in other domains (e.g. ground, sea). Program areas include sUAS, Counter UAS systems, and Autonomy Algorithms. Typically, the Unmanned Systems Integration Branch integrates hardware into low cost commercially available surrogate platforms for demonstration purposes. Primary sponsors are from the US military research and development community.
  
  
The Systems Integration branch chief is expected to prepare and manage branch budgets, oversee expenditures, recruit qualified personnel, and maintain personnel proficiency, training, and qualification. jobs.title: Mechatronics Controls Engineer for Cartesian Robotics
jobs.description:
**Mechatronics Controls Engineer for Cartesian Robotics**
=========================================================

**Build motion that moves industries**
--------------------------------------

Picture this: a manufacturer needs a cartesian robot to speed up precision handling. You review their requirements, select an actuator with profile rail and a ball/lead screw, size a servo and drive with accurate load calculations, and implement safety, sensors, and controls. You program the PLC in IEC 61131-3, tune the axes for crisp performance, and wire a clean, well-labeled panel. When testing reveals a hiccup, you read the schematics, troubleshoot the panel, and iterate until it runs flawlessly. Along the way, you coordinate with vendors, customers, sales, and fellow engineers—and when the application demands something new, you help shape the next PBC Linear product.

**Your impact**
---------------

* Serve as a technical authority for linear motion systems, components, and actuators.
* Own design, component selection, and troubleshooting using stepper motors, servo motors, drives, sensors, and safety equipment.
* Analyze loads to properly size motors and drives.
* Tune servo/stepper-driven linear motion systems to meet demanding motion profiles.
* Program PLC systems with IEC 61131-3 languages; integrate drives and field devices.
* Install and wire electrical components into control panels; read and produce electrical control schematics.
* Diagnose and correct faults in existing electrical panels.
* Support customer applications and linear motion test stands—from design and construction through operation and troubleshooting.
* Communicate effectively with engineering colleagues, vendors, and customers on controls opportunities and issues.
* Apply broad mechatronics knowledge across controls, software, and mechanical actuator systems.
* Use electrical design software to document and validate control architectures.
* Partner with sales and customers to translate requirements into the right PBC Linear products—or assist in creating new solutions where gaps exist.
* Enhance tooling and tests with optional C++, C#, or Visual Basic skills.

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------

* Proven, hands-on understanding of servo and stepper motor dynamics, PLCs, controls, and drive systems.
* Exposure to linear motion elements including actuators, profile rail, ball screws, lead screws, and linear bearings (preferred).
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related 2-year technical degree; preferred fields include Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or Mechatronics.

**Life at PBC Linear**
----------------------

PBC Linear (A Pacific Bearing Company) is a global leader in linear technology and a proud local manufacturer committed to our associates and our community. We thrive on challenge and move fast in a dynamic environment. Our benefits package includes medical, dental, vision, 401(k), life insurance, STD, LTD, AD&D, and Aflac.

**Equal Employment**
--------------------

PBC Linear is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
