jobs.title: Principal – Electrical & Controls / Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world.A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary.

**Job Summary**
---------------





**Position Summary:**
---------------------

The Principal – Electrical & Controls / Automation Engineer is a senior individual contributor and technical subject matter expert responsible for providing enterprise-level technical leadership across electrical, controls, industrial networking, PLC, SCADA, and automation systems. This position serves as one of Engineering’s highest technical authorities for complex automation and electrical systems. The Principal Engineer is expected to personally solve the organization’s most difficult technical problems while establishing technical standards, mentoring engineering and technician resources, and improving the reliability, maintainability, and performance of automated manufacturing equipment.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

**Technical Leadership & Troubleshooting**

* Serve as the senior technical escalation point for complex electrical, controls, PLC, SCADA, networking, and automation issues across manufacturing operations.
* Lead troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of difficult or recurring equipment failures that cannot be resolved through normal maintenance and engineering escalation paths.
* Diagnose complex interactions between electrical systems, PLC logic, industrial networks, drives, motion systems, instrumentation, safety systems, SCADA, and equipment controls.
* Use a structured, data-driven troubleshooting methodology to identify root causes rather than relying on component replacement or trial-and-error troubleshooting.
* Provide hands-on technical support during critical equipment failures and high-impact production events.
* Identify systemic technical weaknesses and develop permanent corrective actions that improve equipment reliability and reduce repeat failures.

**PLC & Controls Systems**

* Serve as a senior technical resource for industrial electrical systems and machine-control hardware.
* Troubleshoot complex electrical problems involving control power, power distribution, motors, VFDs, servo systems, safety circuits, sensors, instrumentation, grounding, noise, and communication systems.
* Troubleshoot, modify, optimize, and validate complex PLC programs and machine-control architectures.

**Industrial Networking**

* Serve as a technical authority for industrial networking and OT communications.
* Troubleshoot complex network and communication failures involving PLCs, SCADA systems, HMIs, drives, remote I/O, vision systems, instrumentation, servers, and manufacturing equipment.
* Demonstrate expert-level understanding of Ethernet/IP, industrial Ethernet, TCP/IP, VLANs, managed switches, network segmentation, routing fundamentals, addressing, communication diagnostics, and industrial network architecture.
* Work collaboratively with IT and cybersecurity teams to maintain secure, reliable connectivity between operational technology and enterprise systems.

**SCADA, HMI & Manufacturing Systems**

* Provide technical leadership for SCADA and HMI architecture, configuration, troubleshooting, and integration.
* Troubleshoot communication and data-flow issues between equipment controls, SCADA, historians, databases, and manufacturing information systems.
* Support development of standardized approaches for equipment connectivity, tag structures, alarms, data collection, and system integration.
* Partner with Digital Transformation and Manufacturing Intelligence resources to enable reliable acquisition and use of equipment data.

**Reliability & Root Cause Engineering**

* Partner with Reliability Engineering and factory engineering teams to identify recurring failure modes using downtime, alarm, maintenance, and equipment-performance data.
* Develop engineered solutions that eliminate failure modes rather than repeatedly restoring equipment to operation.
* Identify opportunities for condition monitoring, predictive diagnostics, improved alarming, and automated fault detection.

**Technical Mentorship**

* Serve as a technical mentor to Controls Engineers, Electrical Engineers, Controls Technicians, Engineering Technicians, and other engineering resources.
* Develop the troubleshooting capabilities of plant engineering teams through structured coaching and hands-on problem solving.
* Transfer knowledge from complex troubleshooting events into documented standards, troubleshooting guides, and lessons learned.
* Help establish technical competency expectations and training requirements for controls and electrical disciplines.
Promote disciplined engineering practices and a culture of technical excellence.  

  

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls or Automation Engineering, Mechatronics, or mechanical Engineering with demonstrated competencies strongly preferred.
* Equivalent combination of education and extensive demonstrated industrial controls expertise may be considered.

**Experience**

* Minimum 6(+) years of progressive experience in industrial automation, controls engineering, electrical engineering, or related manufacturing engineering disciplines.
* Extensive hands-on experience supporting highly automated manufacturing equipment.
* Demonstrated history of personally resolving complex controls, electrical, networking, and automation problems.
* Experience serving as a senior technical authority, Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer, Lead Engineer, or equivalent technical SME strongly preferred.
Experience in high-volume, highly automated man

jobs.title: Infrastructure Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
**Department**

Research Computing Center

**About the Department**

The University of Chicago Research Computing Center (RCC), a unit within the Office of Research, provides advanced research computing resources and expertise to support computational and data-intensive research across the University. RCC enables research through centrally managed high-performance computing (HPC), storage, visualization, and AI infrastructure, along with scientific consulting, user support, education, and training. RCC also helps researchers leverage local, national, and cloud-based computational resources.  
  
The Office of Research oversees sponsored research administration, research development, and contract management across the University.

**Job Summary**

The job participates in the design of automated, scalable, and rapidly deployable solutions to systems infrastructure and server configuration. Installs, configures, and maintains operating systems, monitoring and alerting systems, utility software, and firewalls. Plans and executes hands-on maintenance for production servers as well as Windows and Linux servers.  
  
The University of Chicago is seeking a highly-qualified and versatile Infrastructure Platform Engineer to design, deploy, and operate the infrastructure and platform services that support the Research Computing Center's mission and its users. This is a hands-on role spanning infrastructure automation, private-cloud deployment, platform and service integration, and general Linux system administration. The engineer in this role will provision systems from bare metal upward, write Infrastructure as Code, integrate community and third-party services, interact with stakeholders in a high-level research environment, and mentor student workers on programming and infrastructure projects.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - ML/AI
jobs.description:
Chamberlain Group (CG) is a global leader in intelligent access and Blackstone portfolio company. Powered by our myQ technology, we make access simple and secure for millions of homeowners, businesses, and communities worldwide. Our flagship brands, LiftMaster® and Chamberlain® , are found in 51+ million homes, and 14 million+ people rely on the myQ® app daily.

This role is central to our mission of enhancing everyday intelligence in connected systems. This role will be responsible for building robust pipelines that analyze temporal behavior, identify anomalies, and trigger intelligent alerts.

Job Responsibilities:

* Design, develop, and deploy machine learning models for detecting anomalies in time-series data from connected devices (e.g., cameras, door sensors, access logs).
* Build pipelines that analyze historical patterns and identify deviations using a combination of statistical, classical ML, and deep learning approaches.
* Collaborate with data engineering and platform teams to ensure real-time model inference, stream processing, and alert triggering
* Tune models for low false positives and high sensitivity while maintaining operational efficiency.
* Develop and manage ML Ops pipelines for training, testing, deployment, and monitoring of anomaly detection systems
* Implement robust monitoring and feedback loops to adapt to behavior drift or seasonal variations.
* Contribute to overall AI system architecture and collaborate with engineers working on LLM-based assistants and agentic AI to ensure seamless integration.
* Work across product, engineering, and AI research teams to ensure scalable and performant deployment of models
* Drive decision-making around tooling, infrastructure, observability, and production-readiness.
* Mentor engineers across the org in AI-native engineering patterns, architecture, and LLM ecosystem evolution
* Manage, mentor, and grow a team of applied AI and full-stack engineers.
* Guide career development. Hire top talent and build a strong, collaborative team culture.
* Comply with health and safety guidelines and rules; managers should also ensure compliance across their teams.
* Protect Chamberlain Group’s reputation by keeping information confidential.
* Maintain professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, reading professional publications, establishing personal networks, and participating in professional societies.
* Contribute to the team effort by accomplishing related results and participating on projects as needed.

Job Requirements:

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science
* 10+ years of experience software engineering experience with 5+ in ML engineering or data science with a focus on real-time systems, behavior modeling, or time-series data.
* Proven experience building and deploying anomaly detection systems in production.
* Hands-on experience with time-series libraries (e.g., Prophet, Darts, GluonTS, Kats, Merlion).
* Experience working with event-driven architectures, edge devices, or smart home / IoT environments is a plus.
* Familiarity with vector databases or integration with LLMs

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

* Strong understanding of time-series analysis, including: Trend/seasonality decomposition, Statistical anomaly detection methods (ARIMA, z-score, moving average), Classical ML techniques (Isolation Forest, One-Class SVM, clustering-based approaches), Deep learning for sequences (LSTM, GRU, TCN, Transformers)
* Experience in streaming data processing and building pipelines that operate on live or near-real-time data.
* Knowledge of change point detection, event modeling, and alert systems.
* Ability to design interpretable anomaly detection systems with threshold tuning, confidence scoring, and alert escalation.
* Understanding of MLOps principles, including CI/CD for ML, versioning, and retraining strategies.
* Strong programming skills in Python and familiarity with ML frameworks (scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow).
* Proficient in data handling and engineering tools such as Pandas, NumPy, Kafka, Spark, or Flink

Other:

* Ability to travel up to 10% of the time domestically and internationally

Preferred Job Requirements:

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field
* Experience in IoT, software services, video, and AI
* Analytical and systems thinker who can reason about behavioral patterns over time
* Detail-oriented with a strong focus on data integrity and alert quality
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment and building 0-1 systems
* Effective communicator — able to explain models, metrics, and uncertainty clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Experience with consumer electronics, smart home companies will be beneficial

The pay range for this position is $148,912.00 - $254,054.00; base pay offered may vary depending on a number of factors including, but not limited to, the position offered, location, education, training, and/or experience. In addition to base pay, also offered is a comprehensive benefits package and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). This position is eligible for participation in a short-term incentive plan subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Chamberlain Group wants all of its employees to succeed and encourages people of all backgrounds to apply. We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, and you’ll be considered for this role regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, ancestry; marital, disabled or veteran status. jobs.description:
**ABOUT ROCKET LAB**

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

**NEUTRON**

Neutron is a medium-lift launch vehicle capable of delivering the mega constellations of tomorrow, high-assurance payloads, and human spaceflight. As a highly reusable launch platform, Neutron will provide a cost-effective and reliable launch solution by leveraging Rocket Lab's proven execution history with the Electron program. If you're interested in joining a high-performing team and pushing the boundaries with a clean-sheet development of a reusable liquid launch vehicle, this is your opportunity!

**SENIOR ELECTRICAL ENGINEER – MARINE OPERATIONS**

We are currently seeking an Electrical Engineer based out of Rocket Lab's Space Structures Complex in Middle River, Maryland. You will be responsible for the design, specification, analysis, and execution of power distribution, navigation systems, controls, and communications systems on our recovery vessel.

**WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:**

* Serve as the electrical engineering technical expert within the Marine Operations team, enabling recovery and reusability of Neutron

* Design critical electrical infrastructure, including schematics, layout, and routing for power, lighting, navigation, instrumentation, propulsion, and communications systems

* Coordinate with other Rocket Lab engineers to ensure electrical systems are well integrated with the other vessel systems

* Ensure all systems meet regulatory requirements (ABS, USCG, IEC, NFPA, FCC)

* Conduct design reviews to ensure systems meet requirements, identify risks, resource needs, and schedule estimates

* Work onboard the vessel during construction, ensuring build-out meets engineering specifications, and drive future modifications to enable more efficient mission execution

* Collaborate with the marine engineering group for commissioning and sea-trials test planning

* Troubleshoot and validate electrical systems during commissioning

* Oversee the operation, sustainment, troubleshooting, and repair of critical electrical power and control systems

* Build and manage electrical and electronic spares inventory and maintain minimum inventories of those onboard parts and components.

**YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS AS AN ELECTRICAL ENGINEER:**

* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or marine engineering

* 3+ years of experience as an electrical engineer, preferably in the maritime industry, with exposure to large vessels and autonomous or automated vessel systems

* Technical project management experience and the ability to liaise with external suppliers

* Advanced understanding of systems design principles

* Proficient in using EPLAN or comparable electrical CAD software for developing detailed schematics, wiring diagrams, and panel layouts

* Advanced ability to analyze systems, troubleshoot and solve problems, and select and source equipment

**THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:**

* Project management experience in a fast-paced prototype environment

* Detailed knowledge of Siemens NX or similar CAD and PLM packages.

* Experience with hands-on projects, including the use of hand tools

* Knowledge of modern industrial communication protocols and network layers, including experience with Modbus (RTU/TCP), Profibus, Ethernet, and serial interfaces (RS-232/RS-485) for control systems

* Experience integrating marine components (hoists, thrusters, winches, radar, etc.)

* Valid and current training certifications as an Electrical or Electronic Technician issued by a recognized authority.

* At least two years of experience working on vessels of comparable size and mission duration, or in a similar industrial setting requiring equivalent qualifications and operational expertise.

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS**

*This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.*

**WHAT TO EXPECT**

We're on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that's not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other's backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

Important information:

**FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:**

*To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR* *here**.*

*Rocket Lab provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves

We are looking for an engineer who is naturally curious, relentlessly analytical, and driven to understand how things actually work. The ideal candidate is the person with the home lab, the engineer who takes systems apart to understand them, researches the problem until they find the answer, and is never satisfied with “that's just how it works.”

This is not a traditional single-system engineering role. You will work across a large enterprise environment spanning 28 IT engineering disciplines, helping solve complex operational problems, develop new capabilities, automate processes, and improve the effectiveness, security, and compliance of systems supporting tens of thousands of devices and users.

The problems will change constantly. So will the priorities. We are looking for someone who is excited by that.

  
  

**What You'll Do**

* **Solve the hard problems**. Investigate complex enterprise IT issues, identify root causes, research potential solutions, test hypotheses, and stay with a problem until you understand it and can recommend a path forward.

* **Support architecture and engineering**. Work alongside senior engineers and architects to develop new capabilities, validate designs, troubleshoot existing environments, and turn concepts into operational solutions.

* **Continuously improve the environment**. Identify weaknesses, inefficiencies, security gaps, operational problems, and opportunities for automation—and take ownership of improving them.

  
  

We are looking for someone who wants to know the answer. Somone with the mindset – We give you a hard problem, limited direction, access to the environment and the tools/resources available, and you will keep digging until you understand the problem and find an answer.

Join our ATCoach product team!

ATCoach is a high-fidelity approach and en route air traffic control simulator that is the choice of leading air navigation service providers, military organizations, and universities worldwide. We provide advanced standalone and embedded simulation solutions that enhance the training and operational capabilities of our customers, and contributing to safer aviation. As part of our team, you will develop and maintain simulation software, user interfaces, and support system integrations to enhance the training experience for air traffic controller clients. * Communicate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.

OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.

**About the Role**
------------------

Community Intelligence is a new engineering team at OpenGov, based in our Boston office, chartered with bringing next-generation physical-world sensing and AI-based detection into our Community Operations suite. Rather than treating sensing as an external add-on, this team builds the pipeline and integration layer that make it a native, foundational capability across our products.

As a founding Staff Software Engineer on this team, you will design and build the systems that turn raw sensor data into structured records, condition assessments, and automated workflows across multiple products. You will make real technical calls with incomplete information, evaluating emerging sensing technologies, reconciling third-party data against our own systems, and sequencing a rollout across a multi-product suite. * Evaluate, integrate, or build the computer-vision and LiDAR-fusion models this requires, including the technical path for consolidating with or extending EAM's existing Vision AI microservice (rd-capture).

* Establish testing, monitoring, and data-quality standards appropriate to a system whose outputs feed regulatory and safety-relevant workflows, including ADA compliance and FEMA reimbursement documentation.

**Qualifications & Preferred Experience**
-----------------------------------------

* 12+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of owning complex, cross-system integrations end-to-end in a production SaaS environment.
* Experience building or integrating computer-vision, LiDAR, or geospatial data-processing pipelines; comfort with point-cloud or 3D spatial data is a strong plus.
* Strong data-modeling and API/connector design skills, able to reconcile a third party's data schema against multiple existing internal data models without resorting to one-off custom logic.
* Experience with geospatial systems (PostGIS, spatial indexing, coordinate reference systems) preferred.
* Comfortable operating with incomplete information and ambiguous vendor integration paths; makes and defends build-vs-integrate calls.
* Experience partnering across multiple product teams and translating a strategic technical vision into a scoped, sequenced delivery plan.
* A track record of shipping systems where data accuracy carries real compliance or safety consequences (regulatory, infrastructure, or public-sector systems) is a strong plus.
* Proficient in AI-native engineering workflows: can direct AI tooling for scaffolding, test generation, and code review while retaining ownership of architecture and correctness.
* Excellent written communication; can produce technical design docs that align stakeholders across five product teams.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

**How This Level Is Differentiated**
------------------------------------

The following competency behaviors distinguish this level from adjacent ones:

* Owns a technical domain end-to-end with full accountability for outcomes, from architecture through production operation.
* Operates with strategic awareness across multiple downstream product teams; makes strong technical calls with incomplete vendor and data information.
* Sets technical direction and milestones for the sensing-integration roadmap; influences cross-functional partners without formal authority.
* Establishes patterns, like the connector/adapter approach, that other engineers and products reuse, elevating the work of the broader team.
* Expected to embed AI-native tooling in their own workflow and model its effective use for teammates joining the team.

jobs.title: RF Embedded Firmware Engineer
jobs.description:
**About VectorWave**

VectorWave is building the Analog Processing Unit (APU), the world’s first programmable neuromorphic processor that runs AI inference on raw radio-frequency waveforms pre-digitization. Conventional RF systems must digitize the signal before any AI inference can occur, fundamentally limiting the latency, power consumption, and performance of wireless edge compute. The APU bypasses these bottlenecks by performing the AI signal processing fully in analog.

We are a venture-backed MIT spinout translating award-winning research into new wireless products with fundamentally new capabilities. With applications spanning defense (electronic warfare, spectrum awareness, anti-jam) and commercial wireless (Wi-Fi and 5G/6G spectrum sharing, interference management), we are building a team of engineers who are excited to transform the future of wireless communications!

**The role**

The RF embedded firmware engineer role entails designing and developing the programmable systems for VectorWave’s APU. In a multi-disciplinary effort, you will work closely with the analog hardware RF engineers and RF machine learning engineers to create subsystems that enable the APU to execute programmable signal processing operations and AI functionalities for wireless edge compute. Your work will be integrated with that of the other subsystem designers to advance the APU.

**Location:** This is an in-person, full-time role at our office in the Greater Boston area. There may occasionally be some travel to conferences.

**What you'll do**

* Design subsystems for the APU’s programmable edge compute
* Choose the components and design circuit systems integrating RF components, memory, and microprocessors
* Program the control scheme and interface for the programmable APU subsystem
* Evaluate the performance of the programmable APU subsystem against internal and customer KPIs
* Work with the RF, machine learning, and system engineers to ensure inter-system compatibility

**What you bring**

* Expertise programming and interfacing with ADCs, DACs, and on-board memory
* Experience programming microprocessor units (MPUs) and/or RF system-on-chips (SoCs) and/or edge FPGAs
* Experience designing and implementing system-level interfaces between components
* Mathematical maturity and mastery of the physics of designed circuits
* Experience designing and implementing methods of analog system characterization
* Experience implementing environmental hardware stabilization as necessary
* A BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or a related field

**Nice to have**

* An MS or PhD in a relevant field
* Published experimental demonstrations of any scalable analog circuitry (e.g. AI hardware accelerators, photonic integrated circuits, quantum hardware)
* Development board design experience
* Robust system documentation experience
* Experience using RF signal processing devices & components
* In-situ/physics-aware/back propagation-free machine learning for AI hardware accelerators
* Experience developing physically accurate digital twins to validate hardware designs through math and simulation
* Understanding of RF signal processing techniques
* RF PCB design & impedance matching experience

**How we work**

* **Always be curious.** Sometimes the most profound outcomes come from paying attention to the smallest details.
* **Truth guides us.** Honesty and candor are foundational. Don't delay hard conversations, start them.
* **Think out loud.** Voicing anything both technical and non-technical helps us solve problems together.
* **Mistakes are expected.** Perfection is impossible when you're building something new. We want to navigate challenges thoughtfully so we can learn and improve.
* **Adaptability is essential.** Make the best decision with the information at hand, then be ready to adjust.
* **Lean on each other.** As we scale, we aim to maintain our scrappy, small team camaraderie.

**Compensation and benefits**

Competitive salary and meaningful equity, plus:

**The basics**

* Medical: UnitedHealthcare Choice Plus, platinum tier. $10 primary care visit. $10 therapy visits.
* Dental: Blue Cross Blue Shield Dental Blue. Child orthodontia included.
* Vision: Guardian.
* Unlimited PTO.

**Family matters**

* We offer 95% dependent premium coverage.
* Plus, we have uncapped IVF support for fertility and family planning.
* Coming soon: Twenty-six weeks of parental leave at 100% of pay for every parent: birthing, non-birthing, adoptive, and foster.

**For life beyond work**

* 401(k): we match 100% of the first 6% of pay, dollar for dollar.
* Take care of yourself with a $2,000 annual wellness benefit.

**Equal opportunity**

VectorWave is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. If you need an accommodation during the hiring process, let us know.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

VectorWave participates in E-Verify. See the E-Verify Participation and Right to Work posters in English and Spanish.

Oracle is seeking a Senior Power Engineer to join the team that designs and supports power solutions for its server architectures. The role spans the full product lifecycle, from concept and prototyping through qualification, production, and sustaining engineering. Key products include AC/DC power supplies, battery backup units (BBUs), BBU shelves, and rack-mounted power distribution units (PDUs), with particular emphasis on ORv3-based systems.

The engineer will design and integrate electrical subsystems that meet functional, performance, efficiency, security, and reliability requirements. Responsibilities include component selection and qualification, schematic capture, FPGA design where applicable, and the testing and validation of analog and digital power-control systems. The role also involves developing specifications, test plans, test reports, signal integrity constraints, and bills of materials; investigating product issues; and working across engineering teams to bring designs into production and support them over time.

The successful candidate will bring deep experience in power electronics, strong knowledge of analog and digital power control, clear technical communication skills, and familiarity with relevant industry standards, tools, and design practices.

The role will be based in Burlington Massachusetts and is not a remote position.

  

**Key Responsibilities — Senior Power Engineer**

* Lead the design, development, and integration of power supplies, converters, battery backup units (BBUs), BBU shelves, and power distribution units (PDUs) for Oracle server and rack-level systems. Translate system requirements into designs that meet performance, efficiency, reliability, cost, and schedule targets.
* Bring up prototypes and lead hands-on lab characterization, testing, and debugging across operating loads and environmental conditions.
* Develop test plans and validation methods to confirm that power products operate reliably and integrate correctly with Oracle server architectures. Build and maintain validation automation where appropriate.
* Partner with firmware, software, diagnostics, and system engineering teams to implement power controls, monitoring, fault reporting, and system-level diagnostics.
* Work with component suppliers and power-product vendors to define requirements, verify performance, resolve technical issues, and qualify designs and alternate sources.
* Lead sustaining engineering investigations, including customer escalations, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and component end-of-life issues.
* Prepare specifications, lead design reviews and communicate technical trade-offs and results to cross-functional teams.
* Apply relevant power-conversion, safety, EMC, and environmental standards throughout development. Lead pre-compliance activities and coordinate with test teams and external laboratories to support global certifications.
* Mentor junior engineers and identify design, test, and process improvements for future power products.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering with at least 10 years of power electronics experience, or a master’s degree in Electrical Engineering with at least 7 years of experience.
* Strong understanding of switch-mode power supplies and rack-level battery backup systems.
* Experience with I²C and PMBus communications, and analog and digital PWM control architectures.
* Proficiency with power electronics lab equipment, including bench power supplies, AC sources, oscilloscopes, current probes, and high-voltage probes.
* Working knowledge of C++ and Python.
* Familiarity with applicable safety standards and global compliance requirements. Basic knowledge of network communications is a plus.

**Soft Skills and Leadership**

* Communicates technical findings and decisions clearly with engineers, stakeholders, vendors, and leadership.
* Uses sound analytical judgment to investigate complex problems, document findings, recommend solutions, and escalate critical issues when needed.
* Works independently while collaborating across teams, listening to different perspectives, and aligning solutions with product and customer needs.

jobs.title: Senior Precision Analog/Power Electronics Engineer
jobs.description:
**Overview:**

Draper is an independent, nonprofit research and development company headquartered in Cambridge, MA. The 2,000+ employees of Draper tackle important national challenges with a promise of delivering successful and usable solutions. From military defense and space exploration to biomedical engineering, lives often depend on the solutions we provide. Our multidisciplinary teams of engineers and scientists work in a collaborative environment that inspires the cross-fertilization of ideas necessary for true innovation. For more information about Draper, visit www.draper.com.

**Job Description Summary:**

A Senior Precision Analog/Power Electronics Engineer designs, specifies, develops, and tests analog/ power electronics for a wide array of applications, such as switched-mode power conversion, battery management circuitry, distributed power architectures, wireless power transfer, radiation hardened designs, motor controllers, low noise power conditioning for precision instrumentation, analog front ends, signal conditioning, analog-to-digital conversion, precision feedback systems, and dc/dc conversion. The engineer develops the architecture, designs these circuits, performs simulations, implements the physical layout, verifies and tests designs. They also perform a variety of engineering activities throughout the life cycle to support planning, design, test, deployment, and sustainment.  
  
Applicant will be responsible for carrying out circuit simulations to verify custom spice models against component specifications. The engineer will collaborate closely with the part designer and model designers to verify and modify both as necessary.

**Job Description:**

**Duties/Responsibilities**

* Optimizes system designs for reduced size, weight, and power.
* Designs new products and develops technical specifications for their production.
* Analyzes hardware configuration and processing solutions and tests hardware conformance to specifications.
* Independently drives solutions to complex problems - develops requirements, proposes ways forward when customer requirements are unclear or incomplete, and adapts appropriately to changes in requirements.
* Subject Matter Expert (SME) able to develop advanced architectures and designs for complex electronics.
* Involved in business development and proposal activities.
* Identifies program/system-level technical risks and develops and executes mitigation strategies.
* Ability to manage multi-disciplinary tasks with a cross functional team and effectively communicates status to project leadership and customers.
* Develops, documents, and teaches best practices to less experienced teammates.
* Demonstrates strong organization, planning, and time management skills to achieve program goals.
* Support business development and proposal activities.

**Skills/Abilities**

* Proficient with schematic capture and printed circuit board layout.
* Ability to perform circuit simulation using Spice or other simulation tools.
* System modeling and analysis experience using MATLAB, Simulink, or other comparable tools.
* Ability to prioritize tasks.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent time management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**Education**

Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or a related field required. Advanced degree preferred.

5-10 years of experience in electrical engineering or related field.

* **Resource Allocation & Scheduling:** Direct daily operations of the controls engineering team. Plan, schedule, and balance engineering hours across active build cycles (schematic design, panel build support, programming, shop-floor debug, and runoff).

* **Team Development & Mentorship:** Supervise, evaluate, and mentor controls engineers and programmers. Serve as the primary technical sounding board and escalation point to unblock team members during machine debug.

* **Standardization & Best Practices:** Develop, implement, and maintain departmental standards for 2D AutoCAD drafting (symbol blocks, drawing templates, layer structures) and Rockwell/Fanuc/vision programming architectures.

* **Process Improvement:** Identify and resolve workflow bottlenecks between electrical design, mechanical engineering, panel build, and shop-floor assembly.

**2. Technical Governance & Integration Oversight**

* **Schematic & Design Approval:** Review and sign off on all multi-sheet electrical, pneumatic, and safety circuit drawing packages generated in standard 2D AutoCAD. Ensure accurate manual cross-referencing, proper wire/device labeling, and rigorous BOM generation.

* **Core Automation Platforms:** Govern all software development within the **Rockwell / Allen-Bradley** environment (Studio 5000, ControlLogix, GuardLogix safety routines, FactoryTalk View ME/SE, EtherNet/IP, and Kinetix motion).

* **Robotics & Machine Vision:** Oversee the integration, programming standards, and troubleshooting of **Fanuc robotics** (handling/assembly applications) and machine vision systems (**Keyence** and **Cognex** inspection, guidance, and identification systems).

* **Regulatory Compliance:** Ensure all machine wiring, control panels, and safety interlocks strictly comply with NFPA 79, NFPA 70 (NEC), and UL 508A requirements.

**3. Commercial Alignment & Customer Interfacing**

* **Customer Design Reviews:** Lead customer controls design reviews, establishing technical authority and securing formal sign-offs on drawings, safety concepts, and sequences of operation.

* **Scope & Change-Order Management:** Defend project scope against creep. Identify, document, and price out-of-scope customer requests to ensure engineering change orders are executed.

* **Quoting & Estimation Support:** Review customer RFQs and specifications to develop accurate controls engineering hours, hardware component costs, cycle-time feasibility assessments, and technical risk evaluations.

Join us as a Controls Manager to help shape a resilient financial environment built on transparency, compliance, and operational excellence!

Pay: From $90,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Location:** United States - Minneapolis, MN

**Pay:** $97,500 - $150,600

  

With more than $1B in revenue, Tennant Company is a globally recognized leader in the cleaning equipment industry. For the past 150 years, we have been passionate about developing and manufacturing innovative and sustainable solutions for our customers. At Tennant Company, we are committed to stewardship and creating a cleaner, safer and healthier world. With manufacturing, operations and sales, service, and support functions across the globe, your journey at Tennant can take you places you never expected.

  

We are seeking a Senior Systems Engineer to join the Tennant Company (TNC) Robotics Product Development organization. This role combines strong hands-on systems engineering execution with emerging technical leadership responsibilities, supporting the definition, integration, and delivery of complex electro-mechanical, electrical, and software-enabled robotic systems.

  

The Senior Systems Engineer contributes to system-level design and integration while owning key subsystems or technical areas end-to-end. This role partners closely with Electrical, Software, Mechanical, and Manufacturing teams to translate product and business requirements into well-defined, verifiable system solutions, while beginning to influence architectural direction, technical decisions, and engineering best practices.

Success is measured by technical quality, execution reliability, system integration effectiveness, and the ability to guide work, reduce risk, and elevate team performance.

**Key Responsibilities**

Systems Engineering & Emerging Architecture Ownership

* Own development and delivery of subsystem architectures and system features, ensuring alignment with overall system design.
* Lead requirements decomposition, allocation, and verification for assigned systems and subsystems.
* Establish functional requirements and performance targets for electrical and control subsystems, including power, communications, and safety.
* Create and maintain system documentation including requirements, interface definitions, and verification artifacts.
* Contribute to system-level architecture discussions, providing technical input on tradeoffs, scalability, and maintainability.
Utilize requirements and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Jama, Visure, or similar.  

Electrical Integration & Controls Engineering

* Lead integration of electrical subsystems, including:
* Wiring harnesses, connectors, and cable routing
* Printed Circuit Board Assemblies (PCBAs)
* Controllers and embedded software interfaces
* Power distribution and protection (fuses, circuit breakers)
* Contribute to definition and implementation of machine control systems, including closed-loop control strategies.
* Support and guide integration of communication interfaces such as CAN, RS-232, Ethernet, and USB.
Troubleshoot complex electrical and controls issues across development, validation, and production environments.  

Verification, Testing & Technical Rigor

* Define and execute verification strategies for assigned systems to ensure requirements traceability and performance.
* Apply design risk assessment tools such as DFMEA and HARA to identify and mitigate system-level risks.
* Support and influence compliance activities, including UL, IEC, EMC, and related standards.
* Utilize modeling or analysis tools (e.g., MATLAB, Simulink, MathCad, PSpice) as appropriate to validate system behavior.
Drive structured root cause analysis and resolution of integration issues.  

Execution, Prototyping & Product Development

* Own delivery of complex subsystems or integration workstreams within New Product Development (NPD).
* Lead and execute Proofs of Concept (POCs) and prototype builds to validate design assumptions and de-risk development.
* Break down technical challenges into structured tasks and milestones with clear outcomes.
* Actively lead or contribute to design reviews with a strong system-level perspective.
Support product launches by ensuring designs are robust, manufacturable, and serviceable.  

Technical Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Provide technical guidance and informal mentorship to junior engineers.
* Drive alignment across teams on system interfaces, integration strategies, and technical decisions.
* Collaborate closely with Systems, Electrical, Software, Mechanical, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, and external partners.
* Communicate technical concepts, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to stakeholders at multiple levels.
* Influence best practices in requirements management, integration, and system validation.
  

**Education & Experience**

Required

* Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a closely related field.
* 5+ years of experience in systems engineering, electrical engineering, or controls-focused roles.
* Strong hands-on experience in electrical system integration and testing for complex products.
* Experience owning subsystems or significant technical workstreams.
* Experience with requirements development, decomposition, verification, and technical documentation.
Proven experience working on cross-functional engineering teams.  

Preferred

* Experience with robotics, autonomous systems, or complex electro-mechanical products.
* Experience with batteries, chargers, power electronics, or control systems.
* Familiarity with model-based design and simulation tools (MATLAB/Simulink, PSpice, MathCad).
* Experience with an object-oriented programming language (C#, Python, or C++).

jobs.description:

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We're working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

  

This role sits in the development organization responsible for Blue Origin's battery products. We take energy storage from concept through qualification and into volume production, and we do it for every program in the company.

As part of a passionate and accomplished team of experts, you will develop the embedded software that makes our batteries safe, smart, and flight-ready. Our battery management systems monitor and protect every cell, estimate state of charge and health, control contactors and power paths, detect and respond to faults, and communicate with the host vehicle.

  

We are looking for an experienced embedded software engineer to design, implement, and verify battery management system software for mission-critical spaceflight systems, working directly with battery electrical, mechanical, and systems engineers. This is a software role that is hardware heavy. The candidate we are looking for should be comfortable reading hardware datasheets, understanding register maps, and making performance tradeoffs, and must have hands-on lab debugging skills. You will collaborate with cross-functional, multidisciplinary teams and often work on multiple embedded software efforts simultaneously.
  
  
**Responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

* Developing Board Support Package (BSP) software for new hardware, including driver development
* Bare-metal or OS-level programming for hardware initialization, control, embedded data processing, and networking/communication
    
  specific operating systems, such as FRTOS/SafeRTOS/VxWorks;
* Hands-on work with avionics spaceflight hardware, including debugging with logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and JTAG debuggers
    
  Specific certification levels like DO-178C, and ISO 26262
* Participating in design concepts and reviews, with special attention to partitioning between HW and SW implementation
* Performing benchmark analysis and deploying benchmarking code to characterize hardware performance
* Bring up and utilization of HW-accelerators in modern SoC devices (e.g. encoders, decoders, encryption engines, image signal processing cores, etc.)
* Scripting, Linux development, and hands-on work with development kits and sensor modules
* Defining and implementing embedded SW for interfaces such as I2C, SPI, UART, TCP/IP, UDP, GMSL, SpaceWire, CameraLink, Aurora, AXI, AMBA, etc.
* Developing boot and SW-based fault-tolerance strategies
* Publishing internal documents and memos, participating in design reviews, reviewing and generating requirements
* Willingness to learn new skills, languages, debug/development tools
* Ability to collaborate across multiple disciplines: Software, Hardware, Electrical, Mechanical, Manufacturing, Operations
We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* BS in computer engineering, computer science, electrical engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related technical field
* 6+ years of experience in the field(s) above
* 2+ years of experience developing battery management systems
* Embedded software design and development skills in C/C++/Rust with Linux (or similar) scripting experience
* Debugging skills, using a mix of cross HW/SW techniques and tools (GDB, XSDB, GRMON, Logic Analyzer, Protocol Analyzer, Wireshark, etc.), and experience single stepping through code, looking at Assembly, probing memory, and driving I/O
* Background in computer architecture, understanding of memory buses, cache, DMA, CPU execution pipelines
* Experience with / knowledge of version control systems (Git)
Ability to work well in a team and independently with minimal direction  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Enter MS in computer engineering, computer science, electrical engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related technical field
* 8+ years of experience in the field(s) above

jobs.title: Senior Autonomous Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
At the interface of design, engineering and supply logistics, REHAU Automotive and SRG Global combine to form RESRG - a leading global supplier of coated exterior systems and components. With a combined track record of over 160 years across four continents and 22 production sites, RESRG's 10,000 skilled team members manufacture the latest exterior systems and components for the world's leading automotive manufacturers.
  
  
We are looking for you to join our team as Senior Autonomous Systems Engineer at our Portageville, Missouri facility!
  
  
Your Job
  
You will help transform our Portageville operation into one of the most advanced manufacturing facilities in North America.
  
This is an opportunity to design the future state of manufacturing from the ground up by developing factory layouts, optimizing material flow, deploying advanced simulation tools, and creating the infrastructure required to support our Overall Automation Maturity Index (OAMI) strategy and Lights-Out Manufacturing roadmap. You will work at the intersection of manufacturing, automation, robotics, logistics, and digital engineering to create highly efficient production systems that maximize productivity, minimize waste, and support autonomous operations.
  
If you enjoy solving complex operational challenges, visualizing the factory before it is built, and creating innovative solutions that redefine manufacturing performance, this role was built for you.
  
  
What You Will Do in Your Role
  

* Develop and optimize plant, department, and production layouts using AutoCAD and advanced 3D modeling tools.
* Create digital factory models and simulations to validate future manufacturing concepts before implementation.
* Design material handling routes that maximize efficiency while supporting robotic, AGV, and AMR operations.
* Analyze and optimize product flow, inventory flow, and information flow throughout the facility.
* Lead value stream mapping and factory optimization initiatives to reduce waste and improve productivity.
* Support the deployment of advanced automation systems by ensuring proper equipment placement, flow paths, and operational integration.
* Develop capacity models and scenario analysis to support growth, expansion, and future-state planning.
* Partner with robotics, controls, manufacturing, quality, maintenance, and operations teams to execute transformation projects.
* Utilize simulation and modeling software to evaluate throughput, bottlenecks, labor utilization, and system performance.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that advance OAMI maturity and support increasing levels of autonomous manufacturing.
* Establish factory standards for layout design, material movement, storage strategies, and operational excellence.
* Support brownfield projects from concept development through implementation.

Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)
  

* BS/MS in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related field.
* 3+ years of experience in manufacturing, industrial engineering, or operations optimization.
* Strong proficiency in AutoCAD for facility and manufacturing layout development.
* Experience in creating detailed plant layouts, workstation designs, and facility flow plans.
* Knowledge of lean manufacturing, value stream mapping, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and project management abilities.
* Ability to visualize and design complex manufacturing systems.

What Will Put You Ahead
  

* Experience with 3D factory simulation and modeling software.
* Experience with FlexSim or similar simulation platforms.
* Knowledge of AGVs, AMRs, automated storage systems, and autonomous material handling.
* Experience developing warehouses and production material flow strategies.
* Understanding of robotic manufacturing systems and automation integration.
* Automotive manufacturing experience.
* Knowledge of Industry 4.0, digital twins, smart factories, and advanced manufacturing technologies.

Join the Team Shaping the Next Generation of Manufacturing
  
At RESRG Automotive, we are investing in technologies, people, and ideas that will define the future of manufacturing. As a Senior Autonomous Systems Engineer
  
in Portageville, you will have a unique opportunity to create the layouts, material flow strategies, simulation models, and operational systems that enable our journey toward Lights-Out Manufacturing.
  
  
About the Company
  
We are a fast-growing global manufacturer with a strong internal culture that values respect, diversity, and purposeful work. We offer career paths that enable professional growth, a team-focused environment, and a commitment to safety and wellness.

Our goal is for each employee and their family to live fulfilling and healthy lives. Our benefits package includes medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, AD&D, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, paid parental leave, and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria are set by the applicable Summary Plan Description. Speak to your recruiter for details on benefits that apply to you.

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. Except where prohibited by state law, some offers of employment are conditioned upon successfully passing a drug test. This employer uses E-Verify.

jobs.title: Principal Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you looking for an opportunity with plenty of growth potential? Do you enjoy working in an exciting, fast-paced, collaborative environment? Are you interested in working with the world’s most innovative companies to create a more connected world?

*Connecting Continents. Impacting Communities.*

The backbone of the Internet is a series of high-tech subsea fiber optic cables deployed throughout the globe - SubCom has deployed over 50% of them. Our employees ensure data communications networks are engineered, manufactured, deployed to the highest standards, enabling faster and more reliable connectivity to communities worldwide. Every member of the SubCom team plays a role in an end-to-end process that is critical to enterprises, governments, big cities, and rural towns.

We encourage, expect, and value creativity, thoughtful risk taking, openness to change, and diverse perspectives. Whether you’re a seasoned applicant seeking a new and exciting challenge, or you’re new to the workforce and looking for a flexible, rewarding, and fast-paced position with an innovative and stable organization (since 1953), SubCom has opportunities to advance your career.

**Position Overview**

The Principal Electrical Design Engineer is an established and experienced lead engineer on a team of outstanding engineers that research, develop, design, test, and transfer to manufacture our next generation of high-reliability opto-electronic network elements. The primary job activity provides novel high reliability and fault tolerant circuit designs, including analog and digital circuits that may involve microcontrollers and FPGAs, as well as other electro-optic components like photo diodes, modulators, EDFAs, VOAs and lasers. The role involves high level planning, platforming, and innovation across multiple network elements, as well as the development of product, system and firmware requirements. The role reports to the Director of Network Element Electrical Design.

**Responsibilities**

The role is responsible for all electrical design activities from concept to manufacture needed to achieve established project goals and timelines for the development of a portfolio of new Terminal or Undersea Network elements. The position requires leadership in managing and improving development processes including organized design and DFMEA reviews. The role will work with electrical, optical, firmware, reliability and other mechanical engineers and vendors and at times lead and mentor less experienced teams, engineers, and technicians.

* Participates in developing and approving product and system requirements documents.
* Conducts analog and digital circuit design and simulation.
* Selects suitable electrical circuit components and helps maintain component libraries.
* Interacts with key component suppliers, distributors, and application engineers.
* Collaborates with PCBA CAD designers to generate PCBA design files.
* Leads and participates in design and requirement reviews.
* Plans, documents, and executes the design verification testing for new products.
* Leads hands-on experimental work on prototype components, circuits, and assemblies.
* Develops GUI based test software tools for testing circuit boards and components.
* Provides firmware requirements and supports integration testing of firmware on new circuit assemblies.
* Delivers factory testing requirements and supports early factory testing efforts.
* Initiates and develops relationships with internal partners and external suppliers.
* Consistently ensures that business is always conducted with integrity and behaviors that align with SubCom policies, procedures, and core values.

**Qualifications**

* MS/PhD in Electrical Engineering required, 14+ years of experience.
* Expertise with a deep foundation in analog/digital circuit design and PCBA development.
* Strong design and analytical skills and willingness to tackle challenging assignments.
* Experience with product realization processes, including ability to realize prototype assemblies, including hands-on testing, and technology transfer with factory and field personnel.
* Ability to synthesize new electrical design concepts from requirements.
* Experience with design of analog and digital circuits and circuit simulations.
* Experience with design of power circuits and use of DC/DC converters, fuses, soft-start circuits, low-noise design techniques and by-pass filtering.
* Experience with circuit techniques that will pass environmental, safety, EMI and EMC testing.
* Experience with op-amp and transistor circuits for detection/amplification/filtering of <1GHz) signals.
* Experience with analog and digital control loops, DACs, ADCs, logic devices processors, and use of I2C, SPI, RS-232 buses.
* Experience with transimpedance and log amp circuits for use with photodiode detection of optical signals.
* Experience with CAD tools and standard methods for design of printed circuit board assemblies.
* Experience with PCB vendors and PCB fabrication and assembly processes.
* Experience with selection of circuit board components based on reliability, availability, cost, performance.
* Strong troubleshooting, experimental and laboratory skills working with circuit board prototypes, electrical components, electrical circuit test instruments and measurement techniques.
* Experience with design of experiments, evaluating circuit performance, analyzing data.
* Experience with writing firmware requirements and integrating firmware into new circuit assembly.
* Experience with CVI or other software for creating GUIs to help with DVT and firmware integration.
* Experience with developing test procedures and writing Manufacturing Testing Requirements.
* Experience with writing firmware requirements and leading firmware integration testing.

At Lockheed Martin, our team at the Mount Laurel, NJ site supports the SEMS (Systems Engineering, Modeling & Simulation) Ship Integration Engineering organization. We design, develop, and maintain advanced combat system cabling solutions that enable seamless integration of mission-critical naval and land-based systems. Cable Running Sheets (CRS), Minimum Data Sets (MDS), Cable Impact Statements (CIS), Network Maintenance Diagrams (NMD), and Electrical Interface Control Drawings (EICD).  
  
Serve as the responsible engineer for the development of cable products and associated deliverables within the SEMS Ship Integration Engineering team.  
  
Review PARM, OEM, and vendor Installation Control Drawings and Technical Data Package (TDP) products for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with program requirements.  
  
Provide engineering support across multiple ship classes and land-based test sites.  
  
Conduct ship checks to assess existing conditions and deliver on-site engineering support during installation and testing of new equipment and systems.  
  
Lead peer engineers and engineering aides, ensuring customer requirements and project schedules remain the top priority.

This position requires the ability to travel up to 5%.

We are part of Lockheed Martin’s SEMS Ship Integration Engineering organization based in Mount Laurel, NJ. Our team specializes in integrating complex combat systems, ensuring that hardware, software, and cabling architectures function as a cohesive, mission-ready solution. Familiarity of various network types.
  
  
Familiarity with cable interface design.  
  
This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD clearance at the Secret level.
  
  
This position is fulltime onsite in Mount Laurel, NJ.

Systems engineering background.  
  
Knowledge of various network types, current commercial trends in this field, as well as the cabling materials required to support.

* Networking, dispatch systems and telephony systems

* Familiarity with technologies including Fiber Optics, MPLS, Microwave, VM servers, Windows/Linux OS

**Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?**

Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.

With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

The selected colleague will work at an MUFG office or client sites four days per week and work remotely one day. A member of our recruitment team will provide more details.

**About the Role**

  

We are seeking a Vice President to build and lead our Modern Management Platform function: the shared engineering team that owns how every Windows, macOS, iOS, Android and cloud PC endpoint in the enterprise is configured, secured, updated and measured. You will treat Microsoft Intune and its surrounding control plane as a product, delivering a reliable, well-governed platform that multiple endpoint, mobility and virtualization teams build on.

This is a new function in a highly regulated, multi-entity environment. The successful candidate will set the standards, operating model and team that the broader workplace engineering organization depends on.

Key Responsibilities

  
  

Platform & Tenant Ownership

* Own the Intune tenant as a platform, including tenant configuration, RBAC, scope tags, administrative units and change control.

* Govern a consistent multi-entity, multi-tenant management model, including tenant-to-tenant migration patterns and configuration parity.

* Serve as the accountable technical owner for the platform in audits, regulatory examinations and incident reviews.

Policy Architecture

* Design and govern endpoint policy across Windows, macOS, iOS/iPadOS and Android: configuration profiles, security baselines, compliance policies, update rings and app protection.

* Act as design authority for device-based Conditional Access in partnership with Identity and Information Security.

* Assess the platform impact of security and baseline changes before enterprise-wide rollout.

Application Deployment

* Own the Intune application deployment plane: assignment model, deployment rings, supersedence, dependencies and delivery telemetry.

* Define packaging standards and acceptance criteria, and partner with software and vulnerability management teams on remediation and upgrade campaigns.

Automation & Engineering Practices

* Build automation using Microsoft Graph, PowerShell and Power Automate to eliminate manual configuration, reconciliation and reporting.

* Establish configuration-as-code with source control, peer review and dev-to-production promotion for all policy and script artifacts.

Compliance, Telemetry & Reporting

* Define endpoint compliance baselines and measure drift against them.

* Deliver an authoritative device and configuration dataset and Power BI reporting for operations, audit and executive audiences.

Leadership

* Build, lead and develop a team of platform engineers

* Set and enforce engineering standards across peer teams, and run a clear intake and prioritization model for platform requests.

Chair a cross-team configuration review forum and maintain documentation, runbooks and roadmap.  

  

**Qualifications**

  

Required

* 8+ years in endpoint, platform or systems engineering, including 3+ years leading engineers.

* Expert-level Microsoft Intune and Entra ID, including RBAC, scope tags, Conditional Access and multi-tenant patterns.

* Proven ownership of endpoint policy and security baselines at enterprise scale (10,000+ devices).

* Strong automation skills with Microsoft Graph, PowerShell and REST APIs, with source-control discipline.

* Application deployment and packaging-standards experience across Win32, MSIX and macOS.

* Experience delivering operational reporting in Power BI or a comparable tool.

* Demonstrated ability to influence and set standards across teams without direct authority.

Preferred

* Financial services or other regulated-industry experience, including audit and exam support.

* Familiarity with control frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001 or SOC 2.

* Experience with tenant-to-tenant migrations, Windows Autopilot, Autopatch and Windows 365.

Microsoft certifications such as MD-102, SC-300 or AZ-104.  

  

**Education:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a closely-related discipline, or equivalent in professional experience

The typical base pay range for this role is as follows:

  

* New York / New Jersey: $120k - $171k
Non-/New York/ New jersey: $120k - $154k  

  

depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience and location. This role may also be eligible for certain discretionary performance-based bonus and/or incentive compensation. Our hybrid work schedule is four days on-site and work remotely one day per week.

jobs.title: High Voltage Electrical Engineer 2/3
jobs.description:
**What You Will Do**
  
  
**Powering the Future at Los Alamos National Laboratory (LANL)**
  
  
Are you an early to mid-career electrical engineer looking to take on high-impact, real-world challenges? At LANL, you'll be part of a team responsible for maintaining and enhancing our primary electrical transmission (115kV) and distribution (13.8kV) system-powering one of the nation's most vital research institutions. This is a chance to work with cutting-edge technology, contribute to national security, and develop your expertise in high-voltage systems while enjoying an outstanding work-life balance in beautiful northern New Mexico.
  
  
As a Utility Electrical System Engineer, you'll play a key role in managing and maintaining LANL's high-voltage electrical infrastructure.
  
  
This position will be filled at either the Engineer 2 or 3 level, depending on the skills and experience of the selected candidate. Additional job responsibilities (outlined below) will be assigned if the candidate is hired at the higher level.
  
  
Power System Engineering & Design
  

* Perform power system studies (Short Circuit, Coordination, Arc Flash, Load Flow) for high (115kV), medium (13.2kV), and low voltage equipment
* Design and implement electrical solutions to enhance system reliability, safety, and performance
* Develop detailed designs, calculations, and specifications for utility and facility projects

Operations, Maintenance & Compliance
  

* Support preventive and corrective maintenance for substations, transmission/distribution lines, and switchgear
* Ensure compliance with national standards (NESC, NEC, IEEE, NFPA 70E, OSHA)
* Work closely with PNM and Los Alamos County on Bulk Electric System (BES) planning, operations, and maintenance

Project Leadership & Stakeholder Collaboration
  

* Provide technical expertise and leadership on LANL projects, ensuring safe, high-quality, and reliable power delivery
* Collaborate across multiple teams, including safety specialists, utility operators, and project managers
* Develop and refine the Utility Health Report, identifying key investment areas for future improvements

Innovation & Problem-Solving
  

* Evaluate complex electrical challenges, identify risks, and develop creative solutions
* Provide insights on electrical safety, power quality, system protection, and reliability improvements

Additional Responsibilities at the Engineer 3 Level
  

* Act as an Electrical Safety Officer (ESO), conducting risk and hazard assessments
* Lead technical discussions, mentor junior engineers, and drive process improvements
* Manage long-term operational and strategic planning for utility reinvestment and asset management
  

  
  
  
**What You Need**  
  
**Minimum Job Requirements:**  
  
  
We're looking for an innovative, problem-solving engineer who's ready to grow their career and take on exciting challenges with the following experience:

* Hands-on experience with power system analysis tools like SKM, ETAP, or Synergi
* Familiarity with transmission and distribution system protection, SCADA systems, RTUs, or other operational technology (OT) hardware
* Knowledge of industry standards (NESC, NEC, IEEE, NFPA 70E, NERC)
* Experience in preventive maintenance programs, load flow modeling (PSLF), and GIS platforms (ArcFM)
* Ability to manage complex projects, schedules, and resources effectively
* Leadership or mentoring experience in a team-oriented, high-impact environment
  

  
  
**Education/Experience at Engineer 2 ($106,400-$176,000):** Position requires a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering and a minimum of 3 years practical work experience to the degree necessary to perform the responsibilities outlined above. Current registration as an Engineer-in-Training (EIT) is highly desirable.
  
  
**Education/Experience at Engineer 3 ($117,200-$195,400):** Position requires a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering and a minimum of 6 years practical work experience to the degree necessary to perform the responsibilities outlined above. Advanced engineering or technical degree is highly desired. Current registration as a Professional Engineer (PE) is highly desirable.
  
  
**Desired Qualifications:**  
  
  

* Professional Engineering (PE) License
* Hands-on experience with SEL relays, NFPA 70B electrical system testing, and DOE standards
* Familiarity with LANL engineering processes and procedures
  

  
  
**Work Location:** The work location for this position is onsite and located in Los Alamos, NM. All work locations are at the discretion of management.
  
  
**Position Commitment:** Regular appointment employees are required to serve a period of continuous service in their current position in order to be eligible to apply for posted jobs throughout the Laboratory. If an employee has not served the time required, they may only apply for Laboratory jobs with the documented approval of their Division Leader. The position commitment for this position is 1 year.
  
  
**Note to Applicants:** Due to federal restrictions contained in the current National Defense Authorization Act, citizens of the People's Republic of China - including the special administrative regions of Hong Kong and Macau - as well as citizens of the Islamic Republic of Iran, the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (North Korea), and the Russian Federation, who are not Lawful Permanent Residents ("green card" holders) are prohibited from accessing facilities that support the mission, functions, and operations of national security laboratories and nuclear weapons production facilities, which includes Los Alamos National Laboratory.

----------------

  

Sandia National Laboratories is the nation’s premier science and engineering lab for national security and technology innovation, with teams of specialists focused on cutting-edge work in a broad array of areas. Some of the main reasons we love our jobs:

* Challenging work with amazing impact that contributes to security, peace, and freedom worldwide
* Extraordinary co-workers
* Some of the best tools, equipment, and research facilities in the world
* Career advancement and enrichment opportunities
* Flexible work arrangements for many positions include 9/80 (work 80 hours every two weeks, with every other Friday off) and 4/10 (work 4 ten-hour days each week) compressed workweeks, part-time work, and telecommuting (a mix of onsite work and working from home)
* Generous vacation, strong medical and other benefits, competitive 401k, learning opportunities, relocation assistance and amenities aimed at creating a solid work/life balance\*

World-changing technologies. Life-changing careers. Learn more about Sandia at: http://www.sandia.gov
