* Plan, direct, and coordinate projects for internal and external customers by defining system/subsystem requirements, project scope, schedules, cost estimates, and deliverables; develop comprehensive project plans using advanced management techniques.
* Manage project resources and teams to ensure timely delivery, applying earned value management and other performance metrics to monitor progress, analyze variances, and support decision-making.
* Provide technical leadership and tactical planning throughout project execution, including evaluating system functionality, recommending integrated solutions, overseeing change management, identifying risks, and developing mitigation and contingency plans.
* Coordinate negotiations with customers and partners to establish deliverables, stakeholder requirements, and project constraints.
* Conduct technical and program reviews to communicate status on cost, schedule, and performance to management and customers.
* Analyze data and deliver work products that inform future technology development needs for Sandia.
* Recommend project initiation, expansion, or discontinuation based on performance and strategic alignment.
* Prepare and deliver progress reports, proposals, requirements documentation, and presentations.
* Develop logistics, deployment plans, and training resources to support system implementation.

Due to the nature of the work, the selected applicant will be required to work onsite.

**Salary Range**
----------------

  

$87,400 - $168,800

* Salary range is estimated, and actual salary will be determined after consideration of the selected candidate's experience and qualifications, and application of any approved geographic salary differential.

-----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in relevant discipline, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience. Equivalent experience in lieu of degree must be directly related experience that demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and ability to perform the duties of the job.
* Active DOE Q-level security clearance and ability to obtain and maintain Sigma 14/15

* Demonstrated ability to review and understand end-to-end work processes

The Software Engineer II designs, develops, implements, and supports healthcare integration solutions that enable secure and reliable exchange of clinical, financial, and operational data across enterprise systems. * Participate in code reviews, peer knowledge sharing, process improvement initiatives, and the development and adoption of integration standards, security practices, and change management procedures.
* Stay current with healthcare interoperability standards, emerging technologies and industry best practices through ongoing professional development. Perform other duties as assigned.

* Or equivalent combination of education and experience
* Experience with and knowledge of a modern object-oriented programming language and framework required
* Experience retrieving and writing to databases required
* Experience with industry standard development tools and technologies, including IDEs, such as Visual Studio, and source control tools, such as Git required
* Experience in the higher education, medical, or healthcare industry preferred
* Experience with multiple programming languages and frameworks preferred
* Experience designing database schemas and data models preferred
* Experience with project management methodologies, including Agile, from planning through implementation preferred
* Experience with Epic Bridges, Rhapsody or other integration platforms
* Experience with healthcare messaging protocols: HL7 v2, HL7 v3 CDA, HL7 FHIR, X12
* Javascript, PL/SQL, TSQL or related programming experience, including source control tools
* Oracle, MySQL, MS SQL or related database experience
* Experience designing and implementing data integration, transformation, or ETL processes using integration platforms or ETL tools preferred.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Ability to analyze and troubleshoot technical issues independently
* Ability to learn new technologies and apply technical concepts in a healthcare environment

jobs.title: Hardware Engineer
jobs.description:
Fairport, NY, United States
  

**Your Impact**

As a Hardware Engineer within the Transformers Value Stream, you will aid in driving new technology initiatives and performing Qualitrol’s NPD and Sustaining initiatives. The position requires a highly motivated, team oriented professional with the right mix of experience and skills. They will work on multiple projects using internal and external resources to deliver quality products that meet our customers' needs. Involved in all facets of development starting from requirements specification, validation, verification, and deployment. Responsible for product quality and reliability along with feature completion. This individual will embody Ralliant’s principles of leading by example, communicating openly, enabling, and inspiring extraordinary teams, excelling with partners, acting conclusively with high integrity, and collaborating efficiently to delight customers.

In this role, you will use SAFe Agile development Methods and the Scrum Framework to deliver critical, customer facing, monitoring systems, sensors and solutions for Utilities and Industrial customers. You will be expected to possess a thorough understanding of electrical design principles of analog and digital circuits.

*Here’s where you’ll demonstrate your proficiencies:*

* Support guidance into the entire product implementation cycle including requirements analysis, high level and detailed design (including PCBA layout), implementation, testing, integration, documentation, compliance certification and introduction to production in coordination with architecture team.
* Work with a multi-functional team that includes hardware architecture, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, logistics engineering teams, product and program management and other groups, as needed.
* Support advanced technology initiatives to develop next generation sensors and sensing platforms and improvements in products sustaining activities.

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and innovative Hardware Engineer to join our dynamic R&D team. This role is pivotal in driving the development of next-generation sensing and monitoring solutions for industrial and utility applications. The ideal candidate will bring a strong foundation in analog/digital circuit design, embedded systems, and communication protocols, with a passion for developing robust, field-ready hardware platforms.

**Skills & Experience**

The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate the following skills and experience:

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or similar.
* 2+ years of experience in hardware design for embedded systems.
* Proficiency in analog and digital circuit design, including low-noise signal paths and power management.
* Strong understanding of industrial communication protocols (e.g., Modbus RTU/TCP, LoRa, RS-485) with experience in integration into new and existing hardware platforms.
* Familiarity with sensor integration, including temperature, humidity, pressure, and optical sensors.
* Experience with schematic capture and PCB layout tools, Altium Designer preferred.
* Experience with Agile and Scrum framework.
* Knowledge and understanding of the fundamentals of fluid dynamics, thermal dynamics, computational fluid simulation using Ansys, Solid Works or similar would be an advantage.
* Experience with firmware-hardware co-design and debugging embedded systems.
* Knowledge of designing for compliance (EMC, safety), compliance testing, and product certification processes.
* Experience working with global manufacturing partners and contract manufacturers.
* Strong technical documentation and communication skills.

#LI-PW1

**Ralliant Corporation Overview**

Ralliant, originally part of Fortive, now stands as a bold, independent public company driving innovation at the forefront of precision technology. With a global footprint and a legacy of excellence, we empower engineers to bring next-generation breakthroughs to life — faster, smarter, and more reliably. Our high-performance instruments, sensors, and subsystems fuel mission-critical advancements across industries, enabling real-world impact where it matters most. At Ralliant we're building the future, together with those driven to push boundaries, solve complex problems, and leave a lasting mark on the world.

**About Qualitrol**

QUALITROL manufactures monitoring and protection devices for high value electrical assets and OEM manufacturing companies. Established in 1945, QUALITROL produces thousands of different types of products on demand and customized to meet our individual customers’ needs. We are the largest and most trusted global leader for partial discharge monitoring, asset protection equipment and information products across power generation, transmission, and distribution. At Qualitrol, we are redefining condition-based monitoring.

We Are an Equal Opportunity Employer. Ralliant Corporation and all Ralliant Companies are proud to be equal opportunity employers. We value and encourage diversity and solicit applications from all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or other characteristics protected by law. Ralliant and all Ralliant Companies are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. Individuals who need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment application process, please contact us at applyassistance@Ralliant.com.

**THE POSITION**

Our roster has an opening with your name on it

We're looking for passionate & experienced technologists, strong communicators, and those with a commitment to continuous improvement. The ideal candidate will be proficient in frontend engineering with ability to contribute to backend when necessary. We're looking for the confidence to propose pragmatic solutions to complex problems and be eager to learn from and educate others as a Senior Software Engineer working for our Sportsbook domain.  
  
You will be working with the FanDuel Sportsbook application, providing our customers with a best-in-class experience as a frontend proficient Software Engineer. You'll play a pivotal part in making our platform highly usable and will write clear, scalable, and high-quality code. You will work continuously to improve architecture and processes to improve quality and efficiency. In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs.

  

**THE GAME PLAN**  
Everyone on our team has a part to play

Your work is consistently of high quality. You solve difficult problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. You work with your team to invent, design and build software that is stable and performant. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to use them and when it is not. Your solutions are pragmatic. You consider the legacy of the code you produce and write code that an Engineer unfamiliar with the system can understand. You limit the use of short-term workarounds. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time (or at least minimize incidental complexity). You create flexible software without over-engineering. You make appropriate trade-offs, re-use where possible, and are judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g., system hardware, database, memory/CPU, etc).

* You work on project ideas with stakeholders, and peers.
* You own parts of product and technology and strive to become a subject matter expert.
* You write simple and extendable code following standards and best practices. You test your code thoroughly.
* You utilize AI-powered tools to maximize efficiency.
* You help balance customer requirements with the team requirements.
* You help your team evolve by actively participating in the code review process, design discussions, team planning, and ticket/metric/COE reviews.
* You classify, store, and handle data in accordance with FanDuel policies.
* You track security risks and mitigate and/or escalate them in a timely manner.
* You focus on operational excellence, constructively identifying problems and proposing solutions.
* You take on projects and make software enhancements that improve the team software and processes.
* You work to resolve the root cause of complex problems, leaving software better and easier to maintain than when you found it.
* You mentor and help new team-mates on how your team's software is constructed, how it operates, and how it fits into the bigger picture.
* You foster a constructive dialogue and seek resolutions in a professional way.
* You help recruit and interview for your team.
* You estimate stories/tasks accurately and deliver them in time.
* On-call rotation where required. You provide excellent customer support on behalf of Technology.
* You keep yourself up to date with market standards, and open-source frameworks.
* Most importantly, you are: humble, pragmatic, self-managed, thirsty for knowledge, never satisfied and always challenging the norm. You demonstrate responsibility for the state of the code you both inherit and produce.

  

**THE STATS**

What we're looking for in our next teammate

* Degree in Computer Science, related field, or equivalent work experience.
* 5 or more years of Software Development experience in creating and maintaining mobile applications with experience in React and React Native.
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and core web technologies (HTML and CSS)
* A fundamental understanding of data structures and algorithms with experience working with backend for frontend (BFF) architectural patterns.
* Proficient with prompting AI-powered development tools Claude or Cursor to accelerate coding workflows, improve code quality, and increasing efficiency.
* Experience working with cloud-based infrastructure and technologies, preferably AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, ECS, RDS).
* Experienced with optimization utilizing monitoring and alerting tools like DataDog or Sentry.
* Experience working with CI/CD pipeline tooling, preferably Jenkins or Buildkite.
* Familiarity with Git, GitLab, Atlassian suite preferred.
* Experience with unit testing, testing tools, integrating testing and best-quality practices into an SDLC.

**ABOUT FANDUEL**

FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America's #1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry's unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product.

In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV+, its leading direct-to-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico.

The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company's affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia.

FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming

jobs.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

**What We’re Doing**

At Lockheed Martin Rotary Mission Systems, we develop advanced technologies that support critical defense and aerospace missions. Our Owego, NY engineering teams deliver innovative Digital and RF solutions designed for demanding mission environments.

**The Work**

As a Power Engineer, you'll provide vital technical support for our Digital and RF programs, focusing on unit level power systems. You'll be responsible for analyzing and troubleshooting power distribution circuits at the circuit card assembly (CCA) and unit levels. You will interpret requirements and develop pass/fail criteria to conduct root-cause analysis and recommend engineering changes. In addition, you will assist senior engineers in circuit designs. In this role you will also develop power test procedures, execute power qualification tests, and write detailed reports to show adherence to the applicable power standards (MIL-STD-704).

Please note:

This position is located Owego, NY and is fulltime onsite.

This position requires the ability to travel up to or less than 10%.

This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD government clearance at the Secret level.

**Who We Are**

Rotary Mission Systems in Owego, NY develops mission-critical technologies for advanced defense systems. Our engineers work across the product lifecycle, from requirements and design through integration, qualification, and production.

**Who You Are**

You’re a power engineer who enjoys solving complex hardware challenges and turning requirements into reliable, testable designs. You bring expertise in power distribution, power conversion, circuit analysis, and hardware troubleshooting, along with strong technical communication skills and the ability to mentor others.

**Why Join Us**

Join Lockheed Martin in Owego, NY and apply your power engineering expertise to advanced Digital and RF systems. You’ll solve challenging technical problems, collaborate with experienced engineers, and influence designs from requirements through qualification while supporting technologies built for critical missions.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field with 2 years related experience, or Master's degree in engineering
* Experience using component layout, board layout, and schematic capture tools
* Ability to secure a Secret clearance.

**Desired Skills**
------------------

* Experience with analyzing and designing isolated and non-isolated DC/DC converters, switch-mode power supplies (SMPS), and Point-of-Load (POL) regulators
* Experience programing and utilizing programmable power supplies
* Knowledge of MIL-STD-704 and MIL-STD-461
* Knowledge of VITA specifications
* Experience with specifications writing and review, and tracking requirements through product lifecycle management tools to ensure full compliance with customer requirements
* Proficiency using oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, and benchtop power supplies and other basic lab equipment

**Pay Information**

Full-Time Salary Range: $70500.00 - $130900.00

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

**Benefits offered:** Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

* Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.
* For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

jobs.description:
**Date:** Oct 15, 2026

  

**Location:** Fairport, NY, US, 14450

  

**Company:** Corning

  

Requisition Number: 78728

  

**The company built on breakthroughs.**  
**Join us.**

Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible.

How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward.

At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more.

Come break through with us.

  

Corning’s businesses are ever-evolving to best serve our customers, industries, and consumers. Today, we accelerate and transform life sciences, mobile consumer electronics, optical communications, display, automotive, and solar markets. We are changing the world with:

* Trusted products that accelerate drug discovery, development, and delivery to save lives
* Damage-resistant cover glass to enhance the devices that keep us connected
* Optical fiber, wireless technologies, and connectivity solutions to carry information and ideas at the speed of light
* Precision glass for advanced displays to deliver richer experiences
* Auto glass and ceramics to drive cleaner, safer, and smarter transportation
* Solar polysilicon, wafers, and innovative photovoltaic modules, enabling low-cost solar energy solutions
  

**Scope of Position:**

The Electrical Engineering Technician – Systems Test provides hands-on electrical and electromechanical support for optical assembly and test operations across both Class 100 (Molecular Cleanroom) and Class 10,000 cleanroom environments. This role is responsible for troubleshooting and resolving motor control, cabling, wiring harness, and instrumentation issues on custom metrology benches and production equipment. The technician will support daily production and test bench operations, occasionally assist with new product introduction (NPI) and new bench builds, and provide infrequent support to other departments.

  

**Day to Day Responsibilities:**

* Provide hands-on electrical technical support for daily production and test bench operations, including rapid response to motor control, cable, and wiring harness issues
* Troubleshoot and repair servo/stepper motor systems, motion controllers, encoders, and feedback devices
* Diagnose circuit-level issues on production and test equipment
* Fabricate, modify, and repair cable and wiring harness assemblies
* Perform cable testing including continuity, hi-pot, and insulation resistance verification
* Create and redline wiring diagrams, schematics, and pinout documentation
* Support new bench builds and NPI activities requiring electrical assembly, integration, and validation
* Troubleshoot data acquisition and instrumentation interfaces (GPIB, RS-232/485, USB, Ethernet/TCP-IP, EtherCAT)
* Support PLC troubleshooting (Allen-Bradley, Beckhoff, or similar) and interpret ladder logic as needed
* Perform soldering and rework activities to IPC-A-610 / J-STD-001 standards
* Address power distribution, grounding, shielding, and EMI/ESD mitigation concerns
* Provide occasional electrical support to other departments as needed
* Collaborate closely with assemblers, test technicians, engineers (electrical, mechanical, optical, software), and production leadership
* Maintain housekeeping standards and support autonomous maintenance of work areas and equipment
* Demonstrate flexibility to support off-shift production needs when required
* Follow and promote safe work practices, cleanroom protocols, ESD controls, and laser safety practices (ANSI Z136) where applicable
  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Associate's degree in Electronics or Electrical Engineering Technology (or equivalent military/technical training)
* 3+ years of hands-on electrical technician experience, preferably in a low-volume, high-mix manufacturing or R&D environment
* Strong circuit troubleshooting skills using multimeters, oscilloscopes, function generators, and logic analyzers
* Proficiency with soldering and rework, including through-hole, surface mount (SMT), and fine-pitch work
* Working knowledge of AC/DC power distribution, grounding, shielding, and EMI/ESD mitigation
* Hands-on experience troubleshooting servo and stepper motor systems including drives, encoders, and controllers
* Familiarity with motion controllers such as Galil, Newport, and similar (Aerotech, ACS, Delta Tau, etc.)
* Experience with motion feedback devices — encoders (incremental/absolute), resolvers, limit/home switches
* Working knowledge of PID tuning, homing routines, and diagnosing following errors
* Understanding of linear stages, rotary stages, and piezo actuators used in optical setups
* Experience fabricating wiring harnesses including crimping, pinning, and connector assembly (D-sub, circular MIL-spec, Molex, JST, etc.)
* Ability to read and interpret wiring diagrams, schematics, and pinout documentation
* Willingness to work in cleanroom production environments
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to prioritize multiple concurrent issues across benches and drive issues to closure
* Self-starter with a strong troubleshooting mindset and attention to detail
  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* IPC-A-610, J-STD-001, and/or IPC/WHMA-A-620 certifications
* PLC troubleshooting experience (Allen-Bradley, Beckhoff, or similar) and ability to read ladder logic

* Experience with communication protocols including serial, TCP/IP, Modbus, EtherCAT, and CANbus
* Understanding of signal integrity fundamentals including noise reduction, differential signaling, and cable routing best practices

* Familiarity with HMI / SCADA systems

We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $147000 - $210000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**

jobs.title: Junior Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
**Position Summary:**

The Controls Engineer, entry level, supports the configuration, programming, testing, troubleshooting, and maintenance of industrial control systems, automated visual inspection (AVI) systems, and machine vision equipment used in manufacturing operations. Working under the guidance of experienced engineers, this role applies foundational knowledge of controls, electronics, programming, and computer science to improve equipment reliability, inspection performance, data integrity, and production efficiency.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Support the programming, configuration, testing, and maintenance of programmable logic controllers, human-machine interfaces, industrial computers, and related control equipment.
* Assist with the setup, calibration, optimization, and validation of automated visual inspection and machine vision systems.
* Review images, inspection results, alarms, system logs, and production data to identify defects, equipment faults, and improvement opportunities
* Support integration among AVI equipment, machine vision software, PLCs, and, manufacturing systems.
  
* Document software revisions, control configurations, test results, troubleshooting activities, and technical findings.
* Work closely with validation and quality to determine the boundaries between accept and reject product.
* Continuously improve the vision system applications to improve defect detectability while also reducing the percent of false rejects.
* Create and update standard operating procedures, work instructions, electrical documentation, and training materials.
* Participate in change controls, corrective actions, preventive maintenance, backups, and continuous improvement projects.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Validation, IT, Maintenance, and equipment vendors to resolve technical issues
* Follow current Good Manufacturing Practices, data integrity requirements, cybersecurity practices, safety procedures, and Good Documentation Practices
* Other duties and tasks assigned by management.

**Required Skills:**

* Foundational knowledge of industrial controls, automation, PLCs, human-machine interfaces, and input/output systems
* Foundational knowledge of machine vision concepts, including cameras, lenses, lighting, image acquisition, inspection tools, and defect detection
* Understanding of electronics, digital and analog circuits, sensors, control panels, and computer hardware
* Understanding of computer science concepts, including software logic, data structures, databases, operating systems, and networking fundamentals
* Ability to read basic electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, control narratives, technical drawings, and equipment manuals
* Ability to troubleshoot methodically, analyze data, document findings, and follow technical problems through resolution
* Familiarity with industrial communication protocols, SQL, version control, robotics, or machine vision software is preferred
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate across technical disciplines
* Ability to learn regulated manufacturing practices, including current Good Manufacturing Practices, data integrity, change control, and cybersecurity requirements

**Education and Experience Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Controls Engineering, Automation Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Science, or a related technical field; equivalent relevant education and experience may be considered
* Zero to two years of relevant experience, including internships, co-op assignments, academic projects, laboratory work, or entry-level technical employment
* Coursework or project experience involving PLC programming, industrial automation, electronics, embedded systems, machine vision, robotics, or computer-based controls is preferred
* Experience in a regulated manufacturing environment is helpful but not required

**Position Overview:**

The Controls Engineer II is a mid-level engineering professional responsible for leading the design, development, implementation, and optimization of control systems for industrial automation and manufacturing processes. This role involves working closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of hardware and software systems, troubleshooting automation issues, and ensuring system reliability, safety, and compliance with regulatory standards. The Controls Engineer II is expected to mentor junior engineers, manage automation projects, and contribute to the strategic direction of control system architecture. The role requires experience in PLC/HMI programming, motion control, robotics, and customer support. Strong project management skills, the ability to work independently, and a commitment to continuous improvement are essential for success in this role.

Responsibilities

* Develop, design and support custom control systems and automation processes

* Design HMI screens for process monitoring and control.
* Integrate automation systems with other equipment, sensors, instrumentation, network communication protocols, and robotic cells.
* Perform system testing and validation to ensure all systems meet technical specifications and safety standards.
* Diagnose and resolve issues, ensuring minimal downtime and maximum productivity.
* Create and maintain detailed documentation including system schematics, BOMs, programming code, sequence of operations, and user manuals.

* Understanding of electrical systems, integration, and industrial automation.
* Proficiency with servo and VFD motor control, sensors, and instrumentation.

**Job Description**

**Company Overview**

Teledyne Judson Technologies (TJT) is a global leader in detectors from the Visible to Long Wave Infra-red spectrum, offering an extensive range of single element infrared detectors. Two-dimensional focal plane arrays (InGaAs, InSb, and HgCdTe) and Integrated Dewar Cooler Assemblies (IDCA) complement our detector portfolio. The high performance of our detectors makes them highly valued in both commercial markets and critical space applications.

**Position Summary**

Previous experience with photodetectors/cameras and/or in optical design/modeling is considered a plus. The candidate will generate models and technical drawings, and support part procurement, product assembly, and product test as needed. The candidate must be able to work both independently and in collaboration with a cross functional team as necessary to ensure successful development of new products.

The ideal candidate has significant experience in ultra-high vacuum processing, including but not limited to loading and unloading devices onto a vacuum manifold, getter activation and degas, pinch-off, and leak check. Experience with laser welding, and metrology is desired.

**Qualifications & Competencies**

* Minimum 5 years of demonstrated detector packaging with an emphasis on vacuum Dewar design
* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations. Ability to organize data and write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients and customers.
* Significant experience in high vacuum processing, including but not limited to loading and unloading devices onto a vacuum manifold, RGA analysis, getter activation and degas, pinch-off, and leak check (Helium). Experience with laser welding and metrology.

Life Insurance Benefits

401(k) Eligibility

jobs.title: Lead Automation & Controls Engineer (Siemens TIA)
jobs.description:
**About EH Group Engineering**

EHG is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product is a significantly more compact fuel cell with high power density and lower costs of production. Faced with the challenges of climate change and the transition to a decentralised energy system, EHG seeks to provide high performance and cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To help bring this vision to life, we are looking for a Senior Control Engineer to coordinate our efforts in designing control strategies for containerized systems integrating our fuel cell technology alongside equipment such as gas reformers, batteries, and climate control units. You will coordinate the control team and play a key role in shaping how these complex, multi-equipment systems operate safely and efficiently in the field.

**Based in the US? You’re welcome to apply.** This is an on-site role in Nyon, Switzerland. We ask that you relocate within 3 months of starting, and we’ll support you with a relocation package.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate the control engineering activities and define the control architecture and technical roadmap for our fuel cell and containerized power systems
* Develop control strategies, models and algorithms for test-benches, fuel cell system and containerized power supply systems using Matlab/Simulink and Siemens PLCs
* Coordinate the transition of prototype control algorithms from Simulink to industrial-quality code in TIA Portal Step 7
* Implement, tune and validate controllers for thermal, air, fuel and power subsystems
* Define and own control requirements, state machines and safety/diagnostic logic
* Drive the continuous improvement (performance, efficiency and robustness) of our products
* Define and oversee model-in-the-loop (MIL) testing and validation procedures
* Manage the complete software life cycle, from requirements through release and maintenance, including dataset management
* Establish coding standards, conduct code reviews and ensure compliance with industrial and certification requirements
* Coordinate and develop the control team, including task planning and prioritization
* Act as the main control interface with embedded, test and electrical engineering, as well as external partners and suppliers

**Skills and Experience Required:**

* BSc/MSc in control, electrical, mechatronic or automation engineering is mandatory
* Minimum 7 years of experience in control engineering, including at least 2 years in a technical lead or senior role
* **Skill 1 :** Strong experience in process control engineering, particularly with containerized power supply systems; knowledge of programming and implementing safety PLCs is a strong plus
* **Skill 2 :** Strong experience with TIA Portal (Step 7, WinCC, Test Suite), with the ability to structure code to industrial standards and meet certification requirements
* Experience with functional safety (e.g. IEC 61508, ISO 13849), including SIL/PL determination and implementation of safety functions
* Experience across the complete V-model development cycle, including hazard and risk assessment, requirements definition, safety requirements specification (SRS), verification and validation, and dataset management
* Experience with stationary and maritime power applications, with a focus on the US and EU markets and their respective standards and certification requirements
* Proven team player, with the ability to:
    
  *(i)* Coordinate and mentor the control team by clearly explaining your code and helping the team adopt robust industrial methods: you will take the responsibility in developing **Skill 1** and **Skill 2** across the team  
  *(ii)*Collaborate effectively within interdisciplinary teams
* Solid knowledge of control theory, state machines and system identification

* Strong experience with MATLAB/Simulink and model-based design is a plus
* Professional working language is in English.

**Start date: Immediately**

**Job Description**  
The Controls and Avionics Solutions (CAS) business is experiencing unprecedented growth. Our two design centers in Endicott, New York and a new state of the art development center in Austin, Texas are the home for our next generation technical solutions. Engineers will develop flight and mission-critical products for more than 170 commercial and military customers. You will have the opportunity to help design and develop the next generation: Fly-By-Wire Flight Controls, Aircraft Engine Controls, Ground Vehicle Power Management Systems, Aircraft Electrification Systems, Advanced Air Mobility Systems, Autonomous Flight Systems, Flight Deck Systems, Cabin Management Systems, Weapon Control Systems, and Mission Systems for the world's most prominent commercial and military aircraft and vehicle manufacturers.
  
  
When you become a member of our team, you will work across multiple disciplines and collaborate with Systems, Hardware, Software, Test, and Operations during all phases of the Product Development Lifecycle. At BAE Systems, we promote a strong, collaborative culture and provide our employees with the tools, skills and training they need to succeed. We are all about trust, camaraderie, and a shared mission on delivering world-class products to our commercial and military customers. We offer a flexible hybrid work environment and 9/80 work schedule. Our company is part of the community and driven to improve our future and protect our freedom.
  
  
This role is based in Austin, TX and involves a combination of collaborative/in-person and independent work and will take the form of a hybrid work schedule, with time split between working onsite and remotely.
  
  
**Position Summary**

**Robotics Software Engineer (Engineer / Senior) – Austin, TX**

**Summary**  
The Robotics Software Engineer builds the software that makes the robots in our automated manufacturing cells aware of what is actually in front of them and able to react, rather than repeating a taught path. This role owns the robotics software stack for our cells from sensor input through motion, integrates arms, grippers, sensors, and cameras alongside the PLC and SCADA layers, and supports commissioning on site. You will be early enough to shape how we do robotics software, and close enough to the floor to see whether it works. We are hiring at the Engineer and Senior levels; scope and independence scale with level.

**Key Responsibilities**  

* Design and build the robotics software stack for our automated cells, from sensor input through motion.
* Write ROS 2 nodes for perception, planning, control, and coordination between machines.
* Integrate robot arms, grippers, sensors, and cameras into working cells alongside PLC and SCADA layers.
* Build simulation environments so behavior can be validated before it touches real hardware.
* Handle calibration, coordinate frames, and the tolerance stack-up that decides whether a part actually seats.
* Tune cycle time and reliability, then keep it there across shifts and part variation.
* Support commissioning and bring-up on site, including the debugging that only happens with real parts.

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Mechatronics, Electrical, Mechanical, or related engineering field, or equivalent experience.
* Engineer: 2+ years · Senior: 5+ years building robotics software that shipped on real hardware.
* Strong ROS 2 experience, including having shipped something on real hardware. A ROS 1–only background is not a fit for this role.
* Working knowledge of the ROS 2 stack itself: DDS middleware, QoS settings, lifecycle nodes, launch, and colcon builds.
* Proficiency in C++ and Python.
* Working knowledge of kinematics, transforms, motion planning, and trajectory execution.
* Experience integrating sensors and interpreting messy real-world data.
* Comfort with simulation tools such as Gazebo, Isaac Sim, or MuJoCo.
* Practical instinct for mechanical and electrical constraints, since the robot is one part of a larger machine.

**Level Expectations**  
Senior additionally owns the robotics software for a full cell end to end, makes the architecture calls inside it, leads integration with the controls and vision engineers, and mentors Engineer-level teammates.

Preferred Skills  

* Computer vision background: camera calibration, pose estimation, 2D and 3D detection, OpenCV.
* Deep learning for perception, including running inference on edge GPUs.
* MoveIt 2, ros2\_control, or Nav2.
* Industrial robot brands and their controllers, for example FANUC, UR, ABB, or KUKA.

* Experience talking to PLCs from a robot stack over OPC UA or EtherNet/IP.

jobs.title: Principal Systems Engineer, Signal-Path Performance & Modeling
jobs.description:
**About Neurophos**
===================

The demand for new data centers and AI compute is rapidly outpacing the planet's energy capacity. Digital solutions are hitting a power wall as we approach the physical limits of traditional silicon. Conquering this bottleneck means rethinking the fundamental architecture of inference compute. The industry's current path can't meet the need, so we're taking a different approach.

Instead of traditional electronic circuits, we use silicon photonics and an active, programmable metasurface to perform matrix multiplications at the speed of light. Our optical cells are 10,000x smaller than traditional photonic components, enabling unprecedented density. By using photonics instead of electricity, our chips become more efficient as they scale. This architecture will deliver up to 100 times the energy efficiency of existing solutions while significantly improving performance for large-scale AI inference.

We’ve assembled a world-class team of industry veterans and recently raised a $110M Series A led by Gates Frontier. Participants include M12 (Microsoft’s Venture Fund), Carbon Direct Capital, Aramco Ventures, Bosch Ventures, Tectonic Ventures, Space Capital, and others.

Join us and shape the future of computing!

**Location:** Austin, TX. Full-time onsite position.

**Reports To:** Chief Systems Engineer

**FLSA Status:** Exempt

**Position Overview**
---------------------

We are seeking a highly skilled Systems Engineer to own the quantitative, end-to-end performance model of our optical vector-matrix multiplication (OVMM) engine. This role is the technical center of Systems Engineering's performance-modeling focus area: you will lead the end-to-end modeling, analysis, and architectural definition of high-speed communication and signal-processing systems. In this role, you will build and maintain the link and power budgets; quantify impairments and non-idealities across the optical, analog, and digital domains; develop mathematical and behavioral models; define the hardware and algorithmic techniques required to meet aggressive system-level performance targets; and determine how accuracy, throughput, and power trade against one another as the architecture evolves.

You will spend most of your time running system-level simulations and translating them into defensible allocations the rest of the organization can design against. If you have deep communication-theory and signal-processing intuition, are fluent in turning a signal chain into a quantitative model, and want to be the person who can answer "where does the system actually lose its margin," this role will let you define the performance envelope of a first-of-its-kind computing platform.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Primary Responsibilities**

* **Signal-Path Architecture Ownership:** Own and define the architecture of the high-speed communication and signal-processing system that converts the digital data stream into an optical signal and back—spanning digital signal processing, D/A and A/D conversion, and the analog/optical signal conditioning surrounding them on both the transmit and receive sides. Define the blocks and processing stages that comprise this system and specify the requirements for each. Negotiate block-level requirements with the photonic and mixed-signal implementation teams who build to this architecture.
* **Link & Power Budget Ownership:** Own and maintain the end-to-end optical and electrical link/power budget for this signal path, keeping it synchronized with the as-designed and as-measured hardware as the architecture evolves.
* **Signal-Path Modeling:** Build and maintain the reference behavioral model of the full TX–channel–RX signal path, capturing optical, analog, quantization, and algorithmic effects with the fidelity needed for architecture decisions and requirements allocation.
* **Accuracy & Performance Allocation:** Allocate NMSE/SNR/SNDR targets across optics, analog, quantization, and algorithmic domains, and update those allocations as component and architecture choices change.
* **Impairment Analysis:** Characterize and model optical, analog, and digital impairments—noise, distortion, jitter, quantization effects, crosstalk, mismatch, and nonlinearity—and quantify their impact on system-level accuracy.
* **Throughput & Efficiency Trade Studies:** Analyze the impact of TX/RX channel configurations and architectural options on TOPS, TOPS/W, and latency. Balance the complexity, risk, and time-to-market of proposed architectural solutions.
* **Monte Carlo & Time-Domain Simulation:** Develop and run statistical (Monte Carlo, corner) and time-domain simulations to quantify design margin and manufacturing robustness.
* **Model-to-Measurement Correlation:** Correlate model predictions with laboratory and silicon measurements; when measured performance does not match simulation, isolate the source of the discrepancy and refine the architecture, model, and allocations accordingly.

**Secondary Responsibilities**

* Represent this system's architecture in roadmap and planning discussions.
* Supply quantitative performance data, both predicted and measured, to support other efforts across Neurophos (e.g., customer-facing technical discussions).
* Support calibration accuracy-budget definition with sensitivity analysis.
* Collaborate with analog, photonic, digital, and software engineers to keep subsystem designs consistent with the architecture and its performance targets.
* Mentor engineers in system modeling, communication theory, and architecture/trade-study methodology.
* Contribute to intellectual property creation, including invention disclosures and patents.

* **Experience:** 7+ years of professional experience in communica

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer – Medium Voltage - Power Distribution & Control Products
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

Integrated Circuit Solutions (ICS) is seeking a Medium Voltage Electrical Engineer to provide engineering expertise and product application support for medium-voltage electrical power distribution, protection, and control solutions. This role supports the design, application, analysis, testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of medium-voltage power distribution systems.

The engineer will help select equipment, support proposals and procurement, evaluate vendors, and contribute to project execution. Working with customers, suppliers, and cross-functional teams, this role helps deliver safe, reliable, code-compliant, and cost-effective electrical solutions.

**Areas of Technical Expertise**

* Medium-voltage metal-clad and metal-enclosed switchgear and circuit breakers
* Load-break and disconnect switches
* Transformers, motor control centers (MV MCCs), VFDs, and soft starters
* Protection and control systems, protective relays, metering, and power monitoring
* Automatic and manual transfer schemes
* Grounding systems and equipment
* E-Houses, power distribution centers (PDCs), and integrated power racks/skids
* Capacitor banks and power factor correction equipment

**Key Responsibilities**

* Product and Application Engineering
* Review customer requirements, specifications, and project documentation to develop medium-voltage power distribution solutions.
* Select and apply medium-voltage equipment, including switchgear, transformers, motor control equipment, protective relays, and associated components.
* Determine equipment ratings and configurations based on system requirements, applicable standards, and project objectives.
* Develop and review electrical drawings, technical documentation, and equipment layouts.
* Evaluate equipment and system designs for safety, reliability, maintainability, and code compliance.

**Technical Support and System Design**

* Review system voltage, load requirements, available fault current, equipment ratings, protection requirements, grounding methods, and coordination considerations.
* Perform or review power system studies, including short-circuit, protective device coordination, load-flow, arc-flash, motor-starting, and voltage-drop analyses.
* Develop and review protection schemes for feeders, transformers, motors, buses, and other medium-voltage equipment, including protective relays, CTs, PTs/VTs, metering, and relay settings.
* Support system design, equipment integration, reliability, maintainability, selectivity, and overall performance.
* Support integration of switchgear, transformers, MV MCCs, VFDs, soft starters, protective relays, PLC/control systems, SCADA, metering, and communication networks.
* Support installation, startup, energization, testing, and commissioning; assist with troubleshooting relay operations, nuisance trips, control issues, communication failures, and other system events.

**Protection, Control, and Automation**

* Develop and review medium-voltage protection and control philosophies and protective relay functions.
* Develop and review breaker control, interlocking, transfer, permissive, synchronization, and trip schemes.
* Review DC control power systems, including batteries, chargers, UPS systems, and associated distribution.
* Support integration of protective relays and intelligent electronic devices (IEDs) with PLC, SCADA, DCS, and power management systems.
* Review communication architectures and protocols, including Modbus, IEC 61850, DNP3, and Ethernet/IP.
* Support control narratives, sequence-of-operations documents, cause-and-effect matrices, interlocking logic, and system testing.

**Codes, Standards, and Power System Studies**

* Apply applicable NEC/NFPA 70, NFPA 70E, IEEE, ANSI, NEMA, UL, customer specifications, and local codes.
* Review equipment interrupting and short-time withstand ratings, momentary ratings, BIL, insulation levels, enclosure ratings, environmental requirements, and electrical clearances.
* Evaluate arc-resistant equipment requirements and accessibility classifications where specified.
* Review power system studies and evaluate results to verify equipment ratings, protection requirements, and system performance.
* Identify specification deviations, exceptions, and technical risks and coordinate design changes.

**Project, Manufacturing, and Customer Support**

* Support projects from quotation and order entry through engineering, procurement, manufacturing, testing, shipment, installation, energization, and commissioning.
* Review engineering drawings, bills of material, technical submittals, protection schemes, relay settings, equipment configurations, and vendor documentation.
* Coordinate technical requirements with switchgear, transformer, relay, MV drive, and other equipment suppliers.
* Support manufacturing teams in resolving technical and production issues.
* Participate in design reviews, factory acceptance tests (FATs), customer inspections, relay testing, equipment functional testing, and technical meetings.
* Investigate non-conformances, field issues, equipment failures, nuisance trips, and protection or application concerns; recommend corrective actions.
* Support sales and proposal teams with quotations, equipment selection, system configurations, technical specifications, customer discussions, and value engineering.

***Required Qualifications***

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or a closely related engineering discipline.
* Experience with medium-voltage power distribution systems, including switchgear, substations, motor control, protection, or engineered electrical equipment.
* Demonstrated knowledge of medium-voltage power distribution, protection, and control systems.
* Ability to develop, read, and review one-line and three-line diagrams, schematics, AC/DC control diagrams, wiring diagrams, equipment layouts, and technical specifications.
* Working knowledge of power system fundamentals, including short-circuit calculations

ENER-i is a cutting-edge software solution from Electric Power Engineers (EPE) helping utility clients plan for the rapidly evolving electric grid and achieve their planning and operational goals through innovative digitalization. jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

Decision Technologies Inc. is a forward-thinking company specializing in technical support services and engineering consultancy. With extensive expertise in RF systems and missile sensors development, we are committed to delivering exceptional support, quality, and innovation to our clients across the defense and aerospace sectors.

Decision Technologies is seeking an experienced, high-impact **Air Defense/AAW Senior Systems Engineer** ready to take the next major step in their career trajectory by serving as the principal technical direction engineer embedded within a major U.S. Navy weapon system program office. **This is a 100% in-office (Arlington, VA), on-site position sitting inside the Navy program office spaces. This position is not eligible for hybrid or remote work arrangements.**

**Position Description:**

This role is tailored for an accomplished surface weapons or combat systems engineer, especially those with direct experience at OEMs and Labs/Warfare Centers who are looking to move beyond isolated subsystem tasks and transition into high-visibility technical leadership across the Navy enterprise. Embedded directly with program leadership, you will partner with the Government Technical Director to steer future weapon capability, analyze real-world operational feedback from the Fleet, and translate emerging threat intelligence into actionable science & technology (S&T) roadmaps for the next generation of surface munitions and ship self-defense capabilities.

**YOU MUST HAVE AN ACTIVE DOD SECRET CLEARANCE / TOP SECRET PREFERRED**

**Responsibilities**

The selectee will serve as the Decision Technologies Lead Systems Engineer for U.S. Navy Terminal Defense Systems engineering support. In this capacity, you will drive top-level engineering analysis, architectural roadmapping, and operational alignment across the portfolio:

* **Strategic Planning & S&T Roadmapping:** Lead technical, programmatic, and architectural roadmapping across the entire IWS 11 portfolio. Identify, evaluate, and transition emerging Science & Technology (S&T) and R&D solutions to formulate future weapon system upgrade evolutions.
* **Operational Fleet Feedback & Threat Analysis:** Serve as the trusted technical advisor to the Government Technical Director, keeping a constant pulse on real-world operational challenges, Fleet feedback, and live combat engagements to rapidly inform near-term CONOPS and long-term capability baselines.
* **Threat vs. Weapon Systems Requirements Analysis:** Analyze cutting-edge threat intelligence and emerging adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) against current and planned surface weapon capabilities to identify gaps, update weapon specifications, and drive survivability solutions.
* **Combat System & Weapon Integration:** Direct system-of-systems (SoS) integration studies and interface definitions linking terminal defense weapons (e.g., RAM, CIWS) into ship combat systems (such as SSDS and Aegis) and advanced sensor suites (e.g., SPY-6 EASR).
* **High-Level Stakeholder & Enterprise Alignment:** Interface at the senior executive and Flag/SES levels across PAE Munitions, PAE Mission Systems, OPNAV, warfare centers (NSWC Dahlgren, NSWC Port Hueneme, NAWC China Lake), international cooperative partners, and national security leadership.
* **Digital Engineering Leadership:** Guide the program office’s model-based transition by applying Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) frameworks (SysML, Cameo/MagicDraw), digital threads, and Agile/DevSecOps practices to weapons modernization lifecycles.

**Required Qualifications**

jobs.title: Systems Engineer – C4IT Systems Engineering & Integration
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Systems Engineer to support the engineering, development, integration, installation, testing, and sustainment of complex Command, Control, Communications, Computers, and Information Technology (C4IT) systems.

The Systems Engineer will provide technical leadership and engineering expertise across multiple system lifecycle activities, ensuring that hardware, software, network, and peripheral components operate together to meet operational and mission requirements.

This position requires strong technical analytical skills, experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering activities, and the ability to address complex system integration and operational challenges.

The successful candidate will collaborate with Government representatives, project managers, software developers, test engineers, technicians, cybersecurity personnel, and external vendors.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

*Systems Engineering and Architecture*

* Perform systems engineering activities throughout the system lifecycle.
* Develop and evaluate system requirements, designs, specifications, and engineering documentation.
* Analyze system architectures and identify opportunities for improved functionality, interoperability, and reliability.
* Support hardware and software integration activities.
* Analyze system interfaces, data flows, and communications requirements.
* Perform technical analyses to evaluate proposed system designs.
* Identify engineering constraints and recommend feasible technical solutions.
* Support engineering trade studies and technology assessments.

*Requirements Engineering*

* Analyze operational, functional, performance, interface, and system requirements.
* Translate Government operational needs into engineering requirements.
* Develop and maintain technical requirements documentation.
* Support requirements verification and validation.
* Identify conflicting, incomplete, or technically infeasible requirements.
* Maintain engineering traceability between system requirements, designs, and verification activities.

*Systems Integration and Installation*

* Plan and coordinate integration of hardware, software, communications, and peripheral systems.
* Evaluate compatibility between system components.
* Support equipment configuration and system installation activities.
* Coordinate with technical personnel to resolve integration issues.
* Analyze and troubleshoot complex system-level problems.
* Support installation and operational readiness activities.
* Participate in system demonstrations and acceptance events.

*Test and Evaluation*

* Develop or oversee development of system test and evaluation plans.
* Coordinate engineering verification activities.
* Participate in integration, functional, performance, and operational testing.
* Analyze test results and identify deficiencies.
* Recommend engineering corrections and system improvements.
* Support test readiness reviews and technical milestone events.
* Document verification results and engineering recommendations.

*Technical Project Coordination*

* Provide technical guidance and direction across multiple engineering disciplines.
* Coordinate technical activities with project managers and Government stakeholders.
* Support technical planning, engineering schedules, and task execution.
* Provide input into project estimates, budgets, and technical resource requirements.
* Support technical reviews and engineering presentations.
* Monitor and report progress against technical milestones.
* Coordinate vendor and subcontractor technical activities when assigned.
* Identify technical risks and develop mitigation recommendations.

*System Sustainment and Troubleshooting*

* Support system maintenance, modernization, and technology refresh activities.
* Investigate complex hardware, software, or communications failures.
* Perform root cause analysis and recommend corrective actions.
* Evaluate system changes for impacts on performance and interoperability.
* Support configuration control and technical baseline management.
* Assist with operational troubleshooting and system restoration.

*Engineering Documentation and Reporting*

* Develop and review system engineering documentation.
* Prepare technical reports, engineering analyses, and design recommendations.
* Maintain system interface and configuration documentation.
* Prepare technical presentations and Government briefings.
* Document technical decisions, risks, resolutions, and lessons learned.
* Communicate engineering findings to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications**

*Education*

Bachelor's degree in one of the following fields:

* Systems Engineering
* Computer Science
* Electrical Engineering
* Industrial Engineering

*Experience*

Minimum seven (7) consecutive years of experience in C4IT or Systems Engineering.

Experience must demonstrate progressively responsible engineering activities involving:

* Systems engineering and technical analysis.
* Hardware and software system integration.
* System requirements and design.
* Technical troubleshooting.
* Test and evaluation support.
* Engineering documentation.
* Multidisciplinary technical coordination.

*Security Requirements*

* U.S. Citizenship required for eligibility for the required security clearance.
* Secret security clearance required.
* Ability to maintain the required clearance throughout employment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

*Government and Military Systems*

Experience supporting:

* U.S. Coast Guard programs.
* Department of Defense programs.
* Department of Homeland Security programs.
* C4ISR systems.
* Maritime communications systems.
* Command-and-control environments.
* Government system modernization and sustainment programs.

*Technical Knowledge*

Knowledge of:

* Systems engineering lifecycle processes.
* Systems integration methodologies.
* Network and communications architectures.
* Windows and Linux environments.
* Hardware

Lockheed Martin is a global leader in aerospace, defense, and technology solutions. Our Manassas campus is a thriving center of engineering expertise, fostering a culture that encourages creativity, excellence, and the creation of exceptional products. Our team is made up of dedicated professionals who are passionate about pushing the boundaries of what's possible.

**What We’re Doing**

At Lockheed Martin, we're at the forefront of cutting-edge technology and innovation. Our campus in Manassas, Virginia is a hub for engineering excellence, where we tackle some of the world's most challenging engineering problems. We pride ourselves on our culture of creativity, excellence, and product innovation.

**The Work**

Lockheed Martin Rotary & Mission Systems is seeking a full-time Systems Engineer. This Systems Engineer will support the United Kingdom (UK) Tactical Tomahawk Weapons Control System (TTWCS) program within our C6ISR market segment at our Manassas, Virginia location. This individual will be part of a small team responsible for maintaining UK customer requirements, system hardware requirements, and interface specifications, for addressing a variety of systems engineering tasks, and defining and executing a test and acceptance program for the Tomahawk Weapon System (TWS) onboard UK Astute-class submarines.

This position involves frequent interaction and collaboration with customers and end-users. This Systems Engineer must be able to effectively communicate and interface across the team to address matters that affect execution or performance of the project and provide regular progress status and participate in required program planning. The ability to build and maintain positive relationships with stakeholders, including customers, end-users, and internal teams, is essential.

This Systems Engineer must also participate in the full System Engineering life cycle, including system and hardware requirements development, hardware stand-up, system integration, test definition, test planning, system certification and sell-off, and system delivery and production support. The Systems Engineer should demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and a desire to optimize team efficiency throughout the entire lifecycle.

This position requires occasional international travel to the UK for several weeks at a time, as well as occasional local and domestic travel.

Your Health, Your Wealth, Your Life

Joining Lockheed Martin means becoming part of a team that's making a significant impact in the field of engineering. When you choose to work with us, you'll enjoy:

* An excellent working environment equipped with state-of-the-art tools.

* A culture that encourages creativity, excellence, and the development of remarkable products.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Core Product
jobs.description:
**About Tin Can**
=================

Tin Can is building a safer, simpler way for kids to connect — without smartphones. We’re creating screen-free, delightful devices and services that let families call the people who matter most, free from the noise of today’s digital world.

We’re building a bold, authentic, nostalgic, and kinda quirky brand that resonates with folks who want something simpler & better for their kids than the tech-infused lives we’re currently living (and who have a sense of humor about it). As we gear up to scale to thousands of families, we’re ready to bring on two engineers to help make it happen.

**The Role**
------------

A Tin Can earns its spot on the kitchen counter when a kid keeps picking it up. Because we build both ends of the call, we get to make things no other phone can, and the next ones are the kind families ask us for: an easier way to fill the contact book, even more speed dials, more a kid can do without waiting on a grown-up. We’re hiring two Software Engineers to own the core product — the features that give a kid someone to call, a reason to call, and an easy way to do it.

You’ll build across the whole product: the app parents live in (Flutter), the TypeScript services on AWS Lambda behind contacts, plans, call logs, and voicemail, and the call-routing service that gates every call. You’ll sit with the Head of Product and the core experience’s PM and designer, alongside the engineers who own our voice platform, firmware, and account portal. When a feature reaches into the call path — a new hotline number, the voicemail menu — you’ll go there, with our voice engineers reviewing anything on the SIP and media plane.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Make it easier to hear who called and call them back — on the phone itself, in our services, and in the parents’ app
* Give kids more of the phone: even more speed dials, and more a kid can set up alone, with a parent’s say-so
* Make the first week count — improved contact syncing, faster contact approvals, and a first run that has a family calling on day one
* Build the fun, weird features no other landline can, the kind a kid tells their friends about
* Own the call-routing rules a feature needs — what a speed dial or a hotline number does, who a kid can reach — in the service every call goes through
* Build the tooling behind hotlines — scheduling, uploading, playback — with the engineers who own our voice platform
* Spec and build the service side of features whose other half is firmware — what the phone plays, how it rings — with the firmware engineer
* Instrument what you ship — event schema, dashboard, alarm — so we can see kids calling more, week by week
* Take a turn in our on-call rotation, because nobody knows a feature like the person who built it

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* 3+ years building user-facing software, including a feature you took from idea to production and kept running
* Strong TypeScript; you’ve built and run an API in production (ours run on AWS Lambda with Postgres) and can model contacts, permissions, and call history
* You’ve shipped a mobile or web client people use every day; our app is Flutter, and we’ll teach you Dart
* You think about the kid and the parent at once — what a kid can do alone, what needs a grown-up, and how fast “no” takes effect
* Fluency using AI as a multiplier across prototyping, build, and analysis; this is how we work, not a nice-to-have
* Hands-on and scrappy; you’d rather prototype the flow on a real Tin Can than wait for a perfect spec
* A clear communicator who writes things down, and a collaborative, low-ego approach — everyone here sweeps the floor
* Based in Seattle and ready to work from our office Monday through Thursday; this isn’t a remote role
* **Bonus:** Flutter or Dart; curiosity about telephony (dial plans, IVRs, text-to-speech); a product for kids or families; or Stripe, Shopify, or IoT integrations

**Why Join Tin Can**
====================

* **We’re building tech that protects childhood:** We’re on a quest to give kids a more analog childhood — one with real conversations, real connection, and way less screen time. No doomscrolling, data mining, or dopamine traps — just a simpler, better way for kids to stay in touch. This is a rare opportunity to build something that truly matters.
* **You’ll own the reason a kid picks up the phone:** Reliability makes a call connect; you’ll build what makes a kid want to make one — easier ways to call back, more speed dials, more to do when no one’s around — and see it in how often families call.
* **Small, high-trust team:** Every company says “team,” but at Tin Can it means something different. We’re a small, mission-driven group that genuinely has each other’s backs — professionally and personally. You’ll be joining a tight-knit crew where your ideas and instincts matter from day one.
* **Room to explore, not just execute:** You’ll have the space to challenge assumptions, solve hard problems, and build systems that reflect our values of trust, simplicity, and care.

If you’re excited by making a Tin Can the thing a kid reaches for when they’ve got something to tell someone — and building what makes that call easy to make and return — we’d love to meet you.

Compensation Range: $145K - $175K

This role supports the development and operations of New Glenn, a single-configuration, heavy-lift orbital launch vehicle capable of routinely carrying people and payloads to low-Earth orbit, geostationary transfer orbit, cislunar, and beyond. Its first stage is fully reusable, and the vehicle was designed from the beginning to be human-capable.

As part of a small, passionate, and accomplished team of experts, you will own end to end product development as a responsible engineer of LRUs. These LRUs are a critical component of New Glenn, and control some of the most significant functions on the rocket. In this role you’ll interface with design, test, systems, integration, software and control engineering disciplines throughout the entire product lifecycle from conception to flight ready hardware.

This role is part of the Lunar Permanence business unit, which develops Blue Origin’s Blue Moon landers and related products.
