- Familiarity with common development and infrastructure tools including Git, GitHub, Docker, HashiCorp Vault, and artifact management platforms (e.g. Artifactory)

- Ability to champion modern software practices and uphold software quality standards in all phases of development

- Strong analytical skills and the ability to evaluate software architecture & design, including existing codebases

- Familiarity with AI coding tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot) to accelerate development

- Deep understanding of the bootloader and application bring-up process

- Experience orchestrating and optimizing resources (CPU, memory, disk) using tools such as cgroups and MGLRU

The Annapurna Labs team at Amazon Web Services (AWS) builds the AWS Neuron SDK, the software development kit used to accelerate deep learning and GenAI workloads on AWS Trainium machine learning accelerators.  
  
The Neuron Inference organization is at the forefront of optimizing inference performance for a wide range of ML models and model architectures on AWS's custom ML accelerators. We are working across the stack from PyTorch to the hardware-software boundary, our engineers build systematic infrastructure, develop high-performance kernels for ML functions, ensuring every compute unit is fine-tuned for optimal performance forour customers' demanding workloads. We combine deep hardware knowledge with ML expertise to push the boundaries of what's

You will work closely with the new product development team to create novel applications for high-frequency power converters using state-of-the-art GaN and silicon technologies, and to deliver differentiated solutions that address critical customer needs.

You will also develop best-in-class reference designs using Power Integrations products for next-generation AI and data center power architectures.

Responsibilities

* Develop innovative high-frequency power converter solutions for AI and data center applications across AC/DC and DC/DC architectures using Power Integrations products.
* Define power converter architectures and key system components for emerging AI and data center power solutions.
* Provide switching power supply design support and technical guidance for applications based on Power Integrations products.
* Develop reference designs and application solutions that demonstrate performance, efficiency, and system value for next-generation AI and data center power architectures.
* Collaborate with product development teams and customers to solve complex technical challenges, evaluate design tradeoffs, and optimize system performance, density, and reliability.

* Active power factor correction circuits
Phase-shifted and LLC resonant converters  
Buck, boost, buck-boost, and flyback converters  
Expert knowledge of high-frequency magnetics design  
Ability to perform complex calculations, including worst-case analysis, for circuits designed using Power Integrations products  
Experience with tools such as MATLAB, Excel, and simulation software such as SIMPLIS/LTspice/PLECS

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience creating specifications, technical reports, and test plans or instructions

Experience using finite element tools such as ANSYS  
Experience designing power supplies/power converters from concept to production and supporting post production

jobs.title: Senior Systems Software Engineer - Deep Learning Solutions
jobs.description:
NVIDIA is a global leader in physical AI, powering self-driving cars, humanoid robots, intelligent environments, and medical devices. Our software platforms are central to this mission. We help innovators build products that save lives, enhance working conditions, and improve living standards globally!

We are hiring a Senior Systems Software Engineer to join our team as a technical expert focused on optimizing deep learning inference for autonomous vehicles and robotics on edge devices. This role requires a hands-on specialist who can examine model architectures at the operator level. They will locate performance issues through kernel trace analysis and evaluate modern architectures (transformers, vision-language models, diffusion/flow matching, state space models) on GPU and SOC. This work directly enhances autonomous vehicles’ and robots’ ability to perceive and respond in real time, yielding immediate benefits. The group works on some of the hardest optimization challenges in the industry, positioned at the convergence of model frameworks, compiler technology, and embedded hardware. We maintain strong collaboration with automotive OEMs, robotics colleagues, and internal hardware teams to extend edge device capabilities.

**What you'll be doing:**

* Address customer and partner optimization challenges: Engage directly with prominent automotive OEMs and robotics associates to analyze, debug, and improve their deep learning models on NVIDIA platforms. We emphasize delivering solutions rather than just recommendations.
* Own performance benchmarking: Drive efforts to achieve leading results on MLPerf Edge and industry benchmarks, as well as closed-source engagements with key partners. Define methodology, ensure reproducibility, and turn results into actionable optimization priorities.
* Evaluate emerging model architectures: Investigate new DL architectures, including vision encoders, multi-modal VLMs, hybrid SSM-Transformer backbones, diffusion/flow matching decoders, and multi-camera tokenizers, regarding compilation feasibility, memory footprint, and latency on target SOCs.
* Collaborate across teams: Work alongside our compiler, runtime, and hardware groups to link model-level insight with platform capabilities.
* Contribute to build reviews and help develop internal roadmap priorities based on real customer workload patterns.
* Represent NVIDIA externally: Share our deep learning optimization expertise at conferences, webinars, and partner events. Help elevate the broader team by bringing back insights and establishing guidelines.
* Deliver TensorRT and compiler-stack solutions for edge: Build and deploy inference solutions on Jetson, DRIVE, and GPU + ARM platforms for AV and robotics workloads. Develop Proofs of Readiness (PORs) and collaborate closely with our compiler team on Torch-TRT, MLIR-TRT, and related frameworks to bridge performance gaps.

**What we need to see:**

* Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* Over 12 years working in the industry, including at least 8 years specializing in deep learning model optimization, inference engineering, or neural network compilation. Proficiency in understanding and reviewing model architectures at the operator/kernel level, not merely handling their operation, is required.
* Over 5 years of validated expertise in embedded/edge software, with experience delivering production inference solutions within power-limited, latency-sensitive deployment environments.
* Comprehensive knowledge of contemporary DL architectures: transformers, attention variants, vision encoders (ViT), multi-modal/vision-language model frameworks, as well as experience with diffusion models and/or state space models.
* Expert knowledge of GPU architecture fundamentals, CUDA, and low-level performance optimization using heterogeneous computing. Experience with TensorRT, compiler IRs, or equivalent inference optimization toolchains.
* Solid understanding of embedded operating system internals (QNX/Linux), memory management, C/C++, and embedded/system software concepts.
* Background in parallel programming (e.g., CUDA, OpenMP) and experience reasoning about memory hierarchies, data movement, and compute utilization.
* Demonstrated capability to collaborate directly with external partners and customers in a deep technical role. You solve their workload issues, identify performance problems, and provide solutions within production limitations.

**Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:**

* Experience with ML compiler frameworks (TVM, MLIR, XLA, Triton) or contributing to inference runtime development.
* Production deployment experience with autonomous vehicle perception or planning stacks, understanding the full pipeline from sensor input through trajectory output.
* Familiarity with the Physical AI model landscape: VLM + action expert architectures, end-to-end driving models, or robot foundation models.
* Contributions to MLPerf benchmarks and large-scale industry performance optimization efforts.
* Experience with automotive safety standards (ISO 26262, SOTIF) and their implications for inference system development.

jobs.title: Hardware Engineer - Test Development
jobs.description:
Zoox is building a purpose-built, fully autonomous robotaxi, and every electronic control unit (ECU) on it has to be proven before it reaches a vehicle. The Autonomy Hardware Validation team in Robot Platform Verification & Validation runs the design validation (DV) and production validation (PV) testing that shows our ECUs meet their requirements across temperature, power, vibration, EMC and lifetime stress.

As a Hardware Engineer on our Test Development team, you will be the hands-on engineer who gets testing done in our Foster City labs. You will build test setups and automation, run tests, and help find the root cause of failures. You will move between projects as needs shift, including next-generation vehicle platforms, production validation for our current robotaxi, and cold-weather qualification. You will use AI tools and automation to build and run tests faster.

### **In this role, you will:**

Build, debug and maintain test setups for vehicle ECUs, including fixtures, test carts, harnesses, fault injection racks, power supplies, electronic loads, data acquisition and thermal chambers.

Run electrical, environmental and reliability tests in our Foster City labs and at local test labs, and document the results clearly.  
Write test automation and tools in Python, and use AI tools to review specifications and test procedures, synthesize results and speed up test development.

Support root cause analysis of test failures with validation, design, firmware and supplier quality engineers, and track issues to closure in Jira.

Add capacity where it’s needed most, working with validation leads to turn their validation plans into working test setups and procedures.

### **Qualifications:**

* 2+ years of experience in hardware test, hardware validation or electrical engineering, and a BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related field.
* Hands-on experience with lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, power supplies, electronic loads, DMMs and data acquisition systems.
* Experience building or modifying test setups such as harnesses, fixtures or instrumentation, and reading schematics to debug board-level issues.
* Working proficiency in Python for test automation or data analysis.
* Comfortable using AI tools to review documents, synthesize information and build test tooling, and checking their output critically.
* Experience with fault injection, hardware-in-the-loop or automated test equipment for electronics.

jobs.description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.

We are a leader in the development of innovative DNA sequencing instruments that transform the landscape of genomics. Our flagship products, such as the NovaSeq X and 6K series, drive scientific discoveries across healthcare and biotechnology. Join us and bring your expertise to products that make a difference globally.

  

As a Staff Electrical Engineer in our Lifecycle Management team, you will be a technical leader responsible for overseeing the entire electrical-system lifecycle of our high-performance sequencing products — from New Product Introduction (NPI) through sustaining phases until end-of-life. You will lead and manage technical LCM projects end-to-end, guiding a sub-team of engineers while personally driving the most complex technical investigations.

  

This role demands a dynamic, fast-learning, and highly flexible engineer who can manage component End-of-Life (EOL), drive supplier and design changes, and lead product improvements — all while adhering to our Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions (WIs), and software/PLM platforms. You will have the opportunity to lead, mentor, and grow the team, and to progress toward broader electrical-systems engineering leadership.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead and own LCM technical projects end-to-end — scoping, planning, execution, risk management, and release — across component EOL/shortage response, redesign, qualification, and documentation. Familiar with instrument PDP and LCM (Life Cycle Management) process.

* Partner with software/firmware, product development, and strategic sourcing to balance sequencing performance against CE cost and supply risk.

Compliance, Quality & Test

* Ensure all engineering activities comply with internal SOPs, WIs, and company software/PLM platforms and infrastructure.

* Champion testing as a quality-control measure; contribute to the design and implementation of test fixtures and related engineering tools.

* Maintain product compliance (EMI/EMC and safety standards) through change events and support certification documentation.

**Technical Requirements:**

* **Problem Solving:** Strong analytical skills to evaluate system-level impacts of component changes, diagnose issues quickly, and implement sustainable solutions.

  

**Qualifications:**

* **Experience:** Demonstrated experience leading full-lifecycle management of electronic systems in complex products, including technical project ownership and mentoring.

jobs.title: Embedded Flight Software Engineer (TS/SCI Cleared)
jobs.description:
Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge.

For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet.

**About the Role**
==================

As a Senior Embedded Software Engineer on Apex's Flight Software team, you will design, develop, and own the software that brings our spacecraft to life. You will tackle the hardest problems in autonomous systems and build robust software that enables reliable spacecraft operation 24/7, across every phase of a mission. You will work closely with our mission operations, GNC, and hardware teams to architect new systems, prototype ideas, and turn them into mission-critical software that ultimately flies.

Experience in the space industry is not necessary to thrive at Apex. Instead, we are looking for motivated engineers who enjoy solving complex problems, balance technical rigor with practicality, and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

The Flight Software team is composed of three interconnected teams: high-level application software, operating system software, and embedded software. There is significant collaboration and crossover across these teams.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop the low level software that configures and drives the processor peripherals and communication interfaces on our avionics.
* Write and debug the device drivers for the sensors, actuators, and components across the bus.
* Implement onboard algorithms, including closed loop control and the logic that detects and responds to faults such as failed sensors or radiation upsets.
* Design, develop, and own mission-critical software for satellite systems throughout the full software lifecycle, from initial architecture and development through deployment and operations.
* Develop rapid, iterative software to support bench and development testing, as well as robust, rigorously reviewed and validated software delivered to manufacturing and flight systems.
* Plan and execute unit, integration, and system-level testing of satellite components, diagnosing and resolving defects to ensure software quality, reliability, and performance.
* With a focus on embedded software and hardware designs, collaborate cross-functionally with systems, hardware, test, and operations teams to establish product requirements, define technical roadmaps, and drive successful execution.
* Support spacecraft commissioning during launch and early operations, troubleshooting software and ensuring critical flight systems remain functional and reliable throughout critical mission activities.

**Requirements**
----------------

* U.S. Citizenship (must possess the ability to access export-controlled data)
* Active Top Secret clearance with SCI access and SAP eligibility
* 8+ years writing C/C++ for embedded systems, ideally in spacecraft, robotics, automotive, or other hardware that interacts with the physical world
* Bachelor’s degree in CS, EE, or equivalent
* Strong proficiency in programming languages such as C++, Python, or Rust

**Preferred**
-------------

* 3+ years of flight software experience
* Experience developing firmware for microcontrollers, either bare-metal or on an RTOS.
* Comfort with hardware/software integration, including reading schematics and using tools like oscilloscopes and logic analyzers to bring up new hardware.
* A solid understanding of microcontroller and microprocessor architecture, including memory, buses, and DMA.
* FPGA development experience.
* Experience bringing up new avionics or flight hardware from first power-on.
* Experience with satellite attitude control systems (ACS), including reaction wheels, magnetorquers, and small thrusters, and sensors
* Experience driving motors and power electronics or reading feedback sensors such as encoders and current monitors.
* Experience developing, testing, deploying, and troubleshooting mission-critical satellite software from prototyping through flight operations.
* Experience with real-time software on distributed hardware platforms across multiple satellite products.
* Knowledge of embedded and real-time operating systems (e.g., Embedded Linux, Yocto, Buildroot, FreeRTOS, VxWorks).
* Experience writing and debugging low-level device drivers for hardware interfaces (e.g., SPI, I²C, UART, Ethernet, CAN, SpaceWire).
* Familiarity with satellite communication standards and protocols (e.g., CCSDS, ECSS).
* Familiarity with networking and secure communications (e.g., TCP/IP, UDP, TLS), data serialization (e.g., Protobuf, JSON, MessagePack), and encryption (e.g., AES, RSA).
* Experience translating requirements into technical solutions, defining technical roadmaps, and coordinating with cross-functional engineering teams to support project execution.
* Experience supporting spacecraft commissioning during launch and early operations.
* Experience with version control, configuration management, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines for software build, deployment, and release.

* Experience taking electrical designs from prototype through production

* Experience with EtherCAT, EtherNe

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer (ArsenalOS Deployment)
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

Maritime Digital Production (MDP) is the software and digital systems function within Anduril's Heavy Metal division. We build and deploy the full technology stack that powers Anduril's shipbuilding factories: the data infrastructure that makes every machine and sensor visible in real time, the manufacturing execution system (ArsenalOS) that workers and planners use every shift, the scheduling engine that replans production in minutes instead of days, and the AI systems that eliminate manual toil from both the shop floor and business operations.  
  
MDP operates at the boundary between Operational Technology and Information Technology. Our systems live where factory-floor machines, edge compute, and OT networks meet enterprise platforms and cloud infrastructure. We incubate solutions close to the production line, validate them with real operators building real hardware, harden them for reliability and security, and then scale them across multiple sites. The environment is fast, physical, and consequential. When our systems go down, production stops. The output of our work is not a dashboard: it is a ship.  
  
This is not a support function. It is a strategic investment by Anduril in the premise that digitizing the manufacturing lifecycle end-to-end, from engineering definition through scheduling through execution through field feedback, is how Heavy Metal will out-build, out-adapt, and out-scale the traditional defense industrial base. MDP is scaling from a founding team to 70+ engineers across multiple U.S. sites. You will be joining early, working on hard problems with real operational stakes, and shaping how manufacturing software is built at Anduril from the ground up.

**Responsibilities:**

Do you excel in an environment that values exploration and discovery? We have a universe of opportunities waiting for you!

The **Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL)** is NASA’s lead center for robotic exploration of the solar system. Our core competency is the end-to-end implementation of unprecedented robotic space missions to study Earth, the Solar System, and the Universe. We are proud to be part of NASA and Caltech, as we explore the universe and make history through new discoveries. jobs.description:
**Lab Summary:**

The Robot Intelligence Lab at Samsung Research America is a new facility dedicated to advancing the field of robotics through cutting-edge research and development. The lab's mission is to develop advanced technologies to power intelligent robotic systems capable of manipulation, navigation, and complex reasoning for a variety of high-impact application areas. To achieve this mission, the lab collaborates closely with external entities such as universities, startups, and government labs, as well as with several Samsung Product and Advanced Research labs.

**Position Summary:**

Samsung Research America is looking for a Senior Robotics Systems Engineer to own the end-to-end software architecture for our robot platform, driving technical decisions that shape how hardware and software integrate at scale. This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role: you won't inherit a mature codebase—you'll *build* the foundations that make it possible.

As an early team member, you'll work directly across software teams (reasoning, dexterity, perception, simulation) to integrate their work into a cohesive platform. You'll establish the architectural patterns, engineering practices, and infrastructure that allow rapid iteration today and maintainable growth tomorrow. This includes defining component interfaces, building CI/CD pipelines, containerizing environments, and implementing package management and deployment strategies—essentially, laying the technical groundwork for a production robotics system.

Samsung's unique advantage in the consumer electronics market and growing focus on AI and robotics will provide you with exciting technical challenges and a rewarding career experience. By leveraging Samsung's vast product ecosystem to deliver novel user experiences, your work will define Samsung's future in robotics and significantly impact real-world users.

**Position Responsibilities:**

* Guide cross-platform robotics software architecture, including component interfaces, dependencies, and integration across software and hardware.
* Establish practical guidelines for maintaining the codebase, including repository organization, coding standards, code reviews, testing, and documentation.
* Develop and integrate Python and C++ software within ROS/ROS2-based systems.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and automated integration tests for simulation and physical robots.
* Maintain Docker-based development and runtime environments across x86-64 (Intel/AMD) and ARM platforms.
* Improve software deployment, logging, and troubleshooting workflows for robot computers and shared lab systems.
* Support reproducible AI development environments and cloud-based training workflows in collaboration with researchers.

**Required Skills:**

* MS degree in CS/EE/Robotics, or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience
* 5+ years of experience conducting state-of-the-art robotics R&D
* Proficiency in Python and C++, with experience developing and maintaining Linux-based software.
* Experience with ROS/ROS2 and hands-on integration with robotics hardware.
* Experience designing software components and defining clear interfaces within complex systems.
* Practical experience with Docker, Git, CI/CD, and automated testing.
* Ability to establish maintainable engineering practices while supporting fast-moving research.

jobs.title: Sr. Sensor Hardware Engineer, Sensor Fusion
jobs.description:
**What to Expect**

The best rides feel effortless and rejuvenating. The cabin is prepared for you before you notice: the freshness of the air, the atmosphere, the temperature, and the humidity. The vehicle seems to know when you need warming up, when you are heating up, when you are feeling unwell, and when you are ready to rest. None of it happens because someone pressed a button. It happens because the car quietly senses how its passengers are doing and responds.

Think of automatic climate control, or air recirculation that reacts to what is in the air outside. We are building the next generation of that technology, to go with Tesla's industry-leading FSD vehicles.

Passengers never tell a vehicle how they feel, and no single sensor tells the whole story. Body heat, comfort, and drowsiness show up across many signals, and the vehicle understands them best when a well-chosen set of sensors works together.

As a sensor fusion hardware engineer on the Sensing Hardware Team, you will design that set. You'll decide which sensors the vehicle needs, where they go, and how their signals come together. Then you'll build prototypes, study the data, and refine the suite until it is as simple, robust, and affordable as it can be. You'll work closely with the algorithm team, and you're welcome to shape the algorithms yourself.

As FSD frees people from the wheel, the ride itself becomes the product. You'll own a focused part of it, from first prototype to high-volume production, on one of the most visible products in the world.

 **What You'll Do**

* Own your subsystem end to end, from requirements through production, and be accountable for how it performs in the field
* Architect the sensor suite for passenger comfort and state: choose sensing principles, quantity, and placement, and decide where signals are combined
* Choose sensors with data: instrument prototypes with candidate sensors, analyze what each one adds, and cut to the smallest suite that meets the goal
* **Electrical:** design and build sensor prototypes, including schematics, PCB layout, low-noise analog front-ends, and bring-up
* **Mechanical:** design sensor housings, mounting, and interior integration in CAD, working with HVAC and design teams
* **Software and algorithms:** collect and analyze multi-sensor data, and design and validate fusion algorithms with the algorithm team
* Run test campaigns with people and in vehicles, and turn the results into clear hardware decisions
* Work with suppliers and manufacturing to take the design from prototype to production

  
**What You'll Bring**

* Degree in related field or equivalent experience
* A proven record of building a feature or product from the ground up and taking it to commercial production
* Hands-on sensor hardware experience in any domain, such as thermal, climate, air or gas, optical, MEMS, biometric, wearable, medical, consumer, industrial, appliance, or robotics, and the curiosity to learn a new one
* Experience combining multiple sensors and showing that the combination beats any one of them
* Strong PCB and analog design, with working knowledge of CAD and mechanical integration
* Strong data analysis (Python, MATLAB, or similar), with comfort using statistical or machine-learning methods
* Familiarity with common cabin and environmental conditions (temperature, humidity, CO2, VOCs) and how people affect them, plus the basics of human thermal comfort
* Clear communication, sound judgment with incomplete information, and the ability to bring people along with data

#### **Benefits**

Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:

* Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction
* Family-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
* Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
* Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High-Deductible medical plan with HSA
* Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
* Company paid Basic Life, AD&D
* Short-term and long-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
* Back-up childcare and parenting support resources
* Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft & legal services, and pet insurance
* Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
* Tesla Babies program
* Commuter benefits
* Employee discounts and perks program

  

#### **Expected Compensation**

$100,000 - $354,000/annual salary + cash and stock awards + benefits

In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by *TIME* as a “Best Invention”, *MIT Technology Review* as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and *Fast Company* as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing - might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.

**Role Description**
--------------------

Form Energy is hiring a Staff Control Panel Designer to impact development and validation of our groundbreaking battery technology. As part of our BMS Hardware & Electrical System team, you will be responsible for the full lifecycle of industrial control panel design — from component selection and schematic development through vendor coordination and high-voltage validation. You will work cross-functionally with mechanical, electrical, and manufacturing teams to deliver panels that meet the highest safety and compliance standards.This is an exciting opportunity to help shape and be part of the growth of a fast-moving company with breakthrough technology and an incredible mission!

* Design the control panel panels in compliance with NEC (NFPA 70) and UL 508A standards

* Select components rated for 600V AC and 2000V DC high-voltage applications
* Work directly with third-party panel vendors to translate design intent into built assemblies.
* Execute and oversee high-voltage testing procedures including hipot, insulation resistance, and functional validation
* Collaborate with mechanical engineers on panel enclosure selection, thermal management, and physical integration
* Support DFMEA activities for panel-level failure mode identification and risk mitigation

### **What you'll bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field with 7+ years of relevant experience; OR Master's degree with 5+ years of relevant experience
* Proficiency in panel design SW EPLAN or equivalent
* Demonstrated experience designing panels to NEC and UL 508A requirements
* Hands-on experience in testing with high-voltage testing procedures and associated safety protocols
* Strong working knowledge of branch protection coordination, wire sizing, and power conversion device integration
* Experience managing third-party panel fabrication vendors through design, build, and acceptance phases
* Familiarity with the SW including PLM (e.g. Arena or Team Center), product development SW (e.g. JIRA) and requirement management tools (e.g. JAMA)
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently and cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment

Amphenol Communications Solutions (ACS), a division of Amphenol Corporation, is a world leader in interconnect solutions for Communications, Mobile, RF, Optics, and Commercial electronics markets. Amphenol Corporation is one of the world’s largest designers and manufacturers of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor-based products and coaxial and high-speed specialty cable. ACS has an expansive global presence in research and development, manufacturing, and sales. We design and manufacture a wide range of innovative connectors as well as cable assemblies for diverse applications including server, storage, data center, mobile, RF, networking, industrial, business equipment, and automotive.

The Power Systems Engineer is a customer-facing technical role at the intersection of system-level power architecture and connector/cable interconnect engineering. Working directly with hyperscalers, GPU/CPU partners, infrastructure partners, and Rack Power ODMs to understand current and future power delivery architectures and turn that insight into connector and cable power solutions. The role sits between the customer's engineering teams and internal product development engineering, R&D, and applications engineering, acting as the primary technical liaison who gathers technical requirements, aligns architecture with product capability, and presents solutions back to the customer.

Power Systems Engineer works under the guidance of senior team members supporting key customers and/or key programs, while building fluency in power architecture and connector/cable technology.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Technical Requirements:** Engage with customer engineering teams to capture requirements to develop power interconnect solutions.
* **Architecture translation:** Translate system-level power architecture (e.g., 800V bus conversion, sidecar or vertical power delivery, busbar distribution) into connector and cable technology requirements to define product development.
* **Customer-facing solutioning:** Serve as the front-facing technical point of contact for power architecture discussions, presenting connector/cable solution options, trade-offs, and roadmap alignment directly to customer engineering teams.
* **Cross-functional alignment:** Partner with product engineering and manufacturing site to develop and deliver power interconnect solutions.
* **Specification development:** Develop technical requirement documents and specification inputs that drive new product development and design-in activities.
* **Design-in support:** Support qualification, validation, and design-in activities for new power interconnect solutions at customer sites.
* **Industry Standards:** Track relevant industry standards and consortia (e.g., OCP, hyperscaler-specific specifications) that shape power delivery and interconnect roadmaps.
* **Voice of customer:** Deliver customer and market insight back into internal roadmap and new product development.
* Support senior team members in customer engagements.
* Build working knowledge of the company's connector and cable product portfolio as applied to power delivery use cases.

**Required Qualifications**

* At minimum Bachelor of Science in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or related engineering technical field.
* Bachelor’s degree with 3+ years of experience in power connector, systems engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* Master’s degree with 1+ years of experience in power connector, systems engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* Foundational understanding of connector development and power architecture concepts.
* Ability to read and interpret system-level requirements and specifications.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable participating in customer-facing meetings alongside senior colleagues.
* Willingness to travel to customer sites as needed.

* Direct exposure to data center power architecture with strong critical thinking skills.
* Familiarity with the connector and cable industry landscape and their power interconnect product lines.
* Working knowledge of Open Compute Project (OCP) standards.
* Experience/exposure to Creo 3D CAD software.

The e-Beam division plays a critical role in KLA’s inspection ecosystem, with tools that deliver high-resolution, timely insights into defects and critical locations on the wafer. Used alongside KLA’s patterned and bare wafer inspectors, e-Beam systems help our customers quickly identify and understand yield-impacting issues—enabling faster, more effective actions to correct the manufacturing process.

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

jobs.title: Senior Spacecraft Mission Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Varda**
---------------

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. **Varda's W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.**

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

**About This Role**
-------------------

The **Senior Spacecraft Mission Software Engineer** is responsible for Varda's critical ground segment software, and the platform it runs on which enables spacecraft operations. We operate at the intersection of telemetry and commanding, data acquisition and distribution, mission control interfaces, simulation and test automation, with reliable deployment across lab, test range, and mission operations environments. You'll work hands-on with flight software, avionics, RF/ground systems, and mission ops.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* **Own Ground Segment Services:** Develop and maintain high-reliability services for telemetry ingestion, scaling, distribution, and commanding. Ensure deterministic behavior for real-time operations and post-flight analysis.
* **Mission Control Interfaces:** Deliver operator-grade UIs and dashboards that optimize "ops time" and reduce cognitive load across integration, test, and on-orbit operations phases.
* **Simulation and Test Automation:** Build tools to run flight-software simulations, device emulators, and scenario-based automated tests - enabling fast, safe iteration for avionics, GNC, and operations teams.
* **Build the Mission Platform***:* Design, implement, and productionize software for mission and ground software teams. Standardize CI/CD pipelines, artifact management, service templates, infrastructure-as-code, simulation and hardware-in-the-loop frameworks, test harnesses, and observability - all delivered as self-service tooling.
* **Deployments Across Environments:** Create robust deployment patterns for lab benches, test stands, and mission networks. Implement safe rollout/rollback strategies and air-gapped or limited-connectivity deployment approaches.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, math, physics, engineering or equivalent technical experience in safety critical software.
* 5+ years of experience in the development of spacecraft or similar safety critical software.
* Expertise with development in Python, along with a strong understanding of the language concepts.
* Have strong systems fundamentals: concurrency, networking, performance, reliability.
* Experience building real-time data acquisition, scaling, and distribution services - low-latency messaging, time-series and relational stores.
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD, dependency/build systems, and infrastructure-as-code.
* End-to-end observability experience: logging, metrics, tracing.
* Docker/Kubernetes; release management, phased rollouts, and operational readiness for controlled networks.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**
-----------------------------------

* Proficiency in C++, Ansible, and/or NiceGUI.
* Experience with DAQ and closed-loop control (lab/test control environments).
* Prior work on CI/testing/simulation/data tools integrated with flight software teams.
* Experience with requirements, test, and certification artifacts from safety-critical or certified workflows.
* Knowledge of ground systems standards; security in mission networks.
* Experience building mission-grade UIs with structured command workflows, alarming, and situational awareness.

**Pay Range**
-------------

* Salary range: Senior Software Engineer: $169,067 - $216,031/ per year.
* This role is on-site in El Segundo, CA.
* Leveling and base salary is determined by job-related skills, education level, experience level, and job performance.
* You will be eligible for incentives in the form of stock options and/or long-term cash awards.

**ITAR Requirements**
---------------------

Varda, like all employers, must ensure that its employees working in the United States are lawfully authorized to work in the U.S. Additionally, our employees are exposed to and have access to certain export-controlled items. Because our employees are provided access to export-controlled items, our policy is to only hire "U.S. persons" who are permitted to have access to our technology without an export license.

jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world's largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world's hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

**Role**

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer - AI Security to join our team. This is a Hybrid role based in San Jose, CA, reporting to the Director, Software Engineering in the Engineering department. We are building security products that enable organizations to adopt AI applications and agents safely and at scale. As a Staff Software Engineer, you will take ownership of complex engineering challenges, build secure and scalable systems, and raise the technical bar through hands-on execution and collaboration.

**What you'll do (Role Expectations)**

* Define technical direction and architecture for major areas of the product
* Lead high-impact initiatives that span multiple teams and system boundaries
* Turn ambiguous product and security challenges into clear, executable engineering strategies
* Establish standards for secure, reliable, scalable, and maintainable systems
* Identify systemic risks, architectural gaps, and investments needed for long-term growth

**Who You Are (Success Profile)**

* You thrive in ambiguity. You build the path as you walk it, viewing ambiguity not as a hindrance but as raw material to create impactful solutions.
* You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action, seamlessly navigating between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
* You are a problem-solver. You are energized by complex challenges and finding elegant solutions that deliver maximum value.
* You are a high-trust collaborator. You build strong relationships through clear feedback, respect, and a commitment to team success.
* You are driven by innovation. You possess a deep curiosity for how systems work and are energized by solving technical challenges at the cutting edge of AI security.

**What We're Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)**

* Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving
* 5+ years of software-engineering experience, including technical leadership across complex production systems
* Strong proficiency in Go, Rust, and Python, with deep expertise in systems engineering, security engineering, and backend platforms
* Demonstrated experience architecting and evolving platforms that span multiple teams or product areas
* Proven ability to remain hands-on through coding, prototyping, design review, and complex debugging
* Deep understanding of concurrency, networking, storage, APIs, data systems, and cloud infrastructure on AWS, GCP, or Azure

**What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Experience building enterprise security, endpoint, cloud, or infrastructure products
* Familiarity with AI/ML systems, analytics platforms, AI applications, or AI security
* Experience helping a startup or high-growth product evolve into a scalable engineering organization

jobs.description:
Meta is seeking talented experienced engineers to join our teams in building cutting-edge products that connect billions of people around the world. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to work on complex technical problems, build new features, and improve existing products across various platforms, including mobile devices and web applications. Our teams are constantly pushing the boundaries of user experience, and we're looking for passionate individuals who can help us advance the way people connect globally. If you're interested in joining a world-class team of engineers and researchers to work on exciting projects that have significant impact, we encourage you to apply.  
  
  

### **Software Engineer, iOS Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, design, operations, infrastructure) to build innovative application experiences
* Implement custom user interfaces using latest programming techniques and technologies
* Analyze and optimize code for quality, efficiency, and performance, and provide feedback to peers during code reviews
* Set direction and goals for teams, lead major initiatives, provide technical guidance and mentorship to peers, and help onboard new team members
* Architect efficient and scalable systems that drive complex applications
* Identify and resolve performance and scalability issues, and drive large efforts to reduce technical debt
* Work on a variety of coding languages and technologies
* Establish ownership of components, features, or systems with expert end-to-end understanding

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* Experience utilizing data and analysis to explain technical problems and provide detailed feedback and solutions
* Demonstrated experience driving change within an organization and leading complex technical projects
* 8+ years of programming experience in a relevant language OR 4+ years experience with a PhD

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience building maintainable and testable code bases, including API design and unit testing techniques
* Shipped at least one large-scale product to production, supporting millions of active users
* 2+ years of experience building complex applications for the iPhone or iPad using Objective-C/C++/Swift with the iOS SDK and other frameworks
* Experience with multithreading programming and mobile memory management
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. jobs.description:

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We've got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform's impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that's alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. **JOB DESCRIPTION**

We are seeking a curious, motivated Systems Engineer II to support the implementation of end-to-end power subsystem solutions, including supporting the delivery of power hardware and operations. As a systems engineer, you will be involved in all phases of the mission life cycle including technical concept development, hardware implementation, delivery, and operations. A systems engineer is highly motivated and creative with the ability to oversee, balance and integrate technical and program-related issues in an end-to-end manner to ensure that the total system satisfies the project and mission requirements.

Tasks include but are not limited to:

* Develop and manage power system and electrical system requirements.
* Develop and execute V&V plans on JPL lead projects/missions.
* Develop power system architectures and power subsystem definition on new mission proposals.
* Perform power system sizing & resource management.
* Develop and document electrical interfaces across a spacecraft to ensure a self-compatible, robust design implementation and to support the fabrication of flight harnesses.
* Work effectively with power designers in defining optimum architectures.
* Perform architectural trades to optimize systems across technical, schedule, and cost constraints.
* Develop grounding diagrams in support of a compliant EMI/EMC approach.
* Produce detailed, complex, and accurate design products in support of hardware development and to document the as-built configuration.
* Present complex power system concepts to different levels of line management and project teams.
* Understand and follow standards for power and electrical systems engineering architecture, design, and execution including clear expectations for quality.

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

* Extensive understanding of one or more of the following areas: Analog Electronics, Controls, Power Systems Design, Systems Engineering, Electrical Systems Engineering, Reliability Engineering, Integration and Test.
* Extensive understanding of principles, theories, concepts and techniques in Power Systems Engineering.
* Experience in power electronic design including schematics, reliability analysis, board layout, and testing.
* Experience delivering flight hardware, supporting ATLO operations, and in-flight operations.
* Extensive knowledge of grounding, EMI/EMC, harness design, electrical compatibility, signal integrity, safety and inhibit architectures, battery management, pyros and propulsion drivers, and multi-stage vehicles.
* Knowledge related to the development, testing, integration, and use of solar arrays and batteries for space applications.
* Extensive experience with standard electronic test equipment: oscilloscope, power supply, logic analyzer, etc.
* Ability to troubleshoot and diagnose problems to determine the root cause.
* Experience in power converter topologies, power switching, and closed-loop power control systems and their implementation using microcontrollers and/or FPGAs.
* Excellent oral and interpersonal skills.
* Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering, or related technical subject area, typically with a minimum of 3 years of related work experience, or Masters in a similar discipline with a minimum of 1 years of related work experience, or PhD in a similar discipline.
* Recent demonstrated experience in defining and delivering hardware.
* Extensive knowledge on the observables in electronic control systems and data acquisition systems.
* Strong interpersonal skills.

**DESIRED SKILLS**

* Experience with power subsystem hardware, electrical interfaces, and complex integrated systems.
* Complete knowledge of Laboratory policies and procedures, NASA policies and procedures, and government regulations across a range of applications.
* Knowledge of industry, military, and/or academic practices and standards system development.
* Extensive experience in hardware development and troubleshooting.
* Proficiency with Altium Designer, LTSPICE, and PLECS.
* Ability to multi-task meet schedule milestones.

It replaces decades-old training methods that depend on costly live aircraft or ground simulators. Warfighters get more realistic, repeatable training at a fraction of the cost, and they show up to the fight better prepared.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

**IDEAL IF YOU HAVE**

* Hands on military flight hardware development experience, especially taking hardware through qualification and airworthiness and into flight on military aircraft.

* **Test Execution & Data Analysis –** Execute system‑level test plans (electrical, functional, EMI/EMC, vibration, thermal). Collect and analyze test data to support verification efforts and report findings.

**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

Basic understanding of radiation effects (TID, SEE) and mitigation techniques. Experience working with embedded microcontrollers/FPGA.

We are seeking an experienced Optical Systems Engineer with expertise in lasers, optical systems, and hands-on laboratory development to mature advanced optical technologies from early-stage R&D prototypes into robust, field-deployable systems. You'll combine your strong technical knowledge of laser systems, optical architectures, opto-mechanical integration, alignment, controls, and optical measurements with the ability to lead engineers and technicians through system development, integration, testing, and transition to production. This position serves as a critical bridge between R&D and engineering and product development, translating emerging technologies into reliable, manufacturable, maintainable, and field-ready systems with progressively higher Technology Readiness Levels (TRLs). The successful candidate will work directly in the laboratory, troubleshoot complex optical systems, develop experimental methods, guide technical teams, and establish processes for transitioning research concepts into operational systems across Laboratory, Engineering, R&D, and Product and Field environments.

  

**What You'll Work On:**

* Lead the design, integration, characterization, and testing of complex optical and laser systems.
* Define system architectures, requirements, specifications, and performance metrics.
* Develop test configurations, and verification methods.
* Troubleshoot and improve optical subsystems and integrated systems with R&D team
* Translate research results into engineering requirements and development plans.

* Assess performance, reliability, manufacturability, maintainability, and deployment readiness.

* Support qualification, reliability, calibration, acceptance testing, deployment, and field troubleshooting.
* Create system specifications, interface-control documents, test procedures, alignment guides, troubleshooting guides, and verification documentation.
  

Join us. The world can't wait.

  

**You Have:**

* 10+ years of experience developing optical, laser, photonic, or electro-optical systems
* Experience with optical alignment, characterization, troubleshooting, and integration

* Experience with fiber-optic and free-space optical systems
* Experience transitioning experimental prototypes into mature engineering systems or products

The candidate will serve as a key contributor to payload system development, system-level trade studies, technical assessments, supplier evaluations, and payload integration activities.

jobs.description:

Ursa Major was founded to revolutionize how America and its allies access and apply high-performance propulsion, from hypersonics to solid rocket motors, satellite maneuvering and launch. We design and deliver propulsion and defense systems that solve the most urgent and critical national security demands.

Ursa Major is seeking a **Staff Systems Engineer** within the SMS Systems Engineering Team to creatively drive safety, reliability, and risk management solutions for our propulsion systems. This role is responsible for the safe design and operation of our rocket motors to ensure they meet the highest standards of performance and safety. You will work cross-functionally with systems engineering, mission operations, design, test, manufacturing, and program teams to develop robust product safety strategies and ensure successful mission execution. You will also own the relationship between Ursa Major and DoD Safety Review Boards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and implement mission assurance processes to ensure product reliability, safety, and performance

* Own the Ursa Major relationship with branch specific Weapon Safety Boards and assist with authoring & presenting motor qualification plans & test reports for WSESRB, JSWRB, etc. approval

* Own technical inputs to Interim Hazard Classification (IHC) & Final Hazard Classification (FHC) planning, execution and approval for motor shipments and fielding

* Establish and maintain best practices for risk register management across different programs and products; present both internally and externally as required

* Work with design and product teams to find creative and efficient solutions to engineering challenges that ultimately reduce product risk; develop system safety requirements for product design

* Perform system-level failure assessments (Failure Modes & Effects Analysis (FMEA), Fault Hazard Analysis (FHA), etc.) to inform system design and risk tracking

* Establish plans for end-to-end product lifecycle, including but not limited to any required handling restrictions, demilitarization, and disposal

* Assist with flight test range safe execution planning

* Lead failure investigations

* Perform reliability assessments for motor products

* Other duties as assigned

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering or a related field

* 8+ years of experience in system safety, mission assurance, or systems engineering

* Experience with solid rocket motors, ignition systems, propulsion systems, launch vehicles, or defense aerospace programs

* Experience with risk analysis methods (FMEA, FHA, probabilistic risk assessment)

* Experience with aerospace industry standards (MIL-STD-882, etc.)

* Experience working with cross-functional teams, interfacing with internal/external customers

* Engineer scalable deployments supporting hybrid, virtual, and physical infrastructures.

4. Documentation & Reporting

5. Collaboration & Leadership

* Coordinate with Network, Cybersecurity, Systems, and Application teams.

* Serve as the technical liaison between contractor teams and government leadership.

6. Troubleshooting and Support

Join us. The world can’t wait.

**Clearance:**

**Job Description**

We have an exciting opportunity for a **Robotics Software Engineer** at UL Research Institutes , based in our Skokie, IL office.

  

The **Robotics Software Engineer** will design and maintain the software infrastructure that connects laboratory automation, robotics, scientific instruments, data systems, and decision tools into integrated autonomous workflows. The role will work closely with scientists, automation engineers, robotics engineers, and data scientists to build scalable, reliable software for experimental orchestration and closed-loop research.

  

**UL Research Institutes:**

At UL Research Institutes (ULRI) , we expand the boundaries of safety science to create a more secure and sustainable world. For more than a century, we have studied the unintended consequences of innovation, designed solutions to mitigate risk and shared our findings with academia, scientists, manufacturers, and policymakers across industries. We identify critical safety and sustainability issues, asking the tough questions because we believe a safer world begins with knowledge.

  

Build a safer, more secure, and sustainable future with us. Join us and work with our Materials Discovery Research Institute teams who conduct the research required to produce that knowledge and put into practice.

  

**Materials Discovery Research Institute:**

The Materials Discovery Research Institute (MDRI) works to develop and deploy new materials with the potential to address current global safety challenges. Pursuing materials that will help produce transformational safety breakthroughs, MDRI harnesses the power of advanced computing and high-throughput experimental methods to create innovative materials that will produce resilience for a sustainable future and protect individual and societal health.

  

We focus on today’s critical challenges, working to create new and better materials that will support renewable energy and environmental sustainability. Among our top priorities is research into materials capable of carbon capture and energy storage, with an eye toward reducing the adverse impacts of humanity’s reliance upon fossil fuel resources and enabling a transition to renewable energy sources.

* **Total Rewards** : All employees at UL Research Institutes are eligible for bonus compensation. Moreover, we invest an additional 4% into your retirement saving fund after your first year of continuous employment. Depending on your role, you may be able to discuss flexible working arrangements with your manager. We also provide employees with paid time off, including vacation, holiday, sick, and volunteer days.

  

**What makes you a great fit:**

**While no one candidate will embody every quality, the successful candidate will bring many of the following professional competencies and personal attributes:**

* Experience with an additional programming language or development framework such as C#, .NET, Java, Go,

S&C has more than a 100-year history of innovation and has been 100% employee-owned since 2012. We continue this legacy as a trusted, forward-thinking leader in the electrical industry. You will advance a safer, more reliable, and more resilient electrical grid. Our products help the grid adapt to severe weather and transition to clean energy. We’re big enough to be a respected industry leader but small enough for you to impact our company directly. Our commitment gives you opportunities to impact on and off the job positively.

Join S&C to make an impact on tomorrow’s energy challenges and become an employee-owner!

**Hours**

* **8:00 am – 5:00 pm (Mon-Fri) Onsite**

**Compensation**

At S&C, we are dedicated to providing competitive and equitable compensation for all our team members, and we are committed to transparency in our pay practices. **The estimated annual base salary range for this position is $116534 - $154413.38.** Individual pay within this salary range is determined by several compensable factors, including performance, knowledge, job-related skills and experience, and relevant education or training. This role is also eligible for S&C’s annual incentive plan (AIP), subject to eligibility criteria.

**Join Our Team as a Senior Manager-Production Operations!**

S&C Electric Company is a global leader in equipment and services for electric power systems. The Technology & Breakthrough Innovation (TBI) organization drives the development of next-generation technologies and products that address emerging challenges in the electric utility industry. The Electronics Hardware team within TBI is seeking a Staff Electronics Engineer to perform research, development, and validation of advanced electronics technologies for future power system applications.

The ideal candidate is an experienced engineer with deep expertise in power electronics combined with a passion for innovation and technology development. This individual will leverage strong analytical and hands-on engineering skills to evaluate emerging technologies, develop novel concepts, and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to mature technologies from concept through prototype validation and eventual product deployment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Identify emerging technologies, industry trends, and customer needs to develop innovative product and technology concepts.
* Conduct technical research to define system architectures, evaluate technologies, perform component selection, and lead feasibility and tradeoff studies that optimize performance, reliability, cost, and overall system value.
* Evaluate competing technical solutions and present technical recommendations to engineering leadership and other key stakeholders.
* Design, analyze, and evaluate power electronics and power conversion systems, including magnetic components, motor control and H-bridge circuits, energy storage interfaces, and industrial power applications utilizing Buck, Boost, SMPS, Flyback, SEPIC, and other isolated and non-isolated converter topologies.
* Perform circuit modeling and simulation using tools such as PSpice, LTSpice, MATLAB, Simulink, and related platforms.
* Lead root-cause investigations and implement corrective actions for technical issues identified during development or product support activities.
* Support design reviews, DFMEA, Risk Management activities and reliability assessments.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, including specifications, schematics, test plans, reports, and design review materials.
Mentor and guide engineers while fostering a culture of innovation, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.  

**What you’ll Need To Succeed:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering
* Minimum 10 years of experience in research, experimentation and designing complex electronic systems.
* Experience working within research, advanced development, or innovation-focused organizations, with a demonstrated ability to independently lead research and development activities with minimal supervision.

Space Tango is an innovative space technology company based in Lexington, Kentucky. We develop automated facilities and payloads that enable biological research and small-scale manufacturing in microgravity, advancing health and technology products that create value here on Earth.

We are hiring electrical engineers to join our EE team, which develops the electrical and embedded systems that power this work. We are looking for people who excel at hands-on development and troubleshooting and can help turn designs into reliable, working systems. You do not need equal expertise in PCB design and firmware development; your responsibilities will reflect the focus of your position.

We will consider candidates at Levels I, II, and III for these positions. Responsibilities, technical independence, and leadership expectations will reflect your experience and the level of the position.

**What You’ll Do**

Depending on your position’s focus and experience level, your work may include:

* Represent the Electrical Engineering team on multiple, interdisciplinary spaceflight projects.
* Develop/assist with technical design documentation (requirements, diagrams, experiment protocols, etc.) and execute on the project electrical systems accordingly.
* Implement and verify electrical systems through various tests along the project lifecycle. Develop associated test plans and action plans based on results.
* Adhere to functional team quality assurance practices to ensure high quality EE products.
* Serve as the primary electrical engineering representative for spaceflight projects by leading electrical integration and assisting with build, testing, checkout, and quality assurance.
* Take initiative to coordinate inter-project team communication to solve project issues as they arise and ensure success on assigned projects.
* Participate in external stakeholder and internal team communication in a professional manner.
* Identify improvements in standard project electrical systems to improve reliability, usability, and scalability.
* Lead and/or assist with IRAD projects when assigned.
* Continually review, learn, and discuss with other team members about applicable NASA safety requirements and regulations that apply to electrical engineering designs for spaceflight projects.
* Research existing industry electrical engineering platforms that could positively impact current or future company designs.
* Travel to support customer or partner projects and launches.

Requirements:

**Qualifications, Skills and Experience Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related technical discipline
* Experience appropriate to the position level. Level I candidates may demonstrate relevant skills through coursework, projects, or internships; Level II candidates should have professional experience developing and testing electronics or embedded systems; Level III candidates should have 5+ years of related engineering experience and the ability to independently lead technical work in their area of focus
* Relevant skills and hands-on experience building, integrating, testing, or troubleshooting Electronics Hardware and/or Embedded Systems, with depth appropriate to the position level
* **Electronics hardware:** Hands-on hardware integration and testing including sensor selection and interfaces, cable and connector design, electrical safety, system integration (PCBS, sensors, actuators, mechanical interfaces, firmware, etc), and general engineering troubleshooting and verification techniques
* **Firmware / Embedded systems:** C/C++ programming, assembly languages, RTOS, microcontroller architectures, device drivers (sensors, comm modules, storage, actuators, etc.), debugging tools, version control, bootloaders and firmware update mechanisms, and common buses and protocols (I2C, SPI, UART, GPIO, USB, Ethernet, etc)
* Understanding of electrical safety, design verification, and engineering quality practices
* Strong communication, multidisciplinary teamwork, and technical coordination skills

**Helpful Experience**

* Space industry experience is helpful at any level
* Master’s degree or advanced training in a related technical discipline
* High-speed, RF, or sensitive analog PCB layout; multilayer stack-up design and thermal management
* PCB fabrication and assembly, device driver development, assembly languages, real-time operating systems, bootloaders, and firmware update mechanisms
* Spaceflight payload development from concept through integration, testing, and mission support

BAE Systems is seeking an Electrical Engineer with 3 to 6 years of experience to support the design, integration, qualification, production, and sustainment of the AN/SPN-50(V)1 Shipboard Air Traffic Radar (SATR) system. The selected engineer will apply practical electrical engineering experience across RF and radar performance assessment, digital signal processing, target identification parameters, electrical power interfaces, thermal and environmental stability, built-in test, diagnostics, reliability metrics, and system-level verification. Baltimore, MD, US
