Overview:

**Verathon®** is looking for an Electrical Engineer III to become the newest member of our Urology R&D team located in Bothell, WA. This role is expected to work primarily on-site at our Bothell facility and will design and develop electronic systems and components including camera, lighting, and circuit board systems, for an exciting new program targeted at improving patient outcomes in a urological endoscopy procedure - offering the opportunity to shape our newest urology product within Verathon's established new product development (NPD) framework.

The Electrical Engineer III is responsible for the electronic design, analysis, and development of complex medical device systems. * Serve as a core technical contributor on major development projects or multiple simultaneous projects, working independently with review at critical points
* Ensure that engineering design activities follow the development procedure and maintain strict design control
* Develop electronic systems and documentation in compliance with applicable medical device standards, regulatory requirements, and Verathon design control procedures.
* Interact with internal and external stakeholders, component vendors, and contract manufacturers to design for manufacturability, reliability, and cost-effectiveness
* Adapt communication style to differing technical and non-technical audiences
* Design robust analog and digital multilayer PCBs and flex circuits.
* Investigate design approaches, evaluate tradeoffs, and develop solutions to complex technical problems through analysis, prototyping, and bench testing..

* Integrate and interface specific subsystem technologies including camera and imaging sensors, other sensor interfaces, LED lighting drive circuits, power conversion, microprocessors, data storage, and high-speed interfaces into complex multilayer rigid, flex, and hybrid PCB designs

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Training/Inference (C++)
jobs.description:

Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to understand the universe and help expand humanity's knowledge and capabilities. We work across the full Super Intelligence stack: compute (Colossus supercomputers), models (Grok), and applications (Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X). We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

* We are building the high-performance inference platform that serves Grok to millions of users every day with lightning speed and perfect reliability.
* As a Member of Technical Staff - Inference, you will design and optimize large-scale model serving systems end-to-end. You will own everything from distributed infrastructure (global KV cache, continuous batching, load balancing, auto-scaling) to deep low-level optimizations (GPU kernels, quantization, speculative decoding, tail latency).
* This is a high-impact role where your work directly determines how fast and reliably users interact with Grok at massive scale

**Responsibilities:**

* Architect and implement scalable distributed infrastructure for model serving (load balancing, auto-scaling, batch scheduling, global KV cache).
* Optimize latency and throughput of model inference under real production workloads.
* Build reliable, high-concurrency serving systems that serve billions of users with 100% uptime, 0% error rate, and excellent tail latency.
* Benchmark, fine-tune, and accelerate inference engines (including low-level GPU kernel work and code generation).
* Develop custom tools to trace, replay, and fix issues across the full stack — from orchestration down to GPU kernels.
* Create robust CI/CD infrastructure for seamless endpoint deployment, image publishing, and inference engine updates.
* Accelerate research on scaling test-time compute, RL rollout, and model-hardware co-design for next-generation systems.

### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Deep low-level systems programming (C/C++ or Rust)
* Experience with large-scale, high-concurrent production serving.
* Experience with GPU inference engines (vLLM, SGLang, Triton, TensorRT-LLM, etc.).
* Strong background in system optimizations: batching, caching, load balancing, parallelism.
* Low-level inference optimizations: GPU kernels, code generation.
* Algorithmic inference optimizations: quantization, speculative decoding, distillation, low-precision numerics.
* Experience with testing, benchmarking, and reliability of inference services.
* Experience designing and implementing CI/CD infrastructure for inference.

### **COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:**

$180,000 - $440,000 USD

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

We're looking for a hands-on Senior Engineer to play a key role in building Rippling's Security program. Rippling's product’s scope provides a unique set of security challenges, but our management is especially supportive of security and compliance as a central function of the business. As an early member of Rippling's security team, you'll have a meaningful impact on the security program’s priorities and direction.

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you’ll design and build the services, APIs, and platform primitives that power complex workflows across Rippling’s multi-product platform. You’ll work on systems involving permissions, policy enforcement, approvals, payments, device and app management, procurement, asset tracking, auditability, and secure handling of sensitive workforce and financial data.

This role also supports Rippling’s expansion of AI-powered workflows across HR, IT, Finance, Spend, and core platform experiences. You’ll help make AI capabilities safe, reliable, explainable, auditable, and enterprise-ready, while ensuring customers have the trust, transparency, and control needed to adopt automation at scale.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Own the design and implementation of backend services and APIs that power critical product capabilities.
* Build reliable, secure, and scalable systems for high-volume workflows across Spend, IT, identity, access, approvals, and compliance.
* Make strategic technical decisions around architecture, infrastructure, data modeling, performance, and operational reliability.
* Translate ambiguous business and customer needs into robust technical solutions in partnership with product, frontend, platform, design, and cross-functional teams.
* Build and evolve systems involving workflows, permissions, policy enforcement, financial operations, device and app management, procurement, and security controls.
* Raise the technical bar through system design, code reviews, design reviews, mentorship, and backend engineering best practices.
* Help create unified product experiences that replace fragmented point solutions for managing employees, spend, devices, apps, access, and business operations.

**What you will need**

* 5+ years of experience in a production environment using Python, Go, or a similar high-scale backend language.
* Deep expertise in distributed systems architecture, data modeling, and performance optimization of relational databases.
* You have seen and contributed to systems operating at a significant technical and organizational scale.
* Strong understanding of CS/algorithms fundamentals and experience with complex project delivery.
* Exceptional communication skills with technical and cross-functional stakeholders.

--------------------------

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. jobs.title: Manager, Systems Engineering
jobs.description:
The Kestra team has over 400 years of experience in the external and internal cardiac medical device markets. The company was founded in 2014 by industry leaders inspired by the opportunity to unite modern wearable technologies with proven device therapies. Kestra's solutions combine high quality and technical performance with a wearable design that provides the greatest regard for patient comfort and dignity. Innovating versatile new ways to deliver care, Kestra is helping patients and their care teams harmoniously monitor, manage, and protect life.

The Systems Engineering Manager facilitates the execution of strategic product development objectives by providing both technical leadership and direct systems engineering contributions across the product development lifecycle. This role leads a small team of Systems Engineers while actively participating in system architecture, requirements development, risk management, system integration, and verification activities. The Systems Engineering Manager partners closely with cross-functional teams to translate customer, clinical, business, and regulatory requirements into robust medical device solutions while continuously improving systems engineering processes, tools, and best practices.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES**  

* Leads and develops the Systems Engineering team.
* Generates and analyzes system architectures, requirements, and risk management artifacts.
* Communicates and coordinates with cross-functional teams.
* Provides technical leadership for system integration, verification, validation, and problem resolution.
* Advises teams on systems engineering tools, methods, and standards.
* Monitors work to ensure technical quality, effective execution, and schedule adherence.

**COMPETENCIES**  

* Passion: Contagious excitement about the company – sense of urgency. Commitment to continuous improvement.
* Integrity: Commitment, accountability, and dedication to the highest ethical standards.
* Collaboration/Teamwork: Inclusion of Team Member regardless of geography, position, and product or service.
* Action/Results: High energy, decisive planning, timely execution.
* Innovation: Generation of new ideas from original thinking.
* Customer Focus: Exceed customer expectations, quality of products, services, and experience always present of mind.
* Emotional Intelligence: Recognizes, understands, manages one's own emotions and is able to influence others. A critical skill for pressure situations.

  
**QUALIFICATIONS**  
**Education/Experience Required:**  

* Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related discipline with a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional engineering teams.
* Direct experience with requirements development, traceability management, risk management, system architecture, and verification activities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred:**  

* Previous people management experience.
* Direct experience developing regulated medical devices.
* Strong knowledge of ISO 14971, IEC 60601 series, IEC 62304, IEC 62366, and FDA design control requirements.
* Experience with requirements management and traceability tools such as IBM DOORS.
* Experience supporting FDA, EU MDR, and international regulatory submissions.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**  

* Directly supervise Systems Engineering team members including conducting performance reviews, providing performance feedback, establishing development goals, allocating resources, and supporting career growth.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**  

* Indoor open office environment
* Minimal noise volume typical to an office environment
* Extended hours when needed
* Kestra manufactures and provides life-saving products regulated by the Federal Food and Drug Administration and under contract with Medicare. Kestra maintains a drug free workplace and testing is a condition of employment post-offer.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**  

* Frequent repetitive motions that may include wrists, hands and/or fingers, such as keyboard and mouse usage
* Frequent stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods of time
* Frequent computer use
* Frequent phone and other business machine use
* Occasional lifting required, typically between 2-15 pounds

**TRAVEL**  

* Occasional travel may be required, 10%

  
**OTHER DUTIES:**  
This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the Team Member. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

Kestra Medical Technologies, Inc does not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other reason prohibited by law in provision of employment opportunities and benefits.

jobs.description:
Division

Battery & Charger Development

Primary Work Location

Brookfield, WI

Job type

Regular

Time type

Full time

Job Post From

2026-10-12

### **Job Details**

##### **Job Description**

**Job Description:**

***Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S.; sponsorship is not available for this position at this time.***

  
  

**INNOVATE WITHOUT BOUNDARIES!** At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success – so we give you unlimited access to everything you need to create disruptive new technologies and solutions on our electrical engineering teams. Our Engineering Team is responsible for giving life to the batteries, motors, and electronics that power solutions changing the lives of our users. Every developmental phase of these critical components happens in-house under the watch of this team. We continue to invest in electrical engineering resources to design and develop leadership in electronic capabilities; something unique within the industry. And we’re pushing the limits in firmware engineering, power electronics, embedded systems, machine learning, and the use of artificial intelligence.

  
  

Behind our doors you’ll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to design and develop the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you’ll have the support and resources of the fastest-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen.

  
  

Year after year, our team continues to make significant breakthroughs in the industry. We’re just getting started. To learn more about our story click HERE.

  
  

The Sr. Electronics Engineering Technician will support new product design teams through test development, data analysis and competitor benchmarking. You will independently plan and create test fixtures, configure products for testing, log the measurements for data collection/ graphing, and troubleshoot, repair, and modify circuit board assemblies focusing on the chargers and live batteries. You will assist in the maintenance of lab equipment and operating procedures, as well as being a resource for entry-level technicians.

  
  

**You’ll also be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:**

* Test chargers and batteries in methods that are consistent with best practices for lithium-ion charging systems.

* Performing hands on mechanical testing of batteries and tools.

* Collect data through various equipment and software programs.

* Perform tests per work instructions and other procedures.

* Prepare reports of test results and make recommendations as needed.

* Provide updates to Engineers on projects.

* Create and edit documents using the Microsoft software suite.

Manage lab space

* - tools/parts/work surfaces/consumable materials.

* Move between lab spaces to execute and monitor testing.
  

  

**What TOOLS you’ll bring with you:**

* Associate's degree in engineering technology or High School diploma accompanied by 4+ years of experience.

* 3+ years of experience with mechanical/electrical principles, test equipment, product life/performance test procedures and methods.

* Knowledge of test concepts in the design and development of products and components.

* Capability to lift and manipulate 50lbs.

* Ability to travel between lab locations on foot or by vehicle if needed.

* Interest and ability to use power tools to simulate consumer usage.

* Ability to reach out to cross functional groups for reference or troubleshooting.

* Strong mechanical mindset and aptitude. Some experience with using hand and shop tools is expected

* Effectively manages multiple tasks to achieve desired outcomes and deliver to deadlines.
  

  

**Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:**

* Experience with Lithium-Ion battery charging system methods and test environments.

* Experience in using data acquisition equipment such as Agilent data buckets.

* Experience in viewing schematics and PCB layout files in an environment such as Altium.

* Operate various lab equipment such as power supplies, oscilloscopes, and e-loads.

* Ability to reach out to cross functional groups for reference or troubleshooting.
  

  

**We provide these great perks and benefits:**

* Robust health, dental, and vision insurance plans.
* Generous 401(k) savings plan.
* Education assistance.
* On-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service.
* And many more, check out our benefits site HERE.
  

  

**Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.**

*Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.*

##### **About Us**

Milwaukee Tool, founded in 1924, is a global leader in delivering innovative solutions to the professional construction trades that increase productivity and safety. Milwaukee® is known for their world-leading M12™, M18™, and MX FUEL™ cordless systems, the ground-breaking performance of their cordless innovations, safety solutions, battery-powered outdoor power equipment, jobsite lighting and clean-up, time-saving accessories, and innovative hand tool and PACKOUT™ Modular Storage Products. The company is dedicated to delivering a steady stream of advanced, trade-specific solutions.
  
  
Milwaukee Tool is a Brookfield, Wisconsin-based subsidiary of Techtronic Industries Co. Ltd. (TTI) (HKEx stock code: 669, ADR symbol: TTNDY). For more information on the full line of Milwaukee® products, please call 1-800-SAWDUST or visit Milwaukee Tool.

jobs.description:
**About Pierce, an Oshkosh company**

**At Pierce Manufacturing, we build trucks that protect people and communities around the world. To our team, there is no room for anything less than providing the absolute best. Since 1913, building truck bodies on Model T Ford chassis in an old converted church has evolved to creating highly customized, carefully designed and engineering pumpers, aerials, tankers and rescue units that have no equal. Today, you'll find more than** **30,000 Pierce apparatuses** **on the road that are making a difference in people's lives, every day. To us, every step in the process of building our trucks is personal. From innovation and expertise, to the customization and service. Our trucks are designed to perform under the toughest conditions.**

Ready to shape the future of Connected Vehicle IoT solutions for mission critical equipment that help our everyday heroes? If you are passionate about building a better world through innovative technology, thrive on technical challenges, and are excited to build next generation connected vehicle embedded solution, we invite you to join us as an Sr. Principal Embedded Software Engineer. As a technical leader and hands-on engineer, you will design and develop embedded software for connected Fire, Refuse Collection, and Concrete Mixer vehicles.

This is a fully onsite role in Greenville, WI. As the Sr. Principal Embedded Software Engineer you must be able and willing to perform hands-on testing, troubleshooting, and validation on large vocational vehicles. Remote and hybrid arrangements are not available for this position.

**YOUR IMPACT**

* Design and Develop - Design & develop embedded software for connected vehicle solutions including telematics, edge computing, remote diagnostics, over-the-air capabilities, vehicle network integration, and video recording/streaming capabilities.
* Technical Leadership - Serve as technical leader, balancing hands-on development with providing technical direction to ensure solutions are scalable, reliable, secure, maintainable, and cost-effective.
* Engineering Excellence - Establish architecture standards and best practices for high-quality, production-grade software while driving technical rigor through mentorship and technical leadership.
* Execution Excellence & Delivery - Drive team accountability, Agile execution, and delivery predictability by improving backlog readiness, removing technical roadblocks, and helping the team consistently meet sprint and release commitments.
* Vehicle Validation – Hands on validation on trucks. This role requires working inside trucks to ensure software performs reliably in real world operating conditions.
* Cross functional Collaboration - Collaborate with embedded, cloud, and front-end engineers and product owner, resolve cross functional challenges and ensure successful end to end solution delivery.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATION**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of experience developing embedded software using C and C++. Standout: Rust.
* Experience developing and testing embedded software on Embedded Linux platforms
* Experience with networking concepts and protocols including TCP/IP and UDP
* Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and embedded software development best practices.
* Strong technical leadership and collaboration skills, with experience leading technical projects while remaining hands-on in software development.
* Experience developing connected mobile asset (e.g., vehicle or mobile equipment) or telematics platforms, including cloud-connected architectures, over-the-air (OTA) updates, cellular-connected devices, and remote fleet management solutions.
* Ability and willingness to perform hands on testing on vehicles, including working inside vehicle cabs and conducting testing in manufacturing and field environments. Occasional travel to customer sites may be required.

**STANDOUT QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with automotive or heavy-duty vehicle networks, including CAN, J1939, and related protocols.
* Experience developing portable software solutions across multiple embedded hardware platforms, including cross-compilation, platform abstraction, and migration of applications to new processor architectures or operating system environments.
* Experience porting embedded applications to new hardware platforms, including board bring-up, BSP integration, hardware/software debugging, and platform validation.
* Experience with multimedia frameworks (e.g., FFmpeg, GStreamer) and video recording, streaming, and media processing technologies, including RTP, RTSP, WebRTC, or similar protocols.
* Strong sense of initiative, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, influence without authority, and solve complex technical problems.

jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
Wegner CPAs is excited to partner with our client in Verona, WI on their search for a Controls Engineer to join their team!

LOCAL CANDIDATES ONLY, PLEASE

**About the Opportunity**

Our client is a growing automation and robotics company that designs and builds custom machinery and robotic integration solutions for manufacturers across North America. With ambitious growth goals and a commitment to delivering high-quality, innovative solutions, the company is looking for talented individuals who take pride in their work and want to make a meaningful impact. This is an opportunity to join a hands-on, collaborative team where your ideas matter, your work makes a tangible difference, and you can grow alongside the business.

**What You'll Do**

* Develop, review, and test PLC programs that control automated manufacturing systems and robotic cells.
* Collaborate closely with mechanical, electrical, manufacturing, and assembly teams to ensure seamless integration of hardware and software.
* Troubleshoot technical challenges, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.
* Participate in machine testing, debugging, and commissioning to ensure systems perform as intended.
* Take ownership of your work from initial programming through final implementation, seeing projects through to successful completion.

If you enjoy watching your designs come to life and seeing the results of your work on the production floor, this role offers the opportunity to do just that.

**What We're Looking For**

* 5+ years of PLC programming experience using ladder logic and/or structured text.
* Experience with Siemens or Allen-Bradley PLC platforms.
* Background in manufacturing automation, robotics, custom machinery, or machine building.
* Ability to define technical requirements, develop solutions, and validate system performance through testing.
* Comfort working in a hands-on manufacturing or shop environment.
* Strong troubleshooting skills, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
* A sense of ownership and pride in developing reliable systems that perform in real-world production environments.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with SCADA systems.
* Familiarity with common electromechanical systems and components.
* Hands-on experience with machine testing, debugging, and commissioning.

**You'll thrive in this role if you:**

* Bring energy, initiative, and follow-through to your work.
* Enjoy learning new technologies and taking on increasing responsibility.
* Prefer a collaborative, team-oriented environment where everyone contributes.
* Take ownership of challenges rather than passing them along.
* Care about the quality, reliability, and real-world performance of the systems you develop.

**Interested in building the technology that drives modern manufacturing?** This is an opportunity to put your PLC programming expertise to work on custom automation and robotics projects while growing your skills and making a lasting impact.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer IV
jobs.description:
**About Company:**

Steele Solutions Inc. is the nation’s leading designer and manufacturer of platforms and mezzanines used to support equipment in distribution, fulfillment, and sortation centers throughout the United States. We also design and build structures to support and access equipment in numerous other industries, with installations in every state and throughout the world!

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Electrical Engineer IV is a senior technical expert responsible for leading the design, execution, and continuous improvement of complex electrical systems for industrial automation and material handling projects. This role provides technical leadership across the electrical engineering discipline, ensuring system reliability, scalability, regulatory compliance, and cost efficiency.

Working with a high degree of autonomy, the Electrical Engineer IV establishes engineering standards, mentors team members, collaborates across departments, and contributes to the organization’s long-term technical strategy and innovation.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------

*The following duties and responsibilities are not all-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties and responsibilities as management deems necessary.*

### **System Architecture and Standardization**

* Develop scalable electrical design solutions for complex, multi-system environments.
* Establish and maintain standardized engineering documentation, electrical component libraries, and compliance frameworks.
* Lead system-level design reviews to ensure adherence to engineering standards, minimize risk, and promote design consistency.

### **Technical Leadership and Execution**

* Lead the design of complex electrical systems, including motor control centers (MCCs), variable frequency drives (VFDs), servo systems, and integrated safety circuits.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary design efforts across electrical, controls, mechanical, and project engineering teams.
* Provide advanced field support and resolve escalated technical issues to ensure successful project execution.
* Oversee the preparation, accuracy, and completion of final as-built documentation and certification packages.

### **Team Development and Mentorship**

* Serve as a technical mentor to electrical engineers at all experience levels.
* Provide formal and informal training to strengthen technical capabilities, knowledge sharing, and team performance.
* Support technical recruiting, onboarding, and professional development initiatives.

### **Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Lead cross-functional design alignment for customer programs and standardized product solutions.
* Partner with Project Management on project estimates, resource forecasting, scheduling, and risk mitigation.
* Represent the electrical engineering discipline during executive-level technical reviews, customer meetings, and external stakeholder discussions.

### **Strategic Growth and Innovation**

* Evaluate and implement emerging electrical technologies, including DC power systems and energy-efficient hardware.
* Lead initiatives to improve design automation, engineering efficiency, and bill of materials (BOM) standardization.
* Contribute to long-term departmental planning, technical strategy, and the development of internal engineering capabilities.

**Qualifications**
------------------

*To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The qualifications listed below represent the knowledge, skills, and abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

### **Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering or a related field.
* Eight or more years of progressive electrical engineering experience, including technical leadership on complex industrial automation projects.

### **Technical Skills and Competencies**

* Expert-level proficiency in AutoCAD Electrical, EPLAN, or equivalent electrical design software; AutoCAD Electrical preferred.
* Advanced knowledge of electrical safety, industrial power systems, and system integration.
* Demonstrated ability to provide technical direction to multiple engineers while managing complex projects and competing deadlines.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with experience leading customer-facing design reviews and external technical discussions.
* Proven ability to evaluate technical risks, solve complex engineering problems, and drive continuous improvement.

### **Travel Requirements**

Travel of up to 35% may be required to support onsite project execution, customer needs, and technical leadership activities.

**Language Skills**
-------------------

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical specifications, professional journals, blueprints, and other technical documents. Ability to prepare clear technical reports, engineering documentation, and written communications. Must communicate effectively with vendors, customers, colleagues, and other stakeholders.

ECI is highly motivated to attract electrical engineers that have significant experience performing EHV technical design studies. We are looking for hands-on study engineers that can utilize any software to perform the analysis and write detailed reports. The ideal candidate should have deep knowledge and experience in most of the following studies at the EHV level:

* Shunt Reactive Compensation and Voltage Control
* Coupled Line Resonance Studies (stuck pole on breakers drives NGR size on switched/fixed line connected shunt reactors to prevent resonance)
* Single Pole Automatic Reclosing (NGR sizing, reclose dead time determination, check stability margins, etc)
* Series Capacitor Analysis (develop cap size, MOV sizing, etc.)
* Line Switching Overvoltage Studies (with/without breaker PIRs and point on wave controllers, etc)
* Line Insulation Coordination Studies (includes assessing line clearances and make recommendations for PIRs, sub/line arresters, changes to clearances)
* Breaker TRV/RRRV Studies
* Line or Sub MAD calculations
* Coupling to Adjacent Circuits in ROW
* Voltage/Current Unbalance/Transposition Studies
* Transformer Energization
* TOV studies in HV/EHV systems
* EHV Capacitor Switching (analysis and TLI/PIR sizing)
* Technoeconomic Conductor Selection Studies
* EHV Power Cable Studies (EMT studies of riser design including grounding, cross-bonding, SVL sizing/placement, protection of cables)

The engineer will join a team of experienced engineers and perform detailed EMT analysis for the study work as well as provide guidance to younger staff who this individual will train. Extensive experience with PSCAD is required and knowledge of common loadflow tools, MathCad, Excel is a must.

Depending on experience, applicants may be qualified for a hybrid or remote work arrangement. Relocation to Madison, WI or Chesapeake, VA to work with the team is preferred.

jobs.title: Associate Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**Associate Automation Engineer**
=================================

**Job Description**
-------------------

An Associate Automation Engineer is an entry-level engineering professional responsible for supporting the development, design, and implementation of industrial control systems for building automation projects. This role combines control system design, HMI/SCADA development, PLC/DDC programming, and field commissioning to ensure the successful delivery of projects under the guidance of senior engineers. An Associate Automation Engineer focuses on learning company standards, control system architecture, and software integration while contributing to project execution and system optimization.

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree (preferred) or Associate degree in any of the following fields: Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Trade school certificates or equivalent technical training combined with relevant experience may also be considered.

**Experience**
--------------

* 0–3+ years of experience in industrial automation, instrumentation and controls, PLC/DDC programming, or a related industrial engineering field.
* Familiarity with PLC/DDC and HMI configuration, industrial networking, and/or HVAC systems is preferred.
* Familiarity with construction site environments and field devices (instrumentation, valves, drives) is preferred.

**Skills**
----------

**Technical Skills:**

* Systems Knowledge: Basic understanding of HVAC and building automation systems (BAS).
* Control System Design: Ability to read electrical schematics, P&IDs, control system documentation, and network architecture drawings.
* HMI/SCADA: Basic experience with HMI and SCADA platforms (e.g., Rockwell, Ignition, Wonderware) and the ability to instantiate standard graphics, alarms, and trends.
* PLC/DDC: Basic understanding of PLC platforms (e.g. Allen-Bradley, Siemens) and at least one industrial automation programming language, such as Ladder Logic.
* Networking & Infrastructure: Basic understanding of industrial protocols (Modbus, BACnet, Ethernet/IP) and OT network design.
* Testing: Familiarity with troubleshooting techniques and tools such as simulators and multimeters for software testing and point-to-point device verification.

**Soft Skills:**

* Learning Mindset: A strong eagerness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving engineering standards.
* Problem-Solving: A solution-oriented mindset with the ability to perform strategic debugging and know when to escalate issues.
* Attention to Detail: High commitment to accuracy in technical drawings, naming conventions, and project documentation.
* Communication: Ability to provide concise status updates and define technical challenges to project leads and team members.
* Leadership: Ability to collaborate effectively within multi-disciplinary teams.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Control System Design: Perform product selection for common automation systems and applications and support generation of accurate control system drawings.
* HMI/SCADA Configuration: Instantiate graphics and configure HMI/SCADA screens in alignment with company standards.
* PLC/DDC Programming: Support basic PLC and DDC programming tasks such as tag configuration and control logic using standard templates, reusable code libraries, or custom code.
* Testing and Commissioning: Assist with testing, device verification, and troubleshooting during bench testing, Factory Acceptance Testing, and site startup activities. Travel may be required. Expect up to 30% travel, including regular overnight stays for non-local client sites and up to 100% travel to local client sites.
* Documentation: Maintain accurate project documentation, including IO lists, Sequence of Operations, Functional Specifications, test protocols, and redline markups.
* Safety & Compliance: Follow all office and site safety procedures and participate in mandatory safety training (e.g., OSHA-10).
* Quality Control: Ensure all document and code deliverables meet established quality standards for right-first-time accuracy and on-time delivery.

jobs.title: Principal Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**ABOUT ROCKET LAB**

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

**SPACE SYSTEMS**

Rocket Lab's Space Systems division builds complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space including solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, and radios.

The Space Systems division has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. We have built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it's a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help get to space — our Space Systems division is empowering the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

**PRINCIPAL SYSTEMS ENGINEER**

Rocket Lab Optical Systems solves mission-critical space domain and Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance challenges for Department of Defense and Intelligence Community customers. Our vision is to revolutionize the space-based payload market with innovative and novel designs for space, terrestrial, and airborne environments. Building on more than 20 years of electro-optical and infrared systems innovation from Geost, Rocket Lab Optical Systems delivers solutions to the warfighter for responsive, scalable sensing solutions across all orbital domains.

As a Principal Systems Engineer for Rocket Lab Optical Systems in Tucson, AZ, you will be involved throughout the entire lifecycle of advanced space payloads in support of Tranche 3 of the U.S. Space Development Agency's Proliferated Warfighter Space Architecture.

**WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:**

* Support the development of system architecture for space-based optical instruments, subsystems, and payloads on airborne and space platforms, with emphasis on electrical architecture and controls integration
* Define, decompose, and manage system requirements with focus on electrical behavior, control functions, subsystem interactions, and overall system performance
* Develop and maintain technical documentation including architecture descriptions, interface control documents, electrical interface definitions, concepts of operations, state and mode descriptions, test plans, and verification artifacts
* Support development of electrical and functional architectures, including command and telemetry flow, power distribution, control logic, signal paths, timing, synchronization, and subsystem interaction
* Collaborate with hardware, software, firmware, and test teams to ensure the electrical architecture and controls implementation align with system requirements and mission intent
* Support the development, integration, and testing of space payloads to be integrated on spacecraft platforms
* Support hardware and software development teams with system-level test planning, debugging, integration, and execution of verification procedures; analyze data and recommend design refinements
* Participate in hardware and software verification and validation activities related to system behavior, electrical performance, controls implementation, and interface compliance
* Support architecture trades involving sensors, motor control, embedded electronics, power systems, command and data handling, and subsystem interfaces
* Participate in technical interchange meetings and project discussions with internal teams, customers, and external partners as needed
* Identify, assess, and help mitigate technical risks related to electrical architecture, controls implementation, and subsystem integration
* Support travel or off-site work as needed
* Perform other duties as assigned

**QUALIFICATIONS YOU'LL BRING AS PRINCIPAL SYSTEMS ENGINEER:**

* Bachelor's degree in electrical, systems, or aerospace engineering; or other technical discipline
* 12+ years of engineering experience, including 3+ years supporting development programs and 2+ years in technical leadership, CAM, IPTL, or equivalent role
* Demonstrated systems engineering experience with emphasis on electrical architecture, subsystem integration, and controls focused development
* Strong electrical engineering background supporting complex aerospace, payload, avionics, or instrument systems
* Experience developing system requirements, interface definitions, and verification approaches for complex systems
* Strong background in electrical interfaces, control functions, avionics integration, or subsystem architecture
* Experience with requirements management and modeling tools such as JAMA, DOORS, Cameo, or similar tools
* Experience working across hardware, software, and firmware development throughout the lifecycle
* Familiarity with command and telemetry interfaces, power architectures, signal interfaces, timing, synchronization, and control logic
* Experience supporting integration and test, including troubleshooting electrical or controls-related issues at the subsystem or system level
* Strong ability to read, interpret, and develop electrical, interface, and system technical documentation
* Familiarity with aerospace development standards, environmental testing, and mission assurance practices

**THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:**

* Current SSBI clearance
* EO/IR payload integration experience
* Experience with spacecraft bus interfaces, payload electrical integration, avionics architecture, or embedded electronics
* Experience with pointing, stabilization, gimbals, motion control, focus/control electronics, or other closed-loop control applications
* Experience defining or troubleshooting elec

jobs.title: Embedded Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**Embedded Systems Engineer**  
Bright Silicon Technologies | Pleasanton, CA | Full time

**About the Role**
==================

Bright Silicon Technologies (BST) is developing precision optical systems around our Lightfield Directing Array (LDA), a solid-state beam-steering technology. Our projects include OCTANE, a free-space laser communications terminal that brings together optics, electronics, and controls to connect moving platforms. Reliable embedded software makes that hardware work as a system.  
  
We’re looking for an Embedded Systems Engineer to develop the low-level and system software that connects these components together. This is a broad, hands-on engineering role spanning firmware, embedded Linux, device interfaces, hardware bring-up, system integration, and test. Because we are a small engineering team, the work can vary from writing real-time firmware and device drivers to performing hardware bring-up and characterization in the lab. You’ll work closely with electrical, controls, communications, photonics, and software engineers to move systems from early prototypes to dependable integrated hardware. We’re looking for someone who is comfortable working across these boundaries, learning unfamiliar technologies when needed, and taking ownership of problems that do not always fit neatly within one engineering discipline.

**What you’ll do**
==================

* Develop and debug C and C++ firmware and embedded software for device control, data acquisition, and communications. Carry your work from hardware bring-up through integration and validation.
* Work with electrical engineers to bring up new hardware and diagnose problems across electronics, firmware, and software. Use measurements and targeted experiments to understand timing, performance, and reliability.
* Use oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, debuggers, protocol analyzers, and other laboratory instrumentation to measure system behavior and investigate timing, signal, performance, and reliability problems.
* Partner with controls, integration, communications, and photonics engineers to deploy algorithms and connect subsystems on target hardware. Provide dependable device access, timing, telemetry, and diagnostic interfaces.
* Lead design and code reviews, share knowledge, and support other engineers through implementation and debugging. Document decisions so the team can build on each other’s work.
* Strengthen automated builds, hardware testing, and release practices. Make software configurations reproducible and failures easier to diagnose as systems move from the lab toward deployment.

**What we’re looking for**
==========================

* Strong C and C++ development skills and experience delivering embedded software on physical hardware. You’ve taken responsibility for a subsystem through bring-up, integration, and validation.
* Experience with bare-metal firmware, an RTOS, or embedded Linux. You understand how concurrency, interrupts, memory, and execution timing affect system behavior and can investigate performance problems.
* Hands-on hardware and software debugging experience. You can read schematics, work with device documentation, and use debuggers, oscilloscopes, or logic analyzers to trace a problem to its cause.
* Experience implementing device interfaces and communications, such as SPI, I2C, UART, or Ethernet. You can reason about latency, throughput, synchronization, and failure handling across connected components.
* A degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* U.S. citizenship - Position works on government projects requiring US Citizenship.

**Nice to have**
================

* Experience working with processor–FPGA systems or developing software interfaces to FPGA-based hardware.
* Familiarity with FPGA RTL development for timing, control, data acquisition, or digital interfaces.
* Experience with precision instruments, robotics, lidar, optical systems, or communications hardware.
* Familiar with Python or other scripting languages for test automation and lab tools; familiarity with MATLAB-based algorithm development and the work needed to deploy algorithms on embedded targets.
* Hardware-in-the-loop testing, field diagnostics, or maintaining shared embedded components across multiple products.
* Experience leading engineers deliver coordinated technical work through planning, interface definition, reviews, or mentoring.

Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At BST we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

**Why BST**
===========

* Help shape the embedded software behind a new optical technology, with work spanning hardware bring-up, system integration, and deployment.
* Lead through hands-on engineering and collaboration with experienced colleagues in software, electronics, controls, precision mechanisms, and optics.
* Take meaningful technical ownership in an engineer-led company with competitive compensation, equity, and a sustainable approach to work.

**Company Overview**
====================

At Bright, we build precision optical systems to guide data for a new era of communication. Our team combines precision engineering, optical design, and product development to commercialize the Lightfield Directing Array. Applications include laser communications, optical switching for data centers, lidar, and additive manufacturing.  
Founded in 2020, Bright Silicon Technologies is building an enduring technology manufacturing company. You’ll contribute to the development, launch, and scaling of advanced optical products.

**About the Role**
==================

Bright Silicon Technologies (BST) develops precision optical systems built around our Lightfield Directing Array (LDA), a MEMS micromirror array for fast, precise control of light. Custom electronics drive and sense the motion of these devices, supporting applications in optical communications, tracking, and light control. Characterizing and integrating these electronics is central to advancing the LDA from research into reliable products.  
We’re looking for an electrical engineer to own the specification, qualification, and integration of custom silicon for our LDA technology. You’ll develop test boards, instrumentation, and automated test systems to characterize mixed-signal ASICs, evaluate their reliability, and integrate them with MEMS hardware. **What you’ll do**

* Define requirements for custom ICs in next-generation LDA systems, including digital, analog, and high-voltage designs that improve performance, power consumption, size, cost, and supply chain resilience.

This might mean that you spend a week working remotely doing paperwork and video calls, followed by a week of working from the office directly overseeing manufacturing and testing operations. Some folks prefer to work from an office full time, and we support that as well.

\**Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, people from underrepresented groups tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Colossus, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.*

**Responsibilities**

* Lead a team of engineers, and support hiring as the team grows with the company. Currently the team numbers five, but will be growing in the next year.
* Coordinate work across engineers, set priority levels, remove blockers, and provide accountability, keeping them happy and focused on their work
* Set schedules and maintain timelines, working closely with our project manager to set realistic schedules for the team and flag any issues meeting those timelines.
* Oversee engineering design work, setting high standards for both the work and its documentation
* Provide training and mentorship to junior engineers
* Create and maintain systems for managing supply chains and inventory to ensure we have the parts and materials we need to manufacture on time
* Create and refine systems for manufacturing to ensure quality, including overseeing documentation, checklists, standard operating procedures, and quality inspections.
* Supervise testing of product, both functional checks and environmental testing such as vibration and thermal testing. Review test specifications, test plans, test reports, and manage the systems to ensure quality.
* Maintain systems to securely and safely ship product to customers, including packing and handling, along with relevant documentation.
* Coordinate with the Commercial Team to support sales and customer success, ensuring customers know when they are getting hardware and set up for success in using it
* Work with senior leadership on high level strategy, product roadmaps, and hiring
* Minimal travel may be required to support our builds, visit vendors, attend conferences, etc (<10%)

**Experience We’re Looking For**

* 8+ years of experience in electrical, mechanical, aerospace or similar engineering field
* 5+ years of experience managing a team of 4 or more
* Experience in the space industry building and shipping space hardware or similar experience with high value, low volume products
* Have taken a product from concept to production, either leading the team or being a member
* Experience using value stream mapping, lean agile, and similar tools to improve quality, increase efficiency, and reduce waste
* Familiarity with industry standards and best practices in aerospace manufacturing, such as ISO 9001 or similar quality management systems
* *(bonus) Knowledge of aerospace standards (i.e. GEVS 7000, AS9100)*
* *(bonus) Experience with spacecraft AI&T and/or operations*

**Life at Colossus**

We are curious. We’re the kids who took apart appliances on the kitchen table. We have to understand how everything works. If that sounds like you, you’ll fit right in. Let’s try to have a little fun along the way, too.

We have standardized compensation per level. The compensation for this role is $240,000 USD, with regular updates and bonuses tied to the company’s success. HYFIX Spatial Intelligence is building the next generation of autonomous drones and

robotic lawnmowers for dynamic, unstructured outdoor environments. Our systems

enable precision landscaping, spatial mapping, and property maintenance that scales

seamlessly, built on top of our proprietary RTK stack. We are developing fully

autonomous systems with no humans in the loop and are looking for a Robotics

Engineer to help shape the future of intelligent outdoor robotics.

We are seeking a Robotics Engineer to own key parts of the robotics stack, including

navigation, perception, controls, software, and simulation. You will help guide how our

robots map, navigate, and operate in complex outdoor environments, ensuring that

behavior is rigorously validated in simulation before deployment in the field.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
* 3 to 7years of experience in robotics software development focused on mobile robots,

UAVs, navigation, or perception.

* Experience with vehicle kinematics, flight dynamics, and trajectory/path planning.
* Proficiency in Python and C++.
* Hands-on experience integrating, debugging, and commissioning robotic hardware in

the field.

**Preferred Skills & Experience**

* Experience with NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Gazebo, AirSim, or similar simulation platforms.
* Experience with ground vehicle navigation stacks (Nav2) or UAV flight controllers (PX4,

ArduPilot).

* Familiarity with SLAM, visual odometry, GPS/RTK integration, and point-cloud

processing.

* Experience deploying computer vision models on edge AI platforms such as NVIDIA

Jetson.

* Background in agricultural robotics, delivery drones, autonomous driving, or high-

reliability autonomous systems.

* Experience designing for fault tolerance, safe autonomy, and graceful degradation.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.

* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* 401(k) with company matching
* Health, dental, and vision insurance **Dynamic startup environment with hands-on engineering opportunities**

jobs.title: Terrestrial Automation & Controls Engineer II
jobs.description:
**About Varda**
---------------

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. **Varda's W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.**

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

**About This Role**
-------------------

The **Terrestrial Automation & Controls Engineer II** builds bespoke test infrastructure that qualifies spaceflight hardware for orbit. They design, build, and own sophisticated ground support equipment (GSE) and test systems: propulsion test stands, environmental qualification chambers, spacecraft-level integration testing and more! Our stack is modern, including a custom PLC framework and Beckhoff EtherCAT tooling built in-house. They will have a meaningful impact on architecture decisions, and the chance to define standards that will outlast any single program.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Design, build, and maintain test systems and ground support equipment (GSE) for flight hardware qualification and manufacturing operations.
* Integrate with a wide range of external hardware, including thermal vacuum chambers, ovens, chillers, pressure systems, data acquisition hardware, and precision instrumentation.
* Develop and extend Varda's internal PLC framework and EtherCAT tooling to support evolving program needs.
* Contribute to architecture decisions on real-time control implementation, including evaluation of PLC-based (TwinCAT 3) versus Linux-based approaches for high-frequency control applications.
* Build cabinets, wire panels, and own systems end-to-end from electrical design through commissioning.
* Partner with propulsion, avionics, GNC, and manufacturing teams to deliver test infrastructure that meets their needs on aggressive timelines.
* Champion sustainable engineering practices that enable new engineers to ramp quickly on the tech stack and maintain production systems reliably.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, or related technical field.
* 2+ years of industry experience in test automation, controls, and/or industrial automation.
* Hands-on experience integrating with industrial hardware over protocols such as EtherCAT, Modbus (TCP/RTU), RS-232/485 serial, or similar communication standards.
* Experience with at least one modern PLC ecosystem - ideally Beckhoff TwinCAT 3 with structured text (IEC 61131-3), or a demonstrated eagerness to develop deep expertise there.
* Comfort working across the full stack: designing electrical panels, wiring cabinets, debugging hardware, and writing control software.
* Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment where priorities shift, and end-to-end ownership of problems is expected.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**
-----------------------------------

* Strong intuition for when to use real-time PLC code versus higher-level Python orchestration, and a strong understanding of the tradeoff.
* Experience working with custom or in-house control frameworks, rather than relying solely on vendor-provided stacks.
* Advanced EtherCAT expertise - including DC sync, ENI configuration, master implementation, or driver-level work.
* Production experience with TwinCAT 3, structured text, and the broader IEC 61131-3 language suite.
* Experience designing deterministic, hard real-time control loops with sub-millisecond cycle times.
* Familiarity with time-series data acquisition and visualization tools such as Grafana, InfluxDB, or similar platforms.
* Aerospace experience, particularly in spacecraft testing or GSE development.
* Environmental test experience, including TVAC, thermal cycling, and vibration testing.
* Hands-on experience working with high-pressure gas or fluid systems.
* Experience developing propulsion test stands or other complex, multi-subsystem test infrastructure.
* Familiarity with spacecraft qualification standards and associated documentation requirements.
* Experience developing safety-related control systems and evaluating proposed solutions for reducing safety-related risks.

**Pay Range**
-------------

* Salary range: Engineer II: $119,543 - $152,749/ per year.
* This role is on-site in El Segundo, CA.
* Leveling and base salary is determined by job-related skills, education level, experience level, and job performance.
* You will be eligible for incentives in the form of stock options and/or long-term cash awards.

---------------------

Knowledge of caching technologies, key/value stores and message queues.  
  
Advocate for test automation and software engineering best practices.  
  
Client-Server protocol & API design skills.  
  
Excellent data modeling skills.

Javascript and UI skills for building tools.

BS or higher in Computer Science or equivalent.

jobs.description:
Overview:

Department 460 is seeking a highly motivated candidate to support submarine construction activities of VIRGINIA Class, including the VIRGINIA Payload Module (VPM). D460 is responsible for the resolution of design issues, trouble-shooting of construction problems, technical support for manufacturing operations, verification and certification of as-built dimensions and configurations, and implementation of process improvements. The department’s main goal is to provide timely, high quality engineering support for all manufacturing, steel fabrication, and outfitting activities at the Electric Boat Quonset Point (EBQP) facility. In addition, engineers in D460 are exposed to various aspects of submarine design and construction which provides opportunities for continuous growth, leadership, and advancement as an engineer.

Individuals selected for this position will be responsible for providing fluid systems technical support for submarine construction activities for VIRGINIA Class submarines at the EBQP facility. This position requires continued progression of technical and project management skills. The successful candidate is expected to help manage construction issues throughout steel fabrication, manufacturing, and outfitting organizations at the EBQP facility, and be able to communicate engineering assessments with Operations trade, planning, and ship’s management organizations. They are also expected to relay shipyard priorities to appropriate engineering groups.

**Responsibilities:**

* Proactively assisting trade personnel to overcome construction problems and facilitating /implementing design and process improvements
* Adjudication of technical issues encountered during construction
* Interpreting design/drawing/specification requirements
* Providing clear and timely direction and/or evaluation to Quonset Point trades via disposition of Engineering Reports (ERs) and TIR UNSATs.
* Performing engineering calculations for “as-built” configurations
* Interfacing with trade personnel, management and on-site Customer (Navy) representatives

Qualifications:

**Required:**

* Bachelor of Science degree or higher in Engineering (e.g., mechanical, marine/ocean, naval architecture, aerospace, civil, chemical) completed by May 2027
* 0-5 years of professional engineering experience following degree completion
* Ability to obtain and maintain a Department of Defense Secret security clearance

**Preferred:**

* Experience with task or project management
* Previous submarine experience
* Previous internship, co-op, or hands-on experience providing deck-plate engineering construction support
* Familiarity with Electronic Desktop and JCALs
* Experience dispositioning Engineering Reports (ERs) or Change Notices (CNs)

Skills:

* Candidate must be able to take initiative and work independently.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Demand Bidder, Ad Serving Platform
jobs.description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.  
Roku is changing how the world watches TV
Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.
From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

About the Team
Roku's Ad Serving Team builds and operates the real-time advertising platform that powers all of Roku’s ad monetization across video, display, and native ad formats. Within Ad Serving, the Demand Bidder team owns the high throughput and low latency systems responsible for serving relevant ads for tens of thousands of campaigns through targeting, scoring, bidding, auctions, measurement and more. Every millisecond and every decision carries direct, measurable revenue impact, and the team operates with the high engineering rigor that this demands.

About the Role We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer (Staff scope) to help scale and evolve this platform. Demand Bidder is a large, high-throughput system driving our next phase of growth. As we onboard a rapid wave of new businesses, we are actively scaling and advancing our architecture — including state of the art pacing engine, scoring/ML engine, modularizing designed for agentic development. Our reliability bar keeps climbing alongside our business scale. We need someone who can rapidly master this intricate ecosystem and take immediate ownership of key initiatives.

For New York Only — The estimated annual salary for this position is between $195,000 – $408,000 annually. Compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, certifications, and specific geographical location. This role is eligible for health insurance, equity awards, life insurance, disability benefits, parental leave, wellness benefits, and paid time off.

How will I use AI at Roku? 
At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. 

We value your AI skills if have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.  

What You'll Be Doing
Design, build, and operate core components of a large-scale, real-time distributed decisioning system with strict latency requirements
Take end-to-end ownership of specific subsystems: architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, on-call, and long-term evolution
Build a working mental model of a highly distributes, complex production system, and make high-leverage contributions
Identify opportunities to continuously evolve the system and tooling
Partner with engineers and applied scientists working at the intersection of distributed systems and statistical/ML-driven decision-making
Diagnose and resolve subtle, often timing- or statistics-related issues in a highly concurrent, multi-region distributed system
Mentor other engineers and raise the bar on engineering rigor, testing discipline, and operational excellence across the team
Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and drive alignment across engineering, product, and business partners

We're Excited If You Have
10+ years of experience designing, building, and operating large-scale, low-latency distributed systems — ideally including at least one system you built substantially from the ground up
A demonstrated track record of owning complex systems end-to-end: design, build, operate, on-call, and iterate based on production feedback
Proven ability to ramp quickly into unfamiliar, complex, large codebases and become productive fast — you enjoy the “figure it out” part of the job as much as the “build it” part
Experience evolving and refactoring live, business-critical systems without compromising uptime or correctness
Strong command of Java, with a solid foundation in algorithms, data structures, concurrency/multi-threading, and performance optimization
Practical experience with distributed caching, high-throughput messaging/streaming systems, and SQL/NoSQL datastores
Comfort operating in cloud infrastructure (GCP or AWS) at scale
Exposure to applying statistical, control-theory, or ML-driven techniques within production decision-making systems is a strong plus
Real-time bidding / ad-tech domain experience is a big plus, but deep experience in adjacent high-stakes, low-latency domains (trading systems, large-scale ranking/recommendation, matchmaking, risk/fraud systems) is equally valued
B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
High ownership, self-motivation, critical thinking, and comfort operating with ambiguity
Low-ego and nonpolitical — you'd rather get to the right answer than be the one who's right, and you take critical feedback in stride rather than personally
Genuinely collaborative and team-oriented, with an open mind toward other people's approaches and the outgoing energy to work well across teams
You've used AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) in real production work to accelerate design, implement, debug, and understand unfamiliar codebases. You have informed opinions on how best to leverage
You're curious about applying AI – whether that mean using AI to monitor system health, triage issues or develop agentic workflows
You hold yourself to a high bar of correctness and understanding of what you ship, even as these tools accelerate your pace
Deep prior experience isn't required — genuine curiosity and a willingness to help shape how the team uses these tools responsibly is what matters most

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?
Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

What are some of the benefits?
Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

Accommodations
Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.

What should I know about Roku's culture?
Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 
We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. 
To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.
By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

You’ll work in a highly cross-functional environment, partnering with security, legal, marketing, and data teams to define solutions that balance compliance, security, and high-quality patient experiences.

What You’ll Do

Build and maintain privacy-first, distributed data systems and consent management systems that comply with consumer privacy regulations.
Design and operate high-throughput, event-driven architectures (e.g., Kafka, streaming systems) for collection, processing, and distribution of first-party data.
Contribute to authentication and identity systems, including user lifecycle management, access controls, and multi-factor authentication.
Architect and scale asynchronous data pipelines and event processing systems for real-time and batch use cases.
Partner with marketing and growth teams to enable privacy-compliant advertising, CRM, and analytics workflows.
Implement privacy-preserving techniques (e.g., anonymization, tokenization, minimization) and ensure compliant data flows to third-party platforms.
Collaborate with security and legal teams to enforce data governance, retention, and compliance policies.

What You’ll Bring To The Team

8+ years of software engineering experience (2+ years at Staff or above level) with a focus on distributed systems, data infrastructure, privacy, or security.
Strong proficiency in Python and experience building scalable, production-grade systems.
Deep experience with distributed systems, including streaming platforms (e.g., Kafka), event-driven architectures, and asynchronous processing.
Experience designing and operating data pipelines, eventing systems, and first-party data platforms.
Familiarity with authentication and identity systems (e.g., OAuth, session management, MFA, user lifecycle management).
Experience using agentic coding tools to improve development velocity, reduce workflow friction, automate repetitive tasks, and increase system visibility—while maintaining strong engineering judgment and ownership of outcomes.
Experience in regulated environments and strong ownership in driving complex, cross-functional technical initiatives.

We’ve Got You Covered

Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA
401(k) with company match

Paid parental leave + Fertility benefits
