About Vercel

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About The Role

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our Platform team. You will build the observability systems that give Vercel visibility into how we build, ship, and operate our systems. Core Platform owns Vercel’s reliability, resilience, and engineering velocity. We’re looking for engineers to create observability for everything from cost attribution to deployment velocity, alongside the logs, metrics, and traces necessary to optimize how Vercel builds its systems. This is a role with a wide breadth where we quickly develop critical systems and improve the entire Vercel code base. You will report to Eric Larson, Engineering Manager, Platform and will be located onsite, hybrid, or remote.

If you’re based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday, even if the role is listed as remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.

What You Will Do

Design and build high-scale, internal observability systems (metrics, logs, and traces) that give engineering and the business visibility into Vercel's own infrastructure.
Build cost attribution and chargeback tooling so spend can be accurately mapped to the parts of the business driving it, reducing reliance on third-party tools like Datadog.
Partner with Backend and Platform teams to instrument services for compliance, auditing, and record-keeping requirements.
Evaluate, integrate, and help operate observability infrastructure across our existing vendors and the CNCF ecosystem.
Ship pragmatic, high-leverage visibility quickly that drives improvement in how we build, deploy, and operate our systems.
Work closely with Backend and Platform engineers to scale observability infrastructure to the throughput and cardinality of Vercel's full production traffic.

About You

Proficient in TypeScript, with backend/infrastructure experience.
Hands-on experience with Go, Rust, or Zig in production systems.
Experience with distributed computing systems at scale.
Experience with cloud infrastructure, including object storage.
Familiarity with observability tooling and concepts (Datadog, Grafana, New Relic, Splunk, or CNCF-based stacks such as Prometheus-compatible backends).

Bonus If You

Have contributed to or worked closely with CNCF observability projects.
Built, scaled, and improved internal developer platforms.

Competitive compensation package, including equity.
Inclusive Healthcare Package.
Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.
Flexible Time Off.

Vercel gives developers the tools and cloud infrastructure to build, scale, and secure a faster, more personalized web. As the team behind v0, Next.js, and AI SDK, Vercel helps customers like Ramp, Supreme, PayPal, Chick-fil-A, and Under Armour build for the AI-native web.

Our mission is to enable the world to ship the best products. That starts with creating a place where everyone can do their best work. Whether you're building on our platform, supporting our customers, or shaping our story: You can just ship things.

About The Role:

We're looking for a Software Engineer
to join the Next.js team
. In this role, you'll work on the core of the framework, collaborating directly with the open-source community, shaping the future of the web, and delivering impactful features to a global audience of developers.

Our team is responsible for advancing Next.js and its ecosystem, enabling developers to build faster, more scalable, and more performant applications. If you’re passionate about web standards, open source, and developer experience, you’ll thrive here.

You’ll work on challenges such as server rendering, routing, bundling, performance optimizations, and integrating emerging web standards – all while ensuring the framework remains intuitive and stable.

Design and implement core features in Next.js, from RFC to release
Collaborate with internal teams (like Vercel’s platform and runtime teams) to build seamless integrations between framework and infrastructure
Engage with the open-source community through issues, PRs, RFCs, and discussions
Optimize performance across the full stack – from server to browser to edge
Stay up-to-date with emerging web standards (e.g., React Server Components, Partial Prerendering, Web Streams)
Contribute to developer tooling, docs, and examples that help others succeed with Next.js

About You:

Strong experience in JavaScript, TypeScript, and React
Deep understanding of web fundamentals: HTML, CSS, HTTP, rendering models, caching
Experience building production-grade web applications or frameworks
Familiarity with build tools (e.g., Webpack, Turbopack, Babel, SWC, or similar)
A collaborative mindset and clear communication – especially when working in public/open-source

Why Vercel:

Work on one of the most widely used web frameworks in the world
Collaborate with the team behind Next.js, Turbopack, and other open-source tools Fast-moving, developer-focused culture with autonomy and ownership
Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits (remote-first team, generous PTO, learning stipends)

jobs.title: Software Engineer, eve
jobs.description:
Engineering
New York City
Full Time

Software Engineer, eve

Careers /
Engineering
Engineering
New York City
Full Time

About Vercel

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About The Role

We are looking for a Software Engineer
to join the Agent Stack
team and help build eve — Vercel's framework for building production-ready AI agents. Eve is to agents what Next.js is to web apps: an opinionated, batteries-included framework that lets developers write only what's unique about their agent and have the platform handle the rest. You will design and implement core framework primitives, contribute to eve's runtime (built on Vercel Workflows, AI SDK, and Sandbox), and help shape the developer experience for the next generation of AI-native applications. You will report to the Director of Vercel's Agent Stack
and will be located onsite in New York City
.

If you're based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday, even if the role is listed as remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.

What You Will Do

Design and ship core eve framework features — the file-system conventions, compiler, and runtime that turn an agent directory into a durable, production-ready agent on Vercel.
Build and maintain integrations across eve's channel layer (Slack, Web Chat, WhatsApp, API, Cron, and more) and connections layer (Vercel Connect / MCP endpoints).
Collaborate with the AI SDK, Workflows, and Sandbox teams to ensure eve's primitives compose seamlessly on the Vercel platform.
Drive DX quality — CLI ergonomics, error messages, docs, and examples — so TypeScript/Next.js developers can ship their first agent in minutes.
Contribute to eve's evaluation and observability story: test suites, scoring rubrics, and deployment-time evals that make agents production-safe.
Partner with early customers and internal teams to gather feedback, diagnose agent reliability issues, and iterate rapidly.

About You

5+ years of production TypeScript/JavaScript experience; comfortable owning complex, stateful systems end to end.
Strong understanding of distributed systems concepts — durable execution, checkpointing, async workflows, and failure recovery.
Experience building or operating developer tooling, frameworks, or SDKs used by external developers.
Familiarity with LLM APIs and agent orchestration patterns (tool calling, multi-agent delegation, human-in-the-loop flows).
Track record of shipping high-quality open-source or customer-facing APIs and caring deeply about API design.

Benefits & Compensation

Competitive compensation package, including equity.
Inclusive Healthcare Package.
Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.
Flexible Time Off.
We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

The New York, NY base pay range for this role is $208,000-$312,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of NYC may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.

Disclosures

Privacy: Please review our Job Applicant Privacy Policy for more information on how we handle your data.
Equal Opportunity: Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

Apply Now.

A bit about us:

Join a fast-growing, well-funded Series B startup at the forefront of building the modern test stack for hardware engineering teams. Founded by MIT, SpaceX, Palantir, Anduril, NASA, and Harvard alumni and backed by top-tier investors like Founders Fund and General Catalyst. This company is revolutionizing how aerospace, autonomy, clean energy, and advanced manufacturing teams collect, validate, and act on real-time data.

Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams—including Sales and Operations—to support technical evaluations, guide pre-sales discussions, and define the scope of customer-facing projects.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Systems ML Tooling
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a Software Engineer to join the MTIA (Meta Training & Inference Accelerator) Software Tooling team, which develops and maintains the tooling ecosystem for Meta's in-house AI accelerator ASICs. The Tooling team provides debugging, profiling, memory analysis, and monitoring capabilities for the whole MTIA Ecosystem, redefining ML accelerator tooling by leveraging Meta's full-stack ownership from silicon specs to fleet observability.In this role, you will design and build developer tools across the MTIA tooling ecosystem, with a primary focus on debugging, sanitizer technology, and fault isolation for AI workloads running on MTIA hardware at scale. You will work at the intersection of compilers, runtime, hardware, and ML frameworks, collaborating with cross-functional partners to deliver a high-quality developer experience for Meta's custom AI accelerators.This role can focus on either debugging and sanitizing technology or simulation infrastructure for pre-silicon and post-silicon model bring-up, depending on the candidate's background and team needs.

Software Engineer, Systems ML Tooling Responsibilities:

Lead the design and development of MTIA's debugging and sanitizer tooling, including live debugging, core dump, and memory sanitizers for accelerator workloads
Build debugging capabilities spanning graph-mode debugging, kernel-level diagnostics, and multi-rank fault isolation
Contribute broadly to the MTIA SW tooling infrastructure — profiling, performance debugging, memory analysis, monitoring, and reliability analysis for training and inference workloads
Own significant components end-to-end, from technical design through implementation, production rollout, and long-term maintenance
Collaborate closely with the MTIA compiler, runtime, kernel, and hardware teams to instrument the software stack with the hooks, sanitizers, and debuggers required
Drive AI-native tooling approaches, leveraging automation and LLM-guided diagnostics to reduce time-to-root-cause
Partner with internal product teams across advertising, recommendations, and generative AI to understand developer pain points and prioritize tooling investments
Communicate architectural decisions through design documents and cross-team reviews
share debugging methodology and best practices with engineers across the MTIA stack

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
4+ years of experience in systems software engineering, performance engineering, developer tooling, or a closely related field
Experience building debugging, sanitizer, profiling, simulation, or diagnostic tools for complex software/hardware systems
Proficiency in C++ and Python, including low-level systems programming and scripting for tool automation
Experience working across multiple layers of a system stack (compiler, runtime, OS/driver, hardware)Track record of leading the technical design and delivery of tooling or infrastructure projects through to production deployment
Cross-stack debugging skills, with the ability to trace issues across application, runtime, and hardware boundaries

jobs.title: Hardware Engineer (Electrical)
jobs.description:
Navi captures everything a pilot sees and hears. The Wave is how we do it — the hardware that lives in the cockpit, captures flight data, and streams it to the cloud in real time. You're building the next generation of that device.

**About the role**
==================

This is a founding hardware role. You own the entire physical product — from bare-metal architecture through PCB design, ruggedized enclosure, embedded firmware, environmental certification, fleet deployment, and cloud integration. This is Version 2 of the Wave, and you are the definitive technical voice for every decision that shapes it.

The device has to survive cockpit environments — heat, vibration, RF noise — while continuously streaming high-bandwidth audio and telemetry over wireless networks without dropping a frame. It has to be deployable across hundreds of aircraft and manageable as a fleet. It has to meet certification standards for operating in aircraft. And it has to be built fast, because Navi is already live at flight schools and the U.S. Air Force and demand is accelerating.

If you thrive in high-autonomy environments and love building mission-critical edge devices that work in the real world — not on a bench — this is your role.

**What you'll do**
==================

* Lead the end-to-end technical design of Navi's next-generation edge compute node — architecture, component selection, PCB layout, and mechanical enclosure
* Build hardware that is ruggedized for cockpit environments — thermal, vibrational, and environmental stress — and optimized for continuous wireless data transmission
* Architect real-time data pipelines for processing and streaming high-fidelity audio and complex telemetry from the edge to the cloud with minimal latency
* Own the hardware validation lifecycle — environmental testing, quality assurance, and securing regulatory and industry-specific certifications for hardware operating in aircraft
* Develop and oversee embedded firmware and edge processing logic — real-time operating systems, on-device compute, and fleet-wide OTA update infrastructure
* Guide the architecture of live cloud-based telemetry dashboards to ensure seamless data ingestion and real-time visibility from deployed devices
* Collaborate with software and ML engineers to ensure the hardware captures exactly what the intelligence layer needs to generate automated debriefs

**About you**
=============

* 7+ years of experience in systems engineering, embedded edge compute, or connected hardware development — with a track record of bringing a complex device to market, not just prototyping one
* Deep understanding of electronics design — PCB schematics, microcontrollers, wireless communication modules (cellular, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth)
* Experience collaborating with industrial or mechanical designers to build ruggedized enclosures that survive challenging thermal, vibrational, and environmental conditions
* Strong proficiency in embedded C/C++ or Python for edge applications, with experience running RTOS or embedded Linux
* Familiarity with edge-to-cloud architecture, device fleet management, and building scalable live data infrastructure
* Hands-on experience navigating rigorous hardware certification processes and environmental testing standards
* You own projects end to end in ambiguous, fast-moving environments — and you ship

**Nice to have**
================

* Experience with edge processing and lossless streaming of high-bandwidth data — real-time audio, complex signal processing, or continuous telemetry
* Background building hardware for aviation, defense, or other safety-critical regulated industries
* Familiarity with avionics data formats, cockpit audio systems, or aircraft electrical environments

**Why this role matters**
=========================

Every piece of intelligence Navi generates starts with the Wave. The AI is only as good as the data the hardware captures — and in a cockpit, there are no second chances. A dropped audio frame is a missed instructor callout. A connectivity gap is a blind spot in the debrief. You're building the device that makes the entire platform possible, and it has to work perfectly every single flight.

**What you'll get**
===================

* Flight training — earn your pilot's license and build with true domain expertise
* Impact you can see — the device you build will be in cockpits at flight schools, airlines, and the U.S. Air Force
* A role that scales into hardware leadership as we grow

**How we work**
===============

* **Find a way.** We don't wait for permission or perfect information. Ideas come from anywhere regardless of title. Figure it out, ship it, iterate.
* **Creativity over control.** First principles over process. We'd rather have a creative solution that's 80% right today than a perfect one next quarter.
* **Update fast.** Come in with a hypothesis, throw it away when the data says otherwise. Ego has no place here.
* **Intensity with focus.** We work hard because the mission demands it. Clarity on what matters is how we make that sustainable.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
### **About Subsense**

Subsense is a deep-tech company developing the world’s first non-surgical, bidirectional brain-computer interface powered by plasmonic and magnetoelectric nanoparticles. Our mission is to unlock direct communication between the human brain and AI - starting with medical applications such as stroke recovery and moving toward cognitive enhancement for healthy users. Headquartered in Palo Alto, Subsense brings together leading scientists and engineers to redefine the future of human–machine interaction.

### **The Opportunity**

Design and develop electronics and integrated hardware for emerging neurotechnology and medical-device systems. Initial work may include focused ultrasound platforms, while the role is expected to support and adapt to other stimulation, sensing, and experimental hardware approaches as technical needs evolve. You will take hardware from early concepts and laboratory prototypes through characterization, verification, and preparation for manufacturing. Working closely with specialists in neuroscience, mechanical engineering, and software, you will translate experimental requirements into reliable, measurable system performance.

This role suits a hands-on engineer who enjoys building and troubleshooting hardware, working across disciplines, and making sound engineering decisions as requirements evolve.

### **What You'll Own**

* Design drive, control, and interface electronics for neurotechnology and medical-device systems, including waveform generation, power amplification, impedance matching, sensing, and transducer or actuator interfaces.
* Develop analog, digital, and mixed-signal circuits, owning schematic capture, PCB layout collaboration, board bring-up, and debugging.
* Translate application and experimental requirements into electrical specifications, including operating frequency, output power, timing, duty cycle, channel synchronization, and sensing requirements.
* Integrate transducers or other stimulation/sensing hardware, power supplies, embedded controllers, sensors, and software into working prototypes.
* Build automated test setups to characterize electrical performance, transducer loading, efficiency, thermal behavior, and repeatability.
* Partner with acoustics specialists to correlate electrical measurements with acoustic output and identify the causes of performance variation.
* Implement monitoring, fault detection, interlocks, and protective circuitry appropriate to the device’s intended use.
* Document design decisions, test methods, and verification results; contribute to risk analysis and design reviews.
* Work with suppliers and manufacturing partners to improve component selection, assembly, testability, and reliability.

### **Who You Are**

### **Must-have experience**

* Master’s degree in electrical engineering, biomedical engineering with a strong electronics focus, or equivalent practical experience.
* Hands-on experience developing electronics for medical devices, neurotechnology, instrumentation, or related experimental hardware systems; experience with ultrasound systems is a plus.
* Strong grounding in analog and mixed-signal design, power electronics, signal integrity, grounding, and noise reduction.
* Experience designing drive, interface, or impedance-matching circuits for transducers, actuators, sensors, or other electrically driven hardware, with an understanding of how electrical loading affects system performance.
* Ability to take a PCB from schematic through bring-up and systematic troubleshooting.

**About Sesame**

Sesame believes in a future where computers are lifelike - with the ability to see, hear, and collaborate with us in ways that feel natural and human. With this vision, we're designing a new kind of computer, focused on making voice agents part of our daily lives. Our team brings together founders from Oculus and Ubiquity6, alongside proven leaders from Meta, Google, and Apple, with deep expertise spanning hardware and software. Join us in shaping a future where computers truly come alive.

**About the Role**

We're building smart wearables where the speaker gets a fraction of a cubic centimeter and has to be loud at the ear and quiet to everyone around you. We're looking for a Speaker Systems Engineer to own the speaker system in our products end to end: choosing and specifying the transducers, designing the acoustic path around them in very little space, setting their limits and protection, partnering with the Audio Lead on tuning, and getting them built and tested at volume.

**Responsibilities:**

* Own the speaker path of a shipping consumer electronics product, from transducer selection through enclosure design and factory test
* Translate product-level requirements into speaker system and transducer requirements: bandwidth, level, distortion, leakage, and power budget in the volume available.
* Select, specify, and qualify speakers with suppliers, including evaluation of new and unconventional transducer technologies where they fit the product better than a conventional driver.
* Design and simulate the acoustic path: back volume, ports and leaks, front acoustics, open-ear leakage control, mesh and sealing, in close partnership with mechanical and industrial design.
* Build and measure prototypes; characterize frequency response, distortion, maximum output, far-field leakage, and excursion and thermal limits, and turn the results into design changes and better models.
* Own speaker limits and protection parameters; partner with the Audio Lead on tuning and with firmware on implementation.
* Work with the audio DSP team to minimize speaker-to-mic coupling through the frame.
* Qualify the speaker system for reliability: sweat and ingress, temperature and humidity, drop, mesh clogging, and drift over life.
* Set up and maintain speaker measurement methods in the lab and at the factory, including golden units, limits, and end-of-line acoustic test.
* Support builds and factory ramps, root-cause acoustic yield and quality issues, and drive fixes with suppliers and the CM.
* Work with the cross-functional team (EE, ME, FW, PD) to trade off acoustic performance against size, cost, and power.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Acoustics, Physics, or similar.

* 5+ years of experience integrating speakers into consumer electronics hardware, with at least one shipped product where you owned the speaker system.
* Strong grounding in electroacoustics: lumped-parameter modeling, Thiele/Small parameters, enclosure and port design, and the behavior of small drivers at their limits.
* Hands-on experience specifying and qualifying miniature speakers with transducer suppliers.
* Extensive experience with audio test systems (e.g., SoundCheck, Klippel, Audio Precision) and with measuring distortion, maximum SPL, and rub-and-buzz.
* A record of using acoustic simulation (lumped-parameter and FEM, e.g., COMSOL) to make design decisions, checked against measured hardware.
* Working knowledge of speaker tuning and protection (EQ, limiting, excursion and thermal protection) and how to partner with a DSP team on it.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Masters or Ph.D. in EE, ME, Acoustics, or related disciplines.
* 8+ years of experience in speaker or transducer development for consumer electronics.
* Experience with wearables, hearables, or other products where the speaker sits close to the ear and the acoustic volume is measured in fractions of a cubic centimeter, including open-ear designs.
* Hands-on experience with a range of transducer technologies beyond conventional moving-coil drivers, and a view on where each one fits.
* Transducer design experience: motor, diaphragm, and suspension design, or close work with a supplier’s design team.
* Proficiency in a high-level programming language (e.g., MATLAB, Python) for measurement automation and analysis.
* Familiarity with human perception of sound and psychoacoustic evaluation of speech quality and intelligibility.
* Experience with factory acoustic test development and yield analysis at a contract manufacturer.

Sesame is committed to a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered. We welcome all qualified applicants, embracing diversity in race, gender, identity, orientation, ability, and more. We provide reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. Contact careers@sesame.com for assistance.

**Full-time Employee Benefits:**

* 401 (k) max employer match: 3.5% of compensation
* 100% employer-paid health, vision, and dental benefits for you and your dependents
* Unlimited PTO and sick time
* Flexible spending account with employer matching up to $1,650/year (medical FSA)
* Guardian Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Benefits do not apply to contingent/contract workers.

Compensation Range: $175K - $280K

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Kernels & Performance Optimization — MTIA Software
jobs.description:
Meta designs and deploys its own AI systems. MTIA — the Meta Training and Inference Accelerator — is Meta's family of in-house AI accelerator ASICs, running recommendation and ranking workloads in production across Meta's data centers today and expanding into generative AI inference and training as successive silicon generations land (see [https://bit.ly/metamtia](https://bit.ly/metamtia)).The MTIA Software team is part of the \*\*AI & Compute Foundation (ACF)\*\* organization within Meta Infrastructure. Because the hardware is ours, the software is ours too: we build the entire stack a chip vendor would normally supply — compiler and LLVM toolchain, runtime, kernel authoring frameworks and libraries, developer tooling, and deep PyTorch integration — and we co-design it with the silicon teams generation over generation.Within that stack, the AI kernel and optimization software development team drives the layer where architecture meets arithmetic. Our mission is performance \*and\* programmability at scale: hit roofline enablements on the workloads that matter, and make kernel authoring accessible enough that the whole organization can close coverage gaps without funneling every problem through a handful of experts. We do this by shipping high-performance kernel libraries with broad PyTorch operator coverage, by building the C++ and Python kernel authoring frameworks and DSL surfaces that others build on, and by writing production kernels against new architectures long before first silicon — turning hardware proposals into measured roofline evidence while the design can still change.We are hiring an experienced kernel and performance engineer to take on this role at a senior level. You will own the performance of workloads that serve billions of people, from the innermost loop of a fused attention kernel to the numeric decisions that determine whether a model converges. You will read hardware specifications and RTL-adjacent documentation as easily as you read code, and you will be expected to say clearly when the hardware — not the software — is the problem. Your findings will change what gets built next.This is a hands-on engineering role with wide latitude. The problems aren't incremental.## What you'll work on- \*\*Roofline-level kernels.\*\* GEMM and attention variants, normalization, collectives, elementwise and reduction fusions, sparse and quantized paths — implemented against novel architectural features (matrix engines, on-chip reduction fabrics, software-managed memory hierarchies) and tuned until the remaining gap to the machine's limit is explainable in a sentence.- \*\*Numerics under precision constraints.\*\* Low-precision formats (FP8, MX-style block-scaled types, integer quantization) where the difference between a correct scale choice and a plausible one is several decibels of signal, and where the fix has to work on silicon that has already been taped out.- \*\*Kernel authoring frameworks.\*\* Templateized, composable C++ kernel SDKs in the spirit of CUTLASS, Python DSLs in the spirit of Triton and CuTe, and the compiler-facing interfaces that let automated codegen reach performance that used to require a specialist.- \*\*Pre-silicon and bring-up.\*\* Kernels on simulators and emulators, validating architectural features and rooflines before tapeout, then first-light bring-up on real parts.- \*\*Software mitigations for hardware realities.\*\* Every chip ships with something you wish were different. Finding the workaround that recovers most of the lost performance — and generalizing it so nobody rediscovers it — is core to the job.  
  
  

### **Software Engineer, AI Kernels & Performance Optimization — MTIA Software Responsibilities:**

* Design, implement, and optimize high-performance compute and communication kernels for MTIA accelerators, taking ownership from architectural analysis through production deployment
* Profile and root-cause performance across the full stack — instruction scheduling, memory hierarchy and DMA behavior, on-chip interconnect, multi-device collectives — and drive the fixes to the right layer, whether that is the kernel, the compiler, the runtime, or the hardware
* Build and extend kernel authoring frameworks, templates, and libraries so that other engineers can reach high performance without deep architectural expertise
* raise the ceiling and lower the floor at the same time
* Deliver and maintain broad kernel coverage for PyTorch operators across recommendation, ranking, and generative AI workloads, in both eager and compiled execution paths
* Partner with silicon architecture and design teams on hardware/software co-design: quantify the value of proposed features with real kernels, characterize rooflines pre-silicon, and advocate for the changes the software stack actually needs
* Work with compiler, runtime, framework, and product-facing teams to land end-to-end wins on production models rather than isolated microbenchmark improvements
* Investigate numerics and precision trade-offs, and design software mitigations that recover performance or accuracy lost to hardware limitations
* Set technical direction for a kernel domain, write the design documents that align cross-functional partners, and mentor engineers on performance methodology and accelerator programming

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Proficiency in C++ and Python, including low-level systems programming, templates and generic programming, and comfort reading and writing performance-critical code
* Demonstrated experience writing and optimizing kernels for a parallel architecture — GPU (CUDA, ROCm/HIP, SYCL/OpenCL), TPU or other AI ASICs, or SIMD/vector CPU targets
* Working knowledge of computer architecture as it applies to performance: memory hierarchies and bandwidth, latency hiding, occupancy and scheduling, vectorization, and synchronization

**About us**  
  
  

One team. Global challenges. Infinite opportunities. At Viasat, we’re on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. For more than 35 years, Viasat has helped shape how consumers, businesses, governments and militaries around the globe communicate. We’re looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team.

  
  
**What you'll do**  
  
  

We are looking for an Information Assurance (IA) Systems Security Engineer who is eager to contribute to a small, fast-paced team! You will have a systems architecture background to support security design and certification on U.S. Government High Assurance communications programs. Provide technical support and oversight as part of a program team's system engineering effort for IA design and development, including security architecture analysis, security requirements definition and allocation and identification of potential security vulnerabilities. Requires generation of security-related documentation per Department of Defense (DOD) standards and leading system security architecture design in a team environment. Background in High Assurance (NSA) Communications Security (COMSEC) and Transmission Security (TRANSEC) design, certification requirements and techniques are required. High Assurance Computer Security (COMPUSEC) requirements background a plus. Support for new security related business development, including proposals, white papers, and presentations, as well as interfacing with Government customers, is required.

  
  
**The day-to-day**  
  
  

* Derive, develop and document system, software and hardware requirements from customer specifications

* Prepare system level material and present at internal and customer reviews
* Work with Agile scrum teams to identify develop and prioritize spiral based product features

**What will help you on the job**  
  
  

* System security design experience with focus on NSA related efforts, including cryptographic engine embedment
* Strong system, software, or test background including design and implementation
* Familiarity with design and certification to the latest NSA security requirements and specifications, as well as working knowledge of NSA High Assurance Device (Formerly Type 1) certification and documentation requirements
* Familiarity with NIST and FIPS 140-2 Design and Certification
* Familiarity with Quantum Resistant Algorithms and SERD 2.0 requirements

* Build and maintain interface emulator logic

* Collaborate with other teams on simulation health

* Working knowledge of physics-based modeling, numerical methods, or control systems

* Demonstrated proficiency with Git and modern Agile software development practices and tools

jobs.title: RF Hardware Engineer - Radar
jobs.description:
Description:

**ABOUT PROTORA**

**Protora** (formerly *C Speed*) builds radar and surveillance systems that give military and government customers eyes on their airspace, borders, and critical sites. Our name draws from the *Praetorian Guard*, elite soldiers whose job was to **watch and protect**. That history shapes our mission today: we take first watch, so the people we protect don't have to. We are a growing company with a new brand and a clear direction. **This role is an important part of designing, developing, and testing the radar technology behind our mission**.

**THE ROLE**

**Protora** is seeking a mid-level **RF Hardware Engineer** to design, build and test the RF hardware at the heart of our radar systems, including receivers, exciters and transmitters. In this role, you will own discrete technical work packages end to end—from block diagram and component selection through simulation, bring-up, integration and field test—with guidance from senior staff on program-level architecture. You will work alongside antenna, signal processing, software, and systems engineering teams to turn performance requirements into demonstrated capability.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Design, build and test radar receiver, exciter and transmitter subsystems, from block diagram and component selection through schematic capture, board and subsystem bring-up and verification.
* Perform RF cascade analysis (gain, noise figure, linearity, dynamic range and phase noise) and allocate system-level requirements to hardware specifications.
* Simulate RF circuits and assemblies using RF toolsets and validate models against measured performance.
* Work with antenna, signal processing and systems engineers on interfaces, calibration approaches and system-level performance trades.
* Lead hardware bring-up, debug and troubleshooting; plan and execute laboratory, chamber, and field test and analyze measured data against predicted performance.
* Support environmental and EMI/EMC qualification (e.g., MIL-STD-810, MIL-STD-461) and transition designs to production, including acceptance test procedures.
* Author technical documentation, including hardware specifications, design documentation, trade studies, test plans and procedures, and test reports.
* Present analysis and test results at internal design reviews and customer technical exchanges.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* **B.S. in Electrical Engineering, Physics**, or a related technical field.
* **4–7 years of professional experience** designing, building and testing RF/microwave hardware, preferably for radar or other sensor systems.
* Solid grasp of RF and microwave fundamentals, including S-parameters, impedance matching, noise figure, linearity (P1dB, IP3), and phase noise, along with working knowledge of radar theory such as radar range equation.
* Demonstrated ability to apply RF and radar theory to hardware design, integration, and troubleshooting.
* Demonstrated ability to work **collaboratively in a lean, cross-functional engineering environment** with a positive, solutions-oriented approach.
* Disciplined **engineering mindset** with an understanding of engineering processes, including requirements, design, documentation, integration, test, and validation.
* Proficiency in **MATLAB** or **Python** for analysis, test automation, and data reduction.
* Experience with RF design and simulation tools and schematic capture and layout tools (OrCAD).
* Hands-on experience with hardware bring-up, integration, and test, including spectrum analyzers, signal generators, vector network analyzers, oscilloscopes, power meters, and noise figure and phase noise measurement equipment.
* Demonstrated ability to document and present technical work to engineering and customer audiences.
* U.S. person status and the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. DoD Secret clearance.
* Ability to work across office, laboratory, anechoic chamber, and outdoor test range environments, including occasional testing outside standard business hours to meet range scheduling constraints.
* Ability to lift and move test equipment and hardware and work outdoors in varying weather conditions during field testing.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**

* M.S. or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, RF/Microwave Engineering, electromagnetics, or related discipline.
* Active DoD Secret or Top-Secret clearance.
* Experience with active electronically scanned arrays (**AESA**), T/R modules, or phased array calibration.
* Experience designing amplifiers, low-noise receivers, frequency synthesizers or LO distribution networks.
* Experience with air surveillance, counter-UAS, or weapon-locating radar.
* Embedded or **FPGA/DSP** implementation experience (**VHDL, Verilog, or C/C++** on real-time targets).
* Prior work under **MIL-STD-461/464, MIL-STD-810**, or comparable qualification standards.
* Experience with RF PCB layout and taking RF hardware from prototype into production including design for manufacturability.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

* **Compensation Range**: $120,000 - $130,000 commensurate with experience.
* **Benefits**: Health, Dental & Vision Insurance | Paid Time Off (**PTO**) | Retirement Plan Package.

**WHY JOIN PROTORA**

* **Direct impact**. Your engineering work directly contributes to radar systems designed to support critical missions.
* **Hands-on engineering**. You will design hardware, bring it up on the bench, see it perform in the lab and out in the field.
* **Work that supports people who protect others**. The systems you build help the people on watch see threats coming.

**READY TO JOIN THE MISSION?**

**Protora** is always looking for talented professionals who want to do meaningful work with a team that treats every challenge like a mission.

For more information about **Protora**, please visit our website: http://protoratech.com

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Integrations
jobs.description:
We're Scan.com. We're building America's national imaging network: the infrastructure that connects patients, providers, and payers to faster, better-value diagnostic imaging. Thousands of patients move through our platform every day, and each is a real person waiting for an answer to a healthcare concern. We exist to get them that answer faster.

We manage the medical imaging pathway end-to-end. Providers order through a single point of entry, and from there, we run the entire medical diagnostic pathway. Managing the full pathway, rather than brokering pieces of it, is what lets us deliver imaging faster, at higher quality, and at a lower cost than the fragmented status quo.

We’re looking for a **Senior Software Engineer, Fulfillment,** at an exciting time — we’ve successfully launched multiple platforms and products, raised over $100m in VC funding, reached profitability, and have a growth trajectory of over 100% YoY.

  

Millions of people wait too long for a diagnosis. Come help us fix that.

  

**WHAT YOU WILL BE GETTING INVOLVED IN**
----------------------------------------

Scan.com's integration layer is mission-critical infrastructure. We interface with hundreds of imaging centers and health systems operating disparate, often decades-old systems — RIS platforms built on legacy protocols, HL7 v2 feeds with idiosyncratic vendor dialects, and hardware gateways running in constrained clinical environments. On the demand side, we connect to modern EHR APIs, third-party referral networks, and portal integrations that must work reliably at scale.

As a **Senior Software Engineer, Integrations**, you will architect and build the systems that make these connections robust, observable, and extensible. This problem area requires genuine passion for legacy system integration patterns, message transformation pipelines, and the operational discipline to maintain high-reliability infrastructure against the entropy of the real world.

As a scale-up business, you can expect your role to develop over time. Here are some of the types of things you could be getting involved in:

* Build and maintain REST API integrations with third-party referral sources, attorney platforms, and demand aggregators, including OAuth flows, rate limiting, retry logic, and schema versioning. Design and implement HL7 v2 transformation pipelines — parsing, normalizing, enriching, and routing ADT, ORM, ORU, SIU, and MDM message types across heterogeneous RIS and EHR systems with non-standard vendor extensions.
* Build and maintain integration connectors for modern and legacy imaging center RIS systems.
* Architect fault-tolerant message queuing and delivery infrastructure for inbound and outbound HL7 and API traffic.
* Develop interfaces for demand-side EHR integrations, including mapping from internal data models to FHIR-compliant (and other standards) representations.
* Own the observability layer for the integration infrastructure: structured logging, alerting on message processing latency/failures, and dashboards that surface issues before they reach the operations teams.
* Contribute to the design of integration onboarding tooling that reduces time-to-live for new imaging center and referral source connections
* Provide technical mentorship to mid-level engineers and participate in architecture reviews across the broader Engineering org

**WHAT YOU MIGHT BRING TO THE TABLE**
-------------------------------------

You don't need to tick all the boxes to apply for this role. Whether it's your first role or your fifth, we believe everyone can add value, learn, and grow. However, these might be some of the ways you are currently adding value:

* Strong command of message transformation architecture: you can design pipelines that are observable, replayable, and extensible without requiring a full rewrite every time a new vendor is onboarded
* Proficiency in at least one backend language used in high-reliability integration contexts (Python, Ruby, Java, C# are all relevant; language is less important than architectural rigor).
* Familiarity with RESTful API integration patterns, including schema versioning, backward compatibility, and API contract management
* Strong operational instincts: you instrument what you build, you think about failure modes before they happen, and you treat on-call escalations as a signal about systemic gaps
* Experience in healthcare is a plus, but not required. We care far more about your integration engineering depth and legacy system fluency than your industry background

**A VIEW ON OUR CULTURE**
-------------------------

We're building something that matters. Every scan we speed up is a real person waiting on an answer, and that urgency runs through everything we do. We move fast, we own outcomes, and take pride in our output. If you like ambiguity, working with ambitious people, and want your work to visibly move the needle, you'll feel at home here.

  

**HOW WE WILL INTERVIEW YOU**
-----------------------------

jobs.title: Vision Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our Edge team building the software platform behind these products. You will design, build, and operate the distributed edge-to-cloud pipeline that runs on IoT devices on the production floor, ingesting high-rate sensor and controller data and reliably forwarding it to the cloud over intermittent connectivity.

This is a hands-on backend-focused role spanning containerized .NET services, relational and document data stores, pub/sub messaging, and industrial protocol integration. You will own features end-to-end and collaborate closely with Controls, HMI, Manufacturing, and Field Support to ship reliable, production-grade systems to our customers.

**Key Job Responsibilities**

* Design and implement backend services in C# on modern .NET / ASP.NET Core for the edge platform - REST APIs, background workers, message handlers, telemetry aggregators, and long-running device services.
* Own the data pipeline from device ingest to cloud archive: schema design, repository / data-access layer, database migrations, partitioning and retention strategy, and durable store-and-forward upload to cloud object storage.
* Build and maintain containerized services and their deployment manifests, configuration, and orchestration.
* Integrate with industrial controllers over standard fieldbus and industrial communication protocols - designing message contracts, register maps, warning/error codes, and controls-side handshakes for coordinated operation.
* Deliver features end-to-end, from work-item breakdown through implementation, unit and integration tests, CI, code review, deployment, and field validation on live equipment.
* Contribute to architecture: write and review architecture docs, evaluate new patterns, and drive refactors that keep the codebase maintainable as the team and product line grow.
* Mentor and collaborate: raise the bar in code review, pair with junior engineers, and coordinate with Controls, HMI, DevOps, and Field Support to ship releases. Mentor junior software developers and provide guidance on best practices and advanced analytical techniques.
* Communicate complex data insights and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders effectively.

**Key Competencies & Skills**

**Required**

* Strong professional experience with C# and modern .NET building ASP.NET Core REST APIs, hosted / background services, and worker services.
* Solid database engineering skills: relational schema design, indexing, migrations, and query tuning. Comfort writing and reviewing raw SQL is expected.
* Practical experience with containerization
* Comfort with Linux as a deployment target (systemd services, log management, networking, device troubleshooting) and shell scripting.
* Proficiency with Git, pull-request workflows, and CI/CD (Azure DevOps Pipelines, GitHub Actions, or similar), including running unit and integration tests in the pipeline.
* Strong grounding in software engineering fundamentals: automated testing, code review, refactoring, API design, and writing clear technical documentation.

**Strongly Preferred**

* Working knowledge of Python for tooling, data analysis, and test automation (pytest); ability to move fluently between C# and Python codebases.
* Experience integrating with industrial control systems via standard fieldbus or SCADA protocols (e.g., EtherCAT, MODBUS, OPC UA, PROFINET, EtherNet/IP), or otherwise interoperating with PLCs.
* Azure cloud services: Blob Storage, IoT Hub, Container Registry, Managed Identity, and Azure DevOps. Equivalent experience on AWS or GCP is also welcome.
* Experience with Kubernetes for orchestrating containerized workloads, including deployments, services, and Helm charts; lightweight distributions such as K3s or MicroK8s at the edge are a plus.
* Experience building IoT device software - long-lived services on embedded / ARM64 hardware, remote deployment, module or fleet management, and safe over-the-air updates.
* Familiarity with columnar / analytics formats such as Parquet and downstream analytics engines (Fabric, Synapse, Databricks, DuckDB).
* Familiarity with visualization / dashboard tools (Grafana or similar) and time-series data modeling.

**Education and Experience Requirements**

* 3+ years of professional software engineering experience shipping production systems.
* Demonstrated experience delivering distributed backend systems in production, ideally at the edge or in an IoT / industrial context, with responsibility for reliability, observability, and on-call or field-support obligations.
* Track record of cross-functional collaboration with hardware, controls, or research teams, and of translating ambiguous product requirements into well-scoped, testable engineering work.

**Working Conditions**

Work is performed inside a flex space building consisting of offices, open desk space, laboratory, machine shop, and a manufacturing floor. Level of noise is usually quiet in the office environment and temperature controlled. Noise levels are elevated in the warehouse space where temperatures can vary depending on the outside elements and weather. Travel may be required, including up to 2-8 trips per year to visit suppliers, attend conferences, meetings (customer, investor, and business) and customer sites (hatcheries).

**Join us.**

Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible.

How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward.

At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more.

Come break through with us.

  

Our Optical Communications segment has recently evolved from being a manufacturer of optical fiber and cable, hardware and equipment to being a comprehensive provider of industry-leading optical solutions across the broader communications industry.This segment is classified into two main product groupings – carrier network and enterprise network. The carrier network product group consists primarily of products and solutions for optical-based communications infrastructure for services such as video, data and voice communications. The enterprise network product group consists primarily of optical-based communication networks sold to businesses, governments and individuals for their own use.

**Role Purpose**
----------------

Responsible for the design, development, programming, implementation, and optimization of control systems supporting Corning’s cable manufacturing processes. This role provides controls and electrical engineering expertise to improve product, process, and equipment performance, support innovation, and enable new product introduction within the plant. It requires advanced technical leadership in troubleshooting complex automation issues, integrating systems, and improving equipment reliability, safety, and efficiency. The position also leads projects that drive root cause understanding, cost reduction, continuous improvement, and cross-functional collaboration, while mentoring junior team members and maintaining awareness of emerging technologies and intellectual property developed through project work.

* Mentor and train junior controls engineers

Participate in all phases of the project including design, fabrication, off-line integration and testing, installation, production start-up support, training of plant personnel, and technology transfer. Independently follow construction of equipment in vendors’ facilities.

**Work Hours and Schedule:**

• Informal 24/7 coverage for ad-hoc call-in support (3rd Level Subject Matter Expert).  

**Travel**: less than 20%

**Experiences/Education - Required**
------------------------------------

**Preferred**

jobs.title: Hardware Systems Engineer

Meta is seeking a Hardware Engineer to support the validation and production readiness of AI and high-performance computing infrastructure deployed across Meta's global data centers. In this role, you will work at the intersection of AI silicon, server systems, and data center operations, partnering with hardware design, firmware, software, and capacity engineering teams to bring AI accelerators and GPU-based server platforms from new product introduction through full-scale deployment. * Develop and execute test plans covering thermal, power, and electrical characterization of AI server systems at component, board, and rack levels
* Investigate and root-cause complex hardware failures across the full stack, including AI silicon, firmware, system software, and thermal subsystems

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 6+ years of experience in hardware engineering with a focus on AI servers, GPUs, AI accelerators, or high-performance computing systems in a data center environment

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. **\*This position is contingent upon contract award\***

Amentum is seeking a skilled and driven **Senior Electrical Engineer** to join our engineering team based in Houston, TX. This is a design-focused role that spans the full product lifecycle — from early concept development through hardware design, fabrication, installation, and on-site operation.

The ideal candidate is a licensed or degree-qualified electrical or systems engineer who brings expertise in low voltage electronics, wiring systems, sensor integration, and harness design, and who communicates and collaborates effectively across engineering and operations teams.

This position offers the opportunity to lead and participate in design reviews, work alongside vendors to bring electrical hardware from schematic to reality, and provide direct technical support during field installation and testing. If you are looking for a role where your engineering decisions have real, visible consequences on mission-critical systems, this is the opportunity for you.

This team supports multiple US Navy research and development facilities associated with top priority submarine weapon system development programs. * Coordinate proactively with project managers, fellow engineers, field technicians, and operations staff to plan and execute work efficiently.

* Serve as a technical resource and collaborative partner across disciplines, fostering a team environment built on transparency and shared accountability.

Under the general direction of the Calibration & Combustion Engineering Manager, the Staff Engineer – Electrical & Controls has responsibility for the design, development, and implementation of electrical components, systems, and software to operate associated hardware for engines and engine control systems for Rehlko engine platforms.

  

**Specific Responsibilities:**

* Understand and support software modeling and simulation to develop concepts.
* Integrate software with existing systems including testing and quality assurance.
* Support, maintain, and document software & hardware functionality.
* Perform functional testing along with troubleshooting capabilities.

* Delivery of project work to time, cost, performance, and quality
  

  

**Requirements:**

* ASCET/INCA, MotoHawk/Mototune (or similar platform) experience.
* Two or more years MatLab/Simulink/Stateflow experience (Modeling, simulating, and analysis). TargetLink experience a plus.

* Use of software tools such as compilers and emulators.

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

Anthropic's Infrastructure organization builds and operates the distributed systems that train, serve, and secure our AI models. Every other team at Anthropic depends on these systems.

In this role, you'll work directly with our Research teams to build the reliable, scalable, performant infrastructure our research depends on. This is a cross-functional systems team: you'll scope and lead complex, multi-month infrastructure projects and resolve the performance and scalability bottlenecks that limit how fast we can grow.

Independently scope and lead complex, multi-month infrastructure projects, from an ambiguous starting point through to a production system
Build deep partnerships with researchers and Research teams to understand their needs and deliver for them
Mentor other engineers and help raise the technical bar for the team

We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. Your safety matters to us.

We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. jobs.description:
**Description**

  
  
Job Description

Looking for an opportunity to make an impact?

At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainable. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.

**Your greatest work is ahead!**

The **Leidos Defense Electrical Systems Department** is seeking a talented **Lead Electrical Engineer** to join an experienced, high performing, multidisciplinary team to create unique solutions to complex engineering challenges in our Huntsville, AL location. The Electrical Systems Department is a design-focused group specializing in advanced hardware products. The individual selected for this position will be an electrical engineer with project engineering, design engineering, and production skillsets. The individual must be a self-starter with experience working with inter-disciplinary teams to solve challenging technical problems. The engineer will work closely with hardware integrated into a diverse range of aerospace and military systems including manned/unmanned ground/air vehicles, missiles, radars, and space systems.

The selected candidate will be expected to execute in a fast-paced, small team environment through all phases of the hardware life cycle from conceptual development and detailed design through manufacturing, qualification testing, and post-delivery support. With a product focus, the individual is also expected to actively partner with other engineers, project managers, technicians, and customers to develop solutions that adhere to a diverse set of requirements. The ideal candidate will thrive in a learning environment that encourages leadership and technical growth.

**If you are up for the challenge of joining this team, then apply today to be considered.**

**Leidos Defense Systems Sector** provides a diverse portfolio of systems, solutions, and services covering land, sea, air, space, and cyberspace for customers worldwide. Solutions for Defense include enterprise and mission IT, large-scale intelligence systems, command and control, geospatial and data analytics, cybersecurity, logistics, training, and intelligence analysis and operations support. Our team is solving the world’s toughest security challenges for customers with “can’t fail” missions. To explore and learn more, click here!

* Leading Failure Review and Corrective Action committees for critical component failures
* Presenting to program leadership and customers in weekly meetings, quarterly IPRs, and CDRs
* Integrating LRUs into larger systems by collaborating with system design teams on design updates
* Coordinating with line management and program management to identify staffing opportunities and accelerate schedules

**Basic Qualifications**

* Candidate must possess a Bachelor's of Science in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or equivalent degree from an ABET-accredited institution.
* Candidate must have at least twelve (12) years of experience in the design and test of electronics or ten (10) years with MS degree.
* Candidate must demonstrate experience in the design, test, and manufacture of analog/mixed-signal PCBs or integrated RF/microwave assemblies.
* Candidate must have demonstrated experience leading engineering teams through production transitions from LRIP to full-rate production
* Candidate must demonstrate proficiency in engineering leadership and team management
* Candidate must have hands-on laboratory experience with instrumentation, test equipment, and debug/test methods including use of network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, oscilloscopes, signal generators, etc.
* Position requires candidates to be capable of performing in a collaborative engineering environment working closely with multi-disciplinary teams.

* Develop and apply approaches and tools for system-level and element-level performance analysis of the complex Missile Defense System
* Produce analysis results and inputs for official SEA test-report products and present findings during mission data reviews

* Support continuous improvement of analytical processes and mission assessment capabilities

* Electrical Engineering

* Related technical discipline

  
  
**YEARS OF EXPERIENCE**

jobs.description:
Overview:

i3 is seeking a Senior Systems Engineer to support the U.S. Army DEVCOM Aviation & Missile Center (AvMC) Air/Ground Integration and Interoperability Lab (AGIIL) in Huntsville, AL. AGIIL is a fast-paced, rapid prototyping and systems integration laboratory supporting a diverse range of Department of War customers and mission areas. The selected candidate will work with multidisciplinary teams to translate operational and customer needs into technical requirements and practical hardware and software engineering solutions. You will apply a comprehensive understanding of Systems Engineering principles to identify and derive requirements, support software and system architecture development, design, integrate, test, and verify complex systems in a fast-paced R&D environment, contributing independently while also collaborating closely with senior engineers and mentors.

Responsibilities:

* Analyze customer and operational needs and translate them into practical technical requirements, approaches, and engineering solutions.
* Support rapid prototyping, software development, system integration, troubleshooting, laboratory and field testing, demonstrations, and evaluation activities.
* Develop system concepts, architectures, interface definitions, functional/data flows, mockups, and other engineering products used to communicate and mature solutions.
* Coordinate with software developers and other engineering disciplines to refine system behavior, interfaces, and implementation approaches.
* Work with software, hardware, network, test, and integration engineers to develop, evaluate, and improve integrated system solutions.
* Perform technical assessments, trade studies, and gap analyses; document findings, test results, risks, and recommended courses of action for internal and Government customers.
* Reviewing test plans, procedures, and verification and validation activities.
* Independently manage assigned technical tasks and priorities while coordinating with Government customers, internal teams, vendors, and external organizations as required.
* Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in an engineering, technical, or related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 10 years of relevant Systems Engineering, systems integration, or related technical experience.
* Experience supporting the development, integration, and testing of hardware and software systems, including software-intensive or networked solutions.
* Experience working with a multidisciplinary teams providing systems engineering support to develop practical engineering solutions.
* Ability to analyze technical problems, troubleshoot integration issues, and support software/system verification and validation activities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to work independently with general guidance as part of a multidisciplinary team.
* Active DoD Secret security clearance required to start.
* U.S. Citizenship required.
* Ability to lift 50lbs.
* 10% Travel.

Preferred:

* Experience with DoDAF architectures, UML/Object-Oriented Design, data flows, interface diagrams, or similar system modeling methods.
* Familiarity with DevSecOps environments and tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
* Experience supporting DoD/Army rapid prototyping, tactical networking, system integration, laboratory, or test environments.

Knowledge/Skills

* Knowledge of office administration and procedures.
* Exceptional judgment capabilities and relationship management skills.
* Excellent communication, teamwork, and client service skills; ability to clearly communicate in discussions and written documents, and to deliver feedback clearly and tactfully.
* Interact with a diverse array of customers and staff in a professional and courteous manner.
* Work independently with accountability for accurate and complete results.
* Be extremely organized and exceptionally detail oriented.
* Work well both independently and in a team environment.
* Be energized by a fast-paced work environment.
* Must be able to communicate with others effectively.
* Analyze information and respond appropriately.
* Manage time wisely and prioritize tasks.
* Provide superior customer service.
* Multi-task in a pleasant manner.
* Work well under pressure.

* The employee is occasionally required to sit; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.
* Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.
* Regular i3 hours are 8:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m. Monday-Friday, however, additional hours may be required on occasion. Regular and punctual attendance is required.

We are seeking a Systems Engineer III to lead technical execution across multiple complex military aviation programs, spanning both rotary-wing and fixed-wing platforms. You will serve as a primary customer interface, lead Integrated Product Teams (IPTs), and steer major design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR). * Customer Interface: Serve as the principal technical point of contact for military customers, sub-contractors, and external stakeholders.

* Cross-Functional Interface: Serve as the primary technical bridge between engineering, program management, quality, manufacturing, and operations, organizations to ensure seamless design-to-sustainment transitions.

Qualifications:

* **Experience:** Minimum of 12 years of progressive systems engineering experience in the military aerospace or defense industry.
* Leadership & Communication: Proven success leading IPTs and presenting complex engineering data directly to military customers.
* Platform Expertise: Proven background supporting both rotary-wing and fixed-wing aircraft development or modification programs.
* Testing & Integration: Demonstrated experience in hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing, system integration labs (SIL), and formal qualification testing (QT).
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering.

**Preferred Skills**

* Advanced, hands-on experience using Cameo Simulation Toolkit and the 3DExperience ecosystem for Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE).
* Strong knowledge of military airworthiness certification processes (e.g., MIL-HDBK-516C, AR 70-62).
* Strong knowledge of military safety (e.g. MIL-STD-882E, SAE ARP 4754/4761)
* Strong Knowledge of Design Assurance Guidelines for hardware and software (RTCA DO-254, RTCA DO-178C)
* Team Leadership: experience formally leading, mentoring, and direct-tasking a team of engineers.

PeopleTec is currently seeking a **Software Engineer (AI Agents & Orchestration)**to support our **Huntsville, AL** location.

PeopleTec is seeking a Software Engineer in Huntsville, AL, to build the software services and instructor interfaces that connect AI capabilities to the H-1 flight simulator. You will develop real-time services that process voice requests, route them to the appropriate AI capability, communicate with the simulator, and provide tools for instructors to review and evaluate system performance.

**Duties:**

* Develop software services that connect voice input, transcription, AI agents, and spoken responses in a real-time application.
* Build the interfaces between AI services and the flight simulator, including support for simulator commands and scenario activity.
* Develop browser-based tools that allow instructors to review system behavior, provide feedback, and support training and debrief activities.
* Implement traceability, logging, and other controls needed to understand system behavior and connect results to the models and software versions used.
* Develop automated tests, troubleshoot problems, and deliver software fixes and improvements.

Qualifications:

**Required Skills/Experience****:**

* Preferred experience range: 5–8 years of software engineering experience using Python and at least one additional language such as C++, Java, or TypeScript. Demonstrated technical ability will be considered regardless of total years of experience.
* Experience building real-time or streaming software services and integrating multiple software components into a working system.
* Experience developing browser-based user interfaces and backend services.
* Experience using containers and continuous integration in a Government or other regulated environment.
* Must be a U.S. Citizen

**Education Requirements****:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field preferred. Equivalent relevant professional or military experience may substitute for a degree.

**Desired Skills****:**

* Experience integrating flight simulators or training devices, including instructor operator station workflows.
* Audio pipeline experience, including capture, voice activity detection, and text-to-speech playback, along with low-latency service tuning.
* Experience with Kubernetes and Helm, GitLab CI, software bill of materials (SBOM) tooling, and development in STIG-hardened environments.
* Familiarity with experiment tracking, model registries, and dataset versioning tools.
* Familiarity with language-model applications and guardrails that control how model outputs are acted on.

Overview:

***People First. Technology Always.***

**PeopleTec, Inc.** is an employee-owned small business founded in Huntsville, AL that provides exceptional customer support by employing and retaining a highly skilled workforce.

The AIRO Group, designs, certifies, and manufactures critical navigation, communication and display components and integrated systems that equip clients with unparalleled precision and accuracy. AIRO has a proven track record of excellence, with over 600 FAA certifications. Are you ready to explore the world of aerospace and defense? Do you want to learn from and collaborate with some of the greatest minds in the industry? At RTX, our internships, co-ops and full-time careers provide an exceptional foundation to work on complex problems, advance your skills and create a safer, more connected world. Discover opportunities to make a difference at RTX.

**What You Will Do**

At Raytheon, the foundation of everything we do is rooted in our values and a higher calling – to help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression. We bring the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat.
