jobs.description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

**Role Overview:**

* Design, build, and own the tools and services that pull data from dispersed production sources, organize it into a cohesive system, and make it usable across the factory.
* Work across manufacturing areas, talking to machines and systems on different networks.
* Turn one-off operational asks into durable software other people can actually use.
* Write Python services against the existing codebase, deploy them in containers, and help set engineering practices for a growing manufacturing software team.
* Operate as a high-ownership, on-site engineer in Los Angeles, CA, partnering closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Engineering, and IT.

**Responsibilities:**

**Data Services & Systems Integration**

* Design and build Python services that ingest, organize, and store manufacturing data from dispersed shop-floor, test, and enterprise sources in mixed formats, then present it as a coherent system others can rely on.

**Factory Networks & Device Connectivity**

* Experience organizing data from multiple sources and formats into a usable storage, access, and application layer.
* Working knowledge of computer networking fundamentals as they apply to software you write — IP addressing, routing, subnetting, VLANs, and talking to devices across those networks.
* Practical Docker (or equivalent container) experience: packaging your own services and integrating with containerized runtimes.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience programming in C++ or Python.
* 2 years of experience developing compute/storage systems, software systems, or networks.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Science.
* 2 years of experience with hardware design, and data structures or algorithms. Experience in Python and good understanding of Object Oriented Programming and Functional Programming.
* Experience with distributed systems, OS/kernel, network system design, and large-scale storage systems.

* Experience with interfacing to industry-standard HDL simulators, such as Register Transfer Level code in Verilog.

**About the job**
-----------------

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.  
  
With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

In this role, you will help solve complex problems including hardware acceleration, performance bottlenecks, computer architecture, automation, and machine learning. You will perform research, design, and development for the hardware, software, and networking technologies that power all of Google's products and services.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

jobs.title: Electrical Systems Engineer, Energy Products
jobs.description:
**Drive the Future with Xos**

**Xos** **(NASDAQ: XOS),** is a technology company and electric truck manufacturer on a mission to decarbonize commercial transportation. We design and build state-of-the-art electric vehicles, develop advanced fleet management software, and create charging solutions that make fleet electrification seamless and cost-efficient.  
  
At Xos, we're problem-solvers, innovators, and go-getters, working together to drive a cleaner, more sustainable future. Join us and be part of the movement shaping the next generation of commercial transportation.

**The Role**  
  
Xos is looking for an Electrical Systems Engineer to join our Engineering team, with a focus on the electrical design and deployment of our energy products, including the Xos Hub.  
  
In this role, you'll own the electrical design across the product lifecycle from understanding customer applications and developing system architecture to supporting production, commissioning, and deployed products in the field. You'll work across high and low-voltage systems, energy storage, power conversion, EV charging, controls, and communications while partnering closely with engineering, manufacturing, service, suppliers, and customers.  
  
This is a hands-on role for an engineer who enjoys taking ownership of complex electrical systems and seeing their designs move from schematics to real-world operation.

**\*\*This is an on-site position based at our Los Angeles, CA headquarters, with occasional travel required based on business and project needs.\*\***

  

**What You'll Do**

  

* Design and maintain electrical schematics, single-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, and harness designs for HV DC, LV AC, and 12/24V control systems.
* Develop electrical architectures for new Xos Hub configurations and customer-specific applications.
* Perform power and energy calculations, including load analysis, battery sizing, charging profiles, voltage drop, fault current, and short-circuit analysis.
* Evaluate grid power and interconnection requirements, including utility service configurations, grounding, bonding power, power quality, and power conversion.
* Size and select wiring, connectors, overcurrent protection, control devices, and other electrical components.
* Define electrical and communication interfaces across batteries/BMS, inverters/PCS, EVSE, generators, controllers, and telematics using hardwired I/O, CAN, and Ethernet.
* Create and maintain engineering documentation, including electrical drawings, E-BOMs, assembly packages, SOPs, and test and commissioning procedures.
* Support production builds, first article inspections, system testing, and commissioning at Xos facilities and customer locations, including travel as needed.
* Troubleshoot deployed systems using telematics data, logs, CAN traces, and other diagnostic tools; perform root cause analysis and translate findings into design and process improvements.
* Review customer applications, including vehicle and charging requirements, site power, load profiles, and duty cycles, to determine appropriate system configurations.
* Support product design and certification activities to applicable electrical, energy storage, and safety standards.
* Additional duties as assigned.

  

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field.
* 3-4+ years of electrical systems design experience in EV, energy storage, transportation, heavy equipment, rail, industrial power, or a related environment.
* Strong understanding of AC/DC electrical systems, single-and three-phase power, grounding, electrical protection, and power conversion.
* Experience creating electrical schematics and wiring diagrams using AutoCAD, AutoCAD Electrical, EPLAN, CATIA Systems Schematic, or similar tools.
* Hands-on experience with load calculations, wire and overcurrent protection sizing, and electrical component selection.
* Experience producing release-ready engineering documentation, including schematics, wiring diagrams, BOMs, and engineering changes.
* Experience testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting electrical systems.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work across engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, customers, and field teams.
* Ability and willingness to travel occasionally based on business and project needs.

**Nice to Have**

Experience in one or more of the following areas is a plus:

* Battery energy storage systems (BESS), batteries/BMS, inverters/PCS, EV charging, or mobile power systems
* Wire harness design and harness supplier coordination
* CCS or NACS charging systems
* Microgrids, including grid-tied and islanded operation
* CAN communications and diagnostic tools such as CANalyzer, CANoe, or PCAN
* Interface Control Documents (ICDs), requirements traceability, FMECA, or EMC analysis
* PLM systems and 3D CAD tools such as Windchill, Creo, SolidWorks, or CATIA
* UL, NFPA, NEC, IEEE, or IEC standards related to energy storage and EV charging
* EIT certification or PE licensure
* Startup or high-growth manufacturing environments
  

**Physical Demands**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is may be required to stand, walk, reach, bend, and use hands to handle tools, equipment, or components, and lift and/or move up to 25lbs. The employee may also be required to perform hands-on work on or around energy products, including the Xos Hub, while using appropriate personal protective equipment in manufacturing, testing, and field environments.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Application deadline: Oct 12, 2026  
  
Join AWS Hardware Engineering to design the servers powering the world's leading cloud platform and AI/ML infrastructure. We're seeking an exceptional Linux Kernel Engineer to accelerate critical kernel initiatives across millions of servers worldwide.  
  
We are seeking an exceptional Linux Kernel Engineer to join our server firmware team. In this role, you will lead Linux kernel patching, code development, and version adoption for our server management controllers across a massive global fleet. You will ensure our kernel remains current, secure, and compliant with strict patching service-level agreements that directly impact AWS infrastructure reliability. Your work will power the backbone of AWS compute infrastructure, including the servers that enable AI/ML workloads for customers worldwide.  
  
The ideal candidate will be an innovative self-starter with deep expertise in Linux kernel internals, device driver development, and embedded Linux systems. You will gain comprehensive understanding of our server firmware kernel stack and analyze it in both current and future contexts. Using your systems knowledge, you will architect solutions to complex multi-factor problems, including kernel upgrade strategies that minimize customer impact, address security vulnerabilities rapidly, and optimize operational efficiency across millions of servers supporting diverse workloads from traditional compute to advanced machine learning applications.  
  
You will collaborate with engineers across AWS and external partners, leading development efforts that span kernel security, hardware enablement, and platform services teams. Your work will directly contribute to critical initiatives that keep our infrastructure patched, secure, and operationally excellent—ensuring the foundation for tomorrow's AI/ML innovations remains robust and scalable.  
  
AWS Engineers are shaping the way people use computers and designing the future of cloud computing technology – come help us make history!  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Design and develop firmware solutions for AWS servers, contributing to server designs that power millions of customer workloads.  
Lead the complete development lifecycle from initial conception through production deployment, ensuring robust and scalable firmware implementations across our massive server fleet.  
Architect and implement firmware deployment strategies that minimize customer impact while maintaining the highest standards of security and operational excellence.  
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including hardware engineers, validation teams, software services to optimize functionality and performance.  
Explore and evaluate emerging technologies and their potential impact on AWS infrastructure, making recommendations for adoption and integration into our firmware stack.  
Drive technical solutions for problems, balancing security requirements, operational efficiency, and system reliability.  
Tailor firmware solutions specifically for the AWS environment, ensuring seamless integration with our unique infrastructure requirements and operational workflows.  
Mentor team members and contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes, tools, and best practices.  
  
A day in the life  
Most mornings, you'll dive into code—whether that's developing new security features, optimizing firmware deployment strategies, or debugging a tricky issue that's affecting a subset of servers.  
You'll collaborate a lot. Maybe it's a quick sync with platform teams about an upcoming deployment, or a deeper technical discussion with hardware engineers about a new server design. You might work with internal customers to understand their requirements.  
Some days you'll be architecting solutions to complex problems. Other days you might be mentoring a teammate through a code review or exploring a new technology that could improve our firmware stack.

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

* 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

jobs.title: Senior Information Systems Engineer (ISSO)
jobs.description:
Overview:

FTI is a defense technology company seeking an Information Systems Security Officer (ISSO) to support the security of information systems used in defense missions. You will work with technical teams and program stakeholders to maintain security requirements, address risks, and protect the systems and information our customers depend on. You’ll join a team guided by FTI’s 4C’s: Core Values, Commitment, Compassion, and Charity. The ideal candidate brings technical knowledge, attention to detail, and a collaborative approach to supporting secure operations while meeting mission needs.

This position is based at the ENSCO location in Colorado Springs, CO. An active DoD Top Secret clearance with SCI access is required.

Responsibilities:

The Information Systems Security Officer (ISSO) will work on Defensive Cyber Operations for *Space* (*DCO*-*S*) providing expertise and support in network security engineering and/or integration of security products. This is a fast-paced and highly challenging position where you will be a member of a team. The ISSO is responsible for ensuring the appropriate operational security posture is maintained for the assigned IT. This includes the following activities related to maintaining situational awareness and initiating actions to improve or restore cybersecurity posture.

The ISSO:

* Implements and enforce all AF cybersecurity policies, procedures, and countermeasures.
* Completes and maintains required cybersecurity certification IAW AFMAN 17-1303 Individuals in this position must be U.S. citizens.
* Ensure all users have the requisite security clearances and need-to-know, complete annual cybersecurity training, and are aware of their responsibilities before being granted access to IT according to AFMAN 17-1301.
* Maintains all authorized user access control documentation IAW the applicable AF Records Information Management System.
* Ensures software, hardware, and firmware comply with appropriate security configuration guidelines (e.g., security technical implementation guides /security requirement guides).
* Ensure proper configuration management procedures are followed prior to implementation and contingent upon necessary approval.
* Coordinate changes or modifications with the system-level ISSM, SCA, and/or the Wing Cybersecurity office.
* Initiate protective or corrective measures, in coordination with the ISSM, when a security incident or vulnerability is discovered.
* Reports security incidents or vulnerabilities to the system-level ISSM and wing cybersecurity office according to AFI 17-203, Cyber Incident Handling.
* Initiates exceptions, deviations, or waivers to cybersecurity requirement.
* Ability to travel up to 10%.

Education/Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, Engineering, Mathematics or a related technical field is desired.
* 6+ years of relevant experience
* **Top Secret/SCI clearance required.**
* Sec+ required
* Experience working with DoD and/or Intelligence Community (IC) space system acquisition programs.
* Understanding of Risk Management Framework (RMF) and DoD / IC cybersecurity requirements, policies and best practices.
* Experience with IT Security including requirements, architecture and design.

For this role, the annual compensation range for candidates in Colorado is $100K-$163K. Starting pay will be based on a number of factors and commensurate with qualifications & experience. FTI has a location-based compensation structure; there may be a different range for candidates in other locations.

jobs.title: Automation Engineering Technician
jobs.description:
Pay Range: $30.00-$34.50/hour

This position is located in Pueblo, CO

Summary of Role

The Automation Engineering Technician will apply electronic theory, electrical principles, engineering mathematics, computer programming, and troubleshooting expertise to build, test, calibrate, repair, and modify electronic and electro-mechanical systems. This position is responsible for assembling and wiring electrical control systems, programming and troubleshooting automation equipment, supporting prototype development, and assisting with the installation and commissioning of new equipment.

The ideal candidate will possess strong experience in industrial automation, electronic troubleshooting, PLC programming, and machine controls, with hands-on knowledge of Beckhoff, WAGO, and Allen-Bradley control platforms. This role requires close collaboration with engineering, manufacturing, and field service teams to ensure reliable, high-quality equipment performance.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

* Assemble, wire, and test electronic circuit boards, control panels, and electrical systems using hand tools, diagnostic equipment, and surface mount technology.
* Interpret and work from electronic schematics, electrical drawings, wiring diagrams, mechanical drawings, assembly drawings, and Bills of Materials (BOMs).
* Troubleshoot electronic, electrical, and electro-mechanical system failures by analyzing circuit boards, wiring systems, motors, drives, and machine components to efficiently identify and resolve issues.
* Work safely with AC and DC electrical systems, motors, drives, controllers, and power distribution equipment up to 480V.
* Program, configure, modify, and troubleshoot PLCs, stepper motors, servo drives, motion control systems, and Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs).
* Configure, modify, and troubleshoot Human-Machine Interfaces (HMIs), including operator screens, alarms, recipes, trends, user access levels, and machine status displays.
* Perform functional testing, calibration, validation, and troubleshooting of electrical assemblies, control systems, and automation equipment.
* Identify assembly, wiring, programming, and operational issues while providing feedback and recommendations for design and process improvements.
* Support prototype development, machine builds, and transition of products into production-ready systems.
* Solder electronic components and assemblies in accordance with quality standards and manufacturing requirements.
* Install, configure, and support machine software, equipment programming, network connectivity, field hardware, and peripheral devices.
* Work onsite with the Lead Engineer to support installation, commissioning, startup, testing, troubleshooting, and optimization of new machine builds and automated systems.
* Assist with system integration, field modifications, customer acceptance testing, and the resolution of technical issues during equipment deployment.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on equipment reliability, quality, productivity, and safety.
* Maintain accurate records of troubleshooting activities, modifications, testing results, and commissioning documentation.
* Adhere to all company safety, quality, and regulatory requirements.

Required Qualifications

* Minimum of 5 years of experience in an Electronics Technician, Electrical Technician, Controls Technician, or similar role.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience programming, testing, and troubleshooting control systems and automation equipment.
* Strong understanding of electrical systems, industrial controls, and wiring standards.
* Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, blueprints, wiring diagrams, and BOMs.
* Proficiency in electrical board assembly, soldering, repair, and diagnostics.
* Strong troubleshooting skills for electronic, electrical, and electro-mechanical systems.

* Experience programming, configuring, and troubleshooting PLCs, HMIs, stepper motors, servo drives, motion control systems, and VFDs.
* Hands-on experience developing and supporting HMI applications for industrial automation systems, including screen navigation, alarm management, operator controls, data display, and basic troubleshooting.

* Experience using automation software including:
* Beckhoff TwinCAT
* WAGO CODESYS
* Allen-Bradley Studio 5000 and RSLogix
* Working knowledge of industrial communication protocols including:
* EtherCAT
* Ethernet/IP
* Modbus TCP
* Profinet
* TwinCAT
* Basic understanding of AC and DC circuits, motors, drives, and controllers operating up to 480V.
* Competent knowledge of CE and UL requirements and industrial safety standards.
* Familiarity with hydraulics and pneumatics.
* Experience supporting prototype builds, machine commissioning, and equipment startup activities.
* Strong computer and networking skills with the ability to diagnose communication and software-related issues.
* Ability to travel as needed to support machine installations, commissioning, and customer startup activities.
* Excellent problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree or technical certification in Electronics Technology, Electrical Engineering Technology, Industrial Automation, Mechatronics, or a related field.
* Experience with HMI development, industrial networking, and operator interface design.

* Experience commissioning automated manufacturing equipment.
* Knowledge of machine safety systems and risk assessment practices.
* Familiarity with vision systems, sensors, and industrial robotics.
* Experience in a manufacturing or OEM machine-building environment.

Physical Requirements

* Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.
* Ability to stand, walk, bend, climb, and work in industrial environments for extended periods.
* Ability to distinguish wire colors and perform detailed electrical work.
* Ability to work around energized electrical equipment while following established safety procedures.

**Job Summary:** As the Senior RF Communications Systems Engineer and **TT&C Technical Lead** , you will have primary technical responsibility for the architecture, design, development, integration, verification, and operation of the spacecraft Telemetry, Tracking, and Command (TT&C) communications subsystem.

You will lead the development of the **end-to-end TT&C architecture** , translate mission and spacecraft requirements into subsystem requirements and interfaces, and lead the RF communications engineering team responsible for delivering the subsystem. This role requires a combination of strong RF/microwave technical expertise, spacecraft communications systems engineering, architectural thinking, and technical leadership.

The successful candidate will work closely with spacecraft systems, avionics, GNC, flight software, power, thermal, ground systems, and mission operations teams to develop a robust, reliable, and scalable TT&C solution from concept through on-orbit operations for a large scale constellation.

* Develop TT&C **CONOPS and communication scenarios** , including command, telemetry, tracking, acquisition, safe modes, nominal operations, contingencies, and ground-station interactions.
* Lead **RF communications architecture and technology trade studies** , evaluating alternative architectures and technologies against mission requirements and system-level constraints.
* Lead end-to-end **RF link budget and communications performance analysis** , including transmit power, antenna gain, path loss, atmospheric losses, noise temperature, receiver sensitivity, link margin, data rate, and availability.
* Lead RF cascade analysis, including gain, noise figure, dynamic range, compression, phase noise, spurious performance, and intermodulation products.
* Define and manage **RF and TT&C interfaces** with the spacecraft bus, avionics, flight software, GNC, power, thermal, and ground systems.
* **Lead and mentor the RF communications engineering team** , establishing technical direction, priorities, development plans, and engineering processes.

* Review and approve RF designs, analyses, simulations, test plans, and verification results.
* Lead the development and execution of **TT&C integration and verification plans** , including component, subsystem, spacecraft-level, and end-to-end testing.
* Support spacecraft integration, test, troubleshooting, launch readiness, commissioning, and **on-orbit TT&C operations** .
* Lead resolution of complex RF and communications system issues and coordinate technical decisions across engineering disciplines.
* Establish and maintain TT&C architecture documentation, requirements, interface control documents, link budgets, CONOPS, trade studies, test plans, and verification matrices.
* Identify technical risks and develop mitigation strategies throughout the TT&C development lifecycle.
* Work with program and systems engineering leadership to establish **team staffing, technical capabilities, and resource requirements** for the RF/TT&C organization.
* Mentor engineers and develop the technical capabilities of the RF communications team.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, RF/Microwave Engineering, or a related discipline.
* **10+ years of professional experience in RF communications systems engineering, RF/microwave engineering, or a related field.**
* Demonstrated experience leading or owning the **architecture of RF communications or TT&C systems** .
* Demonstrated experience developing **end-to-end RF communications architectures and link budgets** .
* Experience defining, allocating, and verifying **system and subsystem requirements** .
* Strong experience with RF/microwave systems, including antennas, transmitters, receivers, amplifiers, filters, frequency conversion, and analog signal chains.
* Strong understanding of antennas, RF propagation, microwave engineering, and communications systems.
* Experience with RF simulation and analysis tools such as Keysight ADS, AWR Microwave Office, or similar.

jobs.description:
Space is a warfighting domain. True Anomaly seeks those with the talent and ambition to build the technology that secures it.

OUR MISSION

True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.

OUR VALUES

* **Be the offset.** We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity.
* **What would it take?** We challenge assumptions to deliver ambitious results.
* **It’s the people.** Our team is our competitive advantage and we are better together.

BENEFITS & PERKS\*

* **Best-in-class healthcare:** 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents, with HSA/HRA options
* **Generous time off:** Flexible Time Off (FTO) for exempt employees, accrued PTO of up to 25 days for non-exempt employees, plus 12 paid holidays; Parental Leave; Sick Leave
* **Fuel for your day:** Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks for in-office employees
* **And more:** 401(k) retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, and Dog Fridays
* **Equity participation:** Equity is included as part of our total compensation package, giving you an opportunity to share in the company’s success.

* Do not apply to fixed term and temporary roles

**YOUR MISSION**

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Digital Engineering team, you will be the senior technical hand building the in-house software behind our digital thread — full-stack applications that become our systems of record for product, manufacturing, and operations data, and the services and integrations that connect them across the product lifecycle. You will set technical direction alongside the principal engineer, architect for scale, reliability, and security, and raise the engineering bar for a growing team while staying deep in the code.

The work goes well beyond connecting tools. Integrations bridge the off-the-shelf systems we run today; the larger job is building the software that takes their place. You will regularly face the question “How do we build software our engineers, buyers, and technicians would rather use — while keeping product data authoritative and traceable?” The data models, applications, and patterns you establish will define how product data is created, changed, and used across the company for years.

This is an ideal role for a senior full-stack engineer who wants deep ownership of foundational products and the platform beneath them, enjoys mentoring, and is energized by building something new in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment. You'll work in an AI-native environment where using AI to accelerate your impact is expected.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Architecture & Design**

* Design the domain data models and workflows for in-house systems of record — parts, revisions, BOMs, change orders, and as-built records — with lifecycle states and end-to-end traceability.

* Architect the services, APIs, integrations, and event-driven data flows that connect our applications with the off-the-shelf tools they work alongside and, over time, replace.

* Own significant parts of the network, infrastructure, and security design, including role-based access and audit for export-controlled data.

**Technical Execution**

* Build and ship full-stack applications end to end — data model, services and APIs, workflow, and web user interface — and operate them in production.

* Plan and execute migrations from off-the-shelf tools to in-house software: data migration, parallel operation, and cutover, without breaking traceability.

* Build in observability, auditability, sync health, and data-quality checks as first-class features.

* Set and uphold engineering standards — code quality, testing, reviews, and technical documentation.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Mentor senior and early-career engineers and raise the technical bar across the team.

* Work directly with engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing users to understand real workflows and ship software that fits them.

* Partner with the teams that own today's engineering and business systems to design integrations and plan migrations that respect how those systems are run.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 8+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record designing and shipping production applications, services, and system integrations.

* Experience building user-facing web applications end to end — from data model and APIs to a modern front end (e.g., TypeScript, React).

* Deep experience with API design, event-driven architectures, and reliably moving and transforming data between disparate systems.

* Strong grasp of domain data modeling for complex, versioned records, and of keeping data consistent and traceable across multiple systems of record.

* Experience building for observability, auditability, and data quality in production.

* Cloud and infrastructure fluency (e.g., AWS), plus strong fundamentals across networking, security, and CI/CD.

* Proficiency in one or more modern programming languages (e.g., Go, Python).

* Track record setting technical direction across multiple services or teams and mentoring other engineers, including senior engineers.

* U.S. Citizen or lawful permanent resident (U.S. Person) as required under ITAR.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience building, extending, or integrating PLM, ERP, manufacturing execution (MES), requirements/ALM, or MBSE systems.

* Experience migrating an organization from an off-the-shelf system to in-house software, including data migration and user adoption.

* Strong product sense and experience working directly with engineering, manufacturing, or operations users.

* Familiarity with digital thread / digital engineering concepts and product-lifecycle data.

* Experience with Go and building products from an early stage.

* Lead projects from scoping through delivery, breaking down work and keeping it moving.

* Carry out parts of migrations from off-the-shelf tools to in-house software, including data migration, parallel operation, and cutover.

**Job Summary**

The Robotics Software Engineer develops and maintains software for GPSI autonomous underwater vehicle systems. The position supports a ROS2-based software stack running on embedded Linux, with responsibilities spanning navigation, state estimation, sensor integration, deployment infrastructure, autonomy, and mission software. The role works across software and hardware boundaries and supports development through in-water testing and field deployment.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in robotics, computer science, engineering, or a related field.
* One to seven years of professional experience, or equivalent graduate research, working with physical robotic systems.
* Professional or research experience developing software in C++ and Python within a ROS or ROS2 environment.
* Experience working with embedded Linux and debugging software-to-hardware interfaces.
* **Must be a United States citizen.**

**Primary Job Duties**

**Navigation & State Estimation:**

* Develop, evaluate, and maintain algorithms for sensor fusion and coordinate-frame management across a multi-sensor suite operating in GPS-denied environments.
* Support evaluation and troubleshooting of navigation, state-estimation, and controls behavior using test data and physical vehicle results.

**Sensor Integration:**

* Develop and maintain driver-level software for vehicle sensors and embedded communication interfaces.
* Diagnose integration issues across application software, operating-system services, firmware interfaces, and connected hardware.
* Collaborate with cross-domain personnel to incorporate physical design changes and new sensors into the software stack.

**Systems & Infrastructure:**

* Build and maintain development and deployment tooling for a multi-vehicle fleet, including build pipelines, containerized development environments, device provisioning, and process management on embedded targets.
* Support repeatable software configuration, deployment, and troubleshooting across development and fielded systems.

**Autonomy & Mission Software:**

* Contribute to higher-level software governing mission execution, vehicle safety protocols, and communication with operators.
* Support autonomy architectures, mission planning, simulation, and vehicle-behavior testing as assigned.

**Required Knowledge and Skills**

* Proficiency in C++ and Python in a ROS or ROS2 environment.
* Firm grasp of state estimation, sensor fusion, or controls and the ability to reason about system behavior from first principles.
* Experience working with embedded Linux and comfort operating at the OS level.
* Ability to debug problems that cross abstraction layers, from algorithms to hardware communication.
* Self-directed and comfortable working in a small team with significant individual responsibility.
* Clear technical communication and documentation skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with marine, underwater, or field robotics.
* Familiarity with inertial navigation, acoustic sensing, or subsea communication systems.
* Experience with simulation frameworks for robotic vehicles.
* Background in autonomy architectures, behavior trees, or mission-planning systems.
* Experience with cross-compilation, containerized workflows, or CI/CD for embedded targets.

**Physical Demands and Work Environment**

This role involves extended periods of computer-based work in an office or engineering-lab environment and may include work around electronic equipment, autonomous underwater vehicles, test fixtures, docks, boats, or waterfront test locations. The position may require occasional lifting of equipment or materials weighing up to 25 pounds and participation in field or in-water test activities. Reasonable accommodation may be made as required.

This individual will have a demonstrated track record supporting defense programs across the full product lifecycle—from requirements development and architectural design through integration, qualification testing, and transition to production.

The Leidos St. Petersburg facility specializes in the design, development, modeling and simulation, analysis, prototyping, and testing of advanced electronic systems. Our primary focus areas include embedded communications systems, Software Defined Radios (SDR), and Phased Array Antenna Systems supporting Department of Defense and commercial customers.

Primary Responsibilities:

  

* Participate in a multi-disciplinary engineering team developing secure, high-performance military communications hardware and firmware.
* Analyze and decompose system-level requirements into detailed hardware design specifications with full traceability.
* Perform Logic Design; write VHDL code, perform synthesis, logic simulation, test bench generation, functional testing and hardware debugging of designs within FPGA/CPLD devices.
* Architect, implement and test embedded firmware /software within FPGA-based digital designs including signal processing, control logic, and high-speed interfaces on a variety of platforms (FPGAs, microcontrollers, microprocessors, and mixed signal designs).
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex hardware, firmware / software and integration issues across prototype and production phases.
* Support design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR), technical documentation, and configuration management processes.
* Provide technical input for cost estimates, schedules, and risk assessments.
* Collaborate closely with Firmware, Software, RF, systems, and test engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle.

Clearance Requirements:

  

* U.S. Citizen required.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret Security Clearance.
* Active Secret clearance preferred.
* Ability to obtain Top Secret clearance preferred.

Required Qualifications:

  

* BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
* 8+ years of experience in embedded hardware and digital design (10+ preferred for Senior level).
* Experience supporting full product development lifecycle including:
  + Requirements analysis, System design and hardware implementation, Integration and test
  + Firmware/software architecture development for embedded systems, including FPGAs and SoCs
  + Technical documentation and formal design reviews
* Strong VHDL, FPGA/SoC design and implementation experience:
  + Digital logic design using VHDL/Verilog with System-On-Chip devices (SoC’s), FPGA’s, CPLD/s, and/or Microcontrollers.
  + Modern vendor design tools (IDE’s) such as Xilinx Vivado, Vitis, STM, Libero SoC, Lattice Diamond
  + Simulation and Testbench generation (Xilinx simulator, Aldec Active HDL, Riveria Pro, Modelsim, or similar)
  + RISC microprocessors architectures (ARM Cortex, Microblaze, PowerPC, RISC-V)
  + C/C++ language software development for embedded, real-time systems.
* Experience with one or more of the following:
  + Integrating and troubleshooting digital subsystems within embedded systems.
  + Digital interfaces such as I2C, SPI, RS-232/422, USB, Ethernet
  + ADC/DAC devices and understanding performance characteristics.
  + Hands-on lab experience debugging hardware using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and related tools
* Understand trade-offs of embedded system targets (FPGA, SoC, microcontroller, RTOS, bare-metal) for developing best cost/option architectures

Preferred Qualifications:

  

* Active Secret or Top Secret clearance.
* Proven experience in full-stack FPGA development for Xilinx UltraScale/UltraScale+ architectures, spanning RTL design (VHDL/Verilog) and embedded C/C++ development for bare-metal, FreeRTOS, or embedded Linux environments (PetaLinux, etc).
* Experience with one or more of the following:
  + Design and development with other FPGA/CPLD vendors such as Microsemi, ST-Micro, Lattice, etc
  + High-speed interfaces/protocols such as PCIe, JESD204B, LVDS, and SERDES
  + Simulation and modeling tools (MATLAB, Python, LabVIEW)
  + Implementing signal processing concepts such as digital filters, digital modulation, up/down conversion within HDL designs
  + IP cores and modern processor interfaces (Xilinx IP Cores, AXI4, AXI-Stream or similar)
  + Design, integration and testing electronic circuits within embedded systems, including digital, analog and radio frequency (RF) subsystems.

* Experience with the Cooperative Engagement Capability Naval communications system.

* Experience transitioning prototype designs into production hardware

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. The Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) team are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all of the robotics and material handling equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!  
  
About the Role:  
As an Automation Engineer, you will play a crucial role in maximizing equipment reliability and operational performance in our fulfillment centers by providing proactive controls automation and technical support. Your expertise will be essential in troubleshooting complex control systems, analyzing performance metrics, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize material handling equipment (MHE) systems and implement innovative projects. You'll work with state-of-the-art technology, including conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print and apply systems, and SCADA devices and programs. Through your efforts, you'll directly contribute to ensuring our customers receive their orders with Amazon's signature speed and accuracy.  
  
What Do We Offer?  
Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there’s more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  

* You will serve as the site expert for maintaining the automation systems that are critical for operations
* You will understand, maintain and troubleshoot material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers and industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems
* You will monitor MHE metrics and partner with maintenance/operations to address system performance issues and provide analysis across all operations
* You will provide first-level escalation support for site technicians, both locally and remotely
* You will perform and analyze building System Assessments to enhance material handling system performance

* Experience with HMI and control network components, including maintenance, troubleshooting, programming and design
* Experience identifying, maintaining, troubleshooting, and modifying Motor Controls including motor starters, Variable Frequency Drives, DC drives, and standard electrical components

* Experience interpreting and modifying mechanical and electrical drawings
* Experience programming with RSLogix5000, Studio 5000, FT View, and other controls software platforms

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of the Lunar Permanence business unit, which develops Blue Origin’s Blue Moon landers and related products. To further Blue Origin's mission of millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth, we are building sustainable infrastructure for our transport of crew and cargo from Earth to the lunar surface.

We are a team of collaborators, doers, and problem-solvers who are dedicated to a culture of safety. This role plays a crucial role in the history of space exploration and demands a dedication and meticulous focus on safe and repeatable spaceflight. **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or another technical field

At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

The Boeing Defense (BDS), Security, Space, Intelligence & Weapons Systems (SI&WS) is seeking multiple **Senior Systems Engineers** to join our Experimental Systems Group (ESG) at **Kennedy Space Center, FL**.

At Boeing, our Systems Engineers drive the innovation, development, evaluation, and end-to-end execution of validation methods and test systems across manufacturing, refurbishment, integrated vehicle testing, and operational checkout. In this role, you will operate across multiple engineering disciplines to verify system-of-systems performance, serving as the technical bridge between design intent, physical hardware validation, and flight readiness through the following responsibilities.

**Position Responsibilities:**

* Define, decompose, and coordinate system-level test and verification requirements derived from customer, mission, and operational needs
* Integrate cross-functional parameters across electrical, mechanical, fluids, thermal, and software interfaces to verify end-to-end compatibility and functional integrity
* Lead specialized analyses including safety, reliability, maintainability, testability, survivability, and requirement certification to optimize configurations for mission success
* Govern requirements management and verification tracking using formal tools, risk/opportunity frameworks, and readiness assessments to ensure complete verification closure

* Represent the system test organization directly in the factory, test cell, and post-production environments throughout hardware builds, integrated functional testing, and refurbishment cycles
* Lead dynamic system test operations, translating complex flight and ground environments into actionable test procedures, instrumentation strategies, and acceptance criteria
* Author technical dispositions and engineering deviations for hardware non-conformances, operational limit exceedances, or test anomalies to maintain operational cadence without sacrificing safety or quality

* Lead rapid root-cause analysis (RCA), failure investigation, and multi-system troubleshooting to diagnose complex operational anomalies and flight hardware defects
* Identify, develop, and deploy continuous upgrades to test infrastructure, instrumentation setups, and operational processes to improve test cadence, reliability, and mission throughput

**Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):**

* Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology (including Manufacturing Technology), Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry or non-US equivalent qualifications directly related to the work statement
* Active U.S. Top Secret / SCI security clearance (investigation active or open within the past 24 months; U.S. citizenship required)
* 7+ years of experience in an engineering role
* Ability to analyze and interpret engineering drawings, schematics, wiring diagrams, and parts lists
* Strong skills in engineering analysis, requirements tracing, and technical communication

**Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):**

* Expertise in system-level tests and verification of space vehicles or space systems
* Refined cross-functional leadership skills and experience working with multi-disciplined teams
* Expert in aerospace avionics, electrical systems, and RF equipment
* Subject matter expert for approved repair and testing techniques for electronics and components
* Experience with hardware and software requirements verification using tools like DOORS
* Scripting experience for test automation or data processing (e.g., Python, Tcl/Tk, Perl)
* Experience with configuration management and tracking tools (e.g., Git, SVN, PLM, Jira, MS Project)

**Conflict of Interest:**

Successful candidates for this job must satisfy the Company’s Conflict of Interest (COI) assessment process.

Boeing is a Drug Free Workplace where post offer applicants and employees are subject to testing for marijuana, cocaine, opioids, amphetamines, PCP, and alcohol when criteria is met as outlined in our policies*.*

jobs.title: Instrumentation & Controls Engineer I
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we're building rockets to serve today's needs and tomorrow's breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that's just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven't been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you're in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you'll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we're writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it's early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

**About the Team:**

The Launch team operates at the intersection of every major aspect of Terran R, from stages and payloads to ground systems, launch, landing, and refurbishment. The Cape is the only place where you see it all come together, offering a level of exposure and responsibility unmatched elsewhere in the program. This is where first flights happen, where history is built on top of history, and where the scale of what's underway is unlike anything in modern aerospace. The mission stays the same, but the work evolves with every milestone: from first launch to reuse, high-cadence operations, and beyond. If you're looking to define what's next in space launch and write a new playbook, not just repeat what's already been done, this is where it happens.

**About the Role:**

* Design, develop, test, integrate, and operate launch control and acquisition hardware, instrumentation, and cameras used to support and control the Terran R rocket.
* Work with Beckhoff PLCs or similar systems.
* Support high-speed data acquisition.
* Work with instrumentation including pressure, temperature, flow, level, accelerometers, solenoid valves, VFDs, and heaters.
* Integrate and operate IP, SDI, and CoaXPress high-speed cameras.
* Assist in the design of electrical systems for use in hazardous areas.
* Collaborate with other groups to gather requirements, plan schedules, and coordinate work.
* Plan, install, and operate wiring and hardware in access-limited areas such as launch mounts and transport erectors.

**About You:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or another related STEM discipline.
* Exposure to data acquisition hardware, PLC-based control systems, complex camera systems, and instrumentation selection and troubleshooting.
* Ability to work with multidisciplinary groups in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

**Nice to haves but not required:**

* Experience with the design and operation of spacecraft and launch vehicle infrastructure.
* Experience working at a rocket launch site.
* Proficiency with electrical schematic design software such as AutoCAD Electrical, EPLAN, or Zuken E3.

**Successful candidates must clear a background check administered by the US government to obtain clearance for on-site work at our government partner location in Cape Canaveral, Florida.**

**We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.**

***If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact us at*** ***accommodations@relativityspace.com******.***

***Please note: Relativity Space does not accept unsolicited resumes, candidate profiles, or referrals from recruitment agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited submission - via email, our website, social media, or directly to an employee - will be deemed the property of Relativity Space, and no fee will be owed absent a current, fully executed agreement with Talent Acquisition that specifically authorizes submissions for the applicable role.***

jobs.title: Flight Software Engineer – Command & Control
jobs.description:
Hermeus is a venture-backed defense aviation company reclaiming the lost art of rapid iterative prototyping to build the fastest aircraft in the world today. By prioritizing relentless hardware iteration, we deliver high-speed systems at the pace of the modern battlefield. We work with the Department of War to provide the high-speed capabilities our nation and its allies need to maintain a durable, asymmetric advantage.

**About The Role:**  

We are seeking a Software Engineer to join our Command & Control team in Atlanta. The team is responsible for the design, development, integration, testing, and delivery of software supporting Human Machine Interfaces (HMI), Pilot Vehicle Interfaces (PVI), Command & Control (C2), telemetry, and vehicle communications.

This role will focus primarily on the embedded flight software and networking that enable communication between our aircraft and ground control systems. You will develop software supporting command and control, telemetry, network management, RF communications, and vehicle data links while working closely with avionics, RF, flight software, and ground systems engineers.

This is not a traditional voice communications role. You will work on the software and network infrastructure that allow an air vehicle and ground control station to reliably exchange commands, telemetry, and other mission-critical data.

The ideal candidate is comfortable moving between embedded C/C++ development, network and communications system design, and hands-on testing with target hardware. You will have ownership across both the vehicle and ground sides of the communications network and will help take systems from initial architecture through integration and flight operations.

### **Responsibilities:**

* Develop and maintain embedded C/C++ software supporting aircraft communications, telemetry, Command & Control, and vehicle data links.

* Design and implement software that enables reliable communication between aircraft and ground control systems.

* Own and support networking functionality across both vehicle and ground-based systems.

* Develop software interfaces for radios, transmitters, receivers, and other communications hardware.

* Integrate and troubleshoot RF communications systems in collaboration with RF and avionics engineers.

* Develop and maintain network management functionality including Ethernet, TCP/UDP, multicast, and related networking protocols.

* Develop software requirements, system architectures, interface definitions, and technical design documentation.

* Participate in software and system design reviews and communicate technical tradeoffs across multidisciplinary teams.

* Test and debug software on target hardware, including Software-in-the-Loop (SIL), laboratory, and integrated hardware environments.

* Develop and execute system-level tests to verify communications performance and reliability.

* Support integration, troubleshooting, and testing of aircraft and ground station communications systems.

* Write efficient, maintainable, well-documented software that meets performance and safety requirements.

* Participate in the development and verification of safety-critical software.

* Own technical schedules and roadmaps for assigned software and communications capabilities.

* Support flight test and range operations as required.

* Travel up to approximately 25% to support integration and test activities.

### **Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical field.

* Professional experience developing embedded software in C and/or C++.

* Strong understanding of software fundamentals including memory management, pointers, references, and object-oriented programming.

* Experience developing, debugging, and testing software that interfaces with hardware.

* Familiarity with networked or distributed systems and common communications concepts.

* Experience working in Linux-based software development environments.

* Ability to independently troubleshoot complex software and hardware integration issues.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across software, hardware, and systems engineering teams.

### **Preferred Skills and Experience:**

* Experience with real-time operating systems (RTOS) and developing or testing software on target hardware.

* Experience with aircraft, spacecraft, robotics, autonomous vehicles, defense systems, or other embedded platforms.

* Experience with vehicle communications, telemetry, Command & Control, or data-link systems.

* Experience with aerospace telemetry standards or protocols such as CCSDS or IRIG.

* Experience with serial communications, CAN, Ethernet, TCP, UDP, or similar protocols.

* Experience with multicast networking, including IGMPv3, Source-Specific Multicast (SSM), or related technologies.

* Experience interfacing software with radios, particularly Software Defined Radios (SDRs).

* Experience writing software used to configure, command, monitor, or control RF communications hardware.

* Familiarity with RF communications concepts and troubleshooting communications links across software and hardware.

* Experience with satellite communications, cellular communications, or other wireless data-link technologies.

**Company Overview:**  
Coreforce is an innovative technology company providing public safety organizations a comprehensive technology suite from dispatch to the courtroom. Coreforce delivers integrated technology designed to support public safety entities, regardless of organizational size. Our products - body cameras, in-car videos, mobile routers, and digital evidence systems- help public safety officers and first responders save lives, strengthen community trust, and enhance accountability.

**Embedded Engineer II****-** Build Your Career with Purpose

Join Coreforce and use your engineering skills to support innovative technology that strengthens communities.

**Why You’ll Love Working Here:**

* Flexible hybrid schedule.
* Free chef-inspired lunch Monday–Thursday.
* 15 PTO days + floating holiday.
* Competitive benefits: medical, dental, vision, 401(k). We provide 401(k) matching per the terms of the 401(k) plan.
* Annual bonus.
* Tuition reimbursement.
* Career growth in a fast-growing, mission-driven company.
* Collaborative, purpose-driven culture.

**Responsibilities:**

* Design, implement, and deliver firmware features end-to-end in C/C++ for bare-metal and embedded Linux platforms with limited supervision.
* Own small firmware subsystems or components — including their testing, documentation, and maintenance.
* Develop, integrate, and debug device drivers for peripherals such as sensors, radios, storage, and communication interfaces (I²C, SPI, UART, USB, CAN, Ethernet).
* Perform board bring-up tasks independently — including bootloader configuration, peripheral initialization, and hardware validation for known platform variants.
* Implement and tune interrupt handlers, timers, and low-level scheduling mechanisms to achieve reliable, deterministic behavior. Use debugging and measurement tools — oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, JTAG/SWD, protocol analyzers — to diagnose and resolve hardware/firmware interaction issues independently. Collaborate with hardware engineers to review schematics and identify firmware-relevant design considerations.
* Contribute to board support packages (BSPs), bootloader configuration, and OS integration for embedded Linux and RTOS-based systems.
* Implement error handling, logging, and diagnostic capabilities for field debugging.
* Write and maintain unit and integration tests for owned components, using test harnesses and hardware-in-the-loop setups where appropriate.
* Participate actively in design discussions — proposing approaches, identifying tradeoffs, and asking clarifying questions.
* Conduct peer code reviews with attention to correctness, performance, maintainability, and adherence to team standards.
* Break down requirements into technical tasks and estimate work for sprint planning.
* Participate fully in Scrum ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement of team processes.

**Mandatory Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities)**
---------------------------------------------------------------

* Professional experience developing embedded firmware for production or near-production hardware platforms.
* Solid proficiency in C/C++ for embedded systems, including practical understanding of memory management, concurrency, and real-time constraints.
* Experience developing and debugging device drivers for common embedded interfaces (GPIO, I²C, SPI, UART, USB).
* Hands-on experience with at least one microcontroller family (ARM Cortex-M, RISC-V, etc.) and familiarity with bare-metal development patterns.
* Exposure to an RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, ThreadX) or embedded Linux distribution (Yocto, Buildroot).
* Practical experience with low-level debugging tools — oscilloscopes, logic analyzers,JTAG/SWD debuggers.
* Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics and understand hardware behavior relevant to firmware development.
* Understanding of real-time systems concepts including interrupt handling, priority inversion, and timing constraints.
* Experience with Git-based workflows, code review practices, and CI/CD tooling for firmware builds.
* Experience working in an agile/Scrum environment as part of a cross-functional team.
* Good written and verbal communication skills for design discussions, documentation, and code reviews.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with wireless communication stacks (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, LTE, proprietary RF) in an embedded context.
* Experience with Nordic Semiconductor BLE devices and SDK, or similar BLE chipset development environments.
* Familiarity with Android debugging tools (ADB, logcat) for cross-device BLE communication debugging; exposure to Android NDK for native- layer integration.
* Exposure to secure boot, cryptographic libraries, or secure firmware update mechanisms.
* Experience developing firmware for battery-powered or low-power devices, including basic power state management.
* Familiarity with manufacturing test, factory programming, or calibration processes.
* Experience with scripting (Python) for test automation, tooling, or build orchestration.
* Exposure to embedded audio/video capture or camera subsystems.
* Experience integrating embedded devices with cloud services via MQTT, HTTP, or gRPC.
* Experience with rugged, field-deployed hardware or public-safety devices.
* Familiarity with Java or JVM-based languages for companion services, device management applications, or test automation tooling.

**Coreforce is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion.**

jobs.description:
**About Carrier**

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow on Carrier social media at @Carrier.

**About Automated Logic**

At Automated Logic, we've been developing and supporting intelligent building solutions that have helped customers, including small businesses to Fortune 500 corporations, operate their buildings more efficiently for over 40 years. Our products help reduce energy consumption, lower utility, operating and maintenance costs, and improve indoor air quality, occupant comfort, and productivity. Technology that supports the buildings and industry of today and tomorrow requires a wide range of talents and skill sets.

**About this role:**

As an Associate Controls Engineer, you will be crucial to ALC’s business through the designing of building automation systems created specifically for each individual customer. We are looking for someone who works well in a team and has excellent problem-solving, time management, and multi-tasking skills. You will work to build new skills and advance existing skills while completing smaller projects on your own.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and program building automation systems, site-specific configuration of control system, and control algorithms.
* Adhere to project requirements and company and customer standards of design, programming, and implementation.
* Create a clear design document for project teams with technical information.
* Document and communicate the building automation system design and revisions.
* Develop graphical and text-based interfaces for building automation systems.
* Test programming and interfaces prior to implementation.
* Provide technical support to sales representatives to ensure customers’ needs are met.
* Identify and communicate project opportunities and risks.
* Support functional testing for building systems.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Associate or Bachelor’s Degree

OR

* High School Diploma / GED with 2+ years of HVAC/BMS experience
* Must have unrestricted authorization to work in the USA. No visa sponsoring available.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Basic knowledge of primary functions of building automation system software and associated engineering tools, Automated Logic suites preferred.
* Basic knowledge of Automated Logic software, peripherals, add-ons, services, or hardware design.
* Understanding and/or experience with IP networks
* Understanding and/or experience with Microsoft Visio and/or similar software.
* Ability to understand written sequences of operations, diagrammatic depictions of systems.
* Familiar with third-party communication protocols used in building automation, such as BACnet, Modbus, SNMP, LON, N2, etc.
* Able to translate technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Capable of climbing ladders or using other lift equipment over 8 feet above grade, and capable of lifting items up to 50lbs.

**Pay Range**

The annual salary for this position is between $53,000.00 - $106,000.00 annually. Factors which may affect pay within this range include, but are not limited to, skills, education, experience, and other unique qualifications of the successful candidate. The pay range will not be below the minimum wage applicable to the jurisdiction in which the applicant is to be employed.

**Other Compensation**

This position may be entitled to short-term cash incentives, subject to plan requirements.

**Benefits**

Employees are eligible for benefits, including:

* **Health Care Benefits**: Medical, Dental, Vision; Wellness incentives
* **Retirement Benefits**
* **Time off and Leave**: Paid vacation days, up to 15 days; paid sick days, up to 5 days; paid personal leave, up to 5 days; paid holidays, up to 13 days; birth and adoption leave; parental leave; family and medical leave; bereavement leave; jury duty leave; military leave; purchased vacation
* **Disability**: Short-term and long-term disability
* **Life Insurance and Accidental Death and Dismemberment**
* **Tax-Advantaged Accounts:** Health Savings Account; Health Care Spending Account; Dependent Care Spending Account
* **Tuition Assistance**

**To learn more about our benefits offering, please click here** **Work with us | Carrier Corporate****.** The specific benefits available to any employee may vary depending on state and local laws and eligibility factors, such as date of hire and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

**Carrier EEO Statement and Accommodations Process**

Carrier is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status or any other applicable state or federal protected class. Carrier provides affirmative action in employment for qualified individuals with a Disability and Protected Veterans in compliance with section 503 of Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete the application process, participate in an interview, or otherwise engage in the hiring process, please contact us at Carrier.Recruiting@carrier.com. We will make every effort to meet your needs in accordance with applicable laws.

OR

* Able to provide direction and guidance to other team members and lead project teams.

* Extensive knowledge of third-party communication protocols used in building automation (e.g. BACnet, Modbus, SNMP, LON, N2, etc.). Able to design and troubleshoot integrations with the same.
